name: Analemma
short_description: Discover a new, mysterious and unusual world. Pass the tests, open the secrets of the main character and slightly open the veil of secrecy, as well as find the answer to the question - "Who am I? And why am I here? ".

name: Tank Warz!
short_description: Tank Warz! is an arcade shooter that will keep you entertained with fast paced tank destruction, power-ups, traps, secrets, and an energetic rock soundtrack. You'll possibly enjoy hours of arcade fun!

name: I was here
short_description: Test your ingenuity and explore the world from your sofa with our trivia game "I Was Here", where the objective is to guess the place from the photos.

name: Jamie's Dream
short_description: Jamie's Dream is a short, emotional, experimental, psychological horror narrative experience. Walk through nightmares, facing fears and memories as they are revealed going deeper and deeper into the abyss of Jamie's mind.

name: RECHARGE COMPLETE
short_description: RECHARGE COMPLETE is a third/first person shooter featuring a hard-strutting jet-packing android created to destroy job-stealing robots! Blast enemies with homing missiles, lasers and EMP grenades! Jet pack, boost and skii your way through peril. Be the robohero you were made to be!

name: A Boy and His Beard
short_description: A Boy and His Beard is a fast-paced beard fighting experience that lets you steal the beards of your enemies! Survive waves of bearded foes as you collect as many beards and achievements as possible!

name: Printer Forge 3D
short_description: 3D Printer Forge allows anyone to quickly and easily build Miniatures for 3D Printing. Fantasy Miniatures, Mechs, Starships and more!

name: TriElement
short_description: Fire, Ice and Lighting elements often cancel each other out. However, in TriElement the enemy invasion is so dire that even the elements must work together to push them back. TriElement is a casual endless shooter against hordes of germs and viruses.

name: Lost Artifacts - Ancient Tribe Survival
short_description: Lost Artifacts — Restore the ancient city and defeat the dark priest!

name: Code World
short_description: In Code World you control the robot that can walk around the world and send messages to devices. Every device reacts on those messages according to its code. You will have to read this code, understand what messages to send and write your own code.

name: Fantasization
short_description: Fantasization is a team-based roleplaying game with turn-based tactical combat, deep RPG mechanics and an evolving procedurally generated world with multiple factions.

name: Lava Rolling Kid
short_description: Lava Rolling Kid is an arcade adventure platformer inspired by classic retro games. Focusing on innovation, we have given the game a modern feel so that gamers can play time and time again!

name: Text Wormhole
short_description: Text Wormhole is a dodge game of bullet hell generated by the roguelike way dynamically based on the theme of letters, which adopts the minimalist design style. The unprecedented visual spectacle will give you an extraordinary game experience.

name: Bobbi_Cities
short_description: In 10 levels, players can use fireballs, snowballs and boulders to attack enemies in addition to building defensive towers, and can summon reinforcements for defense.The fireball can cause a lot of damage, and a snowball can slow down the enemy, and the boulder can destroy the enemy.

name: Infinite Gravity
short_description: This is a build sandbox game We have hundreds of elements for your choice We offer a variety of materials in building their ideal architectural works for you We will also open survival mode in the future

name: Shark Simulator
short_description: Shark Simulator is a WTF physics sandbox. Play as Ed the shark, and give those tourists a vacation they will remember!

name: VR Racket Ball
short_description: Interesting combination of multiple sports delivering an entertaining experience in VR

name: Reboant Demo
short_description: Please note that this release is a "Early Access Version" of the full game. Reboant is a sci-fi FPS game set in the future. The story centers around the origin of Earth’s civilization. As the main character Wu, the player will join a special task force the ends up being caught in the crossfire or warring alien races.

name: Kamikaze Cube
short_description: Once a cube named Kamikaze decided to discover a dungeon but when he entered the den he realised that it wasn't a dungeon at all - it was the HOUSE OF DETENTION. Our hero, Kamikaze is a seasoned one but even for him these hell-like traps turned out to be a great challenge. Find the exit from this dungeon.

name: Pembrey
short_description: Two young film makers travel out deep into the Pembrey Forest in search for footage for their documentary. Record and document your findings and unravel the truth behind the famous "Pembrey Forest".

name: The Promethium Effect - The Idle Clicker MMO
short_description: Your job as head of the corporation is to take on the role of manager, pirate, and bounty hunter. All for the growth of the corporation. Protect your assets, steal from the weak, post bounties and pay others to do your dirty work to get ahead.

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 1: First Rites
short_description: The Exorcist: Legion VR is an episodic VR experience set in the academy-award winning world created by horror maestro William Peter Blatty. Each chapter features a unique demonic entity that will test your courage and resolve. Available for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Not for the faint-hearted.

name: Battle Master
short_description: A world of Dwarves, Elves, Humans and Orcs. Mounted in the crowns of each race's king are four scattered shards of the Watcher's Tower Gem, which must be returned to its rightful place before the world degenerates into oblivion. Conquer all four races with the army you assemble and lead into battle.

name: Little Adventurer II
short_description: Third-person 3D casual games.which is suitable for people of all ages.Control your little adventurer to help NPC find his items.Knock down the little monster.Or you need to start again.

name: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator
short_description: You appeared on this beach by accident, but it took you 5 seconds to realize one thing: DO NOT let go of your pants.

name: Octopus Bar
short_description: Enter this hidden izakaya bar hidden deep in the magical forest, where the octopus serves you, fish float into the sky, and a frog enjoys your company while smoking his pipe. In this world the impossible is now possible and you are invited to discover the games and enjoy this whimsical scenery.

name: Defend Your Castle
short_description: Defend your Castle against the relentless army of crayon invaders! Those crafty barbarian hordes have amassed their forces once again to challenge your domain. Will you and your court rise to the challenge, or stand aside as they raze your Castle to the ground?

name: Gridiron
short_description: Gridiron is a fast-paced fusion of sci-fi and arcade-style football featuring easy to understand controls and a competitive multiplayer driven online experience. Gridiron supports up to 7v7 action in both casual and competitive online matches, offline practice mode and much more!

name: Social Club VR : Casino Nights
short_description: When you enter Social Club VR : Casino Nights you enter into a high-class Casino, where you can play your favorite casino table games, like Blackjack, Texas Hold'em Poker and Roulette. Play a private game with friends you know, or get to know people from around the world.

name: Slam Fighter II
short_description: In this rhythm/fighting game, The Philosopher’s Burn, the most legendary put down in history, is the prize as the world’s best trash talkers face off in the diss battle of the millennium!

name: Baby Hands
short_description: Hilarious retro parodies! Experience the world through the eyes, ears and chubby little hands of a baby! Crawl your way through a zany retro sandbox experience, filled with imagination and fun! Baby Hands is a funny, family friendly VR baby simulator!

name: The Armament Project
short_description: The Armament Project is a fast paced Science Fiction First Person Shooter.

name: Reverie
short_description: An ambient, very simple game* with pseudo-puzzle elements, something you can leave open on a second monitor while you work.

name: Reginald Does His Thang
short_description: Reginald Does His Thang is a platformer in which Reg gathers scattered pages for his grandfather's final recipe. In a surreal land where cannibalism, vomiting, and creeping kuru are commonplace, Reg chops, explodes, masticates and vomits to see what culinary masterpiece Grampinald's cooking up.

name: BEATris
short_description: BEATris is a puzzle-based rhythm game. Feel the rhythm as you bash the blocks with the power of music! Enjoy various levels with unique soundtracks. Make and share your own level on Steam Workshop.

name: Hordiaz
short_description: Hordiaz is a combination of survival, simulator and role-playing. Explore the magical lands of Solinia, surrounded by dangers, adventures, secrets and deities.

name: I Can See the Future
short_description: This is my job. Dying again and again. But I'm used to it. That's how I can see the future. What's waiting for me? Good question.

name: Dice 1000 online
short_description: This game is a simulator of a board game.

name: Steam Tactics
short_description: Welcome aboard your airship, captain! Engage in tactical combats, upgrade your ships and weapons, level up your pilots.

name: GOD STARFIGHTER
short_description: GOD STARFIGHTER is a fusion of a roguelite and puzzle game. We're the dark soul of space invaders genre. Extremely challenging combat that is logic-based, innovative guns, equipment and enemies, tough choices and light humour - we have it all.

name: Turtle's Quest
short_description: A tale of a Kid who's looking for a treasure by looking for a turtle that he will have to save but first he must find.

name: Offroad Transport Simulator
short_description: Sit behind the wheel of powerful trucks and take care of business. Face a harsh off-road environment and maintain your vehicles and equipment to successfully transport valuable cargo long distances! Be careful to not get stuck in the mud as the time is money and your competition never sleeps!

name: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR
short_description: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR is a brand new simulation game, where you can explore the human body and fight against viruses and infections .The game begins on the emergency class, where a sick man lies, who waiting for a medicine of vital… You will be the medicine capsule which can redound the healing, and you enter into the human...

name: Volseons
short_description: Volseons is a turn-based strategy RPG with a rich and vast story, comprised of six epic chapters of intricate plots, lots of monsters to fight and a handful of characters to play!

name: GHOUL
short_description: What would you say regarding what you have been through; happenstance, or result of your actions ? We can not expect good things to happen to a thief who works with contracts, but this time what she will experience is even different from what you imagine.

name: The Bears And The Bees
short_description: The Bears And The Bees is a debut adventure that follows the heroic exploits of Beesworth, a baby bee who hasn't got his wings yet. Bounce through a hand crafted world in which bears have kidnapped the queen bee, and everyone is relying on Beesworth to get her back!

name: Strange girl beside
short_description: Why is a frustrated teenager always behind closed doors? Why do cohabitation girls always infiltrate into the middle of the night? What kind of sparks will boys and girls scream? In the visual novel "Strange girl beside"

name: A Dream For Aaron
short_description: A Dream For Aaron is a first person shooter with a huge replay value.

name: God of Failure
short_description: Defend your castle from the orcish chavs, lure them into your traps and destroy them.

name: Ingnomia
short_description: Following in the footsteps of Dwarf Fortress and Gnomoria, this game aims to provide the best experience of both worlds. The graphics and accessibility of Gnomoria and the depth and rich content of Dwarf Fortress.

name: Rage Quest
short_description: Zye has awoken in the internet, and the only way to out is to fight past its worst elements and harness its strongest force.... hate. Rage Quest is a real-time, tile-based, combat-focused RPG where you you have to carefully time and chain your abilities for maximum effectiveness.

name: Spirits of Mystery: The Dark Minotaur Collector's Edition
short_description: Find out who stole your magic animals, and reveal the secret of the Dark Minotaur.

name: Dark Realm: Princess of Ice Collector's Edition
short_description: A magic bear summons you to help save the neighboring kingdom of Nypha.

name: BadRobots VR
short_description: BadRobots VR is an action shooter where your goal is to stop the boss from turning robots bad, use your bullet-time ability to finish off larger groups of robots from one wave. Be careful tho, you'll never regain hitpoints after each wave and you only got three charges of bullet-time.

name: Circularity
short_description: Relaxing puzzle with interesting game mechanics - bring your character to the final portal which will transit you to the next level. You will need to move straight, avoid obstacles, jump through portals, ricochet from walls and a lot more.

name: Chewbrick
short_description: Arcade shoot'em up. Dodge ORBs, destroy them with different weapons and superpowers, pick up bonuses and crystals to improve Chewbrick.

name: Low Desert Punk
short_description: A stoner trip in the desert on a 50s chevy pickup. A classical hardcore arcade game where you must to score fleeing and smashing enemies and cleaning your karma.

name: AZURA
short_description: AZURA - exciting adventure story in the genre of RPG. Explore an unknown island. Classic combat turn-based system in the best traditions of JRPG, non-linear plot with the choice of the path and juicy anime graphics.

name: Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity
short_description: A soldier wakes up in darkness with a headache - Where is he, and how did he get here? Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity is a prequel mystery minigame to the upcoming full length RPG Towards The Pantheon.

name: Mirrors
short_description: Mirrors is a light reflection puzzle game where you play as an adventurer navigating your way through the tombs of Ancient Egypt. By reflecting light off mirrors onto a receptacle, you can progress deeper into the tombs where danger waits. Can you find the Pharaoh’s treasure?

name: Mutiny Island
short_description: Live like a pirate. Die like a pirate. Repeat! Mutiny Island is an open-world style pirate-themed game with light survival and RPG mechanics. Explore the Arbor Ocean at your own pace as you devise a plan to reclaim your ship, The Red Dawn, by any means!

name: Towards The Pantheon
short_description: Join Freyja, Bam, Mishima, and Phenez on their journey Towards The Pantheon! Gone are the RPG cliches of potions and elemental powers; in Towards The Pantheon you dive head first into a simultaneously lighthearted, fun, dark, and painful adventure in this fresh and exciting world!

name: WHERE'S PHANTOM THIEF
short_description: Your job is to find the Phantom Thief who is hiding in a crowd of moving characters! Beware though, the thief is known for his special transformation skills! Your mouse-moving skills are key to finding the Phantom Thief!

name: Until the last
short_description: Horror with elements of detective...

name: Mahjong Match
short_description: Mahjong Match is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

name: Squareboy vs Bullies: Arena Edition
short_description: Squareboy vs Bullies is an old school beat 'em up by Rohan Narang that follows the titular Squareboy and his quest for Justice!

name: Clarent Saga: Tactics
short_description: A straightforward SRPG inspired by 16-bit classics and made with SRPG Studio. The storyline follows the armies of Prince Abel of Meyr as he battles Pherrelios who invade them. The third entry of Clarent Saga.

name: The Thing: Space X
short_description: At your disposal are a dozen of the best combat spacecraft equipped with death beams, machine guns and missiles. The sector is divided into several subsectors, which swarm with enemies. In the end, you will have an unbeatable boss - the "Thing".

name: Jung's Labyrinth
short_description: Jung's Labyrinth is a psychological exploration game that uses Jungian psychology, mythology, alchemical and dream symbolism in a series of active imaginations to map the process of individuation. Confront your inner archetypes, collect messages that other travelers left behind and reach your Self.

name: YAGZZ!
short_description: YAGZZ! - it's a cool, platformer, where you have to play for a dark goblin who collects the souls of his enemies!

name: Slingray
short_description: Slingray is a minimalist online sport: the look and feel of vector arcade classics with modern networking, physics, and addictive competition play.

name: IRO HERO
short_description: In a world where humans are used as power supplies, only one man has the will to change it all! Iro Hero is a sci-fi adventure with beautiful pixel art graphics inspired by many old-school classics. Staged across 9 action-packed levels, Iro Hero features a unique and fresh four-color polarity system, with interactive elements, puzzles,...

name: Crazy Scientist
short_description: Crazy Scientist - is a simple, intuitive 2D platformer with original, beautiful graphics suitable for all ages. In this platformer you have to pass a variety of picturesque levels for a mad scientist. Your main mission is to complete levels by gathering vials.

name: The Red Front
short_description: December 1941 - The Third Reich has reached Moscow and are preparing the final invasion. In secret, the Soviet army has constructed a super tank which you will pilot.Leading the charge against the invading Nazi's, defend Moscow, crush the Reich and take the fight back to Hitler himself!

name: Hardcore ZBoy
short_description: You play as a zombie that runs from people, you have to run as far as possible

name: Wasted Pizza
short_description: Wasted Pizza is an Online Multiplayer shooter game where you will be playing as an untouched pizza in a room full of all the other pizzas but be aware you aren't the only untouched pizza out there. Your mission is hiding amongst the other pizzas, spot and shoot tomatos on the other untouched pizzas.

name: Bloody Glimpse
short_description: Bloody Glimpse will take you on a immersive journey through bloody and dark world, the one that you always dreamed of.

name: AMBUSH tactics
short_description: Red Cloud, a shadow, struggles to survive and keep Centralia from falling into chaos in this epic tactics RPG.

name: West of Red
short_description: WEST OF RED will take you on a immersive journey through bloody and dark wild west, the one that you always dreamed of while your bed was getting wet.

name: Panzer Doctrine
short_description: Panzer Doctrine is an unconventional World War II real-time strategy game. It was designed to provide an interesting alternative to turn-based hex grid wargames involving complex military simulation of tank warfare on the eastern front.

name: Crazy Mob
short_description: Crazy Mob is 2 GAMES IN 1: DEFENSE AND RUNER WITH MONSTERS THAT MAY GO ON THE CEILING!

name: Tametsi
short_description: Tametsi is a difficult logic game played on a set of tiles, in which you must use the clues provided to discover and mark hidden mines.

name: Weapon and Armor: Mahjong
short_description: Weapon and Armor: Mahjong is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

name: STARCATCHER
short_description: STARCATCHER is an experimental wave-based arcade game, currently in development. It's simple, unique, and intensely hard. Protect the heart!

name: Cinderella Escape 2 Revenge
short_description: Cinderella is back with a new goddess power. Ready to fight for her innocence and reveal the secret plan of the Prince. Will she get her revenge? Will she accept her destiny?

name: Helltown
short_description: Deliver packages to the weirdly happy folk of Little Vale and discover the terrifying secrets they hide. Are you brave enough to face the many monsters and sinister locations of this first-person horror adventure game? There's only one way to find out...

name: Annual
short_description: This is a classic FPS with all the 90's feel. You are a survivor of a space expedition trying to survive the alien threats at all costs. As you awake from a stasis chamber with only a blaster. Will you survive the horde or become another casualty?

name: Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 3
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 3 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new mixed category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 4
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Mini Mixed Trivia 4 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new mixed category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Strata Spaces VR
short_description: Strata Spaces VR is the ultimate application for modelers and designers to visualize their creations in an immersive, virtual environment. Choose from several different spaces to fill with your creations. Using Strata's innovative COLLADA importer, bring in any models you want to view, stage, and manipulate in VR.

name: Galactic Lords
short_description: Experimental indie strategy game. Lead the group of Galactic Lords through 7 levels to discover the origin of a world-wide menace!

name: Eight Dragons
short_description: EIGHT DRAGONS is an old-school scrolling beat-'em-up for up to eight players! Can you defeat the criminal gangs ruling the city and stop MR BIG?

name: Guns'n'Stories: Preface VR
short_description: Put on your VR device and grab a gun for one heck of a wild n' crazy story heading your way! Dive into your grandfather's memories, who once was an infamous bounty hunter! Relive his glory days full of adventures. Dark humor, steampunk and cowboys – this is the world of GUNS`N`STORIES.

name: Crazy Toad
short_description: A breakout style game with a fun twist. In Crazy Toad you control an old gnome who is carrying a huge mushroom, and your objective is to keep up with the bouncing toad, not letting it fall to the ground.

name: VOID
short_description: VOID is a visual novel themed around espionage and revenge. You play as Arthur Woods, a man seeking revenge from the death of his loved one, forging himself into a deadly assassin. Along the way, you will meet people who may (or may not) be your allies, as you try to untangle the web of lies and intrique surrounding your girlfriends...

name: Blackberry Honey
short_description: A lesbian love story set in Victorian England, featuring maids, music, and finding love in unexpected places.

name: Reign of Guilds
short_description: Reign of Guilds is an indie old-school MMORPG where everyone influences other players and the game world. The game doesn't hold your hand, nor does it impose casual restrictions on players' actions. Here, everyone can find their path to power.

name: SweeperVR
short_description: Minesweeper has finally come to Virtual Reality! Flag, count, and open cells in this fully 3D, yet familiar, reinvention of the classic game. Professional mine-defusers and newbies alike will be able to enjoy the challenges and gameplay of SweeperVR.

name: Flippt
short_description: Flippt is a highly addictive, casual puzzle game. A sequence of colored gems are briefly shown, then you have to repeat that pattern on the tiles below. Simple, right? Not so fast! It's easy to learn, yet difficult to master.

name: The Chemist
short_description: Self taught back alley black market-y concoction mixing can get no better! Become a chemist, see the darker side of chemistry. It's as easy as pouring one thing into another while deciding what to do when parents start eating their babies because the soft body lotion you've made just makes them so tasty.

name: Battle of Red Cliffs VR
short_description: 「Battle of Red Cliffs VR」 provides you with the chance to experience the great battle of Red Cliffs, one of the most historic battles from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Experience the novel gameplay features only available in VR.

name: Halloween Knight
short_description: Halloween Knight is a hack n' slash adventure game mixed with tower defenses where you try to protect your house on Halloween night. You can switch between melee, ranged, and magical attacks on the fly while you battle against the hordes of monsters attacking your house and you.

name: EXAPUNKS
short_description: The year is 1997. You used to be a hacker, but now you have the phage. You made a deal: one hack, one dose. There’s nothing left to lose… except your life.

name: Eliza
short_description: Eliza is a visual novel about an AI counseling program, the people who develop it, and the people who use it. Follow Evelyn Ishino-Aubrey as she reconnects with people from her past, gets to know the people of Seattle who use Eliza for counseling, and decides the course of her future.

name: Trancelation
short_description: A dynamic arcade game set in a neon universe full of fractals and translations! Boost your memory, develop new skills, and improve your scores to become a master of Trancelation in this ever-changing journey through linguistics!

name: Premier Buggy Racing Tour
short_description: Premier Buggy Racing Tour provides drivers with a thrilling off-road racing experience. Hire Drivers, Sell Merchandise, and purchase Upgrades as you earn a reputation and compete for the Premier Buggy Racing Championship!

name: Battlevoid: Sector Siege
short_description: Battlevoid: Sector Siege is an epic straight into action real-time space strategy game, in which the world has been built to deliver a lively battle field; and the action is never more than just seconds away at the start of every game.

name: Sigma Theory: Global Cold War
short_description: A Turn-based Strategy game in a futuristic global cold war from the award-winning creators of Out There. Recruit a squad of special agents and run your intel agency to secure the control of the singularity.

name: Yorkshire Gubbins
short_description: A collection of incomprehensibly daft comedy adventures. Forget about the real world and come to Yorkshire where everything's safe, everyone's clean and those robots are totally, totally normal.

name: Nirvana Pilot Yume
short_description: Nirvana Pilot Yume is the cure for your ‘80s sci-fi anime nostalgia: a retro-synthwave world with space races inspired by the DOS classic SkyRoads and a steamy visual novel of romance and redemption. Raise the volume and turn on the neon lights!

name: 東方憑依華　～ Antinomy of Common Flowers.

name: Nemesis Realms
short_description: Be the massive raid boss in VR, smacking heroes around with your awesome powers. Be a multi-headed dragon spewing fire, or an arcane entity wielding the power to tear down worlds. Only possible in the ultimate VR bossfight game: Nemesis Realms!

name: Dream Alone
short_description: Are you skilled enough to face frequent deaths, survive deadly traps and avoid scary enemies? Enjoy an ultra difficult classic 2D platformer with a dark story! Master your special abilities, enter an alternate reality, and clone yourself to get through 21 hardcore levels!

name: Exorder
short_description: A fantasy turn-based strategy game, fight for Cerulean and claim the crown as her rightful heir! Enjoy hours of our single-player campaign and battle your friends with cross-platform multiplayer. Expand your skills as a commander with the challenge mode.

name: Sand is the Soul
short_description: An unusual adventure game with combat and RPG elements. Everything you do has a result and the so-called right choice does not always lead to good. Accept the consequences of your decisions and explore, fight, die or go mad in the gloomy post-punk Victorian lore of Crosshill.

name: Jewel of WonderLand
short_description: Jewel of WonderLand - The new match 3 game is here, with brilliant jewels in over 600 dazzling puzzles! A magical journey filled with waves of excitement and brilliant visuals! Swap jewels to clear the way, and match pieces to crush each challenge that lies ahead.

name: Gravity Ball

name: El Ministerio del Tiempo VR: Salva el tiempo
short_description: "Save the Time" is a virtual reality experience in which you'll be inside one of the best television series in Spain," The Ministry of Time ". In this experience, you​'ll​ live an adventure in first person​,​ try​ing​ to dismantle the plans of the "Angel Exterminator"​ sect​ ​as they tr​y to change the...

name: The Ultimate Trivia Challenge
short_description: How well do you know your trivia? Test your knowledge in 9 of the most popular categories, including Movies, Music, Sports, People, Places, General Knowledge, History, Science, Spelling, and Famous Quotes. Challenge your friends and family in Party Mode (Up to 4 Players).

name: Grape Jelly
short_description: Dial the highest score, beat all records! But be careful, because with every second the game gets complicated, and you only have 3 lives.

name: Dino Scourge

name: SKIMMERZ
short_description: Battle the enemy 3 rounds at a time in SKIMMERZ. Utilise game changing abilities to turn the tide and unlock each unique skimmer as you progress through colourful arena style maps.

name: Drosoph Hotel

name: Claire de Lune

name: A Collection of Bad Moments

name: Super Dungeon Master Ace RPG

short_description: Built from the ground up for VR, Still Dark At Dawn's highly immersive gameplay will test your grit and ability to trust all of your senses, in a hope survive The Dawn.

name: Divide & Conquer
short_description: You're a walking number and you need to survive. The other numbers will try to make you less than 1. Throw "power downs" at them and collect "power ups" to make yourself bigger. Complete objectives to unlock new levels and worlds.

name: Critters - Cute Cubs in a Cruel World
short_description: Critters is a brutally cute game about you and your cubs. Help your cubs to survive in these beautiful but harsh and unforgiving lands, they need you, but you also need them, to evolve and adapt to what challenges lay ahead.

name: Arena
short_description: Enter the Arena! From the creators of Galaxy Control comes a real-time multiplayer game starring the space stations assault and defence, your favorite Galay Control characters and much, much more.

name: Aggelos
short_description: Critically-acclaimed action-RPG that takes the template laid down by classics like Wonder Boy, nails the 16-Bit aesthetics for nostalgia fans, but updates the mechanics to feel fresh and modern. Explore a beautiful open world and plunder dungeons, caves and forests to help take down epic bosses!

name: Tales of Inca - Lost Land
short_description: Explore an unknown country with your Incas and find lost paths through forests, deserts and mountains! Capture islands, marshes and volcanic landscapes to get closer to their goal.

name: Halloween Pumpkin Story
short_description: Evil spirits on the Day of All Saints give the pumpkin power and send into the otherworldly dark world of nightmare and horror, and what will happen to the pumpkin you will be able to find yourself in the world of the game!

name: Yerah
short_description: Yerah is a indie farming game. You can build your farm, collect resources and process them, take care of your animals or send Warriors into adventures.

name: Power of The Void
short_description: Welcome to Hell! Can you help a little demon escape from hell and go to heaven? He does not want to torture sinners but wants to help lost souls. To do this, he will have to use the power of void and go through hell, purgatory, and paradise, to gain freedom. However, the devil does not intend to give up so simply.

name: Hiro's Harvest Season
short_description: Lola and Benny Hiro are two bunnies that can scare away foxes, wolves and bears.

name: De Mambo
short_description: Spicy Action for 1-4 Players!

name: Lucifer Within Us
short_description: Solve 3 increasingly intricate murders by examining the evidence -- find the motive, the means, and the opportunity. Use testimonies of the suspects as evidence by examining every detail for contradictions... and signs of sin. Purify the possessed. Purge the daemons.

name: A Case of Distrust
short_description: A Case of Distrust is a narrative mystery from 1924 San Francisco. Play as private investigator Phyllis Cadence Malone in this historical 2D adventure game.

name: Reigns: Her Majesty
short_description: Reigns: Her Majesty is the revolutionary follow-up to the smash swipe ‘em up hit Reigns.

name: The Occupant
short_description: You've been sent to the 13th floor of a long abandoned hotel. Abandoned, that is, except for the Occupant

name: Tubular Rift
short_description: Tubular Rift: In the far-flung future race on different planets. In old tubes meant to hit the rift. The rift being another dimension parallel to our own. The rewards are great! The consequences are even greater! Excerpt: 1: The game has full controller support for the Xbox 360 in game.

name: Cyberia 2: Resurrection
short_description: Randomized gameplay - so it's never the same game twice.Action that moves... you can't just shoot your way out of this.Blackout-inducing G-force flying and driving, but don't just hang on or you won't make it.

name: Catch the Thief, If you can!
short_description: Inspired by the classics like Atari’s Keystone Kapers, chase thieves around the town and THROUGH TIME!

name: Trap Labs
short_description: Help Billy get across the room. Dodge series of traps that fire in repeating patterns that tests your memory, reaction, and sense of rhythm. Good luck, don't die, and have fun.

name: Hold Your Own
short_description: A single player open world sandbox, crafting and survival FPS game set in a multi-island land where you'll fight to survive. Build your base, hunt and craft to defend yourself from aggressive wildlife, enemies or friends. Do you have what it takes to Hold Your Own?

name: 三国宏图(Great Cause Of The Three Kingdoms)
short_description: "Great Cause Of The Three Kingdoms" is a strategy game based on the strategy of war and combined with simulation operation (SLG). Players will control the power of the Three Kingdoms during the game, and lead the Three Kingdoms to conquer the Three Kingdoms (or even Asia).

name: Boom Island
short_description: Imagine being stranded on an island in the early 1900's, being a only survivor in a experimental plane crash. However, the island you crashed on is not a normal island, its Boom Island! Engage yourself in this arcade style first person shooter, where the main objective is to shoot explosive balls while surviving.

name: Waiting for the Loop
short_description: A short form visual novel about artificial intelligence, humanity and family.

name: Viral
short_description: A straightforward and exhilarating first-person-shooter game that runs on all platforms (including mobile phones)! Pick a side, join the army of Viruses or White-Blood-Cells, and invade/protect the human body as you defeat your enemies.

name: Sable's Grimoire
short_description: Sable's Grimoire is a visual novel featuring monster girls in a magic academy setting. Play as Sable, an aspiring magic researcher, as he get sucked into the daily lives and troubles of his demi-human classmates.

name: An Adventurer's Gallantry
short_description: Disgraced knight-in-training Oren gets a second chance at life as an adventurer in this fantasy visual novel.

name: Bubble Rush
short_description: A relaxing and addictive puzzle game set in a stylized world that will make you forget your name or why you exist at all. 100 levels played out over 50 stages including the mind bending "Lotus-a-greatus" bonus levels along the way.

name: DEADHUNTERS
short_description: DEADHUNTERS is a cooperative rogueplaying game. Choose your hero, embark on missions and make decisions together. Loot, level up and die again and again in an ever changing world of darkness. Conquer the damned and earn your rightful place in the Guild of Deadhunters!

name: WIL
short_description: Use the SLING- NEW and UNIQUE mechanics ! Help WIL rescue his friends from terrible evil ! Jump right into the action, or roll out of trouble ! Hint: for jumping and speeding up- Use the SLING !All of this and more - exclusively in WIL. (Don't miss the opportunity to: Master the SLING !)

name: Rainbow Snake
short_description: Rainbow snake is a beautiful classic game. Eating food, snake painted in different colors. Collect a colorful snake.

name: SoTo
short_description: SoTo is a challenging game which you need a good plan to pass safely through the path of enemies. In order to collect the keys and unlock the locks, you need to adjust your timing well.

name: 伏雨录：少年篇
short_description: 《伏雨录》是一款2D横版角色扮演类的剧情游戏。在一个宁静的村庄，有两位热血少年，不顾众人反对，毅然踏上了由朝廷举办的“种青”考试之路。然而路途看似平坦，未料上一辈的“前仇旧账”却向他们抛下一张束缚之网。

name: Bloodworks
short_description: Bloodworks is a free top-down survival action game where you fight against an endless waves of monsters. The odds are not in your favor!

name: Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries
short_description: Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries! A hardcore 2D platformer that will mess̢ ̶w̷ith you͠r ̧min͝d̀ and test your skills. Enter a Temple full of devious traps and of course, lots of treasure!

name: GRAL
short_description: GRAL is a futuristic racing game with combat elements, a tribute to the 90s games such as Megarace, POD, DethKarz. Rides fast racing cars that spin 600Mph on articulated tracks with shortcuts, jumps, parabolic and death rides!

name: Kyklos Code
short_description: Kyklos Code is a first person action puzzler where you are reset to your starting location every 10 seconds. You can toggle the reset state of other objects in the world to solve puzzles. By activating new reset locations you can advance through the game.

name: Super Arcade Boy in Defender of Planet Earth
short_description: A Retro Style Classic Side-Scrolling Shoot 'Em Up with Super Arcade Boy's Debut! Fly him through 8 levels while defeating waves of enemies and bosses with amusing dialogue, power-ups, HD graphics and full controller support. Super Arcade Boy's up to the challenge. ARE YOU?

name: AgeOfDarkness
short_description: Age Of Darkness is a Builder/Survival game set in the medieval period. Build up large City's and Town's with over 100 items with more on the way.

name: Artifact Quest 2 - Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: Travel together with Jess to a tropical island and find ancient treasures!

name: Jack B. Nimble
short_description: Jump in the shoes of Jack B. Nimble and master the whip in this cute, retro infinite runner.

name: Domino Dungeon
short_description: Domino Dungeon is a physics based puzzle game where you place and topple domino pieces collect gems and treasure in a dungeon

name: Super Dungeon Boy
short_description: 2D platform game focused on intense combat against enemies and exploration of secret areas in dark dungeons full of dangers.

name: Koboo: The Tree Spirit
short_description: Koboo is a fast paced action rogue-lite platformer where you battle against towering hunters as a small tree spirit by attacking their weak points. Forge powerful synergies, explore the Ancient Forest's branching paths, fish, catch bugs and garden to rebuild your home!

name: Forever Home
short_description: Retro RPG that takes inspiration from SNES and PS1 classics. Action turn-based battle system with skill learning, slots for stat boosting, equipment crafting, monster catching, rank based Colosseum, and side quests. 30+ hour emotional story with adult-oriented themes and powerful original soundtrack.

name: Depopulation
short_description: The world’s pollution is threatening all life on Earth. Employed by a Billionaire, and chosen for your high intelligence and psychopathic tendencies, it’s up to you to save the world by any means necessary.

name: Solar Collector
short_description: Harvest Energy. Sell the energy. Keep up with payments.

name: Nova Flow
short_description: Nova Flow is a First-Person Platformer. Using your Nova Cannon and its powers, you must traverse the terrain, finding the shortcuts along the way to set the fastest times.

name: ZombieThon
short_description: ZombieThon is an arcade shoot ‘em up, with the goal of each mission being to survive as long as possible and to use any means to do so.

name: FoxyLand
short_description: Ah... love, Love... How beautifully in one word. My mind is racing, my stomach flutter butterflies, heart racing. Are you willing to do anything to give a million cherries, collect all the jewels and even save your favorite?

name: Loot Collection: Mahjong
short_description: Loot Collection Mahjong is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

name: LSD
short_description: LSD is the new match 3 game with beautiful juicy anime graphics! Classic light casual gameplay in the best traditions of the genre. Explore casual match3 in company with naked anime girls It's easy to learn. Line up and win!

name: Holopoint: Chronicle
short_description: Holopoint: Chronicle is intense archery combat. Explore the once lively island while skillfully weaving your way through waves of relentless holographic enemies, all while swiftly loosing arrows toward your targets.

name: AWS Argentina Wingshooting Simulator
short_description: Play for the very first time the most real simulator ever made for wing shooting in South-american scenery. Feel the real game in the best spots of the Argentinean marshes shooting the most variety of real ducks.

name: Rockland VR
short_description: Head into the 《Rockland VR》 and experience the most fun of puzzles like never before . You can take your time to stack the most beautiful art work or you can complete it as fast as possible.

name: LOGistICAL: Japan
short_description: LOGistICAL: Japan is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the islands with over 700 towns to Complete. LOGistICAL: Japan game covers the islands of Japan including cities like Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe.

name: Derpy Dinos
short_description: Derpy Dinos is a 2.5D side-scrolling arcade shooter. Smash, throw, and blast derpy dinosaurs. The more carnage you produce, the more points you earn for a spot on the global leaderboards. Protect your ship, collect power-ups, and earn achievements by completing challenging feats.

name: The Survival Test VR: Defend To Death
short_description: “The Survival Test VR: Defend To Death” is a horror defensive shooting game. You have been placed in various dangerous scenes accept survive test ,you will survive or die.

name: Usurpator
short_description: Usurpator – The ultimate extraction melee slasher. Wield powerful weapons, master brutal combat, and battle the forces of Evil. Team up or face off against other players, unlock talents, and forge your path to glory. The land is yours to conquer - will you rise or fall?

name: Scythe: Digital Edition
short_description: Scythe transports you to an alternate reality in 1920s Europa, one ravaged by the First World War. Take up the role of leader by assuming command of one of 5 factions, and set out to conquer the coveted "Factory". Lead your mechs to war and your people to victory!

name: Dark Devotion
short_description: Explore the secrets of a mysterious fallen temple and put your Templar faith to the test in Dark Devotion, where no sacrifice is too great in praise of your God.

name: Driftland: The Magic Revival
short_description: After a devastating war between ancient mages, a powerful spell is all that holds together the shattered planet of Driftland. Take on the role of a powerful mage capable of moving and connecting floating lands, develop a mighty empire, and restore Driftland to its former glory!

name: Magic matchstick
short_description: Minimal puzzle with matchsticks

name: Cultist Simulator
short_description: Seize forbidden treasures. Summon alien gods. Feed on your disciples. Cultist Simulator is a game of apocalypse and yearning. Play as a seeker after unholy mysteries, in a 1920s-themed setting of hidden gods and secret histories.

name: Left&Right
short_description: You have to choose the correct answers while under the pressure of limited time and a destructive sounds.

name: Command: Shifting Sands
short_description: Shifting Sands traces the history of many Arab-Israeli conflicts: from the sidelines of the Suez crisis, through the lightning Six-Day War, the guerilla-like War Of Attrition and the strategic surprise of the Yom Kippur War, all the way to the historic Osirak raid and the epic air battle over the Bekaa Valley.

name: DEATHPIT 3000
short_description: Fight waves of enemies in a sci-fi arena bullet-hell shooter, with up to four friends in multiplayer co-op. Upgrade weapons and equipment and unleash powerful abilities against hordes of distinct and deadly enemies to claim the championships!

name: One Strike
short_description: One Strike is a 2d fighting game with fast and furious gameplay, memorable characters, and a retro pixelart aesthetic! Choose between one of six unique fighters, travel to medieval Japan’s beautiful pixelated landscapes and fight to become the greatest warrior in history.

name: Chop Chop Princess!
short_description: Hand-crafted cartoon violence endless runner about princess adventures in Zephyr Kingdom

name: Epic Battles of History
short_description: Experience a world where the greats of human history collide in epic battles across time. Pick your favourite hero and assemble a team for the ages to duel it out with your friends and unleash the power of your cards to see who among you is the strategic mastermind.

name: Warmonger
short_description: Warmonger is a Free-to-Play PVP MMO with MOBA-style combat in a persistent world. Choose between different factions and many distinct characters with tons of different weapon setups. It's not just a match: It’s WAR!

name: Unrested Development
short_description: Wizard Weather, a cat girl, and a dead guy looking for a sandwich--maybe. Grab a bottle of Rock Cow. You're going to need it.

name: DiamondFalls
short_description: DiamondFalls is a captivating and challenging match-3 puzzle game for enthusiasts of the genre. Players must solve each puzzle by collecting all diamonds and balls of the same color in a specific order within a limited amount of time.

name: Age of Wonders: Planetfall
short_description: Age of Wonders: Planetfall is the new strategy game from Triumph Studios, creators of the critically acclaimed Age of Wonders series, bringing all the exciting tactical turn-based combat and in-depth empire building of its predecessors to space in an all-new, sci-fi setting.

name: Vitamin Girl / ビタミンガール
short_description: Vitamin Girl makes throwbacks to some runner and high speed classics, while making it unique and charming. Reach the end of the road in this high difficulty game, use your Vitamin powers to save the world from the Koko Cola disease, what kind of surprises will you find at the end of the road?

name: Dead Noir the Heart
short_description: Jackson Corpse, a hardened detective-turned-consultant who has seen the best and worst of life, finds himself following a string of murders across Ratliff City in hopes of catching the killer and bringing them down. However, something about these cases seems a bit more peculiar than usual...

name: Prey with Gun 带枪的猎物
short_description: Under command of a young boy to complete his plan and dig out the hidden truth and his motivation. (The English Version of this game will release soon)

name: The Flesh God
short_description: The Flesh God is a tough action platformer where you shoot a massive gun to fly through deadly levels infested with mutant flesh.

name: Gone Astray
short_description: Gone Astray is a First-Person survival horror game which features rich atmosphere, believable interior and exterior environments.

name: Grey Zone
short_description: Become a member of the first space expedition! Go through the path with the main character from the first landing to the final point. Take under your control the colonist Scipio and prove that it's hard for you to break!

name: Drone Infiltrator
short_description: U.S. military is training more drone pilots than jet fighters. Attack drones have become a safer way to protect your country. Now, you have the unique opportunity to fly with one of the most amazing lifelike technologies.

name: Steel And Soul
short_description: Steel & Soul is an Early-Access Singleplayer VR robot simulation game which aims to give the feeling of controlling giant war machine. Hop on robot's cockpit and fight to gain new mechs, weapons, body-parts and even new robots. Goal is to conquer resource stations in the map and protect them from your enemies.

name: Wasteland 3
short_description: Following the critically acclaimed 2014 Game of the Year winner Wasteland 2, the RPG series that pioneered the post-apocalyptic genre in video games returns with Wasteland 3.

name: BlowOut
short_description: Lead your team to a space station that has been overrun by mutated alien parasites. Take out the enemy before they have a chance to zero in on the station's control center and threaten colonized space. Secure the station by eliminating the alien threat.

name: Super Knockoff! VS
short_description: KNOCK IT OFF! It's an all-out clash between the greatest manga icons of 1999! Use your magic, energy, sporting goods, ninja tools, and more to destroy the ground beneath your friends and foes! Featuring a fully-voiced and star-studded roster, this is the battle of the millennium!

name: Lines X
short_description: Beautiful & relaxing Numberlink puzzles.

name: Robot's Mystery
short_description: A game that can touch you in many ways but also a very fun and challenging game , you roam around tthe world looking for answers in a place where evil rules now . While talking to the strangers and going through tthe sttory you will find many answers and will face hard enemies.

name: Duralumin Wind
short_description: Pilot your helicopter to victory as your complete objectives, dodge missiles, and destroy your enemies. But don't forget to keep an eye on your fuel, ammunition, and health or you might not survive.

name: Glorious Noon
short_description: Hack and slash your way through hordes of fantastic monsters as you practice an engaging blend of magic and swordsmanship. Pulverize your enemies to pieces, dodge their sorcery, and gain aptitude over the weapons at your disposal. Arm yourself and use the environment in creative ways as you fight.

name: Hallowed Encounter
short_description: Trick-or-Treat! Or so you thought? Halloween night, last year, Weston Norris lost his daughter. This year, he plans on avoiding the night as the Trick or Treaters come knocking. But, once you sit alone in the screamingly silent darkness on Halloween night, you’ll truly learn what goes bump in the night.

name: Icarus Six Sixty Six
short_description: Icarus Six Sixty Six is an intergalactic musical VR experience.

name: Starcats
short_description: Cooperation is a strategy, not a requirement. Make temporary allies, break promises, and watch out for backstabbers in Starcats, a local party game.

name: Last Chickenburg
short_description: Fight to build your base, gather resources and take back the land that is rightfully yours from the humans who wish to eradicate and enslave you.

name: Beach Cry of VR
short_description: Bikini zombies are coming! “Beach Cry” release upgrade “Beach Cry”, the game was made from Beijing Daxing media has got big update recently. It added level setting, five boss from myths and legends make debuts! Brand new magic theme let the game has a new life, more details waiting for you.

name: Hope is in 23
short_description: Hope is in 23 is a supernatural 3rd-person action game set on an island where humans are hunted and killed for sport. A rift opened from another dimension bringing forth monsters that almost wiped out humanity. Find a way off the island and keep the enemy from learning your secret.

name: Need For Seed: Bird Simulator
short_description: "Need For Seed" is an IMMERSIVE bird simulation experience. Collect as many seeds as you can in singleplayer, or challenge your friends to a battle in the local or online multiplayer modes!

name: 神舞幻想 Faith of Danschant
short_description: A 3D ancient and fantasy RPG console game is created by Beijing Joyfun. Users will have a fabulous adventure and start their own legend in a fictional world based China’s traditional mythology.

name: Winter Warland
short_description: In this free for all multiplayer battle, fight to be the last snowman standing. Use your snowballs to destroy your enemies from far away, or use your carrot as a sword and deal damage up close.

name: Dark Town : Invisible Danger
short_description: 1986 yılında Muğla'da bir köyde yaşanan gerçek bir olay. Köyde insanlar hazine bulmak için şeytani ruhlarla anlaşma yaptılar. O günden sonra hiçbir şey eskisi gibi olmadı. Fakat sen açgözlü olduğun için köye gidip hazineyi çıkartmak istiyorsun. Bunu gerçekten başarabilecek misin ?

name: SoM Soul Of Mask
short_description: Soul of Mask (SoM) is a labyrinth game where the spirit tries to collect Demon eyes to leave the underworld. Controllers: Touch Screen, Keyboard, Joystick. Support of Afrikaan language in game

name: Ebony Spire: Heresy
short_description: Crawl, throw, summon and smash your way through 20 levels of pure mishap in this first person turn based dungeon crawling game! Every item can be used both by the player and against him! And there are more than 100 items (+ stats variations) ranging from potions, to scrolls, weapons and artifacts!

name: Thug Life
short_description: Thug Life is a Virtual Reality First Person Shooter campaign that places the player in a leading role on a film set. The player is given a choice of guns and led through a series of takes by a voice acted film director.

name: Fearful Symmetry & The Cursed Prince
short_description: Fearful Symmetry is a fun puzzle game with a unique brain-teasing twist. Control two characters at the same time; both in different dimensions. It’s up to you to move the characters simultaneously in opposite directions to guide them through treacherous puzzles filled with traps.

name: Medieval Mayhem
short_description: Build your castle and destroy those of your ennemies in this online destruction game. Defeat your ennemies and steal their gold to make it to the top, allowing you to build bigger and bigger!

name: Exoblast
short_description: Exoblast is a mix of shoot’em up and arcade game, pimped with synthwave and pixelart. Choose your pilot, your ship and join the arena to confront other players in nervous and punitive matches. Impose your gameplay and reach the top of the tower!

name: Wizards Tourney
short_description: Wizards Tourney is a party game for up to four players in which different wizards from around the world compete against each other to show who is the most skillful and astute. Test your magical talent and use all your tricks on your rivals to become the best wizard!

name: ADIOS Amigos: Galactic Explorers
short_description: Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Experience the perils and intrigue of space exploration with 1-4 players.

name: Nogard
short_description: Explore the Floating Kingdoms in a low poly 3D platformer with Nogard and try the materia power of the ancient Yksimals. Restore the power of a mysterious land and discover what happened using the power to change your state in an incredible adventure.

name: Home Run Solitaire
short_description: Score a home run today!

name: Necrobarista
short_description: In a back-alley cafe, the dead are granted one last night to mingle with the living. Necrobarista follows a dynamic and diverse cast of characters as they navigate Melbourne's hipstery coffee culture, the questionable ethics of necromancy, and the process of letting go.

name: Psi Project
short_description: Psi Project is a hardcore 2D shooter with elements of horror. The main character wakes up in an unknown place. Absolutely remembers nothing. Who he is and how he got here. Throughout search of answers he is strongly plagued by different kinds of hallucinations.

name: Dance Studio VR
short_description: Dance Studio VR is a virtual reality dancing game. The Player can choose different characters to play as, and can choose their own songs to play. The goal of the game is to mimic the dance moves of the other two characters in the studio. The faster and more accurate the players moves, the faster they win.

name: Zelle
short_description: Zelle is a occult adventure game. You can explore the inside and outside of the castle using adventure game mechanics and battle demons with strategic mouse clicks. Your goal in this game is to bring the protagonist home.

name: Lines X Free
short_description: Beautiful & relaxing Numberlink puzzles.

name: Maddening Euphoria
short_description: A unique, challenging, unnecessarily colourful arcade game with randomly generated circular level design and a wall of death.

name: 𝄞Gaia's Melody: ECHOED MELODIES
short_description: Gaia's Melody is a story about friendship. About bonds, family - lies, deception, and the truth. Overcoming yourself, and accepting. Do you have the courage to accept the truth?

name: Gates of Avalon
short_description: Explore a rich and varied environment as you quest, develop skills, make friends, and battle enemies all as you uncover the mystery of a dark and growing menace. Gates of Avalon is a first person action-RPG, the first module in the Avalon series, a Gates Game Adventure.

name: Slap City
short_description: Slap City is a Seriously Fun platform fighter with a perfect mix of characters from the Ludosity universe. Play Locally or Online. Slap it hard in Ranked or fast and loose in Slap Ball game mode. We are the original inventors of Clutch Technology.

name: Merper VR
short_description: Animate your 3D models intuitively in virtual reality.

name: Morps
short_description: Morps game is 2D pixel art strategy with simple principies of fight and defense. Use your king to control Morp´s world. The future of little creatures and end tyranny of king Gark is in your hands.

name: VS Round 1
short_description: Versus is a fighting game starring comic book characters from Independent publishers/creators. The game is 2d with 3d models featuring specials, parrys and team-ups. You can build a team or run solo but you must make your way through 12 levels beating each character on each team until their health bar reaches 0.

name: Battlegrounds2D.IO
short_description: Battlegrounds2D.IO is the new battle royale 2D experience.

name: DUEL
short_description: This game is for controlling the robot for fun

name: Thundering Skies
short_description: A shoot'em up inspired by the 16-bit classics of the genre.

name: Golf 2D
short_description: Become the king of the swing! Golf2D is a fast and fun arcade game! The goal of the game is to finish a maximum level without losing. To do this, just shoot the ball in the hole before the end of the timing and watch out for the limit!

name: Play With Me: Escape Room
short_description: See how a game created by the very Jigsaw would look like! Use the available objects, outwit tricky illusions and optical puzzles and above all, answer the question – will you dare to Play with Me?

name: Kana Quest
short_description: A Kawaii Kana Match-Em Up. Learn Japanese. Match Kana (Japanese letters) with their sounds. Solve Puzzles.Your quest to learn Japanese starts now!

name: Age of seas
short_description: Space Thieves embarks you on a stellar mission to collect materials through an open world universe, meet the requirements of the demand, create your transport routes and beware of space thieves, many wait to get quick money, since transporting the loads by space can be very dangerous at times.

name: Assembly League
short_description: Choose from over 150 components to include in your killer robot. Design the ultimate robot combat strategy by writing real code. Upload your destructive creation to compete in the online league. Sit back and watch your killer robot wreak havoc in the battle arena.

name: Collide
short_description: Collide is a sliding puzzle game. As an orange square, players must collect all of the coins on each map then slide to the finish, using as few moves as possible. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around the map. Players can create and share their own maps.

name: If Only...
short_description: This VR experience uses the architectural design by M@ STUDIO Architects for the 2016 National Gallery of Victoria (NGV) Architecture Commission titled “Haven’t you always wanted…?” which transplanted a familiar object (a suburban car wash) into an unfamiliar surrounding (the art gallery).

name: Zombie Nightmare
short_description: Defend yourself from waves of zombies! Support SteamVR

name: Ballistic Mini Golf
short_description: Ballistic Mini Golf is a futuristic mini golf game set in a Sci-fi universe with hundreds of challenging holes, advanced ball customization and single-player / multi-player game modes for up to 4 players.

name: COMBAT INSTINCT
short_description: Fight like hell in this real-man fight and adventure game dedicated to hard-core action gamers. Get prepared for lots of deaths, and see whether you’re the talented fighter the galaxy has been waiting for.

name: Path Out
short_description: Path Out is an autobiographical narrative game following the real journey of Abdullah Karam, a young Syrian escaping the civil war in 2014. Abdullah himself comments the game through Youtube-style videos, giving insights into his dramatic travels through Syria's war torn countryside & daily life.

name: No King No Kingdom
short_description: No King No Kingdom – First-Person Strategy Game. Ride Dragons! Command peasants! Build towns! Raise Armies! Tame Epic Creatures! Take your own sword and fight side by side with your troops against powerful giant bosses.

name: Mission Ammunition
short_description: The most secure prison facility in the country is under attack ... The city mayor called personally and asked you to take care of this problem.

name: MinSweeper
short_description: MinSweeper is a minimalist take on the classic Minesweeper. Simple relaxing game play in which you avoid mines on a puzzle board and try to get the best time. MinSweeper also includes 3 minigames

name: CAR THIEF SIMULATOR 2017
short_description: Try the new CAR THIEF SIMULATOR 2017 game!You can learn couple of techniques and test your skills! Hurry up because the cops are coming!This is a really amusing simulator game for you.

name: Hidden Object - Sweet Home
short_description: Help a pretty woman search for lost objects in this hidden object game.

name: Queen's Garden: Halloween
short_description: Night fell, sending shivers down your spine. Will you persist? The Queen counts on your Match 3 bravery!

name: Overcrowd: A Commute 'Em Up
short_description: Design and build the most efficient metro stations known to man! Excavate. Expand. Set staff priorities. And manage the commuter flow. Overcrowd is a 2.5D management/tycoon/simulator set below the bustling city of Lubdon Town.

name: The Under
short_description: In a place unknown to the living, a young boy must navigate The Under so he may return to the world above.

name: Hostil
short_description: Hostil is a short emotional interactive tale about a young astronaut who has crashed on a extremely dangerous planet. No one will come to rescue him and his only hope is to move forward.

name: The Superlatives: Aetherfall
short_description: Lead a superpowered team of "Superlatives" to defend 19th-century Victorian London! Battle a Martian warship, clockwork monsters, and nefarious inventors. Don your mask, take to the skies, and God save the Queen!

name: Unknightly
short_description: Unknightly is a medieval VR stealth game designed from the ground up for virtual reality. You assume the role of a retired master-thief as he is drawn back into a life once thought left behind.

name: Bit Bullet
short_description: Bit Bullet – Is a single player top-down shooter with an escalating difficulty level and complicated enemies, in which you will have to blow up and crush hordes of enemies using various weapons and skills.

name: Ionball 3
short_description: Hack programs and wipe out viruses in cyberspace. Retro arcade gameplay merged with fun new mechanics. Original synthwave score by Tim Moffet.

name: Girl Blonde
short_description: Girl Blonde - It's a nice 3D platformer with a side view. In it you have to play for a girl-blonde and gather fruits, vegetables and other sweets! That would pass the level you must collect a certain number of items, but it is not easy to do because you will interfere with obstacles.

name: Ocean's Crabellum
short_description: Shoot 'em up! The former soldier Crab have to holster up his old Parabellum guns. He must wreak massive havoc to clean up the Big Ocean from villains and get revenge for his friends. Destroy the unrestrained mafia gang led by giant octopus in the best tradition of top-down and scroll-action shooters.

name: Alchemist's Castle
short_description: Fight your way through the dungeons of the Alchemist's Castle, collect power ups and take back what is rightfully yours from the Alchemist himself in this old-school metroidvania!

name: BOOBS SAGA: Prepare To Hentai Edition
short_description: Imagine that you're a young woman with some tasty curves; and it can only mean one thing - you're a perfect sacrifice to the Boobs King! Avoid traps, fight monsters or hide from them, solve puzzles, dance. And remember: the main goal is to save your BOOBS! Boobs Saga - is a satirical action.

name: Space2D
short_description: Space2D allows you to create highly detailed space scenes in seconds, generating stars, nebulae, suns and planets on parallax layers. The perfect tool for 2D Games, Visual Novels and more.

name: Scream Collector
short_description: Build up a haunted house in this Halloween themed Idle Clicker game!

name: Creeping Terror
short_description: Trapped below a creepy abandoned mansion deep in the forest, a group of friends find themselves on the run from a terrifying monster. Using only her wits and what's around her, Arisa must uncover the secrets of the mansion, and figure out how to escape...before it's too late.

name: Hero's Descent
short_description: Battle against time in this faced-paced retro-inspired Rogue-like

name: Choice of Broadsides
short_description: A swashbuckling naval adventure, in the spirit of C. S. Forester's Hornblower or Patrick O'Brian's Aubrey/Maturin books, with a dash of Jane Austen.Choice of Broadsides is a 60,000 word interactive novel, where your choices control the story.

name: Projection: First Light
short_description: Projection: First Light follows Greta on a puzzle-platforming adventure through a mythological shadow puppet world, as she embarks on a journey across cultures meeting legendary heroes.

name: The Adventures of Sam Carlisle: The Hunt for the Lost Treasure
short_description: My name is Sam. Sam Carlisle. I have a normal life. A life that I really enjoy. It is simple really. I go to work, come home and work on a secret project. A project that will make me millions. A lost treasure. A treasure too big for one man, one man alone.

name: Heads Run
short_description: HeadsRun is a platformer starring a green circular fellow who must make his way through some stages increasingly dangerous environments and monsters as quickly as possible.

name: The Merchant Memoirs
short_description: What if you had a second chance at life? That's what happened to Engel Marx, a failed merchant who is killed in his previous life and now through the screw-up of his Guardian Angel, he now is in youth again! How will doing something just a bit differently drastically alter his life?

name: Form of a Legend
short_description: Form of a Legend is a real time strategy game set on a fantasy world with different races. Build and manage your civilization to make your story a legend.

name: Heavy Destinies
short_description: Heavy Destinies [/]23 heroes, 23 stories of the survivor, one big storyline. All fates were interwoven into one tangle. Puzzle, which you have to untangle.

name: Game Machines: Arcade Casino
short_description: Game Machines: Arcade Casino is a simulator of playing on the game machines. Great entertainment for long hours. Check your reflex, skills, and luck. Become the master and claim the cash! Retro.

name: NBA 2K Playgrounds 2
short_description: NBA arcade action is back with NBA 2K Playgrounds 2! Pick your team, get ready to jam, and Ball Without Limits!

name: Drift Zone
short_description: Welcome to the world of drifting! The smell of burned rubber, the roar of 500 bhp engines and the style you have never seen before. Take part in two types of competition and win high cash prizes and reputation points needed to climb up the career ladder.

name: Kitty Rescue
short_description: Oh dear, Kitty is always getting herself into a pickle. Luckily, you’re here to save the day. You must defy death to save our careless kitten from the dangers of a construction site, rescuing her from 3 perilous scenarios. Hope you don’t have a problem with heights!

name: Mare Nostrvm
short_description: From the dawn of history to the Roman Civil Wars, from Iberia to Cyprus, revive the ancient naval battles of the Mediterranean Sea.

name: RAZED
short_description: Neon-infused high-speed platformer where the rules are simple - blast though levels as fast as you can! But there's a catch. If you go too slow, you explode! Unlock skills and powers, and seek out shortcuts to propel yourself to the top of the online leaderboards.

name: Marble Run
short_description: Marble Run - is a fantastic educational toy that provides hours of fun while combining basic learning skills with coordination and organizational skill.

name: Boy Next Door
short_description: Escape from the gay boys and bodybuilders and get it to the gay club at any cost.

name: Infinite Horizon
short_description: Infinite Horizon is a peaceful, meditative exploration game in which you travel to procedurally generated solar systems and explore the surface of infinite worlds in your planet rover.

name: The Rare Nine
short_description: The Rare Nine - ultrafast and explosive beat 'em up, in which you should break through the darkness and hordes of undead in a giant skyscraper. Also you can enjoy a lot of great chiptune music.

name: Void Cube Runner
short_description: VCR is skill based runner game. Infinity running game meets with music. It's time to show yourself how you are skilled in leaderboard.(READ THE DESCRIPTION PLEASE)

name: Inner Mazes - Souls Guides
short_description: Carefully crafted puzzles in a challenging turn based 3D platformer take the player on a surrealistic journey through a maze of illusion, ghosts and spiritual guides. In I.M.: Souls Guides, you'll become Lucas, a medium seeking enlightenment through the ways of afro-brazilian traditions.

name: Vacation Simulator
short_description: The latest VR sensation from the creators of ‘Job Simulator’, now with free DLC! Welcome to Vacation Simulator: a rough approximation of VACATION inspired by real human NOT JOBBING. Reallocate your bandwidth and get ready to splash, s’more, snowball, and selfie your way to optimal relaxation.

name: City Game Studio: Your Game Dev Adventure Begins
short_description: Manage a game studio from the dawn of the gaming industry in 1976. Your journey starts with small indie titles and grows into a gaming empire. Develop, design, and conquer the industry. From humble beginnings to gaming legend – it’s your story, your studio, your legacy!

name: Anchorhead
short_description: You take a deep breath of salty air as the first raindrops begin to spatter the pavement, and the swollen, slate-colored clouds that blanket the sky mutter ominous portents amongst themselves over the little coastal town of Anchorhead.

name: Posable Heroes
short_description: A puzzle game that asks YOU to animate the main characters. In the same spirit as Toribash or QWOP, Posable Heroes is a physics game that rewards precision and physical manoeuvres. Pose your characters and press play to see what happens. Keep modifying the poses until you create a full movie that solves each challenge.

name: Star Wars: Droid Repair Bay
short_description: In Star Wars: Droid Repair Bay by ILMxLAB, Poe Dameron's sidekick needs your help. Repair BB-8 and his astromech droid friends, each with their own unique personalities, so they can roll back into the fight against the First Order.

name: Dark Rose Valkyrie
short_description: Defend humanity from the Chimera Virus as the new leader of Japan's covert military agency (ACID) in Dark Rose Valkyrie! Battle enemies in this real-time combat, action-packed RPG, and investigate your party members to find and expose the traitor within before it’s too late!

name: Cyber Warrior
short_description: Cyber Warrior is a hacking simulator where you play as an ex retired bureau agent recruited back to take on a powerful criminal organization. Explore dozens of interactive desktops, navigate 200+ in-game websites, solve puzzles, customize your setup and make decisions that will shape a new cyber age

name: Wrath of Thor
short_description: Wrath of thor is a ARPG. There are a massive of monsters pouring into your territory. You need to kill all monsters to complete every mission.

name: Arcade Moonlander
short_description: Explore space and race against the clock in this retro styled adventure game.

name: Museu do Círio de Nazaré em Realidade Virtual
short_description: Círio de Nazaré. A maior e mais emocionante festa católica do mundo. Conheça a história do Círio, curiosidades sobre os mantos da Santa e ainda ver bem de perto a Imagem Peregrina de Nossa Senhora de Nazaré.

name: Alucinod
short_description: Alucinod is a first-person puzzle game where gravity changes to match the ground beneath your feet. There are no walls, there is no up, it all depends on where you stand.

name: The Mystery Room
short_description: This game is a game where you solve the puzzle problem and escape the room. When you start the game, you will be able to solve the puzzle problem and ask for reasoning ability. Unlock all secrets in 8 rooms and escape. Tense music and a mysterious background await you. Puzzles of various difficulty await you.

name: Hex
short_description: Hex is a unique puzzle game with a simple goal, clear the tiles to win. Tiles might multiply, explode, toggle on and off, and more as you jump between them in this exciting journey through over 80 challenging levels.

name: Orch Star
short_description: Orch Star is a real-time strategy game set in an immersive space universe where orchs and elves fight for domination. Crush your opponents as you lead a rebellion through the campaign, or challenge other players in online battles to conquer the galaxy.

name: The Lost Wizard
short_description: Enter the magical castle of The Lost Wizard,you are tibiothar a skilled wizard, the castle was attacked by the evil skeleton king, free the magician Althazar from the tyranny of skeleton king and bring peace inside the castle of Althazar, destroy the army of darkness. Your actions will be remembered forever.

name: Between the Stars
short_description: Become the Captain of an interstellar cruiser and journey across the galaxy to save the Republic. During your journey you will have to make important decisions, improve the weaponry of your ship and fight against numerous enemies.

name: Love all you have left
short_description: Psychological thriller set at the Eastern-Front during World War II.

name: One Watcher
short_description: Precision platforming at its finest with retro-inspired tile-based 2.5D levels. Ultra-responsive jumps, wall climbs, and ceiling slides are your keys to beating 66 handcrafted levels across four distinct chapters. Hunt down and defeat the Watcher, but be warned – only the most skilled will survive.

name: Old School FOTD
short_description: You play as a schizophrenic and must find an outlet at any cost...

name: 大逃亡专家 Escape Expert
short_description: This is an open world escape Indie Game, you are an escape expert helping clients to escape. Work is not always simple, you may become city wanted, police will block all exit ways, you need to prepare enough food, fuel, energy, tools, etc to survive during these wanted days.

name: BLIK
short_description: BLIK is a fascinating spatial first-person puzzle. You are a student at one of the best educational institutions in the world! Сomplete the study program course by solving all the puzzles and passing the final test! Be smart and diligent! Become the pride of the Academy!

name: Santa's Workshop
short_description: Sit back and relax with this wonderful puzzle game. Help Santa at his workshop to wrap the gifts he’ll soon be delivering to children around the world.

name: Nightingale Downs
short_description: You play a deer, tasked by your clan leader with a most urgent mission: Find and sabotage the plans of a local human settlement, intent on destroying your homeland. Your journey will be long, through dangerous jungles and facing many natural predators. Will you save your home?

name: Scrap
short_description: Shoot, kick, and detonate your way through a post tech apocalyptic wasteland where robots reign terror upon the resourceful Scrappers. Scrap foes, unlock weapons, play alone or with friends and take back the world in this free, 3D, action, twin stick, shooter.

name: Boot Hill Bounties
short_description: A conspiracy to provoke war between the western settlers and the Chepakwik threatens to destroy both sides. Only Kid, Doc, Moon and Rosy know the truth. But to save their homes, they’ll have to track down five legendary outlaws whose very names strike fear into the hearts of men.

name: Major League Gladiators
