short_description: Major League Gladiators is a 2-player co-op shooter for VR. Each taking control of one of two classes, players will have to survive endless rounds of enemies by combining their unique movement and combat abilities as well as maintaining each others resources.

name: Operation Desert Road
short_description: Operation Desert Road is a retro style arcade action game. Climb aboard your vehicle and destroy everything on your way!

name: Last Salvo
short_description: Last Salvo is a dynamic ww2 shooter. To survive battles after battles, mastery of your weapons and knowing your enemies are key. Only the skilled can survive.

name: Stitched HD
short_description: A pleasantly anticipated trip back home for the holidays becomes a nightmare for Catherine as a tragic accident leaves her unconscious. After coming to her senses, she realizes that something is dreadfully wrong. She must escape the doll factory she awoke in before it's too late.

name: Taco Tom 2
short_description: It's time to make some tacos! Speed up time, dash through walls, and collect ingredients. Find out what happened to your dead ex-girlfriend, and maybe try to date a squid as well.

name: Beats Of Fury
short_description: Beats Of Fury is a psychedelic mix of Rhythm games and bullet hell, start shooting the evil beats while playing the best music.

name: Magic Tower
short_description: Inspired by RPG map in "Warcraft III" , the core gameplay is plunder resources from enemies. This game is not only a simple thief, but also a test of the collocation between the various defensive towers, as well as a balance between the defense tower injury and the enemy's blood volume.

name: Reach Me
short_description: Reach Me is a colorful physical puzzle in a minimalist style.The goal of this game is to move the blocks onto the platform using special ammunition, as well as various objects in the level.

name: Hell Space
short_description: This is the 360 degrees indie slasher with the top view and old school graphics.

name: Void Memory
short_description: You, who was born in a world full of darkness, should wander this hollowed land to find the Relics for a person who created you. However, fallen and lost souls with trap-filled trials await in your course of doing so. Can you survive in this crumbling world and start a new era?

name: Expelled
short_description: Expelled - the adventure of a rabbit on dangerous planets, and all in order to use the only chance to get out of prison and return home to his wife and children.

name: ReX
short_description: Rex is a classic hardcore 2D platformer shooter, you play as a soldier to hunt down an evil scientist. Fight your way through with powerful weapons and put an end to his mad experiments.

name: Illville: Return instructions. Act 1
short_description: Illville: Return Instructions is a 3D adventure set in a remote foggy and rainy English village. Follow the beam of the lighthouse to find your way home as you face different situations in this enormous investigative quest.

name: After the Collapse
short_description: ATC is a base building game set in a post-apocalyptic world featuring urban environments. Build a base across several layers with dozens of survivors. Fight other factions for the control of the remaining production centers and explore the world to find long forgotten resources and technologies.

name: Hot Pool
short_description: Adult people gathered at a hot pool party with boundless flirting and sex. Your goal is to arrange the characters according to their sexual orientation (including LGBT).

name: ШП - ShP
short_description: Incomprehensible interface errative puzzle game. No instructions! This product includes 3 different puzzles.

name: Eden Falling
short_description: Eden Falling is a new kind of multiplayer, sci-fi, turn-based, strategic survival RPG. As a chosen survivor you travel the wastelands, craft, take on contracts, hunt feral mutants, and navigate the merciless politics of a savage new Earth. Make your mark on the world and create your legend!

name: PAIN-TO-WIN
short_description: Sick and twisted 2D shooter packed with blood and severed limbs. Hunt, eliminate, and extract brains in a filthy world of killers, whores, and swindlers.

name: Found Horror Game 11.exe
short_description: You'll scream in pleasure... You'll choke with fear! Play through 11 sick, frightening and perverted games, released in an experimental episodic format that relies on you, the players, to continue. Can the curious souls brave through the hidden depths of each game to reach the shocking conclusion?

name: Shiver
short_description: Welcome to Windy Oaks National Park. A beautiful and chilling point-and-click horror adventure. On your way to visit your aging father, everything goes wrong, leaving you trapped and isolated.

name: Raging Fists: Retribution
short_description: Raging Fists: Retribution is an Action Fighting Game based in a sci-fi industrial era.

name: Umiro
short_description: Huey and Satura find themselves lost in the colorless world of Umiro with no memory of their past or how they arrived in this mysterious place. Draw your way through beautiful puzzles and guide Huey and Satura as they restore color to Umiro.

name: DEAD TARGET VR: Zombie Intensified
short_description: Survive the Zombie Intensified, Face to Dead and Fear

name: Voxel Tank VR
short_description: Voxel tanks can easily operate tanks! A large explosion if the bullet that fired hits an enemy tank! Feeling is exhilarating! Let's move it well and avoid enemy attacks! It's a gameover when To be attacked receives enemy bullets five times!

name: Reformers
short_description: This is a retro RPG game, in which players play the role of world-changing changers, and have a special ability - soul alliance, soul alliance is able to sign a contract with the soul of the monster, the ability to fight together, since the future of the world will be changed by you.

name: Eggcellent VR
short_description: Eggcellent VR is a simple arcade game inspired by Mickey Mouse egg catcher on Nintendo Game & Watch. The game is driven by a pure spirit of arcade with every level getting more and more challenging. Despite the inspiration of the game, it has additional gaming modes to keep you entertained.

name: ELDERBORN
short_description: ELDERBORN - a Metal AF* Slasher with brutal FPP melee combat and souls-like/RPG character progression. In the times of legend, barbarian tribes need a new dark messiah. Be that merciless slayer. Uncover ancient secrets in the city of doom. Forge your own destiny! *Action Fantasy.

name: Space Quiz
short_description: Show how much you know and conquer the universe with this strategic game.

name: Maze of Gaea（Real Maze VR Simulation）
short_description: Have you ever been challenged in a real maze? Stand tall and find the path of the maze, and then try to get out of the maze by memory. It's a double test of patience and memory. We have crafted seven labyrinths, each with its own characteristics, come into the maze of virtual reality .

name: Titanic: The Experience
short_description: Experience the Titanic in all of its glory, witness the iceberg collision and the sinking of the most famous ocean liner. Relive that fateful night on April 14th 1912 and experience what that night was like.

name: Robo Revenge Squad
short_description: Robo Revenge Squad is a co-op action game for 1-4 players, where everything is a weapon. Fight alien robots using Robos made of everyday objects: fridges, disco balls, baseball bats, and more!

name: Xagia Wars
short_description: Xagia Wars is an epic fantasy tale about Magic, Courage, and Friendship that revolves around Isaac Victor, a young man brimming with talent living his daily wizardry school life. But his fate is already determined, as Cahos the resurrected one will bring the end to the world. What kind of fate awaits him?

name: Cosmic Trail
short_description: Run through the Cosmic Trails in this skill-based 3d platformer. You will only have 32 seconds to complete each trail and it won’t be easy. At all.

name: C.A.S.T (Combat Alchemy Solution and Tactics)
short_description: C.A.S.T is a fast paced, 2D arena fighter where you combine elements to cast spells and disassemble your enemies. You have a multitude of spells at your disposal. Ranging from defensive to full offensive! The arena is yours to own!

name: Award. Room of fear
short_description: Solve a riddle of damned family and do not forget to survive at the same time.

name: The Hospital: Allison's Diary
short_description: "The Hospital: Allison's Diary" is a new horror virtual reality experience, putting the user alone in an abandoned hospital searching for the unknown with only the help of a single torch. You will face true fear in a way you had never thought possible.

name: YOUFIGHT
short_description: Discover integrated reality with this game mixing 2D fighting and video!Keep your real appearance and become an outstanding boxer in the game thanks to an automated video cutting technique which allows to show some animations from your video capture.

name: Sakura Cupid
short_description: Lilim, a lazy cupid exiled from Heaven, accidentally makes a human girl fall in love with her while trying to steal a free cup of coffee.

name: Steel Eagle
short_description: Steel Eagle is a reference to the 80's and 90's shooters. Your task is to reach the landing pad at the end of the level, destroying as many enemy units as possible, for which you collect points that can be exchanged for force and strength, which allows you to upgrade your “Steel Eagle”.

name: MegaRace 2
short_description: MegaRace 2 is the sequel to 1994's combat racing smash hit and is once again developed by Cryo Interactive. The sequel included several upgrades such as fully rendered 3D cars, new weapons, and track shortcuts.

name: MegaRace 3
short_description: MegaRace 3 is the third entry in the ever-popular MegaRace series. The first truly 3D game in the series seamlessly blends elements of futuristic racing and first-person shooters. Cynical presenter, Lance Boyle, is once again at the helm leading the player through hallucinogenic enhanced tracks whose environments are constantly changing.

name: Not Tonight
short_description: Person of European Heritage #112: Welcome to Relocation Block B, your new home. Your designated role is 'Bouncer'. Work hard, stay out of trouble, and we might let you stay in the UK.

name: Frosty Nights
short_description: Frosty Nights is a First Person hybrid horror game that focuses on atmosphere and suspense.

name: Clutter VI: Leigh's Story
short_description: The best Clutter yet by far!

name: Highrisers
short_description: An Urban Survival RPG! Crafting, Exploring and Defending in a desolate metropolis haunted by the mysterious dreamers. Lead a team of 4 survivors through this urban desert of skyscrapers and high-rises, where the streets are crowded with the mutated victims of a strange disease.

name: Anime Bubble Pop
short_description: Anime Bubble Pop is a fun relaxing Bubble Shooter with an Anime theme. Help Mysty complete all of the bubble puzzles to beat the game!

name: King of the Eggs
short_description: Play with your friends Online for FREE using Steam Remote Play. Welcome to Eggorias! A land where you and your friends will compete in the wildest most exciting egg smashing competition the world has ever seen.

name: Magical Girl Dash 2 - Triple Prisma Attack
short_description: Magical Girl Dash 2 - Triple Prisma Attack! is the second game of the Magical Girl Dash Series. Protect the streets of the city and fight against evil creatures causing chaos. Choose between three different magical girls, each with their own playstyle, and increase the Public Safety of the city.

name: Entropic Shop VR
short_description: Welcome to the Entropic Shop, a bundle of arcade VR experiences set in a cartoon and colorful magic shop. Aim for the high-score and challenge your friends in short, fun and absurd mini-games.

name: I Can't Believe It's Not Gambling
short_description: Do you love opening loot crates, but hate the tedious gameplay sessions in between? Our marketing department has the game for you! Unbox random items! Get stuff, but not what you really want! Skate legal and ethical lines! Remember kids, its only a video game, so grab your parents credit card!

name: Legendary DXP
short_description: Welcome to the fantastical world of Alamyth where you can recruit all new legendary heroes and fight the terrifying forces of evil. Visit all new landscapes of Alamyth such as the Firelands and fight the likes of The Leprechaun Henchmen and the evil villain, Ernak The Lethal.

name: Qajary Cat
short_description: “The Qajar Cat” is the story of a mother cat together with her kitten which, accidentally, becomes the apple of the Iranian King’s eye. The King (Naser al-Din Shah Qajar) takes it under his roof and bestows all kinds of lavish royal blessings to it.

name: Moon Bus
short_description: 2 - 4 Players must skillfully maneuver their lunar lander style busses to deliver the most passengers.

name: Bonbon
short_description: A thirty-minute childhood-horror walking-sim about toys and a giant rat. A short, single-sitting experience.

name: World Warfare
short_description: World Warfare is an intense 3D, Real-time Strategy game where hundreds of players around the world command dozens of land, sea, and air units in World War II-inspired combat. The goal is conquest and supremacy.

name: Ultimate Coaster X
short_description: Ultimate Coaster X is a free roller coaster simulator built with simplicity and utility in mind. The in-game roller coaster and world editors allow you to create and experience rides of many types.

name: Rocket Armor
short_description: Rocket Armor is the most realistic and exciting flight combat experience in VR today! It features a completely new type of flight control system and maneuvering capability – it’s like really flying using two huge rockets strapped to your arms!

name: Black Moon 黑月
short_description: A suspense puzzle game that explores scenes, collects objects, solves puzzles, and cracks well-designed organ puzzles. There are different endings depending on the player's choice of branch.

name: Grimante
short_description: 50+ levels of tactical combat boiled down to its addicting, puzzle-like core. Solve the battlefield.

name: Reality Falls
short_description: In a dusty, dilapidated town on the former Soviet steppe, a young traveller finds himself embroiled in a strange and surreal plot that threatens the very existence of Reality Falls itself. A story-driven indie adventure, with classic point-and-click puzzles and a retro JRPG-style look and feel.

name: Minimancer
short_description: Build your team, fight your way through the land, unlock minions and become the ultimate Minimancer!

name: Worshippers
short_description: It's hard to be a god! Worshipper is a fast-paced strategy combined with collectible card game. Explore and conquer the land, face dreadful creatures, lead your people to glory! With every victory you will unlock new units, spells and buildings, use them to develop your own unique strategies!

name: Wheel Riders Online OBT
short_description: Wheel Riders Online - Survival Racing. You will build your own mode transportation using the parts in your garage and battle other players online! A very entertaining automobile building system is waiting for you, don't let your fantasy limit you; moreover, those constant improvements are adding to your abilities.

name: Bitcoin Tycoon - Mining Simulation Game
short_description: Play as a new person who just get touched with the Virtual Currency area by starting mining in early 2014. Dig enough coins and expand your business, virtual currency exchange and complete trusts. Become the king of the whole bitcoin empire.

name: BattleRush
short_description: Free-to-play multiplayer action game in the entourage of the Second World War with total destructibility of the environment. Enjoy full freedom, build a defense, create your army, crush the enemy.

name: Civil Warfare: Another Bullet In The War
short_description: CIVIL WARFARE allows you to fight against real players with the Battle Royale style and different game modes. You battle until you are the one last survivor of dozens of people in a Battle Royale style civil war town.

name: The Lost Gardens
short_description: Forgotten and lost to time, a mysterious entity known as The One has awoken you; an ancient robot known as The Caretaker. You are tasked with reclaiming the world from a being known only as Fear before he finishes draining the world of life.

name: Ancient Frontier: Steel Shadows
short_description: Steel Shadows is a standalone tactics RPG set in the epic universe of Ancient Frontier. Take command of a rag tag band of pirates and outlaws as you fight your way across the Frontier for treasure and glory. Delve into our latest turn based tactical RPG.

name: PickCrafter
short_description: Conquer PickCrafter, the hit indie idle game! Break blocks, forge equipment, and collect powerful Pickaxes. Prestige to legendary tiers with the new Ascension Skill Tree. Discover biomes and battle epic bosses. Make meaningful choices and invent complex builds in this addictive endless adventure!

name: Protect Me
short_description: Protect me, and I I'll help you do it more effectively.

name: Neon Defense 1 : Pink Power
short_description: Neon Defense is a minimalistic classical tower defense game with puzzle elements. Build towers to defend yourself against the attacking enemies. Can you beat every level on hard?

name: Houston, We Have Spinach!
short_description: Design and build rockets, fuel them with food and explore a galaxy filled with strange planets.

name: The Francy Droo & Friends Collection
short_description: Five tiny indie games for the price of one slightly bigger indie game!

name: Chemically Bonded
short_description: Enter the melancholic life of a Japanese high school student, as you soon become entwined in the dispute between two female students. Learn more about their past as you piece together their relationship and mend their bond, all whilst forming bonds of your own.

name: Eternal Hour: Golden Hour
short_description: Play through a timeless adventure as Yasu or Rin Fujimoto and discover the origins of Eternal Hour! Eternal Hour: Golden Hour is a fun, emotional, and story-driven Visual Novel that takes place before the events of Eternal Hour.

name: MEANDERS
short_description: MEANDERS is a sparkling adventure through a series of funny and relaxing challenges in a colourful setting.

name: Prosperity
short_description: Take on the role of leading a camp of weary peasants, make strategic decisions to fight for survival against the elements. If you're capable, the camp will grow into a settlement, and then a hamlet. Do you have what it takes to grow it into a city?

name: Fantasy of Eden
short_description: This game is 2D open world RPG. You will advance games by clearing quests that occur in towns and others. Battle is a turn-based battle of symbol encounter.

name: The Forbidden Arts
short_description: The Forbidden Arts is an old-school action adventure platformer with a focus on discovery and exploration. You play as Phoenix, a young boy who seeks to master the element of fire in a grand adventure of ancient magic.

name: Defenders of Tetsoidea
short_description: It's the classic Cyberpunk RPG that got everyone hooked on the genre! Newly remastered!

name: BLACKSTONE
short_description: BLACKSTONE is a role-playing game based on RPG MAKER.

name: meleng
short_description: meleng is a logic puzzle game played on a grid of square cells. This grid also contains circles with dots which indicates how many lines must crosses at that point. You must complete the grid by filling in every cell with lines and linking them with or away from each other.

name: EMERGENCY 20
short_description: Coordinate your team of first responders in the anniversary edition of EMERGENCY! Featuring 10 remastered classic EMERGENCY missions and three full campaigns, EMERGENCY 20 is the complete package for both experienced and new rescue commanders!

name: Genesis Noir
short_description: A noir adventure spanning time and space. When a love triangle between cosmic beings becomes a bitter confrontation, you'll witness a gunshot fired by a jealous god—otherwise known as The Big Bang. Jump into the expanding universe and search for a way to destroy creation and save your love.

name: TimeTravelers
short_description: 「We got the remains of someone's dream in the end」 Short musical movie about two girls who travel to magical space!

name: Bottle: Pilgrim Redux
short_description: Bottle: Pilgrim is a story of loss, regret and redemption, which reminds us that while we cannot change the things we have done, we can always learn from our mistakes.

name: Task is to Survive
short_description: Task is to Survive - Is a first person shooter. You play as a soldier and you were sent by helicopter to the infected object in which there are a huge number of dangerous zombies. Do you have a special mission - to kill as many zombies before the time, until you die!

name: Highway Madness
short_description: Highway Madness is a social VR game where you get to play with old and new friends from all over the world! Pick your character then choose from a selection of fun games including Standoff, Road Crossing, Roof jumping and Shootout! So what are you waiting for? Come on in and join the Madness!

name: vBuilder
short_description: vBuilder empowers ANYONE to easily create any desired space and interactive experience in VR. Model, import, paint, arrange scenes and make animations across platform with intuitive and powerful tools. You can publish your works and invite spectators to watch or just create with them in real time!

name: 烛梦灯  The Dreams of Candlelight
short_description: This is a suspense plot decryption game during the Republic of China, telling the protagonist in order to find the mysterious past that happened sixteen years ago...

name: Creepy Road
short_description: The world has gone mad and Flint Trucker must go down a long, creepy road to get back home and save his beloved Angelina. Blast your guns across different scenarios to fight hordes of ravenous beasts and bloodthirsty enemies.Will you survive?

name: Time Killers: CatchOut
short_description: CatchOut is a simple “Ball & Paddle” game, but without the paddle. Instead you move the bricks to catch the ball.

name: Time Killers: Spot Race
short_description: Spot Race is a little simple pair based puzzle game, which can been played when you are short in time.

name: NO ONE
short_description: NO ONE is a VR puzzle game where you have to connect the mirrors in the right order. When you succeed, you can get clues to the scene of the incident in the mirror. Become a detective and collect clues. Then the truth of the incident in the room will be revealed.

name: Crazy Soccer: Football Stars
short_description: The Interstellar Soccer Cup is here! Use mines, cows and flying saucers in the most unrealistic football-manager ever and lead your team to victory. Play against AI opponents, friends and random opponents online!

name: Project Rhombus
short_description: Project Rhombus is a rhythm-based casual action game that combines exciting electronic music with stylish flat design. Hold on as long as possible, blocking the oncoming arrows moving to the beat.

name: 11-11 Memories Retold
short_description: 11th November 1916, a young photographer leaves Canada to join the western front in Europe. The same day, a German technician is told that his son is missing in action. Both want to preserve their humanity and come back alive to their loved ones.

name: BANZAI ROYALE
short_description: BANZAI ROYALE (バンザイロイヤル) is a top-down online shooter where contestants scavenge the map for weapons. Throw katanas and dodge roll past flying bullets in this fast-paced brawl to become the last salaryman standing!

name: Die drei ??? - Geheimnis der Schattenhelden
short_description: - German language only – Rocky Beach is the scene of a top-secret Hollywood action movie series plotted around a league of super heroes. But suddenly, the main actor has disappeared without a trace, along with his secret super hero suit. Help Jupiter, Peter, and Bob to find the actor and save the series!

name: One More Night: BiO Clinic
short_description: Everything around you is trying to kill you! Can you survive for One More Night?

name: Forgotten Light
short_description: In a world of complete darkness there is always light, since you were born you felt something was wrong with living in this darkness. Not knowing what happened to your family you are alone, like many others in your cells you are forbidden to seek the light. This all changes when the light suddenly calls to you.

name: Cyber Surf
short_description: Cyber Surf allows you to race through the air and explore different worlds using your favorite VR headset.

name: Kink
short_description: Use your drawing skills to trace over looped curves created by the game, and avoid the black spot or you will get kinked.

name: Deep Sorrow
short_description: Deep Sorrow is a horror/adventure game which leads you to a bunker and makes you feel desperate to get out.

name: EX0: Dark Moon
short_description: An indie retro-ish puzzle platformer where you must upgrade your stats to run, jump, and shoot your way through each level and beat the evil dark slimes.

name: Chinese Parents
short_description: In this casual sim set in China, you step into the shoes of an average kid from birth towards the end of your high school. Study hard, have fun, make friends and face your ultimate challenge, the “Gaokao”. What will your life be after that? And when you have a child, will you be a Tiger Parent?

name: Nana in the Dark
short_description: Nana who came to a strange place, To escape from there, you must survive from unidentified things! * Simple graphics * Cute characters * A little fear * Story * Multi-ending

name: Squad 44
short_description: Team up and join the frontline in Squad 44, the most authentic tactical WW2 shooter. Experience ruthless realism with an immense arsenal of faithfully recreated weapons and vehicles across massive WW2 battlefields.

name: Salt Thrust
short_description: infinitely bouncing ball on the sea in your library

name: The Revolt: Awakening
short_description: The Revolt: Awakening is an action-platformer RPG, allowing you to explore a city under military control… You will have to make your way through powerful enemies and face many dangers during your missions. Run, Fight, Destroy, Loot!

name: Amberskull
short_description: Amberskull is a survival horror anthology with several terrifying experiences where you must overcome 4 unique enemies in widely different environments.

name: Baba Is You
short_description: Baba Is You is a puzzle game where the rules you have to follow are present as blocks you can interact with. By manipulating them, you can change how the game works, repurpose things you find in the levels and cause surprising interactions!

name: VJmachine
short_description: VJmachine is the plug & play Full HD VJ software music visualizer and music video creator e.g. YouTube. Install VJmachine on your computer or notebook. Connect your music & screens and you're ready to start your party! Custom videos & pictures as well are automatically synced to the music.

name: Isle of Dinosaurs 2D
short_description: You got teleported into a prehistoric world. It's time to show the inhabiting dinosaurs why you are not extinct and return back home.

name: Our Feelings
short_description: Hiyoko searches for the truth when she is thrust three years into the past, to a parallel universe and surrounded by faces she has never seen before. Who did she replace, and what's behind her appearance in this world?

name: VR Mini Bowling
short_description: Welcome to the world of Mini Bowling! In this VR game bowling meets mini golf to create a totally new experience!

name: Unforgiving Happiness
short_description: Connect the batteries and collect the energy while discovering the inspiring story of a hard-working, independent developer and his journey to happiness.

name: Soundscape (Classic)
short_description: Get teleported to a psychedelic world of music and light in the classic version of Soundscape! For the best experience and visuals, be sure to download the latest version - http://store.steampowered.com/app/636930 - and stay tuned for regular upgrades!

name: Yag
short_description: Yag is a 3D virtual tabletop (VTT). It offers what's needed to play: dungeons, voxel terrains, miniatures, dice and character sheets, customizable and automatable through embedded LUA scripting. It lets you use any public picture from the net to play any game requiring a gameboard, dice, and pawns.

name: Clicker bAdventure
short_description: The faster you click, the faster you will cut the trees to get bonuses, and damage your enemies. Will you be fast enough to stop the enemies coming always stronger in this open world?

name: Rotate – Professional Virtual Aviation Network
short_description: Rotate is an MMO aviation platform for Flight Sim and Air Traffic Control enthusiasts. Bring your favourite Aviation Sim and experience the best possible realism and functionality from a Virtual Aviation Network. Play as a pilot or air traffic controller and join other players from around the world.

name: The Godbeast
short_description: Welcome to the City of Eternal Night. Take revenge on the villainous Council of the Hunt and rampage on your motorcycle through the moonlit streets in this stylish action game.

name: Glory & Honor
short_description: In Glory&Honor your mission is to lead a team of gladiators of different races into success. The battles are fought out on a 7x5 battlefield, where your jov is to find out the enemies weaknesses and use your strengths against them. You can use different races and their racial abilities to your advantage.

name: The Crooked Man
short_description: There was a crooked man, and he walked a crooked mile... This is the first title in the series known as The Strange Man, developed by Uri Games. Experience the myriad horrors awaiting David as he moves into his new house.

name: Operation: Harsh Doorstop
short_description: Operation: Harsh Doorstop is the ultimate, free to play, tactical shooter sandbox. Play singleplayer, multiplayer, or co-op modes and explore thousands of community-created maps, weapons, and vehicles via the Steam Workshop. Created by ex-developers of Squad, Red Orchestra, and Insurgency.

name: WAR Pig - Big Bang
short_description: Your mission is easy: Destroy the enemy! That is all - no more, no less. Fight your way through many exciting missions in the campaign or compete against each other with up to 6 teams, consisting of 6 pigs each in free play mode.

name: Starry Makino
short_description: The universe is full of unknown and magical for mankind. At present, our understanding of the gorgeous universe is mainly derived from the study of the invisible universe, the vast sky, the mysterious constellation, the beautiful aurora phenomenon, all show the infinite charm of the universe.

name: Yōdanji
short_description: Coffee-break rogue-like themed after Japanese folklore tales.

name: BAAM SQUAD
short_description: BAAM SQUAD is a VR zombie co-op shooter following a band of four brave agents seeking to shoot, loot and run in order to solve the mystery case of Santana's Sweets Factory: The place where it’s been taken over by zombies eating human flesh and candies!

name: Clash of Spells
short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer magic shooter for room-scale VR. Cast and dodge elemental spells to destroy the enemies and survive.

name: The Raven Remastered
short_description: London, 1964. An ancient ruby is stolen from the British Museum. At the crime scene: a raven feather. Is somebody trying to follow in the footsteps of The Raven, the legendary master thief who disappeared years before?

name: Knights of Honor II: Sovereign
short_description: Become the king and fight over Europe in this fresh take on medieval real-time grand strategy. Manage provinces, gather armies, initiate diplomacy, and dabble in espionage. The path is open: become the true Sovereign of your people and bring them to glory.

name: FEN: Prologue
short_description: FEN: Prologue is a new interpretation of the survival genre. After a sequence of unexpected events you find yourself at an unauthorized landfill. The fen where the landfill is located will become your new home. You will have to try hard in order to survive in this horrible place.

name: aMAZE Double
short_description: aMAZE Double is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with portal and gem's

name: We. The Revolution
short_description: As a judge of the Revolutionary Tribunal, preside over complicated cases of ordinary citizens, dangerous criminals, and enemies of the revolution in revolutionary Paris. Make judgments, plot political intrigue, and try to not lose your own head!

name: Around the World in 80 days: Hidden Objects
short_description: You will travel round the world with the Jules Verne heroes! Each location (scene) is a new continent or a new country where you will find yourself in the atmosphere of this region thanks to the picturesque and colorful graphics and the unique musical background.

name: Cats Fly Helicopters
short_description: Cats Fly Helicopters is about creatively completing jobs with your homebuilt helicopters in a quirky simulated city of cats. Upgrade your gear while you meet the needs of residents - but try not to make a mess along the way.

name: Here & Elsewhere
short_description: It is twenty thousand years in the future and our signals have been received, but it is too late for life on earth. The hyper dimensional crystals have arrived to a blasted wasteland.

name: Delicious - Moms vs Dads
short_description: Join Emily and Patrick in a hilarious battle of the sexes!

name: Open Sorcery: Sea++
short_description: You wake up at the bottom of the ocean, surrounded by your broken memories. Reclaim and compile your magic or drown in a sea of dreams.

name: OlympicVR
short_description: OlympicVR is a singleplayer/party game for HTC Vive. Get yourself in action and challenge friends in different disciplines to find out who will win. Three difficulty modes (easy, normal and extreme) will change the experience adding unique elements to the game.

name: Starfighter Neon
short_description: You've been dropped into enemy space. Weave your Starfighter between alien spaceships, lasers, asteroids and bombs destroying as many as you can and collecting valuable coins and powerups as you go.

name: Rusty Lake Paradise
short_description: Rusty Lake Paradise is set on a small remote island which is cursed by the ten plagues of Egypt. Solve all the mysteries of this dark, macabre puzzle adventure. Paradise builds upon the distinctive atmosphere and excitement from the Rusty Lake series.

name: Altiros
short_description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

name: AI Dummy
short_description: Try to get out with all your strength and tell the whole of humanity that you have the same rights as a person and that you have consciousness!

name: FISK
short_description: 《FISK》is a simple 2D platform game made by myself, based on the classic jumping elements of 2D platform game. You can complete the mission through enhanced action capability by interaction with monsters using simple buttons.

name: Legend of Homebody
short_description: The simple game of a shut-in learning from home and earn money. (The game is purely fictional, do not try this out in reality. This is a somewhat serious and heavy game, so don't be fooled by appearances.)

name: Rise of Ages
short_description: Rise of Ages is a sandbox game, allowing you to explore, build, found cities, make wars and evolve technologies to reach the highest level of a civilization and then travel to other planets! The game begins in prehistory and will advance ages, one by one, as the player evolves.

name: AF-ZERO
short_description: A tribute to the 80's games containing 7 stages with continuous action.

name: Perspectrip
short_description: A mind blowing puzzle game that challenges your spatial abilities.

name: Gear Stalker
short_description: VR post apocalyptic giant robot hunting game

name: Yago, the Coquerrestrial
short_description: Yago, the Coquerrestrial is a "Point & Click" third person adventure in which you play the character of a little alien from planet Coque.. You will interact with the diferent characters, items and elements that conforms the different stages using an easy radial menu.

name: TRATEL64
short_description: Prepare for an experience unlike anything you've seen before... TRATEL64 (spell it in all caps) is a zany comedy adventure game that's stylized like a fever dream! Watch Tratel go from 0 to 64 over the course of an afternoon (in real time that amounts to 1-2 hours).

name: Adventures Of Pipi
short_description: You play as an alien Pipi, whose ship was wrecked on the planet Vapeland. Escape from the Vapeland planet and collect as many vapes and spinners as possible

name: Deep GachiGASM
short_description: Fly and destroy slaves, Billy Carringtons, Mark Pulfs, Ricardo Hilses, Kazuas and punish their assholes

name: The Breeding: The Fog
short_description: The World governments experiment to control soaring atmospheric toxin levels have failed. The weather has become unstable and the "Breeds" have appeared. Journey into the safe zone in The Breeding: The Fog's atmospheric randomly generated seamless world...

name: Water Density
short_description: Water Density is an digging game where the goal is to obtain the most Heavy Water. Use a wheel loader to create a road for your tanker to transport water back to your ship. Fly a drone to scout the landscape and tunnels, to find water.

name: BE THE HERO
short_description: VR COMIC SUPER HERO GAME"BE THE HERO" is a transitional super hero game which takes you from an interactive comic book to playing as a powerful ninja hero with intense action and fluid locomotion. Stop dreaming, it's time to Be the Hero!

name: Bulleto Master
short_description: Bulleto Master is a game in the wild wild west style. You shoot and control your bullets and try to move them to bunce and hit your targets.You can also go into slow motion for a limited time to gain additional controls over them. Defeat all the enemies and keep your town safe at all cost.

name: NEKO-NIN exHeart +PLUS Nachi
short_description: From developer Whirlpool comes a mini-sequel to NEKO-NIN exHeart featuring the sub-character, Nachi! Impressed by the protagonist's desire to become a better Master for his ninja, Nachi decides to train our hero. What happens when Nachi finds herself glued to our protagonist as well...?

name: Tactical Operations
short_description: Tactical Operations is a subsystem of investigative, organizational-preparatory, other actions and operational-search activities conducted under a single plan and aimed at solving individual intermediate tasks subordinated to the general objectives of investigating a criminal case.

name: Substance Painter 2018
short_description: Substance Painter is the reference texturing app for 3D professionals and enthusiasts. From AAA Game Developers to Indies, from Feature Animation to Visual Effects studios, the industry uses Substance Painter to bring their creations to life thanks to its unparalleled speed, flexibility and visual quality.

name: Starship Clicker
short_description: A science fiction clicker with an arcade twist.

name: Balloonatics
short_description: Pilot a weaponized basket while dodging enemy fire and collecting weapons and traps to take down your opponents. Invite your friends, shoot them down, avoid getting shot down.

name: TAD: That Alien Dude
short_description: TAD: That Alien Dude is a retro RPG that takes you back in time to a world of analog cartoon franchises, sugary breakfast cereals, a thriving music industry, and die-cut comic book covers.

name: Mystery Stone from Heaven
short_description: Mystery Stone from Heaven is a decoding and exploration game. Player would act as a prehistoric archaeologist. In 2008, he excavated a shinning fragment in Shuidongou. After researching historical document, he got to know this stone consist three parts and its name is ‘Po’.

name: Order Of The Gatekeepers
short_description: Online Co-Operative Tower Defense with endless build options and a heavy focus on rewarding creative strategies. With so many Levels, Towers, Abilities, Items, & Builder Specialties every match can be a different experience!

name: Dream Channel
short_description: Dream Channel is a pilot produced in 2016 (being replaced in 2020) for a branching narrative XR story format (linear & non linear) . Audiences choose which way the story goes - resulting in 9 different story endings. Story branches take also the audience into VR mode to reach a particular ending

name: WORLDS AT WAR (Monitors & VR)
short_description: A fun, addicting & high-adrenaline dog-fighting 'sim-lite' horde-mode game. Worlds At War thrusts the player into the aftermath of an alien invasion. A multi-national ragtag group of surviving fighter pilots and crew man a small carrier-group, roaming the oceans, trying to survive against all odds.

name: ARCANORUM 231
short_description: A journey into a mystical underworld and immersive occult art and ritual. Featuring artwork by Barry William Hale, music by NOKO210, and drumming, chanting, and invocations by a number of other practicing occultists.

name: 神话纪元 TitanSiege
short_description: "Titan Siege"is a 3D MMORPG game developed by 10 game enthusiasts. With XEngine's fully-developed 3D engine, the entire world is seamless with aesthetically pleasing images that create a true 3D world for you.

name: Kungfu Beggar
short_description: "Kungfu Beggar" is a simulation of the drama of the game, a total of 40 episodes, the player plays the protagonist "SuCan", from the dandy reduced to beggars , on the revenge road,going through a variety of exciting battles and love affairs.Different options will be different outcome.

name: The Silence Outside
short_description: The Silence Outside is a First Person Stealth Mystery game set on a space station in the near future. You play a freshly hired maintenance engineer thrust into the middle of a catastrophic power failure and caught between the competing interests of those on board.

name: Devil and the Fairy
short_description: Experience this ultimate virtual reality dungeon defense adventure!

name: Epic Royal
short_description: up to 100 players are droped on to a island to fight to the death only 1 will live

name: Banyu Lintar Angin - Little Storm -
short_description: Banyu Lintar Angin is a series of experimental illustrations about three siblings, living together independently in a rural Indonesian environment.

name: A Raven Monologue
short_description: A Raven Monologue is a short experimental silent story about a raven that does not know how to croak and his relationship with the people in the town.

name: Monkeys Ahoy
short_description: Join two young pirate chimps on their quest to make the Ultimate Friendship Smoothie through this bright and lively monkey world

name: TEEN DATE SIMULATOR
short_description: Who'll be the ONE? All will be revealed... Teendate is a dress up and dating game for youngs.  Fill out the personality test and this game show your possible features. Choose your character and browse through the candidate guy profiles, send blue heart to show your date intention, then pick your dreamy date. Style your outfit.

name: Dead Frontier 2
short_description: Survival horror MMO. As one of the few survivors of the outbreak, you must scratch a living out of the decaying ruins of society. Scavenge for supplies, improve your skills, and trade with other players. All the while, keeping your eyes peeled for the infected lurking around every corner.

name: Shipbreakers
short_description: Tear apart the seven seas in this fast paced arcade shooter and cover the abyss with the wrecks of your enemies. Hire vicious sea wolfs as your crew members and board other ships to unlock crazy weapons and become the fiercest pirate of this little planet.

name: Blue Whale
short_description: After returning from school, 12 year old Midori receives a message on the social network from a stranger. He invites her to play the "Blue Whale", a mysterious and dangerous game, at the end of which Midori should become a whale...

name: Super Club Soccer
short_description: Super Club Soccer is a tactical turn based football game. FIFA Pro Clubs meets turn based RPG. Create your player and begin competing in tactical online battles against users from around the globe, or hone your skills against our AI in single player action. Start your soccer story today!

name: Card Crawl
short_description: Card Crawl is a solitaire style Dungeon Crawler played with a deck of cards.

name: Mechanic Miner
short_description: Put your mechanical skills to the test in a physics-based sandbox where ingenuity and creativity are the ultimate key to survival. Construct fantastical machines, gather resources, acquire new technologies to battle dangerous enemies and use your imagination to shape your world.

name: Squarism
short_description: SQUARISM is a minimalist logic game about combining pieces scattered around into a perfect square. Complete all 70 lovely-crafted levels and become master of square assembling!

name: Hunter of Antiques
short_description: Just one wrong step and you die

name: ROMBIE
short_description: Modular robotics & a Central Command was suppose to usher in prosperity, yet something went terribly wrong... ROMBIEs now scour the artificial wasteland for credits, modules & purpose. You, the Elite Recovery, spawned after a routine check on society started to fail...

name: Pinball
short_description: 3D Pinball game with an amazing feature: a Table Editor for you to create and play your own tables.

name: Rage Room
short_description: Welcome to Rage Room. Leave your day behind, let loose and release your rage, every last bit of it. With over 50 weapons to fuel your fury our test dummies won’t know what hit them, or at least until they gain sentience. Then it’s time to battle for your life as the dummies hit back in their faceless uprising!

name: Bike of the Wild
short_description: 2017 marks the bicentennial of the invention of the bicycle. To celebrate 200 years of riding, we present the gift of epic biking adventures, even when it's snowing outside!

name: YAPP: Yet Another Puzzle Platformer
short_description: A challenging puzzle platformer in which you clone and teleport.

name: Defrain
short_description: A simple arcade style space shooter.

name: まぜっこタワー
short_description: まぜっこタワーはプレイヤー自らダンジョンを作りながら冒険する、ローグライクゲームです。作り出したダンジョンを冒険し、 素材を集め、新たなダンジョンを作る・・・。こうして冒険を繰り返すことで、高難度のダンジョンを作成・攻略し、いずれは全100階からなるダンジョンの頂上を目指しましょう！日本のローグライクではお馴染みの合成システムもあります！武器や盾を合成して冒険を有利に進めましょう！

name: StrikeForce Kitty
short_description: Comedic puzzle-adventure with strong RPG influences. Take away costumes from the foxes, create the most mad combinations of clothes, explore the world, find secrets and save the princess from the clutches of the cunning king!

name: Super Meat Shooter
short_description: Retro first person shooter about love story with ocean of gore effects in an unusual world of strange dream with incredible creatures. 23 different levels, 12 types of enemies, 6 weapons and that's not all!

name: Ecopoiesis
short_description: Ecopoiesis is a top-down action game in which the player needs to protect the structures (and themselves) from enemies for a certain time on dozens of missions throughout the planet.

name: Purple Heart
short_description: Hardcore pixel indie platformer with puzzle elements and history. Can you get to the end?

name: Znkl - 177
short_description: You are a pilot of the spaceship "Znkl - 177". You need to deliver a capsule with important information to the cargo spaceship.

name: Kebab it Up!
short_description: Kebab it Up! is a fun and challenging game where you play as Sherban, chasing a runaway kebab through the streets of Bucharest. With challenging levels, a banger soundtrack, and a level editor for creating and playing community-made levels, it's perfect for curious adventurers who love a challenge.

name: Tronix Defender
short_description: Tronix Defender is a retro styled Tower Defence game where you must protect your CPU from hack-bots and trojans inside a digital world. The levels are partially randomised for maximised replay-ability and the game is enhanced by a killer Synthwave soundscape created by TimeSlave Recordings.

name: Neon Aileron
short_description: Neon Aileron is a shoot 'em up for people who are bad at shoot 'em ups. Enjoy the forgiving gameplay and 16-bit era graphics while shooting lots of enemies that spawn to the soundtrack!

name: The Finnish Virtual Art Gallery
short_description: The Finnish Virtual Art Gallery has a collection of famous Finnish paintings e.g Akseli Gallen-Kallela, Albert Edelfelt, Eero Järnefeld, Ferdinand von Wright, Fanny Churberg, Hugo Simberg and Helene Schjerfbeck.

name: Pixel Space Battles
short_description: Fly for a spaceship and destroy enemy alien ships to return to your homeplanet – Nibiru

name: Fidget Spinner In Space
short_description: Fly for a spinner in space, avoid asteroids and the UFO police, and collect heads of aliens flying in space

name: RoboVDino
short_description: Throw Garbage At Dinosaurs! RoboVDino is 1-5 player cooperative carnage!

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2018
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2018 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite professional basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: Touhou Tenkuushou ~ Hidden Star in Four Seasons.

short_description: This is a multiplayer tank combat VR game developed by Unreal4, which successfully helps the player get rid of dizziness and fatigue during playing. Using VR devices, the player will get unique virtual reality experience in “driving” a real tank to fight.

name: Temtem
short_description: Temtem is an online creature-collection adventure. Tame 165 unique creatures across 7 vibrant islands, battle other tamers, tackle mythical Lairs, chase Luma & Umbra variants, and breed your favorite Tems - with friends by your side! Dive into a colorful monster catching adventure, so Temtem up!

name: Ancient Treasure 法爾斯編年史：上古秘寶

"A Sky Full of Stars" is a coming-of-age astronomy tale by the same team who brought you "If My Heart Had Wings".

name: Terminal Conflict
short_description: Touch the world with your fingertips! Your retro terminal awaits your command, for the balance of power, in this definitive Cold War strategy game. Here you belong; assert your leadership through turn based strategic tit-for-tat, on the brink of mutually assured destruction. Don't let it slip away!

name: Play Together: Party Games

short_description: In Labyrinth Mode, challenge 9 levels, with each one being more challenging than the last! In Story Mode, control various characters and make the right choices to avoid the multiple dead ends and find a way to get out of an abandoned orphanage.
