short_description: The Placebos is a funky local couch multiplayer party game for one to four players. It includes three sophisticated minigames where you can show your friends or who is the boss here! Play as one of the oblique forty sons of King Placebo IV against your brothers, to prove yourself worthy to become his successor and to rule the kingdom of...

name: Battle Of Keys
short_description: Low Poly FPS Shooter where you need find 5 keys and avoid police army

name: Animals Memory: Underwater Kingdom
short_description: Animals Memory: Underwater Kingdom is a card game with images of various underwater animals that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards.

name: Maze Walker
short_description: Seriously big labyrinth for everyone who likes great challenges. This maze is exceptional by the fact that you can add a few interesting elements yourself, such as zombies and moving walls.

name: HorD: High or Die
short_description: HorD is an arcady highscore-driven Twin-Stick-Shooter set in a dystopian Drug Film universe. The player is orderd by the ominous "Chick" to collect samples of a new drug named FLOW, but instead ends up using it, creating a drug induced gorefest and fighting his own nightmares.

name: Fleets of Ascendancy
short_description: Meet allies, foes and aliens on your trek across a solar system. Plan layouts, coordinate attacks, balance resources, manage fleet facilities and take on many different kinds of enemies in numerous encounters along your journey.

name: Flyout
short_description: Build and fly realistic aircraft. Use free-form fuselage and wing editor tools and tune your engines to recreate aircraft from any era or design your own.

name: EarthNight
short_description: EarthNight is an illustrated epic 2D platformer about the dragon apocalypse.

name: Quests Unlimited
short_description: Quests Unlimited is inspired by a love for classic idle games like Progress Quest. Quests Unlimited is a classical interpretation of the idle rpg genre with a more traditional rpg style of gameplay being emulated.

name: Virtual Boxing League
short_description: Virtual Boxing League is a realistic physics and skill-based VR boxing simulation! Learn how to box, build self-confidence, have fun and get a great workout while developing your own personal fighting style!

name: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage
short_description: Welcome to the craziest racing experience! Destroy your friends in this demented shooting racing game, play alone, with the split screen mode or online. Enjoy multiple tracks, lots of vehicles and heavy artillery with multiples game modes and feed your hunger of speed, shooting and chaos!

name: The Infinite Black 2
short_description: Command a fleet of ships to hunt aliens, trade resources and loot treasure! Form corporations with your friends while fighting a never-ending intergalactic war in this open-world online space adventure!

name: Salsa Virtual
short_description: Learn to dance simple Salsa steps in this dance studio simulation. You will balance, step, pivot, mimic, learn, practice, salsa dance, and repeat. Virtual teachers break down real dance patterns within the salsa community. You hold hands with a virtual avatar and unlock new venues as you progress.

name: The Windzen Hero
short_description: Eight Stages of Run and Gun Action Leading to the Final Boss! Choose Different Paths on Different Play Throughs! Search for the Secrets Hidden in the Different Lands!

name: King Battle
short_description: R & D team effort for several years, focusing on the show the beauty of fighting! Even strokes, floating, block, dizziness, tyrants body, crushing fighting spirit! Focus on multiplayer!

name: INVISIBLE
short_description: "You are in a closed space craft. Your aim is to survive even though you defeat other passengers."

name: Champ Against Chumps Upgrade Edition
short_description: Collect the coin to reset the timer and to give yourself money. Spend the money on upgrades to make yourself better. Reach $500 in a single to game and then defeat the boss to win the game!

name: 众生
short_description: You may go through ups and downs in this life, with emotional experiences from unknown events. That could be something excites you, lifts your spirit, or something saddens you, drowns you into bitterness. But whatever you may be through, you will be dead eventually and with a new life to start.

name: Drumming
short_description: "Drumming" is an immersive simulator designed for aspiring drummers, offering a fun and affordable way to explore drumming without the need to invest in a full drum kit.

name: Little fight
short_description: 《Little fight》 is a magic theme, heroes battle, heavy athletics, turn-based SLG game. Proficient in the technical, strategic requirements, followed by competitive game skills design, strategy skills diversification: can be forced, dizziness, treatment, crawling, combat range, stealth, clear skills and so on.

name: Yet Another Research Dog
short_description: The research dog is a newly graduated Ph.D.. His life-long dream is to become a great scientist, but the fortune is not on his side. After years of hard working, he is finally offered an intern position in a random lab. However, the job is not that easy and happy as he expected.

name: Okinawa Rush
short_description: Take on the role of the martial arts master Hiro, Meilin, or Shin as they face off in a desperate fight for their lives against the Black Mantis clan. DOUBLE THE MAYHEM: Bring a friend and battle against ninjas, demons, and more in the 2-player local co-op mode of this action-adventure platformer.

name: Entropy 2120
short_description: Entropy 2120 is an extremely difficult First Person Shooter set in a dystopian futuristic world on the brink of collapse.

name: Charlie II
short_description: Charlie II is a classic side-scrolling platform game. Run through levels, collect coins, diamonds and other power ups. Jump on top of enemies to defeat them. Dive into the water to find hidden areas!

name: WAR PARTY
short_description: War Party is a strategy game where you enter a prehistoric world of Dinosaurs, Cavemen and Magic! Build up your chosen faction, gather resources, explore the land and command them against enemy tribes and wildlife! Will your story be about Life, Death or Balance? Can you survive?

name: Final Directive
short_description: Final Directive is a story driven shooter set in a space station disastrously infested by alien mutants. Find the crew, contain the infestation, and most importantly: make it out alive.

name: The Quest for the BIG KEY
short_description: The Quest for the BIG KEY is highly inspired by NES classics that you will no doubt recognize. It focuses more on the exploring part. It comes completely without Enemies and Battles. So if you like finding secret passages and collecting items that allow you to progress in different parts of the map, ...

name: Cannon Crew
short_description: Cannon Crew is a multiplayer co-op castle defence party game. Work as a team to defend your castle from incoming enemy attacks.

name: Jambo
short_description: A good game without limits with simple control and syllogistic passage of levels.

name: Fluffy Horde
short_description: Fluffy Horde is a 2D side-scrolling hybrid between real-time strategy and tower defense. The game revolves around a magical hyper-breeding bunny horde created by a misunderstood Shaman wanderer!

name: Primitive
short_description: Enter a three dimensional representation of open source Java, C#, C++, and JavaScript code in the Primitive Immersive Development Environment.

name: The SOL Device
short_description: Breaking free from stasis, you find yourself in an abandoned spaceship, full of hazards and mysteries. Using the Solid Optipartical Laser Device, you must journey your way across the ship, collecting new pieces of equipment as you go.

name: Filmmaker Tycoon
short_description: Filmmaker Tycoon is a next generation movie tycoon simulation game! You're the producer of your very own movie studio! Hire actors, build movie sets, make films, move up in the industry, and watch your finished films in Filmmaker Tycoon.

name: Block Heads: Instakill
short_description: Shoot and double jump your way through fast, kinetic, and blocky action in this one-hit, one-kill FPS as you secure your score. With customization galore: skins, hats, outfits, guns, maps, music, so much that you can't ignore! Co-op map editing, need I say more? Oh, and there are active ragdolls.

name: Revenge of the Headless
short_description: A brick adventure game. Every time will change the dungeon, use your head to kill a blood road, Durahan.

name: Specter
short_description: SPECTER is an experimental visual concept tool that allows Artists, Designers, Directors and Creatives alike to visualize concepts into basic shapes and human forms for storyboarding and concept art.

name: Mini Wheels
short_description: Mini Wheels is a story-driven karting game. Play one of the five available game modes: Story Campaign, Single Racing, Capture the Flag, Burnout and Boss Battle. Help Pipo - the lost and lonely toy - find the way back to his favorite human through an action-packed series of races.

name: 40 Winks
short_description: 40 Winks is an action platformer where you control brother and sister, Ruff and Tumble. Your goal is to collect 40 Winks scattered around the world to stop an evil man called Nitekap. Nitekap wants to turn the winks into hood-winks who are responsible for giving children nightmares.

name: Bladeline VR
short_description: Bladeline VR is a game designed to make players enjoy powerful sword actions. Get the best score, prove your performance and be the best swordsman ever!

name: Hyperbolic Ignition
short_description: Hyperbolic Ignition is a 2D multidirectional bullet hell-like shooter about a wandering pilot trying to return home. By utilizing wormholes, enter and evade combat against hostile spaceships, machinery, sentient crystals, and remnants of warfare.

name: BRIKS 2
short_description: BRIKS 2 is a classic retro arcade game with animated characters, animated backgrounds, boss monsters, power-ups and custom music. Collect bonuses and power-ups and power your way through over 100 new levels and unlock hidden levels.

name: Crossroad
short_description: Every granddaughter visits her grandmother for tea and something delicious to eat. Lumy is no different from millions of other girls. That is, except for one thing…

name: Mighty Gemstones
short_description: Combine all gemstones to complete the many different missions in this match 3 game.

name: STAR SOD
short_description: Abducted by the mysterious STAR group, you are put to work eliminating key targets of the Space Trading Association in this short action shooter game. Will you Succeed Or Die!?

name: Battle of Kings VR
short_description: The time of war has come! Take the command of your kingdom and use your strategic skills to defend the siege against your fortifications. You can’t win only by defending your Kingdom. Develop your economics, assemble and upgrade your army to defeat the enemy forces in a real Battle of Kings.

name: The Scent of Summer
short_description: This is a short story of a boy and girl in elementary school 6th grade in Japan. You can experience to go back home from school with a girlfriend who goes the same cram school in the early summer evening. Special things don't happen but you can being with a girlfriend in a sentimental atmosphere of dusk.

name: Tombo Breaker VR
short_description: Tombo Breaker VR - Action Parkour game with procedural generated levels.

name: Squirm
short_description: After a previous adventure, you and your rat friend stop for a snooze. When you wake up, the rat is gone and strange creatures have appeared across the land as if from out of nowhere! What has happened while you were asleep? Where is your rat friend?

name: Animals Memory: Dogs
short_description: Memory Animals: Dogs is a card game with pictures of different dogs that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards. This part of the game is aimed at fans of dogs.

name: Love or Loved - A Bullet For My Valentine
short_description: This Valentine, the only way to claim your love is to clear your competition. Put a bullet through them.

name: Valley of the foxes
short_description: Test your survival skills against other players in a new multiplayer battle royal game. Cook, craft, kill, build, throw, fight or just starve but make sure you are the last alive.

name: Corpse Party: Book of Shadows
short_description: An anthology series that serves as a Corpse Party sequel, prequel, midquel, and alternate universe tale all in one. Rejoin old friends for a deeper dive into the haunted halls of Heavenly Host Elementary...

name: Corpse Party: Sweet Sachiko's Hysteric Birthday Bash
short_description: Vengeful spirit Sachiko Shinozaki is having a birthday bash, and the lovable cast of damned souls from the Corpse Party series is invited! Join the revelers as they do their best to keep Sachiko happy and survive her twisted games in this midquel to Corpse Party and Corpse Party: Book of Shadows.

name: Dead Ground
short_description: Tower defense reimagined! Dead Ground is a procedurally generated tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Each playthrough will offer randomly generated guns, skills and augments. You'll have to travel, collect scrap, water, manage your inventory and upgrade your base to survive!

name: Ruzar - The Dark Stones
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey in Ruzar - The Dark Stones, the sequel to Ruzar - The Life Stone. Explore mysterious realms and uncover the secrets of the Dark Stones, with enhanced gameplay testing your skills in treacherous dungeons.

name: The Communist Dogifesto
short_description: The Communist Dogifesto is a science fiction first person shooter set on a Soviet space station in lunar orbit, which has been taken over by hyper-intelligent dogs.

name: Crystals and Curses
short_description: Welcome to Asterra, where the puzzles are cursed, the lobsters gamble, and riddles lead you somewhere you never expected.

name: Amelia's Curse
short_description: Amelia's Curse is an action-horror survival game built from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Experience hordes of demonic creatures as you descend into an increasingly decrepit and sinister castle to uncover the mystery behind Amelia's Curse.

name: Big Blue - Memory
short_description: Become a killer whale and join a great journey to the endless sea. Join the great story of breaking through the harsh environments of ever-changing seas and overcoming the mighty storms.

name: Nazi Elimination
short_description: Nazi Elimination is a hardcore fps. Buy guns and ammo in the store, use them to kill nazis.

name: Bustories
short_description: A small visual novel about bus trips and conversation with different companions, whom you see for the first and last time in your life.

name: Trinity
short_description: Trinity is a challenging fps/puzzle set in a surrealistic universe.

name: Mountain Troll
short_description: Mountain Troll is a simple 2D platformer in which you play as a mountain Troll. Imagine that you are the kindest Troll in the world and someone stole your stuff, you have to get them back!

name: Zero Gravity Pool
short_description: Defy gravity! Zero Gravity Pool is a new sci-fi spin on an old classic. The game of billiards is finally promoted to the third dimension! Find new and challenging trick shots in geometries never before imagined.Play using your virtual reality (VR) system, with a gamepad, or mouse and keyboard.

name: Foto Flash
short_description: Foto Flash is an adventure game about two things: HOT BABES and FUNKY TRACKS. If you're into that then this is the game for you! Can you get enough photos in time to save the pin-up magazine? Explore the streets of Sala City and meet a cast of quirky characters in this tongue-in-cheek adventure.

name: Strange House
short_description: Сity of sadness, where everyone tries to survive, in which there is no place for anyone and which is infinitely huge. It absorbs everyone who is not ready to live by his rules. Are you ready for this?

name: Snoobli
short_description: Thousand years of knowledge taken by the strangers from humanity, Unleash your mind and join to the Heroes of the Snoobli to lead your way back to the knowledge and take back!

name: Super Bit Adventure: Paragons of Life
short_description: Super Bit Adventure: Paragons of Life is a perma death dungeon crawler where you take on the role of a mysterious hero that survived a battle inside of a magical prison. Enter the prison and discover what happened on that fateful day and collect the powers of fallen adventurers along the way.

name: Volcano Tower
short_description: Climb the infinite volcano tower and fight your way through the dangers within!

name: Amorous
short_description: Explore the dazzling neon lights of Amorous. A bustling furry night club that attracts all species, personalities and sexualities. Create your own character and find all 9 datable characters!

name: Tunescape
short_description: Check out new VR experiences without buying more apps! Browse shared tunescapes, or create and share your own with building and animation tools that let you create whatever you can think up.

name: The Agency: Chapter 2
short_description: After experiencing engine problems on board Commodore Ashemont’s flagship “The Orion”, our team of cunning detectives have been forced to land near the affluent town of Pera, a playground for the Empire’s nobility.

name: Ladybird Reflect
short_description: Ladybird Reflect is a Breakout game about a ladybird on a journey to find its lost children and it needs your help to get them back.

name: Desktop Agents - Cov1d-999
short_description: Consider wearing a mask to play. A virtual alien virus COV1D-999 uses dramatic scenes from movies and series in order to conquer your PC. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more! Wash your hands after playing.

name: HYBRIS - Pulse of Ruin
short_description: Embark on a journey about finding strength to stand up to challenge your destiny and discover a purpose beyond survival. Experience a deep story in a post-apocalyptic fantasy world. Enjoy an epic RPG with an innovative turn-based battle system.

name: Soul for two
short_description: Soul for two is a heroic JRPG about the life of two different people in different worlds, but with different destinies. Will two souls pass all the tests?

name: Armored Evolution
short_description: Armored Evolution is an arena style top down shooter where you battle planetary guardians on a quest to dominate the universe! Venture alone or with your friends earning legendary avatars and weapons on your way. Find and upgrade equipment to discover unique strategies and decimate your foes!

name: Please close the doors
short_description: "Please close the doors" is a quest with elements of the detective and thriller in which the player should find out who of seven people, which got stuck with him in the elevator, is a criminal until he hasn't killed all the peaceful characters during interruptions in light.

name: Animals Memory: Insect
short_description: Animals Memory: Insect is a card game with images of various insects that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards

name: KOMMERSANT
short_description: KOMMERSANT is a game that will teach you how to think positively, carve your way to success, and finally sell that friggin vacuum. Buy KOMMERSANT now and become mind-bogglingly successful in no time!

name: Magical Star Pillars
short_description: Save the Star Pillars by finding allies and switching between them to solve the many puzzle based levels.

name: Bashville
short_description: Bashville is a good old-fashioned shoot 'em up with loads of weapons and enemies to fight. Go through The Realm levels and defeat the various enemies found within. Use the level environment to your advantage.

name: SUPREMACY: WORLD WAR 3
short_description: This Long Term Strategy Game lets you take control of the armed forces of your nation. Become responsible for its military expansion, technological research and economic development. Form alliances and wage total war for global dominance on the battlefields of World War 3.

name: Little Adventurer III
short_description: This is a first-person casual game that focuses on going home after helping the little girl, and a few mini-games.

name: Massive Galaxy
short_description: Explore, trade and fight your way through Massive Galaxy, a point and click narrative adventure set in bustling cyberpunk cities, deserted wastelands and beautifully crafted space habitats

name: Dig and Shoot
short_description: It looks like a simple play, but there's a deeper story behind it.

name: Dark Flow
short_description: Three bandits kidnaped a girl, bring her to an abandoned building and wait for a ransom, they chose the right victim but chose the wrong place.

name: Cosmic Top Secret
short_description: Play the incredible true story of T and her quest to uncover the truth about her parents’ work for the Danish Intelligence during the Cold War.

name: Anime girl Or Bottle?
short_description: This is a logic game with 2 modes, in one you need to find and click on all anime girls before the time runs out, and in second mode you play for anime girl and you need to collect as many bottles as possible before the time runs out.

name: Clawface
short_description: Clawface is an intense, arcade-styled twin stick shooter where you play as an adorable robot equipped with crazy weapons and a giant claw to fight an endless wave of alien monsters!

name: VIRUS RUSH
short_description: Create a universal cure for all coronaviruses in a modern nano-laboratory! A modern view on the classic game! Colorful action and catchy mechanics are now in virtual reality!

name: Team Sonic Racing™
short_description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing.

name: Space Farm
short_description: Space Farm is following in the footsteps of amazing games like Stardew Valley, and any of the Harvest Moon franchise. We are setting out to bring this amazing genre into the next generation. In-depth Storyline, dynamic marketplace, reputation, items, and of course FARMING!

name: Neon Krieger Yamato
short_description: Relive the arcade era! Select from 8 unique characters and brawl your way to victory - solo or with a friend! A genre mashup of Japanese 90s gaming, it mixes stylish combos, sidescrolling action, and twitch combat puzzles, set in a pixel art cyberpunk world harkening to the days of 16 bit.

name: Titanic: Adventure Out Of Time
short_description: Intrigue and adventure await you on board the Titanic, the most famous ocean liner in history. As a British secret agent on a vital mission, it is up to you to change the course of history as you explore the world’s most luxurious ocean vessel in all its original splendour.

name: Scutter
short_description: Scutter is a VR arcade-style obstacle race for a hexapod robot. While exploring the planet Cryla, an alien virus rains down potentially ending your mission. Fire, Roll and Fly your way through action-packed maps of increasing difficulty to collect energy crystals and teleport Scutter back home. Free demo available!

name: The Real Laser Ball
short_description: A physics based, arcade, high score chaser with a progression system and a fetish for the 80’s. In The Real Laser Ball you’re a ball… with a laser.

name: Spring It!
short_description: A Physics puzzle game where you build tools to bounce, launch, push, and pull your toy robots to reach the end of production.

name: Luminescence
short_description: "Let's make a deal, if you can prove that urban legend is a lie, I won't bother you anymore." Rena is annoying student. She always show up wherever Ady is. Until one day, they make a deal. If Ady can prove that urban legend is a lie, she promise to leave Ady alone. Can Ady prove it ?

name: This Is the Police 2
short_description: Interpret the law as you see fit! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

name: [東方二次] Senran Meisuishu Tactics / 戦乱命萃酒タクティクス
short_description: One day, a strange cup appeared in Gensokyo. A big fight will occur in search of it!

name: Crumple Zone
short_description: A tribute to arcade crash racing games of the 90s and 2000s. Turn off your brain, put the pedal to the metal and smash up some cars!

name: Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation 2
short_description: Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation 2 is the consequent further development of the successful first part, which lets every Firefighter Fan experience the way a professional fire brigade works.

name: OF MICE AND SAND -REVISED-
short_description: On a desert planet in the farthest reaches of space, mice await your command! Direct their mobile fortress, and seek the legendary city of gold!

name: WHAT THE GOLF?
short_description: A silly physics-based golf parody where every golf course is a new surprising type of golf, some brilliant or hilarious, others so absurd you will ask yourself: WHAT THE GOLF?

name: ADONIS
short_description: Adonis is a stylized, open world action game that focuses on third person combat & platforming!

name: Moe Jigsaw
short_description: "Moe Jigsaw" is the definitive version of the digital jigsaw puzzle that collects only "Moe & Kawaii" illustrations, that is one of the Japanese cultures.

name: Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story
short_description: Build a school for RPG heroes in a mix of simulation and role-play adventure. As Principal of a school for the warriors and mages of the future, you must build your Academy to train the best in the land. Place and upgrade facilities, form teams of the best students and send them out on epic quests!

name: Zombie Watch
short_description: Top-down open world single player / survival / RPG game with zombies and wildlife.

name: Admine
short_description: Admine is a new take on a classic minesweeper puzzle game with procedurally generated levels that challenge the player to get to the exit through a mine infested facility.

name: OVERWHELM
short_description: You're outnumbered, low on ammunition and the paranoia sets in. This is an action horror-world where enemies get power-ups and you don’t.

name: Hexologic
short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautiful world of Hexologic. Solve challenging, yet rewarding puzzles, listen to relaxing music, dive deep into the game’s atmosphere and fall in love in with Sudoku again!

name: Madness of the Architect
short_description: Madness of The Architect is a surreal horror/puzzle game inspired by older point-and-click adventure games such as Myst, Nine Doors and 999: Nine Hours. Players enter a world that seems to be going insane and must solve labyrinths of mind bending puzzles to escape the clutches of the Mad Architect!

name: Command: The Silent Service
short_description: Submarine warfare from post-WW2 to the present day! Lay mines, strike land targets with cruise and ballistic missiles, creep up to surface ships to take hull shots undetected, sniff sensitive electronic emissions, tap undersea communications cables, covertly deliver special-forces teams ashore, and of course hunt down anything on the sea...

name: Strategic Command Classic: Global Conflict
short_description: The Matrix version is the Gold Edition of the original and includes the the two DLCs "Assault on Communism" and "Assault on Democracy". Players will be able to wage World War II across the massive expanse of the entire planet.

name: Sacrifice Dungeon
short_description: Sacrifice Dungeon is an FPS that pays homage to the FPS of old. The game is built on Ray Casting technology, simple yet challenging. Fight your way through hordes of monsters while collecting items and increasing your high score. Find the source of evil that is causing great turmoil to the village of Riksbruk!

name: Hub Culture VR
short_description: The Hub Culture Virtual Reality experience delivers the world's first immersive banking experience and is based on the Ven digital currency. Members can access virtual hospitality environments and use their HubID to send and receive Ven, message members, interact with a virtual Concierge etc.

name: Warhead
short_description: A man sent to exile gets his memory erased by a god after a bad trauma happened. Survive, craft and fight your way back to the Empire.

name: Haunted Hotel: Lonely Dream
short_description: Explore the Haunted Hotel and experience supernatural phenomenon for yourself in Haunted Hotel: The Lonely Dream!

name: Redemption Cemetery: Clock of Fate Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you undo the past and set the trapped souls free?

name: Sea of Lies: Burning Coast Collector's Edition
short_description: A mysterious plague is sweeping through towns along the coast, and you're the only one who knows the truth!

name: Myths of the World: Spirit Wolf Collector's Edition
short_description: The wolf spirit still haunts... will you heed its call?

name: Grim Facade: A Wealth of Betrayal Collector's Edition
short_description: The city fears the return of the infamous Fire Knight – but is Rosa Ramirez really responsible?

name: Rite of Passage: Hide and Seek Collector's Edition
short_description: Twenty years ago, the children of Greystone were taken by a mysterious fog - only you escaped. It’s time to find out why...

name: Maestro: Notes of Life Collector's Edition
short_description: A missing girl has been lured away by evil music! Stop the young prodigy and save everyone from the evil Maestro!

name: Cubes
short_description: A puzzle game uniquely suited to virtual reality.

name: Galaxy Wide Domination
short_description: In this game, you must take down an empire of evil, corrupt space ships, and restore peace to the universe. To do this, you must take out as many ships as you can, as well as defeat the emperor, who is hiding out in an other dimension, in an arena, top down shooter-style game made entirely by 1 person.

name: Teeny Heist
short_description: Can you shoplift until you drop? In this shoplifting simulator you can steal everything from groceries to pets from a crazy pet store while avoiding the police!

name: Plat4mer
short_description: "climb. kill. survive." Plat4mer is a simple 2D action platformer. Use your character's skills to kill as many enemies as possible!

name: Pad of Time
short_description: A 2.5D retro-platformer game with time travel mechanics. Use a time machine to explore the past, present, and future.

name: Bomb Bay
short_description: Bomb Bay is a new single player game that takes the player into many different and unique settings with the task of arming explosive devices on enemy payloads. You are all alone, with nothing but your mind, your weaponry, and your mission.

name: ReHack
short_description: The hacking simulator, which consists of many mini-games, which together all merge into one, composite game.

name: Armored Squad
short_description: Fast paced team shooter with mechs, robots and cartoon style graphics.

name: Undercover Agent
short_description: Think fast and lie faster! When you go undercover to retrieve a deadly new bio-weapon, can you pull off the mission and escape with your life?

name: Internal Storm
short_description: This game let you dive into the nostalgia atmosphere of the old-school text-based PC games. You’ll have only few commands to use. So the key to success is your attention and imagination.

name: Ativeil
short_description: Ativeil is a fun and interesting 3D puzzle game. Cubes, lasers, teddy bears... this game has them all. Can you figure it out ?

name: Shinobi Bad Buddies
short_description: Shinobi Bad Buddies will reveal the mischievous ninja in you, as you make your way through the story and the co-op missions or challenge your friends into a local battle!

name: Alien Crusader
short_description: Alien Crusader is an action packed, vertical scrolling, space shooter game, similar to classic coin-up arcade and shoot'em up games.

name: Bleak
short_description: Bleak is a Sci-Fi survival game. You must fight the planetary environments to survive and thrive. Currently available features are basic base building and mining with Researching new technology and discovering new flora and fauna coming soon. Play alone or coop with friends, its up to you.

name: Purgatory Fell
short_description: Purgatory Fell is a psychological thriller set in 1955. Explore the declining mind of a man who cannot sleep. A progression of nightmares reveals hints about who you were, and what you are becoming.

name: An Aspie Life
short_description: One day your roommate Leaves for no reason. You’re left to face the outside world alone. But this can be both difficult and amazing when you have autism. This game recreates how some people with autism perceive the world. All forms of sound, graphics and interactions are intentional.

name: Fantastic Sea
