short_description: In this world, as part of the adventurers, the Puddings Bear will travel to labyrinths around the world and seek treasure, in a land of magic and technology, where pudding will fight an army of greedy thieves, while searching for the lost magic along the way.

name: Dungeons of the dead
short_description: Dungeons of the dead ... Who knows what is hidden in them?

name: HOST
short_description: When your spacecraft crashes on an unknown planet, you navigate your way through its dark and puzzling corridors. Using only your hands and your wits, will you discover your parasitic power before it's too late?

name: Stargazer program
short_description: Dueling pvp, shoot em up. Face your opponents head on, trade bullets and blast them across the universe.

name: Jelly Bomber
short_description: An innovative abstract puzzler from the creators of 100 Rogues and Auro: A Monster-Bumping Adventure! Get combos, use special powers and drop bombs on fruit to create delicious Jelly Jam!

name: Grid Clash VR
short_description: Grid Clash is a physically demanding team based multiplayer disc battle/ ball game. At its core this game is supposed to be a virtual gym where you can just let loose with other people.

name: Tomb Towers
short_description: The necromancer is hiding in a locked tomb tower. Solve puzzles, acquire keys and open doors until you catch-up to him.

name: Death Mark Vol.1 - 死印之迷雾
short_description: Yuri Detective Adventure Game created by Cloud Studio.

name: OniBushi VR
short_description: Samurai Action Slasher for VR Defend your Castle from invaders using your fencing, ninja, archery skill.

name: Six Second Slam
short_description: You have six seconds to race to the next level, before the door slams shut! Ten levels, six seconds each! Can you finish in a minute? How far can you get? Is it even possible? Find out, in Six Second Slam!

name: The Other Side Of The Screen
short_description: The game has 5 main characters that participate in a deadly show called "The Other Side of the Screen" . Each player has to find a way out of his location. The levels and their difficulty are completely different. You are given an opportunity to play for any of the mentioned characters.

name: Rise of the Savage
short_description: The Last Barbarian is a 3D action hack and slash game.

name: MinigolfPark VR
short_description: Experience VR minigolf on a variety of courses. Play by swinging the club like you would in real life by using motion controllers. Fully supports Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.

name: Metis One
short_description: Metis One is an action-packed co-op top down shooter in the design style of the arcade classics. Take command of the A6-Gravitus to defend the people of Jupiter Colony, Metis One, against an unrelenting alien onslaught. With Drop-In Co-op, Player Two can join the action at anytime!

name: Игра забытых Богов. Проснись / Game of the forgotten Gods. Wake up
short_description: The game of forgotten gods. Wake up is a dynamic action game, sword fighting, magic tricks, and an exciting adventure deep into the mysteries of the world, which are protected by invisible force.

name: Trivia Vault: Hockey Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Hockey Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer hockey trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Canvas
short_description: Navigate a mysterious world with painting as your guide. Unlock abilities, grow plants, meet characters, discover new worlds, and confront the mad mage to free yourself.

name: NEKO-NIN exHeart 2
short_description: This is a Sequel to NEKO-NIN exHeart. Japan. From time immemorial, there are those who possess superhuman abilities. These beings who looked like a cross between man and beast are called Demi-Humans. They acted as Ninja and served those in power.

name: Super Weekend Mode
short_description: Catch hearts, Crush bunnies, Shoot the bad guys

name: Mama Farm
short_description: Help Mimi the young farmer apprentice to manage the farm while her parents are away. This is not going to be as easy as it seems: there's a lot of work, and some undesirables may make your work tougher than expected !

name: The Stranger VR
short_description: The Stranger is an intense VR combat game which sets in an incredibly detailed exotic world. Explore the rich sci fi universe and survive with your weapons and wrist blade. Welcome to the world of the Stranger!

name: War Of The Zombie
short_description: War of the Zombie brings together the best of turn-based simulation and real-time strategic gameplay action across the entire world at the very start of a mysterious undead outbreak.

name: Berserker's Descent
short_description: Berserker's Descent is a visceral, hardcore Roguelite. Descend into The Source and engage in brutal melee combat.

name: Laws of Machine
short_description: This game is 2.5D platformer with logical puzzles that you should to solve. In the game, you control the robot DR12 that must get to the professor to save him from the evil robot who wants to escape from the lab. To get to the professor's room, you need to solve logical puzzles.

name: Dumb As Wizards
short_description: Magical madness for 1-4 players on the couch and online. Whale on your frenemies with crazy spells in a shrinking arena and be the last dummy standing! Embrace the chaos in this fun-for-all wizard brawler. You're a wizard, Dummy!

name: Tales of the Neon Sea
short_description: Welcome to a world of intrigue and suspicion. Where humans and robots contend with escalating tensions and mutual distrust. And where gangster felines scheme their way to the top of the food chain. Welcome to the Tales of the Neon Sea!

name: Paper Shakespeare: The Legend of Rainbow Hollow
short_description: Explore a post-apocalyptic world and solve puzzles using that big brain of yours. Discover the secrets of the universe! Be awesome!

name: Turbo Soccer VR
short_description: Turbo Soccer VR is an ultimate football simulator created exclusively for Virtual Reality. Become a professional football player. Challenge yourself in a real-life, goal-scoring situations. Practice your skills in the arcade modes and enjoy the immersive atmosphere of the stadium!

name: Artipic
short_description: Excellent tools to perfect your great shots! Artipic is a multi-platform image editing system that allows you to quickly and easily edit, retouch, compose and distribute your pictures and photos. - Are you an amateur or professional photographer? - Do you take a lot of great photos when traveling?

name: The Stroke of Midnight
short_description: Rowan Cox wakes up in a barren room, alone with a mysterious girl he's never seen before. He quickly comes to realise that things are very much out of place. A full-length Mystery/Detective visual novel with an LGBT-inclusive cast.

name: My Golf
short_description: My Golf is a relaxing mini golf game set in beautiful environments.

name: The Stillness of the Wind
short_description: A quiet game of life and loss. One by one, everyone left the village for the city. Everyone, except Talma. Approaching her final years, she maintains a simple way of life tending to her homestead, surviving, subsisting, whilst increasingly disturbing letters arrive from her family in the city.

name: aMAZE Frozen
short_description: aMAZE Frozen is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with calm soundtrack.

name: Howlville: The Dark Past
short_description: Many years ago an artifact was found in one of the mines near the small town of Howlville. The government asked scientists to examine it. Dr. Joseph was one of those scientists. Strange events began to happen in the underground lab, and something went wrong, causing a strong earthquake.

name: Blonde Driver
short_description: Blonde Driver is parking simulator. You need to park your car with minimal hits.

name: Hit The Hive
short_description: Hit the Hive is a dark Space Shooter in VR, where you must test your mettle against waves of brutal robots. HTH is focused on challenging you like never before and we utilise procedural generation to make sure no two waves are the same, ensuring a fun, energetic and novel experience every time you play.

name: Light Borrower
short_description: Join Rachel as she faces the Cleansing, a coming-of-age ritual that will determine whether she joins the last survivors of the end of the world or is banished above ground.

name: Burst Into
short_description: Burst Into is an indie game that will give you a break with your friends on the chosen map.

name: LEGO® DC Super-Villains
short_description: It's good to be bad… Embark on an all-new DC/LEGO® adventure by becoming the best villain the universe has seen. Players will create and play as an all-new super-villain throughout the game, unleashing mischievous antics and wreaking havoc in an action-packed story.

name: Extreme Dash: Reloaded
short_description: Extreme Dash: Reloaded is an extremely fast arcade game. Challenge yourself with this minimal, colorful neon themed game featuring an awesome electronic soundtrack!Your goal is to survive for 60 seconds in order to unlock the next level. It looks easy, but it will certainly take you a *few* tries to achieve it.

name: AIdol: Artificial Intelligence Idol
short_description: A young high school student goes on an adventure to save her favorite virtual idol, Aiko, from malfunctioning, and gets help from the most unexpected of places.

name: Morning Never Comes
short_description: Morning Never Comes is arcade style arena twin stick shooter that takes place in the dark and eerie kids bedroom filled with evil toys trying to kill you. Collect synergetic power-ups and survive as long as possible.

name: Kaze and the Wild Masks
short_description: Go on a journey as Kaze in this 90’s classics inspired platformer. When the Crystal Islands get cursed, Kaze needs to save her friend Hogo while facing enraged living vegetables. Find the Wild Masks to unleash the powers of the legendary guardians and master land, sky and sea.

name: bomber-un
short_description: The game requires you to blow up the stone blocks with extreme caution! Because you have a certain quantity of explosive by means of which you will blow up blocks.

name: Nicky - The Home Alone Golf Ball
short_description: A poor and home alone golf ball needs your help to get your goal - to find his home ( a hole in a golf track ) in less movements as possible. Nicky moves only with mouse, you just need to drag, look at some point and release. The game is funny and challenging!

name: Wren's Journey
short_description: As the new entrusted soul chosen to be the next Guardian Bear Spirit of the Island of Virtue. You are tasked with connecting yourself within the land and defending it from all else who seeks to cause it harm.

name: Project Myriad
short_description: Project Myriad is a tower defense strategy game. You build towers on a map of hexagons that will attack and defeat oncoming waves of enemies. Towers can be upgrade and some have varied upgrade paths. The goal is clear as many waves as possible. How far can you get?

name: Fun Hospital
short_description: Build your own theme hospital! Here, you might meet patients with a lot of hair, or no hair; strange aliens, evil guy, super hero…

name: Firebird - Steam version
short_description: Love retro shooters? Firebird is a blend of some of our teams favourite games from the space invasion genre. Battle aliens, giant space birds, tractor beams, air burst weapons, robot terrorists and massive motherships in a fight for domination.

name: Katie
short_description: "What are you running from?" Katie is a game about forging relationships, reflecting on your own existence, and trying to figure out why you ended up trapped in this secluded town. Features a large cast of unique characters and a lovingly handmade pixel-stylized environment, ripe for exploration!

name: CryoFall
short_description: CryoFall is a sci-fi colony simulation survival game set on a forgotten planet in a distant future. Master technology, agriculture, trading, industry, cybernetics, exploration, and more!

name: Alice In VR
short_description: Fall down the rabbit hole as Alice in Wonderland! Drink from the bottle and become tiny, eat the cake and become huge. Meet the cat, the rabbit and the caterpillar - all in VR!

name: Skat Stammtisch
short_description: With Skat Stammtisch you can enjoy a match of Skat on your PC whenever you feel like it!

name: No Time to Relax
short_description: No Time to Relax is a life simulation game where up to 4 players online or locally compete against each other in the ultimate game of life.

name: The Nature
short_description: (NOT A MOBILE GAME PORT or NOT AN RPG MAKER GAME!!!) You are a creature just like others. You have the same needs, the same abilities. There is just one difference; you can talk with the Spirit of The Nature. Gather items, craft weapons, achieve your dreams, start a family, form a party and complete the quests without dying.

name: Robots Attack On Vapeland
short_description: You play for robot Pep, and you need to save your planet from invasion of invaders from Kokostan. An great and interesting adventure awaits you

name: Synthrally
short_description: Synthrally is a local multiplayer arcade sports game with simple, fast-paced action. Choose from an array of selectable classes, map variants, and alternate play modes to mix things up and keep gameplay exciting!

name: Baby's on fire: 99 virgins
short_description: Become a real hero! At least in this game.

name: Russian World
short_description: Russia, an alternative reality Vasya is an ordinary welder at the plant, typical Monday morning, Vasya is going to go to work, but, unexpectedly, he discovers in his house a strange man ... You are waiting for an incredible and interesting adventure

name: Jagoondo
short_description: Third-person survival game, where you have to stay alive and travel the ocean. Each foray is a challenge. Sharks and other creatures constantly will want to eat you up. Collect resources, build bases, manage minions and travel to the Islands searching of missing Jagoondo!

name: Platform Challenge
short_description: Platform Challenge was made to challenge even the most experienced players. Can you complete all the challenges?

name: Monster Crown
short_description: Dive into a dark world where monsters rule and make pacts with them to defeat an evil young woman seeking power. Hunt, battle, tame and breed monsters to create your own legacy. Together with your monsters, you can restore the balance to Crown Island.

name: Nogalious
short_description: Nogalious is a retro-style action platformer that pays homage to the era of classic 2D platforming on 8-bit personal computers. Explore 5 different worlds and go through cozy dungeons in the first title of a trilogy that tells the story of Nogalious, his daughter Mariet, and the evil Darama.

name: Drowning
short_description: Walk in the shoes of this teenage boy who learns to live with his inner demon.

name: MazeBot
short_description: “Awake! Your next cycle is close. Fulfill your purpose, do as you are told!”

name: Achievement Lurker: You are going to have to work hard for these nuts
short_description: Jacob must find all tat is hidden in the dimensional rift. fight monsters, turn based combat, XP system RPG Combat Level UP Shop Inventory system

name: The Blobs Fight
short_description: The Blobs Fight is a silly, local multiplayer, arena party game where you play as blob creatures. Attacking knocks pieces off others, and collect those pieces to get bigger. The bigger you are, the more damage you do, but the slower you move. Play across a variety of PvP and PvE modes and maps!

name: Bounty Hunter: Ocean Diver
short_description: Take to the depths of the deepest oceans in search for the Prime fish in this hidden object game, every mission you'll be assigned various fish to hunt and an oxygen timer, get the mission completed before your oxygen runs out!

name: Finger Jets
short_description: Finger Jets: Phase Challenge is a 2D Arcade physics game where you control the Jets of your Spaceship with your Finger tips as you Challenge 3 phases with 6 levels each. High scores for challenge Time Attack are tracked on the leaderboards.

name: OVERTURN: Final Operation
short_description: After the down of Beholder, MAGI is left alone and since the final fight, she lost all her abilities and is unable to fight anymore. Enemies are still coming and they shows no sign of stopping... It’s terrifying to see that there are still a huge number of enemies even many of them have been defeated before.

name: BattleBeasts
short_description: Planet Shima attracts adventure seekers from all over the Galaxy BB-79 due to its unique resources. The mysterious effects on this planet made Artificial Intelligence of Shima aggressive towards all intelligent species of animals.

name: Holy Potatoes! A Spy Story?!
short_description: Holy Potatoes! A Spy Story?! is a wacky spy agency sim where you manage your very own potato spy headquarters, train an elite spy team, and strategize top-secret missions while uncovering the truth behind an evil spy corporation.

name: Storm of Jigsaw Puzzles  拼图风暴
short_description: A hardcore puzzle, 300+ puzzle choices, ranking list of global players, unique customized puzzle,enjoy the fun of puzzles.

name: Existential Kitty Cat RPG
short_description: Inspired by Garfield. Join Louis and Timcat on a strange quest to discover their feline origins. Make your characters warriors, assassins, mages, or healers.

name: DayZ Tools
short_description: A complete tools suite for the game engine powering DayZ.

name: The Eerie Inn
short_description: The Eerie Inn is a mystery, puzzle-solving horror game with a strong emphasis on the narrative. You play as one of the girls staying at a guest house and your mission is to find out the truth behind the mysterious things happening there. You will soon realize that things aren't what they appear to be..

name: Poker Simulator
short_description: Learn, Play and Win !!! Poker played on a PC has now reached a new standard of game play. Not only can you play poker, you will also be taught how to improve your game and surprise your friends.

name: Death Game
short_description: It's a race to your grave! Can you die before everyone else, or will you be forced to watch in despair, living to a ripe old age before finally succumbing to a regular, uninteresting ending?!!

name: Jets'n'Guns 2
short_description: Jets'n'Guns 2 is a side-scrolling space shooter with insane levels of action and destruction. Travel the galaxies and unleash an arsenal of the deadliest weapons and devices to save the universe from its inevitable doom.

name: Dragon's Eye
short_description: Dragon's Eye is an action adventure game filled with fast paced combat against dangerous creatures in an ever changing open world. Play your way through this adventure as Yen, a brave knight trying to prove his might against Gonti, a dragon that is hellbent on destroying everything in sight.

name: Infinite Vector
short_description: As a "Time Traveling Assassin" you are tasked with going back in time to take out the bad guys who ruined the future as we know it. You wield powers such as super speed, teleportation, and the ability to use anything in your environment to your advantage, including incoming bullets!

name: Doodle Date
short_description: Romance, seduce, and even marry your own drawings! Forget about finding true love; In Doodle Date, you create it!

name: London Museum Of Water & Steam
short_description: This application is a virtual tour of the London Museum of Water & Steam museum. The application allows you to explore the museum and the functioning steam machines.

name: Dolmen
short_description: Dolmen is a terrifying new action RPG that combines futuristic Sci-Fi and Cosmic Horror elements. Will your timeline be erased or will you defeat your enemies to survive and fulfil your mission?

name: Black Jack Story
short_description: In the game, you act as a participant in a large card tournament "Golden Skull", held among the best players from all over the world.

name: The Cabinets of Doctor Arcana
short_description: The Cabinets of Doctor Arcana is a dark adventure game set inside the haunted mansion of a mysterious magician who vanished several years ago. Resolve a maze of riddles and perplexing puzzles to unlock doors and secret passages, or be doomed to spend eternity trapped inside the inescapable mansion.

name: OS:Path
short_description: Small but tricky indie game to spend your evening on playing. You'll have to determine the cause of a program's critical error and restore its modules by playing mini games and solving puzzles while using the console.

name: Brother Perro
short_description: Play with 'P.', a mystery character trying to figure out what's going on in this 'dream'. Who to trust? Apparently, not the dog.

name: Unconventional Warfare
short_description: In this top-down tactical shooter RPG, guide a band of cute soldiers through a warzone to safety. Rescue, train and manage your squad for the upcoming war of survival.

name: Space Pilgrim Academy: Year 2
short_description: As Margaret Dale enters her second year at the academy, she begins to suspect that one of her classmates might possess some unusual abilities. Meanwhile, Gail and Sabina undertake an investigation into suspicious activities at Union Station.

name: Doors Quest Demo
short_description: Wow, it's Doors Quest Demo! You gotta go through the door if you wanna win the game!

name: Maxi Pool Masters VR
short_description: Maxi pool Masters takes you inside the action in a fun and innovative pool game.

name: KeyBoard Guitar Master
short_description: KeyBoard Guitar Master is an easy to play music rhythm game. If you like old style rock guitar songs, please don't miss this one.

name: Hovercraft Drive
short_description: Casual hovercraft driving experience with three sprawling environment: Hills, Dunes and Tundra.

name: Kolb Antarctica Experience
short_description: Using VR to deliver Experiential Learning. The main objective is to further facilitate the Department of Education curriculum learning through emerging technology that students are excited to use.

name: VOICEACTRESSⅡ
short_description: 普通の学生『米倉清子』を有名な声優へと育成する『ノベル＋パズルゲーム』 パズルで点数を稼ぎ清子を成長させて、有名な声優に育て上げよう！

name: One Dollar Simulator
short_description: This is, in truth, the best simulator of 2020! This simulator will transform your dollar from your ordinary and everyday world - into a DOLLAR of the world of beauty and harmony!

name: Draw Near
short_description: Huge meteorites suddenly collided with your space ship. Due to that shock, your ship is drifting in outer space now. Let's take various actions and survive in the lonely universe! Can you finally return to the earth? Your survival life begins now.

name: Norilsk
short_description: Norilsk is an adult orientated Visual Novel. It centers around a main character who can pursue up to 4 different love interests (3 different girls or 1 guy.) At the end of the common route you can choose who you want to date.

name: WARRIORS OROCHI 4
short_description: The supreme "WARRIORS OROCHI" experience is here! The definitive installment of the "WARRIORS OROCHI 4", featuring all the content of the WARRIORS OROCHI 4: The Ultimate Upgrade Pack, is available now.

name: Isoland
short_description: The objective of the game is to explore a small island in the Atlantic Ocean, and uncover its secrets

name: VRQ Test
short_description: A simple test will help you measure and better understand your sensitivity to VR so that you can have a better VR experience.

name: Chronus Arc
short_description: Venture through puzzle-filled dungeons to bring the past back to the present!

name: Monobeno-HAPPY END- Deluxe
short_description: 《茂伸奇谈-HAPPY END- 合集版》将《茂伸奇谈 本篇》与《茂伸奇谈 后传》整合为一个整体。中文版使用了最终优化的剧情版本进行制作，并且同时收录了PSV版《ものべの-pure smile-》与PC版《ものべの-happy end-》各自拥有的独占剧情。可以说是迄今为止集《茂伸奇谈》内容之大成的版本。

name: SPACE HUNT
short_description: Fight off waves of zombies in the new co-op shooter!

name: Hero Go
short_description: "Heroes~!!" Three beauty girls broke into a fantastic world. in here they meet a lot of heroes and villains whom from other game worlds. Through continuous training their own companions, to make them more stronger, more reliable until conquer the universe! join this fantastic adventure trip quickly.

name: EMMA The Story
short_description: Elliott is paralyzed by doubt. Tomorrow he must go to Emma, far, far away from here. But on the eve of his departure, a strange meeting will change his future.

name: Circles of hell
short_description: Circles of hell - a cooperative platformer for lovers of complexities.

name: Zombie Derby
short_description: Zombie Derby is a small 3D racing action in the world of zombie apocalypse. Drive to survive! How far can you get before they get you?

name: Geeste
short_description: Take on the role of the ultimate Ghost-Fighting robot "Ghostatron 9000" and eradicate every ghost in site, you are humanity's last hope. Will you be the 1st one to make it to the end, to claim your prize?

name: Bane of Asphodel
short_description: Bane of Asphodel is an Action-Adventure Game set in the mystical world of Asphodel. Players can play as Neith, a recently deceased normal person, and must liberate the land from the evil Keeper of the Cycle.

name: The Hero Project: Open Season
short_description: Can you win The Hero Project, America's #1 reality competition for heroes? Team up with allies old and new to unravel a conspiracy threatening your world, and save the planet from destruction!

name: The Gametrekking Omnibus
short_description: A collection of tiny experimental games (and "notgames") inspired by travel.

name: King of Peasants
short_description: King of Peasants is a modern, story-driven adventure game, set in the dark ages during inquisition. It´s fast-paced, snappy and features streamlined interaction. Welcome to medieval times!

name: Point
short_description: Point is a short minimal, math puzzle game.

name: HyperParasite
short_description: A rogue-lite twin-stick shooter/brawler that never plays the same twice. Collect and control 60 different characters as the body-snatching alien Parasite with a grudge against humanity. Fight to the top of the food chain: possess the President, push the Big Red Button and one-up the human race.

name: Trail Breaking
short_description: Trail Breaking is a First-Person Adventure/Puzzle game set in multiple fantasy worlds. You unwillingly get drawn into an ancient magical portal to another realm. Solve puzzles and survive danger to find your way back home.

name: MechCorp
short_description: MechCorp. is a turn-based-tactics/strategy game where you take command of a mercenary mech squadron in space. Decide which battles to fight and what contracts to pursue while managing every aspect of the squad including mech lineup, crew management, research and production.

name: Hidden Protector : ROADTRIP (Preface)
short_description: A cinematographic visual novel, that tells the story of a roadtrip between a man and an artificial intelligence.

name: Endersite
short_description: Enter a new world where you can BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS TO THE DEATH, or team up with them TO TAKE DOWN A FOE. In this new game made by Lilkkgoog you can battle on 6 different maps in which you unlock them slowly. Or go into the single player mode to break targets

name: Darkwinds
short_description: In this new online card game, you must sail the dangerous seas of Thard, infested with ferocious pirates, dark spells and terrible creatures that will seek to sink you into the depths of oblivion. To survive, you must choose your crew wisely and create a powerful deck to defeat your opponents in order to become the most respected pirate...

name: Grandpa
short_description: *Early access game* Grandpa is a survival horror game. You woke up in a house you never knew. Strange things happen in the house. You have to find a way to survive and get out of the house.

name: XENOCAVE
short_description: XENOCAVE is a retro-styled, scrolling platformer that elevates the genre with a unique fusion of ability and fine-tuned mechanics inspired by the classics. Specifically, imagine an amalgam of Mario's fluid controls, the double-jump and rapid-fire of Ghosts 'n Goblins, and the themes of Crystal Caves.

name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon
short_description: Battle with swords and whips in this retro-style action game brought to you by game creator Koji Igarashi and Inti Creates! Play as Zangetsu, a demon slayer bearing a deep grudge, who must travel through perilous lands to defeat a powerful demon lurking in a dark castle.

name: Warlords Awakening
short_description: Prepare yourself as you step into a world writhing in chaos. Warlords Awakening, a remastered MMORPG that will place you on a journey to become an Elite Lord with an action packed story and ominous monsters around every corner. Explore and conquer the world of Epheia together with the cute and dashing pets to choose from.

name: May
short_description: Sudden tragic event shook up Yun’s routine: his friend is balancing between life and death. Doctors are not being supportive, not to mention that something feels shady. Would young man be able to help Max through?

name: 太吾绘卷 The Scroll Of Taiwu
short_description: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

name: Life Goals
short_description: This is a game about life. And because life is already complex enough, and games are getting harder to make, let's make it simpler and project everything onto one dimension. In 1D, choices seem simpler, but it does not make life much easier. Grow up. Overcome all obstacles. Reach your Life Goals.

name: DEAD OR ALIVE 6
short_description: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 is fast-paced 3D fighting game, produced by Koei Tecmo Games, featuring stunning graphics and multi-tiered stages that create a truly entertaining competitive experience.

name: Merry Glade
short_description: What has Bunny done? Why does everyone want to kill him? And why is Carrot so delicious? You’ll find all the answers in this game…

name: Tabletop Playground
short_description: The modern digital tabletop game for fans and creators! Featuring deep customization and choice, enjoy more immersive tabletop sessions with friends than ever before. Build new rule sets for traditional games, play custom-made games by the community or create your own and share them with the world.

name: The Great Race
short_description: The Great Race - it's a family affair when it comes to inheritance! Professor, Crone, Rider Girl, Soldier, Taxi Driver, Jack and Jackie. Meet them all! The Family of Seven - are the eccentric and greedy relatives. This parody of racing games is dedicated to all who love to play chasing games like tag.

name: Theorem
short_description: Abstract puzzle game

name: City Escaper
short_description: City escaper is a game based on a gangster escaping from police. City Escaper is a 2D game, dodge the obstacles, run away as long as you can and beat your own highscore!

name: Slappy Ass
short_description: Slappy Ass is a sensual simulation spanking game where you play with a customizable booty. You can interact with slapping, grabbing, dragging and stripping the virtual ass.

name: Deadliest Catch: The Game
short_description: Enter the dangerous world of king crab fishing in the deadly Bering Sea! Take command of your own fishing vessel, use realistic equipment, combat hazardous Alaskan waters and become the world's best crab catcher!

name: Unleashed
short_description: Plunge into the brutal Mystria, a corrupt world founded on sorcery and lies. Explore a dense open-world sandbox RPG with a rich history and narrative and a rewarding combat system brought to you by a multi-award-winning team.

name: Azada: Ancient Magic
short_description: Experience a deeper magic in this sparkling sequel, brimming with more than 20 puzzle books of classic tales.

name: Dark Dimensions: Somber Song Collector's Edition
short_description: Townspeople flee as the black smoke covers their town. Can you close the dark dimension, before it’s too late?

name: Mystery Tales: Alaskan Wild Collector's Edition
short_description: Call on the animal spirits to help find your sister.

name: Grim Tales: The Stone Queen Collector's Edition
short_description: The family saga continues when your nephew Brandon encounters the mysterious Stone Queen in a lonely mountain town.

name: Final Cut: The True Escapade Collector's Edition
short_description: Find out who framed your fiancé for murder and clear his name.

name: Shadow Wolf Mysteries: Cursed Wedding Collector's Edition
short_description: After being called to Paris, you find yourself in the middle of a shocking mystery involving an ancient werewolf hungry for revenge.

name: Haunted Legends: The Stone Guest Collector's Edition
short_description: Someone is stealing the hearts of children – literally! Is it a brilliant inventor, seeking to cure his ailing son? Or has dark magic taken over the village...

name: The Devil's Garden
short_description: Can you escape The Devil's Garden?

name: Secret of Harrow Manor
short_description: Explore an abandoned manor and it's grounds filled with nightmare creatures, locked doors, and scattered ammunition.

name: Little Marisa's Disaster Journey
short_description: Marisa wants to borrow some books from Patchouli's library as usual. But this time she has triggered a special magic circle trap. It shrank her body and clothes. In order to return the normal size, Marisa must survive in the huge Scarlet Devil Mansion!

name: Endhall
short_description: Endhall is a byte-sized roguelike. Become an artificial intelligence and combine tactical actions to defeat your enemies and reach the end of the hallway.

name: Real Winners: Victoryball
short_description: In Real Winners: Victoryball, you'll operate as a sports robot doing their best to win. Pick up and play rules that change the match and end up with a game that's nothing like where it started. Rules can change everything from the size of the players to adding buzz saws to the field.

name: The Rig: A Starmap to Murder
short_description: THE RIG is an immersive, story-driven, space-noir ADVENTURE GAME developed exclusively for VR. Explore a fully-interactive light freighter as you attempt to land, find your brother, and uncover a tightly-woven mystery of murder and broken romance.

name: Mad Frost
short_description: Mad Frost - 2D platformer with puzzle elements. In it, you have to go through a world drawn on squared paper. A world full of adventures and unexpected encounters. And our hero is waiting for the holidays like no one else. But not everything is so smooth...

name: Fasaria World: Ancients of Moons + Server
short_description: Fasaria World: Ancients of Moons is a single/multiplayer fantasy online experience that can be played locally from your PC (single player offline). Instructions are included on how to host your own server and how other players can join your game.

name: DRAW CHILLY
short_description: DRAW CHILLY is a hell of an arcade game about Vladimir, his squad, Purgatory, and the Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

name: Galaxy Ball Defender
short_description: Defend against drones by smashing them with space balls.

name: Snowball Saves Summer
short_description: Roll and fling Snowball through 30 levels across multiple worlds to bring the kidnapped Snow Queen back to the North Pole. Each level has three Golden Snowflakes that unlock special rewards and upgrades when collected. Defeat the boss of each world, rescue the queen, and save summer!

name: Nine-Slicer
short_description: Reduce your atlas sizes! Optimize large images for your UI by creating sliced versions. Nine-sliced images can be used in various game engines, including Unity. No more labor-intensive manual slicing work in Photoshop. Spend seconds on what would take several minutes to do manually.

name: SpedV
short_description: With FPH SpedV, you will enjoy your Trucking Simulators more! You can create virtual Trucking Companys and work up with your Friends. We offer you a tool to manage your VTC in ETS 2 and ATS. This Programm will directly link into the Games and make it easy to monitor your drive.

name: The Land of the Seazogs
short_description: Professor Meme, a renowned 164-year-old genetic scientist, receives a mysterious call for help from his old friend Gustav, the head of the animal research base on Zerulia, an inhospitable planet inhabited by ancient aquatic creatures: the Seazogs.

name: Mr. Sweet
short_description: Mr. Sweet - this is the crazy adventure of the most unusual runner in the universe! Help him and his friends to become the best of the best and beat all known and unknown records! Check your agility on the most complicated tracks in different parts of the universe!

name: Penny Black
short_description: A text only dating simulator, created using BBC Basic for Windows!

name: 三国英雄列传 (Legendary Heros in the Three Kingdoms)
short_description: Legendary Heros in the Three Kingdoms is a strategy sandbox game of Sanguo hero's fantasy story. Player can play the role of any one of more than three hundred officers in Sanguo's history.

name: Russian AYE Horror
short_description: You play for Sanya, and you need to explore an abandoned building in the village of Kuvandyk to find all the photos. Be careful, beware of THEM.

name: Cartonfall
short_description: It was another night shift at your job in a warehouse, when a madman with a box on his head, took control over the complex. Now you are under his control, to get out of here you have to solve his wicked riddles and smash through his weird cardboard structures by using anything you find in the boxes.

name: Legendary Eleven: Epic Football
short_description: Legendary Eleven is an ​epic arcade football game inspired by the golden age of football spanning the 70's to the 90's. Choose from 36 teams full of glorious haircuts, moustaches and legends in short shorts. Lead them to glory and win the World Cup!

name: Signal Simulator
short_description: Game inspired by SETI. Take the role of a scientist to find an extraterrestrial signal .Control massive Radio Antennas by using interactive control in your Observatory. Detect , download and decode unknown or story telling signals. Manage and Maintain an electrical system to improve your systems and make it more efficient.

name: Catch Me If You Can
short_description: Chase your friends in this heart-racing "Tag" based game. Use a grappling hook and bouncy physics to your advantage. Features proximity voice chat.

name: SOK MIN
short_description: SOK MIN is the smallest and the easiest levels of SOK puzzle. Now you may not need a guide to complete each level. Just try it!

name: Melordandek
short_description: Melordandek is a puzzle game with 345 levels of increasing difficulty. Walk on each tile of a map, a thing you can only do a single time and avoid being stuck by your own choices. You will follow Dnasack's team, infiltrating the capital of the White Union to crack its military network.

name: The story of Gods 七神物语
short_description: 独居在光明帝国边界村落的年轻猎手阿敏，偶然邂逅了潜入帝国境内的外域女孩艾薇儿，答应护送她深入帝国境内并进行一系列探索的故事， 全中文奇幻风格角色扮演游戏，丰富复杂的回合制战斗模式，超过20小时的冒险时光，不同选择，触发不同主角的命运结局。

name: Undead & Beyond
short_description: Take control of Dr. Beyond in his quest to escape the facility! Use the products of your research to create an undead army and cause havoc in the complex while you aim to accomplish your objectives to reach the next area.

name: Krampus is Home
short_description: Sebastian is a teenager who is waiting for his parents to come back home on a cold Christmas night. Soon he realizes that there is something evil lurking around. Experience Sebastian 's journey into a surreal world like no other.

name: Flurius
short_description: This is what happens when you do not brush your teeth.

name: 7'scarlet
short_description: The remote town of Okunezato is shaped like a crescent moon and shrouded in dark myths and legends. Take on the role of a brave young woman journeying into the unknown to uncover dangerous truths and locate her missing brother with her childhood friend.

name: Psycho Squirrels
short_description: Navigate squirrels and collect enough acorns before winter arrives.

name: 血战夹皮沟
short_description: 这是一款由资深玩家制作的，类似《骑马与砍杀》玩法的，融合了沙盒、策略、经营、贸易、生存、战斗、角色扮演元素的俯视角动作射击游戏。

name: The Legend of Evil
short_description: Destroy all of humanity in a hyper-tactical tower-offense game that takes no prisoners (especially if they are humans).

name: Bomight
short_description: Bomight is a short time attack platformer.Find and defeat the purple demon in as short a time as possible.

name: Shrinking Pains
short_description: You spend a day seeing how many coins you can fit into the hollows above your collarbones. You're losing yourself first in inches, then moments... Will you survive yourself?

name: What Are You Stupid
short_description: Prepare to get your knowledge tested by 15 wacky characters in a 1-on-1 quiz battle format; each with their own theme and unique personality. Brace yourself and do well - or get humiliated by them. Inspired by old comic stripes, ‘What Are You Stupid’ is presented using 100% hand-drawn art.

name: Hamster Daily
short_description: The cute hamster ball keeps rolling, advances for her beloved seeds.

name: Survisland / 实境求生
short_description: Survisland is a super hardcore sandbox survival game that pays great attention to restoring the real survival experience. The character has rich and realistic actions and reactions to , and the process logic of making props is no different from reality.

name: Good Guy Card
short_description: This game is a adv game.says that player go to university and try to find his best lover's story.

name: Alice's Adventures - Hidden Object Puzzle Game
short_description: Alice needs your help unveiling secrets of Wonderland! Colorful 360 degree scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun! Help the heroine solve puzzles and find cleverly disguised clues so she can advance through this wondrous land.

name: The Lost Earth
short_description: No, Pay to Win/ Yes, Original Military FPS OBT 15:00 GMT/UTC + 2

name: Planum
short_description: PLANUM is a 2D platformer in which you will operate an aircraft

name: 戾谈
short_description: There is no English version of this game！There is no English version of this game！You wake up in a room full of mysteries, accompanied by a beautiful girl you have met before. In the following time, you will go on a heartbeat journey to the supernatural world with her.

name: Phoenix Point
short_description: The acclaimed strategy game from the creator of X-COM. Fight tactical battles on procedural maps against a foe that adapts to your tactics. Manage diplomacy and economy on a global scale. Research, explore, overcome. Now includes Steam Workshop support for mods!

name: Drift 4000
short_description: Drift 4000 is a new take on the old asteroids-style space shooter. You will find yourself in an increasingly difficult fight for survival against waves of enemy fighters, with periodic breaks to refit your custom ship with weapons, ammunition and unique abilities.

name: Match Connect Challenge
short_description: Match Connect Challenge - The new match game is here, with brilliant Pirate objects. A journey filled with waves of excitement and brilliant visuals! Swap objects to clear the way, and match pieces to crush each challenge that lies ahead.

name: Lenin - The Lion
short_description: Lenin – The Lion is a Puzzle RPG game about overcoming fears. Walk into chaos and find the claws of loneliness or carefully build your path and find the benefits of understanding and acceptance.

name: Wilmot's Warehouse
short_description: Wilmot's Warehouse is a puzzle game about keeping a warehouse running in tip-top shape. Just remember where you put everything, because when the service hatch opens, you'll need to find the things people want quickly, in order to earn the coveted Performance Stars.

name: Mythgard
short_description: Welcome to Mythgard, a fantasy cyberpunk CCG of heroes, gods, and mythical beasts. Master the unique lane and mana systems in your rise to the top or enjoy team play with a friend. New players can use the code WelcomeChallenger to get 20 free packs and more to start their journey.

name: 9 Balls
short_description: "9 Balls" is a miniature game of billiards. The control is made by the mouse vutton and the spacebar. Use the mouse to aim and change the force of the impact and the spacebar to strike the cue on the ball.

name: My Car
short_description: Choose from one of two different car models! Customize it in your own way, then try it on the track!

name: Silverworld
short_description: In a world of trackless jungles, colossal beasts, and cruel pre-human civilizations, you must survive the past if you want to save the future! Face the savage inhabitants of Silverworld and build your own civilization—or plunder the past and return home unimaginably rich!

name: The Technician
short_description: The Technician is a VR action puzzle game about hacking your way through security systems. Usually while being shot at.

name: Mr Rabbit's Memory Game
short_description: Game is meant to improve vocabulary and memorizing skills of playing children. Kids will learn new shapes, colours,numbers and letters in addition to spending a lot of time having fun

name: Garden Paws
short_description: You have inherited your grandparents farm as they set off to travel the world. Work with Frank at the local construction shop to finish off the final touches on your new home. Aid Frank and Mayor Wilson in building up the town so it may reach it's full potential.

name: Gun Rage
short_description: Gun Rage is an old-school, fast-paced, side-scrolling run and gun, with 16-bit era graphics, inspired by greatest classic games of the genre.

name: ad movere
short_description: Can you guide an aspiring artist to success?

name: Good Doggo
short_description: Train your dog in this treat-balancing action game

name: Magic Scroll Tactics / マジックスクロールタクティクス / 魔法卷轴 / 魔法捲軸
short_description: A side-scrolling tactical RPG where elevation is the key to victory!

name: The Beat: A Glam Noir Game
short_description: In The Beat you take on the role of Leo, a closeted cop investigating a murder in the gay community. Each choice you make has a meaningful effect on the story and the more drama you create the higher your score.

name: Battle Royale: Survivors 究极求生:大逃杀
short_description: Battle Royale: Survivors is a last-man-standing top down shooter pvp survival game. Players are taken as prisoners and thrown to an abandoned island. Players must fight with whatever they can find on the island. Whoever survivals to be the last lone survivor wins the game.

name: 武侠乂 The Swordsmen X
short_description: The Swordsmen X is an adrenaline-fueled free-roaming competitive action game that pits 100 players against each other in a battle royale. Players can wield a diverse arsenal of martial weapons, including bows, daggers, and other ranged attacks, in their fight for survival.

name: Tokavuh Stream Control
short_description: Control your stream from a mobile device and add flair with animations and sound boards! No extra devices needed, just plug it in to OBS Studio or Streamlabs OBS and go!

name: On Board 4 PC

Get yourself ready to command a beast warship to fight against the sea waves and wipe out the enemy fleet by using your big cannon.

name: Arkham Horror: Mother's Embrace
short_description: Inspired by the award-winning board game franchise, Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace is an investigation game served with turn-based combat, set in the cult universe of H.P. Lovecraft.

name: Chicken ~Boiled Egg~
short_description: You are Chicken. And Clear Levels!

name: Mosaic: Game of Gods II
short_description: The Goddess of Creation and the God of Chaos managed to restore peace and harmony in the Universe, but one powerful and evil creature did not like it. And Darkness was its name. It cursed the Goddess in order to make the God of Chaos its again.

name: Endless World Idle RPG
short_description: Explore the eternal landscapes of 3D Idle clicker RPG Endless World! Enjoy an epic adventure with a cast of 40+ characters. Build your army, craft unique weapons, balance your teams and set forth on an heroic saga that spans endless levels of monsters and mayhem!

name: Supralympic Runners
short_description: SUPRALYMPIC RUNNERS is a first-person competition-focused endless runner. Experience the perfectly-shaped, fully mechanized, rocket-powered supralympian runner: the greatest athletes of all times! Step up to the Supralympic Games challenge and show off your skills!

name: SLICE
short_description: SLICE your way through the worlds of mind trials.

name: Quible Sphere
short_description: Roll through 40 different levels that increase in difficulty, avoiding several obstacles and using powerups in order to get to the end of each level!

name: Spacebase Startopia
short_description: Spacebase Startopia captivates with its original mixture of economic simulation and empire building strategy paired with classic RTS skirmishes and a good dose of humor.

name: Mushroom Heroes
short_description: A puzzle platform adventure, with inspiration going all the way back to SNES and 8-bit classics. The game is inspired from ‘90s classics like Lost Vikings.

name: The Gauntlet
short_description: In The Gauntlet, you'll need to move fast and control your every move. Various obstacles stand in your way, and it's up to you to find the best way to get through them, taking advantage of your moves and your unique weapon that lets you freeze objects in place.

name: Planetary Dustoff
short_description: Planetary Dustoff is a space-themed roguelite shooter. Go on a death riddled journey to sprawling alien environments and fight your way through hordes of enemies and epic boss battles. Take part in the revived Planetary Survey Program and help the Space Faction find a new home for humanity.

name: Good Boy!
short_description: The game "Good boy" is an arcade game. Your character is the dog "good boy". The objective of the game is to get to the owner what she has lost. A good boy will face complex obstacles: garbage cans, fire hydrants, lasers, smart missiles and much more.

name: Dictator's dreams
short_description: What dream does your dictator see?

name: Furious Drivers
short_description: Dynamic “car combat” game, where you destroy other players by cars using a variety of weapons.

name: Virtual Foosball
short_description: Virtual Foosball is a funny foosball simulation for Windows. It includes a singleplayer and a multiplayer modus. You can design you own foosballtable layouts and play on different difficulty levels.

name: ANOIX
short_description: In ANOIX you travel through 84 levels trying to protect the ball. Don't let the soundtrack hypnotize you.

name: Fortune-499
short_description: There is no future in the future.

name: Geometry Boxer
short_description: Beat the shapes outta your enemies using special powers, melee weapons, or the old fashioned fisticuffs way - solo or cooperatively - in this physics based, geometric, mob fighter.

name: Setup Developer Tool 2018
short_description: Beginner setup tuning - SDT2018 steps the user through the major areas of race car setup creation and tuning, asking simple questions about the behavior of the car and the user’s feel.

name: Qvabllock
short_description: «Qvabllock» — pixemalism game with elements of puzzle, with minimalistic gameplay. Collect all the colored squares to take the main green and go through all 30 levels.

name: Trivia Vault: Tennis Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Tennis Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer tennis trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Sword Art Online: Lost Song
short_description: Enter the VRMMO world of the much-loved anime SWORD ART ONLINE! In Alfheim Online, a world of fairies and magic, you become the hero of the series, Kirito, and together with your wondrous friends try to conquer the floating land of Svart Alfheim.

name: The Sandbox of God: Remastered Edition
short_description: Build your world and lead mankind (and rabbitkind) into the centuries beyond in this classic PC re-release.

name: The Firlyn Stones *No More Updates*
short_description: The Firlyn Stones is a Survival-Horror, adventure and a pursuit game. In a giant world with Firlyn fragments and dangerous guards, you'll need to survive.

name: Outlaws of the Old West
short_description: Outlaws of the Old West is a massively multiplayer survival MMO with a huge world, thousands of items and a modular building system. Survive the wild, build your own homestead, defeat villainous bandits and work with others to tame the Wild West.

name: Data Ball
short_description: In a distant corner of the universe exists an ancient supercomputer plagued by malfunctioning circuits and corrupted data. Take control of one of its spherical maintenance drones and command a range of abilities as you progress through ever-more challenging levels.

name: Ready or Not [archive]
short_description: Ready or Not is an intense, tactical, first-person shooter that depicts a modern-day world in which SWAT police units are called to defuse hostile and confronting situations.

name: Noonie
short_description: Noonie is a rogue-like action game where you navigate through randomly generated mazes while avoiding traps and enemies. Use problem solving skills to push the environment around in your favor. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Colosso Crystal Skulls
short_description: Classic style 3D 1st person shooter by Campana Productions. Making games for twenty years and more. Colosso Crystal Skulls is the latest game in the Colosso Adventure series. Don't miss out on the action and the adventure. Nothing is better than a classic style game.

name: I Pay No Rent
short_description: Don't let your landlord overpower you with her incredible throwing power, dodge or block those shoes, bottles, and... wait what? bombs?... Try to block, or dodge all the 'things' your landlord ruthlessly thrown at you!

name: Camped Out!
short_description: Camped Out is a frenetic couch co-op game for friends and families where up to four players work together to set up camp before darkness falls.

name: Rocket Rush
short_description: Try, Die, Repeat. In this minimalistic hard platformer you will attempt to traverse a seemingly endless world filled with traps, fire and a bunch of other doo-dads designed and positioned specifically to upset you. Sounds fun, right?

name: Save her, from dreams
short_description: Enter the dream, save the one you love.

name: Asimov Laws
short_description: Asimov Laws is a brutal rouge lite survival game, set in the depressing Robopocalypse world. Survive the harsh condition in the 12 cities, Crush the robotic butlers, scavenge and survive, plan your days and route, grow stronger through genetic transition and head for the Ark.

name: Bing Bong XL
short_description: Bing Bong XL is a fast-paced, minimalist arcade score chaser with simple one-button controls. Dodge obstacles, collect points, and survive as long as possible in this addictive ‘just-one-more-round’ challenge. Perfect for quick sessions or while waiting in queue for another game!

name: Spirits of Metropolis: Legacy Edition
short_description: Blast gems under a starry sky in this unique take on the match-3 genre.

name: Exoder
short_description: Exoder is a frantic, fast paced, 2D, action platformer that will test your skills of reflex, resilience, patience and determination.

name: Jack and Sara: Educational game
short_description: In an unobtrusive way, Jack and Sara will teach your child fun games for the development of logic, attention, memory and color perception.

name: Knockdown the Ball
short_description: Guide the ball and complete the levels

short_description: Ever tried milking yourself while avoiding lawnmowers, butcher knives and sharks at the same time? Beat hundreds of levels and thousand of enemy waves in the endless journey to fill up the milk tank!

You are a new presence in the story of Harry; a man obsessed with solving a mysterious lucid dream.

name: Clash of Magic

name: Furries & Scalies & Bears OH MY!

name: Trivia Vault: Movie Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Movie Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer movie trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Vinnie's Diary
short_description: Vinnie' Diary is a FPP Puzzle Solving Game. The player will be the child psychologist Edward Shawn and explore what happened inside the inner world of a 6-year-old boy, Vinson Gogh. In the game, you will face puzzles in Vinson's fantasy worlds while analyzing the case as a professional psychologist.

name: Visceral Cubes
short_description: After losing contact with a space station on mars, you are sent to retrieve a high value item for the company. It didn’t take very long for our protagonist to find out that something went very very wrong in this place. Use stealth to get past your enemies or run for your life hoping that they don't catch up and explode in your face.

name: YOMOTSU
short_description: A transport that sets out at dusk and arrives at midnight. A world above. A world below. YOMOTSU is the thin line that connects the two.

name: ΔV: Rings of Saturn
short_description: A physics-based mining sim, set in the thickest debris field in Sol. Every action has a reaction, lasers are invisible without a medium, and your thrust is a potent weapon. Find trade, adapt your equipment to your playstyle, hire a crew to help. Unravel the mysteries of the rings, or just get rich.

name: Osternfield
short_description: Little point and click adventure with easter bunnys.

name: Silent Depth 3D Submarine Simulation
short_description: Submarine Simulation playing in WWII in the Pacific.

name: Where Thoughts Go
short_description: Discover the dreams, fears and secrets of other players - and leave your own for others to find. In this award-winning social experience, awake creatures to reveal the voice messages of others that have previously visited. To progress you must leave your own stories behind. What will you say?

name: The friends of Ringo Ishikawa

name: Hello Pollution!

name: Guardians Of The Past
short_description: Guardians of the Past is a fast-paced arena brawler where you use gadgets to battle with or against your friends in a variety of arenas constructed by YOU! Build an array of launch-pads, fields of electrical chaos or even a sea of fire. With hundreds of combinations, every game is unique!

name: Bastard
short_description: Are you used to being a noble knight in shining armor who protects the weak and punishes the evil ones? Sure, you might answer, everybody wants to see oneself as one - especially in a game. But did you consider which price you would have to pay for it in your real life?

name: Sea Explorer
short_description: Sea explorer is a single player adventure with upgrade/RPG elements about exploration of a big blue sea...

name: Catsapults
short_description: Go on an exciting adventure with puzzle solving and kittens.

name: Twin Stick Tanks
short_description: Twin Stick Tanks is an action packed tank shooting party game where you battle to blow eachothers tops off in an explosive plume of smoke!

name: Devious
short_description: A real time first person dungeon crawler mixed with optional story-telling visual novel segments, taking place in a fragmented world on the verge of war. As countries clash and tensions rise, the traditions of the old world find themselves fighting with the ever changing culture of the new era.

name: AI Vendetta
short_description: Play as Proto the robot and use its power to transform to solve puzzles, manipulate the environment and blast your way through an exciting adventure in AI Vendetta.

name: Obliteracy
short_description: Obliteracy is a word game set in a utopian future where energy is generated from language itself. Word-warriors pilot enormous mechanized robots in a tournament to prove themselves worthy of the title of Champion—and to earn the chance to craft the future of the world.

name: OboStar
short_description: Obostar is a unique skill puzzle game. Pilot your ship and touch the colored orbs to collect them.

name: Moss

name: LifeGameSimulator

name: Cicadas - The IQA Edition
short_description: 那份因记忆的空白而生出的不安，终于在回归普通的生活中一点点淡化。 平淡岁月里，逐渐忘却的记忆，与那年的蝉鸣一起，被封存在了黑暗深处。

name: Saint Slaughter X Days
short_description: "Saint Slaughter X Days" is a visual novel produced by the Hollowings production group. The story will revolve around the conflict between the Templar and the sorcerer, the "goodness" and the "evil".
