name: The Legacy: Prisoner Collector's Edition
short_description: "Legacy: Prisoner" is a HO adventure game, with a huge number of exciting mini-games and puzzles, which will take you right into a maelstrom of fantastic events in a distant world!

name: De'Vine: World of Shadows
short_description: De'Vine is a classic JRPG with an engaging STORY. Explore a very large open-world, with full CARD and FARMING systems! An intense BATTLE system and vast character customization! 50+ Hours of content!

name: RUGBY 20
short_description: Rugby 20 gives you the complete rugby experience! With overhauled tactics management, optimised graphics and more realistic player behaviour, the game is a true reflection of modern rugby.

name: Catburglar
short_description: ​Run, jump, dash, duck and slide in a race against time to save the world!

name: DYSMANTLE
short_description: Ascend from your shelter. Ruin everything. Escape the wretched island. ⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 Explore. Fight. Level up. Survive. Gather. Craft. Harvest. Hunt. Build. Farm. Solve puzzles. Fish. Cook. Live. Enjoy the bittersweet post-apocalypse.

name: JumpStream
short_description: JumpStream is a competitive platformer built in real-time by an audience, using Mixer Interactive! The goal is to work with your audience to construct an emergent path to complete challenges in the fastest possible time.

name: Diner Bros
short_description: Diner Bros is a cooking and restaurant management game. Cook and serve meals as fast as you can, but don’t get the orders wrong or else your customers will get angry – and hungry! Upgrade your restaurant and hire staff to help you… or play with your friends in 2-4 local co-op!

name: Tell Me Everything
short_description: A mysterious murder has shocked the inner city, and as the lead detective, it is your job to catch the real killer. Armed with words and wits, you uncover the secrets and capture the murderer, and make sure justice will be served.

name: PartyLine VR
short_description: Welcome to the party! Have you ever wished your friends could join in the fun of VR? Partyline VR is a collection of virtual reality experiences where up to 8 people can use their smart-phones/tablets/computers and join in the fun. No app download required!

name: DearCraft
short_description: DearCraft is a game that allows players to create a world with imagination and creativity unboundedly and play their own 3D sandbox game spontaneously.

name: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair
short_description: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair is a brand-new 2.5D platformer from some of the key creative talent behind 'Donkey Kong Country'. As the colourful buddy duo you must tackle a series of stunning, 2.5D levels and explore a puzzling 3D Overworld rich with secrets and surprises!

name: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick
short_description: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick is a Crude Comedy RPG that has one goal and one goal only: To make you laugh! Play as Quiver Dick, a legendary storyteller and former badass, as he embarks on one of many downright crazy and entirely messed up adventures!

name: Тридевятые земли(Свет или тьма)
short_description: "Проклятый змей! Я отомщу тебе за все загубленные тобой души! Ты слышишь меня, поганый ирод! Я приду за тобой! За твоей головой... "

name: Turn-Based Champion
short_description: Turn-Based Champion is a rpg party game where you and your friends compete in minigames and take on monsters and bosses through turn-based battles to compete for the title of Champion.

name: Zombie Commander
short_description: Zombie Commander is a strategy game about bringing the extinction of humanity by a zombies invasion, and lead the apocalpyse !

name: Community College Hero: Knowledge is Power
short_description: Your favorite small-town heroes return to superpowered college! Study, party, and fight powerful and deadly villains! Choose your path and save the day!

name: Doomsday on Demand 2
short_description: Picking up where you left off, you will encounter new challenges and face tough decisions in the hope to finally escape the living nightmare in the districts that only became worse. Decide whom you will trust, and how will you achieve your goal. It's kill or be killed.

name: Doomsday on Demand
short_description: Survive in the demolished district after the nuclear bombings. Face mutants born of the nuclear radiation, while dealing with what humans are left in the struggle for the hope to end your living nightmare. Decide who you'll trust and overcome the challenges that await you.

name: Super Lucky's Tale
short_description: A delightful, playground platformer for all ages that follows Lucky, the ever-optimistic, energetic, and lovable hero, on his quest to find his inner strength and help his sister rescue the Book of Ages from Jinx. Jinx is the scheming and mysterious villain trying to reshape the world, but for what reason?

name: Sunset Overdrive
short_description: Sunset Overdrive transforms an open-world apocalypse into your tactical playground. Zip, grind and wall-run across Sunset City with an unconventional arsenal. Hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable abilities deliver an explosive and irreverent adventure in the end times.

name: Barrel Boot Camp
short_description: Barrel Boot Camp is a competitive leaderboard-based barrel shooting game.

name: Solenars Edge Heroes
short_description: Answer the call and fight! Choose your side-kick and form a team from over 60 playable characters as you fight to become the greatest Hero in all of Alcornagia.

name: Trapped
short_description: Welcome to Estate de’ Sukari. Home to Aki, a young lady who happens to live inside of the manor. She awakens one fateful evening to a horrific dream of her death. as she considers the possibility of sleep, a loud shriek fills the air leaving her with a question: Should she investigate or should she go back to bed?

name: Star Speeder
short_description: Star Speeder is an atmospheric minimalist space game about controlling a speeder on a colorful platform. Go after your latest high score, or relax for a while and enjoy the space atmosphere.

name: Roller
short_description: Let the colors hypnotize you in this fun filled ball roller game.

name: Pizzamon
short_description: What happens when a pizza fights? Enter Pizzamon, the story of a young adventurer competing in the Chef Championships.

name: HyperBowl
short_description: Be the ball! Roll around the original six HyperBowl lanes and some new ones. Enjoy the scenery, but remember to head for the pins! Play 1-4 players in the original Arcade Mode or quick-play in single-player mode.

name: Strike!OvulationDivine Fist!  Rebellion to Extinction!
short_description: Easy Operation Battle Fuck Action! ! This game is an action game While defending against the attacks of the Extinction Shrine Maiden using the shield activated by the S button, approach and restrain the enemy by pressing the Y key. Mash the Y key quickly to raise the Libido gauge.

name: Our Hero! First
short_description: [Game 1 of 3] Our Hero! is a funny Hack and Slash Adventure game with RPG mechanics starred by cute and colorful characters: dive into this light-hearted story-driven world, full of treasures, puzzles, secret places and boss fights!

name: How About Spikes
short_description: How About Spikes is a 2D metroid-vania like platformer. Fight your way through enemies and a lot of spikes while exploring the world of Garden Valley.

name: Truth: Disorder II
short_description: Continuation of the favorite of many visual novels Truth: Disorder. This time you will feel yourself in the role of the captain of the spacecraft of the future and plunge into computer simulations.

name: Sword of the Black Stone
short_description: If your looking for action and adventure then Sword of the Black Stone is for you.

name: SEG Collection
short_description: A bit of this, a bit of that, and a whole lot of janky love for indie.

name: Virtual Reality Experiment Framework
short_description: VREF is a framework for academic experiments in virtual reality. Download now and take part in academic experiments to aid VR research. The current project aims to assess the technical feasibility of teaching fire training in rural areas.

name: Story: Heaven & Hell
short_description: "Story: Heaven & Hell" - this is a interactive fiction about good and evil.

name: Robo Runners
short_description: Run for your life, the robots are coming! The fast paced multiplayer game pits you against a number of other human contestants for the chance of survival.

name: Pale Cachexia
short_description: A Gothic fantasy tale of loneliness, dark secrets, and the search for a cure.

name: Söldner: Secret Wars Remastered
short_description: Söldner! Enjoy third-person combat, make use of a fully destructible environment. Customize your character and start combat on the huge worldmap (6500*3500 km), selecting your gear from over 100 firearms. Get into battle the way you want by employing over 120 vehicles. Take your tour now!

name: Castle of the Underdogs : Episode 1
short_description: Get a castle, recruit friends and try to restore the peace in the Bestann Federation while spreading chaos to most places you step on in this turn-based comedy JRPG.

name: Indentured Servant
short_description: In this VR experience you are stuck on a fishing boat, you must sort fish to pay of your debt.

name: Toybit Quest
short_description: Toybit Quest is a dungeon crawler/rogue-lite with endless levels, unique toy enemies, a vast skill tree, and tons of loot and gear to find! It draws inspiration from Diablo, Binding of Isaac, and the Legend of Zelda.

name: Endless Horizon
short_description: Endless Horizon is a high octane arcade game of speed, precision and perfect timing.

name: Die In The Dark
short_description: Die in the Dark is a first-person exploration and adventure game inspired by real life events! Trapped in the subway with zombies, vicious dogs, and a slew of other monsters. Can you escape the puzzles and survive the monsters of Plum Island?

name: 小黄条/YYNote
short_description: Cross-platform todolist, mobile phone, bi-directional synchronization on PC.

name: DeathTolls Experience
short_description: With DeathTolls Experience, virtual reality artist Ali Eslami is seeking to resensitize the general public to the reality behind the abstract statistics on the hundreds of thousands of deaths in the Middle East.

name: Suki's Spooky Romance
short_description: Four catgirls, a crazy haunted mansion, monsters, and forbidden love. Grab a bottle of Mojo. You're going to need it.

name: Yakuza Kiss
short_description: Yakuza Kiss is a [GxB] adult visual novel for the feminine audience. Join Jeong Moon on her descent through Cyan City - a neon hell ruled by the criminal underworld. Forced to join the Yakuza she catches the eye of Yuki Yamaguchi. To survive she needs to face her deepest fears and darkest desires...

name: Roundguard
short_description: Roundguard is a bouncy dungeon crawler with pinball physics, lots of loot, and a randomized castle full of oddballs. Press your luck against hordes of dangerously cute monsters and challenging roguelike elements in this all-round bouncy adventure!

name: GP Bikes
short_description: GP Bikes is a realistic motorcycle simulator, based on a scratch built physics engine that accurately simulates motorcycle dynamics and setup options.

name: Story of a Gladiator
short_description: Story of a Gladiator is an arena beat 'em up where you take the role of a man in search of his destiny. Fight against waves of enemies in the arena to earn coin and fame until you are strong enough to enter the colosseum and become champion.

name: UFO Simulator Control Master
short_description: Prepare for the day you drive a UFO.

name: Depths of Sanity
short_description: A mysterious signal. A missing crew. And the one man trying to piece it all together. As Abe Douglas, dive deep into a fully underwater metroidvania to explore massive oceanic biomes, battle monstrous bosses, and piece together a mystery that threatens not only your crew, but your own sanity.

name: BATTER BURST
short_description: This game is a scroll action of continuous explosion drawn with pixel art. Let's blow it all away.

name: Maze Madness
short_description: First Person Shooter Through a variety of Mazes and challenges. Each level has different weapons and AI to make each entertaining and increasingly more difficult. Try your luck and Beat your Time to get past each challenge all the levels have in store for you.

name: Terror World
short_description: This is a survival adventure game. You need to drive a train to explore the world. Cold and a large number of enemies will threaten your life at any time. Can you survive?

name: Fury Fighter VR
short_description: Fury Fighter VR - VR beat em up with procedural levels. Save your Girlfriend/Boyfriend from gangs.

name: KINGDOMS: THE CROWN
short_description: Survive in a cruel medieval environment filled with players and wild animals. Build a small dwelling or huge fortress, and if you feel powerful enough challenge one of the kings!

name: Azuran Tales: Trials
short_description: Azuran Tales: Trials offers challenging combat, beautiful levels and merciless enemies to overcome. Journey across the World of Azuran as you discover its many environments, lore and history in a game that blends platformers with RPG elements.

name: Split Drive
short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

name: Let's Go Nuts!
short_description: Fast, party platform game for up to 4 players. Finish levels as quick as possible. Collect nuts using movable objects.

name: Sky Conqueror
short_description: Sky Conqueror is an intense, easy to learn skydiving game with an infinite procedurally generated map. A great game to relax for half an hour and chase your latest highscore!

name: GROW: Wild West
short_description: GROW: Wild West is an interactive cartoon, that tells us about events occuring in a small town in wild west. Become a mayor and lead the development of the town and follow the story in the best traditions of a spaghetti-westerns of the last century. Fates of the residents of a small provincial town depend on you!

name: Pride Run
short_description: Pride Run is a celebration of Pride events around the world and all things LGBTQ+. Dance your way through the streets of the most iconic cities around the globe in this uniquely awesome RTS - Rhythm Action game. The better you dance, the more people you attract to your parade.

name: AGE 1.2 (seccia.dev)
short_description: AGE 1.2 is a free software for creating 2D adventure games without the need for technical programming skills.

name: Katamari Damacy REROLL
short_description: The beloved roll-em-up game returns with fully updated graphics, completely recreated cutscenes and in full HD!

name: Simian Rising
short_description: Interdimensional UFO Simulator

name: Detached: Non-VR Edition
short_description: Detached, a suspenseful interstellar duel that demands tactics and skill to survive, is now available in a non-VR version! Separated from your unit, you must make smart decisions and race to safety in this visceral exploration of deep space.

name: InstaCondo Limited
short_description: Drop condo blocks to help your parkour actor get through the rooftops of the city & film InstaCondo Limited's ambitious TV ad.

name: Freakout: Calamity TV Show
short_description: Juicy top down intense old school shooter!

name: Subnautica: Below Zero
short_description: Dive into a freezing underwater adventure on an alien planet. Below Zero is set two years after the original Subnautica. Return to Planet 4546B to uncover the truth behind a deadly cover-up. Survive by building habitats, crafting tools, & diving deeper into the world of Subnautica.

name: Aurum Kings
short_description: Aurum Kings is a competitive arena game where the goal is to become the richest in the land!

name: Action Card Football
short_description: Action Card Football takes the concept of American football & applies it to a turn-based, card-focused strategy game format. Coach one of four unique teams to victory against either the single player AI or online against your friends.

name: Creeper World 4
short_description: The unstoppable fluid enemy has returned and destroyed every world in its path! Defend against Creeper as it floods across the 3D terrain in this real time strategy game where the enemy is a fluid.

name: Sniper Strike: Special Ops
short_description: Intercept, eliminate and extract. It’s time to engage the enemy.Sniper Strike is a high-octane sniper experience that pits you in battle across three gameplay modes and 100's of missions. Scout through immersive environments, engage in rapid-fire combat and build the ultimate super-soldier.

name: Super Destronaut DX
short_description: Inspired by an arcade classic, Super Destronaut DX is retro space shooter that pits you against an enemy more dreaded than a UFO, a scoreboard.

name: Cyberemo 2007
short_description: Cyberemo 2007: “Wake up damn you, Emo, we have a lot of veins for cuts!” Old-school platformer breathtaking game.

name: Welcome Back To 2007 Part II
short_description: Would you say that 2007 cannot be returned? After 11 long years, 2007 are coming back to us in 2018! AGAIN! Be ready for Cool Story! Old-school platformer game.

name: Adult Toy Store
short_description: Operating a sex toys shop, Store layout, hiring staff, Develop a variety of fun merchandise, Meet customer needs (But in fact this is not the focus of the game ...)

name: Dinosaur Hunter
short_description: Embark on a great adventure to hunt down some prehistoric beasts!

name: Cool Headed
short_description: Cool Headed is a puzzle casual-programming game. Combine and give instructions to your bots to reach the objective! Piece by piece, make your mark on an extensive overworld, unlock bots and discover secrets. Will you have the heart to sacrifice your team?

name: Toki Time Trial
short_description: What could you accomplish if you had the ability to stop time? Become a master of time and space as you take on temporal puzzles in this first person puzzle platformer.

name: Defendion
short_description: Defendion is a unique board tower defense game in VR where the table in front of you is your battlefield, where enemies will damage and destroy your structures and you can change and block its paths. Conquer new locations, meet new enemies, build your defense.

name: Z.W!
short_description: Full ahead! Kill'em all! Fight as long as possible!

name: Lazergoat: Invasion
short_description: Martians have invaded the Earth and enslaved our animals, but worst of all, they made Lazergoat angry. Now, he wants revenge!

name: Space Drop
short_description: Planets and Objects fall from space. Match in 3, 4 or 5's. It sounds easy, but becomes increasingly difficult as the player progresses with the addition of more Planets/Objects.

name: Krystal the Adventurer
short_description: Krystal's home has been burned down by a magic sword sent by a wizard, and it's up to you to help her beat him up!

name: Star Tower
short_description: Star Tower is a tower-defense game in three dimensions. Play begins in 2D, but you may also navigate forward and backward, revealing the path to reach greater challenges. Features include nebula obstacles, game-wide upgrades, increasingly difficult bosses, and special one-use powers.

name: Bug Splatt
short_description: Splatt your way through TEN splattery bug busting levels, bashing as many bugs as you can before the timer runs out…..

name: Pestis
short_description: A young Plague Doctor, only to learn that the Academy sent to a small village, which, like the whole country is gripped by plague

name: Quarantine Circular
short_description: First, do no harm. From the award-winning team behind Thomas Was Alone and Subsurface Circular comes another experimental short, the next mutation in text-based adventure. In the middle of a world-ending pandemic, a group of scientists discover the galaxy has been watching.

name: Equilinox
short_description: Equilinox is a relaxing nature simulation game in which you can create and nurture your own ecosystems. Shape the world to your liking, cultivate and raise hundreds of different species, and evolve your wildlife to unlock more exotic plants and animals.

name: Lost
short_description: The last knight of an army aims to avenge his homeland and to destroy all his enemies by himself.

name: Goroons
short_description: GOROONS is a teamwork-based adventure where you have to combine your unique skills and overcome tough-as-nails puzzle challenges.

name: The Outlaw, The Drunk, & The Whore
short_description: When three unscrupulous jerks meet an early demise, only the devil himself can give 'em another shot at that federal gold! Contains cussin' and such

name: Stickman in the Portal
short_description: Cubes, panels, buttons and many, many portals.

name: Heart of Dixie: GOTY Hyper Combo Edition
short_description: A rural-themed dating adventure inspired by Shadowgate and Morenatsu, solve puzzles and explore your way to the answers of a mysterious castle you have awakened in.

name: Space Armor 2
short_description: To Be The Hero!

name: Maximum Action
short_description: MAXIMUM Action is a brutal and satisfying physics-based first person shooter influenced by Hong Kong cinema, heroic slow motion bloodshed, and old-school FPS ACTION.

name: BlubBlub: Quest of the Blob
short_description: BlubBlub is too cute! Escape through a trial of deadly traps to save all the blub friends!

name: Great Mountain Experience
short_description: " The Great Mountain Experience." allows you to experience a new kind of tour. You can enjoy beautiful scenery with VR gear at your home. Distinctive ways to enjoy beautiful scenery await you, so we hope you will enjoy the ride. Bon voyage!

name: LOGistICAL: Caribbean
short_description: LOGistICAL: Caribbean is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the countries. Over 1000 towns to complete across the islands of the Caribbean covering 26 different countries.

name: aMAZE Classic
short_description: aMAZE Classic is a straightforward and surprisingly - difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with abstraction art and calm soundtrack.

name: Moonfall Ultimate
short_description: Moonfall Ultimate is a 2D side-scrolling, action-RPG, set in an industrial gothic universe. Hack, slash and cast your way through a treacherous hand-painted world in solo, couch co-op or endless arcade mode.

name: Splash
short_description: Splash is a fast-paced arcade-style game where you try to withstand waves of enemies and rack up a highscore bigger than all of your friends. All while listening to a killer 80s synth-soundtrack by legendary Koto.

name: Ancient Journey VR
short_description: It is the first museum in the world from where you can set out for a trip to ancient times. It's the only occasion to admire ancient buildings, search through Egyptian temples, see under your eyes the beauty of Japan and feel the atmosphere of ancient temple in India.

name: Bob The Cube
short_description: Bob The Cube is a 3D platformer game. Bob The Cube is the main character of the game. Bob's girlfriend was kidnapped and you have to complete all the levels to rescue her. You have to go through 15 unique 3D and 2.5D levels in 5 different worlds.

name: Subterraneus
short_description: Subterraneus is a point&click video game. A mouse, curiosity and some (twisted) logic are your only weapons to help Clodomir venture into the depths below his world!

name: Snail Racer Extreme
short_description: Come play this extremely addictive and fun snail racing game! Can you dominate the scoreboards?

name: Dino Dawn
short_description: Dino Dawn is a platformer game about adventure of the Dinosaur in which it needs to rescue eggs.

name: Russian Gangsta In HELL
short_description: You play as a gangster who got into Hell for your business, and you need to kill all demon devils demons, because there's nothing else to do in Hell

name: Ice Demon
short_description: How long can you survive? In this arcade-style game, employ hand to hand combat and freeze your enemies to get as many kills as possible before you are defeated.

name: FPV Freerider
short_description: RC Quadcopter Racing Simulator - Fly (and crash!) all you want regardless of the weather, all for the price of a few replacement props.

name: Lost in Spice
short_description: Lost in Spice is a cooking game for Oculus Rift in which you play as an abducted human forced to cook Earth food for aliens at the Intergalactic House of Planets. Now you have to dice up weird ingredients, cook them, and submit them in the time limit to get a good score. And if you don't, you'll be vaporized!

name: Doors Push or Pull
short_description: You are trapped in a endless hallway of doors. Push the doors that are marked push and pull the doors marked pull. There is no escape.. eventually you will pull a push door or push a pull door- once you do your game is over.

name: EXCHANGE
short_description: Engage within the world of EXCHANGE, a low poly multiplayer first-person shooter, where players are destined to defeat their competition using smarts and skill. Battles upon a plethora of maps await, the weapons forged and ripe for war, classes varied to your style of play, all anticipating your exchange.

name: Arlo The Rabbit
short_description: Welcome to Arlo's first adventure, in an old-school platformer fashion! Complete with amazing chiptune tracks!

name: Dawn of the Celestialpod
short_description: Swing through deadly spaceships as a squid on a journey to save a species from eternal enslavement! Infiltrate the fleet, take out robotic guards, and escape the self-destruct sequence as quickly as possible. Find the best way to overcome their advanced technology... or die trying!

name: Warlock: Tower Defence
short_description: Warlock: Tower Defence is a story driven tower defence game, giving players access to 6 elemental magics to face challenges spread across 5 chapters.

name: Paper Shakespeare: Stick Julius Caesar (with a dagger)
short_description: The dramatic retelling of the death of Julius Caesar, as only stick figures can. We know that we already did that joke. We don't care. We'll probably do it again. Shakespeare's classic political drama about how political violence never goes over well.

name: Paper Shakespeare: Loves Labor(s) Lost
short_description: What happens when stick figures based on Shakespeare fall in love? Let's find out! Loosely based on Shakespeare's Love's Labour's Lost, play as some cool archeologists forsaking love to explore some awesome ruins!

name: Scary Maze
short_description: Scary Maze is an exciting horror-action hybrid where you run through a maze killing zombies, ready to eat you as soon as they can.

name: Pamali: Indonesian Folklore Horror
short_description: A narrative horror game set in the daily lives of Indonesian society. Interact with various mystical objects as you explore haunted places, unravel their lingering mysteries, and experience how Indonesian myth, taboo and culture, combined with your choices, shape the course of your nights.

name: No Prospects Company
short_description: Bright future is right ahead!

name: HEROES TRIALS
short_description: An intense and fast-paced adventure broken into several trials that can also be played as a shooter. Help siblings Elia and Zoel to become their homeland heroes.

name: DeepLands
short_description: You have just bought a new house, strange things start to happen, and then! you find yourself in a dark and lonely place. Now you have to find a way home, and survive the DeepLands!

name: RollerCoaster Legends II: Thor's Hammer
short_description: Experience Norse mythology in an unbelievable seven minute non-stop rollercoaster ride made for virtual reality. Meet giants, elves, trolls and a fire-breathing dragon while riding the coaster of a lifetime.

name: WTF
short_description: WTF is a chaotic first person shooter that confronts heavily armed players with "The Devil" himself.

name: Simple Sailing
short_description: SimpleSailing is a simple sailing simulator game

name: Washed Up!
short_description: Blocks are washing up on the beaches of your pristine atoll, deploy your crab helpers to tidy them up before they pollute everything! Take blocks from the beach and arrange them into squares in the middle to score points and keep your beaches clean.

name: Cows VS Vikings
short_description: You think you’ve seen everything in Stream already?! No, buddy, you never saw anything like that before! The Vikings against the cows! Show them the strength of Odin and twist their horns off!

name: Perseverance: Part 1
short_description: Perseverance is a horror/drama visual novel about survival and redemption. In Part 1 you play as Jack, a father who is struggling to keep his family together and finds himself in the middle of horrific events.

name: Ikenfell
short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG about a group of troublesome magic students. Use timing mechanics to power your spells and block attacks, explore the twisted halls of a vast magic school, fight challenging monsters and bosses, and uncover dark secrets never meant to be found.

name: Not Without You
short_description: The Pilcri have been captured! You must save them! Enjoy dozens of levels and hours of puzzles to test your wit and help these lovable creatures escape!

name: Starfighter X
short_description: Anarchy throughout the galaxy has forced all pilots to kill or be killed. The stars are a savage battlefield where only the best will survive. Claim your rightful place as the top captain in free-for-all combat. Compete for position on the galactic leaderboards to become Starfighter X.

name: 270 | Two Seventy US Election
short_description: Do you have what it takes to become President of the United States? Can you win the Two Seventy (270) Electoral Votes needed for victory in the US Election?

name: Balloon Strike
short_description: Balloon Strike is amazing Balloon Strike game in which you have bow and arrow to hit balloon and get score.

name: Thunderbolt 2
short_description: In Thunderbolt 2 you play the role of something flying through the long corridors. The main task is to shoot down objects thereby collecting fuel, which very quickly ends. To avoid collisions with other figures and go to the coveted finish. This time you can get some relax in this stylish symmetry puzzle game.

name: Huawei VR 2
short_description: Huawei VR 2 is the first product which can access to both platforms, including smartphone and PC. Via its standalone fast LCD lens and 3K display, Huawei VR 2 is redefining the virtual reality experience.

name: Floating Wonderland
short_description: A 2D platformer set in a world of floating islands where gravity acts with strange properties and can point in any direction. Join one of 4 characters in their own story venturing through these strange and wonderful environments that twist and turn in all directions.

name: VTree Beach Volleyball
short_description: Choose from 37 international teams an 13 different courts from around the world as you pass, assist, attack, block and dig your way to the championships and bring home the trophy for your country. Special features exclusive for Steam members.

name: Squares
short_description: Simple game in wich you can entertain and relax yourself. Squares flying in many directions from you moves in new game mechanic. You should slide the squares by the path and dont touch others squares. Different levels and challenges is waiting for you in the game.

name: The Subject
short_description: You have been taken prisoner and sold to a deep space testing facility. Upon arrival, you are fitted with a device forcing you to participate in their experiment. Released into a massive complex, the dark halls wind around testing rooms and conceal pieces to puzzles. There is no option but to comply.

name: Leon's Nightmare
short_description: A randomly generated player will navigate a hellish nightmare world. Upgrade your player after each run and discover more about the strange world they inhabit. This game is a community-driven alpha game! Submit your ideas for creatures, encounters, and anything you would like to add!

name: The 18th Floor
short_description: In Ancient Eastern Mythology, miscreants and sinners who have lived a life of evil and deception are sent to “18 Floors” after death. Their souls are doomed to suffer an endless torture, forever cursed with pain and anguish, as punishment for their wicked lives.  In 1930, a young Eastern woman was brutally murdered on a train.

name: Ryte - The Eye of Atlantis
short_description: With a little help from the Historia Time Travel agency, set sail to the city of Atlantis for a VR Myst-ical adventure : Fill in the sandals of an Atlantean who recently broke out of prison, wield supernatural powers, solve esoteric puzzles and try to prevent the End of Atlantis !

name: VOiD
short_description: In this epic quest you must reach the end by going through black holes. Try to avoid all the traps, solve all the mind-bending puzzles and escape form the powerful bosses. OH... And one more thing .... secrets are everywhere.

name: New Ice York
short_description: Who froze the city of NEW ICE YORK? Who did this? That's up to you to find out, Detective...

name: Coffee Noir - Business Detective Game
short_description: A unique combination of a business management game and detective novel with elegant graphics in a noir comic-book art style. Experience an advanced business management simulation along with intriguing story set in alternative future of Neo-London.

name: Ahlman Arcade 2018
short_description: Ahlman Arcade 2018 is a collection of games made by the game industry students at Ahlman Institute.All games were made during our ten month long school year as a joint effort between the programmers and graphic designers.

name: Age of Cards - Ra's Chess
short_description: Ra’s Chess is a strategic turn based chess-card game for online multiplayer between two players. Despite being easy to learn it is complex and includes deep strategy.

name: Thrunt XL
short_description: Thrunt XL is a super-tricky time-attack thrust-em-up. Take control (roughly speaking) of an agile but fragile Lander. Race through a series of increasingly ridiculous levels packed with deadly machinery, deadly defences, deadly... actually everything's deadly.

name: Asteroid Deathmatch
short_description: The future is now, so why not take a holiday to the past? Asteroid Deathmatch is a homage to very old games, re-vamped for modern systems.

name: Zeliria Sanctuary
short_description: Sense of reality has not yet returned after a teleportation experiment. Purple hamsters, girls with tails, medieval knights - a fantastic world of an alien planet, where you will lead special forces soldier Maxx.

name: My Brother Rabbit
short_description: My Brother Rabbit is a beautifully drawn exploration adventure and puzzle game set in a surreal world that mixes reality with a child’s imagination.

name: TRIGGER
short_description: TRIGGER is a highly Realistic and Detailed Third person and First person Drift game that include a First person Zombie Mode.

name: 荒野寻踪
short_description: Wild searching is a strategy game abundant in humour elements and promotes memorising, spontaneous reacting and strategic response capabilities. It brings you wonderful experience. Check it out!

name: Trippy Jump
short_description: Simple jumping platformer game.

name: Unsacrifice
short_description: Unsacrifice is a classic survival horror game compile in a solo campaign. You will play as a priest apprendice, lost in a world full of mysteries, hidden dangers and deformed creatures that the player has to escape from.

name: Plants
short_description: Unwind and de-stress with the help of the calm music and serene environment. Plants is a nontraditional and nonviolent experience where you take control over a growing flower.

name: Bum Simulator
short_description: Bum Simulator is a sandbox game bursting with inappropriate humor and memorable characters. You live on the streets of Bumsville. Do you have what it takes to adapt, survive and become an urban legend?

name: Sweet Treats
short_description: Fun and colorful candy themed match 3 game. Featuring 100 levels. Work your way up the ladder and become a mastery pastry chef.

name: UpBoll
short_description: UpBall is a game of climbing up by controlling the speed of time Each death will not reset the level or let you start over If you are unskilled, then stop the time and think about what to do next The game is inspired by “SUPERHOT”

name: Trek: Travel Around the World
short_description: In Trek: Travel Around the World, the adventure starts in your new Helsinki apartment. Each experience after that transports you to a new destination where real-world locations are blended with magical phenomenon!

name: NEX:OS Colosseum
short_description: NEX:OS is a community driven Ability/Movement focused Looter-Shooter style FPS game set in a war torn future. You play as a Centurion, a Biologically and Cybernetically enhanced near-immortal super soldier.

name: Space Elite Force
short_description: Gear up for an intergalactic thrill ride! Space Elite Force is a frenzied space-shooter packed with weapon customization and epic boss battles. Take command of your ship and fight for the survival of humanity!

name: Superfighters Deluxe
short_description: Superfighters Deluxe is a unique action game that combines brawling, shooting and platforming in dynamic sandboxy 2D levels. Lots of weapons and fun gameplay systems interlock to create absurd action-movie chaos.

name: Vixens From Outer Space
short_description: Space Amazons! Cosmic Horror! Action!

name: Wake Up, Good Guardian!
short_description: Wake up, save some spirits, befriend some elves, give some gifts, thwart all evil. Y’know. Just guardian spirit stuff.

name: National Machine
short_description: You are a munitions manufacturer in 1930s. Help your nation for arms race. Before war break, you need to produce enough aircraft, tanks and guns.

name: Chameleon Man
short_description: A new action running game has come! Run and match color puzzles!

name: Conjury of Nature
short_description: Fight in a fantasy world against the troops of the underworld! Defend your village by repelling the endless hordes of enemies using an assortment of weapons. But be prepared, the enemies have their own abilities that will make your life hell!

name: 蝶生梦影-Butterfly dream shadow
short_description: Player Sui Mu is an egg that was killed in an accident on the way to his predecessor's wedding. But fortunately, she was selected by the West as a 'system'. As long as she completes the designated mission, she can have an opportunity to regenerate.

name: The Mill Blackbird VR Experience
short_description: Welcome to The Mill BLACKBIRD®, the world’s first fully adjustable car rig that creates photoreal, CG cars. Experience the key configurable features of this ground-breaking production tool in VR.

name: Mind Labyrinth VR Dreams
short_description: Mind Labyrinth VR Dreams is an emotional journey through your alternative world in dream-like environments and atmospheres...

name: Little Comet
short_description: A cute physics-based space minigolf

name: Antisnake
short_description: Tired of the usual snake, which increases in size and unrealistically accelerated? It's time to try out Antisnake - a game in which you have to help the snake lose weight and lose excess pixels!

name: Dark SASI
short_description: As you progress through the game level of difficulty will increase, so that Dark SASI will be for you the most serious game test. Can you survive thousands of deaths? Dark SASI is an adventure in the style of an RPG, with its own characteristics.

name: Catch'em
short_description: A sudden plane crash interrupts the uneventful journey of a little boy. Now stranded in the heart of the Amazonian jungle, he embarks on an eventful journey along the trails of a long-forgotten civilization, searching for the legendary city of El Dorado.

name: Kidz
short_description: Kidz is 2D Side Scrolling style, featuring different mechanic each episode, including Action Horror, Point & Click, and Parkour! 3 kids from the different universe face the same issue. Let's explore their story!

name: Crashbots
short_description: Run, fly and shoot your way through a robot testing facility. Take control of the latest line of robots and test their fighting capabilities and agility in different worlds filled with dangerous obstacles, booby traps and enemies that want to crash your bots.

name: Master Pyrox Wizard Smackdown
short_description: Master Pyrox Wizard Smackdown is a fast-paced arcade-style multiplayer game for up to 8 players. Avoid the fireballs, knock your opponents down, collect power-ups and cast spells. The game offers single player, competitive and cooperative game modes and a built-in level editor.

name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Cities
short_description: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Cities is your game. Travel the world enjoying its comfortable and intuitive interface and its relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these beautiful photos that pose a real challenge for lovers of puzzles.

name: Rainy Day Racer
short_description: 3D time-attack motor racing in a city in Scotland where it rains like a bastard.

name: Prison Test
short_description: This is a test game in which you can learn life in the russian prison, prison customs, prison riddles and answers to them, find out who are the prisoners and what they are in prison for, learn the articles and so on.

name: Comet Crasher
short_description: Soar, shoot and dodge - but don't stop moving. Fall down at breakneck speeds in this fast-paced platformer filled with chaos and explosions.

name: Footy Ball Tournament 2018
short_description: The auto-run football tournament soccer game. Be the player, be the manager.

name: Bot Tales: The Crashed
short_description: On a hostile planet, an alien race with big eyes and thirsty for energy, will chase you with the only purpose of silencing yours being robotic circuits to drain all your energy. Try to survive this attack!

name: ReMind VR: Daily Meditation
short_description: Repose and unwind with proven meditation techniques from three foremost experts in the field of relaxation therapy. Tranquilize your stressful day with simple, short exercises of requiescence.

name: How Mosquito Became Human
short_description: This game is about a brave mosquito who wants to become a human. The main idea is that if you eat something, you become it.

name: E3.14CENTER
short_description: It takes a mysterious man to solve the mystery of wave propagation. You hero has no weapons, no superpowers, but the world is arranged so that your words take on shape and strength of their own. In this logic arcade game you need to enter words, destroy viruses and get to the next waves.

name: Danger!Energy
short_description: Connect the points with neon rays to liberate virtual city of Santermonia from the Main Virtual Controller's tyranny.

name: Miami Cruise
short_description: Miami Cruise is a game inspired by retrowave aesthetics. Take a ride, and chill out.

name: Time Tenshi
short_description: Join the Time Tenshi on their thrilling adventures through time! Make key decisions to influence the story's outcome... and maybe even go on a date!

name: ROS
short_description: ROS - is a logical game game. You must hold the ball before moving to the next level.

name: Yahrit!
short_description: Easy to learn and fast to play local competitive multiplayer for 2-4 players. Cleverly combine jumping and dashing mechanics to outwit your rivals in this sweet pixel art brawler!

name: FlyInside Flight Simulator
short_description: FlyInside Flight Simulator is a brand new flight simulator built for VR! It ships with ten beautiful aircraft and scenery covering the entire continental United States. Fly high-speed jets, hover helicopters, and enjoy general aviation aircraft around a variety of locations and weather types!

name: Angel Wings
short_description: Upon answering a mysterious phone call, you awaken in an unfamiliar place filled with new faces… Through intricate relationships and thoughtful introspection, will you be able to unravel the reason you are here?

name: To Light: Ex Umbra
short_description: Plagued by tangible darkness, a princess and a young man guided by a mysterious force must travel across the world to find the secret to defeating the darkness once and for all. They must journey To Light.

name: The Spiral Scouts
short_description: Join Remae, the newest member of the Spiral Scouts, on her slap-tastic puzzle solving adventure through a world of crazy characters and redonkulous realms. Experience a fartwarming tale of personal growth, self discovery, poop, wieners and butts.

name: Fantasy Raiders
short_description: In Fantasy Raiders, you'll fight against or cooperate with various factions which seek for treasures, collect precious treasures and become a famous explorer in the end. * Explore the uncharted places and discover the secrets of each regions! * Collect treasures, get rewards and decorate your own treasure house!

name: Talos VR
short_description: Talos" is a realistic and doomsday style of VR, which combines the characteristics of vehicles, robots and a large number of firearms. Can you survive in this doomsday world as a surviving mecha driver, driving Phaethon against Talos?

name: Lucky Night: Poker Games
short_description: Exciting Blackjack and Texas Hold'em games in VR.

name: Ding Dong XL
short_description: A fast-paced, neon-infused arcade game with simple one-button controls! Addictive, easy to learn, and perfect for quick sessions. Challenge yourself to beat your high score while waiting in queue for another game!

name: OK/NORMAL
short_description: OK/NORMAL is a short, experimental third-person horror experience, inspired by early 3D console games of the 90's. Journey through a dark, disjointed, dreamlike dimension with your cloud companion! Remember a good diet, take your medicine, and you should be fine!

name: BlueFear
short_description: Sea survival game with action and survival elements.

name: Sky Tracers
short_description: Jump over rooftops, scale sky scrapers and fight off hostile robots as you master the almost infinite depth of rocket parkour. Find and carve your very own path through challenging courses in a frantic multiplayer race. *Project currently on hold.*

name: Kid,napper: Gosh, I'm Kidnapped by a Pupil
short_description: I had to admit, the only thing that is more scary than a murder weapon, is that girl, who is not even supposed to hold it

name: Cubers: Arena
short_description: CUBERS: Arena, is an electrifying arena brawler/ twin stick slasher game. Play as Baller, a slave fighting his way through an array of gladiators to reclaim his freedom. Play solo or in a local Co-Op and fight waves of enemies using a variety of weapons, armory, and skills.

name: Magic Blast VR
short_description: "Have you ever wanted to fight with magic?" "Magic Blast VR" is an action game to fight with magic in VR! In this game you can create original magic, and fights a lot of enemies. This game features "Magic Form" system. It can set your own form and shoot magic!

name: OneShift
short_description: OneShift is a puzzle platformer where the player has the ability to freeze/unfreeze time and shift through worlds to collect blue cubes. But only one world can be active at a time. Later in the game, a world rotating mechanic is unveiled, which makes everything more complex!

name: KO Mech
short_description: A small mech with a heart of gold embarks on a quest to punch everyone to death.

name: Storm Chasers
short_description: Be one of those intrepid storm chasers in this online multiplayer video game. Your goal is to shoot the best twisters pictures without dying because of powerful winds and flying debris. Feel the challenge of correctly forecasting and intercepting storms with the optimal vantage points before other players.

name: The Great Story of a Mighty Hero - Remastered
short_description: Ironic "Hack and Slash" RPG bath filled with blood and gore! Go through the wall of enemies and defeat the mighty evil to become a mighty hero!

name: Intelligence: Anime girls
short_description: Puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with beautiful anime girls) so that the picture was like the original image. Move the puzzle tiles wisely to collect the correct order of the pieces of images. The essence of the game as in the old game "Tag" (15).

name: Swapette Showdown
short_description: Swapette Showdown is a competitive action puzzler for one to four players. Swap the blocks to create matches! Battle as/against cute magical girls a.k.a. the Swapettes! Be the best of them all! How will you stack up against the competition?

name: Kitsune Kitchen
short_description: Play through the story of a young man’s quest to create the ultimate BLT sandwich.

name: Survive the West
short_description: You find yourself in a desert, full of strangers, wild animals and stuff you might want to collect. Gather everything you can, build some protection for yourself and be careful about others that might plan on hindering you.

name: The General Retreats
short_description: The General Retreats is a puzzle game. Steer your vehicle through a dangerous battlefield, avoiding bombs, artillery, and enemy tanks. Every attempt plays out exactly the same way, so you can learn the fastest safe path to the goal. The game has ten levels and five unique vehicles to drive.

name: Caverns: Lost Sky
short_description: Caverns: Lost Sky is a single player action-adventure RPG set in a fully destructible, voxelized subterranean realm. Join Strato in the Tellurian Sector as he battles hordes of Fera in his quest to find the sky. Level up and increase your stats, or ascend the caverns searching for buried treasure.

name: Muerte's Arena
short_description: Voxels and Vector Graphics combine in a VR Arcade Shoot Em Up where you must always be on your toes and aim true.

name: Gamer Sensei's Range Royale
short_description: Gamer Sensei invites you to hone your Battle Royale shooting skills in our solo practice arena. Don't lose another firefight due to poor aim, bad flick, or lack of practice with common weapon types. Range Royale includes realistic weapons and game modes designed to test your abilities to the next level!

name: Anderson (Alpha)
short_description: CAN YOU ESCAPE THE MYSTERIOUS ROOM AND SOLVE THE SECRETS BEHIND YOUR CAPTIVITY?

name: Super Plexis
short_description: Super Plexis is a cross-platform multiplayer action puzzler inspired by classic console puzzle games. Play online with up to 4 players in a variety of game modes.

name: Orc Island
short_description: Stranded, all alone on a deserted Island. How will you survive? Sandbox game. Build, farm, hunt and explore.

name: Astraeus
short_description: Astraeus is a VR asteroid mining RTS game that's quick to play, easy to learn, and enormous in scope. Build a mining network from dozens of bases, and watch as hundreds of ships swarm around you.

name: Balance of Soccer
short_description: This is a 3D soccer simulation game. Including the 2022 World Cup and the 2021 European Cup. You can freely set the team's formation and tactics, and you can also control the players in real time.

name: FUTURETECH SPACE COMBAT ACADEMY
short_description: Will you make the grade and save the planet? Become a cadet on your first day of training in this 3rd person space combat simulator.

name: Vertical Fall
short_description: Easy. And freedom air. But, this wing does not flutter.

name: Frankenstein: Beyond the Time
short_description: Go on a discovery quest where the task is to solve the greatest mystery of Dr. Frankenstein. The game makes innovative use of Virtual Reality with a hidden object model and crafting simulations combined with the fight against time. Become the time master and carry on Dr. Frankenstein’s legacy!

name: Elemensional Rift
short_description: Elemensional Rift is a platform fighter that shakes out the traditional hit/throw/guard triangle for a focus on energy management. Manage your energy in this clash of gods while humanity fights back from hanging on the brink of extinction. Will you survive to get your wish granted?

name: Feud
short_description: Feud is a turn-based strategy game. Swap pieces on a four-by-four grid to isolate your opponent's pieces, or go straight for their King. Hone your skills against three AI characters with distinct play-styles, then challenge your friends online or on the same screen.

name: One Person Story
short_description: Can the game be a symbol of the life? Friends help, doors stop our movement, we must think and resolve difficulties. Is it a game or life?

name: Cyber Ops
short_description: Become a military hacker and help your black ops team reach their goal in this noir cyberpunk tactical game. Scan, hack, overtake, control and manage high tech devices, vehicles and even enemy cyborgs with cutting-edge implants.

name: Cairo's Tale: The Big Egg
short_description: Cairo's Tale: The Big Egg is a VR animated short about the adventure of young talented mage Cairo and his best friend, who just got surprised by a giant egg that fell off and broke the roof of Cairo’s flying house. Though being afraid, they decide to figure out what happened…

name: Bighead Runner
short_description: Bighead Runner is an arcade endless runner that challenges you to collect coins and conquer the leaderboards! Dash, jump, and slide through procedurally generated stages, striving to beat your best score and unlock awesome skins.

name: All Quiet in the Trenches
short_description: All Quiet in the Trenches is a narrative turn-based strategy RPG set in World War I. Get to know your soldiers, take care of their needs and lead them in battle, trying to strike a precarious balance between the ambitions of your superiors and the survival of your men.

name: Slime CCG
short_description: Build decks using fun and powerful Slime's and battle them in unique arenas!

name: Super Seducer 2 - Advanced Seduction Tactics
short_description: Ready to take your skills with women to the NEXT next level in this amazing sequel to the smash hit Super Seducer? We put you in everyday scenarios and let you do practically anything to see how it plays out with beautiful women.

name: Viking Days
short_description: How long can you survive the Viking Days? The ultimate Viking simulator trains you until your beard can reach the floor. Be challenged by every day normal situations of a Viking! Inspired by games such as WarioWare and Job Simulator, interact with the environment and be a REAL VIKING!

name: Starcom: Nexus
short_description: Suddenly thrown into an unknown galaxy, you must explore, fight or befriend aliens and transform your ship from a small survey vessel into a powerful battlecruiser to unravel the mystery of the forces that brought you here and find your way home.

name: Quiz Time
short_description: Quiz Time is all in one Quiz Package for everyone. You can play any type of quizzes like Sports Quiz, G.K Quiz, Songs Quiz, Maths Quiz, Entertainment Quiz and Many more.

name: Sea of memories
short_description: Optical illusions reach Virtual Reality! Challenge your mind rotating the pieces to clean up the chaos.

name: Science:The world is in your hands
short_description: You are the worlds most successful scientist which has revolutionised the world, but suddenly a tragedy hits and a virus is released on earth. You are the only one that can create the cure to save the world. You must fix your robot and your laboratory to save planet earth.

name: Blueprint
short_description: You can stack blocks to make your own building. Your goal is to maintain the building height after disaster. There are total 48 levels.

name: Otto and the Ancient Worlds
short_description: Otto and the Ancient Worlds is an 8-bit 2D adventure platformer about an archaeologist who discovers an ancient library filled with magical books. Each book contains a living story of a mythology or folklore, and a mysterious evil figure releases them into Otto’s world!

name: Artillery Cats
short_description: Artillery Cats is a 2-8 player party battle game based off the old classic 'Bomberman'. Battle it out with your friends using unique cats with their own special abilities (More cats to come) on 4 different styles of maps each having a 4 or 8 player version.

name: Cat Food
short_description: Get your cat’s food back!! . Your pesky parrot has stolen it and hidden it all over. You will need to take out your giant slingshot to knock down blocks and bring the cat food back to earth. A casual VR knockdown game from Intelligent Procedure.

name: SMASH BOY Ver.KZ
short_description: Fight your way through an army of… evil ladies?! Smash Boy is a single-player mouse-based action game. Enjoy simple but fast paced combat as you battle against large groups of enemies in this 2D beat ‘em up. Customize your own unique and skill combinations to suit your playing style.

name: MinerXP
short_description: Pick up your pickaxe!!!Make your inference, use the best strategy and highest speed, DIG THEM ALL!!!

name: Brain 43℃
short_description: There is no depressing story.

name: Villager's Biography
short_description: Nowadays, the villagers, each more awesome than the next. There are not many villagers like you who have worked hard to earn money. Collecting, fishing, stealing, working, cooking, a variety of ways to make money, two actress in a leading role can be married. The next life winner is you!

name: The Lost Sky
short_description: The Lost Sky is a 2D multi-directional action game set in a dystopian world.

name: Treasure Adventure Game
short_description: Treasure Adventure Game casts you in the role of a young boy who lands on an island that is a fragment of what was once a continent, destroyed in the war between a demon and a wizard.

name: Survive the Rift
short_description: Survive the Rift is a rogue-lite shoot 'em up with procedurally generated levels, unlockable ships, and plenty of items to make each run unique. Inspired by classic 16-bit era scrolling shooters with modern rogue-lite game mechanics.

name: ORIX!
short_description: ORIX!- a puzzle game - where you need to find the right path and get to the yellow cube.

name: Space Force
short_description: Go as much as you can in Space Force.

name: Lost Legend-Legacy
short_description: Embark on an adventure lost in time: a tale of Alchemists being oppressed and trying to figure out what side you are truly on. Dive into Lost Legend and let the story unfold as you journey through the land of Alcomby.

name: Frogvale
short_description: The same day that Marco was fired, he found out that he'll be a father. The only job he can get for the time being is as a bus driver. Manage his passengers, money and relationships to ensure his family's future.

name: Marble It Up! Ultra
short_description: Roll, bounce, boost, and blast your way to victory in Marble It Up! Ultra - the ultimate marble platformer. Chase the records of your friends and the world's best players through a vast campaign - or face them head-on in thrilling multiplayer mayhem. Get ready to roll!

name: Sagebrush
short_description: A first-person narrative adventure game about exploring a cult compound in the remote New Mexico desert. Discover the lives of the former inhabitants -- what brought them together, what they believed, and why they ended it all.

name: Trap Defense
short_description: Trap Defense is a TD like puzzle game. In each level, you need to place the traps at a correct position to prevent the balls reach the finish point.

name: My Magical Demon Lover
short_description: Spicy Ecchi Content + A Yaoi Fantasy Story + A Dash of Comedy = My Magical Demon Lover, a 'mature players' dating sim that puts the wannabe wizard Tristan with his choice of three hot demons.

name: Feelin
short_description: Make your own avatar. Construct as best you can. Feelin open world all constructions are shared by all players. Become a Feelin resident, own land, collect items, build and develop this world! Thank you for your constructions and contributions.

name: BE-A Walker
short_description: Take control of a huge mech on an alien planet! Shoot and trample the natives, avenge your brother, or forgive his killers? Join the rebels to restore peace on the exotic planet of Eldorado.

name: Midnight Horde
short_description: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror parkour action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies. Upgrade weapons, fortify castles and towns to keep darkness at bay.

name: 3, 2, 1, SURVIVE !
short_description: A simple game with an hard difuculty !In 3, 2, 1, SURVIVE ! you control a heart who spawn on an arena with many kinds of mob who attack you. More time you survive, more point you earn, but be carful, moste you stay in the arena, moste the dificulty increas.3, 2, 1, SURVIVE ! it's too a game made by a guy who know nothing in game creating

name: Demolition Ball
short_description: In 2124, an alien race approaches planet Earth. Their intentions are unknown... Well, not really, Demolition Ball is a classic Breakout-style game with multiple game modes to offer some variation to the original game style. Of course the basic concept remains the same: destroy bricks with a ball.

name: Barry Has a Secret
short_description: Meal hiding simulator.

name: qop 3
short_description: qop 3 is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.

name: Destiny of a Wizard 2:  Beyond the Vale
short_description: Keeping a promise to their father, the adventures continue of The Blue Wizard! Journey into a unknown land known as Lulisa. New adventures, friends, and foes await in the exciting second chapter of the Blue Wizard!

name: SAVANNA SHOT VR
short_description: You are a savanna's National Park Ranger! With nature-rich savannah, you must drive a 4WD off-road car and use an anesthetic gun to manage the ecology of animals!

name: Aztec Number
short_description: Challenge puzzle masters from all over the world Accompanied by powerful sound effects, solve 108 puzzles and take possession of the secret treasure of the Aztecs.

name: Waterside Chirping 水畔空蝉
short_description: Aileen was an ordinary village girl. However, after she been cursed on by a weird man, everything changed…

name: SilverFrame(纯白星原)
short_description: This is a 3D space combat game.You will be driving a transformable mecha to perform missions singly or with your partner.There are large fleet, missile barrage, super beam cannon, dog-fighting and other exciting challenges waiting for you.

name: Combat Wings
short_description: It’s the 4th of June, 1942, and Japanese bombs are raining down on Midway – and you. This lethal assault is a prelude to an invasion whose success gives the enemy control over the Pacific. You are one of the American airmen who hold the outcome of this decisive battle in their hands.

name: TapRPG - Homeland
short_description: TapRPG - Homeland is the first in the TapRPG series showcasing a unique style of RPG gaming. The classic top-down overworld map leading into 2D side-scrolling hack and slash. Your hero automatically runs across the levels, but defeating the enemies is no easy task.

name: Calm Cards - Klondike
short_description: Purchasing this game lets you play the age old solitaire/klondike game in a beautiful setting without stress. There are no scores or leader boards, just gorgeous cards to play with.

name: Scud Frenzy
short_description: Scud Frenzy, the Biggest Game Show in the Cosmos, brings you a fast paced eight-directional shooter about destruction, chaos, rewards and high-scores.

name: Necro Immortallis
short_description: Indie horror game about a cruel escape from the artificial death lurking in the forest during World War 2.

name: Fallback
short_description: Lead the rebellion in an epic rogue-like adventure. Guide your jet-pack equipped post-apocalyptic volunteers through a labyrinthine underground complex by jumping, dodging, and battling against robot minions (and masters) to get to the surface — and bring life back to the scorched Earth.

name: Radiant One
short_description: Radiant One is art. It makes you think about the meaning of human existence in today's rapidly changing world.

name: Chocolate makes you happy 6
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills and explosions.

name: Zombie Rampage
short_description: You are trapped in a graveyard overrun by zombies. Your only objective is to survive as long as possible.

name: Jade's Dungeon Descent
short_description: The exciting un-lockable dungeon crawler from Shuyan Saga™ is now available as a stand-alone game! If your steam library is clogged with un-played games, then this micro-game is for you. A brief experience with no grinding and no upgrading, just play!

name: Magic Realm: Online
short_description: Magic Realm: Online is a co-op multiplayer objective defense game developed exclusively for VR, featuring unique playable characters and beautiful maps. Play on your own or online with up to 4 people and defend the Source Crystal from power-hungry invaders of another world!

name: Rover Mechanic Simulator
short_description: As an Engineer - crew member of one of the first Mars colonies - you are responsible for repairing and maintaining Mars Rovers. In this advanced simulator you will learn the internal details of various Mars Rovers and their components.

name: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter
short_description: Become a real paleontologist, explore various environments and search for dinosaur fossils. Dig for and study the remnants of these majestic creatures to learn about their evolution. Build your own museum and experience an immersive background story.

name: Panther VR
short_description: Plan your heist, gear up with weapons and gadgets, and infiltrate in randomly Generated Missions. Go full stealth or guns blazing in Panther VR: an upcoming VR stealth game. Built by and for fans of the Stealth Genre. Everything can be stolen, the rest is up to you.

name: The World of Labyrinths: Labyronia
