name: Amaranthine Voyage: The Obsidian Book Collector's Edition
short_description: Enter the role of Eve Glover, one of the best CCPP's agents, sent to investigate the lack of radio communication from your scientific team on Iceland, researching harmonium radiation.

name: Danse Macabre: Thin Ice Collector's Edition
short_description: You stop a crazy fan, but when he dies, who’s responsible?

name: Mystery Case Files: Rewind Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you keep the past from destroying the present?

name: Generation Streets
short_description: Generation Streets - a game based on a real-world map. Load your hometown, find your home and this casual game will start giving you very unexpected impressions. In the free version of the game, only limited territories are available.

name: Tango: The Adventure Game
short_description: A point & click adventure based on the legendary life of the greatest Tango singer, Carlos Gardel. With a strong grasp on Argentinean culture, it guides the player through a very charming story full of rich details of an early twentieth century Buenos Aires.

name: Faiths End - 2D Survival Horror
short_description: When Matilda Stockwood's partner is abducted her only hope is to follow the trail back to her childhood home, but the once idyllic town of Raven's Point isn't exactly how she remembers.

name: Metal Fatigue
short_description: Metal Fatigue is a real-time strategy game taking the genre to new heights - literally. Build and customize your massive Combots to dominate the three battlefield levels simultaneously - from orbit, to the surface, and even underground!

name: Railroad Tracks
short_description: Railroad tracks is a 2D exploration based adventure game about a lonely circus artist who has fallen into amnesia. As you venture through his surreal twilight world, unsettling memories start to return.

name: TREE
short_description: TREE tells a story of a relationship between a boy and his tree. What starts off as a simple connection, over time it grows into something deeper.

name: Starport Delta
short_description: Build amongst the stars in Starport Delta, a light sci-fi strategy game that focuses on survival. Station Commanders across the universe will turn to you for guidance to expand, defend, and survive. Help them build a thriving station, but watch out, there are many dangers hiding in space...

name: Quatris
short_description: Simple rules, surprising results: challenge yourself with a novel twist on a classic.

name: Space Hamster in Turmoil
short_description: Space Hamster in Turmoil is a shoot 'em up featuring a customizable ship, optional & unorthodox mechanics, 7 interesting bosses, and a short story that takes place one year after the extinction of our species.

name: PSI Magic
short_description: PSI Magic is a classic RPG made for simple fun. Join in on an RPG experience in which enemies can even 'level up' along with you or enjoy exploration in a vast game world!

name: MatchyGotchy Z
short_description: MatchyGotchy Z is a colorful digital pet game that combines idle clicker elements with a new take on pet-raising simulation: trainable personalities. All the nostalgia of those old virtual pets, fully adapted into a new desktop gaming experience.

name: Ultimate War
short_description: This game is an FPS mode, where we will start with a single game mode and we will add many more updates with fun modes.

name: Suitchi
short_description: Suitchi is a two-player co-op platformer that is all about switching. Able to switch positions and teleport to each other, Blue and Orange go on an adventure of puzzle solving to find their lost friend.

name: ZOLO - Zombies Only Live Once
short_description: A Zombie, low poly cubic style, action adventure, PC VR game.Feel the brute strength with your fist punches! Experience the fire power with a large arsenal and exotic weapons! Launch your victims into thin air and score higher!

name: World of War : Battlegrounds
short_description: World of War : Battlegrounds is a low poly shooter multiplayer game. Make alliances to conquer the enemies easier or try to win the battle alone. You can try to stand in this war without any consequences. Be brave and wise to win the battle.

name: Abunka
short_description: ABUNKA is a strategic action-packed team arena brawler. Experience the unique combination of MOBA meets RTS and challenge your friends in a fast-paced battle for survival. Think smart & act fast for you are the one to decide who wins the battle for existence!

name: Ninja SpeedRush
short_description: Simple arcade game with intuitive gameplay.

name: Yaga
short_description: Play as Ivan, a one-handed blacksmith with incredibly bad luck, who must take on the impossible tasks given to him by the tzar. All the while the mysterious witch, Baba Yaga, watches over Ivan's fate.

name: Project 59
short_description: You joined a secret agency. Someone is ordering you to carry out covert operations. There are advanced equipment and weapons at your disposal. You have to eliminate mutant creatures as you go through your mission objectives. But you realize things are not as they seem. There is something wrong in the system.

name: Forest Rabbit
short_description: A fascinating arcade capable of cheering up players of any age!

name: Zombie Head
short_description: Zombie Head is a experimental project. In a casual game, everything should be colorful and cute? No! In Zombie Head, you will play the severed head of a dead man while listening heavy metal, overcoming meat grinders, saws and other bloody traps.

name: Oligopoly: Industrial Revolution
short_description: Oligopoly is a strategy game where you have to set up the production, distribution and trade of various goods. Exploit natural resources, build factories and infrastructures, produce goods and distribute them using trucks, trains or ships.

name: Pilgrimage
short_description: Bring devoutness to a faraway place, where is the place of the Buddha,No worries, no fear, no controversy, quiet, settling down and quietly feeling the beauty of pilgrimage.Life is a spiritual practice, born in nature, and gratitude.It's a spiritual journey ...It's pilgrimage ...

name: Another Sight - Definitive Edition
short_description: A teenager who has lost her sight and a mysterious cat team up in a surreal fantasy adventure into the unexpected, weaving a tale that brings together some of the world’s greatest minds: Monet, Tesla, Edison and other historical cultural icons.

name: Lovestory
short_description: Lovestory is a hurricane shoot 'em up 3D shooter with a large range of weapons and a huge number of enemies. Help the hero to blow a path, gaining the upper hand lot of corpses and tons of twisted metal to save his love.

name: Notified
short_description: The notifications are endless! Use Airplane Mode to clear all notifications when they become overwhelming. Use Battery Drain to stop your opponent's movement. Use Quick Charge to speed up your own movement. Quick reaction times and anticipation are the key to victory!

name: Guess who ?
short_description: Guess Who ? is a quiz game, you will see 5 image of animals, 1 target and 4 options. Just select the animal of the same species with the target animals

name: Pitch Perfect Ear Training
short_description: A quiz game that tests how pitch perfect your ears are! Review notes/pitches, intervals, chords and scales. You can also try to guess the key of a musical piece created using a proprietary custom music writing algorithm. Fresh music to keep your ears fresh!

name: FortOfTheNight
short_description: In FortOfTheNight your goal is to get kills for score. Find weapons from shotguns, assault rifles, and snipers. Use them to get more score and raise your kill counter.

name: Dragonfly Chronicles
short_description: Dragonfly Chronicles is a 2D Action-Adventure game full of challenge and fun for one single player.

name: Adapt
short_description: To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long.

name: Sabbat of the Witch
short_description: Hoshina Shuuji has a secret: He has a mysterious power that allows him to perceive the emotions of others. However, he is soon to find out that he is not the only one who has something he doesn't want others to find out about as Ayachi Nene, a classmate, likewise has a secret.

name: S.F.77
short_description: Use your space fighter (S.F.77) to destroy enemy spaceships and collect energy from them. Use that to upgrade you speed, weapons, or improve shields which will allow you to survive even harder attack waves.

name: Wetwork
short_description: Wetwork is a stealth action game. The protagonist is an assassin and their objective is to eliminate their target as silently and cleanly as possible. The game is set in 2030s and takes place in Latvia.

name: Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Colorful and bright Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles will strike your imagination in assorted piece counts, shapes and levels of difficulty. Dozens of Summer Jigsaw Puzzles to suit any puzzler. Whether you love puzzles with beaches, nostalgic scenes and family gatherings, great vacation destinations or hometown scenes.

name: ZYX STORY
short_description: Try to destroy the curse in this epic adventure and survive in this platform/puzzle game. Avoid death by enemies and lasers with your beautiful rifle.

name: Tano's Fate
short_description: An unknown arrival. A land disconnected from the world's society. Four heroes destined to change the past to save the future, and it's all thanks to the locked mind of one man. Jay-Cast Presents... Tano's Fate. A game built around unlocking the past to save your future.

name: MiniCar Race - 极品飞车2019 Mini
short_description: Little Cars, BIG Fun! Start your engines! The most vibrant, super racing game you’ve ever seen is here! Unlock all kinds of fun cars! Challenge multiple race tracks, multiple racing modes!

name: 雨上がりのハナビィ Ameagari no Hanaby
short_description: A 2D platforming adventure featuring fireworks

name: Open Space 2D
short_description: Welcome to Open Space, the RPG where you fly planet to planet fighting space pirates and building up your ship to fight the Pirate Mothership.

name: Deity Empires
short_description: Deity Empires is a 4X, turn-based strategy game with a powerful “just one more turn” feel! Enter an intricate fantasy world as one of many deities posed to become ruler of the world.

name: Pythagoras' Perpetual Motion Machine
short_description: Head to the top of the tower, guided by a mysterious voice... 40 stages that should leave you with a fulfilling sense of achievement. Play with your knowledge, cunning and sparks of brilliance as your only weapon. What do the messages mean? Who am I? What purpose does this tower serve...?

name: KnifeBoy Rebooted
short_description: KnifeBoy is a unique looking MetroidVania Adventure Game set in a semi-open world with a twisted story and tight gameplay. Defeat crazy Bosses, collect Power-Ups, SideQuests and Collect Comic Books to learn about KnifeBoys past

name: IgKnight Food Fight
short_description: Challenge your friends (up to 4 players) to a food fight in VR! From free-for-all to team battle multiplayer, IgKnight Food Fight comes with face haptic support, kids mode and 5 different festival decorations!

name: ULTIRE: Balls Out
short_description: Roll the ball, avoid obstacles, use powerups - all that on narrow platforms that require precise ball control - one mistake and you fall! Compete against other players in the Multiplayer Elimination Arena or challenge yourself by climbing the Global (and Friends-Only!) leaderboards in the Race mode.

name: Battle Royale Builder
short_description: Battle Royale Builder lets you practice Building, Editing, and Shooting with no limits and AI to practice against! No harvesting resources, no sitting in a queue, no severs, no fall damage, just Build, Edit, and Shoot, with or without AI!

name: Two Wars - Part 1
short_description: A band of survivors must cope with both an alien invasion, lack of resources and themselves

name: A Stickman Reality
short_description: A stickman reality is a short and fun VR experience where stickman invade and take over your world. We have been trying to make contact with the stickman world for a long time. The last 3 people we sent in haven’t returned. They seem simple life forms with advanced technology. This is all we know about them.

name: Loot Box Simulator
short_description: A satirical look at the current trajectory of the game industry. Open loot boxes, collect loot, equip cosmetics, face off against the dark lord, watch ads, take surveys, and slowly succumb to addiction.

name: Bonkies
short_description: Bonkies is a physics-based, couch co-op party game where you and up to 3 of your prime mates equip banana-fuelled jetpacks and robo-arms, and frantically try to raise wacky buildings all over the cosmos for the glory of apekind! Become the CHIMPion of space construction!

name: Marginalia
short_description: Marginalia is a first-person horror game that transports you to Kestlebrook, a secluded valley where history becomes enmeshed with a strange present. Weeks ago Eric left. Days ago you got a letter telling you to come to him. Now you're here, but precisely where is here? And better yet, when?

name: Echoes World
short_description: Adventurous maze style, puzzle game. Find your way out and help Echoes world!

name: The Plant
short_description: Интерактивная история про ученого-отшельника, с которым заговорил его подопытный цветок. Настраивая характеристики выбора ответа, результат приведет вас к одной из нескольких окончаний.

name: SCHOOLBOYS! AYUMI
short_description: Starts from summer, stroll with time

name: StickyBots
short_description: This frantic platform shooter is all about momentum, transformation and sticking to the ceiling. Test your metal with online competition and a complete single player campaign. Launch your fist and swap characters mid fight in this first of its kind platformer!

name: Centifeed
short_description: Collect orbs, upgrade, and crush your enemies in this indie-action game!

name: Another world: Truck driver
short_description: The main idea of the game is to immerse oneself in the life of a truck driver, to tear one’s truck apart and re-assemble it, making it one’s perfect truck. Each delivered cargo can become a real trial.

name: Virtual Virtual Reality
short_description: A game about VR, AI, and our collective sci-fi fever dreams. In a future where AI has transformed society, can humans still find purpose? Find out with Activitude, a service that lets humans aid AI clients in increasingly curious ways.

name: Punk A.F.
short_description: Punk A.F. is a gorgeous and brutal hand-drawn old-school vertical-scrolling 2D shooter game set in the alternate timeline of 197X. Join the Punk Air Force, a rebel team of extreme special-ops pilots violently uprising against corrupt politicians and their greedy corporate overlords.

name: SENRAN KAGURA Burst Re:Newal
short_description: Experience the original SENRAN KAGURA Burst, the beginning of the world's best-loved buxom battle series, like never before! Tackle the classic ninja brawler from a whole new perspective in gorgeous, fluid HD, with new features and mechanics throughout!

name: Empire
short_description: In a traditional fantasy RPG, play as several characters in a time of war as they fight for freedom while a greater darkness grows amidst the chaos.

name: Sharp
short_description: Boot up and navigate a fractured digital world to uncover valuable data hidden amongst dangerous traps and viruses.

name: The Caligula Effect: Overdose
short_description: Mobius. An idyllic world that lets people forget about the pain and problems of reality. Created by a sentient vocaloid program, μ (Mu), reality and fantasy have become blurred, allowing people to relive their high school years in bliss -- but just how real is a virtual happiness?

name: Bitter Tides
short_description: Set in a mysterious desert dream world, Bitter Tides is a first-person stealth and horror game. Your tools are lures and traps with which you avoid and ensnare those creeping things from the deep.

name: Her
short_description: This is a antique style game with TCG & LVG ,you need to carry out the character training of Katie (heroine) in 90 days and finish all the plots. There are 21 endings. There are 5 NPCs that can be interacted, including you(player).

name: Muv-Luv photonflowers*
short_description: It's the best of both worlds! Jam-packed with twelve tales that expand upon the Muv-Luv multiverse, this compilation is sure to satisfy that series sweet tooth!

name: Muv-Luv photonmelodies♮
short_description: Fall in Luv all over again! Familiar faces and worlds collide in three massive new adventures, including the long-awaited follow-up to Muv-Luv Alternative!

name: Crypto Crisis
short_description: Where were you during the rise of Bitcoin? Crypto Crisis is a simulation game which drops you into the beginnings of Bitcoin. Compete for and increase your share of block rewards by building and upgrading your mining rigs while carefully managing your resources.

name: Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars
short_description: Addictive text-based Mafia MMO RPG where you team up with other players to wage Gang Wars, Turf Wars, Boss Fights, Hire Mercs, Hit-List your enemies, buy weapons, vehicles and equipments, City-based Missions, TOURNAMENTS and much more..

name: The Oni Sellsword
short_description: A totally free, short-but-sweet RPG with an unlikely hero. Journey across worlds as Xavienne to save her best friend, the beautiful Princess La.

name: UnHolY DisAsTeR
short_description: The novice priestess who serves "the Spirit of Aqua”, Clementine fights against so-called demons with the spirit's blessings in this exploration based side-scrolling action game!

name: Incandescent 2
short_description: Incandescent 2 is a retro inspired fast paced twin stick shooter that will challenge you the longer you play. Pilot your ship and defeat the many waves of enemies in your way. Challenge your friends to beat your score in the Steam Leaderboards!

name: Save President From Rebels
short_description: 2d flying shooter. Be a hero, control airship. Destroy enemies and save the US president

name: Hell Pie
short_description: Hell Pie is an obscene 3D platformer that takes bad taste to the next level! Hell Pie sees you grab the horns of Nate, the ‘Demon of Bad Taste’. He is given the honorable task of gathering the disgusting ingredients for Satan’s infamous birthday pie!

name: My Farm
short_description: You start with just a hen, an empty field and a few pennies. You have to feed your hen, take care of it and improve its living conditions!

name: RGBCELLS
short_description: Red + Green = Yellow, Red + Blue = Violet, Green + Blue = Cyan. Try to find out all cells' color

name: Hexile
short_description: Hexile is a first-person, narrative puzzle platformer game tin which players confront the consequences of manipulating their environments.. It takes place in a beautiful, surreal landscape where the player progresses by manipulating the environment to solve puzzles.

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
short_description: As Lara Croft races to save the world from a Maya apocalypse, she must become the Tomb Raider she is destined to be.

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
short_description: As Lara Croft races to save the world from a Maya apocalypse, she must become the Tomb Raider she is destined to be.

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
short_description: As Lara Croft races to save the world from a Maya apocalypse, she must become the Tomb Raider she is destined to be.

name: 秋色的記憶(體驗版) / Fall...in Love (Demo)
short_description: "Fall...in Love" is the first love simulation game in Cantonese voice over under the brand Blue Tea College. Characters are based on real-life persons instead of entirely fictional. This is Demo version (chapter0-1). Please help to fill the survey after the demo for the full game making.

name: Pawn of the Dead
short_description: Chess variation with unique twist: Black turns White into undead like themselves

name: Ecchi Cards
short_description: This game is a casual Cards game where you battle your cards against opponent's deck.

name: Destruction  Paper
short_description: 8 levels of run and gun action

name: Kids Learn
short_description: Kids Learn is amazing useful educational game for everyone. Get ready for educational tour.

name: Math Fun
short_description: Math Fun is amazing fun loving app for everyone. This app will let you learn math in an fun and easy manner while playing.

name: Myha: Return to the Lost Island
short_description: MYHA is a First Person Adventure game (Myst-like), part of a sci-fi series named The Black Cube (ASA: A Space Adventure...). Visit Myha, a moon in a far away solar system, and try to understand why you were teleported there.

name: Drop Up
short_description: A difficult puzzle game, where a circle, follows a line you draw, to the end of the level.

name: Majin Woman
short_description: Control a giant girl and protect the earth from invasion in this circular style side-scrolling shooter. In the name of world peace, you can use melee combat to pave a path through your foes (then devour them!) or obliterate the legions with a giant holy machine gun!

name: SWORDS of GARGANTUA
short_description: Experience Swords of Gargantua, a VR sword-action game in single-player mode or online co-op with up to 3 other players! Adventure through the Tesseract Abyss floors to beat the giant, Gargantua lying in wait on the deepest layer, Floor 101.

name: On Board Remastered
short_description: Stein bock games is always improving it's products in order to give a good gaming experience to our customer . We are always listening to our customers to find out what are their needs and wants in their game. We value their opinion since to us it is one of the most important ingredient one can use in order to make a video game.

name: Leaflet Love Story
short_description: A normal male engineering student who used to be successful, is now languishing at the bottom in his English classes. A pretty girl who is said to be unapproachable, and is very proud of herself. How will the romance between the two of them develop?

name: DollKart
short_description: Drive your ragdoll through an infinite number of difficult tracks, against time in single player, your friends in split screen and randoms online.

name: Deadside
short_description: An Open World Survival Shooter blending hardcore PVP and PVE action. Secure precious loot in safe zones or build your own fortress in the wild. With intense gunfights, stunning visuals, and performance smooth enough for any system, the challenge awaits!

name: Path of Sin: Greed
short_description: It was supposed to be a simple suicide case – a quick inspection and lots of boring paperwork. But the more you delve into this secluded island and the twisted family relations of the owners, the more complicated and unclear this case becomes.

name: From The Sky: New Horizon
short_description: From The Sky tells the adventures of two sisters Yuki and Karma, who travel through time and space through the portal. From the Jurassic world to world wars, from ocean to space. But nothing is safe, for each world there are different dangerous obstacles, let's help them overcome obstacles safely.

name: EW/WE
short_description: EWWE – is just a dream. A bad dream in which you find yourself in captivity in your own room. A bad dream, which seems more like a reality sometimes.

name: Fates of Ort
short_description: Fates of Ort is a retro fantasy RPG focused on strategic action, in a land where time is frozen when you stand still. Cast powerful spells - but beware, they will cost you your life.

name: Blow Up Pieces: Unleashed
short_description: Blow Up Pieces is a single player and multiplayer game that you can play locally. Come on this adventure and help Mike save his world by destroying the falling blocks!

name: Blinding Blade
short_description: Blinding Blade is a multiplayer indie game with that allows players to use precision and finesse to defeat opponents ● Engage in skillful swordplay ● Take manual control of your blade to execute precision attacks and block blaster shots ● Multiplayer focused

name: Total 15
short_description: Challenge your problem-solving skills in this game.

name: Yoga Lesson VR
short_description: Become a Yoga Master of an adorable girl. Become her Yoga Master to instruct yoga poses from various angles and give the right advice. You can be hard on her at times, or cheer her up with presents. Instruct her so that she can get good grades in yoga competitions and pretty yoga clothes. She will thank you in her own way.

name: Mojo
short_description: "Mojo” is a new version of the famous game “2048”, an original approach to this well-known puzzle. Several beautiful girls will keep you company during the game. The more points you get, the less clothes remain on the girls.

name: Where's Baby
short_description: Where’s Baby is an asymmetrical multiplayer game pitting a baby sitter against WHAT IS THAT. WHY IS THAT KID SO FURRY! IS THAT A WEREWOLF? SHOULDN’T THEIR PARENTS HAVE MENTIONED THIS? HE BROKE THE TABLE! HE JUST TOUCHED IT AND IT EXPLODED!

name: Spellcaster University
short_description: Develop a prestigious university of mages. Build rooms, train your students, fight orcs, slay the bureaucrats, manage your budget... a director's life is not a quiet one.

name: Save The Cookie
short_description: Save the cookie from the terrible maw of Chester, the hungry pug. He will do everything necessary to steal your cookie! Who will be faster? Your reflexes or your gluttony and tricks?

name: Armajet
short_description: Unique 2.5D multiplayer jetpack combat that unites players around the world in competition. Cross-platform so you can access your progress and play on the go with your mobile device of choice. Updated frequently with new content and features, with good developer responsiveness!

name: ELECTRONIC STOCK TRADING SYSTEM
short_description: This Stock Trading Simulator is the most comprehensive trading system created. This game is so uncomplicated that anyone can play this simulation. The game is highly recommended for the novice trader and more seasoned traders. Buy and sell over 65 different stocks in 10 different sectors.

name: GunFu Heroes
short_description: GunFu Heroes is a quick-paced, 2-4 local multiplayer party game where your goal is to be the last one standing. A variety of weapons introduce different styles of play while various fighters and maps keep the game feeling fresh.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Fluffykins
short_description: Join Mr.Fluffykins on his epic adventure to find all of King Barts lost recipes. Explore Caves, Jungles, Frozen Tundras as well as the Wild West. Throw pumpkins, solve puzzles, shoot cannons, and join our royal kitty on an epic adventure.

name: Ollie-Oop
short_description: A game about a skateboarding dog named Ollie, who goes on the adventure of his dreams! Play with your pup friends and wreak havoc in all kinds of fantastical environments.

name: Kokorogawari
short_description: Kokorogawari (Change of Heart) is a GxB otome human drama visual novel set in a grounded and authentic portrayal of modern-day Japan. While the two main themes are about love and the arts, Kokorogawari also explores the complexity and depth of familial relationships and emotions.

name: URO
short_description: There was a world where URO alone lives. However, the color and sound disappeared from the world from one day. When wearing a glowing ornament, URO is wrapped in color and music I notice that music and colors are gone from the world. To regain music and color to the world again, I started running running my music.

name: WitchAction
short_description: One day, Corona tried to invite Noah for a date, and when I went to Noah's house ... Noah was turned into a sheep! Beside that there was a figure of a mischievous witch, Grette. The place I chased after was "world of sweets" produced by Grette.

name: Project Wingman
short_description: Project Wingman is a flight action game that lets you take the seat of advanced fighter jets and become a true ace. Fight in various missions and gamemodes ranging from intense aerial dogfights to large scale ground assault in an alternate scorched earth setting.

name: GrabBag
short_description: Test your reflexes and hand-eye coordination in this fast-paced VR game! Catch items flying past you as you speed down different immersive environments. Trigger multipliers with consistent streaks for the best score. Glory goes to those who grab the most!

name: The Chaotic Workshop
short_description: Ever wanted to know what would happen if you hooked up a fire extinguisher to a crate of TNT inside a room full of pinball bouncers and proximity mines. Well now you can. Welcome to The Chaotic Workshop

name: Maze Quest 1: The Forest
short_description: Maze Quest 1: The Forest is a simple relaxing puzzle game. Play as Sylvie the Elf and find your way home through 100 forest-themed maze levels.

name: Atlantic Edge
short_description: Atlantic Edge is a strategic VR brawler for HTC VIVE in which you play a mech pilot tasked with defending a city from an endless onslaught of kaiju. Will you save the city? Or cause as much damage as the kaiju?

name: Save Them
short_description: A Minimalist horror-themed Platformer. Guide your way through increasingly twisted landscapes as the mysterious narrative unfolds. Not everything is as it seems - your journey to Save Them begins here.

name: 《古斯塔奥：帝國重生》Gustavo Kingdom Rebirth
short_description: The story is mainly about the Gustavo empire. It is an empire ruled by women. After the death of the queen of the previous generation, Princess Nali, who should have succeeded to the throne, was arrested by her sister and exiled to the border of the Gustavo Empire. The player will play the heroine Nali.

name: 水时钟-Water_Clock
short_description: 沉迷篮球游戏的大学生和破旧水杯里冒出来的小精灵——泠——的夏日奇遇。 笨拙二人组编织出燃与萌的清新治愈AVG小短剧。

name: Clockwork Ambrosia
short_description: Clockwork Ambrosia is a steampunk fusion of metroidvania and weapon-building 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapon modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

name: Fortissimo FA INTL Ver
short_description: This is the whole package! Its got everything you're looking for. Combined perfectly with music, you'll be drawn in to the depth of 'Moe' and dragged right out to a hot-blooded battle. This is a galgame made with the tears and blood of the one and only La'cryma and proudly presented by SakuraGame.

name: The Impure
short_description: They looks same, just like they see us. The coastal city was teared down by earthquake and tidal wave caused by it. A group of black square creatures, was rescuing their brothers and sisters in the ruins day and night with all their efforts, even with their lives.

name: Crime Stories : Days of Vengeance
short_description: When John joined the police department, his future looked bright. He had a loving family, a promising career, and a moral code that prevented him from compromising with criminals. But while John's conscience kept him on an honest path, it also made him powerful enemies.

name: Evil Bank Manager
short_description: What could be better than having a million dollars, a billion? This will not make you all powerful in the world, your goal will not only be to make lots of money, but to print money and become a Federal reserve system

name: My Fox Sister|我的妖狐妹妹
short_description: The high school student's leading role was called by a mysterious woman. Actually, she was forced to adopt a fox. What's wrong with this world? Mysterious woman, you let go of the hero and rush to me.

name: Nazi 2
short_description: Gameplay: In Nazi2 your goal is to get kills for score. Find weapons, use them to get more score and raise your kill counter. As you get more kills, the town level will go up.. As the town level get's higher, more enemies will spawn and be harder to kill.

name: Dangerous Skies 80's edition
short_description: Enter the world of Dangerous skies, a shoot em up inspired by the mythical space invaders, you will face ten fantastic levels in full 80s style.

The weak chicken Xiaobai, who is on the verge of death, constantly recruits teams, takes risks, collects materials, builds equipment, fights the dragon to save the princess, and eventually grows into a real warrior! Can also help you measure a wave of character...

name: 魔物讨伐团

name: Fugue State
short_description: Explore a haunted dreamscape, inspired by the likes of Yume Nikki, Strawberry cubes, and other avant garde "walking simulators." Something dark lies behind The Wanderer's dreams, locked in Fugue State. 11 items hold the clues, but must first be found. You have eternity. Good luck.

name: Hungry Shadows
short_description: In this grim game you have to confront the hordes of zombies, while on a small plot of land. Zombies are constantly attacking our hero.

name: SpaceExile
short_description: This is a Twin Stick Shooter style game that requires the utmost survival against the relentless enemy. You can earn points by playing the game and use the points you earn to purchase six main weapons, six special weapons, and six types of upgrades. Leverage a wide range of unique weapons and upgrades to score even higher!

name: DrillMania
short_description: Become a real drilling master with DrillMania! Rush into the underground world filled with different rocks, hidden secrets, and dangerous gizmos. Dig as deep as it even possible, unlock new cool drills, upgrade their characteristics and maybe soon you’ll find the real diamonds!

name: Inn: the Countryside
short_description: Become a real cooking chef in a cozy countryside tavern – play Inn: the Countryside! Go into the simple but amazingly delicious recipes of the province dishes; please tourists with your mastery and sweet-heart atmosphere. Improve your cooking skills and open your own prospering inn’s net!

name: Caves of Plague
short_description: Strange and awful time has come when the plague swallowed the mankind. Horrific creatures left their graves, and evil spirits shrouded in the cities and countryside… Become a real guardian of retribution – a plague doctor! Explore the world of Caves of Plague!

name: MONOWARS: Red Zone
short_description: Warp into battle against massive monochrome networks controlled by the CrimsonSync AI group. Upgrade your tank and your army as the enemy adapts against your one conquestive mission; eliminating all of them.

name: Skyland Defense
short_description: Defend your skyland! Grab a tower and fight off the pirates. Build traps to slow down their march. Construct utility buildings and expand your village. Play alone or join your friends in this in-depth strategy and tower defense game!

name: Steel Crew
short_description: Join a Tank as a Driver, Gunner or Commander and team up with and against other Tanks in Tank Vs Tank combat where tactics and communication is key

name: Midnight Pulse
short_description: In this stylish rhythm platformer you will traverse an obstacle ridden terrain while listening to a wide variety of music. Equipped with a fully functional level editor create levels with your own music and share them with your friends!

name: TAL: Arctic 2
short_description: TAL: Arctic 2 - In this game you need help an unknown creature to go in the magic portal across many mazes.

name: NOCE
short_description: A nostalgia inducing authentic action game drawn in pixel art style. Use an energy sword, agile body and "cloud weapons" to carve your way through 5 vastly different planets. Epic boss battles with diverse attack behavior await you on every stage!

name: Hentai Case Opening

name: Observation
short_description: Observation is a sci-fi thriller uncovering what happened to Dr. Emma Fisher, and the crew of her mission, through the lens of the station’s artificial intelligence S.A.M.

name: Minotaur Arcade Volume 1
short_description: Minotaur Arcade brings you arcade-style games with a modern twist, playable in 2D or in VR for that 80s Tron "inside an arcade game" feeling. Vol. 1 consists of two Llamasoft classics - "Gridrunner" as the arcade game that might have been, and "GoatUp" as a light-hearted platformer that will have you baaing...

name: POLYBIUS
short_description: POLYBIUS is a fast, trippy tunnel shooter playable on a normal screen or in VR. 50 levels of blissful trance shooting action are set to a blistering soundtrack. The PS4 version was EDGE Magazine's VR GOTY in 2017, and the PC version of the game was even used as the basis for a NIN music video.

name: Repeat the image: Animals
short_description: It is a game for very young children. The essence of the game is that the game provides the main image with a certain animal, and the player below on the screen will be randomly offered four options of animals, but the player must choose an animal, very similar to the main image!

name: Metal Brigade Tactics
short_description: Metal Brigade Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game with deep RPG elements. Control your squad of Vertical Armor giant robots on a mission to stop a small country from embroiling the world in a devastating war.

name: Kamikaze Cube 2
short_description: Kamikaze Сube is back! Our heroic cube got into trouble again! A deadly dungeon is waiting for you to avoid its traps, enemies and leave the dangerous place once and for all.

name: Encore Card Games Collection
short_description: A great card game collection, with all the games you know and love. Card Games Collection features over 70 games and so much more!

name: Encore Casino Games Collection
short_description: The fun never stops when you choose from over 20 casino games! Pull up a chair and deal yourself into Casino Games Collection!

name: Combat Rush
short_description: This "snake", but instead of the snake you have mercenaries with weapons in their hands! Gather your own squad of professional mercenaries and defeat enemies who threaten the world with their weapons!

name: Under One Wing
short_description: Fairy Fight - A large-scale dogfight, utilizing the finest warplanes the world has ever known. Sasaki Junichi is the grandson of a legendary FF Pilot. He arrives at the student dormitory of a legendary FF academy known as Shouou Academy, only to find... every other tenant is a woman!!

name: Rapid Racing
short_description: Rapid Racing is a top-down 2D arcade style racing game - try to beat your best times on the many included levels in singleplayer, or race against friends in multiplayer.

name: LUXO Buddies
short_description: One of the most Classic games which we all know and love! LUXO Buddies makes its return with an assortment of exciting new features. Match cards either by matching color or value and play action cards to change things up. Race against other players to empty your hand before everyone else.

name: Starkid's Obstacle Course
short_description: STARKID’S OBSTACLE COURSE is a skill-based game that has you problem solving the whole way through. There is no shooting, there are no explosions, and the rules are very simple. Find your own path through each level without getting hit.

name: Return.
short_description: Take the lost soul to its home.

name: Gunkid 99

Craft your own unique play-style and develop crazy combos​ with numerous weapons and abilities at your disposal! Lay waste to endless hordes of enemies and get that top score on the Global Leaderboards!

name: Zombie Flick | 僵尸快打
short_description: It's a well-designed side-by-side action adventure game that allows you to control a single character, deftly destroying traps and heroically killing hordes of zombies along the way by executing gorgeous commotion, using a variety of weapons, and unleashing powerful skills.

short_description: VIDEO GAME is a local-multiplayer action arcade game. Curve the ball past your opponents and dash to save a goal at the last second!

name: Zenith Hunter
short_description: Climb to the top of the Zenith in this fast-paced action platformer!

name: Kontrakt
short_description: Kontrakt is a hyper-violent action-adventure game about schizophrenia with a dark and twisted story. You will assume the role of a hitman involved in mysterious contract killing, while uncovering the dirty truth and secrets behind the City of Light.

name: WoodZone
short_description: WoodZone is a unique opportunity to become an entrepreneurial lumberjack. Imagine that you have a company that grows in front of your eyes or you go up the ladder in another corporation to eventually become the boss in it.

name: Ozapell Mystery Text Adventure
short_description: A retro early 1980s text adventure experience involving a murder mystery that is generated differently each time the game is played.

name: Here to There
short_description: A singleplayer puzzle FPS. The player attempts to solve each area, making progress towards the end.

name: Squid Vs Vexus
short_description: As the Sun starts to transform into a red giant, every planet, except Pluto, is joining forces to save the Solar System from certain demise. The Plutonians, feeling left behind and undermined, decide to send Squid, their strongest warrior, to finish off the 8 Emperors of the Solar System, that form Vexus.

name: Vinylove
short_description: Vinylove's a short adventure experience about the connection between music and memories. Relax and play your own records while helping Alex cope with his own lifetime memories. Will you pick the right songs?

name: 街头英雄 Street Heroes
short_description: 精心打造的一款休闲卡牌类写实风硬派3D格斗游戏。收集卡组、摸索搭配、无限连招、绝杀大技、全屏华丽特效，带给你前所未有的畅快游戏体验！

name: Sunny Shine Funland!
short_description: Sunny Shine Funland is an adult visual novel that follows Dustin, a young man who's moved to a new city and is hired as an employee at an amusement park! He soon encounters three lovely coworkers who blow him away! Can he seize love this summer while maintaining his crazy new job? You decide!

name: One Last Try
short_description: Build. Fight. Survive. Play with friends or by yourself in this platform co-op game for up to 4 players. Use a Minigun, a Flamethrower, or a Jetpack. Upgrade weapons. Place your defenses. Survive longer than you did last time.

name: Hifuu Nightmare Diary ~ Violet Detector.
short_description: 東方Project第16.5弾！ 超能力女子高生「宇佐見菫子」に、突如襲いかかる幻想郷の住人達。その恐ろしくも美しい弾幕を、スマホに撮りまくり、SNS映えを狙おう！ サイキカルでSNS映え狙いのシューティング幻想！

name: Beyond Senses
short_description: Beyond Senses is an innovative Multiplayer and Singleplayer Horror Game. Thanks to a variety of different features, Beyond Senses guarantees a varied and adrenaline-charged gameplay - both alone and with friends!

name: Harold Halibut
short_description: Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world in his quest to find the true meaning of ‘home’.

name: Colory Engine
short_description: Colory Engine is the core app for all Colory applications.Colory VR Painter: A virtual reality painting and vfx app.Colory STUDIO: A desktop app for live video virtual production. (currently in beta).Colory Modkit: A free modkit to publish you own content.

name: How to Sing to Open Your Heart
short_description: "How to Sing to Open Your Heart" is a fully voiced romantic otome visual novel. Can the cat-eared princess' song rescue her people and find true love?

name: Island Maze
short_description: If you’re a cube, simple island will become a puzzling maze! You’ll need your shrewdness to get out of island. You surely have some, but if you doubt it – it’s time to reveal your potential!

name: TITANIC Shipwreck Exploration
short_description: Titanic Shipwreck Exploration is a diving simulator and immersive interactive story. With over 6 hours of game-play it you will leave with a greater understanding of the historic tragedy that unfolded in 1912 leading to the sinking of the worlds most famous ship.

name: WARP-TEK
short_description: WARP-TEK is a horizontal space shooter wherein you have to rescue your pet after it got abducted by aliens and consequently imprisoned on a distant planet!

name: One Gun: Cat
short_description: Protect the world of One Gun from evil invaders!

name: Guard of Wonderland
short_description: Guard of Wonderland is a visual novel created from our inspirations of "Alice in Wonderland"; a tribute of respect and love for the author's talent. Here is the atmosphere of absurdity and, at the same time, the beauty of the world in the book, but with new characters and an unconventional look at the story of Wonderland.

name: You Are Here
short_description: Have you ever wondered about your place in the cosmos? Well, now with the magic of virtual reality, you can see exactly where you are! Shrink and expand the universe to see where you fit into the big picture. Stroll through a sea of hundreds of thousands of stars and galaxies.

name: Chessboard Kingdoms
short_description: Chessboard Kingdoms is a multiplayer, turn-based strategy game inspired by the chess mechanics. Employ warriors and engineers, build siege machines, construct walls and towers, consult your court wizard — all while exploring vast landscapes of the realm and satisfying your puzzle-solving appetite.

name: Music Killer
short_description: 🎶 THE VERY FIRST MUSIC ADAPTING FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER IS HERE! 🎵 Always wanted to shoot mobs while listening to your own favorite music tracks? Now you can.

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall™: Escape the Gloomer
short_description: Lost Legends of Redwall: Escape the Gloomer is based on Mossflower, one of the NYT bestselling Redwall™ books by Brian Jacques, with over 35 million copies sold. Set in the caverns and catacombs of Kotir Castle, you guide Gillig the fledgling otter as you build your story.

name: Code Brown: A Game About Pooping
short_description: Warning! Code Brown! Somebody wants to crap but the only one toilet room is closed! Wait, what is it?.. Fine, that pan with a fresh soup will be acceptable.

name: Parkour Polygon
short_description: Dodge hazards, climb walls, and kick off of signs in your rush to the flag! Parkour Polygon delivers a 2D parkour experience with a striking minimalist style.

name: Arcane Trials
short_description: Arcane Trials is a VR fantasy spell casting dungeon adventure. Only the most skillful and competent wizards will conquer the final trials. Dodge, fireball, punch, light and blast your way through the increasingly challenging depths. Will you have what it takes become a Master of the Arcane?

name: Main Character Simulator
short_description: Stop sucking, gain protag powers, save the world and experience an alien invasion, young love, and so many exams, in this hilarious comedic visual novel.

name: Getaway Grand Prix
short_description: Swipe gems and escape the law as a Getaway driver in a thrill ride of HIGH-SPEED MOTOR HEIST MADNESS!

name: Blood Card
short_description: This card game combines elements of roguelike and deckbuilding. During the game, you shall strive ahead, gathering cards to build a unique deck and use it to defeat the enemies getting in your way. You will have to choose between escaping or try to defeat Death, who is relentlessly pursuing you.

name: 东方百问~TouHouAsked
short_description: Null

name: Tale of the Fragmented Star: Single Fragment Version / 星の欠片の物語、ひとかけら版
short_description: Help a stranded girl escape with just your eyes in this puzzle game designed specifically for VR. From the stationary convergence point between the two worlds, use the "Focus Lock" to tell her the steps she has to take in order to put the star back together.

name: The Party of Demons
short_description: The Party of Demons is a high pace, competitive bullet hell game. It contains well-designed bullets and awesome background music. You can even compete against your friend in this game.

name: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER
short_description: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players, following a structured campaign with randomized elements. Abducted by a sinister kidnapper, you now must escape his deranged facility, survive twisted abominations, solve puzzles, and reach one of several endings.

name: STEINS;GATE: Linear Bounded Phenogram
short_description: A story for every lab member. Discover a new side of each STEINS;GATE character and get a glimpse of their inner thoughts through 10 new stories.

name: Angry Ball VR
short_description: Angry Ball VR is a Puzzle-Shooting experience optimized for VR with realistic controls, smooth graphics, and beautiful coloration. Experience it now and immerse yourself into a world of cuteness overload.

name: URUZ "Return of The Er Kishi"
short_description: Live the saga of Uruz! A fantasy epic action adventure based on Central Asian Turkish mythology and culture. Explore the ruined lands, help people, solve small puzzles, face the monsters and spiritual creatures, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

name: BreakHack
short_description: BreakHack is a casual roguelike intended to provide entertainment for 10-30 minutes when you are taking a break from anything else in your life.

name: Tormentum II
short_description: Tormentum II is a Point & Click adventure game taking place in a dark, surreal world full of gloomy characters and repulsive creatures taken straight from the scariest horrors. A long-awaited continuation of the dark adventure game inspired by the works of H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksinski.

name: Slither Link
short_description: SlitherLink is a kind of mathematical intelligence game, which consists of a checkerboard and a number in the checkerboard. When solving the problem, you must use the clues provided by the numbers to connect an uninterrupted closed loop on the checkerboard line.

name: Pixel Maze
short_description: The game fills the color with a digital cue, all the numbers are interlocked, and each step must be patiently calculated to finally break the maze. If you like puzzle games, want to challenge difficult, and have a lot of time, come play!

name: Epic Game Theory
short_description: Prevent two kingdoms on the brink of war before all are annihilated, multiple ways to win, can you find them all?

name: Rento Fortune VR
short_description: Rento Fortune is online VR multiplayer business board game. Between 2 and 6 players can play together.Trade lands, build houses, win auctions, roll wheel of fortune, risk in Russian Roulette and have fun.Play with your friends on Steam now :)

name: Rebound VR
short_description: Rebound VR is a fun and absorbing mix of racquetball and breakout-style gameplay. 42 levels give hours of gameplay. Great stressbuster! Suitable for all ages.

name: Tabletop Basketball VR
short_description: Tabletop Basketball VR brings a basketball experience that you're use to from the TV down on to a virtual table. It's like having little toy basketball players come to life. This is a semi-simulation style basketball game. We designed our own smart AI technology around your game play.

name: Beat
short_description: Basically, the purpose of this game is to pass a level, and listen to the music. Pass a level, and try a harder one. Just use your mouse to choose, and use your spacebar to play, EASY!!! Everyone can play the music. Now, there are 11 different songs in the game, and there will be more. You can also upload your own song in the game.

name: Pixel Royale
short_description: Pixel Royale is a battle royale shooter that pits 100 players against each other in a struggle for survival. Gather supplies and outwit your opponents to become the last person standing.

name: Multibombers
short_description: Based off the hit game Bomberman initially developed in 1983, Multibombers takes the concept to an all-new perspective featuring a unique first-person mode with the inclusion of multiplayer for you and three other buddies to have a night of fun.

name: MicroTown
short_description: Build and manage your own settlement! A relaxing village construction and management simulator.

name: Iron Marines
short_description: Real-time strategy battles in amazing sci-fi worlds! Command brave soldiers, mighty mechas and powerful aliens to face the greatest challenges in hostile alien worlds. The galaxy needs you!

name: Airplane Mode
short_description: Airplane Mode delivers all the thrills of a real-time, six-hour commercial airline flight—in Coach. At least you've got a window seat. Buckle up.

name: Land of Puzzles: Battles
short_description: In Land of Puzzles: Battles the king and queen need your help. To avoid war the king has accepted a challenge of puzzles to solve. He needs you to solve 15 sets of challenging puzzles and help him secure the kingdom.

name: Land of an Endless Journey
short_description: You find yourself in a mysterious land filled with puzzles that will challenge you, embark on a journey into the unknown and uncover the secrets of the land.

name: Solar Purge
short_description: Blow away everything in your path in this 4 player co-op, sci-fi, twin-stick looter shooter action RPG. Upgrade your character with powerful skills and find devastating weapons to fight hordes of enemies in the Nova Genesis solar system!

name: 夏荷 | Summer Lotus
short_description: Summer Lotus, a derivative play of campus love With the arrival of summer vacation, the male protagonist applied for a summer job, and naturally met our beautiful girls by the sea. Then an interesting love story happened.

name: Lab Runner: X
short_description: A short but fun Pixel Based Hardcore Platformer where you run around and escape your lab.

name: Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded-
short_description: Based on the "Touhou Project" world, Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded- is an addictive roguelike RPG that's easy for beginners to pickup and play, but with tons of advanced options for pros! Explore dungeons with your Touhou favorites characters, collect loot, and battle over the Golden Spheres!

name: RevelationTrestan-尸忆岛
short_description: In 2033, a miniature meteorite from outer space crashed in a part of the south Atlantic ocean, when a country near the crash site led the fishing effort and secretly transported it to the isolated island institute near the crash site to study the virus, an event that attracted the attention of many large groups around the world.

name: Seven Days
short_description: A couple of days before the summer holiday starts... Kanzaki Shuuichi receives a "cursed Blu-ray disc" from one of his friends and is possessed by a female ghost which, when exorcised, leaves behind the physical form of the female specter.

name: The Twiggles VR
short_description: A 3D puzzle game designed specifically for VR. Immerse yourself in the unique world of the Twiggles and enjoy hours of mind-blowing, brain-twisting, puzzle-solving fun. Get creative and design your own puzzles with the built-in VR editor and earn points for twisting the brains of your friends.

name: Crystal War
short_description: In 2517, the earth's resources were exhausted, and humans actively went to other planets to find alternative energy sources. The advance expedition team finally found a rich LALU crystal deposit on the planet Marcus.

name: Arcane Legacy
short_description: Arcane Legacy: Turn-Based Fantasy Tactical Game This is Lodmor, the land of the Fathers, the Empire's Core. To help maintaining the peace, the emperor has established the Judgement of the arcanium, where Champions selected by the Great Houses – the Archmages – battle against each other.

name: Kai Entity
short_description: Kai Entity is an adventure that wants to immerse you in epic fighting bullet hell and fantastic sci-fi ambient

name: Braveland Heroes
short_description: The famous Braveland series returns! Destroy your enemies in online duels and uncover the secret of the king's scepter in this new turn-based strategy game.

name: Super Hyperspace Avenger
short_description: Super Hyperspace Avenger is an endless scroller-shooter inspired by classic arcade games with tons of bullets and enemies.

name: Himno
short_description: Himno is a peaceful, 2D platformer game with an infinite number of beautiful procedurally generated maps. Take a breath, and relax.

name: Shooting Hurts
short_description: A brand new AI, a weapon that turns its health into projectiles, and a gauntlet of tests designed to test their limits. How will you make every shot count when shooting hurts?

name: Ballz Royale
short_description: A game about balls... and walls. Played against 98 other players.

name: To Catch a Monkey
short_description: The test monkeys have escaped the lab! You must catch the furry fiends before the professor finds out. Chase them into traps with the tools you have at your disposal -- massive explosions and fiery death.

name: Attack on I-Ching  进击的易经
short_description: A master needs you to help him practice the I Ching. As a goblin, have you conquered the master in the midst of all kinds of difficulties created by the master? It's a roguelike educational game designed to keep you engaged. Through the game, you will learn the I Ching like never before.

name: Space Pirate Amai
short_description: Old school 2d shooter with crazy music by the indie band 8bit Phantom Galactic! -Challenging retro space shooter -Fight your way through various stages and enemies. -Intense Boss fight! -Master the use of your shield to survive. -Use powerups to upgrade your ship's weapons!

name: morphe
short_description: Morphê is an ambient, music-making game set on peaceful, beautiful mountaintops.

name: Bunny Count
short_description: Capture The Flag , Team Deathmatch and Kill Confirmed are included as online and offline game modes! Its the Bunnies VS The Bears !

name: Sydney Hunter and the Curse of the Mayan
short_description: In this pixel-perfect homage to the classic action platformers, you play as Sydney Hunter - an explorer who gets trapped inside a Mayan pyramid while he's out exploring!

name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 朧十夜
short_description: ■優しくも切ない物語をグラフィックとムービーで演出！　天地明宵、四つの幻獣に護られたイタル国を舞台とした「怪獣綺譚」シリーズ。

name: Tekling 2
short_description: Become the Bot! Battle through 40 levels of classic platforming action. Gather the energy orbs to transform into the amazing mighty Tekling and escape the robots that have come to take you down.

name: The Haunted Graveyard
short_description: A spooky fun VR adventure for all ages.

name: Junkyard Wizard
short_description: You find yourself stuck in a sinkhole in the middle of some backwoods junkyard and things are far from normal. Everything in this hole has telekinetic abilities. Including you. Use your new found powers to defend yourself and fight back against wave after wave of toasters, vacuums, televisions, and more.

name: Labyrinth: The War on Terror
short_description: Face the global war on terror in this engaging 2 player strategy game. Set against recent world events, Labyrinth portrays the U.S. efforts to counter extremists’ use of terrorist tactics, as well as the wider ideological struggle – guerrilla warfare, fundamentalist rule, regime change and more.

name: 希望之星
short_description: 本游戏目前的游戏内容开发完成度很低，本人正在持续开发更新中，如果您期望购买后立即体验到完整的游戏体验，那么您不应该在此时购入。这是一款独立制作的横版动作角色扮演类单机游戏，玩家通过控制主角及其同伴在架空的异世界大陆中进行冒险。

name: 七夜怪谈 - 都市校园禁锢传说
short_description: Wanderer in the dark corridor,woman crying at midnight,blood words sudden appeared on the mirror,strange patterns draw on the note,the music from an empty classroom,tightly shuted door of the archive room...

name: Triwave
short_description: Triwave is a chill and challenging arcade puzzle game, featuring deep and unique gameplay, hypnotic visuals, and mesmerizing beats. Currently early in development.

name: TAL: Arctic 3
short_description: TAL: Arctic 3 - In this game you need help an unknown creature to go in the magic portal across many mazes.

name: WWTF
short_description: WWTF is a shoot them up boss rush inspired by the old classic Yars Revenge. Play as Pawda and escape the terrible cybernetic ex-soldiers animals of the zoo by flying with your jetpack and shooting.

name: Late at night
short_description: This is a blasting game that fights beautiful girls, Dynamic characters, Exquisite style, Gently swing the mouse to damage the clothes !

name: Who Wants To Destroy An Alien
short_description: Battle Royale meets JRPG in this Cyberpunk, All-Villain TV Show to see who gets their wish granted! Hehe. "Granted"... By a sadistic host.

name: Aliens Attack VR
short_description: Aliens Attack is a short and frenetic VR game. Players will have to master their reflexes and skills to reach the goal: defend the pillars of knowledge while fending off the multiple waves of aliens that come to destroy them.

name: Nexoria: Dungeon Rogue Heroes
short_description: NEXORIA — is a hardcore roguelike about dungeons with hybrid battles, combining classical turn based combat system and a collectible card game. Collect the best spells and conquer the dungeons!

name: IMMURE
short_description: IMMURE is a story driven, psychological horror game. Will, the protagonist, has found himself trapped inside a foreboding Mansion with no exit. To escape, he must travel through strange doors which lead into other dimensions, filled with tormented souls.

name: Pushing Through...
short_description: Join Gurnuti of the Empenta Clan on his journey to the Gathering of the Clans. Equipped with only the ancient powers of The Empenta Clan, Gurnuti must push and pull his way through the many harrowing trials that stand before him.

name: July the Lost Child
short_description: You are July, a teenager wandering her outback home trying to find her missing father. On the night her estranged mother returns home, after many years missing.

name: Mochi Mochi Boy
short_description: Stretch? Slide! Solve puzzles , Collect slimes!

name: Taco Truck Madness
short_description: Save the world using tacos, nachos and quesadillas to put a taco truck on every corner. Drive across America avoiding obstacles and feeding hungry looking people as you go. Banditos, police, and even a sloppy joe hurling lunch lady stand in your way. Simply fun.

name: Hentball
short_description: The goal of the game is to clear the playing field from the blocks that close the girl. Open all the girls and enjoy your victories!

name: Alchemia
short_description: Alchemia is a cryptic puzzle game which is solved through research outside of the game.

name: Intelligence: Dogs
short_description: Is a puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with dogs) so that the picture was like the original image. Move the puzzle tiles wisely to collect the correct order of the image pieces. The essence of the game as in the old game "Tag" (15).

name: Bearable Nightmares
short_description: Smash, dash, crash, and slash through spooky forests, creepy arcades, chilling schools, and more as you upgrade your teddy hero with amazing set of abilities to reclaim the freedom to dream!

name: Russpuppy Kid Games
short_description: Lots of fun, educational kid games all in one fantastic package!

name: Blade of Acrimony
short_description: Blade of Acrimony is a Psychological Horror RPG where you take control of Sora Loyalar and follow her on her downward spiral into insanity.

name: GraviSound
short_description: Unusual continuation of the Button Music series - GraviSound ! Customize the way for the ball to create your own unique track!

name: Damned Daniel
short_description: The story of a failing business and its owner desperate to pull it out of the gutter. Even if that means turning to an unknown, sinister figure with an even more sinister book. Follow Daniel through shady adventures, battle monsters in turn based combat, and watch as his conscience ebbs away...

name: Skull's Impossible Quest
short_description: Swing your nimble weapon at hordes of enemies while collecting tokens of strength for you and your impish companion. Be a responsible agent of the council or banter with them and others through complex conversations. Find ways to defeat various enemies sent by your evil brother.

name: Battle Of Britain
short_description: Battle Of Britain is a minimal airforce battle game. It has many achievements and iconic airplanes. I hope you enjoy playing Battle of Britain!

name: 阿比斯的宝藏 - Treasure of abyss
short_description: 《阿比斯的宝藏》是一款超长篇的海贼冒险剧情式RPG游戏，并结合半沙盒与半硬核的传统玩法。游戏背景与故事建立在拥有大面积海洋的幻想世界，海洋将各个岛屿连接起来，海路也成为了游戏唯一的交通方法。四大海域成为了海贼们冒险与战斗的舞台，进行着各种各样精彩演绎。

name: Professor Watts Memory Match: Expressions
short_description: Hello Professor Watts here and I have some research to do on memory skills. I have assembled a wide variety of expressions to put our memory to the test. We can see how we're doing by completing matches in a specific amount of time and earning points to track our overall progress.

name: Formula XD
short_description: Take on the role of racing team manager - hiring drivers, negotiating contracts with sponsors and engine suppliers, making the big decisions necessary to keep your team above water. You'll issue orders to your drivers out onto the track, and be responsible for guiding them to victory or defeat.

name: ASCENT: Crash Landing
short_description: Plummeting toward an uncharted planet ruled by a ferocious species, Bluu and Blip must complete a perilous journey if they ever want to see home again. FULL RELEASE DATE: 26 Jun, 2020.

name: Letzte Worte VR
short_description: Trapped in a strange shattered world lost in fog, you take a trip down memory lane. The past not only hides memories of your relationship between you and your brother, but also the suppressed event that may has led to his suicide. Face your deepest fear in this built-for-VR adventure.

name: BattleCry: World At War
short_description: Addictive text-based Military MMO RPG where you team up with other players for TOTAL DOMINATION of the world. Join now, make alliances, build the greatest military force, crush your enemies, defend allies and rule the world!

name: The Great Voyage - Visual Novel
short_description: A visual novel short story inspired by the gorgeous pixel art of PC-98 games and a melodramatic story full of betrayal and crescendo.

name: Simmiland
short_description: Simmiland is a god-like card game. In this game you indirectly influence a small civilization by manipulating their surroundings by playing cards 🃏🃏🃏 Playing cards on different biomes and objects will result in different findings. The way you play the game will define how mankind will develop!

name: The Mark of Robot
short_description: The Mark of Robot is a game in the genre of adventure from the first person. You play as a robot of the old model. Only two types of weapons are suitable for him: a wrench and a Ray gun, which disconnects all complex electronics.

name: RIFF VR for Arcades
short_description: RIFF VR for arcades allows everyone to become a VR rockstar. Its levels of difficulty, leaderboards, customization mode, interactive environments, and rock solid song selection is a crowd pleaser!

name: Sexy Girls Puzzle
short_description: Relaxing puzzle game with professional photos.

name: Archery
short_description: Archery - is simple archery game. You need eliminate all balloons and don't let run out arrows

name: Zombiotik
short_description: Simple, intuitive and addictive, Zombiotik is the tag couch game wich will make your living room a meeting place for you and your friends. In a colorful and minimalist universe, 2 to 8 players try to survivre as long as possible to the epidemics by placing walls and barricades on their way.

name: Shopping Clutter 2: Christmas Square
short_description: “Shopping Clutter 2: Christmas Square” is an amazing, colorful brain-jogging game for players of all ages with festive images, animation and music for entering the spirit of Christmas.

name: Axis Football 2018
short_description: Axis Football is an American football simulation featuring a deep Franchise Mode and full customization.

name: Toy-War: The Beginning
short_description: Welcome to the fantasy war is you never seen Before!

name: Heavy Recoil
short_description: Shoot through 3 levels of enemies with 4 different projectile weapons. Move quickly and use cover as enemies will react to your position and actions. Kill enemies to get health before they take you out!

name: Hentai Weed PuZZles
short_description: This is a jigsaw puzzle game in which you need to put together pictures of anime chans, using provided picture fragments.

name: Fire Place
short_description: Savor the simple pleasure of building and maintaining a fire. Best enjoyed during seasonal gatherings and cold, dark nights.

name: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition
short_description: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition offers players a trial of this historical single & multiplayer RTS experience. *Note: To unlock all features of the game please see the “Base Game” product.

name: Drunkn Bar Fight on Halloween
short_description: Drunkn Bar Fight on Halloween is holiday themed snippet of the VR game Drunkn Bar Fight.

name: Space Cows
short_description: Let this cheesy twin-stick shooter with little gravity and a lot of hard-cow action sweep you off your hooves! Wibble-wobble your way through a mootant-infested space station to save Betsy. Shoot your enemies with a toilet plunger and leave no cow behind.

name: Ant Empire
short_description: Ant Empire is a tactical strategy and management game set in a world where ant species battle to become the top empire. Dive into a unique and intricate world made of 5 ant species with dozens of upgrades, research, and unique abilities to out-smart your opponent and conquer the map.

name: Heart Chain Kitty
short_description: Help Kittey save his parents in Heart Chain Kitty, a surreal 3D platformer adventure that will blow your mind with fantastic locations, a heartfelt story, and unique abilities – like the screw ray!

name: Signed and Sealed With a Kiss
short_description: "Raise" your own perfect boyfriend in this visual novel-stat raiser. Will you fall in love or will you say goodbye?

name: Shining Orb Prequel
short_description: Another day stuck on this floating island under the oppression of the Elves. Another crafty plan to foil their magical dominion and free Humanity. Will you finally break your people from their shackles, or will the clash bring destruction for all? Play the prequel to Shining Orb and find out how it all began!

name: PixelRPG
