Research magic and gather mystical artifacts, face ancient dangers and other sects in your path to spiritual ascension.

name: Asterion
short_description: ASTERION is a 3D action and adventure game with puzzle elements, very much in the vein of Zelda games with a dash of Souls-like. You are Asterion, last in a long line of minotaurs bred to brave the dangers of the Labyrinth of Crete: an ancient, enigmatic, massive structure.

name: Dive Inside
short_description: Explore the Depths!

name: Su Hack
short_description: Hackers Simulation - REAL TIME virtual HACKING - be the TOP 1 RANK HACKER - Tchat with others players / preys

name: Hexanome
short_description: Hexanome is a turn-based puzzle game. After breaking triangle's solution on Hexa Turn, its time to empathize with the triangle. Collect all squares while AI tries to block your way.

name: Creaks
short_description: The ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

name: Mittelborg: City of Mages
short_description: Mittelborg: City of Mages is a strategic adventure with elements of rogue-like and resource management. You are crowned to be Chancellor of the city, but this power is a heavy burden. Face tough decisions, fight mystical tempests, look for the cause of upcoming chaos. Will Mittelborg have a future?

name: Animals Memory: Horses
short_description: Animals Memory: Horses is a card game with pictures of different horses that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards.

name: Lifeslide
short_description: Embark on a challenging journey through life as you master the art of paper plane flight.

name: Mars: Chaos Menace
short_description: Humanity is terraforming Mars, but chaos and destruction threaten the planet. Battle your way through innumerable hordes of enemies that wish to destroy you and face the most terrible and powerful monsters in the galaxy. Our destiny is in your hands.

name: Leopoldo Manquiseil
short_description: The videogame industry is in danger! A dishonest organization (A.M.E.) has set out to monopolize the industry and thus control the minds of the players. Developers and distributors have two options: either they take their side or else the market will end up crushing them.

name: Spec Defense
short_description: Classic, maze based tower defense. Pick your towers and strategy, plan your maze and let none gets past!

name: Simson Tuningwerkstatt 3D
short_description: Simson Tuningwerkstatt 3D

name: DISRUPTION
short_description: Disruption is an action-adventure TPS set in the dystopian future city of Nutropolis — where a disengaged human populace overly-dependent on robotization, has stumbled to the brink of destruction from a mutant robot force led by a rogue madman in his fight against a ruthless, massive tech company.

name: Joe's Wrath
short_description: After being mistakenly kidnapped by the Russian mob, Joe swears vengeance on those who had wronged him. It's up to you to help Joe fight through hordes of enemies on a killing spree he never thought he'd be part of (the main part).

name: Musashi vs Cthulhu
short_description: Musashi vs Cthulhu (or MxC) is a fast paced action game where you take control of Musashi - the most famous warrior from feudal Japan -,as he’s fighting for his life. The ronin is a victim of a terrible curse that makes him a target for unspeakable monsters.

name: There Is No Turning Back!
short_description: There Is No Turning Back is a roguelike survival RNG that reveals your true nature as you face increasingly anxiety-provoking maps of monsters and darkness. Exploration and rescuing helpless survivors can bring you great rewards, and each you save unlocks a trainable ability you can unlock (up to 4 total) to help you survive deeper into...

name: Badminton Warrior (羽毛球勇士 中国新年版)
short_description: Simple to learn but tough to master, Badminton Warrior provides a classic challenge that focuses on reflexes, timing, and problem solving. Clear, drive, and smash your way through the original sixteen levels plus a bonus Chinese New Year themed level!

name: Dark Dimensions: Homecoming Collector's Edition
short_description: For years, Barton Mansion sat abandoned, a haunting reminder of an obsession gone wrong. But something sinister still lurked there...and it's stirring.

name: Final Cut: Fame Fatale Collector's Edition
short_description: A reclusive star's darkest secrets are coming to light.

name: Grim Tales: Bloody Mary Collector's Edition
short_description: Save your niece from the evil presence haunting her school!

name: Steampunk Graveyard
short_description: The dead walk with a metallic clunk! Run, jump and shoot your way past mechanized zombies in an endless series of graveyards. It's up to you, Professor Selene Gasket, to put a stop to the menace and save the terrified villagers from the minions of Baron Richter von Sprocket.

name: Rogue Fable III
short_description: Rogue Fable III is a traditional rogue-like game which combines the depth, complexity, and challenge of the genre classics with a shorter, more tightly focused game length.

name: Six Degrees of Damnation
short_description: Race through a horror filled labyrinth and see if you can make it through and out of the six increasingly extensive floors.

name: Aquarium Sandbox
short_description: Aquarium Sandbox is an aquarium simulator that allows you to learn, config, and share an underwater world.

name: Bow to Blood: Last Captain Standing
short_description: Become a Captain! Fly your ship and command your crew as you compete to become Champion in a winner-takes-all reality show. Build relationships and plot betrayals to avoid getting voted off the season and become the last captain standing. Optional VR support.

name: Color Phase
short_description: Experience a colorful puzzle-platformer experience in Color Phase! Find and use different colors to interact with the world around you in a variety of different ways to reach your goal!

name: Devil Girl Needs Massages
short_description: You are the only one who can recharge Mana of Devil Girl. Please give Devil Girl your Massage and make her Mana full!

name: StarCrossed
short_description: StarCrossed is an action arcade game with a magical girl aesthetic and a cooperative twist. Join our cast of 5 space-faring heroes as they travel across the stars, working together to strengthen their bond and defeat a looming evil that threatens the galaxy!

name: 9Dragons : Kung Fu Arena
short_description: “Nine Dragons : Kung Fu Arena” is a Martial-Art battle royal project based on the history of “Nine Dragons Online”, loved by 7 million users globally. Through the bloody battleground in Gado island, defeat all other mercenaries and find “The Dragon’s Jade” to reveal the legend of Nine Dragon’s Legacy.

name: Yet Another Snake Game
short_description: You are seeing another interpretation of the well-known game from the time of the first game consoles.

name: Magebuster: Amorous Augury
short_description: Fight a magic duel against a haughty mage girl, and show her the power of an evil spirit in an erotic RPG visual novel!

name: Talk to Yuno
short_description: Chat with Yuno! Solve cases, input keywords, or simply check in to see how she's doing!

name: M.A.S.S. Builder
short_description: Commander, customize and build your Mechanical Assault Skeleton Suit (M.A.S.S.) and lead the fight against an alien invasion bent on exterminating the human race. The fate of humanity is in your hands.

name: Prixel
short_description: Prixel is an old-school pixel style 2D platformer.It's designed for speed runners, but ordinary people can play it too .

name: Abstract Hell
short_description: Abstract Hell is a realm of many hostile creatures made of simple lines, curves, and light, and they're bent on destroying you while you navigate the treacherous mazes collecting tokens to advance to the next level. Become overwhelmed in a variety of ways—sheer numbers, shifting environments, and various pranks.

name: Predecessor
short_description: Inspired by the legacy of Paragon, built with love by the community, and powered by Unreal Engine 5, Predecessor is the ultimate fusion of shooter action and MOBA strategy. Join more than 2,000,000 players and play for FREE now!

name: 7-minute HOP
short_description: Interesting jumping game with cute graphics and infinite gameplay.

name: Sanatorium Purgatorium
short_description: Sanatorium Purgatorium provides you with an excellent opportunity to relax, forgetting about all your worries! Here you can make new friends, meet the love of your life and cleanse your sinful soul!

name: Backgammon, Chess & Checkers
short_description: Play either backgammon, chess or checkers against a virtual opponent, in a courtyard setting. Play on desktop or in VR.

name: CastleGuard
short_description: CastleGuard is a independent FPS game. The objective if you accept it is to pass cities and country sides full of enemies ready to kill you at any moments. If you die, you restart. Good luck soldier !

name: Hell-O-Ween
short_description: Santa is real, but missing. Halloween is real, but not a festival. Myths are real, but nightmares. A world filled with horror, but summoned hope. Explore the world of Hell-O-Ween to uncover the truth, hunt the horrors and find Santa. A MOBA-MMORPG game themed towards Halloween and Christmas.

name: Cargo Cult
short_description: Tear through the Trash Dunes on a stolen rocket, evading misshapen mutants, giant sentient maggots, and pistol poppin' pigeons. Build up your ship piece by piece with whatever you find in the dungeons below. Mutate your DNA to gain abilities and try to survive the frenzied onslaught. You won't.

name: Red Blue
short_description: Red Blue is a quickness game. If you want to develop eyesight or APM(Action Per Minute), just challenge this game.

name: Vile
short_description: Vile is an action rogue-lite about fighting demonic creatures and other horrors throughout a vile world. Fight enemies and/or complete random objectives given to you in procedurally-generated dungeons to put a stop to the creatures forever! Collect souls, find new weapons, new artifacts, and battle EPIC bosses!

name: eCheese Zone
short_description: eCheese Zone! A punishment game like no other, a hardcore digital escape room, an activity to get mad at. Featuring lots of text to read, an hour long punishment timer, secrets, and easy directions to follow (you will not read them and you will mess up). Are you up to the eCheese challenge?

name: Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes Complete Edition
short_description: Travis Strikes Again, Beam Katana charged and ready! He's been sucked into the legendary Death Drive Mk II games console, where anyone who collects all the Death Balls has their wishes granted (...or do they?).

name: MarisaLand Legacy
short_description: Twilight Frontier's latest release is here! A Touhou Project inspired work: "MarisaLand Legacy" Eat mushrooms to increase your height in this easy to control 2D side scrolling action game! But it's not only her height which has changed, the number of players too! Marisa's adventure starts once more...!!

name: Config Wars
short_description: Strategic or with a hammer? Decide for yourself and configure your individual army to defeat your adversary in ultimate multiplayer battles

name: Dark Trail
short_description: Dark Trail - Minimalistic beautiful platformer game with hardcore gameplay

name: Flashback
short_description: FLASHBACK™, the hit action-adventure game with over 2.2 million units sold, is back!

name: The Tower of Five Hearts
short_description: A cute and adorable yuri visual novel featuring kemonomimi (animal ears)! Play the role of a princess to find the girl meant for you!

name: Nowhere Patrol
short_description: Nowhere Patrol is a boss rush game with bullet hell and platforming elements. Inspired by classic action arcade games with it's steep difficulty curve and non-stop action.

name: Rampage Online
short_description: Get to the top of the best online shooter players!

name: NekoCharm
short_description: Hey, rookie! You have to go through a series of tests to prove that you are a worthy fighter! And then prove yourself in the service of the government!

name: Puzzle Out VR
short_description: Puzzle Out VR is an atmospheric tangram-style puzzle game in space where you need to put puzzle pieces in the right place before the moving alien wall reaches you!

name: Rope Racer O'Neon
short_description: This is a neon world and racers who can use the rope. Choose your car, paint it however you want, gather crystals and try to cross the finish line!

name: Circle of Sumo
short_description: Use your belly to your advantage! Challenge your friends in this fun party game on sumo. Fight into the arena: charge, hit, dodge and defeat the opponents. Let's have some good old fun!

name: Super Blasting Boy
short_description: Super Blasting Boy is a logical platform platformer made in the best traditions of retro games of the late 80's and 90's.

name: Toltec and the mysteries of the Secret Island
short_description: “Toltec and the mysteries of the secret island” is an Atmospheric physics based action game ,with stunning hand-painting graphics , immersive sound score and simple yet amazing game-play.

name: Charm Tale 2: Mermaid Lagoon
short_description: Charm Tale 2: Mermaid Lagoon is a puzzle game with math3 and hidden object types of levels.

name: Romantic Journey
short_description: Romantic Journey is a Japanese-style visual novel game in which the protagonist, for a variety of reasons, takes a romantic holiday trip with the ladies of the boss's family. "Absolutely torture!" Just joined the company's protagonist, was arranged to accompany the chairman of the company's Qianjin lady and friends to travel...

name: Varenje: Collector`s Edition
short_description: Our hero was spending summer happily at the cottage until curiosity forced him to sample an unknown berry at the stream. Before he knew it, everything had become incredibly large, and he was reduced to the size of a bug!

name: Puzzles for smart: Birds
short_description: Puzzles for smart: Birds - for fans of popular puzzles of different complexity. Collect puzzle with the image of these beautiful birds.

name: Heaven & Hell 2
short_description: Match-3 game with gorgeous visuals and over 200 challenging levels in 3 different game modes (swap, puzzle, group mode). Win powerful bonuses and special boosters to help you win a level. Enjoy the humorous story line and help the hero, little Mephistino to play pranks!

name: Common'hood
short_description: Common’hood is a community building and economy management game with highly customizable base building tools. Scavenge for materials, grow your own food, research new technology, craft new tools, build a home, make friends. Form your community and take it from surviving to thriving!

name: Grounded
short_description: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunk to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?

name: Tactics V: "Obsidian Brigade"
short_description: Tactics V: "Obsidian Brigade" is a retro-style tactical turn-based video game in homage to console tactical RPGs from the 1990s.

name: Ultimate Legends
short_description: The island of Legenia is being attacked. Can you defend it? This world needs new heroes. Will you be its Ultimate Legends? Let's find out...

name: Singularity: Tactics Arena
short_description: Tactics Arena is a narrative-driven RPG inspired by the SCP Foundation, Final Fantasy Tactics and D&D 5e.

name: Quicken® WillMaker® Plus 2019 and Living Trust
short_description: Quicken® WillMaker® Plus 2019 and Living Trust is the easiest way to create your estate plan, whether you're just getting started or you want to update your previous arrangements. This powerful software guides you through the process from beginning to end.

name: Tiger Tank 59 A-Gun
short_description: This is a tank war game, players need to control their tanks, through the enemy lines, break the enemy base, or defeat the enemy tanks

name: Solitaire: Learn the Flags!
short_description: A combination of using flashcards for learning with the classic card game Solitaire.

name: Time Virus
short_description: You as the member of project 'Time Virus' need to control the robot following the rhythm of music to finish your mission and get to know what happened in the game. This is an open-music game, you can import .mp3 file to play, you will have different experience when using music with different rhythm.

name: Fantom Feast
short_description: Help Fantom eat enemies and grow big and strong!

name: 天罡星宿海 The sea of TianGang XinSu
short_description: “The sea of TianGang XinSu” is an individually developed independent space game. The story takes place after the war between the earth and the robot world. The earth was reduced to the bargaining chip of the robots and was locked at a place of black holes. The core aim of this pre-launched version is to release the earth from the robots.

name: Flip-Out!
short_description: Flip-Out! is a challenging pinball game with a twist, the flippers can move! This combination of pinball and the Breakout-style gameplay of horizontal movement and brick breaking brings you a brand new way to play pinball with new challenges and strategies.

name: Wallenda
short_description: Many years later, one early Magic Doll woke up quietly. With the awakening of the mysterious power, she travelled through the world full of nightmare. In order to find the airship and escape from the horrible world, she must go through various levels until the end of the journey.

name: WeLOVE
short_description: 不需要大的曲折，只需要微小的感动。由十段轻松的恋爱小品组成，百张可爱照片演出的真人恋爱文字冒险游戏。

name: The Silver Crusade: Aoorha Axeman
short_description: It is harder than it looks ! Use your axe to cut wood and enemies ! Can you find what you left the tribe for ?

name: HOT FIT!
short_description: This story is about a main character working at a fitness gym. Can you meet the expectations of the heroines who are in charge of training?! Let's proceed with the story and enjoy various event scenes! Visual Novel Type Adventure Game, HOT FIT! all characters are over the age of 18.

name: S.A.I.A.'s Awakening: A Robothorium Visual Novel
short_description: Discover how it all began and explore Robothorium's universe through the eyes of Agent 22, a spy commissioned by Jaklov to stake Alan out. Will you carry out your mission or defy the established authority? Your choices will be crucial.

name: Granny
short_description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

name: 机能女孩-Energy Girl
short_description: The functional girl is an RPG character adventure game, and the player will play the protagonist to experience various adventure stories.

name: The Darkest Woods 2
short_description: You woke up in old, empty psychiatric hospital ward. How did you get here? What's going on around? Where does these creepy voices come from?

name: Summer in Mara
short_description: Take care of your own island and sail with your boat in this cozy farming adventure! Relax and unwind exploring a tropical archipelago or harvesting your own crops while helping others. Discover the story of Summer in Mara, with farming, crafting and exploring mechanics.

name: IScream
short_description: IScream is an arcady driving game where you play as an ice cream truck driver who gets recruited by the Clowntown gang. Complete missions for the clown gang to defeat the other gangs, while the kids in the streets try to stop you by any means.

name: Transient: Extended Edition
short_description: H.P. Lovecraft meets Cyberpunk. Delve deep into a dystopian world and investigate what is happening to you and your friends in a domed city. Solve puzzles, hack systems and plug in to explore other dimensions. Discover a truth that might tear apart your sanity and question your very existence.

name: Paroniria 梦缚
short_description: 一个小女孩被卷入了一连串诡异的事件，信仰，争端，神秘空间----究竟她的命运会如何呢？ 本游戏为多结局模式，玩家需要收集信息和道具来触发不同的结局。 《梦缚》 是一款剧情向游戏，带有部分解谜和迷宫玩法，希望大家会喜欢！ 老梅如果有空会持续更新，如果大家发现一些问题请向梅老师提出，梅老师会尽量修复。 希望大家能不嫌弃我们刚刚起步的革诚星迹团队。

name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Mountains of Madness
short_description: After an encounter with a dreadful horror, detective Lone Carter’s investigation leads him to fateful places as Innsmouth, Arkham and the Antarctic, investigating a series of deaths and mysteries. Play also as Abdul Alhazred and H.P. Lovecraft himself in this Lovecraftian point’n’click adventure.

name: We Must Praise Our Glorious Leader The Flumf
short_description: We Must Praise Our Glorious Leader The Flumf is a 2D side-scrolling resource-gathering and building game. Collect items, build buildings, fend off enemies from your pile, and as always fulfil the eternal hunger of The Flumf.

name: Skater XL - The Ultimate Skateboarding Game
short_description: Experience unparalleled board control and responsiveness while you skate iconic real-world skate spots. This is the evolution of skateboarding gameplay. With Independent Foot Control and unique physics-based gameplay, skate gamers finally have the expressive controls they have always dreamed of.

name: Dark Roll
short_description: Dark Roll is a FREE single player game, in which the player goes through a series of uniquely designed levels. Your agility will be tested along with your logic. Each level is planned to provide a different challenge.

name: Madland
short_description: Find sanity within the Madland. A first-person shooter game, developed entirely by a one-man team, that let's You dive into the cold mystery of the Dark Abyss. For players who love HALF-LIFE , OUTLAST , and THE LONG DARK.

name: 执行人 Executor
short_description: 《Executor》It's a puzzle game.In this house, there are many secret plots hidden behind the doors.You will be unveiling all kinds of puzzles in this house by looking for the prompts and using them properly.

name: My 1/6 Lover
short_description: This is a visual novel about a lovestory with 6 routes, numerous CGs and 200,000 words. Small town, afternoon, leisure is in the air. A young man is trying to straighten himself up and finally say it to the girl of his dream. The girl shocked him with an unexpected answer. "I'm sorry, which of us do you like?"

name: Frog Detective 1: The Haunted Island
short_description: You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve a mystery.

name: Ponkle
short_description: Let a small star jump toward the top floor! A simple and comprehensible jump action game by random generating.

name: Pirate Survival Fantasy Shooter
short_description: Pirate Survival Fantasy Shooter is a VR survival adventure that takes you inside a magical realm full of incredible bloodthirsty creatures. Your entire crew has been slaughtered by the cursed creatures living in these crazy islands and your ship is sinking.

name: Citadale - The Ancestral Strain
short_description: The gravest Citadale adventure yet breaks new ground... and buries you in it!

name: Trash Rage
short_description: One survivor to clean up the mess! A VR post-apocalyptic eco adventure.

name: Pixel World: Unity-Chan!
short_description: This is the action game that you color all of panels. The production is simple, but you can enjoy exhilarating actions by run the player and dash the enemy and spin them.

name: PixNautiCraft
short_description: An amazing alien world is revealed in from of your eyes. Your task is to survive and find out the cause of your ship's tragic events. But BEWARE !!!  You are not the only survivor in the oceans depth.

name: Another Sight - Hodge's Journey
short_description: Take control of Hodge the cat in a brand new, stand-alone prequel story in Another Sight - Hodge's Journey. Tackle new platforming challenges using Hodge's nimble feline skills to solve puzzles and misteries as he travels between the world of dreams and the world of the real.

name: The Bluecoats: North & South
short_description: Reunite with Sergeant Cornelius M. Chesterfield and Corporal Blutch in this remastered game that combines turn-based strategy and real-time action. This new version will delight fans of the original game, initially released on the Amiga at the end of the 1980s!

name: Cute Puzzle MAX
short_description: Brain training in a little free time!The basic rule is simple, same as [Minesweeper].When the panel opens, sexy images are displayed.

name: Talk to Strangers
short_description: Talk to Strangers is a game of everyday survival. Survive door to door conversations ranging from bizarre to mundane (in this order) while trying to sell products to strangers. But beware: nothing is what it seems in this neighborhood.

name: Heroes of Fortunia
short_description: Heroes of Fortunia is an online multiplayer hack ‘n slash game, in which players strive to create their own dungeons, filled with monsters & traps, while at the same time attacking other players’ dungeons in an attempt to beat them.

name: Angel, Devil, Elf and Me!
short_description: Ayumu your average bachelor leading the typical day-to-day until sexy sirens of all walks of life start appearing through portals in his home! WHY?! Well to fight over who gets to become his bride and claim his... essence of course!

name: Nya Nya Nya Girls (ʻʻʻ)_(=^･ω･^=)_(ʻʻʻ)
short_description: The game is a classic puzzle with three levels of difficulty.

name: PRiCERPG
short_description: PRiCERPG is a sidescroller RPG with a strong emphasis on politically incorrect humor and the concept of evolution of consciousness and emotions.

name: SCP: Blackout
short_description: A VR/Desktop game where you are a new D-Class personnel in secret SCP Research Site-50 when everything falls apart. Use what you can find as you explore the facility, access logs to learn about the SCP entities in containment, and run for your life from the SCP entities that have escaped.

name: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED]
short_description: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] is a remake of the original "ETERNAL CASTLE" from 1987, with additional game mechanics, sophisticated sound design, polished 2-bit CGA animated graphics, and modernized game design.

name: A Sound Plan
short_description: A Sound Plan is a local competitive arena game about using sound to manipulate zombies into eating your friends. Inspired by gladiator games, matches are hilarious, hectic, and punishing. Be passive and hide, or be violent and throw rocks, the choice is yours.

name: Abyss Manager
short_description: Take over a small dungeon that no adventure is interested in as a new manager. You'll start with almost nothing and recruit minions, accumulate money, construct facilities, develop technology, explore the realm, have the dungeon's name up, defeat other dungeons and win the championship of the Dungeon League.

name: Intersolar Overdrive
short_description: Intersolar Overdrive was built on a gravity algorithm that lets you experience relative travel in deep space. Follow the story line or play in arcade mode for good old fashioned points.

name: SMOKED
short_description: Fast-paced Mafia topdown shooter shrouded in mystery and spattered with blood.

name: Cubic Factory
short_description: Design and build your own factory within this 3D voxel-based strategy game. Research to unlock new buildings and transport methods and move your factory to the next age. Create and design themed worlds with their own resources, products and end goals.

name: Write word
short_description: This is a simulator game for fast typing! Challenge yourself!

name: Project Flesh
short_description: Project Flesh is a 2D randomly generated dungeon crawler/ Rogue-like, set deep in the sewers under a nameless city, the goal is to survive and make it through all the floors, equipping yourself with the limbs of mutated creatures you kill.

name: Clad in Iron: Sakhalin 1904
short_description: Manage your fleet and army, hunt the enemy's fleet, hide your weak squadrons in protected ports until reinforcements arrive, blockade enemy trade routes, amphibious assaults, struggle for dominance over the seas.

name: Hentai Girl Hime
short_description: Relax class puzzle game to keep you in a good mood

name: Lost in Vivo
short_description: A horror game about claustrophobia. During a storm your service dog is forced down a broken sewer drain. You find the nearest sewer entrance and run in after it. Along the way you will meet others that are also stricken by abnormal or psychological fear.

name: Beasts Shall Rise
short_description: Find Father Shannon at the heart of the cemetery and end the drunken spree that has unleashed his inner demons on earth. Use your skills to keep the clock ticking in this fast paced shooter with rogue-like elements. Fight demons, vampires and werewolves while avoiding The Reaper's deathly grasp.

name: It Lurks! A Noir Horror RPG.
short_description: Take on the role of a hardened Private Detective in this horror themed classic-styled Role Playing Game that pits you against fearsome foes in an exciting turn-based and interactive battle-system.

name: Welcome To... Chichester 1/Redux : The Spy Of America And The Long Vacation
short_description: WTC 1/Redux is the origin story of how the protagonist (that is, you !) unknowningly ends up in England. When a long forgotten mission resurfaces, your nemesis takes drastic measures to deal with it - including taking you along with her.

name: A Flappy Bird in Real Life
short_description: Do not like pixelated images? Enjoy playing this version of the well-known game of the bird.

name: Invaders from Dimension X
short_description: Invaders From Dimension X! is a solitaire game depicting battles between the crack 124th Galactic Marine Raider Battalion (nicknamed “The Old Reprobates”) of the Unified Space Alliance Defense Force and the invading “pods” of a mysterious alien race, commonly known as the Kay’otz.

name: Valor & Victory
short_description: Valor & Victory is a fast-playing, easy to learn World War II squad-level game system. Based on the original Valor & Victory board game, the digital edition provides you with an accessible and deep challenge, developed for classic tabletop game lovers.

name: Touhou Jikuu Kikou ~ Iris Machina's Journey
short_description: This game is a Touhou Project fangame. It's a shooting game where you defeat bosses while dodging danmaku. Customize your weaponry to one of 576 possible combinations, and overcome the danmaku coming your way!

name: Pace Chasers
short_description: Chase the pace of other players in asynchronous multiplayer gameplay as you climb the leaderboards in this time trial racing platformer.

name: Chromatic Aberration
short_description: An action Pixel-Art FPS, with fast combat, bullet-hell enemies and satisfying weapons! Enter a dark, violent struggle between resistance forces and the AI governor ruling the city! Face off against cyborgs, machines, mutants and worse!

name: They That Feast
short_description: They That Feast is a cosmic / Lovecraftian horror game in which your enemies can't simply be observed by the naked eye. Can you walk the line between sanity and survival?

name: Contractors
short_description: Contractors is a team-based competitive multiplayer shooter game for virtual reality devices. Experience the next level virtual warfare with hardcore controls, lethal weapons, customizable load-outs, and intense firefights. BECOME AN OPERATOR.

name: Paws in the Maze
short_description: "Paws in the Maze," a thrilling adventure where you take on the role of a big-hearted pitbull on a mission to rescue two lost puppies trapped in a vast, dark labyrinth. As the brave protagonist, you must rely on your keen senses and powerful bark to locate the wayward pups and guide them to safety.

name: NEONARCADE: adventure puzzle muse
short_description: NEON ARCADE: adventure puzzle quest - a game in which you have to go through many levels, overcoming various puzzles and obstacles. You will enjoy nice graphics, sound and unforgettable gameplay!

name: STARBOY
short_description: The hardest game in the world.

name: Make Your Kingdom
short_description: Make Your Kingdom is a city-building game unique to its genre. Play as a founder of the settlement — help build your kingdom, carry the resources, talk to other settlers, motivate them and fight off hordes of orcs with your own sword!

name: Snood
short_description: Forget Life, Play SNOOD!

name: Turn the mirror, please.
short_description: Turn the mirror, please. - А minimalist puzzle game.

name: Brainmelter Deluxe
short_description: Melt your brain with this twisted take on the platform genre!

name: Aim Theory - Trainer
short_description: "Aim Theory - Trainer" is the scientific way to improve your aiming skills for FPS games.

name: Endless Universe 2 PC Live Wallpaper
short_description: Procedural Generated worlds where you are not alone! Create your spaceship, explore and be ready for the battles! The most advanced PC live wallpaper for Windows 10 in the universe! Do you want to try?

name: License To Clone
short_description: License To Clone is a challenging Open World Sandbox Survival RPG where you learn through survival. Explore a desert with a dynamic economy full of rogue factions. Experiment with powerful mutations. Tame creatures and extract powerful body parts to splice your DNA in your cloning lab.

name: A meadow Piece
short_description: This is a meadow simulator with slightly different flowers. Either just watch the flowers grow. Or defend yourself against strange aliens. Actively intervene in the development of the meadow. Play with your friends, either as a team or against each other.

name: MonGirlTile
short_description: Fight against cute monster girls in this territory control card game!

name: My Colony
short_description: Build, expand, and rule a growing space colony. Explore tech, trade, and multiplayer.

name: Chemical Chimpet
short_description: Interact with Reaction Stones that combine with one another to form molecules, break down adjacent stones, and chain reactions together to crush molecules without lifting a finger. The stones rotate and translate along the board, leaving it up to the player to take a simple or complicated approach.

name: PomboTroll
short_description: PomboTroll is an extremely fun 2D game. Fly on the wings of a pigeon and earn points pooping and vomiting on other birds. Challenge other players for a gross battle and be the biggest troll pigeon of all!

name: Late'O'Clock
short_description: Late’O’Clock is an isometric stealth game in which you play as an office employee who is always late to work and must sneak to their desk. During the game players are able to bribe, distract, or deactivate enemies to avoid being detected. Every new day will bring many obstacles for the player to experience.

name: Brave Hero Yuusha EX
short_description: Familiar tales can take unfamiliar turns! And it's up to you to reconstruct the story!

name: NekoMiko
short_description: The main character is an unfortunate man who can't do anything well. One fateful day, he meets 2 cat-eared shrine maidens by the name of Ayame and Kaede at an old shrine, and ends up living with them! Set in Akihabara, enjoy this adventure game of the slightly dirty-minded and eventful cohabitation life with 2 cat-eared shrine maidens.

name: Yearning
short_description: This 2D horror game is set in Edo period of Japan. The girl notices that her old sister has disappeared. The girl will look for her and clues of her. What will the girl find in end of the story?

name: Omno
short_description: A single-player journey of discovery through an ancient world of wonders, created by solo developer Jonas Manke.

name: Car Transporter 2013
short_description: Highly polished cars are placed in front of the carshops waiting for buyers. To provide the dealers with the necessary cars you transport the vehicles under pressure to their final destination. Load trucks with the desired cars and avoid any scratches or damage during charging.

name: Woodcutter Simulator 2011
short_description: The smell of tree resin is in the air when Woodcutter Simulator 2011 is started. Here the player is the master of a modern wood processing plant and is allowed to take over pithy tasks – feel as if you were in Canada's forests yourself.

name: BattleRush: Ardennes Assault
short_description: Multiplayer action game in the entourage of the Second World War with total destruction of the environment. Complete freedom of action. Do anything and anywhere. Build defense, demolish enemy towns, control any vehicle which you will see on your way or create.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
short_description: Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs.

name: Puzzles for smart: Horses
short_description: Puzzles for smart: Horses - for fans of popular puzzles of different complexity. Collect puzzle with the image of these beautiful horses.

name: Gems of Magic: Lost Family
short_description: This magical Match 3 Adventure makes you work. Simple at the start, but quite challenging when you are further in the game. Enjoy the beautiful graphics, and use the power ups sagaciously. Save the colorful creatures of the lost family in the magic forest by solving the puzzles until their freedom.

name: Psychoverse City
short_description: Dive into the trippy gravity shifted world of PSYCHOVERSE CITY and platform across the rooftops of an ever-evolving cityscape, accompanied by adrenalin-pumping beats!

name: Snares of Ruin Zero
short_description: A short prequel to Snares of Ruin, showing the infection outbreak and other harrowing events over the course of 2 weeks leading up to Hank's and Gwen's arrival in the city.

name: Trinity VR
short_description: Trinity is the pilot for the first live-action, immersive, interactive, virtual reality sci-fi experience… In a future where humans have long been extinct, the last surviving androids fight a final war for freedom against an all-powerful Singularity, their God…Who am I? What role do I play in the story?

name: Reynard
short_description: Reynard is a mixture of procedurally generated action RPG and a Tower Defense genre with roguelike elements. It has been influenced by classics such as The Legend of Zelda and an indie classic - The Binding of Isaac.

name: Hentai Plus Girl
short_description: Hentai Plus Girl - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures.

name: 3 Days in the Abyss
short_description: 3 Days in the Abyss is a Biblical based 2D Top Down Action game, where the Spirit of the Savior must traverse through Hell for three days to find the Righteous Captives.

name: Sierra Madre: The Wild West
short_description: Sierra Madre: The Wild West is a western, open world first person shooter survival game set in the 1870s. You play as a U.S. Marshall in the Wild West. Hunt outlaws, save the locals, and do whatever it takes to survive in your quest to rid the Wild West of injustice.

name: Campido
short_description: Campido is a unique card game which challenge your wits, strategy, memory and management skills. The game is set in a fantasy universe, in which humanoid mammals are replacing the regular and normal human characters you are always used to see.

name: Witoo VR photo viewer
short_description: Witoo VR is a virtual reality experience to visualize your 360° photos

name: Ancra
short_description: A narrative driven, puzzle-horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, embrace or evade vengeful specters, decide who to trust and unravel a mystery.

name: Dr. Schplot's Nanobots
short_description: A challenging, story-driven puzzle adventure that takes place inside your intestines. Solve challenging puzzles with experimental mechanics, collect nanobots with unique abilities and discover the identity of the reclusive Dr. Schplot. The fate of humanity rests in your hands!

name: Hulì The Mage
short_description: Are you looking for a game both relaxing and adrenalinic? A weird plot with lots of NPCs and monsters to slay? Then, this is the game you are looking for. Beware! Do not get fooled by the nice and happy graphics, it is not as easy as you may think.

name: Re.poly
short_description: Build on what was once and defend it with your life. Survive the wild and defeat the evil, alone or with friends in a wonderful poly world.

name: Our Lovely Escape
short_description: Your life is a peaceful one. Each day, you work alongside your (otherwise?) all-female workforce in the pursuit of creating otome games. Will you complete your life with a cute girlfriend? Will you be doomed to a life of normalcy? Or...? Find out in this (mostly...?) normal visual novel!

name: Descent of Man
short_description: Descent of Man is a stealth, survival horror game. Experience fear, a historically inspired narrative, and puzzle solving while hunted by intelligent and nightmarish enemies. Use deception to escape and unravel the dark history of a dystopian world's past and it's horrifying present.

name: Spot The Oddity
short_description: Nowadays we look videos more than pictures. So, spot the differece's age is gone! Now is the time of Spot The Oddity!

name: Emerald Shores
short_description: Emerald Shores is a challenging SNES-inspired platformer with a bunch of twists. Level up, take on rewarding sidequests, play a variety of minigames, unlock secret levels, raise a pet monster, and more! Can you liberate the floating island world of Emerald Shores from its captors?

name: 秦殇 (Prince of Qin)
short_description: 《秦殇》（Prince of Qin）是一款由目标软件公司开发的动作角色扮演游戏，该游戏已于2002年7月6日发行。本次进行重新上架，主旨是为了曾经深爱《秦殇》这款游戏的玩家在时隔20年后，能重新追忆当年的风采，特此针对现在的系统运行环境及显示器尺寸优化了分辨率，支持窗口化及1080P分辨率。

name: 蓝宝石般的被害妄想少女/Damsel with persecutory delusion
short_description: A strange letter came to the girl's hand, pointing to a vicious robbery and murder in Qinshan Port City more than a decade ago. Li Meiyuan, a 17-year-old female high school student, lives in depression and delusion all the time. She almost excludes everything around her.

name: 黑暗料理?!
short_description: 这是一款你从未玩过的餐厅模拟游戏！高度自由的做菜玩法，创造和探索菜谱，昼夜系统结合了农场牧场的经营养成，顾客口味偏好多种多样，还有更多奇葩内容等你探索

name: STEINS;GATE: My Darling's Embrace
short_description: Fall in love with the lab members all over again in this sweet and slapstick romantic comedy!

name: CHAOS;CHILD
short_description: From the creators of the critically acclaimed STEINS;GATE comes a sensational new visual novel: CHAOS;CHILD. Set in Shibuya in 2015, a group of high school students who survived an earthquake six years ago find themselves at the center of a new series of bizarre murders in the city.

name: Cubicity: Slide puzzle
short_description: Buddy, you’re in the cubic world! It has its own laws and rules, so choose a character and start solving the puzzles!Make up a figure from the characters, leading each of them the shortest way!

name: Paranoia: Deliver Me
short_description: Based on the best seller Paranoia, the story about Lingluo's college life will bring you to a world unknown. She pursues her music dream without knowing her life is about to be turned upside down. Losing her best friend and her confidence, she plunges into the depth of despair. What will she do?

name: CHECKMATE : Battle Arenas
short_description: Checkmate! Turn Based Real Time PvP Game!Enter the hottest battlefield and compete other players all around the world.Show your divine move to beat the enemy!

name: Castle Rencounter
short_description: What? These insolent decided to defend themselves and gather an army? How? Is their army going on the offensive? Can not be! Well, in this case, act, my lord. Smash the enemies and destroy their stronghold!

name: Kolumno
short_description: Don't let yourself be fooled by its minimalist looks, Kolumno is one of the most elegant and challenging games in recent time.

name: DRAMAQUEEN
short_description: DRAMAQUEEN lets players tell their own stories, and share them with their friends, for fun, for learning or for both.

name: Ball Out
short_description: Discover a crazy Motorcycle - Football game that combines reactivity and speed! In Ball Out, get on several vehicles and compete against your friends or other online players on various tracks with one goal in mind: score as many goals as possible! Gain experience and customize your equipment to show your opponents what you are worth.

name: Khaos Wind
short_description: How long will you survive?

name: Short Circuit VR
short_description: Short Circuit VR is an electronics lab simulator in Virtual Reality. You can build your own electronic circuits with the components provided, learn basic electronics by completing challenges and just have fun while experimenting and making awesome projects!

name: Julie's Sweets
short_description: Julie's Sweets is story driven time management game featuring 60 story and 18 pure challenge levels. Delicious donuts, cupcakes and pies - make them quick and time flys.

name: Burnouts: The Igne Mori
short_description: Burnouts: The indie adventure game driven by story, humor and weed. Maneuver yourself through the recent zombie apocalypse by utilizing a combination of Stealth, Quick Reaction Time Events and Puzzles. Any moment can descend into life or death in this tale.

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
short_description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

name: OVERPASS™
short_description: Take control of big-name buggies and quads to negotiate scree slopes, steep inclines and various obstacles on extreme off-road and technically challenging tracks. Find the best route, and manage your acceleration, differentials and drivetrain to dominate in local or online competitions.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery has 500 photos to prove the existence of magic!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Earth Chronicles
short_description: Special edition! 1001 unique photos in a new jigsaw! The theme of this game is the world around us.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Australian Puzzles
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw World Tour: Australia. A puzzle game and tour guide!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: London
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: London Puzzles – feel the spirit of London in jigsaws

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Home Sweet Home
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Home Sweet Home: brain teasers around the family hearth.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Great America
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Great America – see the heart of America in jigsaws.

name: The Unicorn Princess
short_description: Explore the world on horseback and help the inhabitants of your village. Befriend Unica the unicorn and try to save the Dream World by completing all your missions!

name: Rebel Cops
short_description: Lead a ragtag squad of cops in rebellion against their town's new criminal power and see how long you can hold out in this unforgiving turn-based spin-off game from This Is the Police. You'll be desperately short on supplies, and a single shot can cost a cop their life.

name: Crappy Tube
short_description: Crappy Tube is a classic FPS game in which you must to escape from a factory.

name: VR INTERACTIVE TRAILER: Runes
short_description: Experience this VR trailer in full immersion inside your headset and get a sneak peek of Runes, a single player, story-driven VR adventure game in which you are Leth, a renegade wizard fighting for survival in a virtual fantasy world.

name: SkateBIRD
short_description: Grind on bendy straws, kickflip over staplers, and carve killer lines through cardboard and sticky tape parks. Above all else, skate birds try their best!

name: Pipeline VR
short_description: Pipeline VR is a hectic virtual reality puzzle game, that pits you against a rising tide of torrential water. With the residents of Pipesville in desperate need for plumbers, can YOU solve their plumbing emergencies?

name: Mystery Case Files: The Countess Collector's Edition
short_description: What lies within the depths of the pitch-black mirror?

name: Dark Parables: The Match Girl's Lost Paradise Collector's Edition
short_description: A sizzling take on the classic tale of greed, yearning, and redemption.

name: Shadow Wolf Mysteries: Under the Crimson Moon Collector's Edition
short_description: Is Martha really a werewolf - or has she been wrongly accused?

name: Hidden Object: Home Makeover
short_description: Help Emma restore her grandparents' old house! Hidden Object, Match-3 and decoration all in one game.

name: Haunted Legends: The Dark Wishes Collector's Edition
short_description: Restore the threads of Fate, before they cause a disaster!

name: Forgiveness : Escape Room
short_description: "Forgiveness" is a series of 7 escape room adventures, Take the personality test and find out which sin you are guilty of - the room design, environment and the trials you’ll go through will change accordingly!

name: Anubis' Challenge
short_description: Anubis' Challenge is an action-based VR adventure game where you need to show your reaction and combat skills to withstand multiple waves of enemies.

name: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends
short_description: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends is a sci-fi top-down shooter rouge-lite with multiple games modes. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op choosing from 4 unique robot characters with different attributes and attacks. Defend your home, rescue the Robofriends, and find MOTHER!

name: Möbius Front '83
short_description: Defend America from an alternate-universe America using state-of-the-art 1980s military hardware in this intricate and tactical turn-based strategy game.

name: 8bit Arena
short_description: Invite and battle your friends in this retro style local multiplayer action game. Choose your character, each with a unique skillset of 4 abilities, and compete in different arenas. Enhance your skill with full controller support and a direct competitive gameplay!

name: Crystal Corruption - Reclamation
short_description: Dive into a fast-paced, stylish action roguelike metroidvania as resurrected King Cedric. Hack and slash through diverse biomes, face corrupted minibosses, and conquer epic foes. Uncover shattered truths and choose your path to redemption in this gripping tale of vengeance and power.

name: ChronoBreach
short_description: A deadly factory surrounds you. The manipulation of time is necessary to escape this underground facility. Use your wit, your laser blaster, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

name: Rogue Monster Rush
short_description: Experience a unique blend of roguelike and tower defense in Rogue Monster Rush! Hatch, upgrade, and command an array of monster defenders, unleash powerful player abilities, and unlock tons of upgrades to defend your town from the invading robots. Every run is unique.

name: Daedalic Complex
short_description: Daedalic Complex is an adventure, RPG, dungeon-crawling game with elements of storytelling and harsh survival. In this game, a player is required to find an exit for each stage by means of meeting certain conditions while surviving unforgiving level-designs and combats with hideous monsters.

name: Bomber Arena
short_description: Bomber Arena is a 3d action adventure game where you go through several mazes in solo mode or co-op (only local) fighting enemies until you reach your goal. You can take powers to improve your character as well as mounts to help you defeat your opponents in this game.

name: Orc Towers VR
short_description: Orc Towers VR is a first person tower defense game. Build your defenses up to defend against the orc hordes. Teleport between towers to unleash different spells and combinations to defeat the orcs.

name: Robert Rodriguez’s THE LIMIT: An Immersive Cinema Experience
short_description: Enter a new world of storytelling in this “immersive cinema” experience from writer/director Robert Rodriguez.

name: Bulls town
short_description: "Bulls town" is a competitive game with a cartoon cattle theme. The game builds a lot of different BOSS functions, and carries out the fight experience while pursuing fun. It brings you an extraordinary decompression experience through the exciting battle for cattle.

name: From Beyond Prologue
short_description: In the winter of 1910, professor Crawford Tillinghast mounted an expedition into the mountains of Europe. He went searching for a lost village shrouded in the myths and rumors of a bygone era. This is his story...

name: FPS Training
short_description: FPS Training is a game designed to train your skills in FPS (First Person Shooter) games. The game includes a series of challenges that will train all of your skills, such as aiming, reflexes, recoil control and more!

name: Scary Teacher 3D
short_description: Sneak, prank, and outsmart Miss T in this suspenseful, humorous 3D puzzle-stealth game! It’s time to Scare the Scary High School Teacher !

name: Kitten Love Emulator
short_description: Come explore a disgustingly LOVE-addled world! Solve 'puzzles' in ever-changing, emotion-based, overly-hyphenated levels -- while hunting down the murderer. Experience an ever tightening knot in your stomach as you realize: "Something is terribly wrong here, and I don't want to dig any deeper".

name: Bubble Burst
short_description: Bubbles... Only you can stop them. Collect three bubbles of the same color or more to burst them. You are waiting for a lot of exciting levels. You will also receive special bubbles that will not let you be bored.

name: VoidGate
short_description: VoidGate is a third-person dungeon crawling action-RPG. It consists of randomly generated dungeons, lite survival elements, and permanent death.

name: SAMS
short_description: Classic shooter with traveling to various exotic planets.

name: Gyro Boss DX
short_description: Dodge an endless assault of weapons as you orbit around the boss on a fixed circle, it's not as easy as it looks. Can you secure bragging rights as the best space pilot to bite the dust against the alien menace?

name: Puyo Puyo Champions
short_description: Easy to learn, tough to master! Challenge friends and family in local multiplayer or compete globally via online matchmaking. Built for all ages, this puzzle game comes with a surprisingly competitive edge.

name: DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb
short_description: A new DragonScales journey with expanded tile-matching challenges, battles, and extra missions. Zarya's adventure comprises 200 levels, new (and weird) characters, a few tricky puzzles, and unlockable power-ups. Her ultimate goal: releasing the dragon sealed in The Frozen Tomb!

name: Failspace
short_description: Failspace is a Co-op, crisis-solving, multiplayer VR game where you have to nurture your fragile spaceship through the ever-changing dangers of space. Up to 4 people can join the mission where their skills, resilience and friendship will be tested all across the galaxy.

name: Montaro RE
short_description: The DOGE is back!

name: Cake Bash
short_description: Fight to be the tastiest cake in Cake Bash! A frantic four player party game where adorable drawn-to-life cakes beat the crumbs out of each other.

name: ALARA Prime
short_description: The groundbreaking free-to-play, 4v4v4 competitive tactical first-person shooter. Choose your class, utilize an array of gadgets, dominate the game or play the other teams against each other.

name: To Hell With Dave
short_description: 'To Hell With Dave' is a narrative-driven adventure platformer for the connoisseur of the absurd. Explore a world full of charming characters and twisted humor. If you're a fan of challenging action, wacky puzzles and foul language, this game is for you!

name: The Wizard's Tower
short_description: The Wizard's Tower is a Tower Defence game that gives you direct control over the Towers. Using three different elements to maximum effect to stop your foes from destroying your main Tower.

name: Elemental Connection
short_description: Minimalist abstract puzzle board game about making elemental connections. Match tiles to create a satisfying mosaic.

name: Tomb of Friends +
short_description: A Futurespective exploration software about life, death, and friends in a toast-apocalyptic Negaverse.... Or something.

name: Ships That Fight Underground (STFU)
short_description: Experience a 6-degrees-of-freedom ship shooter across pulse pounding single player, co-op, and PvP gameplay. Choose your class and ship then customize and upgrade with unique cosmetics, powerful mods, and class-based tech trees. Level up and light em' up!

name: Solitaire Mystery: Four Seasons
short_description: Top Rated Hidden Object and Solitaire Game Play! Great for All Ages

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2019
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2019 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite professional basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: Raiders! Forsaken Earth
short_description: Raiders! Forsaken Earth is a strategy/management game where you play as the leader of a merciless band of post-apocalyptic marauders. Build up your organization while extorting, kidnapping, and destroying the last remnants of civilization. The wasteland doesn't need another hero...

name: Super Captain 3D
short_description: Super Captain 3D is a shoot-em-up game where you become a Super Hero ready to fight the Pixel Invaders. It features an art style that combines 3D pre-renders with 2D pixel art. Use your Superpowers to protect the Universe!

name: Bots Rush
short_description: Bots Rush is a unique mix of Tower Defense and logistic puzzle. You will find a set of interesting and complicated game levels, original enemies. Your task is simply to build a network of roads to deliver resources to factories and ammo to towers. Sounds easy, right? Lets check this out.

name: The Witch's Love Diary
short_description: Spring is here and love awaits, an oasis just over the horizon, a beautiful story waiting to be told. Join Takumi and Alice in a tale of fleeting cherry blossoms and forgotten first love.

name: Geno The Fallen King
short_description: Geno the Fallen King is a fast-paced 2D platformer with fluid movement and easy to master mechanics. Sprint and lunge through vibrant environments and satisfying collectibles. With tight and responsive movement you can blast your way through the open, secret filled levels.

name: 祛魅·入灭（祛魅2）
short_description: 祛魅·入灭（祛魅2）是一款小清新像素风回合制角色扮演游戏，是祛魅系列历代作品中最好的一款。剧情发生在一代教化事件结束三个月后的极北之地，玩家将体验主角月泷烟的爱情与复仇，领略步步走向灭亡的不归路。

name: WatchFamily
short_description: The game "WatchFamily" is a mini game that satirizes the image of our ordinary young man who wants to take the time of his own by avoiding the eyes of the family who watches over and over.

name: Deep Space Shooter
short_description: Again you are alone against the hordes of hostile spacecrafts where you can only rely on yourself. It is the victory or the death!

name: FlyingMetalSuit
short_description: FlyingMetalSuit is an VR aerial racing game. You fly in a superhero-style in an amazing suit during incredibles and dangerous races. 12 Grand Prix, 3 differents worlds, up to the challenge ?

name: DashboardX
short_description: Manage, create and share Windows settings in one single app.

name: Houdini's Castle
short_description: SOLVE THE MYSTERIES OF HOUDINI'S CASTLE Beautiful Hidden Object Game Play Combined with Mysterious Adventure! All Ages Game Play!

name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime
short_description: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime is your game. Beautiful and colorful images of anime kawaii style with a comfortable and intuitive interface and relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these puzzles.

name: Dog In A Box
short_description: Dog In A Box is a virtual reality dog building game, allowing the player to step into the shoes of a travelling toy dog maker. As you step into the shoes of the toy maker, you should expect to receive unexpected orders for toy dogs in often strange locations.

name: FightBit
short_description: FightBit is a side-scrolling beat-em-up with pseudo 8-bit graphics and rudimentary gameplay influenced by contemporary melee focused combat games. Defeat the Dragon Queen and her army!

name: Thingamajig
short_description: Create, play and share interactive VR-based experiences.

name: The Misadventure Of Melon
short_description: Join Melon in this Misadventure that takes him through 6 amazing chapters, Snow, Caves, Forest, Swamp, Mountains and Corrupted lands to battle through corrupted creatures and to make your way back to the village and save the world from this evil.

name: Termite
short_description: The ultimate real-time action strategy experience

name: Block Pooper 9
short_description: Ride a high velocity stream of blocky effluence to glory in this local multiplayer brawler.

name: Gems Kingdom
short_description: Play as a warrior, a knight or a shinobi and embark on a journey to find the most precious gem in this match-three game. 6 classes to play, 4 mini games and many levels await you.

name: Steel Sword Story S
short_description: The classic 2D side-scrolling action game has evovled! With twice the content, better controls, and higher accessibility, Steel Sword Story S is bigger and better than ever!

name: 逗国科举 | Douguo Keju
short_description: Following the ancient imperial examination system of China, including private school test, children's birth test, rural test, meeting test, Palace test, and finally according to the achievements, the National Entrance Examination has won the champion list.

name: TAL: Jungle
short_description: TAL: Jungle - In this game you need to help your hero go through a maze, avoiding traps.

name: Matter
short_description: Dive into a mystical world where gravity crumbles and landscapes transform. Matter is a dreamlike platformer, a contemplative and abstract journey. Explore a strange universe in 30 minutes of serene parkour, where matter and sound harmonize with your actions. A unique sensory experience awaits!

name: Sam & Dan: Floaty Flatmates
short_description: Oh nooo, the world is flooded! Oh no, there is also a really big shark! You are a survivor of the apocalypse, stuck in your apartment, all by yourself, so sad... Across the street there is another survivor. Let's wave to each other, work together and both reach the boat to get to safety!

name: Damn Zombies
short_description: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemi

name: Saints Row®: The Third™ Remastered
short_description: The Full Package, Remastered – With enhanced graphics, improved lighting, reworked environments, and visual effects, Steelport and The Third Street Saints have never looked so good.

name: RGB RUN
short_description: RGB RUN is a fast and hardcore runner, the fractal labyrinths of which will try to piss you off. The first thing that is required from you is a fast reaction and a good memory.

name: Spinheads

short_description: FIND-LIFE. It is a ship that was launched in space in 2018 and had as mission to find life in another place. On board were three crew members in hibernation. Two died, leaving only the player. But there is one more crew on board. The computer "PT-X" with artificial intelligence.

name: Roombo: First Blood
short_description: Roombo: First Blood is a comedic, top-down, stealth-action game about being a robot vacuum cleaner and fending off burglars from your home. A short, experimental game and the first in the JUSTICE SUCKS series.

name: KungFu Kickball
short_description: KungFu Kickball is the fighting-sports game where the best ball kicker wins! Punch, kick, and headbutt your way across the field to smash the ball into your opponents' bell and rack up points!

name: Final Fantasy Tactics - The Ivalice Chronicles
short_description: Featuring fully voiced dialogue, beautifully enhanced graphics, and countless gameplay improvements, the genre-defining tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.

name: Unlock Me
short_description: "Unlock Me" is a highly intelligent puzzle game, You should move/punch these cubes carefully to the designated target points using keyborad 4 keys ↑ ↓ ← → .

name: POCKET CAR : VRGROUND
short_description: 'POCKET CAR: VR GROUND' is a game where you make your own AI mini-car. Customize your own car to participate in the game, and win the race through various strategies and 'PIT IN'.

name: iDancer
short_description: iDancer is a unique video incrustation technology to display professional dancers who come and dance directly on your taskbar, with no background, at the rhythm of the music played on your computer.

short_description: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode…

name: Maiden and Spell
short_description: Maiden & Spell is a magical girl battle game, set in a cutesy fantasy world. Select from one of eight young ladies to battle 1 on 1 with a friend, or fight your way through a series of bosses and learn the secrets of The Kingdom of Stars.

name: Noel's Hope
short_description: If you are interested in magic, dark and dangerous dungeons with traps and enemies, unusual islands, bright weather conditions, mysteries, stories, sea voyages on your own ship, hiding deep secrets through the ocean, then this adventure is for you!

short_description: This JRPG was made for true JRPG fans. As an employee of PsyOps Solutions, you will need to complete the Contract given to you: Kill General Swanson. You are going to need to explore, fight, and help people out to become strong enough to complete your mission.

short_description: Aquatica is real-time RPG in the scenery of a secret underwater base. Explore the environment, find out who real its inhabitants and why you got rescue. Become one of them or escape.

name: The Secret Order 7: Shadow Breach
short_description: There are dark secrets that have an annoying tendency to crawl back into the light, escaping oblivion. But there is also Sarah Pennington, the most skilled agent of the ever-watching Secret Order, who is there to face them.

name: Argonauts Agency: Golden Fleece
short_description: Argonauts Agency: go on an adventure and solve the case of the missing Golden Fleece!

name: Fabulous - Angela's True Colors

name: 東方翠神廻廊 〜 Faith in the Goddess of Suwa.
short_description: “Touhou Suijin Kairou” is a Touhou derivative RPG featuring over 150 fantasy girls! Explore the corridors and solve the strange situation in Gensokyo! A profound story unfolds, and your choices will change the future!

short_description: It is a very funny, fast and easy game which can be played by adults as well as children. This game has two teams that try to prevent each other from winning.

name: 最后的47小时 - The Last 47 Hours

name: Touhou Fantasia / 东方梦想曲
short_description: This is a fan-made Touhou shmup with one single stage, similar to the extra stage of official Touhou games. This game has an auto dodging system, which gives you a choice to ignore all the danmaku and only focus on the story.

short_description: Lead the main hero in his journey to become an Empire Patron to collect artifacts to gain power over other nations and races by building a reputation and armies, explore a dark fantasy open-world RPG with combat and magic.

name: Catalyst
short_description: Catalyst is an interactive narrative into the world on psychotherapy. The story is told through newspaper articles, notes left by a disgruntled secretary, unwelcome letters, audio tape recordings and a unique journal that evolves throughout the game based on the player’s own insightful analysis.

name: Aztec Tower
short_description: Aztec Tower is a free VR bow & arrow game about defending the temple of your people against the spanish conquistadors.

name: SmartyTale 2D
short_description: Fascinating, full of mysteries, an adventure with a storyline unfolded in the style of good old games with Retro Consoles!

name: Dead Wishes
short_description: In this chaotic world, you must adapt - either to forgive or survive. A thriller-romance indie visual novel/dating simulator.

name: Supernatural Story
short_description: When the Past and the Present intertwine, everything that you used to know may not be the same anymore. Supernatural occurrences and unexpected phenomena, in what seems to be or not to be. An action atmospheric storyline that will keep you on the edge of your seat and make you hunger for more.

name: Infinite Art Museum
short_description: The Infinite Art Museum is a free, permanent virtual reality museum and archive of art. Explore a growing collection of over 800 original paintings, illustrations, digital art and photographs from artists around the world.

name: HENTAI MINESWEEPER
short_description: Legendary game "minesweeper" in a unique performance and atmosphere

name: Nomads of the Fallen Star
short_description: A trade sim & turn-based squad-RPG set in a dynamic & living sci-fi post-apocalyptic world. Take the reigns of a rag-tag scavenger gang as they unravel the mystery of the Fallen Star.

name: ANDROMALIUS
short_description: Spending the first night in a new apartment can be quite nervewracking. New sounds, and thin walls that seperate you from others in the complex. Do you trust your new surroundings?

name: Nero GameVR
short_description: Nero GameVR is an app that lets you play non-VR games in an immersive environment with your Oculus Rift or HTC Vive.

name: Hero Staff
short_description: HERO STAFF is a new "Old" Action Role-Playing Game inspired by classics such as Zelda, Dragon Quest and the not that old Fairune. It's a world of puzzles!

name: Life is Pointless
short_description: Earn points in an attempt to find meaning in your normally pointless existence.

name: Border Control
short_description: Defend America from murderous zombie hordes, waves of unwashed orcs, and the military stength of enemy nations all bent on the destruction of the homeland.

name: SIMULACRA 2
short_description: A dead influencer. An obsessed detective. Three suspects. Piece the truth together by going through the victim’s phone messages, videos, and social media in the follow up to the critically acclaimed SIMULACRA.

name: Settlement Zero

name: Bleeding Hunt VR Chap.1
short_description: Experience the movie-like escaping plot with chasing, shooting, and thrilling!The game brings player a short but satisfying VR experience by reproducing the process of a highly-intense chasing plot with the highest quality of game graphic that you’ve ever seen so far in VR!

short_description: Hotel R’n’R, the gonzo VR rockstar simulator! Sell your soul to The Devil, smash up hotels and become Infamous. Pressure from hotel staff and your own limp wrists are against you, but with over 40 weapons, and a World Tour ahead of you, it’s time to get creative.

short_description: This consists of 40 mini-games that you can enjoy together. You can have a happy time with your friends and family. However, sometimes you may have to prepare for the destruction of friendship.

name: PARSE ALLY
short_description: The ancient system, without waiting for help, was destroyed. You are next. Yes? You and the survivors, grouped to repel the onslaught of the intruders. Of course, not all people will support you: there are those who are more interested in continuing the existing conflicts.

name: Whiskey & Zombies: The Great Southern Zombie Escape
short_description: WHISKEY & ZOMBIES is a comedy-adventure brawler/stealther set in a different kind of apocalypse where the only thing that kills the virus is moonshine whiskey. So to survive... just Drink, Fight, and Stay Alive.

name: Outliver: Redemption
short_description: Derek Okoye’s accident on the day of a big trial becomes a window for redeeming his lost values…

name: Field of Glory: Empires

name: Bus Mechanic Simulator

Buy up routers, upgrade cable networks and deal with packet jams as you earn money to research new and better upgrades.

name: Wizard And Minion Idle
short_description: Train your stats, cast spells, feed your minion, defeat monsters and bosses, raise demons, craft gems, go fishing and so much more in Wizard and Minion Idle--WAMI. This free to play, solo developed, Idle/active hybrid game has flexible pacing for long-time play-ability.

name: Super Gerry
short_description: Laxity Media presents a wonderful Jump 'n Run game. You must help Gerry to find the exit portal of the music wonderland. Don't lose the violin or you will not be able to return. Collect all the note bubbles. Don't fall into the rift. Be aware of the Groupies ! GO GO GO !!!

short_description: Light The Way is a first-person horror adventure game. It takes place in a storage house after your character is kidnapped by a stranger.

name: Night is Coming
short_description: Survival strategy game set in a world inspired by Slavic mythology and the nature of Eastern Europe. Build your settlement, protect its dwellers, and help them prepare for the coming Darkness.

name: Dungeon Cleaning Express
short_description: Dungeon Cleaning Express is a 2D action platformer in which you play as a professional dungeon cleaner which uses bombs and dynamite to destroy monsters and other hostile creatures in dungeons and cellars - not that easy but almost always effective and generally lots of fun!

name: Radio General
short_description: It's WWII. You're a general sitting in a tent. All you have is a map, and a radio. Can you win the battle? Radio General is a unique strategy game where you interact with your units over the radio using speech recognition. Test your mettle and relive famous battles as a WWII general.

name: Electric Sleep
short_description: Electric Sleep is a pixel art interactive story. Explore a crumbling world through the perspective of different emotions.

name: Border Force
short_description: It is 10:59PM on March 29th 2019. With one minute to go until Britain's exit from the European Union is formalised, you are ready to get to work. The UK's safety is in your hands. You are Border Force.

Enjoy sketching and concept modeling in 3D space by simply moving the controllers in your hands. Design professional products with this intuitive app specifically tailored to virtual reality.

short_description: Delivery Attempted. That's the Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee! T.R.D.S. is a ragdoll physics simulation about terrible package delivery couriers. Work together using odd machinery, useful gadgets, and the wonders of physics to reliably deliver packages to their destination.

In a distant corner of the galaxy, what was meant to be a routine repair job has turned into a nightmarish scenario for a young technician thrust upon the front lines of a crisis.

name: Dies irae ~Interview with Kaziklu Bey~
short_description: The world of Dies irae returns with an all-new side story based around LDO member Wilhelm Ehrenburg. The subject of an interview in a dusty bar, the legendary "Kaziklu Bey" recounts the tale of a conflict he suffered long in the past...

Players can also use the keyboard to join the game in 2D mode. In addition, the game also has a lot of Chinese elements.

name: Why Chicken? Why?
short_description: Which came first? The chicken or the egg? More importantly, why did the chicken cross the road? For the 25 golden eggs of course!!!

name: Buoyancy
short_description: Buoyancy is a city-building strategy game where you build, manage, and move a floating city on an oceanic world. Explore and scavenge resources scattered around the endless waters. Keep your villagers nourished and happy while combating fires, sickness, and pirate attacks.

Until the full moon night, the cursed person will be inhaled into the alien world. Players play one of the immortals and start their own journey to survive.

short_description: Summoned into a world of only women, and tasked by the Demon Queen to fortify her dungeon against the world's strongest heroines. Use perverted traps to capture them one and a time, and force them to submit. Build a mighty harem and who knows, it might bring the Demon Queen to her knees...

name: mini PVP

name: Kingdom-Heroes

Quickly jump into a dozen different game modes hosted on free servers worldwide to battle, cooperate, race, and survive with/against other Pioneers all over the globe!

name: Estellium Legends

Now, you are stuck in limbo and you must relive every thing and try to collect all of the memories you can find.
