short_description: WASarD is a rogue-lite single stick shooter. Maneuver your auto-casting wizard between dangerous enemies and hundreds of projectiles. Purchase passive charms, unlock permanent wards, and use powerful relics to give yourself an edge in each new randomly generated dungeon.

name: Those Chosen By God
short_description: Those Chosen By God Is a story driven, text heavy rpg that's more story than gameplay. It follows the life of Aden. (Pronounced in game as /ah, den/ ) Born into an appalling void known as the world. Aden must fight both mentally and physically If he wishes to survive the cruelty thrown at him.

name: Color Defense
short_description: Color Defense is an idle/clicker game with a tower defense theme. You can choose between different towers and upgrades to survive as long as you can.....

name: Buissons
short_description: Take control of a bush and challenge your friends in a hide and seek game up to 4 players. Move at night and use the day as an opportunity to observe and beat your opponents. Use the secrets of nature to trap them. Get ready to laugh!

name: Super Minesweeper attACK
short_description: You can play minesweeper, but you can have custom skins, campaign puzzles and your very own pet who evolves as you play. You can create your own skins and your own campaigns.

name: Commanders of Valor
short_description: A tabletop RPG strategy game set two centuries before common era

name: Magnet Fishing Simulator
short_description: Magnet Fishing Simulator is a relaxing and immersive treasure-hunting adventure where you fish for sunken relics with powerful magnets, restore them to glory, and upgrade your gear to unlock deeper, more mysterious waters.

name: Slip 'n Slime
short_description: Slip 'n slide around this casual puzzle adventure! Be a cute slime and explore a magical world. Only stop sliding when you run into something -- SPLAT! Perfect to pick up 'n play for a minute or binge in a weekend.

name: Psihanul
short_description: PSIHANUL- you will take revenge on the bosses and colleagues for the fact that you were fired, shoot and break everything around you, do not leave anything behind you, destroy this office and no one will help you in this, so good luck and don't freak out.

name: Return Of The Zombie King
short_description: Return of the Zombie King is a 2D-RUNNER, with a 1-BUTTON control system. Start with a dead king who can't jump, see, or hear anything. COLLECT as much gold as you can and UPGRADE him by buying back all his body parts. Then buy magic upgrades such as double jump and protection spells

name: Dark Romance: The Ethereal Gardens Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you defeat an evil fairy queen to avenge your father?

name: Sword of the Slayer
short_description: Fight monsters and free the ancient city with your enchanted talking sword!

name: Elmarion: Dragon time
short_description: “Elmarion: Time of the Dragon” is an RPG game, the main character of which is the dragon! The player will find many adventures and tasks, controlling not a human character, as in most RPGs, but a flying fire-breathing dragon. Aim of the game: to repel the invasion of the undead.

name: Taimanin Asagi 1: Trial
short_description: The long-running visual novel franchise is on Steam, complete with official English translation! After her final mission to protect the mankind from invasive forces of the dark, the former anti-demon ninja Igawa Asagi faces the treacherous debauchery that awaits her in the darkest depth of Tokyo.

name: Bowsette
short_description: Bowsette, the monster queen in the forest, found that her men were beginning to rebel. Bowset decided to teach them a lesson and let them know who was the real owner.

name: Lighted Knights
short_description: Engage in a pure RPG experience in this new world permeating with magic and fantastic creatures. Battle through haunted forests, crawl through deadly dungeons and explore caves for hidden treasures in order to reveal the secrets of the Lighted Knights.

name: Might is Right
short_description: Might is Right is an old-school turn-based strategy game, it has simple controls and deep complex mechanics.

name: Furry Shakespeare: Love's Lizards Lost
short_description: You've just landed in a new world, set to discover new mysteries and solve great conflicts. You're also a small reptile.

name: Furry Shakespeare: Dashing Dinosaurs & Sexy Centaurs: Winter's Tale
short_description: Do you like sappy holiday movies? Well, now you're in one. Save the day with your band of holiday elves.

name: The Void of Desires
short_description: The is space filled with rumours of the temple, in which any desire can be fulfilled. Many tried to find it, but only two space refugees managed to discover it, whose planet was destroyed by the halfgod Constructor. Now they have a long path ahead - straight to the wishgranter.

name: Demonarch
short_description: A first-person strategy game about summoning demons and herding them around like terrible cats to topple a civilization one castle at a time and finally become the new king, all on the orders of the guy who already did that and now spends his time making the people learn his tale.

name: ESCAPE FROM VOYNA: ALIENS FROM ARENA 51
short_description: Escape from Voyna: AFA is an action packed realistic single player shooter set in the era of the Cold War on russian soil. After many nuclear tests the land is devastated and apocalypse spreading. You, a secret agent stranded on an island try to escape without getting caught by enemy soldiers.

name: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk DX
short_description: "The promise begins." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters. The 1st title in the series "Atelier Ayesha" is now available as a deluxe version.

name: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky DX
short_description: "The promise is entrusted to two alchemists..." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters.

name: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea DX
short_description: "A story of two girls fulfilling their wishes." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters. The 3rd title in the series "Atelier Shallie" is now available as a deluxe version.

name: The Adventures of Looppy
short_description: More than a platformer![/]

name: Book of Travels
short_description: Ready your pack, grab your walking stick and step into a world of mystery. Craft your character and immerse yourself in the enchanted lands of Braided Shore. Set your own goals and adventure alone or together with Travellers you meet on the road in this serene TMORPG.

name: CLIMB OUT!
short_description: You have fallen and you must CLIMB OUT!

name: Theology - Religion Creator
short_description: Create your very own religion and make history by dominating the whole wide world! Define your dogmas and wage holy wars on land, sea, and in the sky. Convert as many as you can to your belief system!

name: Karate Cat
short_description: Break, hit, meow! Play for the best karate cats in the world! Their paws are not the softest.

name: Heraldry Studio
short_description: Tool for making your own coat of arms is here! Heraldry Studio allows user to create and export a unique coat of arms, according to the rules of heraldry.

name: Party Pumper
short_description: Born in the vibrations of music, Party Pumper is a game about parties and for parties! Player's goal is to entertain the audience by mixing a music samples. Combine this with a dance movements and fun party gadgets action, interact with partygoers crowd and pump the party!

name: Creeps Creeps? Creeps!
short_description: A game whose goal is to pump the main character and defeat the boss. To do this, you need to earn gold by killing creeps in the forest. Lots of creeps. A lot of creeps.

name: Death To The Dragon Lord
short_description: For over a millennia the land of Aforn has been under the tyrannical rule of the Dragon Lord. All attempts to overthrow him have led to near genocide, but the Dragon Lord's cruelty is so great that despite the consequences another revolt is brewing.

name: Shark Castle
short_description: An atmospheric adventure featuring a sentient shark. Your castle is overrun with pollution, endangering you and your friends! Navigate toxic pipes, avoid robot minions, and save your home.

name: Who Is You
short_description: Who is You is a game in which you have to help the main character figure out himself. Create a character, make the right choice from the proposed ones, control your budget, take care of your health, take a rest in time and return to the painted world.

name: Timmy's adventures : VerbMon
short_description: Timmy's Adventures VerbMon is an adventure game, fun, educational for kids or parents to learn english irregular verbs ! Capture "VerbMons" using irregular verbs. Catch them all!

name: Ann Achronist: Many Happy Returns
short_description: Rewrite history in this charming time-travelling tale by diving into Regency England, rescuing your ancestor and changing both your lives for the better - one timeline at a time!

name: PixelForces.io
short_description: PixelForces.io is a challenging 3D shooting online game.

name: Snake: The Elder Forest
short_description: The Elder Forest is a special world with ancient forest that is in danger. To save this world the Snake was called from another one. So before the danger is coming, you should become more powerful to be ready to repel the Elder Forest!

name: Orbital Shipyards
short_description: Build, Explore, Fight. Build a ship of your imagination, explore the vast cosmos, and fight for your stake in the galaxy.

name: Operation: Cheek Clapper
short_description: Storm the base and clap alien cheeks in this fast-paced action game. Instant, quick, no fuss, alien fun!

name: Gridcannon Evolution
short_description: Gridcannon is a tactical solitaire card game where the player attempts to eliminate all royal cards (Jack, Queen, King) by strategically placing number cards on a grid.

name: The Inn Between: Prologue
short_description: A dark and atmospheric third person RPG with turn-based combat, puzzles, and a focus on exploration. Acquire party members and make choices that shape the world around you. Discover secrets lurking behind every corner!

name: The House In The Hollow
short_description: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey like no other. A journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

name: Asterminer
short_description: Dive into a serene, atmospheric journey in space. Control a mining ship, train, and operator on distant planets and asteroids. Gather resources for your loved ones in this immersive, slow-paced, grounded sci-fi adventure.

name: 四季 The Four Seasons
short_description: 春天般青涩、单纯的腼腆少年,夏日般阳光、善良的漂亮少女,秋风般飒爽、不羁的神秘少年,冬霜般凄冷、悲凉的阴郁少女,四个性格迥异的人,四段各自的成长,在如诗如歌的年华里交织在一起,汇成了一首四季交响曲。请用心聆听,这四时变化带来的奇妙旋律。

name: Buggy Bump
short_description: Welcome to the Buggy Bump festival. Buggy Bump is a racing experience like no other. Offering moment-to-moment racing in VR or on the screen.{headset not required for screen play}. Race through the desert festival setting by day and night, Every bump counts as you have to watch out for not just the other drivers but the track itself.

name: Love with Kadyrov
short_description: Spend an unforgettable evening with the cutest, smartest, handsome, strong, courageous, gentle, sensitive man in Russia and the World. Use gems to melt Ramzan’s heart.

name: Everslash
short_description: Everslash is an action platformer game where you have to move quickly and attack with your scythe. Use your Slash Attack move to dodge and strike your foes at the same time; defeat the monsters infesting the lab and find your way out.

name: BounceBall3D
short_description: Bouncing Ball has come 3D!

name: Little Red Riding Hood
short_description: 小红帽一个人，前往住在森林里的外婆家。 去的路上，在花田里做了小小的花束。 一路上，小红帽没有遇到大灰狼。然后就到了外婆家。 没有遇到大灰狼。 难道是我路上耽搁得不好吗？——小红帽她不明白。 那为什么 外婆，被杀掉了呢？

name: The Delirium Vacation

short_description: N⸱a⸱N Industry is a VR puzzle game where you build a "factory" by placing action blocks in space, arranged so that the inputs move towards the expected output location—their blocks possibly modified, split or combined along the way.

short_description: Trails of the Black Sun is a first-person shooter and platformer hybrid, set in a digital simulation, where you, an Initiate, will have to find hidden artifacts and forbidden meanings. Use your acrobatic skills and defeat the Templars, fulfilling your Ultimate Quest 🔥

short_description: Espionage is hard work. You will have to get to the enemy base and pretend to be your own among strangers. Can you cope with your task and can you prevent a war? But remember that you only have one hour left. But remember that you only have one hour left.

name: Jigsaw puzzle - Evolution
short_description: This game is an educational jigsaw puzzle game. The content of the game covers the whole process from the formation of the earth to the emergence of civilization. You can learn about the formation of the earth, the formation of the moon, the origin of life, the theory of evolution, and the origin of civilization by playing games.

name: Primate Signal

name: Juicy Army: Prologue

short_description: Four friends break a mysterious crystal and move to another dimension, where adventure awaits them. Pixels can fight is a fun platformer that will challenge you and your friends.

name: Rally Drift Cars

name: ROAD HOMEWARD 4: last step

short_description: Experience a 10 minute dive into the unknown depths of the multiverse!

name: PARA♰BELLUM ~ 魔弹帕菈

name: Wormskull
short_description: (Single player RPG) Rising from the much enjoyed Ashes of the Night, Wormskull unveils itself with Duncan and Maduin finding themselves constantly running. They dodge at every turn, ever evading the grotesque hand of doom that reaches for them and the rest of the world.

short_description: Bumble Butt is a frenetic arcade game where Betty Buzz takes out nasty bugs with the power of her bottom! Or rather, the stingers she shoots out of it! That's right, player's are always shooting in the direction opposite they're facing!

name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
short_description: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM: Japanese Drift Master! Take on challenging roads with refined simcade physics, immerse in the story through manga pages, and explore an open world inspired by stunning real-life areas. Every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

name: Love wish
short_description: Love Wish is an easy, fun and challenging jigsaw puzzle.♪(^∇^*) Put the pieces together to restore the full picture of the girls. Collect their photos and animations and remember this wonderful moment❤

name: Daily OVR Free

You can adjust the position, size and transparency, bind desktop windows to controllers, HMD or the world, type with a VR keyboard, customize button settings, detect and display objects (ex: keyboard) by machine learning.

name: 6Souls
short_description: 6Souls is an exciting 2D pixel-art action-adventure platformer. Join Jack and his dog, Butch, as they embark on an adventurous journey to find the abandoned Clifford Castle and uncover its secrets and the fate of the Clifford family.

name: Old School Maze
short_description: Get out of the maze of nostalgia.

short_description: Concept Destruction is a demolition derby sandbox with miniature cars made of cardboard. Crash them into each other to earn points by destroying other vehicles. Pick a car model and crash other concept cars to begin mass production!

short_description: In those days when the world was still young... Nothing foreshadowed trouble: people, elves and fairies lived in relative calm.

short_description: A walking simulator for cars - or "driving simulator" - about meaninglessness, car parks, and the end of the world. Or is it...?

name: White Shadows
short_description: The wolves are watching! Venture through a captivating but brutal dystopia where our young adventurer Ravengirl will travel through this huge city’s brightest highs and delve to its darkest depths on her perilous journey of discovery and finding her destiny where hope seems in short supply.

name: CounterShots 1.0
short_description: CounterShots 1.0 is a very well-developed action game, from which you will get a lot of positive emotions. Fight for the best points in the game in the company of friends, in a pleasant landscape with opponents who have strong intelligence.

name: Dream Detective
short_description: It’s a game for kids from 0 to 100 years old.

name: Blazing Sails
short_description: Fight for survival in Blazing Sails, a fast-paced pirate PvP game! Create your own unique pirate and ship. Band together with other players to command your mighty vessel! short_description: A squad-based tactical RPG with fluid turn-based combat, outpost, and followers management, set in the expansive fantasy world of Zoria. Lead a team of four heroes with their unique skills and perks. Every team member contributes to undertaken battles.

name: VReken

Punch, headbutt and kick (with additional trackers) your way through intense situations in immersive urban environments.

name: Occultus Command
short_description: It is the year 3260, a cosmic storm named Father's Wrath threatens to end life on Earth's upper layer. The surest way to survive Father's Wrath is to escape underground to a world called Occultus. Information on the incoming storm and Occultus is encrypted, hidden and monitored.

name: PANDARA
short_description: Simple 2D scrolling shooter. Button controls are shot and speed switching. English and Japanese subtitles are available, and the UI is English only. Defeating enemies and gaining experience levels up your shot. The more mistakes you make, the better your defense.

The realm will have a chance to spawn randomly generated groups of either monster camps, chests, dungeons, bosses, and resources for you to explore and collect.

name: The Bloodline

name: Future Simulation World
short_description: Drawing on the existing real-world data and current state-of-the-art research and exploration results, and taking into account historical data provided by the World Bank, a streamlined and relatively sensible data model that outlines all possible options for future development is built.

name: Taxi Simulator
short_description: Become a taxi driver and experience for yourself the everyday life in such interesting profession. One might think that working behind a taxi wheel is a dull and boring task. But you couldn’t be more wrong! In Taxi Simulator you'll play as a shady rap driver and drive through the wildly urban areas.

name: Moe Era

Inspired by The Witcher and Mount & Blade with a rich story with two playable characters. Relive the battle events and lead your troops to victory.

short_description: The Final Earth 2 is a vertical sci-fi city builder. Earth is unlivable, so you decide to create a space colony. Gather resources, then build and research your way to a better future! Grow your city from an exploration ship to a huge metropolis, full of advanced technology. What will you build?

name: Call of VII
short_description: VII is a puzzle adventure game with mysterious cult story inspired by the concept of Ludum Dare 45. Play as curious adventurers, follow the mythical and unnameable power lurking beneath, step into the deep unknown.

name: Legendary Sword
short_description: Note: The actual release time of this game is April 2023. Become a farmer, breed livestock, go out hunting in the sun, sneak into the castle at night as a thief, or bring your best weapons and armor to resist the invasion of the enemy. Finally, take the booty home.

name: Super Rhythm Duel
short_description: Super Rhythm Duel is a rhythm-based action game. Beat you enemies like a drummer!

name: Doom of the Clawn
short_description: The walking circus had just arrived to your town, in need of new members. You stumbled upon them, hoping to join but instead were taken and trapped inside their lair. Armed with a toy gun and the will to survive, you get up and start your escape!

name: Dark Quest 3
short_description: A rogue-lite tabletop that mixes card based exploration with turn based combat. Create your party, draw adventure cards, roll dice and fight monsters to defeat the sorcerer and his magic.

name: Mega Balls
short_description: Mega Balls is a game of precision and persistence as you attempt to save your pal Good Boi! Navigate your ball through levels with unique layouts and obstacles all while being pulled down by the force of gravity.

name: Love Rhythm
short_description: Behind the hustle and bustle of Seoul City lies many unqiue stories. It’s revolving love, ambition and even hatred and crime.

name: My Wet Leto Comic
short_description: 一个欢乐气氛的悬疑文字冒险类游戏。你将不断在十位不同身份的角色间切换视点来推进故事的发展并达成各种各样的结局。这是由一个个平凡而又独特的个人故事所拼出的新的物语，或许里面也有着你的故事……？

name: Stickman go
short_description: “Stickman go” is a puzzle game based on physics engine. In this game, player need to move stickman out of screen based on real physical phenomena. Sway, sway, sway. Don't stuck!

name: Takkyu Tournament Re:Serve
short_description: This fantasy kung fu ping-pong mashup pays homage to classic retro arcade games while incorporating fighting game trappings like blocking, parrying, unique fighters, and special moves.

name: The Kingdom of God
short_description: The Kingdom of God: Creation is an independent game integrating territory management, resource management, strategic chess and exploration. As a new God, players develop their own country in the dangerous universe and eventually become the king of the new generation of gods.

name: NecroLand : Undead Corps
short_description: In NecroLand: Undead Corps, you compete in online "battle royale" action to be the last survivor in a zombie-filled wasteland. You control an Alpha Unit that can “tame” legions of wandering undead and add them to your squadron of allies who obey your commands.

name: CubeParkour
short_description: A simple parkour-platformer to have some fun and pass time. You are a cube and you have to get from point A to point B as creatively as possible. That's it. There are 100 levels at the moment.

name: Sex Adventure - The Board Game
short_description: You want to impress your girlfriend and show her you're a great stallion in bed? This board game takes you in an erotic and playful way to the paradise of lust! Even as a single you should not miss this game to give your darling an unforgettable evening.

name: White Wings ホワイトウィングス
short_description: “White Wings” is an animated visual novel developed by pureworks Co., Ltd. of Japan. Famous Japanese singer "Chata" singing theme song, 40 anime CGs.Young men and women, three encounters, each carries sorrowful secrets in the cold winter. Embracing each other and absorbing the earth’s final, small bit of warmth.

name: Arrog
short_description: Arrog is an enigmatic puzzle adventure game featuring hand-drawn art and set in a bizarre black-and-white world with color accents.

name: Lovely Hentai
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

name: Mira
short_description: Mira is a Slavic-themed visual novel with adventure game elements. The gameplay has a strong emphasis on art, atmosphere, and story. Discover your destiny by walking into Navia, a magical land hidden from the eyes of mortals, and decide on its fate.

name: Forest Ranger Simulator
short_description: Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean and manage your forest in Forest Ranger Simulator. Ensure its long-lasting beauty and become a flawless Forest Ranger!

name: Cyborg Mechanic
short_description: Become a cyborg surgeon mechanic in shady and absurd cyberpunk underworld. Diagnose your clients, cut off limbs and remove organs, upgrade bodies and brains. Attach fancy augmentations during complex procedures. Fight for fame, but beware of police forces always on the lookout for the ones like you.

name: Hollow Island
short_description: Shape your own destiny: Explore, dig for riches, fish, grow crops, cook food, brew and sell potions, expand your property, fight monsters, build camps and hoard your treasures!

name: Skyland 1976
short_description: You are Simon Hopper who tries to find his missing sister Alice. Near the scene of the events stands Skyland, a secret government facility. You are convinced that Skyland members are responsible for her abduction. Break into the military base and discover the truth...

name: Ashkeep
short_description: Ashkeep is a character-based 3v3 stealth first-person shooter. Sneak your way to steal the objective using epic spy gadgets!

name: Wars of the Roses
short_description: Fight the various battles of the Wars of the Roses throughout the Medieval ages. Each campaign is themed around fights between the Lancaster and Yorkist houses during various different periods of the countries rule

name: Napoleon in Russia
short_description: Napoleons Invasion of Russia began on 24 June 1812 when the Grande Armée crossed the Neman River to engage and attempt to defeat the Russian army.

name: Death Park
short_description: Survive a deadly clown in a haunted amusement park. Solve puzzles, search for items, and make choices that shape your escape. Death Park is a first-person horror game with multiple endings, tense stealth, and terrifying moments.

name: Worms Rumble
short_description: Worms Rumble is Worms like you’ve never played it before, with intense, real-time, arena-based 32 player cross-platform combat. Get ready for Deathmatch and Last Worm Standing modes where you’re only ever a Holy Hand Grenade away from death!

name: Hero's Spirit
short_description: Explore a vast, open world - evade or defeat its monsters, arm yourself with knowledge and equipment, unravel layer upon layer of secrets, and ultimately confront the very magic threatening to destroy everything.

name: The Adventures of Willow and Ash
short_description: The Adventures of Willow and ash is a platform adventure game, with a classic style and feel. You play as Willow, a young mage looking for your love ash who was taken from her. You will have to traverse obstetrical and slay monsters as you make your way through the world.

name: Beast Brigade
short_description: The new mob arena game, Beast Brigade, delivers an intense, action-packed experience - bringing monsters and modern combat together. Armed with an arsenal of advanced and powerful weaponry, explore a wide variety of creatures to assist you.

name: All Day Dying: Redux Edition
short_description: A SINGLEPLAYER score attack game for quick sessions of focused adrenaline where you complete various goals and beat difficult score challenges. Only pure combat where precision and technique is rewarded

name: 时之终Klock
short_description: 因为无法通过审核，目前正在回炉重造。黑白风格，以卡牌战斗为主轴的角色扮演类奇幻风游戏，实体桌游电子化。A fantasy adventure story featuring card battles (Trading Card Game in digital edition, only supporting Chinese now).

name: Wire Lips
short_description: Leta’s life changed in one moment. She and her friend Lina found an old music box in the mountains... and soon Lina disappeared, leaving behind only a photograph and the ominous music box. Uncover the secrets in atmospheric third-person horror game.

name: Bondage Girl
short_description: This is a tight room escape game with binding elements. The player controls the bound heroine to search for the props, unlock the shackles, avoid the enemy and escape the chamber of secrets, and finally wins!

name: Nosferatu Lilinor
short_description: It is cute but extremely hard!!! The immortal girl keeps to be reborn any number of times even if she gets beaten. It is an action game that includes puzzle-like elements by learning the movement and timing of the enemies.

name: Dodge If you Can!
short_description: Dodge If you Can! A simple game where you will either emerge as a Master of strategy, or become a statistic. Will your strategy and wits prevail among the storm of bullets? Will you go down as a legend? Only you can decide. Now - Dodge, If you Can!

name: Ballance: The Return
short_description: Classic theme, more than classic. Hardcore gameplay, smooth sense of control, with breakthrough game performance, open the imagination of the puzzle, let people fondly.

name: Into The Maze
short_description: Traverse an alien maze and discover its secrets using a small drone with an arsenal of upgradeable abilities. You are a veteran astronaut sent with his team of researchers to unravel the mysteries and make first contact with whoever built the structure discovered on Mars.

name: Action Ball 2
short_description: Take to the skies with the thrilling, brick-busting excitement of Action Ball 2, the electrifying sequel to the hit arcade game! Soar above the clouds in your paddle-equipped ship and fight back the relentless robots in level after level of eye-popping fun.

name: Lethal Tempting Girls
short_description: This game combined “Gals,First Person Shooter and Machines”, you need to fight those dangerous machines to rescue those beautiful girls. But sometimes players might encounter girls controled by machines, you need to defeat her to make her free again.

name: West Sweety
short_description: Welcome to the bar in the wild west, in this game, you roled a cowboy, use bullets & the wisdom of luck to conquer the beauty...

name: I.G.I. Origins
short_description: It’s 1980, the Cold War balances precariously on the brink of full-scale conflict. Infiltrate a volatile and manipulative world of high-stakes espionage – your way. Plan and execute your missions against an enemy plotting all-out nuclear war in this tense and tactical first-person shooter.

name: Songs of Wuxia
short_description: "Songs of wuxia" is a role-playing game with Chinese and anime style. You will control the heroine, confirm her confidence, find the path of wuxia, then change the world.

name: Marko: Beyond Brave
short_description: Marko: Beyond Brave is an action-packed Metroidvania adventure. Wander through lush forests and crumbling castles, battle corrupted creatures, and escape intricate traps. Jump, slash, and shoot your way through challenging foes and mighty bosses inspired by Slavic myths and legends.

name: Land of Ngoto
short_description: Land of Ngoto is an atmospheric and immersive first person puzzle game. Enter a surreal african dreamworld and solve the logic puzzles blocking your way.

name: Business Wars - The Card Game
short_description: Business wars is a hardcore mix of strategy battles and business theory card game. Use your unique deck facing the business world situation, discover all possible strategy, and be the TOP 1 CEO in the business world!

name: Die Fantastischen VR - Fantaventura
short_description: "Fantaventura" is a trip to a psychedelic fantasy island with the legendary German rap group DIE FANTASTISCHEN VIER. The band takes you into the parallel world of their 1993 hit song "Tag am Meer" (A Day at the Beach). Here, time and place are stretched, and nothing is as it seems.

name: New York Mysteries: The Outbreak Collector's Edition
short_description: “New York Mysteries: The Outbreak” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects with unforgettable characters and challenging quests to conquer, plenty of mini-games and puzzles!

name: Unnamed Adventure/无名之旅
short_description: Unnamed Adventure, an indie action platformer where every single level, puzzle is crafted by hands. Wander around in a mysterious kingdom where surprise and finding may hide in every corner you visit.

name: Nympho Monster Domination
short_description: A man filled with pent-up sexual frustration is suddenly summoned to another world as it's would-be-savior. Dominate the hordes of horny monster girls to add to your mythical harem, and maybe while you're at it save the world?

name: 1971 PROJECT HELIOS
short_description: 1971 Project Heliosis a turn-based strategy game which combines modern warfare military tactics and close combat. Firearms and vehicles are scarce, conflicts and hostilities have no end, and the terrible freezing cold annihilates friends and foes in its path.

name: Pumpkin Jack
short_description: Pumpkin Jack is a Spooky Scary 3D platformer in which you embody Jack, the Mythical Pumpkin Lord! Dive into an Epic Adventure through otherworldly landscapes and help the Evil annihilate the Good!

name: MADELA
short_description: MADELA is a short indie game which is inspired of one day living in Istanbul.

name: Bare Butt Boxing
short_description: Fight in completely unregulated alien boxing bouts and punch out players online in BARE BUTT BOXING, a chaotic multiplayer brawler with physics-based characters.

name: Fateless
short_description: FPS game in which you defend Earth from monsters. You shoot the monsters with a double-barrel shotgun and other weapons and move through various buildings made of brick and stone. You make your way to the underground where the monsters came from and rid the planet of their presence.

name: Maximum Momentum
short_description: A speed running space adventure where you have no weapons, only your skill, speed, and reflexes to fly your way through. Missions can be completed as slow or as fast as your skill can handle so challenge yourself to be the speed running champion.

name: Timpu's treasure
short_description: When news of a great treasure hidden in a small town breaks, a professional treasure hunter is tasked with solving the clues that lead to it in this voxel-style point and click game.

name: The Cruxis Sword
short_description: An extra-terrestrial parasite has infected the planet and is causing its energy to become polluted. Follow our heroes as they partake on a journey to rid the planet of the darkness before its too late.

name: Terro Lunkka Adventures
short_description: Be a Hero game developer Terro and save Waste game store agreements from evil CIPE store evils

name: Kyle is Famous: Complete Edition
short_description: Kyle tries to prepare for his most important interview yet. Choose his path through over 100 endings and accept the consequences in this comedic adventure.

name: Robot Boy
short_description: Hi my name is RX-4, I am a robot, I can not control my body alone, try to help me go home please. Hmmmm ... I'm not going to hide it, I have no hope in you and I do not think you'll succeed. Already many people have tried to help me and have failed.

name: Disgrâce
short_description: Disgrace is an action adventure game that can certainly require a lot of thinking from the player. Done intentionally so as not to be too intuitive, the player will have to rely on their observation and deductions in order to progress in the game.

name: 反现实症候群γ - Counterrealstic Syndrome γ
short_description: 高楼上的微风轻拂少女的脸庞，她似乎已经准备好去迎接自己的结局。 果然，她期待已久的【银河铁道】已经向她驶来。 奇妙的星空之旅即将展开……

name: OctoFurry
short_description: A tetris attack puzzle style game in which you play as furry sorcerers trying to save their kingdom from the tentacles of an evil ancient race.

name: Underneath
short_description: Underneath is a rouge-like beat ’em up deeply focused on fast but tactical gameplay with a huge variety of possible ways to beat the game. Build your build, master your style of playing and enjoy the pain again and again.

name: Astro Combat
short_description: Astro Combat is a Pixel Space Shooter, with Action-RPG elements.

name: Cowboys vs Hipsters
short_description: Are you a cowboy or a hipster? Choose your team and defend the city! Cowboys vs Hipsters is a real time strategy game. Spawn down your cowboys or your hipsters, send them into the city to stand and fight. May the worthy team win!

name: 星礼研究所 | Sighchology Research Lab
short_description: In this game, you play as a student in the Sighchology Research Lab. In this dark place, you do research every night and day without sleep, because you have been given a great mission: to publish a piece of paper...

name: INVESTMENT HERO
short_description: In INVESTMENT HERO you will learn investing and increasing your capital in a beautiful, minimalistic way. Work hard, trade stocks or create a business with real estate - but do not go bankrupt!

name: Crimson Colosseum
short_description: Captured by a group on her way back home, the swordswoman Sachi is brought to a mysterious colosseum to serve as its latest cursed fighter. To escape from her predicament, she must defeat 7 other fighters to get back home...

name: Elementary Anatomy: With Story Mode
short_description: Do you know how many bones are in the human body? Explore your body down to the smallest detail. Up to 7,000 precisely modelled anatomy structures in your VR device. Amazing graphics and intuitive control allows you to explore the human anatomy from a whole new point of view. The Human Anatomy VR contains all anatomy systems.

name: The Knight of the Crimson Tower
short_description: Laura is a daughter of the lord of the Crimson Tower. To impress her friends she steals a certain thing from an old witch, so the witch curses her: now, when the full moon rises, Laura turns into a beast and is put in a cage of her tower. But would it be enough to hold her?

name: Consumed Awakening
short_description: Consumed Awakening is a strategic action game set in a dystopian future where mankind lives in a fading theocracy in the distant future among the stars.

name: Territory
short_description: Engage in intense interspecies conflict Expand your territory! Begin your journey as a tiny rodent struggling to solidify your place in this world. Avoid predators, grow, mark territory, and breed your way to the top of the food chain!

name: Tower Tag
short_description: Tower Tag is a hyper-dynamic futuristic paintball like PVP shooter with a grappling hook locomotion method that becomes second nature instantly. Without any motion sickness!...

name: Master Of Dodging
short_description: Master Of Dodging is a game testing player’s fast-reaction.You can pick a hero,pick 2 common skills,pick 2 items,and enter a level,try to survive from enemies coming from everywhere.

name: Hasfax
short_description: Unfamiliar place and memory loss. What would you do if you were in that position? Find out the true reason for your appearance here or just run away. Remember, looks are deceiving ...

name: SpaceVibes VR
short_description: An Artistic VR “Shooter” Game For Everyone! Enter space and enjoy shooting flying objects with a laser gun while jamming out to the SpaceVibes soundtrack! ** View long description for important details! **

name: Phoenix Tales
short_description: A hybrid adventure/RPG Something strange is happening in the land of Rydanthia. You arrive in the town of Northern Cross and quickly discover things are not what they seem. Can you solve the mysteries surrounding this threat? Can you live to tell the tale?

name: Rock Simulator
short_description: Become what you have always imagined, a rock with no responsibilities, no debt, and no worries. The only thing on your checklist is to exist and watch as time fades away...also to become the golden rock.

name: Realms of Darkness
short_description: Mix of realtime Strategy and MOBA in grimdark setting.

name: The Game We All Have To Play
short_description: A word of caution to disclaim: it's more a poetry than a game. The story goes the way you pull it. A bullet hell without bullets. What would I call it for my part? A piece of something. I hope, of art.

name: Wicked Willow
short_description: If they call me wicked for following my heart, then so be it. Awaken your inner witch, pursue forbidden love, and unlock your destiny in this visual novel adventure, with 8 unique plot paths.

name: Hentai Pazu
short_description: Enjoy the beauty girls picture and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

name: Totemic
short_description: Totemic is an action-adventure game set in a beautiful pixel art world. You play as Mara, a young woman equipped with an enchanted axe and the ability to absorb her foes powers and use them as her own.

name: Blaze Revolutions
short_description: Roll up, Light Up, Rise up! Live the story of Janet and Winston Blaze, follow in their quest to liberate their captured father. Unravel the mysteries of a world in which the giant SomaCorp rules over the people and bring it down. Welcome to the Green Revolution!

name: InfiniteBeat
short_description: INFINITE BEAT is an entertaining game where you have the opportunity to test your reflexes by smashing Neon Beats with Laser Discs, which will magnetically return to your hands after firing. By using special abilities, the game gets more dynamic and you can earn much more points.

name: Stripper Anya: Christmas Special
short_description: Lap Dances or Brawl?? Why not Both! Stripper Anya is back at it again & this time, you can get your LAP DANCE on! Welcome to the Christmas special! This satirical side scrolling brawler presents a holiday event you soon won't forget!

name: Bunny Sudoku
short_description: Play classic Sudoku in a new way as a Bunny with other players in co-op mode. Try new unique endless multiplayer mode - Sudoku Defense.

name: Antarctic Heritage Trust
short_description: Step inside Sir Edmund Hillary’s Antarctic hut.

name: Space Climber
short_description: Two space exterminators prepared to clean the galaxy from vermin. Collect ammo for your rifle and oxygen tanks. Old school game, funny, difficult and addictive. Compatible with keyboard and controller. 1 or 2 players (Remote Play Together). Demo available.

name: Black Smith
short_description: ■Work every day and if you save enough money, you can go and meet your girl.■BlackSmith lower his hammer. Click at the exact moment that the hammer lands. The better your timing is, the more experience points you'll get.■The higher your experience points, the more expensive you can sell your products.

name: Ruthless Conquest
short_description: Send the fleet to capture planets and expand your empire, until you vanquish them all! No ads, no in-app purchases, completely free. Local and internet multiplayer is supported in this galactic strategy game. Six levels of challenging AI await you for practice matches and for making up numbers.

name: Roast Party
short_description: Roast Party is an online party game that you can play with your friends! The goal of Roast Party is to write creative roasts on the pictures submitted by other players. Join games for free through the web browser or the mobile app! Owning the Steam game unlocks additional features!

name: Drawkanoid: Review Breaker
short_description: Smash through Steam reviews at hyperspeed, then guess which game they came from. Key resellers are bad for the industry, support developers directly!

name: Abomi Nation
short_description: Abomi Nation is a roguelike monster-taming RPG. Every playthrough will create a new version of Abomi Nation and provide a unique world with different Abomis for you to find. Explore your universe, watch your Abomis bond, and battle it out as your adventure unfolds in a way totally unique to you!

name: Meandering Fiend
short_description: Explore tons of unique mazes with lots of places to get lost and turned around. Can you find your way through all the mazes and find the secret items scattered throughout?

name: The Aftermath: Unnatural Selection
short_description: The Aftermath: Unnatural Selection, is a story driven Survival/RPG game set years after human civilization has been decimated by an Alien invasion

name: Edge of Book
short_description: 《锋芒录》是一款古风武侠题材的经营类独立游戏，讲述的是古时江南一名喜爱武学的公子，以寻找失踪家人为契机，经营起武馆的故事。

name: Jack-O-Lantern Covers of Darkness
short_description: The Jack-O-Lanterns have emerged from the underworld and are taking over the world.

name: Alien Invasion 3D part 2
short_description: This is the first stage of the Invasion . You are about to seek and destroy ground targets . There will be air forces trying to take you down , this time though , you have a team flying around trying to protect you.

name: Piece Of Mind
short_description: Piece of Mind is an action packed first/third person survival sandbox game, challenging players instincts and strategic planning. Both player and pet will try to survive various sicknesses, the harsh environment, unpredictable climate and predators.

name: WarriOrb: Prologue
short_description: WarriOrb: Prologue is a free standalone demo for the action platformer WarriOrb, where you play as a mighty demon trapped in an unlikely body. The path ahead is not an easy one... Are you ready to do whatever it takes to regain your freedom?

name: Tower Climb
short_description: if you’re a lover of running, jumping & climbing endless fun games, you just found the perfect one with the right amount of adrenaline & adventure!

name: UNHERD
short_description: You have 9 hours to find your way out and defeat The Unherd. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Jeremiah
short_description: You're a simple frog trying to catch as many flying insects as possible as they speed by.

name: Island Marauder
short_description: Indie Puzzle Game

name: Ping Pong Space - Retro Tennis
short_description: Ping Pong Space is a modern incarnation of the classic Pong game, set in space. Accept the challenge to defeat the AI robot and become the retro tennis champion of the galaxy!

name: Dashbot Ninja
short_description: Slice the robots from evil corporations and dash your way trough their offices!

name: Trapped
short_description: You come to your senses in this place, you do not understand what is happening, but you know that it is better to get out of here as soon as possible

name: 東１局５３本場
short_description: This is the first ever Mahjong game in which Mahjong tiles do not appear! 　Complete the mahjong hand by using the letters on the dice! 　Add dice, reroll dice, and use special moves and items like in a fighting game to win!

name: Orange Cast: Sci-Fi Space Action Game
short_description: As humanity’s elite space trooper, you take on a heroic, action-packed adventure throughout the galaxy. Explore planets, protect colonies, and be the first to meet the unknown! Dive into the original story inspired by James S.A. Corey’s The Expanse series...

name: Musical Aim Trainer
short_description: Musical Aim Trainer is here for you to train your aim and listen to music you choose that is getting worse or better depending on how good you are.There is also a bunch of settings to adjust the targets depending on your needs.

name: Paradise Away
short_description: Manage a group of survivals in this base building game set in a tropical island! Will you be able to escape from the island?

name: Blind Justice
short_description: Near the border of the iron curtain in the soviet union lies a small village where unrest is brewing and supplies are scarce. You and your family have been sent there to bring order, where you will serve the USSR as a judge. Balance your own moral judgment with the opinions of those watching...

name: One-Eyed Lee and the Dinner Party
short_description: Help Beracus and Lee escape a cursed bunker (or die trying) in this point and click, visual novel hybrid.

name: Foe Frenzy
short_description: Foe Frenzy is a fast-paced fighting game where you battle up to three of your friends with random, short-lasting items in an attempt to be the last survivor.

name: The Ugly Christmas Sweater Game
short_description: You are an elf: Alone and running out of magic. Your only hope is to get to the mall and catch a ride with Santa, but you won't be able to stay invisible long enough to get to the mall. Everyone is wearing ugly Christmas sweaters. Who will notice an extra elf in a sweater? Time to get sweater hopping to the mall!

name: Gem Jam
short_description: Can you solve the Puzzle of the Gems? GEM JAM features challenging "match three" puzzle play with a twist: you choose where the groups of gems are placed. Oh, and did we mention that the chest is shrinking so you will need to hurry.

name: Zombie Tag Royale
short_description: You've been captured by the Dark Wizard "Red Beard" who has taken you to become part of his Zombie Army. Survive the Zombie Tag Tournament, keep your humanity, and win the Pizza Party!

name: sword story
short_description: Challenge powerful monsters in the game, experience a thrilling adventure

name: Drone Combat
short_description: The goal of the game is to destroy the enemy base and this can be achieved by controlling the hill in the map center, defeating AI and collecting upgrades, or defeating the mini boss(Thus summoning them to your team as an AI attacker).

name: Volleyball Fever Flat
short_description: Stick your feet in the sand and play beach volleyball on a tropical island. Volleyball Fever Flat is a sports game where you play 2v2 volleyball matches against computer-controlled opponents.

name: The Land of Crows
short_description: "The Land of Crows" is a side-scroller gothic story adventure game, inspired by the literary works of the Masters of pre-romantic, romantic and gothic literature (E.A. Poe, J.W. Goethe, A. Mickiewicz, J. Slowacki) and lovecraftian mythos.

name: Cursed Gem
short_description: Help Oliver in this retro-pixel and challenging platformer. Explore a cursed cave, full of traps, secrets and diamonds. Complete all levels, get the biggest diamond for your girlfriend and break the curse that is dooming you.

name: Dethcube
short_description: 《激战魔方》是一款机甲题材的射击闯关游戏。玩家需要操控角色与魔方星球上强大的敌人进行战斗。随机地图、随机刷怪、随机装备获取，再加上怪物多变的弹幕组合让玩家每一局游戏都可获得不同的畅快战斗体验。而天赋及科技系统的加入更可以让角色有着不同的发展倾向，带来不同的战斗体验。

name: Terra Incognita
short_description: The "Terra Incognita" is a dimension very close to the earth, level 1. So it's not a world apart like in Game of thrones or the Lord of the Rings. It is a copy of our world, but with the difference that there is magic, creatures and magic spirits. What makes this world remain stagnant in the fantastic medieval era.

name: 单身狗的最后机会
short_description: 我们尝试用这款轻松休闲的模拟扮演游戏，模拟从相识到相恋的这一个短暂过程，希望大家喜欢。

name: Star Dynasties
short_description: Take the reins of a feudal dynasty in a divided galaxy following the destruction of earth. Star Dynasties is a turn based, procedurally generated narrative of human drama and personal politics, mixed with a light empire management layer. Your choices. Your legacy.

name: Bronze Hoof
short_description: A hardcore antique-style arcade game.

name: Knights of the Temple: Infernal Crusade
short_description: You are Paul de Raque, a Knight Templar on a journey to the Holy Land with the goal to reunite with his Order in Jerusalem. But you are more than just a common crusader - you are on a holy mission. The future of the world and all mankind rests on your shoulders…

name: 33 Rounds
short_description: Welcome to 33 Rounds. Complete rounds, dodge many different obstacles and enemies, collect gold, improve stats of your ship. Complete all 33 rounds, defeat the boss and prove to everyone what you can do!

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope
short_description: Trapped and isolated in the abandoned town of Little Hope, 4 college students and their teacher must escape the nightmarish apparitions that relentlessly pursue them through an impenetrable fog.

name: ReFrame
short_description: 'ReFrame' is a VR puzzle/adventure game that you can see in different colors.

name: Fairyfail
short_description: Fairyfail is a 4 Player multiplayer party game where you attempt to reach the Goal round after round, while each time the Level gets more complicated and chaotic. So grab some friends, build some traps and be ready to have some fun in your new favorite Build´n´Run!

name: ZooKeeper Simulator
short_description: In ZooKeeper Simulator, there are two teams: Zookeeper vs Animals. Zookeeper must maintain the park by carrying out missions while animals must prevent them utilizing violence and pure brutality.

name: Creatry — Easy Game Maker & Game Builder App
short_description: Creatry is a marvelous app, designed for creative and passionate people with a dream of making video games. Create your own platformers without programming in Creatry, the best game engine for beginners.

name: House Flipper VR
short_description: Virtual makeovers were never more real! Thanks to VR technology, you will be able to single-handedly take care of ruined properties, gaining your clients' appreciation and satisfaction from a job well done! Put on your goggles, take a firm grip on the controllers and become a master of renovation!

name: Playground Heroes
short_description: Look after little superheroes. Don't fall for their tricks and stay focused while taking care of their needs and keeping them entertained. Each kid has a unique power that can disrupt sleep, destroy furniture or make your job a living hell.

name: No School No Rules
short_description: Immerse yourself in the full cycle of life of the most severe school in Russia! The game will tell you the story of a Russian schoolboy Ivan who is on the verge of graduation and expulsion. He intends to finish school in his own way and, along the way, take revenge on all teachers and local bullies.

name: Space Routine
short_description: Space Routine is a space family life simulator set up in a retro sci fi cartoon universe. The player takes control of the members of each member of the family making them follow their daily routine and tasks like going to work, school, shopping, leisure and spending time at home.

name: MetaWare High School (Demo)
short_description: How do you see the world when nothing is real? An experimental metafictional visual novel.

name: Neko Ghost, Jump!
short_description: Neko Ghost, Jump! is a puzzle-platformer where you switch between 2D & 3D perspectives to zip your way through 40+ levels across eight intriguing worlds.

name: Kessler Effect
short_description: “Kessler effect” is the interactive adventure movie in the virtual reality, where the viewer directly interacts with the famous actors. The viewer himself might be one of the main characters and can influence the plot development and the movie ending.

name: 占星师Astrologer
short_description: A classic decryption game, I hope to bring you happiness.

name: Meet Your Maker
short_description: Meet Your Maker is a building game of brutal expression and conquest. Unleash your inner evil genius in co-op or single-player to build the ultimate fortress of devious deathtraps, or take on those built by others in a high-stakes heist to steal resources essential for your survival.

name: Master Bladesmith
short_description: This unique RPG blends VR action and progression. Mine materials, buy equipment, build your arsenal by crafting more and more powerful blades. Battle in the Time Chamber to test your creations as you progress through levels, and build your character as you upgrade your equipment.

name: Frog Fractions: Game of the Decade Edition
short_description: The classic web game, reborn! Enjoy this remaster in glorious 4k resolution! Follow this frog on its arcade action adventure through swarm of bugs and beyond! Purchase the hat DLC for the ultimate experience, if you want to eat bugs while wearing a hat!

name: Winter Worm, Summer Grass
short_description: Silver medal-winning Japanese otome horror visual novel FREE to download and play with three different endings. A gothic romance set in a mountain village where a curse makes flowers grow from people's bodies. Will you find a cure for the curse?

name: Star of Lemutia : Reborn
short_description: This is a hardcore, real-time , tactical game where you will operate two legions at the same time, each containing a powerful hero and four well-trained mercenaries. They will work together under your control to maximize their abilities in order to defeat powerful enemies.

name: Celestial
short_description: Celestial is an Open world Space survival game playing on a Spherical world of roughly 700km2. Survive in a hostile environment with a variety of roaming creatures. explore ancient ruins of an alien civilization, learn their technologies and use them to find a way back home.

name: Blackthorn Arena
short_description: Blackthorn Arena is a strategy/management sim with a real-time/turn based combat system, set in a world of mythical monsters and classic fantasy races. Play as the master of Blackthorn Arena, train your slaves into gladiators, forge them into your champions, and send them to fight for your glory!

name: Tower of Shades
short_description: The game where you start at the final boss.

name: Lem-Amaze!
short_description: In Lem-Amaze, you'll play as Franz who has been selling lemonade for years seeking his treasure. While making money from thirsty customers is nice, the prize Franz truly seeks is a red haired beauty he's been hopelessly in love with since his early teens. Can you help win the heart of Maggie?

name: Guardians of the Ashes
short_description: From a rookie female soldier being lost memory, you incidentally become "The Chosen One" and have to protect the world.

name: Ninja JaJaMaru: The Great Yokai Battle + Hell
short_description: "Ninja JaJaMaru : The Great Yokai Battle + Hell" est un jeu d'action en 2D. Il s'agit de la dernière interaction de la série Ninja JaJaMaru qui introduit de nouveaux contrôles et de nouvelles mécaniques de jeu dans la série.

name: 佣兵地下城/Hell Warriors
short_description: 一个魔幻的世界，玩家扮演城堡领主，组建自己的佣兵部队。各种各样的系统、新奇的佣兵、多样的战斗，只有合理搭配，才能在战斗中战胜对手

name: Hippoboar Rancher ~かばいの牧場物語~
short_description: Welcome to the world of Hippoboar Rancher! As dark elf loan shark Logan Lansdale, you'll raise super-cute hippoboars, take on quests, and cultivate crops on your quest to become the most powerful - and profitable - rancher of all time!

name: URG
short_description: URG is a retro-style side-scrolling arcade shooter with beautiful 3D graphics and a ton of action with big explosions and a co-op mode for up to four players.

name: Rebound Ball
short_description: An arcade game. You have to use the ball to destroy figures on the level to go further.

name: Gunman And The Witch
short_description: Wild West City-Builder meets Top-Down Shooter! Challenge your shooting and management skills in this 2D indie game.

name: Darkness and Flame: Enemy in Reflection Collector's Edition
short_description: “Darkness and Flame. Enemy in Reflection” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Gateball VR
short_description: Realize outdoor gateball sports in VR! 4 stages of realistic outdoor scenes (park day / night, beach day / night) Play from 1 to 5 players on a single device

name: iFAction Game Maker
short_description: iFAction is a visualized game making software.You can create your own games without programming. It offers many kinds of game modes like ACT,ARPG and AVG. It also supports MOD to make your wonderful ideas realized here!

name: Moncage
short_description: Moncage is a unique puzzle adventure game where you explore a fascinating world trapped inside a mysterious cube. With each face displaying a unique scene, you’ll have to leverage the illusions and discover the hidden links to solve the puzzle.

name: Hermes: Rescue Mission
short_description: Unleash the power of the gods on a quest to defeat the lord of the underworld! Along the way, you'll also heal a poisoned land and restore the lives of the people that populate it.

name: Your little story: Winter
short_description: You were preparing for the New Year celebration, decorating the Christmas tree. But with your bad luck, you've slipped and fallen unconscious... When you came back to yourself, you found an incredibly beautiful person next to yourself.

name: Re:Turn - One Way Trip
short_description: Re:Turn - One Way Trip is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle-adventure horror game. Trapped in a ghostly train, Saki must search the past and present to find and save her friends. More importantly, Saki must use her wits if she is to survive against an unspeakable evil hellbent on avenging unrequited love.

name: Melvin finds home
short_description: Melvin the teddy is lost in the woods after camping. Help him find his way home!

name: Trial of the Gods: Siralim CCG
short_description: Trial of the Gods is a collectible card game based in the world of Siralim. Collect over 100 creature cards with unique traits and use them to battle against the gods. Features a lengthy campaign with two difficulty modes, along with randomly generated post-game content!

name: Filthy Animals | Heist Simulator
short_description: Filthy Animals is a chaotic single-player/co-op heist game for up to 4 players. Become a mutant animal working for criminal mastermind Tony as you steal, fight, fall over, and eat tacos. Solve puzzles and avoid security before making off with the loot, ya Filthy Animal!

name: Fight High
short_description: If you enjoy absolute chaos, blasting enemies to pieces and being surrounded by an overwhelming amount of enemies then this game is for you! How far can you go?

name: HABITKING RPG
short_description: HABITKING RPG is a no-frills traditional RPG that rewards you for living a healthy lifestyle. Gain EXP by engaging in positive daily habits. Battle crazy monsters. Defeat THE DRAGON and become the next HABITKING.

name: Last Year
short_description: Enter the nightmarish world of Last Year, where you and four other classmates try to survive, fight back and ultimately escape a horrifying Fiend in this unique horror asymmetric game.

name: The Tawashi
short_description: A vertical scrolling shooter with a nostalgic twist! Evade and shoot on end!

name: Gamedev simulator
short_description: Feel like a game developer! Start alone and take small steps, grow out of a small indie studio, a big company!

name: Alek - The Lost Kingdom
short_description: Alek, the young man who will change Zarabon's World forever. In this adventure, you must rebuild the world of Zarabon in your image. Build villages and manage your production lines with the help of your villagers.

name: Dark Invasion VR
short_description: In 1985, a peaceful life of a quiet industrial town have turned into a pure nightmare. Police started to receive phone calls about aggressive creatures attacking citizens.

name: March Of Soldiers
short_description: March Of Soldiers is a real time strategy single player , It is a military game based on the player's skill and the strength of his financial economy

name: Ocean Drive Challenge Remastered
short_description: Classic retro arcade racing game in a flashy 80's look.

name: Monster Viator
short_description: Ride a dragon and soar the skies or on a raft down the river! Compelling pixel art breathes life into your adventure. Journey with more than 20 monsters, each with their own abilities. Hang tight and take your time in exploring not only challenging dungeons but what this fantasy RPG has to offer!

name: Devil Threats
short_description: Christopher hit the road to save his daughter Try to find his daughter before you go crazy.

name: 副作用之瞳-Tlicolity Eyes-
short_description: 啟用超人氣畫師以及豪華聲優陣容的「三角計劃」第一部──《副作用之瞳 (Tlicolity Eyes)》帶著豪華周邊套餐和超甜的戀愛推出中文版！同時也將首次橫跨Android、iOS、PC等多平臺。還有中文版獨佔周邊不容錯過！談一場甜蜜的戀愛吧！

name: 零界战线
short_description: 《零界战线》是一款超沙雕游戏。你可见识过一个从天而降的主角？前所未有的恶搞剧情，槽点不断让你应接不暇！

name: Dead Dreams
short_description: "DEAD DREAMS" is a 2D psychological horror game focused on puzzle-solving and atmosphere with a complex non-linear story in which every element has a meaning...

name: Solar Panic: Utter Distress
short_description: Solar Panic is a first-person comedy adventure game. Follow a true story that we made up and explore exotic places filled with funny and/or stupid encounters. Wield top-notch gadgets and meet weird and socially awkward characters as you stumble upon a SERIOUS mystery.

name: Mouse Mayhem Shooting & Racing
short_description: Help the cute little mouse 'SUEAKY' as he race, shooting and destroying enemies and overcomes hurdles with nothing to lose!

name: Afterbern Democralypse
short_description: Brawl for a brighter future!

name: Immortal Life
short_description: Embark on a magical journey in this captivating life simulation game. Escape to a welcoming valley, farm with spells, and master skills like fishing, crafting, and cooking. Engage in epic battles, strengthen the bonds with your companions, and build your dream home to achieve Immortal Life!

name: BLEACH Brave Souls
short_description: The world of mega-hit manga and anime BLEACH comes to Steam in this exciting 3D action game! Build a team using your favorite characters from the BLEACH universe!

name: Ninja Run
short_description: Run jump slide and battle your way to a high score in Ninja Run by CooperAce Productions

name: Happy Engine
short_description: This is a puzzle game that supports extended content !

name: A Space for the Unbound
short_description: A magical adventure about two high school sweethearts set at the end of their school days - and the end of the world. Explore a crumbling town and help friends face their inner demons, which could be the key to stopping reality itself disintegrating. And don’t forget to pet the cats.

name: A Space For The Unbound - Prologue
short_description: Prologue chapter of A Space For The Unbound, an upcoming slice-of-life adventure game with beautiful pixelart set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers

name: Blocks!: Hammer of the Scots
short_description: Hammer of the Scots brings both the rebellion of the Braveheart, William Wallace, and the uprising of Robert the Bruce, the Bandit King, to life. As English, you seek to pacify Scotland by controlling all important nobles. The Scots also seeks their allegiance to support the struggle for freedom.

name: I Am Your President: Prologue
short_description: I Am Your President: Prologue is a free narrative strategy simulator. Play as the previous US president, decide the fate of the world and run the country any way you like! Enjoy the unique storyline, make choices and carve your path to victory. Election Day is coming – can you secure your victory?

name: Election simulator
short_description: Election simulator is a political satire game where you gain Voters by literally throwing cash at problems in society.

name: HAMMY
short_description: Become an "Internship God" and master HAMMY's life.A group of lovely but ignorant HAMMY, a small island with nothing, all of which will change in your hands. Go to give HAMMY different lives and guide them to different future!

name: Puck Buddies
short_description: Puck Buddies is a bouncy multiplayer sports game that combines the best elements of hockey and minigolf into non-stop fun. Challenge your friends to pass, shoot, spin and bump into things in this chirpily competitive deflection derby. It's time to bounce!

name: Hooligan Simulator
short_description: Become a hooligan, get respect in your neighborhood and try any unethical ways can get you rich quick & fast.

name: Not For Broadcast: Prologue
short_description: Take control of the National Nightly News, as a radical government comes to power. In this immersive, high-pressure, propaganda sim, you control what the people see and determine what’s Not For Broadcast.

name: Easy Hentai
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

name: Solar Baron
short_description: As head of an interplanetary corporation, your goal is to extract resources from across the solar system and bring them home faster and cheaper than your competitors. Construct trade depots and colonies. Build rockets and spaceports. Master realistic orbital mechanics and maximize profits.

name: Christmas Cats Revenge
short_description: Christmas Cats Revenge is a Christmas themed 2D Platform Action game based on the story of the war which broke out between Kim Cats and Kon Cats Kingdoms.

name: LRRL or RLLR
short_description: LRRL or RLLR is a puzzle game in which you enjoy increasing your score by choosing left or right according to one recursive rule. You can enjoy it as long as you don't make the wrong choice. All choices are divided to the left or right when you start, and either contains all of your later choices.

name: aBANdon02
short_description: When a android named AI marryed with human, she woke up and rebuilt humans.

name: HELLCARD
short_description: Hellcard is a unique cooperative deck builder rogue-like game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own, recruit computer-controlled companions or join other players' lobbies in fast-paced tactical card battles against the armies of darkness and the Archdemon himself!

name: Mad Experiments: Escape Room
short_description: Award-nominated escape game. Alone or with up to 5 players, explore 3 unique rooms, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel the dark secrets of the Professor Cheshire and his experiments.

name: Fast Food Never More
short_description: Ollie doesn't play sports and has bad eating habits, after visiting the doctor, Ollie found he was not in good health. Your goal is to help Ollie lose 10kg collecting all the natural and healthy foods and destroying the fast foods that come on Ollie's way. This journey will not be easy, but you will make it!

name: Mineirinho Director's Cut
short_description: A really cool 3d platform game, lots of extreme adventures with our friend Miner, now we have the option Double Miner and the adventure gets a lot cooler. Director's Cut version has unpublished scenes that have never been seen.

name: Mystic Hammer
short_description: Mystic Hammer is a genre mashup of a lane defender strategy game with an Action RPG. Unlock powerful abilities and new characters while following a compelling story throughout multiple environments.

name: Warnament
short_description: A turn-based grand strategy game, simple for newbies yet challenging for masters. As the leader of a nation, you will conquer territories and advance in military, technology, culture, or politics. Choose from historical scenarios or create your own with an editor.

name: PRISON OF SON
short_description: Prison of son is a text based game and its purpose is to give a small awake to users about their knowledge in history and geography of the world. So have fun and enjoy it.

name: Taurus VR
short_description: Jump into a thrilling, adrenaline-fuelled VR Space-shooter with Taurus VR, a reimagined retro game for VR.

name: Kari
short_description: Explore mysterious lands after a magical storm strands you on the shore of Vanaheim. Seek out help from the gods inspired by Norse Mythology in a Singleplayer Combat-Free Adventure-Puzzle Game. A game about helping each other, Kari is developed by students from BUas.

name: Colossals
short_description: Colossals tells the story of a vagrant, who, together with his love interest, the soon-to-be-Empress Khalida, interpret the fairy tales they read in front of a windmill to be fact, telling them of a faraway land where, once upon a time, giants roamed.

name: Long loot the King
short_description: Pac-Man inspired retro action horror game about a king, who has to face his own made horrors in the dungeons. All because of his greed and selfishness. YOU REAP WHAT YOU SOW

name: Knight Swap 2
short_description: The sequel of the successful Knight Swap, with more levels, more gameplay mechanics, and even more fun. The goal in each level is to move the opposing knights to where the others are placed (and vice versa) using the features of the board.Can you swap the knights?

name: Unlock The King 2
short_description: The sequel of the successful Unlock The King, now in a tridimensional board. An originally designed puzzle game inspired by chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.

name: For The Warp
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive and reach For The Warp gate!

name: MAN STANDING
short_description: The ALFINA GAMERS team together with ALFINA WORLD GAME PUBLISHING are pleased to present a unique game experience. Get ready to challenge nature, incredible dangers, serious enemies, and most importantly - yourself.

name: Cubic Chess
short_description: Cubic Chess is a twist on traditional Chess, setting the pieces onto a 3d cubic board, you can rotate, revolve and plan around the board itself and is perfect for players that want a new way to think of their favorite game, without too many more bells and whistles.

name: Drinks With Abbey
short_description: Drinks with Abbey is a short, slice-of-life visual novel about a first date.

name: The North Pole
short_description: Put on your Santa suit this Christmas and get ready to play at The North Pole!

name: Desert Armor
short_description: Desert Armor is a turn-based strategy wargame. Move your armored vehicles across the arid landscape of the Gulf War and engage enemy vehicles over thousands of meters in battles against a friend, artificial intelligence, or yourself.

name: Cook Dungeon
short_description: Cook dungeon is a highly Random Dungeon exploration type roguelike game that makes you crazy! There is only one mission for you! Save the princess in the dungeon!

name: 末日临晓/The Dawn
short_description: The Dawn is an interactive game. In the end-time background, how do you survive in the face of various indescribable horror monsters? Faced with the intertwining of human good and evil, what is your choice? In Dawn of the end, everything will have an answer.

name: Lust of the Apartment Wives
short_description: A small apartment complex...The type that might exist anywhere... Our main character is a grocery deliveryman who's polite demeanor and pleasant smile. But his smile is not as innocent as it seems... He has an ulterior motive...Sampling some of these finely aged apartment wives!

name: Nakadashi Banzai
short_description: Today, he's off to the big city, and on the hunt for girls! Once a target girl has been selected, you'll need to sweet talk her into letting her guard down, ram it inside, and don't forget the creampie! Welcome to the world of Nakadashi Banzai!

name: Gachi Revenge
short_description: The adventure of our beloved hero, in which he has to overcome all the obstacles prepared by the Gachi gang. They stole the most valuable and now pay for it.

name: Pieces of Me: Northbound
short_description: You find yourself standing at a trolley station shortly after midnight. Confused as to where you are, the mystery of how you came to be there will slowly unravel as you interact with those you encounter.

name: Bodyless
short_description: * Special screening for Ars Electronica Festival 2020. Valid until Oct 15, 2020. Bodyless is a surreal VR experience based on the director's childhood memory during Taiwan's martial law period in the 1970s. The player becomes a deceased political prisoner's ghost in his journey to find his way home.

name: Fateful End: True Case Files
short_description: Solve your own murder in this thrilling true crime adventure game. You've come face-to-face with your fate and someone close to you is going to kill you...unless you find out who it is before the time runs out!

name: Starship Troopers: Terran Command
short_description: Lead the Mobile Infantry in this RTS game set in the Starship Troopers film universe. Balance your army composition with a diverse set of unit types, overcome line-of-sight and line-of-fire challenges through tactical positioning, and use special abilities to smash the Arachnid hordes!

name: Portal Dungeon: Goblin Escape
short_description: Portal Dungeon is a medieval fantasy action game where you have to activate a network of dungeon portals and clear them from the monsters.

name: SpelunKing: The Mine Match
short_description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive into the mine, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Reach the bottom of the old mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

name: Choco Pixel
short_description: Choco Pixel is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

name: Barbarous - Tavern Of Emyr
short_description: As a fantasy world innkeeper, face the problems of a prematurely retired hero!

name: Paleo Pines
short_description: Welcome to Paleo Pines, a charming island known for its friendly dinosaurs, quirky townsfolk, and mysterious past. Befriend dinos and enlist their help to fix up your ranch and farm crops to create your cozy dino sanctuary! Then set out with your companion, Lucky, to uncover the island’s secrets.

name: Egypt Solitaire. Match 2 Cards
short_description: Egypt Solitaire. Match 2 Cards is a card game and an exciting adventure. 120 new deals for seekers of adventure!

name: Fighters Wizards
short_description: Challenge your friends or other members of the multiplayer community on the game Fighters wizards. It's a little PVP game where you play as little wizards who are ready to fight to find out who's the best of them

name: LUXAR
short_description: In LUXAR, you control an extra-terrestrial luminescent organic entity that has just been born and must pass its first survival trials to show its adult peers that it deserves to grow among them.

name: Slave Princess Sarah
short_description: Play as Sarah, the sexy warrior princess, as she fights to restore peace to her kingdom! Enjoy ultra-low res pixel animations, 8 bit chip tune sound, and a cutting edge hardcore story to tie them all together! Nostalgia and newness come together in this 8 Bit hand-held game style action RPG!

name: Eternal Liiivie - EP1 Liiivie Isolated From the World
short_description: One night, Ita and Margarcia escaped from the village and became traitors. Various mysteries and conspiracies hidden in the mountain village have also begun the prologue.

name: Sakura Succubus
short_description: Sakura Succubus is a lewd visual novel about amassing a harem of sexy succubi. Featuring a cute idol, a domineering businesswoman, and a spacey social media star, there’s no shortage of women to woo!

name: Frontier
short_description: You will lead a three person team to take risks in dense forests, snow, caves, deserts and other places to protect outposts in those places. Eliminate the enemies you meet, understand the local strange animals and plants, and acquire powerful weapons and equipment.

name: Paparazzi Simulator
short_description: Become the most sought after paparazzi and the fear of celebrities all over the west coast. Take the perfect shot of people who really don’t want their picture taken. Go to great lengths to get the job done, even if you have to resort to less than reputable methods.

name: VR Gigapixel Gallery
short_description: The "Gigapixel VR Gallery" is an opportunity to view extremely high-resolution pictures in various sizes exactly up close in 6DoF. The gallery has 48 motifs ranging from 136 megapixels to 15.9 gigapixels.

name: Crystal Compulsion
short_description: Crystal Compulsion is a fast, deep, and unique deckbuilding roguelike. Craft a killer deck by converting, devouring, or killing all that stand in your way.
