Find the synergies between the current 150+ cards, climb the 12 ascension levels, and battle the cute but deadly animal creatures.

name: Spermula 1
short_description: Sperms in Space! But also in Sex Robots, Witch Lairs, Ghost Castles and places we can't name here.

name: Midjungard
short_description: Midjungard is a 3v3 deathmatch hack and slash with Battle Royale like elements set in a Norse universe! Choose from 4 characters & engage in intense PvP combat set in a beautifully lit game level that is huge. Has fantasy and magic elements. Tactical skill matters at least as much as magic!

name: Moves
short_description: Moves is a minimalist puzzle game where you must use your mathematical skills to solve tricky puzzles.

name: Treis Zoes
short_description: Treis Zoes is a visual novel where not only choice is important, but also the motive of choice. Explore the world of living skeletons on the experience of past travelers and add your own to the encyclopedia of the dimension of Death.

name: Peasant Uprise
short_description: Peasant Uprise sets a group of peasants on a deadly quest against the new lord that has taken over their province. Unskilled in the arts of war, they will use their only known skills and tools to regain control of the Province of Swayne.

name: 36 apples
short_description: Collect apples and uncover the secrets of a self-contained world.

name: Escape the Ninja Room
short_description: You are trapped in Ninja Room. Can you escape from this room? This game is a point click type escape game.

name: Marco & The Galaxy Dragon
short_description: Marco, an orphan with missing memories, and Arco, a dragon who rules the galaxy, were hunting for treasure in space! On one of their adventures, Marco was given a clue to the whereabouts of her mother. Their next stop, her birthplace - Earth!

name: Zombie Busters VR
short_description: - The professional zombie eradication task force 'Zombie Busters ‘ - There's a rumor that there's a lot of zombies on the ruined 501 Street...Now, why don't we go out hunting zombies? - Increased game quality by the appearance of various monsters with individuality.

name: Hero Index
short_description: Hero Index delivers the superhero-like flying experience that everyone has dreamed of. Fly like the superhero and wipe out everything stands in your way!

name: Aquarius
short_description: Aquarius is a 90's style arcade game where you play as a cave diver in search for treasure, guarded by the ocean's fiercest predators and its cuddliest minnows. Navigate through the caves, collect the treasure, and survive!

name: Beyond Eden: Dear Edward
short_description: Spun off from 'Beyond Eden', 'Beyond Eden: Dear Edward' is a Boys’ Love Life simulation game starring Edward, a naïve young aristocrat. Hone his skills as detective, psychic, or gambler, seek fortune and adventure in the streets and salons of 1890s London, and romance two desirable young men!

name: StretchBot
short_description: StretchBot is a retro platformer with tonnes of action, a compelling story and an ear warming soundtrack that will keep players coming back for more. The adventure is set in a rundown world where both steam-punk and cyber-punk aesthetics collide in stunning 16-bit pixel art.

name: The Walsingham Files - Chapter 2
short_description: After discovering a major clue concerning the double homicide in Willowdale Nature Reserve, Sara is mysteriously convicted on false bribery charges that brings the investigation to a grinding halt. Fortunately, an old friend investigating a related case just so happens to be around the corner…

name: Hentai Tights
short_description: Enjoy the beauty girls picture and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

name: Gift Girl
short_description: This is a desktop pet, Can be placed on the computer desktop, Character's chest has a physical softening effect, Can add a layer of sexy to the desktop !

name: Elizabeth
short_description: Elizabeth is a decryption leisure game.The protagonist is a young man who has just stepped into the society, shuttling through the picture frame in search of freedom and love.The game screen is fresh and lovely, each level has rich puzzles waiting for players to solve.

name: Sex with the Devil
short_description: What is forgiveness and what is a lie? Where does desire end and vice begins? The project "Sex with the Devil" will allow you to ask these and many other frank questions about the greatest personification of evil in human culture.

name: Santa's Christmas Solitaire 2
short_description: An old foe has returned to ruin Christmas this year, can you help Santa defeat him and recover the Christmas presents?

name: nStations
short_description: Construct and manage your colony anytime, anywhere, any device!!!!

name: kirakira stars idol project AI
short_description: "I want to be an idol!"The story of the beginning to the top idol singer starting from the accidental reunion of the new face manager " Nobuyuki Kinoshita " and childhood friend " Ai Amane" of the talent agency.

name: Theme Park Simulator: Rollercoaster Paradise
short_description: Theme Park Simulator is a physics simulation game in which you experience a wide array of different attractions. Ranging from rollercoasters to bumper cars, there’s a ride for everyone in Theme Park Simulator!

name: Lost Brothers
short_description: Lost Brothers is a single-player first-person adventure, taking place in an abandoned mine. All you have is a walkie-talkie and a map. Explore a mysterious forest and a labyrinth of underground passages to rescue a mysterious lady.

name: ROAD HOMEWARD: Open world
short_description: An open world adventure in which you have to get home, through forests, deserts, sea and snowy locations. At your disposal a variety of transport and no one forbids you to explore the world on the way to home.

name: Melbits™ World
short_description: THE CUTEST CHALLENGE ! The cooperative puzzle-platformer game that will equally charm and challenge your friends and family. Communication and coordination are the key to success in the Melbits™ mission!"

name: Cyberception
short_description: Fast-paced, brutal, cyberpunk FPS shooter game. Fight for your right to exercise free will again. Fight through hordes of mindless crooks of the Corporation to reach the executive floor and put an end to contract they put on your head. There will be blood and pieces of neuro fiber everywhere.

name: Sterio
short_description: Sterio is a programming tool to allow 3D graphics engineers to use standard photographic units to take, import, and adequately convert the stereoscopic images into 3D model maps, apply appropriate textures, and subsequently enter them into the Unity 3D game engine.

name: The Heiress of Sorcery
short_description: The young healer girl is accused of witchcraft after a strange disease outbreak in the town. Can the girl prove her innocence and find a real source of the epidemic? And who is this mysterious sorcerer who appeared at the same time with the disease?

name: Spacer Project
short_description: " You are sent into space aboard your spaceship to eradicate any alien threat trying to invade the galaxy.... Facing waves of enemies drawing their strength from the genesis of video games, and armed with rudimentary weapons or slaloming in an asteroid field! Face the growing difficulty of Spacer Project.

name: Assemble with Care
short_description: Repair old-school objects in this cozy puzzle game. Join antique-restorer Maria, as she arrives in the sun-soaked town of Bellariva and set out on a journey of helping the townsfolk reconnect.

name: FallNation
short_description: FallNation is a free-roaming army based RPG adventure mixing a Worldmap stage and FPS battlefield with Real Time Tactics in the middle of an apocalyptic environment where the future depends on you.

name: Boom Boomerang
short_description: Master the skill of throwing and catching virtual boomerangs to destroy bombs before they explode in this challenging and unique arcade-style VR game.

name: Mad Tracks
short_description: Mad Tracks is an action packed toy car games. Play mini games and race in everyday places. Have immediate fun – guaranteed!

name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
short_description: Help northman Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware… this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods. Play through 130 challenging solitaire levels and chase away the Jotun Idyl!

name: RaidTitans
short_description: RaidTitans is a classic-style real-time strategy role-playing game where you hire various mercenaries, craft equipment, and battle a variety of monsters. The hero, who lost everything in a single moment, is exiled to a remote village, but his story has only just begun.

name: ArchiTac
short_description: Stranded on a deserted planet, you must explore and gather resources to craft buildings so that TAC can find and repair his spaceship.

name: Breakwaters: Crystal Tides
short_description: Survive in a world ravaged by massive Titans and an ever changing ocean sim. Displace water to find resources for building and crafting unique items. Swim, sail, and fly to explore new islands and fight Titans.

name: Wreckfest 2
short_description: Ready for mayhem? Wreckfest is back, offering the best in full-contact racing with unrivaled destruction! Witness head-to-head battles as you tear apart rival vehicles bit by bit. Powered by the enhanced physics engine, developed by the creators of Wreckfest & FlatOut!

name: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT
short_description: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 20 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!

name: Remember
short_description: Someone somehow gets in touch with you. And you don't know what they are.

name: Brawl Hopper
short_description: A New Procedural Arena Brawler - Battle Between Up to 8 Players Per Match - New Levels Generated Daily.

name: Tiles Shooter Puzzle Cube
short_description: A cool puzzle on the surface of a 3D cube. Shoot colored bricks on the playing field, making three or more blocks of same color together.

name: Fix it - The Handyman Simulator
short_description: With Fix it - The Handyman Simulator, the player experiences the profession of a craftsman in all its facets. Whether electrical work, installation, gardening or renovation - all fields of activity are covered.

name: Maid Cafe ~Full Service~
short_description: The old style of playing service games from the famous maid cafe! Strip rock paper scissors, hide and seek, and other classics with awesome rewards from the maids!

name: Core Defense
short_description: A roguelike tower defense game with a dash of deckbuilding. Choose a reward, improve your build, survive the next wave, repeat. Highly replayable, difficult, and addictive. You'll want just one more wave, just one more run!

name: Survival Classic
short_description: Try to survive the harsh realities of the cold Siberian countryside. Live long and always remember, man is man's enemy. You can trust no one but it is almost impossible to survive on your own. Choose your path and go to finish. Firefights, transport, crafting and survival.

name: Winter Break
short_description: Grab your slingshot and start throwing snowballs at the opposing team in this amusing and family friendly VR game. Dodge the enemy snowballs and compete in side mini-games to become grand winner of the winter break!

name: Witchcraft: Pandoras Box
short_description: In this fantastic Hidden Object Adventure, the Crow-Witch has seized this world and has kidnapped your daughter with the help of Pandoras Box. Travel into a parallel world where extraordinary and magical creatures await you and your task is simple... survive!

name: Miss Neko 2
short_description: Welcome to the magic island — Nekoland! All good things you want will happen here! Solve the match puzzles, collect the magic coins and then you will see miracles!

name: Rescuers2019
short_description: This is a first person action shooter game，The player is surrounded by enemy troops，Players are free to explore the surrounding area to familiarize themselves with the terrain，Players can kill or evade enemy attacks and must maintain health，Players are free to switch weapons or grab enemy weapons.

name: MechanicalFuture
short_description: For some reason, human beings become petrified and fight against evil forces...

name: Koo & Yuu
short_description: Koo & Yuu is a minimalist game. Solve the puzzles and take Koo and Yuu to the teleportation bases.

name: Earth Analog
short_description: In this relaxing space flight adventure, you pilot the science vessel Eurisko XI on a quest through deep space. Explore fascinating, fractal-based exoplanets and uncover their mysteries. Analyze artifacts and upgrade your ship to unlock new pathways. Your mission: find humanity’s new home.

name: Planet Colonization
short_description: Real time strategy and society management game. Explore the planet, build and defend your colony. Trade products and armaments and take advantage of price changes. Let your colonists establish their own businesses or build the buildings yourself. Fight against the enemy colonies and alien lifeforms.

name: Dorky Fork
short_description: Dorky Fork is a simple yet сhallenging puzzle game about pushing cubes.

name: Prometheus Wept
short_description: Prometheus Wept is a party and action point turn based RPG set in a near-future, post-digital Earth. The game offers hardcore squad-level combat, simultaneous battles between cyberspace and the physical world, meaningful choices, deep character progression and an advanced crafting system.

name: Hentai Like a Boss 2
short_description: Hentai Like a Boss 2 is a Memory Clicker game

name: Adventures in Space
short_description: The learning adventures in this science curriculum unit include the opportunity to pilot a spaceship, as well as a Mars Rover while learning some of the most important lessons about the Universe.

name: Samurai Simulator
short_description: Venture on the way of the samurai! Fight epic battles, serve your Daimyo, defend your honour. and train followers in the Samurai Simulator – first ever feudal Japan life simulation game on Steam.

name: Wooden Nickel
short_description: Step inside the curiosities of an Old West newspaper to explore a frontier town. Meet the locals, wander the desert, make choices that shape each morning's paper in a growing spread of possibilities.

name: Escape from Life Inc
short_description: Escape from Life Inc is a quirky story-driven puzzle platformer, where you switch between three animals: a walking fish, an arrogant eagle and a stuttering reindeer. Together with plenty of wacky characters, help these three unlikely friends escape the alien lab!

name: Reach Coin
short_description: Sometimes I'm hungry, I put a coin in that kind of machine but the candy just won't get out. What happens with my coin in there?

name: Hentai Vs Furries
short_description: Hentai VS Furries offers colorful gunshots. Skins, special angles for your enjoyment. And a "Pleasure" mode without a fight if you want to enjoy calm.

name: RC Service Simulator
short_description: Accept service orders or build your own unique RC Model. Manage your time and finances. Buy only the best parts on the market and bring your RC dream model to life. Compare its capabilities on the race track, sell it for money or put it on display with a certificate to earn bragging rights.

name: Idle Space
short_description: Your cursor won't linger in Idle Space as you play this exciting and fast-paced clicker. You will work to defeat an encroaching fleet, with every explosion collect metal to create, produce and upgrade factories to keep you in the fight.

name: DUMB Infernal
short_description: Enter the infernal hellscape as a lone warrior fending off an army of monsters in arcade style combat.

name: PhyxBox
short_description: PhyxBox is a physics based sandbox in VR, construct anything you can imagine!

name: Deserted
short_description: Deserted is a stylized 3D action adventure with light RPG and narrative elements. Inspired by the alien atmosphere of Out Of This World, Deserted combines narrative storytelling with survival and fast paced strategic combat to deliver a thrilling adventure.

name: Path
short_description: In the world of lightness and darkness, Let's make a Path by connect the dots.

name: Small War
short_description: You need to choose your camp and build the building! Build combat units through barracks and factories, and then manipulate combat units to destroy enemy bases!

name: The War Enders Evolution
short_description: The War Enders Evolution is an arcade style single-stage bullet hell game. Beat the game with the choice from three different fighters and two different styles.

name: Super Crystal Hunter
short_description: Enter this Arcade-RPG adventure incarnating the young thief Slade. Go through multiple places to loot in the Eastern Lands, visit special zones, face several bosses and discover various mini-games and additional extras.

name: Foxfall
short_description: Welcome to FoxFall! Super Satisfying Adventures waiting to you!

name: TAXIDERMY
short_description: An 80's VHS style first person horror experience, in this game you are locked in a house of a mad taxidermist and surviving is up to you!

name: Former Future
short_description: Vaporize evil robots and reclaim Saturn’s cities in this strategic shooter. The path you choose shapes the enemy's strength, the tools at your disposal, and the final stand you'll face. Overcome adaptive AI in solo or co-op play where distinct characters and synergistic abilities reward teamwork.

name: Kingdom Warrior
short_description: 在一个王国里 你即将成为新国王， 但是你会遇到各种各样的困难。

name: The Alchemist's House
short_description: An invitation from a stranger... There's something evil in this house... Will you survive?

name: DanielX.net Paint Composer
short_description: Create beautiful music simply and easily! Save your compositions and share them with friends and the world. Interesting characters are fun for both kids and adults. The musical staff is welcoming, you can leverage your existing knowledge of music or expand it through experimentation. Enjoy!

name: Hiro's Escape
short_description: Help Hiro sneak past Yamana clan mercenaries during the Onin War of 1467 feudal Japan and reunite with his scattered family in this refugee tale.

name: Red Rush
short_description: Take care of restoring the economy and the status of a superpower of a once great country in one of the most difficult times for Russia.

name: Temple Of Snek
short_description: A snaky tile-based puzzle dungeon adventure. Defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?

name: Bunny Park
short_description: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

name: SUPER 3-D CRUNK BROS.
short_description: SUPER 3-D CRUNK BROS. is an action-adventure platformer which tells the tale of a hash brown named Crunk, his "brother" Paco, and their journey to thwart the plans of a nefarious corporation bent on taking over the world.

name: YANCY
short_description: YANCY is an NES style action adventure that follows a small protagonist in a vast world full of danger, swords and rewards. Lead your own adventure in a non-linear game world, explore hand-crafted dungeons, forge magical weapons, battle challenging bosses and unearth ancient secrets!

name: Ailuri
short_description: A hand-drawn, 2D platformer following the breathtaking story of an endangered red panda, named Ailuri. Climb, explore and survive the intricate levels while trying to defeat enemies to restore balance of life in the world.

name: View From Below
short_description: An emotional, story-driven, turn-based RPG about a sad kid put through hell. Literally! Escape a nightmare world, to save your own.

name: Saber Fight VR
short_description: A VR game focused on laser sword fighting. Cut your enemies and environment to pieces in a physics-based world. Use your powers to pull and push any object! Deflect enemy projectiles with your blade! Rebuild your destroyed temple! Train and become a master!

name: Green: An Orc's Life
short_description: A life-simulation card-swiper. Grow an orc. Pilot it through a life of pillage, plunder and gluttony. Build up your horde, become filthy-rich with loot, even become a god!

name: Oil Wars
short_description: Strategy and simulation game where you will be faced to enemies for control of oil refinery and strategic resource locations.

name: FireTry
short_description: FireTry is a 2D overhead co-op tank game. Steer your tank with your keyboard, gamepad or your own codes. Design levels, defeat your enemies and push the limits. Play now for an immersive tank experience!

name: Kanojo x Switch
short_description: Switch around puzzle pieces to complete images.

name: The Blackbird of Amor
short_description: When there is an unsolved mystery, Stein can't let it go, he must pursue it till the end. In Amor there is a certain woman that interests him, she is rumored to have eternal youth. To solve the mystery of this woman he must tear heaven from earth. His journey will take him far beyond the world he has known.

name: FLAGFIGHTS
short_description: FLAGFIGHTS is an online action shooter in which you can choose where you want to fight and the side to play for. The goal of the game is to capture the flag as long as possible against the other team and at the same time shoot as many opponents as possible.

name: Civlands
short_description: Civlands combines elements from legendary RTS titles with epic turn-based strategy to provide a unique hybrid of tactical, real time strategy, with the grandeur, minutia, and depth of turn-based gameplay. Will you be the number one Civ?

name: BomberX
short_description: Take control of atypical characters and blow up as many enemies as possible. Single player or multiplayer, fight for wealth and get equipment that shows your power!

name: Real Orchestra
short_description: Real Orchestra is a VR experience as a orchestra conductor. Become a conductor and direct your orchestra.

name: Freight Simulator
short_description: Manage your transport company! Be a transportation entrepreneur, with control over everything in your business. Work, earn, invest and expand!

name: BlazeSky
short_description: BlazeSky is a space opera action RPG that tells the story of one person changing the fate of an entire galaxy. Explore stunning hand-crafted star systems, fight against strange alien races, and negotiate with key allies in this fully voice acted epic adventure.

name: romantic player
short_description: 这是一款敏捷+AVG类型的游戏，故事讲述了刀客聂关西年轻时的江湖风流趣事。用刀来卸下女侠们的层层防御并收集她们的闺房密事吧！

name: Cowboy
short_description: This is a third person role-playing game，Players have swords, bows and arrows, and guns（You need to be on a horse to use it）,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players must maintain health，Players can kill nearby monsters or dodge attacks from monsters.

name: Defense and Revenge
short_description: Defense and Revenge is a turn-based strategy set in fantasy universe. You have to lead orcs tribe, provide defense and take revenge on enemies invading your land.

name: Peace Data
short_description: Peace Data — hard "Roguelike" game, in which you have to play for Bitard, saving Rusland from the tyranny of the authorities that destroyed the opposition and led the country to ruin, making slaves of citizens.

name: The Square Game
short_description: The Square Game is an insanely hard 2D action platformer with 24 short action packed levels.

name: 匿名信：失心者 / Stayer
short_description: Anonymous letter: the loss of heart is the beginning of the series of anonymous letter puzzle game, mainly tells about the intern detective man because of receiving an anonymous letter and broke the original quiet, when the letter instructions came to the abandoned 13 high school, found that everything has changed, is the trap?

name: Steamliner
short_description: Welcome aboard the Steamliner! As a carriage tester, you will experience anything from classic escape rooms to physics-defying surrealistic scenarios. Try to solve brain-melting puzzles inside a Victorian railway traveling through space!

name: Mompreneur: Pizza Cooking Life Sim
short_description: Live the life of a new mom in this story-driven cooking game.

name: Sakura Knight
short_description: Sakura Knight is a comedic yuri visual novel set in a fantasy world. Adventurous young Estelle dreams of becoming a knight, just like her famous mother, Cressida – but her journey is far more difficult than she ever anticipated!

name: Monster Truck Championship
short_description: A true Monster Truck simulation! A unique and challenging motor racing experience where local or online victory depends solely on your driving skills. 16 customizable trucks, 25 arenas and 3 leagues to win to become champion!

name: King of Seas
short_description: King of Seas is an ARPG adventure game set in a nautical pirate world. Embark on an epic adventure across the seven seas where you’ll discover lost islands and treasures, fight rival pirates and menacing monsters, and become the most legendary pirate of all time!

name: Spartrack VR - Firos
short_description: Mission Firos est un jeu multijoueur en réalité virtuelle, en déplacement libre, mélangeant énigmes et jeu de tir dans un environnement futuriste.

name: Dungeon Cards
short_description: Simple fast-paced card crawler with roguelike elements and addictive gameplay

name: capy hoky
short_description: Sokpop S04: capy hoky - capybara ice-hockey! Control a cast of wacky animals in this funny sports game. Play your real or AI friends in versus mode, or team up to compete in the Capy Cup and unlock new animals!

name: Potion Commotion
short_description: Live the CRAZY life of a Wizard’s assistant in this hilarious Clicker game! You’ll be in charge of making wacky and wonderful Potions, using ingredients produced in your garden. With plenty of twists and turns along the way, the fun never stops! Do you have what it takes?

name: Exit the Gungeon
short_description: Exit the Gungeon is a small, spin-off 'dungeon climber' immediately following the adventures of the misfit Gungeoneers.

name: Hand In Hand
short_description: An atmospheric platformer with puzzle elements and split screen, where the player takes control of two characters at once. Immerse yourself in the ethnic world of two heroes, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles together, explore the fairy forest and other locations, help each other.

name: Smart Moves
short_description: "Smart Moves" is a puzzle with a turn-based mechanics. . Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

name: Cosmos
short_description: Cosmos is a rogue-lite shoot-em-up bullet-hell, in which you pilot the last hope for humanity in an attempt to save the world, pitching your augmented Starship against infused cosmic horrors. Can you close the Cosmic Rifts before The Singularity reaches your star system?

name: Virtually Real Life
short_description: "Reality. A term concocted by creatures to give worth to their version of reality..." What happens if a 2D being is dragged into a 3D realm? Follow the "hero" through a world he/she barely understands and survive the demonic beings who brought our hero into this realm.

name: The Island Story
short_description: The Island Story is leisure simulation game. Players can change the appearance of the island by placing different animals, plants and decorative items freely. Plants and animals also produce fruit and dust resources for further exploration and play.

name: Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions-
short_description: From the developer of Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler-, comes the next installment in the series, Unity Unions! A young jewelmancer must stop the reawakening of a great evil and discover the truth behind her powers.

name: Coloniam
short_description: Colonize islands and grow your population. Manage trade routes and resources to meet the ever increasing needs of your colonist.

name: FlowState
short_description: This simulator is a true FPV Drone Racing simulator. The goal is to make it look and feel as similar to a standard racing drone as possible. As such, the goal is not to make the most HD/GoPro-esque visuals. Instead the focus is on simulating what pilots see through the goggles, static and all!

name: Aloe and Cal
short_description: Dive into the world of Aloe and Cal and experience a gently paced visual novel about the importance of food. With thousands of fun choices to make, over 100 CGs to look at, and 7 colorful characters to meet, you will undoubtedly walk away satisfied!

name: 子夜之章:历史的终局～MidNights of Desperado～
short_description: The protagonist of this lonely life is you. You leave your hometown and come to a strange world. The world is prosperous and cold, strange but real. You may like it or wish you could tear it to pieces. The good news is, you have the choice!

name: 郡主别怕
short_description: 《郡主别怕》是一款以刺客和锦衣卫明争暗斗为背景的全新社交推理游戏，玩家将分为锦衣卫与刺客两大阵营，扮演郡主及护卫展开一场权谋大战！

name: Cyndaria
short_description: 3D RPG COOP ROGUELIKE Explore the mysterious Crypt of Cyndaria and unearth its secrets. A plethora of traps to avoid, puzzles to solve and devious creatures are waiting for you to step into this ever-changing dungeon, with lan and online support.

name: BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre Demo
short_description: BDSM is the first satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son! Get some booze, kill the traitors, save Hell and rescue the hottest demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

name: The Gladhollow Nasties
short_description: A beast stalks the forest by night. It will take cunning, stealth, and strategy to survive long enough to untangle a mystery through one wooded village and many despicable generations. Discover the stories of the sinful, pernicious, malicious morsels themselves: The Gladhollow Nasties.

name: Britannic
short_description: Welcome aboard the HMHS Britannic, the sister ship to the RMS Titanic. Experience first-hand how the biggest ship in the world met its demise in 1916 after striking a mine during World War 1.

name: Race Condition
short_description: Set in a modern low-poly arcade world, players of Race Condition find themselves as a rookie in a highly competitive open-wheel racing league. A rivalry with one suspiciously good opponent complicates things further.

name: POLITICAL KOMBAT
short_description: Classical fighting game featuring characters like Nikola Tesla, Putin, Trump, Hitler, Napoleon, Stalin, etc

name: Blind Descent
short_description: Immerse yourself in a new Martian underground adventure with Blind Descent, an open-world survival craft game that unveils the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends as you search for the missing team. Adapt and mutate to survive in this bizarre alien world.

name: CaveBugBoy
short_description: CaveBugBoy embarks on an epic adventure through dark and mysterious underground caves in search of a better life. The journey will encounter evil floating and screaming skulls, flying dead ants and flies, falling lava rocks, and collect bugs body parts.

name: 烈山海一(BMS1)
short_description: 《烈山海》是一款以中国神话为背景的RPG游戏，内容精彩让人欲罢不能！

name: sok-stories
short_description: A simple game making tool. Draw objects, drag them onto a canvas, and make rules to make a game! Easily upload your stories and share them anywhere, with anyone. What will you make?

name: 노베나 디아볼로스
short_description: Novena diabolos is an Ocult mystery adventure game. The main character, Park Joon-sung, has to find a single human woman who doesn't know who she is and get out of town safely.

name: Submersed
short_description: Rediscover the meaning of terror with Submersed. Are you afraid of depths? You will be.

name: Midnight Ride
short_description: Can you get her home unmolested?

name: Ageless
short_description: Ageless is a story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to progress. Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets and herself.

name: Circle
short_description: This is the game that nurtures “Circle” and adventures in the "Outside" of the room.

name: Suits: Absolute Power
short_description: A business planet full of mystery, relics of power, dangerous jobs and terrifying monstrosities. Will your company defy the toxicity of this environment or will you find yourselves courting the power of corruption itself, in absolution.

name: Island Saver
short_description: A group of amazing islands need your help! Horrid plastic waste has washed up and you need to sort it out with your trusty Trash Blaster! But look out for the Litterbugs. They love mess and they’re out to muck things up.

name: Purgatory Overkill
short_description: "Purgatory Overkill" is a VR shooter and a VR tower defense when you can build turrets and walls to help you fight endless hordes of monsters while you actively participate in the fight with loads of guns.

name: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
short_description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

name: Thunder Kid II: Null Mission
short_description: Thunder Kid, come in. The Robot Empire is back, and they're kidnapping all the humans! Run 'n' gun through colorful environments, dodge bullets, blast enemies, and face off with challenging bosses in this engaging, 3D action platformer. Do you have what it takes to save humanity?

name: Breakneck City
short_description: Old school 3D Beat-Em-Up Action! Use your wits, reflexes and environment to take on the ruthless gangs of Breakneck City!

name: Bingo VR
short_description: It is unheard of that a casual BINGO! game is a weapon of choice which drives aliens to their homeworld and defeats them forevermore. Yet, it is based on a true story.

name: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton: Chapter 1
short_description: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton is a hand-drawn, episodic adventure game set in a world of absolute absurdity. Ally (or make enemies) with a cast of strange characters, and make choices that determine your fate.

name: YesterMorrow
short_description: YesterMorrow is a single-player time travelling 2D platformer, mixing action sequences with puzzle elements. Follow the engaging story of Yui, who travels back into the past to save her family and the remnants of a world now trapped in Never-ending Night.

name: Art Heist
short_description: Get past the guards, get the prized artwork and get out! You have a silenced pistol for this mission, use it if needed...

name: TCM RACING 2
short_description: A car sandbox game with no true goals laid out. It's up for you to decide what you want to do!

name: Hohokum
short_description: Take on the role of a curious flying kite-like being and travel to colorful, curious worlds waiting to be discovered.

name: Rocket Ghost Aidan
short_description: Ever want to experience a game that makes you want to play Rocket Ghost Aidan 2? Just play this! Its completely inferior to RGA 2.

name: Pipeline Of Emperor Yu
short_description: "Pipeline of Emperor Yu" is a puzzle game combining historical legends with classic water pipe gameplay! Facing all kinds of obstructions of the heavenly visions and unsuccessful grievances of three people, you need your wisdom to solve all these problems. Various elements such as sky mine, ground motion, fog, ice skating, etc.

name: Lithium City
short_description: Lithium City is a stylized isometric action game set in a neon-drenched world of electricity and violence.

name: lil' Sherman
short_description: lil' Sherman is a 3rd person action tower defense RPG that takes place in a stylized WW2/Alt-Universe.

name: XYLITH - Hostile Planet
short_description: In the vast subterranean world of Eldriss recently discovered monoliths are fueling more than just the humans fears. Sent by Nimbus you must investigate the mysterious Xylith and use any means necessary to quell an alien uprising.

name: ESCAPE ROOM VR
short_description: This game is a VR escape game. Solve the mysteries in each stage and uncover the hidden truth.

name: Daemonic Runner
short_description: Grab a rusty sword, gain some momentum, and send everyone flying in this aggressive joust. Sweep your foes away like a hurricane and cross bottomless chasms with giant leaps.

name: Silent World
short_description: A post nuclear apocalyptic world that has lost light. Survive by escaping from mutants that roam the city!

name: 封神纪传奇
short_description: 这个世界需要真正的大佬

name: Skull Rogue
short_description: Skull Rogue is an RPG in the classic rogue-like style. You have to pump your ordinary skeleton to an incredible level from scratch.

name: Lumin's Path
short_description: Lumin's Path is an atmospheric 3D platformer using light and darkness to impact the world in mysterious ways.

name: Flatspace
short_description: Flatspace is a top-down space trading game with the emphasis on freedom and exploration. You become captain of a spaceship in a living simulation of a distant galaxy. As a space pilot, you decide how to earn a living; command your crew, buy new and better ships and equipment, and explore.

name: RC Plane VR
short_description: RC Plane VR is a fully immersive RC flying VR experience with free flight and plenty of games and races.

name: Rum & Gun
short_description: Rum & Gun combines fast-paced shooter action with ARPG loot and character building. Journey across the Indian Ocean, uncover the secrets of the Drunken God, and become a legendary pirate captain. You're not on the Caribbean anymore...

name: labyrinth
short_description: A relaxing labyrinth game.

name: Super Kickers League
short_description: The best alternative to conventional football games is here!

name: Dusk Warlocks
short_description: Ever wished to fight using large scale spells? Dusk Warlocks is an online multiplayer spellcasting game in which up to 4 players compete in a tactical battle.

name: Night Of The Living Dead VR
short_description: NOTD VR is an exploratory experience that captures the original spirit of the film in black and white, immersing users in a 3D recreation of the film’s farmhouse set. Exclusive interviews with film experts and original cast and crew enrich the experience with insights into the horror classic.

name: PARANOID
short_description: You play as Michael, you will have to escape from a strange world where monstrous creatures want you dead. You will have to figure out how you came in this world through your past.

name: AIR WARS
short_description: AIR WARS is flight simulation game created with the history of air war. Board the aircraft that was actually used and feel the excitement of becoming a hero in history!

name: DragonScales 3: Eternal Prophecy of Darkness
short_description: A slaughtered caravan of mages. Cultists of an arcane and evil prophecy. Form color combinations of DragonScales through 150 tile-matching levels! Throw down the cult of the Eternal Prophecy of Darkness!

name: Piczle Cross Adventure
short_description: Piczle Cross Adventure takes the classic nonogram logic-puzzle and turns it into something never before experienced in the genre: a story-driven, RPG-style 2D graphical adventure! Follow our heroes Score-chan, Gig and professor Matrix as they tackle their most daunting challenge yet.

name: Danko and the mystery of the jungle
short_description: "Danko and the mystery of the jungle" - the action takes place in abandoned catacombs, where once an alien civilization mined crystals. Using antigravity, a magnet and other devices, Danko will find all the treasures and save his friends.

name: AudioWizards
short_description: AudioWizards is an accessible audio game full of arcade action and charm! Embark on an audiotistic journey to defend the world of Sondveiw. Master the sounds and defeat elementally imbued monsters together with your mentor Saundaman.

name: Economica
short_description: Overproduction Crisis Simulator

name: Animal Revolt Battle Simulator
short_description: The ultimate physics-based, sandbox battle simulator where you can create funny battles between all sorts of ragdoll creatures! You can also make your own monsters with the unit creator or even join the battles yourself in the first-person mode!

name: Radio Commander VR
short_description: Radio Commander now in VR! Be there, right next to the battlefield, in a commander’s tent in the middle of a Vietnamese jungle. Step into the shoes of an experienced leader and lead your soldiers to victory… or at least give them a chance to survive the Vietnam hell.

name: Sproots
short_description: Sproots is a colony management survival game where you control a group of 'sproots' - small pikmin-like creatures - that are in constant need of food and water. They can explore different biomes, pick up objects and study them, learn skills, craft structures and items and teach each other about their findings.

name: Make Me LAG
short_description: Make Me LAG is the first game that features a revolutionary new control scheme: your character actions are determined by the game frame count! Use external softwares and other tricks to lower the FPS count and control your character to defeat evil monsters and save the world!

name: Cattle Admission Challenge
short_description: The year is 2087, the Technotron rules the world. All biological creatures have been exiled to the wasteland. In a remote section of the Grasslandia border Sentry 49-42 must protect the zone from bovine scourge! The sacred grass must be protected. All moo cows must be exterminated.

name: Aldred Knight
short_description: Aldred Knight is a 2D action adventure game. In it you will meet Aldrid, the most powerful swordsman of the divine flame. With him you will pass through innumerable obstacles and war bosses to rid the kingdom of a great evil force.

name: Data Dream
short_description: In this 3D platformer, a bio-digital landscape filled with walking, talking computer components finds itself in a state of peril following a malicious invasion. An unlikely hero must brave this surreal world in order to rectify and restore the jeopardized system.

name: Realistic Tower Destruction
short_description: Game allows you to build many kinds of towers from a variety of bricks and experience their dynamic destruction physics in a sandbox environment.

name: News Agency Simulator
short_description: Manage a news agency and present the news. View the sociological consequences of your actions. Buy sensational news from special sources. Observe the political trend of your channel. When doing all this, be sure to check the channel rating and budget.

name: The Legend of Eldridge Scrolls: Woop
short_description: Welcome to my first-person-shooter adventure game. Use your wit and shrewdness to solve puzzles and collect items. Time travel to the past, shoot arrows; to the present, collect keys; to the future, solve mysteries.

name: William's Love Prelude
short_description: William, a boy living in the woods village of "Woodbell", fell in love with his childhood friend Emilia. He dares to convey love, but she likes a strong man! William decides to get stronger to turn her around ...

name: Clicker Age
short_description: Clicker Age - A classic clicker with a beautiful visual style and a variety of monsters. The player buys various improvements to facilitate the game process and further advance on endless game worlds.

name: World War 2 Zombie Attack VR Coronavirus Simulator
short_description: Immerse yourself in the terrible atmosphere of World War II, playing in the VR WW II Zombie Attack driving shooter. Enter the role of a brave fighter pilot, whose plane was shot down by the enemy during an air battle. Rescuing your life, at the last moment you manage to eject from a flaming plane.

name: Haustoria
short_description: A cosmic entity reveals itself to a young boy in an unforgiving picture-book world.

name: The Spirits of Kelley Family
short_description: What the hell has happened to the Kelley family?? The Spirits of Kelley Family is an amazing hand-drawn point&click adventure game!

name: Hero's Journey
short_description: A platformer designed by an enthusiastic programmer, featuring an equally un-enthusiastic main character

name: Casina: The Forgotten Comedy
short_description: Want a good laugh? Well, in 184 BC Plautus wrote a play you will not easily forget! "Casina: the Forgotten Comedy" is a modern adaptation of his ancient work of literature, brought to you as a fully voiced and animated Visual Novel.

name: Just Arms
short_description: After a terrible fall you wake up confused and without legs. All hope is not lost though, for there is a tale of a witch with the power to regrow limbs. Punch yourself to the top, find the witch and get your legs back!

name: Naked Story (Sports Festival Ver)
short_description: This is a game arranged from [NakedStory] based on [CutePuzzle].This is a sexy puzzle game with easy rules.

name: Banana for Scale
short_description: A Virtual Reality game where you measure things with bananas.

name: Model Railway Easily
short_description: Model railway builder with true 3D graphics. Place all the highly detailed objects on different landscapes and create exciting model railway layouts! Start your trains and enjoy this fully functional model railway simulator!

name: The Walking Evil
short_description: The Walking Evil takes you to the great classic of the survival horror of the 90s, where you guide the main character with a fixed system of cameras, which enhances the feeling of being in a real horror movie.

name: The mysterious Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
short_description: After a respected member of Parliament is found murdered, it’s up to you in this suspenseful Hidden Object game to search for the killer, the notorious Mr. Hyde!

name: Ramiwo
short_description: The trippy and wondrous exploration-walking simulator. Arty, surreal, different. Grant your brain some sweetmeat.

name: Forever Ago
short_description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

name: Getaway Storm
short_description: Survive the fast, chaotic roads in which the environment is affected by music.

name: P-BOT
short_description: P-BOT, the skill-based sci-fi platformer. Take control of the many robots inhabiting this futuristic city, and survive as long as you can.

name: Raven Quest
short_description: Raven Quest is a little adventure on an island where everyone is transforming into crows by a terrible curse. Get lost in this land of strange ruins and creatures to find the solution of all this mess.

name: RhythmDanceVR
short_description: RhythmDanceVR is a rhythm game where you have to try to hit as many beat fields as possible. Filled with a large selection of songs, it turns your surroundings into a dance club.

name: Wildfire Swap
short_description: Swap tiles, fight fires! Consider your moves carefully: fire spreads fast, and an out-of-control fire is unstoppable.

name: Last Week
short_description: The inhabitants of a small portside town begin to fear the worst when they hear the news. This is the last week before the end of the world. With the limited time you have left you must decide which of the town's folk to try and help.

name: DNF Duel
short_description: Action fighting at its extreme! Enter the new beat’em up world of Arad as your favorite character from the beloved Dungeon and Fighter franchise!

name: 坦率的小红帽和爱说谎的狼
short_description: 温馨而有趣的短篇剧情游戏，讲述了可爱小红帽与笨笨狼少年的森林冒险故事，总计4种结局，不含黑暗成分哦（笑）

name: Hell's Pharma
short_description: Welcome Intern, to Hell's Pharma! A lot of sick demons are coming here to get cured. Read their prescription and make sure you gave them the right mixture of potion! Don't do illegal stuff and keep doing your job! Good luck!

name: Color ball
short_description: You need to find the assimilated ball, choose him and let him assimilate. In a limited number of steps, see how many levels you can stick to. When the ball is selected, you need to find the adjacent one in the big ball below Color and click to make the surrounding balls assimilate with him.

name: Coloring Game 2
short_description: Coloring Game 2 is a sequel of the existing color-by-number game which so many users have liked. The sequel features new options and images.

name: Boiling Steel: Preface
short_description: They promised a good job and a bright future. But advertising posters always lie. Instead of a quiet life - war. Instead of a body, a steel shell. Instead of weapons - tools. Thousands of light years from home. You are alone. Nowhere to run. Good luck my friend...

name: Project Heartbeat
short_description: Project Heartbeat is the ultimate cute community-driven rhythm game, featuring music from top artists of the Eurobeat genre made popular by the Initial D anime and manga.

name: Asterook
short_description: You crash-landed on a giant asteroid, broke both your legs, but thankfully always have a trusty grappling hook, and a laser cannon with you. The asteroid you landed on, however, is not a safe place. Danger is just around the corner and the entire comet seems to be about to collapse.

name: My Diggy Dog 2
short_description: Diggy Dog 2 is a game about a brave archaeologist dog named Marty, who helps his elderly master find his wife and solve the mysteries of the universe.

name: Sweet Holiday Jigsaws: Halloween Night
short_description: Happy Halloween! With this great Jigsaw Puzzle your Halloween will be extra scary, play from 30 to 1.000 pieces, Use your own Halloween photo to create a stunning puzzle or solve 100+ Jigsaw puzzles in 5 fearfull chapters. Gather coins to discover the secret bonus chapter.

name: Shieldwall
short_description: Shieldwall is a funny third-person tactical battle simulator with strategy elements. It allows you to feel like a squad leader right on the battlefield.

name: Vampire vs Devil
short_description: Use corpses of your enemies as weapons. Run through 666 levels to hell.

name: Time Hacker
short_description: Time Hacker is an addictive VR game where your creative ability is what gets you through the levels. Your only weapon is the power to stop time. That means, like Marvel’s Quicksilver, you can enjoy playing with the scene while your enemies are effectively frozen.

name: Get the Banana
short_description: Play as a trapped monkey who must solve puzzles to reach food. Learn the rules behind the puzzles as well as the motivations behind the experiments. Get the Banana is inspired by classic Sokoban puzzle games.

name: Knock Harder
short_description: The only way to wake up is to die. The player must decide for himself whether he is inside a dream or is in reality.

name: Player's Eleven
short_description: You're the manager and it's your team. Play Player's Eleven now! Run the club of your choice or work your way up from the bottom to the top. Extensive editing options available.

name: Slimey
short_description: A multiplayer game where you play as Slimey.

name: Zombase
short_description: Survive through progressively harder waves and build defences to protect your respawn orb! Post Apocalyptic Zombie Survival Builder. Build defenses! Blast zombies! Have fun! Perfect for any gamer! As always, HAVE FUN!

short_description: Don't be afraid of heights to find the way out. Lone Land it's about reflection, calm, and relaxation.

name: Hentai Sakyubus
short_description: Enjoy the beauty girls picture and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

name: Cyber Manhunt
short_description: Cyber Manhunt is a story-oriented puzzle game focusing on big data, hacking, citizen privacy, and social workers. It focuses on social issues such as cyber violence and privacy breaches.

name: Human Delusion
short_description: A transformation from being restrained inside the human experience to being free and present. Human Delusion is an exploration of one’s emotions, consciousness, mind and their perception of reality. Are you ready to choose true Freedom?

name: Military Base War
short_description: Top Down Shooter, Face a group of enemies where each type has its own behavior, trying to either destroy you or the blue cube that you have to protect. Eliminate all enemies in the stage, then move to the next stage

name: Only Down!
short_description: Have game developers often forced you to climb somewhere with no purpose? This time, your goal is to hit rock bottom and nothing else. It should be simple enough, good luck to everyone.

name: Risen Kingdom
short_description: Risen Kingdom is a real-time strategy game. Build and fortify your settlements to survive and push back armies of the undead.

name: Vikings Wars
short_description: Lead your army into battle, fight for your lands, you will win!

short_description: "Shizuku : Japanese myth" is a 2D action game set in Japan. The fox girl can transform into various forms, and can take over not only the form of the target but also its abilities. There is no single answer, and the game can be played according to your style of play.

name: VasterClaws 3:Dragon slayer of the God world
short_description: Defeat the God-devouring Dragon in this deceptively simple squad building game! Designed from the ground up for low power consumption, low temp, zero load time gaming. The game text has been fully translated into English.

name: Pawnshop Tycoon
short_description: Start with a garage full of old junk and expand to a thriving business. Manage sales and train staff to automate redundant tasks. Relocate or expand your shop with many options across the city. Learn all the ins and outs of becoming a big city Pawnshop Tycoon!

name: Shaolin vs Wutang 2
short_description: The sequel to Shaolin vs Wutang! Shaolin vs Wutang 2 is a INDIE love letter to Martial Arts and classic Kung Fu films. Made for casual game fans not intended for Hardcore Fighting Game players.

name: Gunfire Reborn
short_description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse Build gameplay, use various weapons to explore procedurally-generated levels. You can play the game alone, or join 4-player coop.

name: Der Geisterturm / The Ghost Tower
short_description: Der Geisterturm is a futuristic turn-based dungeon crawler with survival horror elements where you fight your way to the top floor of a mysterious tower while piloting your own Robotic Combat Suit. Will you reach it alive or die trying?

name: Border Of Insanity Origins
short_description: Do you know what insanity is? The illusory perception of reality and the repetition of the same actions. Immerse yourself in a world where nothing can be considered real. Where you are alive and dead at the same time and surrounded by the walking dead. Feel what real madness is.

name: Mega Hasan
short_description: 32 levels of platforming awesomeness.

name: Celestial Crown

name: Riftnote

short_description: Log 141 is an indie game originally developed as a high school computer science project. Inspired by text-based games of the past, this game was created to be played entirely within a terminal window. Traverse a text-based adventure filled with puzzles and mystery as you uncover the secret of Log 141.

name: Treasure Hunting Club
short_description: “Treasure Hunting Club” is a first-person multiplayer online party game that combines elements of hide and seek with survival. Disguise yourself as props on the map to avoid being hunted by the seekers.

name: Fantamon
short_description: It's a Stardew Vallley-meets-Pokemon experience! Build habitats, catch Fantamon, collect their produces and test their combat potential on battles to earn credits at college. Explore the universe to discover and learn about different Fantamon in different towns.

name: 浮世万千之前世今生
short_description: "Floating world before the world this life" is an independent stand-alone game, this game is floating world myriad game series in the second.The game is a full-length xiuxian novel stream game, using the traditional turn-based combat system.

name: Grimm 1865
short_description: You play has Hebert Grimm For the last nine years, You've been studying abroad. You return home six month ago, and found out that you're father died over six years ago. Apparently, the letter had never been delivered, or so they say...

name: Immortal Legacy: The Jade Cipher
short_description: Delve deep into the origins of a sinister Chinese legend, and unearth the secrets of an island’s forgotten past in this pulse-pounding adventure.

name: E.B.
short_description: E.B. is a simple and easy strategy tower defense game where players can match their own skills and trick to defeat enemy tanks.

name: Timeless Paradox VR
short_description: Our champion failed in her mission two years ago. Everything about this battle remains mysterious. Now you have the chance to go back. Will you change the history? Will you defy this fate with her?​ Your hearty VR journey Starts here!

name: MyBot
short_description: Help Mybot find his home through a 3d maze of traps. Beware of shuttering glass, sliding ice, blocking walls and reset traps. Challenge yourself or your friend in multi-player. Have hours of fun and never run out of game-play as you create your own levels. Make your game the cool place to go.

name: One True Cuddle
short_description: A top-down platformer where you play as a rabbit that's kidnapped, to avoid all obstacles and find your way back to your owner. But... *something else is happening*

name: Terminal squad: Swarmites
short_description: Terminal squad: swarmites is a game with indirect control where you must erect a chain of buildings, which generate resources for construction or the combat units for destruction of an enemy.

name: Anime Studio Tycoon
short_description: In Anime Studio Tycoon you replay the history of the anime industry. Witness rise of Otaku culture to end cell shading. Start your own company, your decisions will make or break your studio. Create bestselling anime and ascend to greatness in the anime industry.

name: Classic Card Game Spades
short_description: Take the least number of tricks and have a blast. Build your card counting skills and trick-taking tactics. From start to finish, you will adore this card game in spades.

name: Encore Classic Puzzle & Board Games
short_description: It's Game Time! Throw the dice, shuffle the cards and put your strategy to the test with latest version of Encore Classic Puzzle & Board Games. This classic game collection features all time classic games including: Chess, Backgammon, Dominoes, Kakuro Crosswords, Mahjongg, and much more!

name: Some Some Convenience Store

name: 孟德大小姐与自爆少年THREE KINGDOM FANTASY

name: Cold Winter Morning
short_description: "Is this justice?"

name: Frontier - TRS
short_description: Frontier – Tactical Response Squad is a fast-paced top down shooter based in a dystopian future where mage corporations are in control. The corporations driven the environment to the edge with excessive resource extraction and humanity is forced to live in a high-tech bio domes.

name: Tyrania - A Kinetic Visual Novel

name: Terminal Singularity
short_description: The black hole is approaching, the singularity is inevitable! It is too late to run now, your only way out is a miracle. Your salvation lies in the power of the Grid - claim it for yourself and use it to escape your dark and terrible fate.

name: Beach Bar VR
short_description: Beach Bar VR is an arcade game about bar tending. See how many tips you can earn in the time limit. Learn to make different cocktails.

name: Hybrid Instinct

name: Guardians of Greyrock
short_description: A tactical, turn-based high-fantasy adventure card game like no other. Take charge of an elite party of heroes to search out and purge the realm of darkness. Save the ailing Kingdom of Greyrock... in this life or from beyond death itself!

name: GORILLA TOWN
short_description: SCIENCE! A 1920s Art Deco world chock full of giant gorillas, spiteful robots, and highly combustible blimps. Battle friends in turn-based combat or play alone and help Victor the gorilla escape 22 levels of robotic revolt! Inspired by the classic artillery game, Qbasic Gorillas.

name: Lessons with Chii-chan
short_description: Kouta, a timid university student is tasked with tutoring the outgoing yet dense Chieri to help her get through her exams. However, they couldn't be more different. Find out what hijinks ensue in Lessons With Chii-chan!

name: Green Elephant: Epilogue
short_description: Green Elephant: Epilogue is a first-person detective quest set at a Soviet military base after the events of the Russian art film “The Green Elephant”.

name: Pro Player Life
short_description: In Pro Player Life you can make your dream of becoming a pro player come true, and maybe even become a legend in the world of e-sports. Manage your career, level up your skills, and come up against increasingly stronger opponents in your journey to the top of the world.

name: Network E.L.E.
short_description: Network E.L.E.™ is an open-world, survival story set on Planet Mercury in 2184, an abandoned city — military base filled with deadly radiation. You play as Myorah, a NASA exploration pilot going after four Mercury-980 single board Space-VPX chips, which activate a dormant spaceship left within the city.

name: God's Challenge
short_description: In the role of an ancient God who has been stripped of his power, along with the two swords of darkness and light, the player must be very agile and skillful to be able to overcome all challenges, to once again regain the power of a God

name: 往け！往け！マグロ - THE SHOOTING MAGURO -
short_description: You are a MAGURO and have to swim through six stages with perfect control and the fastest speed in the world. Let's blow away anyone who gets in the way with a MAGURO bullet. There is no remaining-lives system in this game.However, you will be called a "sluggard" if you do too much continuation.

name: Lasting Solstice
short_description: After suffering from amnesia, Kazu tries his best to regain his former self. Without his memories, he has trouble remembering close friends and family. With the help of old and new friends along the way, Kazu slowly goes on to his path through self-discovery.

name: ILY
short_description: Two Mushrooms, lots of puzzles!

name: Beyond Enemy Lines - Remastered Edition
short_description: The world is near of nuclear apocalypse, a soviet seperatist group captured the control chip of a military satelite. It is your job to recover the chip! Equipped with state of the art weapons and equipment, you operate in absolute secrecy as a lone wolf far beyond enemy lines.

name: Topfold
short_description: This is a classic tetris game from a different angle. You see the playing field from above and the pieces fall down from you.

name: Khimera: Puzzle Island

Help a young man returning from war rebuild his life, kindle new romances, and reveal a secret that will forever transform the lives of those closest to him—literally!

name: DumbBots
short_description: Create an AI for your DumbBots to help them achieve victory! Learn the basics of coding with guns, explosions, and ragdolls.

name: Metal Banana
short_description: The forest was invaded by an army of robots! Use your skill to help Monkee, Donkee, Tinkee and Pinkee save the day. Metal Banana brings classic elements of arcade games in a new title full of action and colors.

name: Parliament - Parlement
short_description: This immersive journey takes you deep into the heart of Parliament, where an iconic building surges to life with magic realism. Animals spring from stone walls. Empty rooms echo with voices of the past. And figures who have helped shape Canada return to take their place in the halls of democracy.

name: The Under Presents
short_description: From the creators of “Virtual Virtual Reality” - Welcome to the Under! A time and mind bending, multiplayer, theatrical adventure featuring a cast of colorful live and pre-recorded characters, time wizardry, magic to perform and stories to uncover.

name: [UNANNOUNCED UPCOMING ODDFELLOWS SOFTWARE PROJECT NO. 1]
short_description: An upcoming and unannounced game by Oddfellows Software, please check back soon for more details.

name: Betrayal
short_description: The West Marches is a corrupt land ruled by immoral leaders. You are one of four Knights with a lust for power, and in the pursuit of power, the end justifies the means. Betrayal. A web of intricate possibilities - but fair play isn't one of them.

name: Armorik the Viking: The Eight Conquests
short_description: Armorik is a young, courageous and ambitious Viking. With your help and that of Thor, he will try to conquer the eight territories that will allow him to become a legend.

name: Wardens
short_description: A turn-based tactical board game with card battler elements. Contains sandbox elements for you to build your own units, craft your own abilities and set your own game rules with a fully integrated editor.

name: Isles of Sea and Sky
short_description: A fantastic, oceanic, open world puzzle adventure. Solve innovative block puzzles while unearthing a mystifying story, gaining new friends that change the puzzle landscape, and unlocking powers that provide more options for how you choose to progress through the enigmatic Isles of Sea and Sky.

name: Street Racing 2020
short_description: Street Racing 2020 - inovation autosimulator about Street Racing with Realistic physics.

name: Utopia Colony
short_description: The year is 2033. You, an ex-Marine with little opportunities left, have signed up with Utopia Arura, a large mining corporation on Mars. They have sent you to a location they have proposed but you have chosen for mining. Everything else is up to you.

name: Wanko of Marriage ~Welcome to The Dog's Tail!~
short_description: Toya Inuzuka is the successor to the family shrine but dreams of becoming a pâtissier. Complicating things further are these two fluffy-eared and bushy-tailed messengers of god, Koharu and Azuki dream to marry Toya... The three of them will have to work together to fulfill their dreams!

name: Hentai Honeys Jigsaw
short_description: Jigsaw puzzle from 3x3 to 5x5. Contains 4 images. The image changes when you clear it.

name: You Are a Bird
short_description: You Are a Bird is an immersive VR bird flight sim where your real arms become wings. Flap and angle your wings to explore and hunt in VR. Based on real bird flight mechanics and soaring flight physics.

name: 墨游记 Inkball adventures
short_description: This world is not just black and white. Alive, and find more colors. Between black and white.

name: Abracadabrew
short_description: Abracadabrew is a memory-based 1-4 player local co-op game. Cooperate with friends while using your memory to brew as many potions as you can by dawn. Gather ingredients hidden around the room while communicating and staying focused to unlock new brain-racking potion combinations.

name: FAIRY TAIL
short_description: Magic x Guilds x RPG = ”FAIRY TAIL”! Based on the fantasy adventure comic about Natsu, a Dragon Slayer of the rowdy Fairy Tail magician guild, and his unique group of friends battling against unusual and memorable enemies.

name: OshiRabu: Waifus Over Husbandos
short_description: "—I wanna marry you." Those simple words set in motion a ♀ yuri ♀ game of cat and mouse!

name: Rush & Command
short_description: Rush & Command is a classic multiplayer real time strategy game, that will intrigue both highly tactical as well as casual RTS players. The game is set in an alternate world where units and armies dating back from the 1960-1980 are enriched with high-tech current technologies and knowledge.

name: Random Heroes: Gold Edition
short_description: Random Heroes is an action-packed 2D side-scroller platformer. Blast through this action-adventure hero shooter inspired by classic retro games, and stop an alien invasion by teaming up with a bunch of, Random Heroes.

name: Sex Apartments
short_description: You can relive it again or for the first time in your life! You can be just a bully, or a geek or even a macho who does not miss the reason to chat with girls!

name: MicroWorks

name: Wanderlust: Transsiberian
short_description: Board the Trans-Siberian railroad and travel 9,289 km from Moscow to Vladivostok. Clash with a vibrant culture as you meet people as strange to you as you are to them. Journey into a standalone Wanderlust adventure from the makers of The Witcher.

name: Star Escape
short_description: Intense competitive infinite jumping in space action! Catapult from planet to planet, and use gravity to slingshot your way past danger and across the universe. Continue onwards and upwards, but most importantly, move faster than everyone else!

name: Juice Mania
short_description: A great mix between Time Management and Match3! Help maria in this great Match-3 game to build her new juice bar.

name: Knights of the Chalice 2
short_description: Knights of the Chalice 2 is a 2D RPG with turn-based combat. Create six Adventurers and set forth on an epic adventure against Evil. Overcome the odds with superior tactics. Enjoy a whole new dimension of complexity and variety based on the 3.5 ruleset! Includes a Module Editor.

name: How Buddy’s parents met - a jigsaw puzzle tale
short_description: All you need is love and a cat. Discover a romance through the eyes of the cat Buddy in this minimalist jigsaw puzzle game, told in 6 scenes illustrated by @Katia.Numakura with her lovely art style.

name: Asterism Online
short_description: Asterism Online is a Science Fiction Fantasy online multiplayer RPG set in the Groombridge 34 star system that uses a skill based advancement system with no player levels.

name: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst
short_description: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst raises the action-adventure bar through fluid, first person action and immerses players in Faith's story as she fights for freedom.

name: Smile
short_description: A simple trip to the doctor has turned the life of Theodore Caldwell upside down. Unaware of what has really happened, Theo now finds himself in a strange location with hostile entities around every corner. Smile utilizes time management and fear of the unknown to create a truly haunting experience.

name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground
short_description: Conquer the Mortal Realms! The first strategy videogame adaptation of Age of Sigmar’s dark-fantasy universe. Lead your highly-customisable force in challenging roguelike campaigns, unlocking new units, equipment and skills in dynamic, turn-based warfare.

name: Corporated Robots Wars
short_description: New RTS-Strategy-Actin game in Cyberpunk style where YOU take control on squad full of robots. Defend our company from competitors.

name: Tactical Warfare Simulator
short_description: Experience Adrenalin fueled dogfights over the western front.

name: Spirit of Glace
short_description: Help tell the story of Glace, a small creature who suddenly blinks into existence and must find purpose in a world torn apart by a mysterious force. Based on the original 2004 classic played by millions, Spirit of Glace is an open world adventure platformer with a story you won't forget.

name: Legends of Astravia
short_description: Dynamic battles, twisting dungeons, and countless secrets await you in the magical world of Astravia. Journey alongside your companions as you unravel the mystery of your past and uncover the truth behind a mysterious trio’s plot... before the Cataclysm brings forth another age of ruin.

name: The Parenting Simulator
short_description: This is a story where you do something more terrifying than entering a haunted house, more dangerous than assaulting an alien horde, and more important than ruling a fantasy kingdom. You, and you alone, must turn your newborn baby into a functional adult. Will you be a tiger mom or a helicopter dad?

short_description: According to my research, most maids can fly in some way. In her case, it's two wires.

The hero (user) must solve numerous puzzles and deal with countless monsters to complete the operation. It combines adventure puzzles with RPG elements.

short_description: Mists of Aiden is a first-person story driven horror game. You play as a thief trapped in an eerie mansion. Each choice can open a new mystery of the house and lead to a unique walkthrough and ending. Uncover final secret of the house. Uncover your own secrets.

Create unique and ultra-realistic 3D maps with the largest variety of themes, scenarios, and objects. It's immersive, user-friendly, fun and fast!

short_description: Feel the rhythm of exotic cultures and amazing instruments in this beautiful aquatic world music game.

short_description: GREED: Abandoned Dogs is a competitive “PvEvP” Third-Person Shooter. Travel back in time to ancient civilizations where your sole goal is to survive, loot treasures and escape. Be the last one standing to sell stolen relics and become rich.

short_description: Astronaut: The Best is an occult management adventure where people aren't just numbers: they're screwups. You must run a proper space academy using lies, witchcraft, and/or hard work. Guide cadets through a roguelite web of scandals and challenges, or the government will have you killed.
