short_description: Move to one of islands and fight with AI or other players at the keyboard. Set shooting angles and power and destroy enemy tanks.5 islands with different conditions and environmentVarious weather effects affecting the battleFull ballistics physicsSurprises to discover

name: Legacy of Sin: The Father Sacrifice
short_description: Welcome to the original Legacy of Sin game! The Father's Sacrifice is a route defense combined with an epic fantasy storyline straight out of a 90s TV serial. Face an orcish army in a fantasy take on early modern warfare! Deploy your men, hold the line, and defend the kingdom!

name: 잭과 콩나무: 숨겨진 이야기
short_description: 원작 동화 '잭과 콩나무' 를 모티브로 한 게임. 전쟁으로 황폐해진 마을에 살고 있는 잭은, 어느 날 한 마녀로부터 알 수 없는 콩을 받는다. 다음 날, 잭은 마당에 자란 콩나무 줄기를 타고 올라가게 되는데.. 잭은 그곳에서 신비로운 콩나무 성을 탐험하게 된다.

name: Shadow Puppets & Beijing opera
short_description: The work is composed of a total of 4 acts with about 15 minutes. The images and characters of this work are based on one of China’s intangible cultural heritage: Shadow Puppets, and the story and music of the game are based on another China’s intangible cultural heritage: Beijing Opera .

name: Seek Girl 2
short_description: That's hot Strip Escape Game!

name: 已下架
short_description: 《神鬼降世》是一款即时战斗类MMORPG网页游戏游戏 游戏整体上延用了经典的战士、法师、牧师三种职业，同时为玩家提供了三大职业神翼、十二星座守护灵兽、四大上古骑宠等玩法 。 是一款娱乐性，互动性都比较强的网页游戏，虽然画面较为简单，但游戏的PK方面还是做得很到位的。 一键精准敌人锁定击杀，满屏热血攻沙精彩，满足你的传奇体验。 复古写实的游戏画风，经典的传奇游戏玩法，带你重回记忆中的热血岁月。

name: Idle Warrior
short_description: Idle Warrior is a little idle/clicker game in which you play an warrior who has to fight against an unlimited number of enemies.

name: Jetpack Stadium
short_description: Jetpack Stadium is a hilarious VR sports game that will have you flying around a virtual stadium. Use your head to hit a massive soccer ball into your opponent's goal using two hand-mounted rockets. Duke it out against other players in a soccer-like competition!

name: Deep Despair
short_description: Deep Despair is a Minecraft-style survival sandbox. Travel, collect resources, craft items, dig, build, grow crops and survive. Freedom of action is limited only by your imagination!

name: SaveKunkun
short_description: Dive into horror-comedy with SaveKunkun. Play as an IKUN fan stuck in a time loop, remembering each reset. When a prank injures your friend, prevent their fall using over 100 methods. Explore time's mysteries, uncover friend's intentions, and save them.

name: POLYGON
short_description: POLYGON is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using various weapons, you will battle with up to 32 players on large-scale maps. Properly managing your arsenal and skills, you will lead your team to victory!

name: ANARCHY
short_description: ANARCHY is an escape / survivor games. Horde of robots, climbing, traps and many other things will try to kill you. It is one of the toughest games on steam right now.

name: Return to Sender
short_description: Return to Sender is a bullet-frenzy and rogue-like shooter. Killing each enemy returns a portion of your ammo, resulting in a fluid and chaotic run with nonstop shooting. Fight your way through enemies all while collecting new weapons and upgrades.

name: Pulse Forge VR v0.544
short_description: Pulse Forge VR– get the highest score in your favourite music by destroying everything. Forge your own map for music destruction and have fun!

name: 降神战役 -A Story of the usurpers-
short_description: Because of an accident, the war once again descended on this land where peace has been welcomed for less than 10 years. Rebels swarming up, weak religious orders, hostile neighbors in the north. Where will the fate of the country go?

name: Hack or Die!
short_description: The Hacky-Sack Platformer! Keep the ball air-born while you kick your way through sprawling levels. Use unique kicking mechanics to rescue your best friend Kevin the dog. Just DONT DROP IT!!!

name: Notera
short_description: Notera is created for anyone trying to learn or play the harmonica better. It allows for both composing and step by step instructions for playing your songs through a virtual harmonica and a comprehensive interface!

name: Lovingly Evil
short_description: Unleash your inner villain and head over to the Villain Conference, the one and only interdimensional business event for evildoers! Who knows, maybe you'll even find a partner - whether it's in crime or love…

name: Perpetual Dream
short_description: Perpetual Dream is a FPV puzzle game telling the story of a dream hiding a lot of secrets... Discover several environnements to seek your past !

name: Void Monsters 2: The Blight
short_description: Summon and train hundreds of unique monsters, and build a party strong enough to turn back The Blight.

name: Rascallz: Tiki Tiki
short_description: Play with girls' cups and find the hidden treasure to impress the heroines. Move along, find new locations, unlock new characters and be the best tiki tiki player in the world!

name: SpellMaster: The Saga
short_description: SpellMaster - The Saga is a story-driving action RPG inspired by the Gothic series. Gameplay takes place in an open, seamless world filled with secrets, mysteries, terrible monsters, and varied NPCs. Who to be and how to behave is yours to choose - this is your Saga

name: Chasing Light
short_description: 'Chasing Light' is the story of the seven days of exploring the physical properties of a game and uncovering an inner world of human beings and society. Have a weird trip!

name: WarDogs: Red's Return
short_description: Fight gangs and bring order back to the city in this retro style beat em up game.

name: Alien Cat
short_description: Save the Universe with the Alien-Cat in this brand new puzzle-platformer game! Jump on your enemies heads, push the boxes and walk on the ceiling.

name: Family Mysteries 2: Echoes of Tomorrow
short_description: Framed scientist travels through time to save his beloved wife and reveal kidnapper's identity. Find hidden objects in the post-apocalyptic world, solve cyberpunk puzzles and embrace the future full of adventures!

name: INVISIBLE MAN
short_description: A story about a man turned invisible by an experiment. Explore the mysterious facility and escape it.

name: Shadowforge
short_description: Shadowforge is a painting software with sandbox features. Upload your own made brushes and share with the Shadowforge community!

name: Quick Trivia
short_description: Quick Trivia is a small multiplayer guessing game — with questions related to gaming.

name: GameGuru MAX
short_description: GameGuru MAX is a 3D game-maker that makes the creation of your game simple, quick and easy – no coding required! With all the tools and assets you need in one place you can start making your dream game in minutes! Dream it ∙ Build it ∙ Play it

name: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands
short_description: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands lets you explore freely and at your pace entire ski resorts and the surrounding mountains. Unlock ski lifts and reach new areas by competing in challenges, or enjoy the scenery while you find your own path down the mountains.

name: Food Chain
short_description: Full Physics Massive Multiplayer.

name: Red Zirion
short_description: Red Zirion is a retro shooting game with upgradeable attributes in the roguelike style. Game inspired by groups of heroes and animated series from the 80s.

name: To the Edge of the Sky
short_description: This stunning post-cyberpunk indie visual novel is waiting for you to dive in. Explore the secrets of Olympia, the most technologically advanced country on Earth, as one of its top secret operatives. Can you complete your mission without regrets?

name: Thirsty Heroes
short_description: Hire tavern patrons for the dirty work in this dungeon-crawling, deck-building business sim with swords. Can you use wits instead of reflexes to amass loot and appease the King?

name: Cube Course
short_description: A simple, yet fun 2D platformer. Get from point A to point B without hitting a spike and dying. Collect coins along the way to unlock features that change the atmosphere, difficulty and feeling of the game. If you like those old games that aren't to complicated and complex, you'll love this.

name: Expedition Zero
short_description: Expedition Zero — survival horror set in the anomaly zone of the northern forest. Face the dreadful forest monster and find a way to defeat it. Reveal the secrets of the lost expedition and your mysterious enemy. It’s either hunt or be hunted.

name: The Dark Heart of Balor
short_description: Archdemon Balor has opened the Gate of Hell into the human realm and hordes of demons and monsters have flooded into your world destroying everything in their path. You must protect those who are still alive and ultimately destroy Balor to close the Gate.

name: Dwarf Shop
short_description: Dwarf Shop is a Shop Simulator with, you guessed it, Dwarves! Help the Dragon Clan lure their very own dragon by amassing piles and piles of glorious gold. Send one dwarf deep into the caves to find ingredients while the others craft various equipment and sell them to unsuspecting customers!

name: Immortal Love: Stone Beauty Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you save your beloved from a dangerous sculptor’s obsession?

name: Pizza Master VR
short_description: Pizza Master VR is a fast paced pizza making game. Play in local co-op mode with a waiter, or by yourself in singleplayer. Please customers with drinks and pizzas made from 8 core ingredients. With warm visuals, arcade style gameplay and intuitive controls, who knew pizza making could be so fun?

name: Carrots and Cream
short_description: An interactive meditation on the violence of nature and nutrition.

name: Your Story
short_description: In Your Story, a visual novel with point’n’click elements, you leave the safe quiet of your family’s inn and embark on a fantasy adventure. It’s a wholesome growing of age tale. The mystery awaits just beyond the horizon…

name: Drive Forward
short_description: Drive through a very long trip including many beautiful scenes! Drive Forward!

name: 藏梦 Hidden Dream
short_description: “Hidden Dream” is a game about puzzle, exploration and collection in horizontal version. In this game, players are supposed to participate in the story about how did Princess Wencheng complete her journey to Tibet that for getting marry with Srongtsen Gampo in Princess Wencheng’s fantasy world.

name: Spectrum
short_description: Spectrum is a short puzzle-platformer about color in a dull world. Explore over 100+ levels of tight, puzzle-platforming to become the king of all colors. Switch colors to interact with a multitude of mechanics that allow for deep, complex interaction.

name: Dragon Banner
short_description: Dragon Banner is a new mix of strategy and base-building. It is built from the love of building blocks and real-time strategy games. Discover the fate of dragons and start the resistance against the Skull Queen and her army of skeleton warriors!

name: 被遺棄的雙子 Gemini of the abandoned
short_description: Horror adventure game, player will control the fairy sisters who have been captured alive and help them escape from the dark experimental site, both parties need to share the same blood volume and live and die together, support single and double player modes.

name: Lesbian Voyeur Simulator
short_description: Make your fantasies come true. Unlock accessories to customize your girls. Make them perform your favourite sex positions. Watch them from any angle and distance possible.

name: Greyhat - A Digital Detective Adventure
short_description: How far would you go to save your daughter? As an infamous hacker-for-hire you have the skills to steal almost any secret. But when your daughter is taken, will you be able to use these skills to uncover a dark conspiracy that goes further than you could ever imagine?

name: zombie variant
short_description: This is a first person shooting game，Players are surrounded by zombies，Players are free to explore the surrounding areas,Players can avoid zombie attacks or kill zombies, and live as long as possible.

name: Thrillgate
short_description: A comic strip, a classic point n' click, a surreal adventure set in the 80's.

name: Realpolitiks II
short_description: Lead your people to glory and write a new chapter of history in Realpolitiks II, a real-time grand strategy game where you lead any contemporary nation in an attempt to secure world dominance.

name: CYGNI: All Guns Blazing
short_description: An unrelenting onslaught of eye-popping visuals, ear bursting soundscapes and mind-melting action makes CYGNI the vanguard for the next generation of shoot-em ups. Outgunned, outmanned and out on your own, plunge into a sky full of hell in a last-ditch battle for survival.

name: Protective Clothing
short_description: Five people found themselves in a secluded, abandoned factory. Abducted for unknown reasons, the victims are faced with deadly traps as trust degrades by the minutes.

name: Higher Critters - 1v4
short_description: 《高等动物》是一款欧美风科幻卡通题材的1v4休闲竞技游戏。虚拟世界中的“伊甸”方舟受到异常干扰，人们发现自己并没有在现实世界的休眠舱中醒来，而是来到了一片酷似魔方的浮岛。他们要面对的是拥有超高武力的大兽人，人类只能利用场景地形和各种道具与其周旋，这会是一场激烈的战斗！

name: Farming Simulator 22
short_description: Create your farm and let the good times grow! Harvest crops, tend to animals, manage productions, and take on seasonal challenges.

name: Trailer Trashers
short_description: PLAY ONLINE WITH STEAM REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER! Join with up to four players in this Hectic twin stick bullet bouncing frenzy. Challenge your friends in Death-match, Last Man Standing, Shotgun Soccer or crown yourself king of the "couch" in the all-including Party Mode!

name: The Deadly Facade
short_description: Fame is a tricky business. You were all set to be the next big star in Hollywood until you got all tangled up in a chilling murder mystery. Can you solve the case while also delivering the performance of a lifetime?

name: 无上道
short_description: 《无上道》是款东方仙侠题材的ARPG网页游戏，主要讲述了主角聚集神州和四荒改造为永界，领导众生走向全新文明的故事。 游戏画面大场景绘图、特色打斗效果设计、丰富的人物造型，将角色的英雄儿女气概展现地淋漓尽致，高度展现唯美仙侠世界。 玩法方面，伴随着剧情推进，各类高级神器、神秘灵宝将不断升级解锁，玩家战力也会随之提升，远古神物、威武坐骑、激萌伙伴，都将一一来到，并一直陪伴玩家战斗。

name: PeakPoise
short_description: PeakPoise is a VR simulator, where the player can practice playing instruments in different scenes. You should have an operator who can trigger different events.

name: PLUGMAX
short_description: Simple yet electric battles! Shockingly easy rules! Plug in to win! Show the world your Power with Plug Max!

name: Spellbound Spire
short_description: Go on an immersive VR Journey into a magical tower in Al-Andalus filled with corruption. Progress the tower's mind-bending walkways and reality-altering moments using your magical gloves. Can you solve its mysteries and restore the peace in the tower?

name: Nyanco Channel
short_description: Welcome to Nyanco Channel! Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process that one does not become a monster. Moreover, should one gaze long enough into the abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.

name: WalkinVR
short_description: WalkinVR Driver is a software program for people with physical disabilities which aims to make Virtual Reality Games and Applications more accessible.

name: Quarter Horse Racing
short_description: Spend a day at the races - Quarter Horse races.

name: Aspiring Light
short_description: The world is a messed up place. But it's all a blip on the radar to Aiden, who's got his own problems to worry about. Things like, what the answer to that last math problem was. Trying to keep his friendships afloat before it's too late. And just wondering what the future has in hold for him...

name: Hexahedra
short_description: Hexahedra is an open-ended programming puzzle game. Design and optimize factories to build cubes, used galaxy-wide as crates, musical instruments, even chic coffins. Rewind and replay the action to hunt for improvements. Compete with friends, and help a tiny octopus with a nightmare family visit.

name: Totemlands
short_description: Totemlands is a relaxing crafting, building game where you raise totem poles, hunt spirits, decorate and explore the lands.

name: Werewolves 2: Pack Mentality
short_description: It's a war between your werewolf pack and the Human Sovereignty Movement! Lead the pack to victory before extremists turn your packmates against each other.

name: Senshi Tank 2: Space Bots
short_description: An exciting, fast-paced, top down shooter -- play til you die in a bullet-hell arena OR choose to race against time in a randomized search and destroy mode set in SPACE! Either way, you'll have fun with this challenging arcade shooter.

name: Performer
short_description: Performer is a game with fun puzzles. Test your logic and ingenuity in different locations of the world as a mercenary who has to eliminate goals or steal secret developments.

name: Entertainment Hero 2
short_description: Training's Over, Hero! Conquer Eleven Stages Full of Unique Enemies and Obstacles! Confront All Nine Exciting Boss Battles Leading to the Final Boss! Find Secret Power-Ups and Additional Weapons to Help You on Your Way!

name: All Must Fall
short_description: You fell into a pit and for some reason you can only move with a pole. Can you get out?

name: Breaking Gates
short_description: Venture into a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this action-packed 2D RPG! Master fast-paced combat, uncover hidden secrets, and forge powerful gear as you embark on a thrilling journey to save a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

name: Archaid
short_description: Archaid is a collection of cognitive arcade games of numeral alphabetics and hexagonal grids with puzzles of memorization, pattern recognition, heuristics, hypercube navigation, complexity and strategy inspired by various ancient and modern concepts of gematria and mathematics.

name: A Squire's Tale
short_description: Battle evil faeries and traitors at court to rescue the prince of England! Can you resist the call of faerie long enough to complete your quest?

name: Stanga
short_description: Relax your mind, unwind with Stanga.

name: Speed Sweeper
short_description: Speed Sweeper is a competitive minesweeper speedrunner!

name: ENEFN
short_description: ENEFN is a strange school, something even more strange happened and only one of the students circulates in its corridors, you, satisfying the requests of those who can no longer move... make your journey in search of your freedom.

name: RATTUS
short_description: Play as a Rattus, a psychic rat capable of summoning meteors and altering the fabric of time. He decides to fight some birds. Can you help him survive?

name: Campgrounds IV Collector's Edition
short_description: Addie's friend, the Shaman, is finding it hard to develop campsites on his own. Some nefarious forces are at work. It's time for you to step in!

name: The Old War
short_description: The Old War is a dark fantasy strategy game where you build, customize, and upgrade a persistent army, keeping units and heroes as long as they survive. Manage world instability, where magic use triggers random catastrophic events.

name: Rollback
short_description: It's a special challenge to get a chance. Go up to the highest point with simple control. If you make a mistake, try again.

name: The Rule of Land: Pioneers
short_description: This is a survival game. After the coronation, human beings had to move into the underground. Fifty years later, some people thought the disaster was over and organized a survival competition on the surface. Some brave people took part in the competition . You are one of them.

name: 离校日 The School Leaving Day
short_description: The game is a 3D Puzzle shooting game, which contains some thriller scenes and RPG elements. You will play a young man trapped in a mystery school and temporarily lost his memory in the game. You will find your memory and discover the truth of the fact while escaping from the school.

name: Lost Memories 3 Side Stories
short_description: Important note: Use the modifier to modify the data in the game will be judged cheating, the penalty is life-long ban on running the game! The game moderate liver injury, clearance time at least 200 hours, before you buy it must be estimated whether the body can bear it. Is your liver OK?

name: Sephonie
short_description: In this acrobatic 3D adventure, parkour through an massive cave network. Face lush caverns, subterranean oceans, and surreal cityscapes as you guide three biologists through the shifting spiritual landscape of the island depths! From Anodyne 2's creators!

name: Cuyo
short_description: Cuyo is a relaxing, small platformer. Relax and play with relax mode or take a small challenge in normal mode.

name: イヌワシ ～うらぶれ探偵とお嬢様刑事の池袋事件ファイル～
short_description: お嬢様刑事とうらぶれ探偵が挑む１７の事件！　池袋を舞台に男女コンビが大活躍！元ギャング執事に天才高校生ハッカーなど個性あふれるキャラクター達と力を合わせて、サスペンスにコメディ、オカルトなど多彩な事件に挑もう！

name: Chronicle of Daneya
short_description: Chronicle of Daneya - is a medieval fantasy where player has to write the history of the realm, make difficult and sometimes deadly decisions and put his signature under every word he wrote.

name: Bigwig Flint
short_description: Bigwig Flint is a challenging, thrilling, and hilarious top down shooter. A soulfully crafted game with emphasis on perfect classic retro gameplay. Waldemar, the circumcised square, must fight against Bigwig Flint and his many allies. At stake is not only the Universe, but also your sanity.

name: Hentai Amazon Girls
short_description: A third-person girl named Yuki has to rescue her friends from the enemies.

name: ISOLAND3: Dust of the Universe
short_description: A sequel to the ISOLAND series, where you continue your journey to explore the story of the universe on this island.

name: American Arcadia
short_description: American Arcadia is a cinematic puzzle game that combines a 2.5D platformer and first-person game to tell the tale of a thrilling escape. Experience the extraordinary story of Trevor, an average man escaping from the world's most popular reality tv show.

name: MyCompany996
short_description: 在《我的公司996》中，你会遇到各种典型职场人物和职场事件，公司危机四伏，如果想要保住饭碗，你需要“机灵点”，与同事维护好关系，哄的老板心花怒放，更快升职、加薪。当然，游戏里可以自由选择，你可以另辟蹊径，制霸职场…… 20余种迥异的大结局，近百种成就，等待你来解锁。

name: AeternoBlade II: Infinity
short_description: AeternoBlade II: Infinity, new patch in 4K is a hardcore action-puzzle game of Time-Manipulation Combat. Control the flow of time, amend the past, foresee the future, convolute with alternate timelines to fight otherwise undefeatable foes and circumvent the impossible.

name: Lynn , The Girl Drawn On Puzzles
short_description: [ Lynn ] In this Oriental Painting, there are many mazes and monsters created by the Nine-tailed Fox.Let's safely guide Lynn back home by moving the puzzle pieces drawn on top of the Oriental Painting.

name: Skully
short_description: On a mysterious remote island, a skull washes up on shore and is reawakened by an enigmatic deity. Dubbed Skully, the newly reanimated being has been summoned to intervene in a war between the deity’s three siblings, whose quarrel jeopardizes the island they call home.

name: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 1
short_description: Lovely adventuring RPG series. Casual, story-driven journey and quests. People live in fear of the dragon. Embark with your friend Brent on a dangerous quest to kill the dragon and become a hero.

name: Daedaluz
short_description: Daedaluz is a game about maneuverability and obstacle avoidance where your ship breaks apart as you collide with them. Try to reach the end in consecutive increasingly difficult levels or try infinity mode and see how long you can survive.

name: Mine Dungeon
short_description: A Minesweeper game with a cute character, the control like a action game, and there have barrier objects and enemies.

name: The Trivial Dead
short_description: Grab some friends to help you fend off a horde of brain eating zombies by answering 1000’s of trivia questions! Earn killstreaks by answering multiple questions in a row. Choose your difficulty and how many waves you can survive against, or even try our survival endless mode.

name: Birth ME Code
short_description: The second entry of the Abime Series. Play as the mastermind in a death game where you must find the traitor while concealing your identity. Six hours, one school, six deaths. Nine participants fight for survival: it's kill or be killed, trust or deceive, escape or die.

name: Physics Based Golf
short_description: Physics Based Golf is an indie physics-based golf simulator that covers ALL aspects of the real sport. Drive your golf cart to your ball and use your rangefinder to gain information. From there it's up to you to choose the right club and execute the perfect swing. Play with 4 people online!

name: The Curse of Zigoris
short_description: The Curse Of Zigoris is an action adventure pixel art platformer game with a story about a girl who tries to lift the curse from her village.

name: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place
short_description: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place is a story about a building eater consuming a tower in a town condemned to be removed from history. It ponders the violence of erasure and the profound grief of surviving at the edge of despotism, when places of entangled heritage are willfully effaced.

name: Tales in the TAXI
short_description: 『Tales in the TAXI』 is a multi-ending adventure game in which the story diverges by driving a taxi and talking with passengers.

name: Summon Masks
short_description: A Shaman gives life to Masks just to play with them. Take a side and show to the Shaman which is the best Mask.

name: Bloodwych
short_description: A dark fantasy role play adventure that pits your strategic thinking against an insane ruler and his mystical forces.

name: Steampunk Genius
short_description: Create futuristic designs in the fantastic world of Steampunk.

name: Sarawak
short_description: A short literary mystery game set in Oxford and Borneo

name: Ex-Zodiac
short_description: A fast-paced low-poly 3D rail shooter heavily inspired by classics of the early 90's. Join protagonist Kyuu as she fights to free the worlds of the Sanzaru Star System, overrun by the intergalactic terrorist organization known as Zodiac.

name: Botty: Paper tales
short_description: Botty: Paper tales is an atmospheric adventure made entirely of paper. Botty's little robot faces a different illusion to get out of the paper world.

name: Apprehend;Girlfriend
short_description: Apprehend;Girlfriend is a Yuri Visual Novel about two young women living together under the same roof.

name: Hnefatafl
short_description: The ancient boardgame of the Vikings. Thousands of variants, offline and online cross-platform play with leaderboards and tournaments. Are you ready for the challenge? Prepared to earn your way to Valhalla?

name: Adventures of JQ Jones: "Isle of the Serpent Empress"
short_description: An action, adventure, stealth, VR maze crawler game. Explore and help JQ Jones collect gems, Serpent's eggs, hidden door knobs and keys to open gates. Battle against the enemies to pass through each levels by using your longbow, sword and Shuriken blade.

name: Transfer Of Essence
short_description: A fantasy tactical rpg /dungeon crawler where you decide how to spend action points to proceed. Play through each character's experience of the events to find out the mystery behind what happened.

name: Ninshi Masuta
short_description: Ninshi Masuta is a 2D action game where you are a ninja and have to save the city from the chaos caused by criminals.

name: Warspace
short_description: Warspace is a arcade space shooter game.

name: Spacewalk Defender
short_description: Dual-wield high tech weapons to fight off endless and increasingly difficult waves of enemies in this sci-fi VR shooter. Give it your best in an attempt to climb the leaderboards by reaching the highest score out of all players.

name: Carnival Games
short_description: Carnival Games offers fun for everyone and can be played alone or with up to three others. Hit home runs, pile the highest stack of cakes, and take your horse to the finish line. 20 total mini-games will have you and your friends stepping right up to win again and again!

name: Touch Typing Home Row Speed Grinder
short_description: An Onscreen Keyboard that is compatible with many programs, it allows you to take your Typing Training Everywhere You go! It also has Onboard Grinding Games that can be played offline allowing you to learn how to type using the "Key Rollover Method".

name: Iron Disco
short_description: A parody of 80s' action films. The game is set on a tropical island. Captain Juan and Dr. Lee challenge the Dark Lord and plan to take over the planet with their army of soldiers, zombies, robots, and creepy monsters.

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII
short_description: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is an ARPG rooted in Chinese history and mythology. Players take on the role of Taishi Zhao, a calm and reliable swordsman who was accidentally involved in a tragic fate. To protect his beloved family, he starts a journey in this chaotic realm to find the truth.

name: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby
short_description: Enter the arena and experience fast-paced, arcade-style vehicular combat. Wield powerful weapons, use the environment to your advantage, or simply smash your way to victory in Crush Zone—where only the strongest survive.

name: King of Vikings
short_description: King of Vikings is an adventure visual novel set in a Viking fantasy land. You play as a Viking noble summoned by Queen Mathilde to defeat a tentacled menace by assembling an elite unit of warriors.

name: Tiny Bunny: Prologue
short_description: Tiny Bunny: Prologue is a non-linear horror visual novel. Those, who have heard the voice of the forest, are beyond help.

name: Survival Denied
short_description: Survival Denied is a casual zombie shooter, made primarily with VR in mind. Wide choice of weapons, perks and power-ups make the game interesting. Dive in and try to survive as long as you can!

name: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown
short_description: TDUSC is a lifestyle and social experience that redefines what an open-world racing game can be. Explore a fully recreated Hong Kong Island. Take to the road behind the wheel of exceptional cars and live the ultimate life of luxury.

name: 愛神餐館MAX
short_description: Love, restaurant, and RPG adventure all in one, the origin of the "Cupid Bistro!!" series is here! As the main protagonist Rato Coriander, you need to run a bistro as part of your final year assignment. In one year's time, you are the one to decide all different endings with 13 beautiful girls!

name: Ourea
short_description: Ourea is a Cinematic Puzzle game about discovering the harrowing past of a long-forgotten world. Play as the last of the Oreads and unravel the mysterious history of your people.​

name: PASVAN
short_description: You can't get away from 'GAMAN' !

name: Roller Riot
short_description: Get your revenge on the enemy cyborg roller derby gang! Roll and fight through a beautiful neon cityscape as CB, a genetically modified cyborg, bent on getting revenge for her past...

name: Purple Saturn Day
short_description: In this psychedelic sci-fi Olympiad, athletes from planets across the galaxy gather to compete in the Purple Saturn Day games.

name: Murders in Space
short_description: Track down a murderer on a space station using gadgets, observation, analysis, and interrogation — before they claim their next victim

name: Space Station 14
short_description: Disasters, enemies, and incompetence conspire to make each shift aboard the station a unique and hellish experience. Sign up today to explore intricate game mechanics and enjoy limitless player interaction! (Nanotrasen Inc. is not responsible for injury, death, or worse).

name: Strange Creatures
short_description: Strange Creatures is a 1 to 4 player couch co-op puzzle game where players are curious creatures that use wacky abilities to solve puzzles and escape the wicked lab.

name: Myst
short_description: Welcome to Myst: a starkly beautiful island, eerily tinged with mystery and shrouded in intrigue. Built from the ground up to play in 2D & VR, explore Myst in a whole new dimension! Journey to the Ages, unravel puzzles, and be a part of the surrealistic adventure that will become your own.

name: 吞噬追踪
short_description: 完全免费的休闲网络游戏,游戏中也不存在内购内容.作者承诺该游戏将一直免费.

name: Geometry Arena
short_description: A free-form arena-shooter Roguelite with heavy emphasis on building an overpowered character! You play as a little shape that shoots other shapes! Strengthen your character by mixing and matching mods and upgrades, and experiment with a limitless rune upgrade system!

name: Mya of the Desert
short_description: Mya of the Desert is a Puzzle Platforming game where you use earth manipulating powers, or Geomancy, to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and defeat foes. Elevate pillars of earth and bend rocks to your will as Mya, a desert wanderer, as she returns life to the world around her!

name: Hand Cannon Virtuoso
short_description: Hand Cannon Virtuoso is a VR roguelite shooter with card game elements. Play your cards right to build your arsenal and crush your enemies as you fight to the top!

name: Brooklyn Sentai: Episode One
short_description: A rhythm game with a story. Dance your way through a platforming, musical adventure. Evil aliens have returned to earth. Problem? Not when you and your friends have matching costumes and the power of music. Someone must rise to fight evil- but don't do it for yourself. Do it for Brooklyn.

name: Karma Knight
short_description: Karma Knight is a fast paced 2D side-scrolling platform action game with stylish combat. Find hidden items in the stages, collect different spells, defeat the enemies as you gain more experience and enjoy the overall platform action game style.

name: Animocity
short_description: Animocity is a hardcore top-down shooter game where we follow a bunch of magical animals down an ever changing set of dungeons as they use spells to fight their way out.

name: 幻想小镇危机
short_description: 这是一款动作角色扮演类游戏,玩家需要通过任务,打怪提升战斗力从而拯救小镇。

name: VIP Rebels
short_description: VIP Rebels is a quick & light RTS. It's an army building game where you will use VIPs and their crazy skills to help you protect your elephant treasure wagon. The further you get, the bigger the rewards!

name: Puzzle Girls: Alexa
short_description: Alexa wants you to join her in having fun whilst playing this relaxing puzzle game.

name: Puzzle Girls: Cute
short_description: Enjoy some cute puzzle action in this relax-alot one handed puzzle game.

name: Jesus Christ RPG: Lucifer
short_description: Finally the long awaited prequel to Jesus Christ RPG is out! Play as Lucifer, the devious dark angel, in this retro arcade styled four-directional shooter.

name: Whisper
short_description: Whisper is a puzzle game about sound shaping our reality. Human perception is guided by visual input. We know that a tree is a tree because it looks like a tree. What if we took that away? If you hear the sound of a falling tree, but no one can see it, are you still in a forest? Knock on wood.

name: The Painted Forest
short_description: You wash ashore as a castaway to come upon the painted forest, a fossil forest in a distant world, and the lost temples of the people that once worshiped it.

name: GANZWORKER
short_description: GANZWORKER - truly oldschool style of gameplay. For all classic FPS lover.

name: Graviter
short_description: Graviter is a real-world-physics-based game about manipulating gravitational forces. Shrink and enlarge bodies, and move them around to find your way through over a hundred different levels of varying complexity.

name: We should talk.
short_description: It's not what you say, it's how you say it. We should talk is a short-form narrative game that will make you think carefully about the words you choose. Can your relationship survive the night?

name: Hyper Treasure - The Legend of Macaron
short_description: A Point & Click adventure game with action scenes, movies, QTE and scary monsters / Find the truth among the multiple endings (It looks like this, but it's a precisely made game)

name: Cosmodread
short_description: Cosmodread is a VR survival horror roguelike about escaping a dying spaceship filled with nightmares. Stranded in a hostile universe, you must explore, survive, and find your way back to the safety of Earth.

name: AnShi
short_description: Grab your hoverboard and explore the ancient, mysterious world of AnShi as you glide across caves, large deserts and old temple ruins to discover its secrets. Featuring stunning visuals and an original soundtrack, AnShi delivers a unique, breathtaking experience.

name: Robot Fight
short_description: Robot Fight is what it looks like. A simple, funny "board game". Fast play with 1-2 minutes per round. The realy play with friends game. The feeling of life, when we laugh together about ourselves and our friends. Of course, it is spiced with the words "how can you be have a such of luck".

name: Chickduck & Catduck
short_description: A find-the-difference, graphical novel love story that follows a duckling who was forced away from home, then in his darkest moments, found hope and the best friend he could ask for.

name: 幸存者 星星之火 | Survivor Spark
short_description: Survivor: Spark is the first episode of a series of anti alien invasion games. It's a classic transcendental third person shooting game!

name: Hyperbolica
short_description: Hyperbolica is a whimsical Non-Euclidean adventure with mind-bending worlds full of games, puzzles, mazes, and secrets! Immerse yourself in reality-warping geometries where lines can never be parallel, horizons are curved, and space grows exponentially.

name: Kinstrife
short_description: Medieval strategy RPG with revolutionary physically simulated combat. Become a wandering knight, journeying to castles and towns in your quest for fortune & glory, fighting in battles & tournaments. Build your wealth, equipment & following - and carve out your destiny in a time of strife!

name: Zeliria Sanctuary II: Xinori Asylum
short_description: The adventures of Maxx, Humkey and their friends continue! Is Zeliria really a kind of sanctuary? Who invaded the empty planet, failing to wake the absolute weapon sleeping in its depth? Sequel of the fascinating story of Zeliria Sanctuary is already waiting for you! Follow the purple hamster.

name: Insania
short_description: Insania is a frenetic coop game for up to 4 players. Play local or online. Use items while cooperating with your friends to stop an invasion of horrifying creatures and find the source of the invasion.

name: Ultimate Under Water
short_description: Ultimate Under Water is a clean and stylish interactive 3D live wallpaper that display cute low-poly under water fishes on the desktop with animated backgrounds. You can control and interact with fishes with your mouse.

name: Wild West Steam Loco
short_description: Fully functional model railway building game in Wild West style. Create and paint the landscape, place the tracks, steam engines and wagons. Start the trains and create control sequences to direct them to the right tracks.

name: FPS Infinite
short_description: Phr00t's Software is all about procedural generation, optional VR support and fun! This is a full free game inspired by Metroid Prime: explore randomly generated worlds for new abilities to unlock new ones. Will you upgrade your missile launcher or teleporting abilities? Will you escape in time?

name: Raiders Run
short_description: Raiders Run is a Multiplayer Arena Fighting Game that takes advantage of Skill Based PVP and fun engaging combat mechanics.

name: LAST CHICK - 最後のひよこ
short_description: The second of low-price series of KimidoriSoft! "LAST CHICK - 最後のひよこ"!An action game depicting the majestic daily lives of chickens and their families living in a world where humanity has become a zombie.Overcome the crisis in three modes using two egg techniques developed by the parent chicken.

name: Bells 'n' Whistles
short_description: Bells 'n' Whistles is a difficult point-and-click game that tests your ability to multitask. You must deal with the multiple systems on a machine in order to prevent it from breaking down. Are you up to the task?

name: Othello Let's Go
short_description: Othello Let's Go is a beautifully designed strategy board game for all ages. A total of 8 levels of computer AI difficulty, suits for both beginners and experts! More than 100 carefully selected Endgame and Lights Out levels are waiting for you to solve!

name: Ohayou! Beginner's Japanese
short_description: Ohayou! Beginner’s Japanese is an educational game that will teach you the basics of Japanese Hiragana and Katakana.

name: Bone Appetit
short_description: When the king declares that all food is now his, whatcha' gonna' do? Raise a skeleton slave to steal it back for you, of course!

name: Sentimental K
short_description: 'Sentimental K' is a 3D roguelike action game. Weapons, skills, artifacts, bosses, dungeon layouts are randomly generated each time you play. Make strategic choices to create powerful synergies and enjoy the unexpected and challenging play!

name: Marshmallow Tank
short_description: A tank simulation game，with cartoon style，battle royale，destory everything you can see!

name: Dream Date
short_description: Date, communicate, enhance feelings and record good memories with girls!

name: Move It Up
short_description: MOVE IT UP V 1.1 brings a unique rhythm game experience with random level generator and battle mode.

name: Iwate Mountain Dance
short_description: Iwate Mountain Dance is a tough-as-nails bullet hell boss fighter. Take on unique multi-stage bosses in a grand dance of handcrafted fights, each with their own attack patterns and intense combos, as you explore the lands of Iwate and learn its history.

name: Library Of Ruina
short_description: "May you find your book in this place." Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage. Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward. And eventually, get your hands on… The one singular, perfect book.

name: CHICARO DENTISTRY
short_description: It's an educational simulation game for the children that entertains teaching the actual dentist profession

name: Hot And Lovely 2
short_description: This is an interesting casual origami game that can exercise your hands-on ability. And when you pass all the levels, you can start the hot sex journey between you and the beautiful girl.

name: Super Arcade Soccer 2021
short_description: SUPER ARCADE SOCCER 2021 combines the best of today’s technology and classic retro games.Use your best skills and tailor your strategy to beat the competition.If you loved games like Sensible Soccer or Kick-Off, this game is a must-have.

name: NO LIFE: Zombie Survivor
short_description: NO LIFE: Zombie Survivor is a brutal survival roguelite where you’ll face endless hordes of relentless zombies. Choose your survivor and weapons, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and gear up for increasingly intense battles against the undead.

name: 贰负传
short_description: This game is based on a fairy tale, a king named Erfu killed a monster with the help of his friend Wei. In this game, we will be Wei, take a great adventure, where show landscape of ancient story, monsters out of our imagine, and of cource an excellent story.

name: Shelter Manager
short_description: We live in a troubled world. Viruses, military conflicts - you never know what danger the world will face tomorrow. It's time to get ready now! Lead a bunker network and start developing society after a global disaster.

name: Pirate Island Mini Golf VR
short_description: Pirate Island Mini Golf VR is a single or multi-player virtual reality experience set in a scenic tropical island. There are four, 18-hole courses placed throughout the island, with multiple challenges and enhancements that can be unlocked to mix up game play to keep you coming back for more.

name: Outset
short_description: Use a GRAPPLING HOOK to explore and uncover the mysteries of a platformer-RPG world in OUTSET.

name: D3D INSIDE 2: HELL
short_description: D3D INSIDE 2: HELL is a first-person shooter in the style of low poly. The famous Ded, the storm of all demons, is back to send the demons back to hell!

name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2020
short_description: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2020 puts you in the role of head coach of your favorite college basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from staff hiring, recruiting, scouting and all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to tournament glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: Hero Tower
short_description: Play as the Hero as he is dropped into the Hero Simulation Machine MKI and take-on a tower full of puzzles and monsters. Equip a variety of tools and weapons found in chests on each floor, that have limited uses and reset every floor, giving each one a unique challenge.

name: Bubble Bounce
short_description: Pop bubbles by bouncing off the ground. Or logs. Or really anything you can find. Compete with your friends to see who can pop the most bubbles before the time runs out or play in dodge mode to make the last player to not touch a bubble the winner!

name: A Week In The Cold
short_description: Traverse the cold slippery ice by sliding and skating while trying to avoid both pesky penguins and ghostly wolves. All the while moving between campfires trying to stay warm.

name: Heartworm
short_description: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

name: Saint Emiliana
short_description: After Emiliana's sister is captured in a Witch Hunt, she offers up her soul to a demon in order to gain the power of a Witch. Now she must wrestle with her faith as she searches for her sister.

name: VR Mini Bowling 2
short_description: Welcome to the world of Mini Bowling! In this VR game bowling meets mini golf to create a totally new experience! VR Mini Bowling 2 also brings the addition of Powerups, which completely change the way the game is played!

name: False Myth
short_description: The story is set in the city of Lylan on an isolated island. Everything seems peaceful until a mysterious aura approaches...

name: Rabbit Simulator
short_description: In a beautiful island, as a bunny, collect some carrots and run around! ᕱ⑅ᕱ This is a simple and relaxing bunny walking simulator game. Your only goal is to collect as many carrots as possible.

name: Metal Gunner
short_description: Action game without motion sickness even in extreme movements! Battle with various enemy robots and enjoy thrill and action.

name: The Valley of Super Flowers
short_description: The Valley of Super Flowers is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of the the valley which had been forcefully captured by an Evil Satanis ruler.

name: Monuments Renovator
short_description: Monuments Renovator is a game in which you play the role of a professional monument renovator. You choose from among the world's greatest monuments, restore them to their former glory and learn about history and architecture.

name: Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy
short_description: This story takes place three years after the events of the previous game “Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout,” and depicts the reunion of Ryza and her friends, who go through new encounters and goodbyes to discover a true priceless treasure.

name: King of Cooking
short_description: Do you want to have your own food truck? You want to expand your business? Do you like tycoon games? Then, this is the perfect game for you!

name: Mechstermination Force
short_description: Join the Mechstermination Force and save the world from the gigantic MegaMechs!

name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2
short_description: Koji Igarashi and Inti Creates are back with more retro sword-and-whip action! Curse of the Moon 2 brings classic 2D action and a dark, 8-bit aesthetic together with modern playability.

name: Duster
short_description: Traveling west is dangerous, and you will die hilariously! Your choices of gear change your gameplay, and unlocking new equipment allows for new strategies! Scavenge for supplies, avoid wolves, and fend off outlaws. You could die of dysentery or bear attack, so be prepared for anything!

name: Cat in the Box
short_description: Cat in the Box is a horror adventure game. Help the poor girl explore the mansion and escape from unknown entities that are pursuing her. Use a variety of tools and your wits to overcome any challenges you face. At times, you'll even have to wake yourself from nightmares to survive.

name: My Harem
short_description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: American Motorcycle Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to drop everything and go on a journey across the United States? Do it now in American Motorcycle Simulator! Grab your motorbike and taste freedom driving across different parts of the USA.

name: Zatorski, Ph.D.
short_description: Indie-game in the genre of psychological adventure with the elements of rogue-like and visual novel. A meditative, thought-provoking simulator of an infinitely lonely old professor who’s life and existence are questionable. Confusion, terror and despair are a part of a routine here.

name: Resistance TD
short_description: Build defense towers, manage your economy and resist the enemy!

name: Mercenary Skirmish
short_description: Multiplayer action fantasy based medieval RPG with deep character development. Be a Warrior, Archer, Mage or a Priest. Each hero has different skill-sets and character customization/development. Beat the arena to be the Master!

name: Spinner Invaders
short_description: Shoot your way through a thrilling action adventure of 120 waves in 4 different game modes while fighting against waves of enemies and 12 extreme bosses. Save the world from The General by yourself or with a friend locally and play 10 different Challenges.

name: SWORDSHOT
short_description: SWORDSHOT is a retro inspired casual sword shooter. BREAK THROUGH THE CYCLE of rotating enemy protectors. BE FAST, BE PATIENT, BE SMART and land the final blow.

name: Prison Architect 2
short_description: Welcome Architects! Design and develop your own personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect 2. The classic prison-builder has broken out into 3D, and it’s up to you to contain it!

name: MagiCarnage
short_description: Once every millennium, the greatest magical beings gather together in order to engage one another in tournament combat. Cast powerful spells and shatter your opponents, this is MagiCarnage!

name: Time Rift
short_description: Time Rift is a fast-paced puzzle-shooter. You’re a hacker-turned-security tester, but your skills will only get you so far - to take down global megacorp VaultCo, you’ll have to manipulate the flow of time!

name: Nyanco Space
short_description: Hi Nyancos! How are you? Crying Out Nyanco in the Center of the Universe!

name: Wacky Golf Land
short_description: Strap your VR headset on, pick up your putter, and step into our wacky mini golf theme park. Win races at Pole Position, conquer high seas at Pirate Bay, feel nostalgic at Arcadia, or chill with our Cafe Latte. How many holes in one can you make? Its just a Numbers Game

name: Tinker Pilot
short_description: Immersion-focused VR space sim. Use your motion controllers, HOTAS or your own custom cockpit and take full control of your ship.

name: Help Me Now
short_description: Help Me Now is a horror and suspense game, where the player faces several challenges to save the terrifying house he finds! You control Thomas Histed, an investigative detective who lost consciousness and woke up in a psychopath's home in Arizona! Hide and plan your escape route in time ...

name: Hats and Hand Grenades
short_description: Kill your friends and steal their hats in this free cover-based twin-stick shooter! Wage multiplayer versus battles online or on the couch. Face off in colorful arenas with destructible environments and bangin' music.

name: I'm on Observation Duty 2
short_description: Your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies in the monitored rooms. Anomalies range from furniture movement to otherworldly intruders. When you spot an anomaly you have to file a report to fix it. You will need sharp eyes and good memory to survive the entire night.

name: Hentai Splash
short_description: Squirt Splash! My heart won’t stop pounding!

name: SOLAS 128
short_description: Explore SOLAS 128, a game of interconnected puzzles where you redirect and reconfigure rhythmic pulses of light to breathe life back into an ancient machine. BAFTA Scotland Game Winner.

name: Clea 2
short_description: Clea 2 is a jump scare free, skill-based survival horror sequel to the 2019 adventure.

name: Raivo
short_description: Collect a team of robots called Raivos. These highly advanced creatures are quick at learning. They start with no knowledge, so everything they learn, through advanced machine learning, they learn from you. Enter your Raivos in an online arena fight against Raivos trained by other players.

name: Glover
short_description: Glover is a puzzle-intensive adventure game made up of 6 worlds with 30 different levels. You control a charismatic glove that walks on two fingers, slaps harder than Steve Austin, dribbles faster than Scottie Pippen, and plays with a bouncy rubber ball.

name: The Legacy: Realm of Terror
short_description: For the past 400 years, your evil ancestors have been planning this housewarming party just for you. And it's one party you may never leave! This horror classic blends elements of RPG and Adventure games in a one-of-a-kind, spine-tingling package.

name: Hexplore
short_description: Immerse yourself in a medieval world. A world where Garkham, Grand Master of the Black Magicians, has sworn to take possession of the Book of Hexplore.

name: DethKarz
short_description: You're one of the elite racers chosen to compete at exotic locations around the world and beyond. Strap yourself into a fusion-powered racing machine for an explosive and exhilarating futuristic racing experience.

name: Canon - Legend of the New Gods
short_description: Originally called Feng Shen Ying Jie Chuan, Canon - Legends of the New Gods is a strategy RPG originally for the Sega Genesis and Mega Drive consoles.

name: Zero Tolerance
short_description: Created by Randel Reiss Kill or Be Killed If this 3D game doesn't your adrenaline pumping, nothing will. Zero Tolerance has you killing alien terrorists who want to annihilate your defense colony.

name: Shadow Madness
short_description: The world of Arkose is in Chaos as a mysterious plague, known as "Shadow Madness", ravages the land. With no cure, it strikes without warning, leaving vile creatures and piles of dust where its victims once stood. As the one hope to this doomed land, you must stop this scourge before it stops you.

name: Motor Mash
short_description: Get Into the Mash! And Get into the 3D Cartoon Madness, 12 different cars and drivers in a fast, varied, style and weapons, lots of weapons!

name: RADARjAM
short_description: RADARjAM consists of the constant unpredictability of your enemy’s location. Dodge what you can't see in your radar equipped fighter!

name: SNIKS
short_description: Are they caterpillars? Are they worms? They’re SNIKS! SNIKS is a puzzle game about colorful snakes hungry for fruits. There’s only one problem: They keep getting in each other‘s way while eating. Your task: Untie the Gordian Knot of SNIKS and help them eat all the fruits.

name: Paranormal Precinct - Last Copy of '99
short_description: Classic survival horror rogue-like from the PSX-era. Explore a fully fleshed-out city, solve casefiles and kill monstrosities. Gather the cash to scout new recruits, upgrade your precinct, and load up the armory. Survive till retirement day.

name: Super Bernie World
short_description: Join Bernie's movement and transform the United States in this free retro 2D platformer.

name: Monster Gals!!
short_description: Monster Gals!! comes with a special puzzle formula and 4 cute girls with animal ears and tails. But not only that, they have furry forms as well!

name: The Travelyan Home
short_description: A text-based Lovecraftian adventure game combining role playing and survival horror dynamics, set in a Victorian Gothic environment. Explore the mysteries of the Travelyan home and unravel

name: Shop Titans
short_description: Shop Titans is the ultimate RPG shopkeeper simulation. Craft powerful equipment, stock your shop and sell to aspiring heroes… at a markup! Hire heroes and explore dungeons to gather valuable materials to craft with. There’s never a dull moment in the world of Shop Titans!

name: Duck Duck Goose
short_description: Fight your friends as ducks and geese with explosive weaponry in this frantic top-down, local multiplayer shooter as a crowd of royal birds overlooks your bloodshed. Avoid a humiliating death in the royal court using Rocket Launchers, Explosive Snipers, Grenade Launchers, and Cannons.

name: Secret House | 秘密房间 | 秘密の部屋
short_description: This is a concise horror Room escape game Every time in a while, there will be terrible monsters here You need to collect random items in the game and fight with them And make sure your life is safe and escape

name: Cyber Lady
short_description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Forsaken Spire
short_description: Forsaken Spire is an untethered physics-based climbing game. You see it, you climb it: however you can!

name: Song of Iron
short_description: Behind you lies a trail of broken helms, shattered shields. You hold the axe of a fallen foe. Worn and dented, it will suit it's purpose. What lies ahead is still a mystery. Your goal is not.

name: Corpse Castle
short_description: Corpse Castle is a procedurally animated high-velocity twin stick fighter set in a deranged body-horror mystery where you must use your bare hands (or what’s left of them) to construct a tower from the flesh and bone of those who stand in your way.

name: Fantasy Memory Card Game
short_description: Finding pairs might sound easy, but this game will definitely challenge your brain! Train your memory, concentration, accuracy, attention, the speed of thinking and logic skills and much more. This game is a great way to exercise your memory and keep your brain fit!

name: Metal Knight
short_description: Welcome to metal knight, a 2D platform action game that integrates roguelite with space mercenaries. There is no archive point in the game, challenge different monsters, and experience the fun of equipment collection. Finish the task and save the princess of the sun empire.

name: Mushroom Cats 2
short_description: Mushroom Cats 2 - is a cute point-and-click game about Mushroom Cats that live on magical islands. Any girl will melt from tenderness, and the kids will be delighted with the funny Mushroom Cats! This fairy tale will fill any heart with good!

name: KukkoroDays
short_description: The appearance of a lady knight reincarnated from another world turns a mundane everyday life upside down! In this love-adventure game set in Akihabara, you can enjoy living together with a lady knight. It's a little serious, a little sad, and a little sexy, but most of all, it's fun!

name: DragonScales 6: Love and Redemption
short_description: A casual game with tile matching, puzzles and battles. Solve the new DragonScales challenges and shatter the plans of the Dark Empress.

name: Shinobi no Okite/The three female ninjas
short_description: Ieyasu Tokugawa, who ended the era of Sengoku and unified Japan. This man created a highway connecting the capital of Kyoto and Edo. It is called the Tokaido-53-tsugi. On this Tokaido, three ninjas will travel from Edo in this present day with a secret mission.

name: Valkyrie's Arrow | 瓦尔基丽的箭
short_description: This is an indie game that tests your skill selection and matching strategies. You can use the fragmented time to quickly enjoy the game, thereby releasing work and study stress. . . Ollie gives !!!!!

name: BLIND QUEST - The Enchanted Castle
short_description: Welcome Wayfarer! Your journey in the world of Blind Quest begins NOW! Blind Quest is a fantasy role-playing game where you will guide Nathan the mercenary in an epic adventure across the lands of Aetherna.

name: Escape First 3
short_description: "Escape First 3" is the third installment of a multiplayer escape room puzzle game for virtual reality or desktop PC! It includes 3 different escape rooms to choose from and can be played competitively, co-op or solo.

name: Aladdin - Hidden Objects Game
short_description: Uncover the secrets of the magical East in the newest hidden object game! Unexpected plot twists are guaranteed, so enjoy incredible adventures! Get some equipment and supplies, grab the map and go!

name: Heart's Medicine - Doctor's Oath

short_description: Build a prosperous settlement in a unique simulation of a feudal economy - each family runs their shop, owns their goods, and trades with other villagers in a free market. You will manage the land, build houses, organise events, set taxes, and balance supply and demand while engaging in diplomacy!

name: Dino Hazard: Chronos Blackout
short_description: Dino Hazard: Chronos Blackout is a mix of several genres, with a carefully built narrative and art style. It is a charming RPG about friendship and courage in a dystopian context with varied mechanics and alternative endings.

name: Tour de France 2020
short_description: Compete against the peloton in all 21 stages of the Tour de France in the official game! To wear the yellow jersey, you will need to take risks, attack, sprint and perfect your race tactics. Challenge your friends in Downhill or Sprint Challenge mode!

name: Nirvana Noir
short_description: A noir adventure beyond time and space. The city of cosmic beings is under threat in two parallel realities - one where the Big Bang was never fired, the other exploding in color and sin. It’s up to you to solve the mysteries of the Bigger Bang in this follow up to the award-winning Genesis Noir.

name: CAGE-FACE | Case 1: The Mine
short_description: Escape from the mine tunnels while hunted by an unstoppable beast and slowly being affected by a mysterious illness.

name: Astro Pirates
short_description: Space pirate co-op hack-and-slash roguelike flight shooter game-description-salad!

name: Rary
short_description: Rary - is a casual game in which you play as a bird and the main task is to eat fruits that fall on the playing field and earn points with this. Do not eat mushrooms, monitor the amount of fruit. And how many points can you earn?

name: RC Flight Simulator 2020 VR
short_description: Virtual reality and RC airplanes together in this amazing RC Flight Simulator! This is the most epic and realistic radio & remote control simulator in the world! And it is pretty cool, especially in VR!

name: PhaseWorm
short_description: PhaseWorm is a fast-paced 2D timing and reflex game built with a speedrunning focus. Players will be challenged to think and act quickly as they push for faster times and more difficult paths through each of the game's 30 unique thematic stages.

name: Schwarzerblitz
short_description: Schwarzerblitz is a love letter to '90s 3D low-poly fighters, featuring 28 playable characters, more than 30 stages, ring out mechanics, classic arcade endings, and a complete story mode. Steel your fists and ride the lightning!

name: Shattered Hourglass
short_description: A mix between Chrono Trigger, Dragon Quest and Breath of Fire! Shattered Hourglass is a massive Turn-based JRPG filled with challenging bosses, puzzles, secrets, multiple choices, endings and of course, time travel!

name: Forbidden Pleasure
short_description: SEXy goddesses, sin and debauchery, desolate lands, magic ...

name: Disciples: Liberation
short_description: Disciples: Liberation is a mature, dark fantasy strategy RPG with turn-based combat. Liberate the land of Nevendaar and uncover the endless stories hidden within this richly detailed world where every decision has a consequence, and every wrong move could be deadly.

name: Guilded
short_description: Guilded is a procedurally-generated guild management game. Complete quests, make gold, and lead your adventurers as they battle their biggest threat yet - interpersonal conflict!

name: The Harrowed
short_description: In a dying land torn asunder by magic, six adventurers find themselves embroiled in the endless dance of order and chaos. A story-driven RPG from Salmon Raws, LLC.

name: In The Search For: Revenge
short_description: In The Search For: Revenge is a very short, intentionally unpolished, abstract and odd game with no dialogue and little to no music.

name: Brass: Birmingham
short_description: Welcome to the Industrial Revolution! Lead your fast-growing business enterprise, build and develop new industries, multiply your income and don’t get distracted by your rivals. Show everyone you are the real deal!

name: Silent Santicado
short_description: Explore a silent, crumbling world in Silent Santicado! A retro journey through a fallen kingdom tainted by lost magic. Explore overgrown ruins, encounter a cast of peculiar characters, and defeat a menagerie of twisted enemies as you search for the source of Santicado's curse.

name: Blaze
short_description: Blaze is a 3rd person over the shoulder action adventure game where you a budding fire elemental seek to cleanse your fellow elementals from the corruption of humanity.

name: Centauri Dominion
short_description: Centauri Dominion is a top down space shooter set in the Centauri sector where a new colony is being established. There are others arriving seeking to dominate the sector for themselves and will not take no for an answer.

name: BoxxyQuest: The Gathering Storm
short_description: An epic and satirical throwback to the internet of yesteryear, made with the help of actress and legendary meme queen Catie "Boxxy" Wayne.

name: Helicopter Simulator 2020
short_description: Helicopter Simulator 2020 - it's simulator about pilot of helicopter, who battle in some places. Realistic Physics of helicopter.

name: LightBall
short_description: Can you see in the dark? Set in a 2D universe, Light Ball brings with it a concept of "Dark Puzzle", a legitimate platform game where you have to cross dark levels with different obstacles using LightBall, a sphere with its own light and capable of firing light.

name: Wire
short_description: Wire is in charge of maintaining a telecommunications center. Ready to take his well-deserved holidays, the entire network goes offline. Help Wire restart the repeater present in each sector. Be careful though! These sectors are a bit strange. Good luck!

name: Super Robin
short_description: It's a new crazy game again from Teen Super Titans Go Adventure.

name: TP Royale
short_description: The outbreak has started! Panic ensues. The world is collapsing and you need supplies, but first you need toilet paper. And so does everyone else. You have to fight for what's left or you will never wipe again!

name: Red Planet Farming
short_description: Become the first Agricultural Director of Mars in Red Planet Farming! This casual strategy game tasks players with producing enough food to feed a growing population of settlers on the red planet.

name: AdaptaTank
short_description: A small tank needs to evolve to survive on the battlefield. Follow Hada and Suru on their journey and fight for evolution!

name: Firework
short_description: An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of massacre. Lin Lixun participates the re-investigation by chances. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.

name: Way of the Hunter
short_description: Become the new owner of a hunting lodge nestled among gorgeous habitats and rich animal populations. Explore vast open world environments and hunt with a premium selection of firearms. Enjoy the perfect hunt on your own or with friends in co-op.

name: XpCade
short_description: Play virtual arcade machines, and program them using a new programming language. Go out explore, edit and play mission maps.

name: Desert attack
short_description: It's a first-person shooter, and you're in a military base full of enemies,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players can kill enemies or evade enemy attacks,Survive as long as possible.

name: Two Bit Hero
short_description: A classic retro metroidvania - retroidvania if you will - with (mostly) black and white graphics. Handcrafted, fast-paced action with multiple endings.

name: Memory Lane
short_description: A game that you'll never forget! Memory Lane is a turned based RPG about taking names. Literally.

name: Tale Of A Wolf
short_description: Tale Of A Wolf is a story-driven, wolf adventure, that puts the fate of Sylvanna in your hands.Join forces with nature and expel man!

name: Outshine
short_description: Unleash your powers against your oppressors in this arcade, fast-paced typing game. Avoid traps, destroy enemies, defeat bosses to seek your revenge, and rush to the top of the leaderboards.

name: The Secret of Retropolis
short_description: The Secret of Retropolis is a VR narrative game of a new kind, a blend of classic point-and-click adventure with immersive cinematography. Embody the witty protagonist of a film noir plot. Meet unforgettable characters. Solve puzzles. Lose yourself in the retro-futuristic atmosphere.

name: TinShift
short_description: Delve into the world of the future, where everyone is out for himself in the humans vs robots stand-off. Pick a traceur, loot an awesome gun, and beat damn machines. Or choose a robot and use his unique skills to get back at those humans for your Boston brothers.

name: Plunder Pack
short_description: A rag-tag group of animals makes it their mission to steal from the rich to give to the poor - and it's up to you to plan the heist! Choose your pack of thieves, plunder evil corporations and help the people take back their city.

name: Jupiter Moons: Mecha🦾
short_description: Choose your mech, customize your loadout, and build your perfect deck. Experiment with cards to find powerful combinations as you enjoy the tactical combat and deckbuilding in this roguelike adventure!

name: Extreme Social Distancing
short_description: Avoid, infect, or seriously inconvenience your friends with this twin stick, topically relevant, local multiplayer party game. Each stick controls a poor soul who just wants to be left alone, to get away from the possibly infected, and to completely and utterly avoid those with obvious symptoms.

name: My Dear Prince
short_description: A sweet and light lesbian / yuri visual novel about an airheaded daydreamer and a cheerful tomboy set on a quaint Japanese island filled with cute bunnies.

name: Vivid Surf
short_description: Vivid Surf is my dream project for the movement mechanic glitch coined 'surf'. Now with a lower barrier to entry (while retaining its depth) using optional surf assists. Play at your own pace in a singleplayer focused campaign that rewards you as your skill improves.

name: TWELVE CONTAINERS
short_description: TWELVE CONTAINERS - Containers auction simulator, take a risk betting on units, clean up containers get things and sell them!

name: Wildcat Gun Machine
short_description: Wildcat Gun Machine is a bullet hell dungeon crawler where you take on hordes of disgusting flesh beasts with a wide variety of guns, giant mech robots, and cute kittens.

name: Myth of Future Dimension
short_description: A real-time strategy game that abandons complicated operations and pursues lightheartedness.Tells a story that............ is not easy to summarize or describe......Experience the cultivation of armaments with a "high degree of freedom".

name: Pon Para and the Unconquerable Scorpion
short_description: Reunite with old allies and find new ones to raise an army that can end the Stormraider War…and stop a mad god from destroying the World That Remains.

name: Antidote
short_description: Doctor Mabbb, biological terrorist, is developing a bacteriological weapon and is kidnapping human guinea pigs to inoculate them with a virus and test its effectiveness.

name: War of Velana
short_description: War of Velana is a 16-bit Tactical JRPG where you play as a group of villagers that stumble upon curious events and try to prevent a new war from sparking in their homeland. Explore Alta, find new friends, and discover secrets as they chase after a mysterious elven woman with dark magic.

name: Dude, Where Is My Beer?
short_description: An old school point and click adventure game about finding a pilsner in the confusing world of unnecessary craft beers and snobby hipsters.

name: BeachHead
short_description: BEACHHEAD - IT'S NOT JUST A GAME, IT'S THE FUTURE OF REALITY. BeachHead 2000 changed the gaming paradigm by bringing a new gaming experience to life. 20 + years later, the original creators are doing it again. Try the new BEACHHEAD experience (VR or Desktop) and see for yourself.

name: [NTRPG] Wife Punishment 妻子的惩罚!!~风情客栈的公交车~
short_description: 客栈老板娘为了老公而堕落的古风NTRPG游戏♥

name: Title_Pending
short_description: Congratulations! You've been hired by an up and coming Game Development Studio to play-test their New Game (which as of now does not have a title). Not only that, you'll get to talk with the Lead Developer of the project, Matthew Stanton, who will give insight on his team's creative process.

name: Anord
short_description: Anord is a single-player 2.5D Sci-fi Action RPG Platformer set in a post-war era. You play as a cyborg, made to infiltrate enemy fronts at all costs. Level up and customize your character’s abilities to match your playstyle and defeat stronger enemies and bosses.

name: Element-174 - Part 1
short_description: Element-174 is an adult sci-fi visual novel where everyday choices can have long lasting effects. In this story-rich and erotic adventure, play as a young man new to a university as he uncovers the secrets of Branchfield and the women he meets there.

name: Hargrave
short_description: Hargrave finds himself inside the walls of a mysterious labyrinth filled with strange robots. Find the way out, or find what's hidden deep inside.

name: ARCHiTECTUS
short_description: ARCHiTECTUS is a sandbox game about planning, building, furnishing and exploring of constructions.

name: SwordBoy
short_description: Art film style, Action role playing, Arcade game, Open level, Soul like.

name: Haypi Monster 3
short_description: New Adventure for Monster Trainers!

name: No One But You
short_description: A Visual Novel/Dating Sim about Hideaki who has moved from his small village to a much larger town, Okutama.

name: Memories of a Spy
short_description: Collect intel, forge documents, blend in, hunt the mole. Immerse yourself in this first-person 1960s spy simulator. Work for CIA, MI6, SDECE, BND, or KGB. Defend your country or betray it, or choose to leave it all behind to live a normal life... as long as you can.

name: [NTRPG] Xiu Lu Ji 修绿记
short_description: 踏上古风修绿言情武侠之旅的神作!

name: Nullum
short_description: Nullum is a minimalist puzzle game. The goal is to eliminate all tiles by creating matching numbers.

name: Krim: The War in the Crimea 1941-42
short_description: KRIM: The War in the Crimea 1941-42 is an operational/strategic simulation of the German 11th Army’s operations in the Crimean Peninsula from late October 1941 through 4 July 1942.

name: Space Mercenary Shooter : Episode 2
short_description: Space Mercenary Shooter is an episodic FPS inspired by early shooter games, featuring handcrafted levels and a fully voice-acted cast of characters.

name: Best Friend
short_description: "Best Friend" is a 3D horror game. Escape and survive from your beloved doll named David after you don't have time to play with him. Follow the advice that David has told you, survive, and remember that you must never turn your back on David!

name: 铁道少女:梦想轨迹 2.0 Railway To Dream
short_description: 梦想轨迹是集合轻百合与养成元素的文字冒险游戏，玩家将扮演力图成为第一名女性动车组司机的田诗虹，在一个月期间接受川崎镜与韩德亮二人的指导，并在最后接受梁凌薇的考核。以此与两位童年好友和解，将三人之间那早已扭曲的轨迹，重新引导回正确的轨道上。

name: Deep in the Woods
short_description: The Deep Forest tells a classical tale of searching for family. Players will experience the changing seasons throughout the game and explore enchanting scenes depicting each season.

name: Bragger's Run
short_description: A Procedurally Generated Rogue-Lite Action Game: Bragger's Run takes you on a death race across a hostile continent where you'll collect treasures and trophies from your kills. Play as the Gunslinger, the Duelist, or the Wizard and see if you have what it takes. Can you make The Run?

name: Draw From Earth
short_description: Draw from Earth is a Rogue-Like, Turn-based Card Game, You are the Leader, as Flagship, Finding your Origin is your Ultimate goal.

name: DJIGULI
short_description: This is a game in the genre of visual novels. In the game, you are immersed in the history of an ordinary car that fell into the hands of the owner is not very diligent. You will get acquainted with other cars of different brands and learn their stories

name: TCSTRIKERS3
short_description: Who are you fighting for? My usual job turns into a big mission. An easy-to-understand system reminiscent of the old barrage STG. Pave the way with powerful PowerShots!

name: Learn Game Development, Unity Code Monkey
short_description: Learn Game Development from a Professional Indie Game Developer. Make your own games and bring your ideas to life!

name: Interrogation Files: Port Landsend
short_description: Search through the interrogation footage of suspects of a bizarre and horrific crime. Decide who committed the crime and see them get arrested and have their day in court. The latest interactive video experience.

name: Final Frame
short_description: Inspired by Danganronpa and Ace Attorney series, Final Frame is a murder mystery Visual Novel set in modern Japan.

name: Game Of Puzzles: Dinosaurs
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

name: Unforgotten
short_description: UNFORGOTTEN – a story-driven, non-linear visual novel, where you can immerse in the ethnic ambience of Northern myths and horrors. Can you solve the riddles of the past - without ever losing yourself in the present? Your fate is in your hands!

name: Syystem - The Phantom Train
short_description: Delve into the haunted underground of Capital City in this paranormal mystery visual novel. Chase down the elusive phantom of an ill-fated railcar and the curse left behind by its doomed passengers. Tread lightly--you aren't the only one scouring the tunnels...

name: Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit
short_description: Сreated by a solo developer, Wonhon is a paranormal stealth-action and tactics game about a young Korean girl killed in a military conflict and returned from the dead to exact her revenge.

name: IMC
short_description: A realtime, roguelike, card game. Traverse planets, build decks and earn riches while battling to the extraction point. Some will make it, most will die...

name: Undead Run
