short_description: A Halloween themed local multiplayer game, where you have to reach the end faster than your friends. Avoid traps, place new ones. Use different characters, each with own ability, activate traps, choose different routes to leave the opponents behind.

name: Dark Lord: Peacemaker
short_description: A dark fantasy classic RPG. Customize your race, gender and class. Gather a party with your favorite companions. Change the fate of the characters and the world with your choices.

name: Rollerdrome
short_description: Rollerdrome is a BAFTA award-winning third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

name: Little Witch Academia: VR Broom Racing
short_description: Soar through the skies, hunt for ghosts, and become the best witch racer in the world!Experience the thrill of flight across more than a dozen tracks! Cast magic to speed up and slow other teams down as you race to finish first! Purify the school’s restless spirits in ghost hunting missions.

name: Deranged Park Rangers
short_description: Free to play massively multiplayer online Shoot ‘Em Up with instant play. Kill sapsuckers in an over-the-top blood and guts filled manner.

name: Undead Can Dance
short_description: Undead Can Dance is a dancing battle game where you take control of the undead through rhythm, power and accuracy.

name: 洛秋 Fall Autumn
short_description: Fall autumn is an ARPG game. The game uses an overhead world. There are several forces in this world. The character is a member of the secret department in his country to perform tasks

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

name: Shape Storm
short_description: Shape Storm is a sort-of roguelike where you dodge shapes. That's it. Dodge shapes, do it well and win. The game contains 20 unique boss fights where the unique boss uniquely attacks you with unique shapes causing you to dodge the shapes in a unique way.

name: The Mansion
short_description: The Mansion, a grim yet fascinating building you’re facing, doesn’t exist.

name: Balloon Blast
short_description: Face off against friends and foes in this vacuum fighting arena.

name: Heliconian - Starship Crew Control
short_description: The essence of the Heliconian is to manage a mixed crew of renegades aboard the starship Heliconian. Manage the crew member’s actions and the ship’s functions to survive as long as possible while exploring the star system in the hopes of earning upgrades and ultimately a safe haven.

name: Dr. Atominus
short_description: Dr. Atominus is a short platformer with metroidvania elements and a cool sci-fi story.

name: HARD BULLET
short_description: HARD BULLET is a physics-based action game, where enemies flood the neon-lit city bringing destruction to its streets. Use slow-motion, a huge arsenal, and brutal combat to survive and unlock new weapons. Prepare for the next RIDE by mastering your skills in Sandbox and Arena modes.

name: Atlas Engine
short_description: Atlas Engine is a world creation program that makes building your map fast and easy! Output realistic images, topographic prints, and even hand-drawn fantasy maps in minutes! You can even save the heightmaps and biome masks for use in other applications such as game engines!

name: Pathfinders: Memories
short_description: Memory is the key. Use it to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

name: Redfall
short_description: The town of Redfall is under siege by a legion of vampires who have cut the island off from the outside world. Trapped with a handful of survivors, slay alone or squad up in open-world FPS action.

name: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami
short_description: Test your limits in this hardcore, cyber-samurai game set in post-apocalyptic Japan. Parry your foes’ blows with your weapon of choice and use implants to attack the weaknesses of unstoppable bosses from Japanese folklore!

name: Under Construction: Summer City
short_description: 3d house design game with a wide variety of options, customization and user-content support.

name: Another FPS Game
short_description: Aren't you tired of always playing the same game?

name: Resistance
short_description: The command gave the task of downloading information from the servers of the impregnable enemy base at any cost. How to do it? Everything depends on you.

name: Undead Darlings ~no cure for love~
short_description: Journey with and learn more about a crew of half-zombie girls through visual novel sequences and as you crawl through dungeons, beating up twisted creatures that were born from the fall of society in fast-paced turn-based RPG combat!

name: The Last Shot
short_description: An adventurous engineer, a diesel-punk world divided by endless conflict, and a whole lot of colossal guns. Sounds like a good time! With massive war machines threatening your home, will you be the one small cog that brings it all to a halt?

name: Minions of Elden
short_description: Craft gear, kill monsters, restore the world. Join your friends in Minions of Elden.

name: Battle For Seattle
short_description: Play as your friendly neighbourhood Anarchist and explore the streets of Seattle as you smash symbols of corporate capital and defend yourself from an oppressive police force in this beat 'em up rougelite!

name: Snack clearing
short_description: 《Snack clearing》是一款休闲三消游戏，讲述的是玩家在美食街的故事。在冒险途中陷入美食陷阱，需通过移动各类美食消除陷阱即可闯关。游戏种的障碍有很多，上百种关卡,享受策略创造的乐趣！

name: Super Buff HD
short_description: Super Buff HD is a fast-paced skate-surf-FPS. Dash, bounce, grind, blast, shred, shoot, and soar through a fever dream world of unhinged weirdness. Defeat all the buff dudes. Get a high score. Be a winner. Home for dinner.

name: 三国志猛将传
short_description: 摒弃传统三国游戏的数据对碰，实现对每个单位都进行独立的实时演算。国产单机三国游戏，尽可能在保留三国历史原貌同时还原壮观的冷兵器决战场景。

name: Future Fragments - Command Z
short_description: Future Fragments was developed with support from Jump Into The Light in New York City and was debuted at Cite Internationale des Arts in Paris.

name: Clockwork Calamity in Mushroom World: What would you do if the time stopped ticking?
short_description: A gentle exploration platformer in a vast yet small world where time has stopped, what will happen?

name: SaGa Frontier Remastered
short_description: The beloved 1998 RPG Classic, SaGa Frontier, is reborn with improved graphics, additional features, and a new main character!

name: Wizdom
short_description: Wizdom is a Role Playing Game、that focuses on the world of Medieval swords and magic. Overcome trials and save the world from demon lord.

name: Pulsar Crash
short_description: Pulsar Crash takes the white-knuckle gameplay of twin-stick shooters and combines it with the competitive spirit of fighting games.

name: Can of Wormholes
short_description: Push, slice, ingest, flip, and squish worms in this puzzle game in which you play as a little sentient tin can.

name: ADVERSE
short_description: ADVERSE is an arcade first-person shooter platformer set in an idyllic world of corruption.

name: Chaos Party
short_description: Chaos Party is a fast-paced, friendship destroying party shooter set in a 2D universe. You are the equipment slot; Remnants will cling onto your sticky body. Each game provides a new opportunity to try synergies with over a hundred weapons. Have fun with friends online or offline!

name: Boom slayer
short_description: Boom slayer is an reckless and fun arcade. Your mission is shoot skull to reach the goal. But each level will be more complex and challenging !! Every level has limit of shots that player can use to unlock next level. At each level there are several types of opponents.

name: Ash of Gods: Arena
short_description: Ash of Gods: Arena is an online game which combines turn-based tactical combat and elements of a card collectibles game. Based on multiplayer mode from the original award-winning game, Ash of Gods: Redemption.

name: Beyond DAWN
short_description: In a world where time is the most precious commodity of them all. You must guide your team of D.A.W.N agents in the epic struggle against the band of rebels led by their charismatic leader Manes. It’s up to you, will world order prevail or slip into the chaos that awaits…Beyond Dawn?

name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
short_description: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

name: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
short_description: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience.

name: Revolution: Path of a Weaponsmith
short_description: Fight for your loved ones and your country in this third person stealth shooter. Scavenge for weapon parts and supplies to survive and maybe even make some profit through trade. Make difficult choices in a branching story taking place in an alternative history in which US has invaded USSR in 1989.

name: Amends VR
short_description: A journey through the reflections of an upbringing with a now estranged mother.

name: Helskate
short_description: Helskate is a skateboarding action roguelite. Grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks to slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
short_description: The award-winning strategy game franchise returns with a revolutionary new chapter. Sid Meier's Civilization® VII empowers you to build the greatest empire the world has ever known!

name: My Strong Horse
short_description: Become a knight on a medieval horse, and defeat 5 enemy captains to win.

name: North Town
short_description: Conquer the icy lands and build the most magnificent city of the North! Admire the vivid scenery, meet the gods and interact with the locals. Become the master of economy, develop your settlement, and rule the North Town!

name: Nitroverse
short_description: Nitroverse is a mix of a Rogue Like and a Bullet Hell with persistent level progression and combinable weapons.

name: Leveling up girls in another world
short_description: Travel Aporia to save it from the Demon Queen Nazmul. Guide a team of girls through strategic fights and strengthen your bonds in this dungeon crawler RPG.

name: Mine Dungeon2 ~Rurumu's trip~
short_description: We’re back with cute girls and minesweeping! A minesweeper action adventure with enemies and obstacles to conquer! Our latest edition includes a hit point (HP) system and mine detection flares to support you. With a myriad of new enemy types and boss encounters, an exciting new adventure awaits!

name: Jack Hayes: The Lazarus Sign
short_description: A very special challenge: people. Deal with the darkest parts of our modern day society in a story with elements of a film noir. Don't let the humorous dialogue or the seducing smile of a stranger fool you - your choices decide the fate of Jack Hayes, his partner and every other person!

name: Moonfall
short_description: Almost extinct and slowly dying, mankind's only hope is to reach the Valley where the broken fragments of the Moon once fell. Manage your squad of travellers through dangerous wastelands in this turn-based Tactical Roguelite.

name: The Longest Road on Earth
short_description: A thoughtful and deeply personal title with stripped-down mechanics. The lack of dialogue or text allows you to create your own narrative through your time with four characters. Each short story will allow players to be swept away by the haunting lyrics of over twenty original, nostalgic songs.

name: A Little Shop in Squirrel Town
short_description: You will become the shopkeeper of grocery shop in Squirrel Town to run your own shop, replenish your stock, sell, make a profit, kill monsters, manufacture outfits, engage in agriculture, angle, cook delicious food, feed monsters and save Monster Forest controlled by the evil crystal.

name: The Ninth Way
short_description: The Ninth Way is an action game which will accompany you on a journey of magic, intrigue and mystery. You will be able to combine the elements at your disposal to create new powerful spells and conjurations in your fight.

name: The Mortuary Assistant
short_description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

name: Adriatic Pizza
short_description: Adriatic Pizza is a peaceful pizzayolo 3D simulator. In a world inspired by Porco Rosso, explore islands, deliver pizzas, meet wonderful characters and watch out for your Seaplane fuel !

name: Stay in the Light
short_description: Beyond the known world there is an ancient temple of great wealth. The treasure you seek is there, you are certain of it. Those who go there forfeit their lives. You have been warned.

name: Risky Floors
short_description: In the maze of rooms secret doors can be found behind which there is an even greater danger

name: What a Cluster Fight
short_description: This is a party game about fighting your friends with unique characters in a fast paced action platforming setting across beautiful environments.

name: Astonishing Baseball Manager 20
short_description: Build your dream lineup, manage a baseball team, sign contracts and live the exciting life of a baseball manager!

name: The Tau Experiment
short_description: The Tau Experiment is an MMORPG where you play as an employee with the Tau Corporation. Group up with other players and complete thousands of quests as you work to help put an end to the company's plans.

name: Sakura Knight 2
short_description: Estelle's adventure continues in the sequel to Sakura Knight, as she strives to become a knight like her mother. Accompanied by the ditzy Felicia, the mischievous Tart, and the affectionate Rune, Estelle faces a new foe, gets kicked out of the local hot springs, and kisses a lot of cute girls!

name: Car Trader Simulator - Welcome to the Business
short_description: Welcome to the prologue to Car Trader Simulator. Here you will learn all the most important in mechanics and economics in the game and you will play your first mission.

name: What Happened
short_description: What Happened is a nightmarish first-person exploration of anxiety and depression from the perspective of American high school student, Stiles.

name: Queer Quest: All in a Gay's Work
short_description: There's a naked bike ride blocking the road. Ryan's selfies suck. Stevie Hix needs some tape for tucking. Oh, and your hot girlfriend is missing.

name: Undercat
short_description: Undercat is a non-restrictive 2D platformer with co-op and PvP modes. Help the Resistance to overthrow the Cats' tyranny and liberate the animal city!

name: Archvale
short_description: Take up your weapon in this RPG bullet-hell world and embark on a journey to right wrongs from long ago. Only you can defeat the evil forces of the Undying guardians and reunite the world with the fabled Archvale.

name: ThinkFast
short_description: Think Fast to survive in this frantically-paced minigame collection, where your brain isn't the only muscle you'll need to flex. Put your reflexes and virtual reality skills to the test with classic carnival games, brain teasers, and more!

name: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator
short_description: Create dream homes! From 3D plan modelling through to on-site decision-making, you must bring each project to life while giving free rein to your creativity, to take your architectural firm to the pinnacle of the profession.

name: Underdog Arena
short_description: A pretty simple action game with a twist; the worse you do, the stronger your character becomes. Grab a friend!

name: Dust & Neon
short_description: Rain down hell on the robot army in DUST & NEON, an award-winning best-in-class post-apocalyptic shooter where twitchy-finger gunslingers are rewarded with fame and glory.

name: 1 Screen Platformer 2
short_description: Try, die, retry in this challenging but fair precision platformer that takes place on 1 screen. Ultra tight controls, dozens of traps, 8 playable characters each with a unique gameplay style. Great for speedrunning, and 100% completionists. Also, no water levels!

name: Surviving Isolation
short_description: Surviving isolation is a game about surviving until you're thriving.

name: Don't Take It Personally, I Just Don't Like You
short_description: The lo-fi anime dating sim to cry to. A love letter to cassette tapes, old computers, and unrequited romance.

name: Super Space Galaxy
short_description: Go anywhere you want in a Galaxy full of wonders! Making a fortune, exploring strange new worlds, and protecting the Galaxy from demonic cultists is all in a day's work for a space-adventurer.

name: Dread X Collection
short_description: 10 Tales of Terror from 10 Twisted Minds. Made in only 7 Sleepless Nights. The Dread X Collection is a series of small games created by some of the most talented indie devs around, all with the same mission: create the P.T. for the horror project of their dreams.

name: Candy Kombat
short_description: Immerse yourself in a world of sweets, which is full of delicious candy. Beat the odds as a sweet frog to find Pinkie and Gingerbread man, to whom you need to explain some things.

name: Flatworld
short_description: Explore a world full of magic, puzzles and enemies in which the main character is the weakest of the game.

name: Altidudes®
short_description: Get your skateboard ready, you are about to climb the tallest mountain in the whole world! With a seemingly infinite height, you can climb as high as you want, but will you ever reach the top?? Pixel graphics! Dude references! Skateboards! A big mountain! We got it all!

name: Vectromirror 0™
short_description: Become the Test Subject and attempt to complete a challenging experiment to awaken emotional responses in your Artificial Intelligence. Jump, wall-run, and parkour your way through the free-to-play prequel to the upcoming game.

name: Finger Guessing King
short_description: A kind of leisure competitive game similar to guessing boxing, which has the element of luck and tests the wisdom and strategy of players.

name: Peglin
short_description: Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage. Acquire special relics that radically change the game and ensure no two runs are the same. Aim carefully to survive in this unique turn-based RPG!

name: The Chronicles of Confucius's Journey
short_description: Dissatisfied with politics and seeking answers, a man named Confucius sets out on a great journey to learn more about the world around him and spread his philosophy throughout the world. In this Match3 game you can step into his shoes and learn more about the man, whose teachings live on to today.

name: Wartorn
short_description: Harness the elements in fierce real-time battles while gathering and upgrading a crew of fantasy creatures in this rogue-lite adventure across a world torn apart by war.

name: Cute Triplets
short_description: This is a horizontal action game. You can switch 3 characters freely, each character has its own different characteristics to cope with different situations.

name: Headbangers in Holiday Hell
short_description: Christmas. Christmas never changes. Soon those overzealous little freaks will swarm the city led by that bearded maniac. But this time, we fight back. Inspired by Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Beavis&Butthead's heavy metal comedy, this is twin-stick mayhem like you've never experienced before.

name: 欢乐消消乐
short_description: Fun games are suitable for players of all ages, and moderate play can enhance our sense of pleasure and relieve our physical and mental stress. Now join us to get the game props easily, and there are plenty of time-limited rewards for you to receive every day. What are you waiting for?

name: The Zone
short_description: Dimitri has a mission: go to an island and disable all the electrical installations to avoid that strange creatures have multiplies and go out.

name: Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue
short_description: Set in a 90's retro future, Inertial Drift offers a driving experience genuinely unlike anything you've played before – boasting twin stick drifting mechanics that need to be felt to be believed.

name: Magicademia
short_description: Magicademia is a tycoon game in which you can design and manage the magic school of your dreams the way you want. Hire some experienced wizards to teach spell casting to the new, brim-hatted generation. Expand your knowledge and school in order to become world's best magical academy!

name: Ultimate Wall Defense Force
short_description: Ultimate Wall Defense Force is a single-player, action game made for VR. Fly into a superhero fantasy inspired by outrageous anime fights. Defend The Wall and destroy an onslaught of enemy Geodites by yielding ultimate abilities in the palms of your hands.

name: Racing Juke
short_description: Compete against cunning and tough rivals racers out on the race track to prove that you are the fastest!

name: Pirates: Mystery of Skeleton Island
short_description: Atmospheric role-playing pirate adventure. You shall fight with unique cursed skeletons; discovery diverse flora and fauna through thunderstorms rain and sand; search treasures and sail on ship and boats!

name: End of Panduora
short_description: "End of Panduora" is a fast-paced fantasy-style strategy management game. In a randomly generated corner of the abyss, by consuming sanity in exchange for strength that does not belong to you. In the endless sea, create a new paradise to welcome the remnants of the old gods.

name: The prisoner of the Night
short_description: THE PRISONER OF THE NIGHT is a single-player platforming game with a wide range of scenarios, where the lovely girl Nartide must survive terrible monsters and deadly traps in the darkest, scariest night of her life.

name: Dead Containment
short_description: Dead Containment is an on-rails shooter inspired by classic arcade games. Players fend off the undead as they race through a city under siege, blasting away the horrors that roam the streets using a variety of weapons. Playable solo or online co-op.

name: Labyrinthine
short_description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

name: F29 Retaliator
short_description: The skies are your hunting ground in this high speed, high action Cold War flight sim, featuring 100 missions of dogfights and strategic bombings across three geopolitical theaters.

name: Elkabo: Selina's Dark Spirit
short_description: When your sister stumbled upon a dark secret you start on a quest of rescue that could just rewrite history.

name: My Very Own Lair
short_description: True artificial intelligence is at hand, time to build your very own lair! Start from an old mansion in the UK and pick a place to move. But careful, the World will try to stop you. Will you make it to Mars?

name: Pursuit of the Bookkeeper
short_description: Venture dark dungeons in a pursuit of the Bookkeeper. Beware, your only defence are spells, and to cast them you need to look into your spellbook.

name: Breakout Planet
short_description: It is the future; aliens came to earth and won the war in a matter of minutes. Unable to stand up to the alien technology, humanity has become enslaved. A ship transporting prisoners has crashed landed, fortunately you are the only survivor and have a chance of escape. Will you be able to break out?

name: The Director's Cut
short_description: The Director's Cut is a story-driven psychological horror game set in a 1984, USA. Redefine your meaning of horror. Using © DREAMu.

name: Close Encounter VR
short_description: Experience the thrill of a UFO sighting and the terror of an alien abduction as you come face to face with extraterrestrial beings! Don't worry, everything will be fine in the end, I promise!

name: RogueJack: Roguelike Blackjack
short_description: Explore endless dungeons, discover monsters and beat them all in a game of 21. Collect weapons, defenses and the carcasses of your enemies while playing a fresh and interesting take on BlackJack.

name: Turbo Shot
short_description: Turbo Shot combines a puzzle-filled top-down adventure with exciting gun-based combat that plays out in regular seasons of free-to-play single player and PvP content.

name: Saiku's Endless Labyrinth
short_description: Follow Saiku's journey through the world as they battle monsters, encounter great bosses and traverse strange lands. With the help of PEROS, an operator from S.A.V.E. Corp., Saiku must seek out the meaning to their life and attempt to recover their memories...

name: Slurkum
short_description: Fantasy themed multiplayer, survival styled RPG. Build your character with unique stats, skills, karma, and reputation as you quest, explore, and conquer. Adventure awaits!

name: Fractured Atmosphere
short_description: Fractured Atmosphere is an atmospheric VR exploration game. Scour abandoned spaceships and avoid hazards in your search for valuable items. Send crew to dangerous environments where each ship you explore will help to paint a picture of this universe and the people who live here.

name: Vaporwave Road VR
short_description: Drive a car on an endless road, listen to music, and watch the scenery. This is a relaxing game, you can import local music, in the game you can only listen to music and enjoy the scenery. This game is completely made for the VR experience and contains 7 music.

name: Cairn: Mathair's Curse
short_description: When an ancient conspiracy threatens the land of Albaness, only one boy and his dreams stands between his family and the end of the world.

name: Diamond Giza
short_description: Run through the pyramids and grab everything shiny! Explore the mazes and rob the pharoahs and your friends in massive couch co-op mayhem!

name: Tanklike
short_description: Tanklike is a cooperative 2D shooter for 1 - 4 players. Improve your stats, upgrade your arsenal, and ricochet your way to victory!

name: Vampirem
short_description: Another story of Bloodlust, this time told through the eyes of Ravenblood; part Ghost... part Vampire... and 100% bada$$. His journey in search of lost strength and revenge will take you through the dark tombs and dungeons of the Vampirem.

name: Swords and Sandals Crusader Redux
short_description: The world of Swords and Sandals is at war! Join the Crusade against Emperor Antares! For the first time since 2007, the beloved Swords and Sandals Crusader returns, reforged from the ground up. Fast paced, addictive tactical warfare is back and better than ever!

name: Show for Lovers
short_description: Interactive visual novel, the ending of which depends on you. Immerse yourself in a romantic story about life in a private school.

name: Pictura
short_description: Pictura is an atmospheric photography game where you explore new worlds, while working on your photo skills. Find the best shots and become a world famous photographer.

name: CITY OF RAGDOLLS
short_description: Create your own ragdolls wars in your own city in Sandbox Mode, play with guns, melee weapons, crazy vehicles and so much more. Simply enjoy everything you love about ragdolls!

name: Realm of the hero
short_description: Everything in this game like JRPG is random. Choose one in many classes to destroy enemies. You are a hero. Strengthen yourself before fighting very strong bosses. Try to learn skills and equip weapons in the adventure.

name: Diving City
short_description: Diving City is an action RPG with strategy elements, featuring Karl, who has been trapped in Luvania, an underground megacity built by a mysterious civilisation, for reasons unknown. Karl will have to collect elemental cubes from the surroundings and create makeshift traps to unlock the way forward when facing the indescribable...

name: Nebula Within
short_description: Nebula Within is a contemplative yet challenging twin-stick shooter about exploring your emotions and finding self-acceptance. Plunge into a colorful consciousness and reveal a mysterious diary alone or with up to 8 of your friends.

name: 大明王朝1789 | Ming dynasty 1789
short_description: In 1789, the Ming Dynasty had survived for a hundred years. At this time, just before the Great Revolution, what will the Ming Dynasty look like under the influence of players?

name: Tormans
short_description: Tormans is an open world, tactical RPG in a post-technology setting. You can do anything, go everywhere and become adventurer, rogue, to travel through the ruins of an ancient unknown world of about 1220 km. Do your best to write own history in this harsh realm and understand what happened here.

name: Hero.EXE
short_description: Hero.EXE is a card collecting action RPG. With visual novel cutscenes and grid based action combat; modeled off of the classic Battle Network series. Choose your Ava wisely, as you both become a central part of the story!

name: Zombo Buster Advance
short_description: Zombo Buster Advance is a tower defense game taking place inside buildings with interchangeable elevators. Deploy, swap and shoot like a boss!

name: Chair F*cking Simulator
short_description: Use our innovative patented funky fresh ChairF*cker simulation tech to meet the chair of your wildest dreams.

name: Telomere
short_description: A minimalist journey though life.

name: Kooring VR Coding Adventure
short_description: Let’s ride the Blockstar and go on a journey to the Coding World. Help Kooring catch the troubled Tooring in the beautiful Block World! Having fun playing block coding fosters logical thinking and creativity. The Highest Level of Immersion Brings The Highest Learning Effect!

name: Tails of Trainspot
short_description: "Tails of Trainspot"is a unique and enjoyable puzzle game that takes you on a journey to a mysterious island filled with stories. As a railway builder, you'll lay tracks, connect stations, and uncover secrets and myths on the Packan Islands.

name: Assembly Planter
short_description: A farming / automation game, that allows you to progress from a poor hard-working farmer with just a few old tools to a lazy rich guy that watches his machines do the work for him while he tries to optimize production.

name: Strike Zero
short_description: In strike zero, you will play a girl who has lost her memory by integrating with the "Pi" fragment, and experience a series of unique adventures as a trainee pilot of the latest combat aircraft. You will find your memory in the crisis again and again and try to save the world.

name: Yuldigard's Fate
short_description: The capital of his native Yuldigard Alzia is torn apart by a civil war, in order to avoid death, the prince has to flee the city, pretending to be a wanderer. He has to find refuge in the provincial town of Torchbergen, but this visit is destined to drag on for a long time ...

name: Cricket Captain 2020
short_description: Cricket Captain 2020 is the perfect companion if you are missing live matches, as the hugely anticipated season is disrupted. We have created the 2020 season as it was originally intended, including rain-delays in one-day matches, and the new 100 ball competition.

name: Tanky Panky
short_description: Fun, chaotic, cut-throat multiplayer vehicular mayhem. Let theft, carnage and cunning be your motto. Support your teammates, outwit and back-stab your enemies. Snatch flags, grab power-ups, but don't forget to protect your base.

name: MARDEK
short_description: MARDEK is a fantasy/sci-fi/retro Flash RPG from 2007-2010, which blends parody with a deeper story. It offers solid turn-based RPG combat and dozens of hours of gameplay.

name: Proxy Air Force
short_description: Proxy Air Force is a 2D Arcade Shoot Them Up game based on the story of the world war which broke out between the US and CES countries in 2020.

name: Vincemus - Air Combat
short_description: Fly through the theaters of World War II with fighters planes from across the world. Intercept, Raid, Defend, Survive in theatres of World War II. Vincemus is an arcade semi-realistic air combat shooter, The game is avalable on WindowsOS and MacOS.

name: Ruggnar
short_description: Ruggnar is a platformer without enemies, but many traps are hidden in the darkness. Help Ruggnar explore gloomy places with his bag and a few candles as his sole equipment.

name: Doctor Simulator
short_description: If you have ever thought of becoming a doctor – here is your chance! Arm yourself in a stethoscope and do a ward round to keep up to date with your patients’ condition. They may complain and question your authority but remember – you’re the doctor!

name: Windfallers
short_description: Become a Windfaller. From heists, to deliveries and other more... sinister contracts, there's no job too big or small for your scrappy crew.

name: Escape Game Fort Boyard
short_description: Beat all the trials to escape the Fort with the treasure!

name: Dig Bombers
short_description: It's a real time multiplayer with fast-paced battles. Dig, blast and become the sole owner of a dungeon full of treasures. Everything needed to win is buried in the mine. Dig up weapons and get rid of your opponents.

name: MelDEV Power Boat Racing
short_description: Real ocean physics. Power Boat Racing at its edge for PC.

name: Small Ball
short_description: This is a casual game,control small ball arrive at the destination,include 4 mini games

name: Drift Racing Rally
short_description: Grip the wheel, pull the handbrake and drift like a maniac, Making donuts drifts like a champion.

name: Ungeon
short_description: Fight your way through a cursed dungeon filled to the brim with undead enemies in hopes of finding your lost father, or at least your way out. Ungeon is a randomly generated dungeon crawler with a large focus on combat and exploration.

name: Dirt Bike Motocross Stunts
short_description: Go ahead and live out your bike stunt racing dreams with Dirt Bike MotoCross Stunts.

name: Rocky Mayhem
short_description: Systems are down and require time to repair, leaving you with a basic gunship with no hopes of escaping an aggressive asteroid event. Will you be able to survive the increasingly difficult 8 minutes to repair the ship's functions and escape?

name: A Lot of Universes
short_description: Jump from world to world searching for an interdimensional fugitive. Collect items and use them to resolve tricky situations that threaten to delay your progress.

name: screamdown
short_description: Scream through your mic at opponents to send them flying into the void in this PvP horror game.

name: Whisker Squadron: Untitled Space Game
short_description: The second title in the Whisker Squadron universe takes the fight to the cosmos! A free roaming roguelike featuring tense battles in open space, sprawling Swarm factories, remote stations with quests and shops, moons infested with bosses, and a fantastically colorful vision of outer space.

name: CAMEO: CCTV Detective
short_description: Play as CCTV Detective Lopez as he solves crimes through the ever faithful lens of a security camera. The crime rate in the small City of ChurchView is rising, and it is up to Lopez to lower it.

name: Noise Hunters
short_description: Noise Hunters is an action stealth video game where noise is your tool, but also your enemy. Don't let them hear you, HUNT or be HUNTED.

name: LeftWay 2
short_description: Nampung encounters the nightmare again and this time also includes her relative people.

name: Pandemia
short_description: Choose who lives and who dies in a small peripheral hospital in a pandemic situation.

name: Radio Viscera
short_description: Radio Viscera is a fast-paced top down shooter without bullets. Hurl enemies into brutal traps and blast your way through walls with your air cannon, in this bloody, arcade action game.

name: runflexio
short_description: This is a narrative runner about the fate of a little jackal, who decided to leave his home and go to another place more pleasant for him. During his trip, the hero of the game reflects on the past, reflects on actions and emotions, as well as whether he made the right decision.

name: Dura Vita Online
short_description: Dura Vita Online is a multiplayer RPG in a medieval fantasy setting. You are an ordinary citizen living your life when The Occurrence happens. Now evil has started to spread across the land and you have no choice but to take up arms and destroy it!

name: Creep
short_description: Experimental dark platform game that takes place inside a struggled man's inner world represented as the worm world. You control the worm form of this man as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there. You also visit past memories/analogies and gain new abilities.

name: Rachael Savage
short_description: Play as a fearsome bounty hunter in this adventure game about hunting down an unbeatable threat! Turn invisible to sneak past enemies, slash with your sword, and use other unique items you find along the way to help acquire new bounties across the land.

name: Parabolus Two
short_description: Shoot your way across the galaxy in this thrilling adventure! It’s the sci-fi shooter which blends old school game mechanics with modern story driven cinematic experiences. Unlock the mystery of strange events all over the Milky Way and find out who (or what) is behind them.

name: Geometric Sniper
short_description: Immerse yourself in Andrew's story and feel the pressure of being a sniper. Find and eliminate the target in the crowd before he runs away.In living environments, designed exclusively for this fantastic game, you will not have a second chance, precision is everything!

name: WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
short_description: Welcome to WORLD OF ART - Learn with JIGSAW PUZZLES! Explore over 1600+ artworks, solve puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and enhance your mind while enjoying classical music. New paintings added for free regularly!

name: Alien Egg: Ascent
short_description: Jump your way into outer space to help a lost alien egg find its way back to its homeworld!

name: Charge Blade Hero
short_description: A fast paced 2D hack and slash, adventure game. Attack, Dodge, and Charge Up to maintain your weapon's durability as you take on waves of enemies.

name: Love n Dream
short_description: 《Love n Dream》 is a puzzle game with many kawaii girls. You will be transformed into multiple roles to approach all of our girls. Your job is to unlock their desired, characteristic, favorite, hate by using your skill to solve all the puzzles and understand more about them.

name: Knife Quest
short_description: Knife Quest is a platform videogame where the character will have to find 3 coins that will allow him to open a new portal to go to the next level.

name: Beware of the Blob
short_description: Eat people and craft limbs in this third-person puzzle exploration game. You'll need brains, arms, lungs, and more to escape from Black Hawk Industries HQ in one piece.

name: Aim Master H
short_description: Aim Master H is the first 2D Aim Game on Steam, designed to warmup and boost your aim quickly and easily.

name: Alchemic Beasts
short_description: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

name: Polter Pals
short_description: Make ghost friends by steering the living into deadly hazards to release their souls. Puzzle through diorama-style levels and make as many friends as possible using comically fatal accidents. Keep up with the latest memes by getting popular on the afterlife's hottest social media app, LiveBurial.

name: Mischance
short_description: Mischance is a game about surviving as long as possible with a curse that guarantees an imminent death. Everything in your day-to-day life is now much more likely to kill you. Your objective is to make smart choices and hope that the most simplest of activities don't end up taking your life.

name: SkunkHunter 101
short_description: 2020 port of the 2009 title. Grow and sell weed.

name: Faraway Lands: Rise of Yokai
short_description: Faraway Lands: Rise of Yokai is an immersive base-building survival strategy game set in mystical Feudal Japan. Build and fortify your town, gather resources, explore new lands, trade with other cities and defend your town against the risen Yokai threat!

name: Toodee and Topdee
short_description: A cosmic turbulence caused the 2D Platformer and the Top-Down Puzzler dimensions to merge! Switch between Toodee and Topdee and their unique perspectives to overcome hard-as-nails challenges, solve mind-melting puzzles and defeat huge bosses.

name: Mini Motor Racing X
short_description: Welcome to the world of Mini Motor Racing X! Strap yourself in, or strap on your VR headset, and jump into a nitro fueled world where little cars mean BIG fun!

name: Training Lab
short_description: A laboratory simulator to do virtual experiments in a simulated laboratory for training

name: Extra Terrestrial Nation
short_description: In the year 2045 scientists discover a new planet that has extraterrestrial life on it, which they brought back to Earth to study. It wasn't long before they mutated and escaped into the city. The only safe place left is on the outskirts of town, can Nicole and Rocky make it safely out of town?

name: Cannibal Crossing
short_description: Cannibal Crossing is an action-survival game where you explore the randomly generated town of Earlsboro while scavenging, fighting hordes of enemies, building a base, and searching for a way to escape! Meet survivors with new abilities and lots of cannibals. Includes a co-op mode for 1-4 players!

name: The Adventures of Fatman: Intergalactic Indigestion
short_description: Emerge from the Fat-cave once more and help Fatman defeat the Intergalactic Indigestion! A cheap and cheerful continuation to The Adventures of Fatman series, by Mike Doak.

name: Color Game
short_description: Color Game is a puzzle game about getting to the end. Change your color, unlock the path to the exit and avoid enemies along the way.

name: ReRoad
short_description: ReRoad is a Tower Defense game with a brand new concept where the players dig their own paths. You need to consider the locations of the randomly placed towers of the stages as well as the towers you will build and strategically create a path. Stop the enemy through a path you have created!

name: Spellbearers
short_description: Spellbearers is a top-down, 2D, twin stick shooter inspired by "Super Smash TV". Battle against hordes of magical enemies to liberate the rulers of three kingdoms that have been overtaken by dark forces. With staff in hand, do you have what it takes to uphold the title of The Spellbearer?

name: Drifter King Online
short_description: Precision drift racing solo or against friends.

name: The End of Labyronia: Nerubis
short_description: Travel through time and the four seasons to avert the apocalypse in the last part of the popular Labyronia saga.

name: Elementallis
short_description: Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples.

name: Call of Corona: Micro Warfare
short_description: A dangerous mission to travel into the human body and meet the Corona virus face to face and send it back to microscopic hell.

name: Fantasy Mosaics 34: Zen Garden
short_description: The penguin family discovered a "Zen" way to play multi-color mosaic puzzles also known as picross,nonogram,griddlers hanjie!

name: Ace of Space
short_description: You and your spaceship versus thousands of aliens! Blast through waves of aliens with upgradable spaceships in this sci-fi shoot ’em up game and become the Ace of Space!

name: 重装无限·Metal Infinite
short_description: 或许在某个时空里他已经战败了 但是在这里或许可以改写一切，传说最强的赏金猎人！ 那段未完的故事 将如何开始又如何结束...

name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 4
short_description: Cross is Super Again! The official videogame of the Monster Energy AMA Supercross Championship is back with its fourth edition, the most extreme ever!

name: Urge
short_description: Fight, build, explore, survive, while the dynamic player-caused hazardous fog is slowly changing the rules of the world around you.

name: Dumb Roguelike-like RPG
short_description: Venture into a forbidden cursed city in the hopes of rescuing your sister!

name: Covid Tale: Ignorance
short_description: Discover the truths about COVID19... according to the internet. And the internet never lies, right? Play a witty story of how it all may or may not happened.

name: The End of Dyeus
short_description: Go in a quest for Dyeus in a primitive and cryptic open world ! Face mysterious assailants in intense and fast paced sword fights, and survive against a carnivorous fauna. Will you uncover the truth about Dyeus?

name: Family Mysteries 3: Criminal Mindset
short_description: Take on a role of a famous scientist drawn into a dangerous game, where the goal is to save the mankind and uncover family secret. Get ready for a pulse-pounding adventure in the world of experiments, mysteries and espionage!

name: Decently Bad Tower Defense
short_description: This is a bad short Tower Defense game made from scratch as a new game developer. This game does all the basic things you expect from a tower defense. We have 3 types of enemies and 3 types of tower to destroy them with. Strategic placement of the towers will make your victory certain.

name: logiCally
short_description: Test your skills in this challenging game of logic, observation and mental calculation. Solve problems of increasing difficulty and exceed your limits. How far can you get?

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 10
short_description: Enjoy a beautiful collection of Hidden Object Scenes and puzzles set in the great outdoors. Tidy up the Park and do your bit for the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to Recycle. Earn extra bonuses for finding all the Lost & Found items scattered around the Park

name: Lorera
short_description: Hook your way through the colorful world of Lorera and solve its biggest mystery. From a little flower to a vicious warrior, Lorera is all about growth and persevering your way through obstacles.

name: Children of the Sun
short_description: On a deadly road trip into darkness, control the path of a single bullet and unleash a fury of vengeance on the sinister cult that ruined your life in this tactical puzzle-shooter.

name: Space Probes
short_description: Space Probes is a Shoot Em Up (SHMUP) inspired by productions from the 90s released on SNES, MEGADRIVE, NEO-GEO, PC-ENGINE etc.

name: Creature Lab
short_description: Become a mad scientist! Conduct crazy experiments, mix mutagens, breed abominable creatures, and attach monstrous body parts to them. Manage your inventory, expand your lab, and make sure your hideout is safe. Send your creations into the city to obtain salvage and test subjects!

name: Video Editor Tycoon
short_description: based on tycoon games, this one provides a way for you to manage a video publishing company, where your mission is to maintain a financial balance in the face of monthly payments and also a professional balance for employees who are not fired

name: Finding Fido: The Journey
short_description: Join the quest to find your dog! Featuring fun environments to explore, strange characters, and riddle to solve.

name: Elliot
short_description: Elliot is a colourful 2D platformer inspired by 16-bit classics, with a touch of hardcore. Don't be misled by appearances: it's a colorful game, but really it's technicolor hell!

name: Uranus
short_description: Uranus is a short visual novel for adults only.

name: OMICRON: Coronavirus Battlegrounds
short_description: The first coronavirus online game. Run away from sources of infection to win, or infect healthy people to prevent them from breaking ahead!

name: Cyber Seraph
short_description: The alien invaders have launched their final offensive on an already crippled Terra. Only one brave pilot can turn the tide of war. Cyber Seraph is a boss focused vertical shoot 'em up with unlockable abilities.

name: Chromalition
short_description: Chromalition is a third-person skating platformer where you play as a graffiti artist who can become graffiti and bring graffiti to life. Find and complete graffiti murals around the city, unlock new abilities, and take down Company Corp!

name: Goodbye Volcano High
short_description: Goodbye Volcano High is a cinematic narrative adventure about love, change, and the end of the world. Guide Fang through their final year of high school as they try to make things right before time is up.

name: Loco Road
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of participating in a deathrace where everbody blows up??! Me neither! But thanks to the sick minds of our Game Design students now you can do it! In this frenetic game you have to avoid beeing last in each lap or you will die and look bad doing it!

name: Mine Trap Reborn
short_description: An arcade-style PvE platformer, with 130 differing levels. Dig, trap, and fill blobs to drop them to their doom, and to take you onward to victory!

name: Alone in the Dark
short_description: Return to Derceto Manor in this reimagination of Alone in the Dark, a love letter to the 90’s cult classic horror game.

name: Tankfight
short_description: Put down all the enemy tanks coming towards you! Collect points. A tank game that won't tire you on quarantine days.

name: Jumperbird
short_description: The boxes you do not crash will earn you points. Each score you earn will prove how good your reflexes are. You have to go through the space between the boxes.

name: Haymaker
short_description: Haymaker is an 80s boxing game that takes place in the blue-collar rustbelt town of Kint. You play as Jackie Elliot, a 21-year-old who's impressionable life is swaying between corruption and commitment; the path to becoming a great boxer, or the path of crime. Your choice, your story.

name: Handy Harry's Haunted House Services
short_description: Team up with up to 8 friends online to explore the haunted, randomly generated depths of these dusty attics. Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!

name: Occupy Mars: Prologue (2020)
short_description: Occupy Mars: Prologue is an old introduction to the world of Occupy Mars in which you have to use your brain in order to survive. The Prologue tells a separate story in a closed location and shows a sneak-peek of the full game mechanics.

name: Tank Battle
short_description: Drive a tank, destroy enemy, defend your homeland. Act alone or co-op with a friend and have fun!

name: The Sight in a mirror
short_description: 'The Sight in a mirror' is a game that collects items and escapes from the monster's house. Find the location of the monster with a mirror at home and find a way to escape!

name: Hedera
short_description: HEDERA is a story-driven 2D horror game about dealing with trauma through dreams and videogames.

name: disc party
short_description: Disc Party is an online multiplayer disc golf arcade game. Compete with your friends on windy, procedurally generated islands and find out who's the best disc golfer!

name: MORTARMEN
short_description: MORTARMEN is a strategic multiplayer PvP first and third person shooter, pitting the New American Coalition versus United Communist Front in a battle for control of Arakousa, a Mediterranean paradise, where soldiers traverse via sliding, rolling, climbing, and HALO drops.

name: Valiantia
short_description: Valiantia is a role-playing game. Solve the puzzles. Altis, a female knight, and you, Leonale as her confidant, were ordered to do missions. You can help her ease the problems, making the decision, or make them more complicated. Her fate depends on you.

name: The Adventures of Eggbert
short_description: Help Eggbert grab eggs, dodge foxes, and hatch chicks in this retro arcade challenge!

name: 动绘（Drawing）
short_description: Drawing is a brand new video puzzle game, where you can experience the excitement and happiness brought by artworks.

name: Image To Normal Map
short_description: A convenient tool for game design, which can convert 2D plate into normal map of picture, and display tool of WYSIWYG

name: Sexual Void
short_description: Nothing in here, except Vicky, sexy outfits and a JOI game

name: DRazor
short_description: Defend the energy planet from the orbs. An easy to play but difficult to master casual game.

name: RussianPunk 2007
short_description: The factory worker, like everyone else, thought that 2007 would never return. However, on his way home, he stumbled upon some magical mushrooms.

name: Bishojo Mangekyo Kotowari to Meikyu no Shojo
short_description: 玩家将和故事中性格各异的角色一起，解开神秘超自然事件的真相。并逐步了解贯穿整部游戏的核心——万华镜，及其持有者莲华的秘密。

name: Greak: Memories of Azur
short_description: Greak: Memories of Azur is a single-player puzzle platformer adventure. Azur is under threat from an enemy attack who have control of strange creatures infecting the land. Take on the role of three siblings: Greak, Adara and Raydel and utilize their unique abilities to escape the invasion together.

name: Dark Existence
short_description: Dark Existence is an upcoming multiplayer atmospheric horror game. You will be able to walk the halls of horror alongside your friends and share the horrifying experience together.

name: Slime Climb
short_description: A terrible storm has compromised the alchemist's tower. This is your chance! Jump, glide, and bounce your way through 20+ stages to get out at the top! The other slimes got stuck though, so don't leave them behind!

name: Long Car Journey - A road trip game
short_description: Traverse the never-ending desert searching for provisions. Look for fuel, fix the engine, pay attention to the battery, change the turbo charger! Explore abandoned buildings, sell the objects you find, check the condition of your car. Collect provisions and hide them at home!

name: Apollon 88
short_description: Apollon 88 is a 2D Top-Down, survival, shooter game. You play as 88, where your goals are to survive by destroying the one who hunts you.

name: Hentai Monster Quiz
short_description: This is a quiz game in which you can meet the beautiful 10 ladies.

name: Virus Madness - Dungeons of your Body
short_description: Fight your way through vicious viruses, bacterias to save all humanity in this cute shooter game. Advance through dungeons of your body and destroy them all

name: Johann Weiss
short_description: Caught off guard, Johann Weiss had his sister kidnapped by the LaVey Order, a satanic cult led by Behemoth LaVey who's going to sacrifice her to Satan to summon Hell on Earth. In this take on Metroidvania and early Duke Nukem games, you must help Johann save his sister Joanna from LaVey.

name: Heretic's Lot
short_description: What will you get out of mixing puzzle, RPG and roguelike? Correct - HERETIC’S LOT! Make your way through cursed lands to repent your sins. Learn perks, collect battle spells, solve puzzles, discover magic auras, fight bosses, find what cursed lands are hiding.

name: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy
short_description: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy, is an introduction to the dramatic story of a boy kidnapped by a psychopath. Exploring the giant house of your torturer you will soon discover things worse than your childish nightmares. Take on the role of Jamie and see what phrase “The First Toy” actually means.

name: HIVE
short_description: Take on the role of a man forced to take down the Hive-mind that has taken over the world - One monster at a time.

name: Escape from the hospital
short_description: Escape from the hospital is a small quest puzzle. You find yourself in an abandoned hospital for unknown reasons and you have no choice but to start looking for a way out. On your way you will meet various monsters and not difficult puzzles. The playing time is about 30-40 minutes.

name: Their Radiance
short_description: Their Radiance is an unconventional walking simulator about love.

name: Arena Experiment
short_description: Arena Experiment puts you in the role of a participant in a reality show, where your only task is to survive in a closed zones called Arenas for as long as you can.

name: 看白海豚的好日子 A Perfect Day for White Dolphin
short_description: 改編自乾綠郎的小說《完美的蛇頸龍之日》。 在這個時代，人們可以透過SC裝置和植物人進行感應。 感應淺者知道自己正在虛擬世界之中；感應深者，則會分不清虛幻與現實。 即使如此，黃芷欣還是決定和植物人弟弟芷樂進行感應，她必須找出芷樂自殺的原因。

name: Lost Alone
short_description: You are an intern headed to a secret military lab. Your plane crashes into a helicopter on arrival and you are the only survivor. Now you must hunt down different items to survive. But it's not so simple.

name: Embracelet
short_description: Travel to northern Norway, solve puzzles using a mysterious, magical bracelet and make new friends on your journey to discover the past - and yourself!

name: The Wake: Mourning Father, Mourning Mother
short_description: The Wake is a record of past wounds opened at a three-day funeral. The journal is encoded with a simple substitution cipher that the player must break in order to reveal the writer’s psyche and discover the contradictions that define him.

name: Drone Zone
short_description: Multiplayer team-based tactical shooter in a postapocaliptic world. Create modules and use them for assembling battle drones. Fight for resources in a world full of hostile anomalies. Use active skills and get advantage depending on which enemy module you have destroyed.

name: Desecrators
short_description: Desecrators is a retro FPS inspired by '90s six-degrees-of-freedom shooters. Plunder your way through the galaxy to destructive weapons and technology powerful enough to take on the ultimate heist: The legendary vaults of the Galactic Treasury.

name: The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper
short_description: A diplomatic mission...with a lethal twist!

name: Swarm
short_description: The Network has been infested. Face a giant creature ruled by music to cleanse it. Fight while switching between 2 complementary Game Modes!

name: Helwyr
short_description: Embark on an adventure traversing the town of Nevstell and its surrounding areas to uncover the dark secrets behind this world and uncover the truth behind your past.

name: Friendly Fire
short_description: Can you save the world from an unknown destiny?

name: The Forsaken Ruins
short_description: The Forsaken Ruins is a first-person atmospheric horror game. As prisoner of Ever-Bleed Keep, your chance to escape has come. Delve deep into the ruins and try to survive long enough to unravel its dark history and your true identity.

name: Bubble Tea : game for thinking and imagination
short_description: Let's find legendary bubble tea to cure grandpa! This is a puzzle RPG Maker game that take you on an adventurous journey across the world, through various dangers to find legendary treasures according to Grandpa's orders.

name: 汉武大帝传-经典策略战棋
short_description: Classic single player game

name: Somber
short_description: Somber is an atmospheric action-platformer that takes place in the semi-open world of Gloom. A hand-painted game filled with stunning environments, Somber demands absolute precision from players who wish to unlock its many secrets.

name: Boreal Tenebrae Act I: “I Stand Before You,  A Form Undone”
short_description: Delve into the dream of a dying town in 'Boreal Tenebrae' , a retro-style adventure with horror elements.

name: Zoo World VR
short_description: Intentio Education Game Studios gives you a passport to all parts of our vibrant planet. As you crisscross the globe you’ll be able to study and learn about the native species while you help out your new four-legged friends through a series of challenging, environmental-themed quests.

name: Jackalope
short_description: Jackalope - is a psychological horror, with supernatural elements. You have to survive in a dangerous forest and not go crazy, defend yourself from monsters, solve puzzles and be prepared for the worst. You can play Jackalope alone or with your friends (up to 4 people).

name: Beodara
short_description: You and your opponent will control a character who will be able to gather resources with different aims : build your village, hire peasants as well as knights and many other soldiers.

name: Music Ball
short_description: The "MusicBall" game, fun music arcade game with many levels. Thanks to carefully selected music and addictive gameplay, the developers managed to achieve an incredible experience for the players!

name: Robot Invasion
short_description: Robot Invasion is a game set in the near future when robots have invaded Earth. There are robots everywhere and they are deadly. Avoid them at all costs.

name: Couple in Trouble
short_description: Challenge yourself in a world of obstacles and dangers, test your skills in a fun and challenging game.

name: Little Terror
short_description: Little Terror is an interactive exploration Horror simulator. Interrogate every detail of a seemingly normal house to discover the story of the people who live there.

name: Wrap It!
short_description: Beat your high score by traversing a genitalia through a wave of STDs.

name: Return to Sector 9
short_description: Spread across a campaign mode and 8 mini games, take on a variety of missions from bug hunts, protection detail, desperate last stands and rescue missions!

name: Zero-G Gunfight
short_description: Battle 1-3 friends in the fast-paced & frantic arenas of Zero-G Gunfight. Pickup different guns that change how you move & fight. Dodge enemy bullets & avoid unique hazards as you strive to be the last one standing!

name: Pink Island
short_description: Pink Island is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

name: Guardians
short_description: Guardians, an extraordinary action role-playing game that transports you to a captivating universe teeming with danger, discovery, and heroism. Immerse yourself in a sprawling, post-apocalyptic world where chaos-infected creatures roam, and the fate of civilization rests on your shoulders.

name: Astro Dash
short_description: A colourful retro physics game for causal and pro gamers alike. Whizzing round the cosmos in your flying saucer dodging asteroids, black holes, cannon fire & assorted obstacles picking up crystals. Thrusting, dodging & speeding through the 30 obstacle filled levels.

name: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia
short_description: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia is a turn-based role-playing game, including tactical space combat, strategic elements and original story, filled by despair.

name: Autumn-Chess
short_description: The single player self-propelled chess game template and experimental works made by myself contain the basic elements of self-propelled chess game. However, due to the lack of funds, the monster setting and ending screen were not done.

name: Shop Tycoon
short_description: Shop Tycoon lets you build, furnish and run your own shop. Hire employees, order goods and face various challenges on the way to success! Develop your business, discover new districts and try to meet the expectations of new customers.

name: Rubikingdom
short_description: Run your very own kingdom on a rubik's cube. Collect resources to develop your kingdom. Fight off raiders. Face events like famine, disease, and corruption of the land. Buy a favor from your god, pay tribute, or ignore them and feel their wrath. How long will you reign?

name: ODIA
short_description: Slaughter the defenders of this dark land to claim the Cathedral. Utilize arcane weapons and dark magic to smite your enemies in this hardcore retro FPS inspired by early first-person shooter games.

name: The Passage Of Time
short_description: Challenge the passage of time and try to survive in dark dungeons while fighting with their inhabitants. Create unique weapons, develop skills and explore caves. But be careful - time is running out ...

name: PengoRoyale
short_description: PengoRoyale is a fun, colorful, competitive, couch-brawling, battle royale! Be the last penguin standing as you fight for dominance on the ice. Grab the many power-ups and bring the smack down to 11 of your friends. Try it today!

name: Golden Moon
short_description: Golden Moon is an old school, 3D Third-Person puzzle platformer game about finding treasure and working your way past ancient robots, booby-traps, and other menaces.

name: Paper Shakespeare: Very Naked Hamlet
short_description: So, like, either know Shakespeare's Hamlet, or don't get laid. That's it. That's the game.

name: The United SPACE of America
short_description: The United SPACE of America is a high action, arcade style, run-n-gun bullet hell, twin stick shooter that allows you to absorb enemy bullets with your Proton Sabre while you blast through countless enemies with your shoulder cannon. It takes a bit of hectic coordination. Can you master it?

name: Eternity Convergence
short_description: Eternity Convergence is a Sci-fi RPG. The player begins their journey as a pilot in the human controlled galaxy of Ennae. After building up a crew and a small fleet of ships the player can explore hundreds of planets and a number of galaxies to uncover a plot that is preparing to consume all life.

name: Hyde and Zeke
short_description: Hyde and Zeke is a stealth game about a boy using light magic to escape a dark castle. The stakes are higher though as a cloaked figure chases him through the castle.

name: Ratico Puzzle Adventure
short_description: Embark on an epic puzzle adventure as a clever rat, navigating intricate mazes, aiming to reach the coveted cheese in 90 levels. With limitless retries and intuitive controls, Ratico Puzzle Adventure offers a delightful journey filled with surprises, all while unraveling the thrilling adventure

name: Spooky Spins Deluxe Steam Edition
short_description: Spooky Spins Deluxe is a 4x5 reel, 40 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Spooky theme oriented from left to right.

name: OMG: One Million Guns
short_description: OMG: One Million Guns is a fast-paced, 2D, top-down, twin-stick shooter set in space, with LOTS of guns. Blast your way through waves of enemies with a multitude of weapons at your disposal. Full controller support included.

name: ハンターハーツ Hunter Hearts
short_description: Have you ever had that feeling of looking back in the past? Well, Hunter Hearts is about the past of the protagonist, before the tragedy happend. Find out in this visual novel what he's been going through.

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

name: Schlag den Star - Das 2. Spiel
short_description: SCHLAG DEN STAR is finally going to the next round. ELTON and the studio shine in a completely new graphic design and are therefore more beautiful and realistic than ever.

name: Super Monkey Ball Banana Mania
short_description: Go Bananas with your favorite monkey gang in the ultimate Super Monkey Ball adventure!

name: VE FPSO TOUR in VR
short_description: FPSO Tour. Live some of the everyday scenarios offshore workers must face.

name: 遗落幻境
short_description: Oblivion is a first-person 3D survive-building game with a super-core gameplay experience and rich content that brings endless possibilities!

name: 77p egg: Eggwife
short_description: After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator.

name: Shape Shooter
short_description: Shape Shooter is an action-packed, colorful, and hectic roguelike game. Survive increasingly harder random generated stages and collect relics, weapons, and active items to help you on your way. How long can you survive?

name: Yuri Ogibalov's Bizarre Adventure
short_description: Yuri Ogibalov's Bizarre Adventure is top-down action rpg, focused on exploration, characters and fights. Explore the dangerous and not so friendly environment of the russian province. Fight enemies in turn based battle system with tons different weapons and items.

name: Charge Knight: A Duck's Tale
short_description: In this casual mechanics game, use continuous movement to overcome challenges. The unstoppable knight Dundee must be strategically driven on his journey, defeating enemies, solving puzzles and mechanics while using the scenery to his advantage.

name: Walthros: Renewal
short_description: Make some friends, eat some burgers, and unearth terrible secrets from the depths of space. Frog and Toad Meet Cosmic Horror. A turn-based RPG with a kind-hearted doofus trying to make tough times a little easier.

name: The Machine's Garden
short_description: ​Use the intelligence of a decommissioned military supercomputer to solve puzzles and guide the lives of humble villagers.​

name: Dicking Around
short_description: Welcome to our game, Dicking Around. Go find some money. Throw some dildos. Shoot some guns. Blow stuff up. Have some fun. Dick around!

name: Lucidscape
short_description: Lucidscape is a 2D puzzle platformer with elements of exploration and combat. Jump in and conquer the nightmares as you explore fear-centric environments!

name: Big City Rigs: Bus Driver
short_description: You've got one job — drive a bus! Get behind the wheel of one of the 8 bus models and master the city streets as you transport passengers and increase your cash flow!

name: Martian Potato
short_description: Galactic farmer - it sounds proud! Do you have a farm on the Red Planet?

name: Eternal Dreamers
short_description: Eternal Dreamers is a battle-focused RPG offering deep tactical combat action. With a wide selection of classes and equipment pieces, the game puts much emphasis on customizability and player choice.

name: HTD
short_description: HTD is a mix of classic party-based RPG and fast-paced real-time action. Control a party consisting of healer, tank and damage dealer, each immensely powerful in their specific role, and use their strengths to take down horrific enemies while journeying through a dark story of mystery and madness.

name: King, Witch and Dragon
short_description: In the game where avatar become weaker and weaker, the player has to become stronger to reach the end.

name: Fractal Alchemist
short_description: Fractal Alchemist is a tool for creating and exploring 3D Fractal Worlds. For this you do not need knowledge of mathematics and programming - the Alchemist will do everything for you.

name: LIMEN: MoonCity
short_description: LIMEN: MoonCity is an atmospheric episodic adventure game that allows the player to traverse between memories using a system called Observe OS.

name: Vertigo Remastered
short_description: An immersive story-driven shooter incorporating the cutting edge of VR gameplay, Vertigo Remastered is a complete overhaul and occasional reimagining of the 2016 original.

name: Party Mashup
short_description: Play Eleven action packed mini-games; Perfect for any party! (With more to come!) Bring the Party to you!

name: Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom
short_description: Help Robin Hood and his merry men rescue King Richard from a cunning kidnapper! With its cast of timeless characters, rollicking story of heroism and addictive gameplay, Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom can turn hours of idle time into a quest for fun!

name: Beautiful Model2
short_description: ·This is a simulation rope art photography game. Players in the game play a rope master, through the cooperation with beautiful models to shoot beautiful photography.

name: PhotoStage
short_description: PhotoStage is an all-in-one slideshow creator loaded with tools and features. Easily drag and drop your pictures, videos, and audio files into the program. Enhance your photos and videos like crop, fade, and zoom, or more detailed changes by editing the brightness, saturation, and more.

name: WiccAtriX
short_description: Wiccatrix is an ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. The elemental balance or the world of Terra has been disturbed. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

name: Gladiators Manager
short_description: Gladiators Manager puts you in the position of a lanista responsible for training and managing gladiators. Participating in brutal arena fights and cruel intrigues will grant you riches and glory in the ancient Roman Empire.

name: Dancing Angel
short_description: Dancing Angel is a place where you can select a cute anime character. Lets dance along to hot songs, find your couple and celebrate weddings.

name: Shields of Loyalty
short_description: Experience tactically challenging turn-based strategy in the hostile island world of Mantaria. Command a dynamic army of various unit types and classes to slay a dark and possessed undead army. Train forces into powerful warriors and fight fervently until the snake's head is at your feet!

name: HUNKER DOWN
short_description: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources.

name: OverShoot Battle Race
short_description: Combat racing game inspired by the classic console arcade games, you can make drifts, upgrade your vehicle and buy many weapons to fight for first place in an insane journey facing the most amazing racers in the galaxy.

name: Summer in Mara Prologue
short_description: A demo of Summer in Mara. Discover the beginning of this adventure and take care of your island by harvesting your crops, fishing on your pond, and cooking. Enjoy the opening act to this farming adventure.

name: Spunky: Gangster Simulator
short_description: Enter the world of crime with Spunky Gangster Simulator. Assume the role of a mafia leader in this role-playing themed game. The mafia bosses, monopolize their presence in the crime world will develop their gangs and struggle with each other. Who will establish domination in the city?

name: Rogue Knight
short_description: Experience fast-paced roguelite gameplay. Explore ever-changing locations and fight vicious enemies in souls-inspired 2d combat. Every run you will find variety of items and spells to compliment your playstyle, as well as resources to upgrade your town for future runs.

name: Dört Model Müzesi
short_description: Four model contents in public relations, which is one of the topics in public relations education, have been developed to support the educational process using virtual reality technology.

name: My Mud Game

name: Ardein.Fall
short_description: Welcome Pilot to the Ardein Initiative. We are leaving Earth, and we need you to protect us. Face new challenges and new rivals EVERY DAY. Can you plan your defense to ever changing war? Can you save humanity?

name: Husbandry
short_description: As an entrepreneur from a far away galaxy, raise and breed the exotic creatures of Earth, then sell them back to your home world.

name: The Sewers
short_description: As you are having a rest in your humble abode you have the urge that something is present, something dangerous. Now you trust the urge and decide it's time to leave. You've been pushing your luck for too long down here. As you walk to exit this place you once called home, your urge becomes a reality.

name: shapez
short_description: shapez is an easy-going, minimalistic factory building game about the automation of shapes through extraction and satisfying production lines. Adapt to increasingly complex shapes and grow your factory across an infinitely expanding map. Your only limitation is your creativity!

name: A Knight in the Attic
short_description: Guide Guinevere on a quest to save the kingdom from darkness. Find mysterious objects in a living labyrinth board to solve unique puzzles and defeat the evil Mordred, all from the comfort of your grandmother’s attic.

name: Axiom Alternative
short_description: A short kinetic visual novel, independently written by Redewaan Duckett, giving an alternative take on the Welcome To... Chichester series

name: Farlanders
short_description: Terraform, strategize, and construct a Martian colony in this retro-inspired turn-based city builder. Create a comfortable living for your citizens, research alien artifacts, and uncover the secrets of the Red Planet.

name: 18 Wheels of Steel: Hard Truck
short_description: The first truck driving simulator from SCS Software lets you be your own boss behind the wheel of a big rig rolling through 11 US states. Road hazards, low fuel and the police can affect the timeliness and condition of your deliveries—and impact your bottom line.

name: BROK the InvestiGator - Prologue
short_description: The very first PUNCH & CLICK! Brok is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

name: ESC
short_description: An interactive novel about identity, roleplay, and dreams.

name: Cyberpulse

Utilize the new Yokai Shift ability to defeat even the most ferocious yokai and be prepared to brave through Dark Realms created by your enemies.

short_description: A 2D turn-based strategy game. PUSH, PULL, CHAIN, SWING. Check out what's new on the game board!

KOORING Forever!
