Just don't get caught.

name: Goblin Rush
short_description: You have been caught in a dungeon and must now fight your way to freedom. This is not an easy task however, as you will meet deadly goblins and other lurking creatures on your way.

name: SugarWinds
short_description: “If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened." Matthew 24:22. The Catholics discovered the Americas. “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you." Matthew 7:7

name: Granduck
short_description: Help blind grandpa find his bed by throwing quacking ducks. Be careful, he is paranoiac, and his house is full of deadly traps!

name: Mülltrennungssimulator 2021
short_description: The Mülltrennungssimulator 2021 is a revolutionary mix of game genres. A quick grasp and a small dose of skill are essential for this idle game. Separate the garbage and climb your way up to becoming a garbage mogul!

name: Revolution: The Spark
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey through a corrupt government in story-driven steampunk RPG Revolution: The Spark. Explore nine distinct areas, assemble a team of fearless allies, and decide if you want to foster peace or lead everyone towards a violent uprising.

name: Sunset 20 Drone Racer
short_description: Fly your drone up mountains, underwater and in space, racing against your rivals and firing missiles at them in this casual yet skillful arcade drone racing game.

name: Elaborate Lands
short_description: Elaborate Lands is a relaxing, turn-based strategy game. It combines unique gameplay mechanics with elements from 4X, city-builder and puzzle builder games. Build cities, gather resources, research technologies and expand your territory. Different maps and biomes offer near endless replayability.

name: FourthMotion
short_description: Fourthmotion: A biped controller enabled game where you collide with car, truck, airplane, spaceships, obstacles, walls and also jungle animals . Advance biped motion control physics pushes the limit of your game playing abilities. Fast-paced and thrilling!

name: Charge Kid
short_description: A challenging puzzle-platformer where each jump is a puzzle!

name: Uproar
short_description: Explore procedurally generated worlds, look for artifacts, fight enemies using any item, because everything around is your weapon. And all of this with friends, in a game with elements of rogue-like and dungeon crawler genres.

name: Rolling Arcade
short_description: Are you skillful enough to rock the tables of Rolling Arcade? Prove it in this digital reimagining of a classic mechanical arcade game. Steer the ball to the target, racing against the timer or another player!

name: Out of Control
short_description: Out of Control is a platformer where the controls randomize each level!

name: Maze Banquet
short_description: A nameless boy emerges from the darkness. His creator led him to the banquet with a letter: "Observe the guests and appoint one as the Maze King". Deprived of his voice, the boy heads to the Maze Banquet. He encounters the four creations at the entrance... from there a mysterious adventure unfolds!

name: Rise & Reign
short_description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, its up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or work together. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

name: Mythic Archive
short_description: The Mythic Archive is a Digital Toolset that lets you prepare and store massive amounts of content for TTRPGs. Prepare handouts, adventure modules, fully automated roleplaying systems, and much more!

name: RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter
short_description: RP7 is a slot-managing roguelike. Spin the reel and beat the odds in this RPG adventure!

name: Jane Skriff
short_description: Jane Skriff is a 2d beat-em up platformer. After being used as part of a secret experiment, Jane Skriff must fight her way out of the despotic nation of Landia. She will combat elite forces, deadly assassins, regular soldiers, several people on pogo-sticks, and a guy in a motorcycle helmet.

name: I AM FLY
short_description: A fly lives a short time, so collect poop and become a fat fly OR Eat rotten poop and die before you are satisfied!

name: GoatShelter
short_description: A tower defense game that can design routes freely. You can rely on your intelligence to design defense lines to resist the attacks of various monsters, so as to protect your shelter.

name: Hardship
short_description: Hardship is a set on a dynamic world in a strange solar system. Build your city, Design your buildings and progress through an in-depth technology tree. Gather resources, craft tools, manage citizens’ needs, and battle the elements.

name: October Night Games
short_description: Will you try to keep the world the way it is or fight for the changes? October Night Games is a digital board game where everyone is a cultist working for one of two different sides. Scour the town for cursed ingredients and make deals with inscrutable entities as something eldrich this way comes.

name: Furry Love
short_description: Entertaining Arcade Game, consisting of a Series of Exciting Mini-Games with the Beautiful Furry Girls. Amazing Atmosphere, Great Music, 32 Levels with Full HD Furry Artworks. Join us! 🐺

name: Takelshin
short_description: Takelshin is a 2D platformer in the style of the older 90's video game classics.

name: KANAPOCALYPSE
short_description: KANAPOCALYPSE is an educative RPG guesser game. Train your Hiragana and Katakana while raiding a city during the apocalypse. Earn money, buy new weapons and keep study/learn more Japanese alphabet.

name: Deja Vu Collector's Edition
short_description: Young American seeking his girlfriend who has gone missing in a backwater Russian city where it seems nothing much has changed since Soviet times

name: Hell Shuffle
short_description: A driving mix of rogue-like card deckbuilder and turn-based strategic combat. Join one of the three factions, craft a unique deck, set up a squad, use a variety of talents, trinkets, items, and a perk tree to wipe out the debauched angelic Protectors again and again.

name: tomorrow won't come for those without ██████
short_description: That day, we told a lie.

name: Dread Templar
short_description: Dread Templar is a fast-paced hardcore old-school FPS, combining classic 90s shooter and modern FPS elements. Unlock and combine dozens of weapon upgrades and skills, embrace the Dread Force and obliterate hordes of fiendish enemies. Become the scariest thing in hell and get your revenge!

name: Onsen Master
short_description: Onsen Master is a hot spring customer management game where players must create ingredients to match the various customer ailments, across the fantasy island of Izajima!

name: Everything Explosive
short_description: Welcome to Everything Explosive Season 2! Experience action packed gameplay with explosive artillery. Explore a variety of modes including unique spins on Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Bomb Blowup, and Castle Defense.

name: Salubrious Scales
short_description: Salubrious Scales is a sexy, adult's only, platforming/rythm game where you shake your scales as you make your way through an island.

name: GOHOME
short_description: This is a third-person horror game set in a residential area in 2000s Japan. It's the complete version of the free horror game GOHOME, which was released in 2019 and caused a boom. The map has been doubled, and six more ghosts, including hidden characters, have been added to the game.

name: Space Slurpies
short_description: Snake, slither, SLURRPP! Chill out with your friends in this multiplayer arcade game. Relax as you grow your colorful space snake by eating lots of food and avoiding playful baddies and other players. How long can you grow your Space Slurpie?

name: Purrseus
short_description: Solve puzzles, evade traps, use magic, and even call on a friend to help in this epic tale of Purrseus, the ancient Greek hero tasked with proving to the Gods he has both brawn AND brains!

name: The Neon Mate
short_description: The Neon Mate is an unique retro 3D platformer experience with synthwave music and endless gameplay

name: The Perplexing Orb 2
short_description: Experience an all new puzzle platforming adventure like none other! Roll, shrink, grow, zip, and jump your way through over 70 all new stages. Experience the classic Perplexing Orb game play with all new twists involving The Perplexing Orb's new character abilities.

name: Mind Over Melee Radio
short_description: Dank Tunes, Dank Memes and everything in-between. Play a stupid game, win stupid rewards. Fill the void in your life with some simple numerical validation for the glorious cause of the Infinite Grind.

name: Ginkgo
short_description: Ginkgo is a single player 3D horror game inspired by East Asian horror. Armed with a magic needle that can sew parts of the world together, solve puzzles and outsmart monsters as you explore a surreal world.

name: Action Taimanin
short_description: An intense, gorgeous hack-and-slash action RPG from the Taimanin fame!

name: Sumire
short_description: One Day, One Life. Sumire is a magical narrative adventure about choices made, and dreams lost and found. Embark on a mysterious journey to help Sumire achieve her deepest wishes, before the day ends and the sky turns to twilight.

name: 放置勇者：远征/Idle Heroes:Odyssey
short_description: As a hero leader, you need to recruit your hero, collect treasures and equipment, and run towns to upgrade the combat team.Facing powerful monsters on the expedition, you also need strategies to match heroes, skills and treasures, finally save the world again.

name: Cursed Letters
short_description: A first-person stealth horror game with a retro-looking aesthetic. Run and hide from creepy enemies and try to survive while you solve puzzles and discover the obnoxious truth behind the facts. A unique and immersive recreation of a "slasher horror game"

name: Dennkind Dock
short_description: Extent your Desktop with the stylish designed and animated Dock. Add games and apps to the integrated library. Customize with Skins and Extensions. Create your own user profiles to quickly switch between multiple environments.

name: The Warlin of Heroes
short_description: The Warlin of Heroes is a martial arts card game that combines Roguelike gameplay. Play with a variety of unique martial arts classes, and customize decks to fit your playstyle. Explore The Warlin, Experience the bloody winds of Junlough.

name: Painted Legend 2
short_description: Welcome to a world where fantasies come to life! Painted Legend 2 is an adventure 2.5D platformer game made in the style of 80s cartoons, where you have to play for one of heroes with different characteristics and abilities.

name: Kaapelipeli: The Cable Game
short_description: The Cable Game is a unique shooter-action-casual-rpg-adventure-survival-game, where player must plan underground cable routes and avoid angry landowners while doing so!

name: Chef Chen
short_description: "Chef Chen" is a multiplayer cooking game for 1-4 players. Join Chef Chen's team in high-stakes cooking competitions, overcoming financial challenges. Embark on a culinary adventure with skilled cooks in a fantastical world.

name: DVR Simulator
short_description: DVR Simulator is a Drone Racing FPV Simulator. Learn how to fly or start training right now with racing or freestyle modes. Do you have a VR headset? Use it to simulate FPV Goggles!

name: Rangers
short_description: This is a zombie survival game for one player and for cooperation in 4 players.

name: 50 Level Survival
short_description: 50 Level survival is a point and click survival game. The goal is to complete the 50 levels. Can you complete the 50 levels?

name: Tyrgard Archer VR
short_description: Prepare yourself against the incoming hordes of unique enemies! Dodge flying spears, magical ravens and kamikaze dragons! Immerse yourself in a stylish low-poly environment. Upgrade your bow, improve your skill and become the champion Tyrgard needs you to be!

name: Smart Tracks - Think and Run
short_description: A fun puzzle that combines the careful analysis of physics and logic with the adrenaline of rally racing. Overcome obstacles, survive deadly curves, make the best time, whether on asphalt, mud or snow, and become a legend on the tracks!

name: Hell's High Harmonizers
short_description: Object heads, monsters and humans. A simulation game of living in Hell where you meet and adventure with a diverse range of residents.

name: The Escape from Bungalow
short_description: A horror escape game where a mysterious woman explores a mansion that wanders around from a first-person perspective The sense of urgency that sudden strangeness appears. Silent BGM, scary even in empty places

name: TAnima
short_description: TAnima is a 2D action-roguelite where you use cards to make each run different! Collect cards, fight enemies, explore the dungeon, meet new friends and solve the mystery of TAnima!

name: Alisa
short_description: Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90s 3D games.

name: UNREAL LIFE
short_description: And now, for today's story.

name: Raven Port
short_description: Raven Port is a Free-To-Play Roque-like MMORPG. Crawl trough the many procedurally generated dungeons this game has to offer. Whether you go solo, or with up to 4 others, an exciting adventure awaits.

name: Monsty Corp
short_description: A story based, puzzle game, Monsty Corp will have you exploring the facility known as “Monsty Corp”, an advanced science facility closed down due to strange occurrences.

name: JoY
short_description: JoY is a horror game where unsettling mini-games and chilling cutscenes take an unexpected turn into darkness. Brace yourself for a unique, terrifying experience that will keep you on edge from start to finish.

name: IMHA
short_description: IMHA is a first-person shooter set on an island ravaged by a demon invasion. Battle your way through endless hordes of enemies and survive the onslaught of relentless ghouls and demons.

name: The Kind Camomille
short_description: A wholesome 3D exploration game about random acts of kindness and the joy of discovery. Take control of Camomille, a kind mouse on her way to her dear grandmother 100th birthday. On a relaxing and beautiful journey she encounters people in need of a hand.

name: Marbleous Blocks
short_description: Challenge your spatial thinking in this point & click, physics based, 3D-puzzle game, where you combine blocks to create paths for a marble named Max.

name: Flight Attendant Simulator
short_description: Travel the world as you progress through your career as a flight attendant while ensuring the safety and comfort of your passengers.

name: Operation: Tango
short_description: It takes two to save the world in this cooperative spy adventure. Pair up with a friend as Agent or Hacker—with only your voices to connect you—and work together to bring a hi-tech global menace to its knees. Now with a FREE CONTENT UPDATE!

name: Bunny's Maze
short_description: Bunny's Maze is a colorful 3D Puzzle game, navigate two little rabbits and move the walls to create a path. Go through the maze and collect all the hidden carrots. Enjoy this cute and relaxing game for all ages.

name: 100 vacas
short_description: 100 vacas is a bite-sized game about a cowboy defending one hundred heads of cattle from bandits and making every bullet count.

name: Len's Island
short_description: Discover, survive, and thrive in Len’s Island, where intense dungeon crawling meets open-world action RPG. Master skill-based combat, craft powerful items, build and defend your homestead, and find solace in farming. Your journey, your destiny.

name: Duo Defenders - Tower Defense
short_description: Cute and cooperative tower defense game where you and your partner must reload towers with ammunition together.

name: Fractured Voyage
short_description: In this 2D sci-fi survival based game you must endure the difficulty of surviving on an alien planet, and need to adventure, dig and build your way to freedom.

name: Droid Guier
short_description: Droid Guier, a challenging addicting robotic combat game, the player controls an Android and destroys several enemies, completes strategic missions, installs traps with explosive mines and lots of action with levels and enemies with various abilities.

name: Ball-it Hell
short_description: Dodge! Strike back! This is a fast-paced barrage arcade game. Move the character to dodge bullets. Pick the right time to strike bullets back and destroy enemies to get gold coins. Unlock more characters and powerful skills. Keep challenging yourself to get higher scores and rankings.

name: Greedy Maze
short_description: Casual next level maze game with 150 levels, in 5 different maze categories, with 3 full customizable modes and 12 color themes for anyone who like solving mazes. Main idea was to add some new features like moving walls and 3D weave type of maze.

name: Mayor of Defense
short_description: You are the village chief. Just when you thought the promised slow life was waiting for you... A monster that attacks without end! Almost a one-man operation! Black Village! Work to get materials, money and hire mercenaries to defend your village.

name: Easter Pairs
short_description: A game in the classic "memory" genre. The images of eggs are laid out on the playing field, your task is to find paired ones.

name: TAISHO x ALICE episode 2
short_description: DUALICE(TAISHO x ALICE episode II) is a fairytale visual novel in which YOU must save your Prince Charming! You will take on the role of the fairytale heroine in order to rehabilitate your chosen love interest and guide him to his "happily ever after"!

name: Ynglet: Prologue
short_description: Ynglet: Prologue presents the first levels of my new game Ynglet! You’ll jump between bubbles that float in the sky like you’re a space dolphin, as you melt into a highly reactive and dynamic soundtrack created by Ynglet’s custom (and needlessly complicated) music software!

name: Arcadium
short_description: Arcadium is an action packed brickbreaker game where you destroy bricks, enemies and bosses using your ball and powerups. Fast reflexes, aiming and avoiding simple misstakes is required for beating this game, choose between three difficulty settings to adjust the challenge.

name: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead
short_description: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead combines the legendary and challenging puzzle gameplay of Bridge Constructor™ with the post-apocalyptic zombie universe of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

name: Inside the Box
short_description: Inside the box, there is a set of 48 boxes with puzzles inside. Test your logic by solving the puzzles from all the boxes.

name: Whispers of the Ancients
short_description: Whispers of the Ancients is a 3D platformer, adventure and RPG game. The whispers will never stop, which makes the life of mortals difficult. Mankind has been possessed by the whispers of the ancients. These whispers can even rule over mountains, soils and rivers.

name: Chupa Chupa VR
short_description: Chupa Chupa VR is a classic stealth licking game that has you licking recorders, drinks, and other things in a familiar classroom, all while trying not to get caught by the girls.

name: The Cabin
short_description: The Cabin is 2D Survival and Resource management game were your simple goal is to survive as long as possible. Deep in the Canadian Boreal after some kind of unknown 'incident' you've fled for safety, now scavenge for supplies, battle the elements and evade the mysterious 'augs'.

name: ANCIENT EVIL
short_description: ANCIENT EVIL is a real-time tactical puzzle game where you need to pass severe tests and win the final battle with the enemy.

name: Go, Go Cowboy
short_description: Fast and hurricane Top-Down-Shooter where you act as a Sheriff in the Wild West and must quickly deal with all the bandits in the area, arm yourself with your trusty revolver and go on a dangerous journey!

name: Hard Driver
short_description: Incredibly beautiful and dynamic Side-Scroller, where you control a car that flew into the air with a super-cool driver must Dodge obstacles, flying past clouds, shooting off flying debris and collecting various Goodies on the way home!

name: Hard Driver 2
short_description: A new part of the hurricane runner, where you act as an unlucky driver who tries to get to his home, can you Dodge obstacles, jump over cliffs, collect coins and improve your car to help the driver in his difficult game of survival?

name: ClickMonster
short_description: An incredibly colorful and dynamic clicker in which you will plunge into the world of unique monsters, visit amazing worlds and acquire new improvements over time.

name: Nightmare Zone
short_description: Nightmare Zone is an indie horror game made by two people. Run away from your nightmares, explore all areas of the dream world and find 5 doors in a row to escape. Will you be able to wake up? Something is looking for you and if you get caught you'll have to restart.

name: Alt254
short_description: Alt254 is a minimalistic open-world action-adventure game. Explore a map full of surprises, evade traps and hazards and fight enemies as ■, set on a journey of exploration and self-discovery, trying to understand the world around you in order to overcome its many dangers.

name: Askold: Path of the Shadow
short_description: Askold: Path of the Shadow is a stealth game with exciting story. Investigate extensive levels from a cosy small village to the shadowy hostile swamp. Beat your enemies and complete the mission in the most unexpected ways. Inquire the complicated storyline and determine the fate of the Kingdom.

name: Solus Sector: Tactics
short_description: A single-player turn-based strategy with simple mechanics. Control spacecrafts, pick skills, and build bases to reach the center of the galaxy. Each sector presents a new tactical challenge and unfolds the story-line.

name: Super Huey™ III
short_description: Super Huey™ III is a direct sequel to the PC’s first helicopter simulation, featuring tense combat and daring rescues in over 35 dramatic missions! This revamped version of the 2003 classic enhances the original while still packing all the high-flying and explosive action you remember.

name: As Dusk Falls
short_description: Explore the entangled lives of two families across thirty years in an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT. Starting in 1998 with a robbery-gone-wrong, the character's lives depend on the choices you make.

name: Steel Thunder
short_description: Lead an elite tank crew in one of four frontline U.S. tanks of the Cold War era, including the M60A3, M48A5 Patton, M3 Bradley CFV, and the devastating M1A1 Abrams. Assume the roles of Commander, Driver, and Gunner in an indomitable war machine that rolls out of the west like steel thunder.

name: Corridor 7: Alien Invasion
short_description: This terrifying 1990s sci-fi first-person shooter from Capstone Software has you venturing deep into the dark and twisting test chambers of Corridor 7 to combat a hostile takeover of Earth.

name: Castle on the Coast
short_description: A hand-drawn, retro 3D collectathon. Parkour through a magic castle as George the Giraffe! String together sweet moves to explore crystal caverns, stone laden halls, and trippy alternate dimensions.

name: Furry Woof
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Fuhrer in LA - Special Edition
short_description: Fuhrer in a LA is a grindhouse-styled top-down action-adventure game which takes place around 1947, unraveling the truth about the demise of the Fuhrer post World War 2.

name: Coronavirus - Nano Force
short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter where you pilot a nano-ship in the fight against the Coronavirus. Grab powerups to upgrade your weapons and eliminate the virus infection.

name: Detour Bus
short_description: Build ridiculous highways to guide the Flowers family on a psychedelic road trip across post-infrastructure America.

name: Sylphy and the Sleepless Island
short_description: One day, professional thief Sylphy learns of the mystical and valuable artifact of the Kingdom of Diezel, but the mission goes sideways and she ends up robbing the island of its night! She has one week to right her wrongs in this action-filled RPG!

name: Lisa and the Grimoire
short_description: Hoping to hit a big payday and pull herself from a life of poverty, Lisa heads to a town with a rumored demonic artifact. But upon arriving, she quickly realizes she has gotten herself into a dangerous situation.

name: The Dead End
short_description: An ancient witch, a living dungeon, an undead curse, and a lost Holy Maiden. Greater men than you have fallen in the cursed dungeon of Witchhome. What awaits you in the depths? Fame? Or infamy?

name: The Triumphant Return of Diabolos
short_description: Many years after humanity came together to defeat the Demon Lord, a young man trained to become an imperial knight. One day, however, he was confronted by a mysterious figure who said, "We have been looking for you, Demon Lord Diabolos."

name: The Maiden, the Butler, and the Witch
short_description: Irina must leave home and complete her pilgrimage to become a full-fledged witch. However, the Demon Lord has built a castle on the island and summoned monsters threatening its citizens and her coming-of-age journey.

name: PRIMITIVE HEARTS
short_description: A voice calls out and four heroes hear its call. Can they rise to the challenge? Or will the Empire capture the land's Crystals and achieve their evil goals?

name: Evening Starter
short_description: A classic dungeon crawler RPG. When Ren Nosogi gets caught up in an incident that puts her in massive debt, she must use her skills as a Sweeper to take down an evil cult in order to pay it off.

name: Mage of the Olekta Desert
short_description: Aisha takes on a mission to deliver a letter to a mage living in the Olekta Desert. To her dismay, she must traverse the dangerous ruins and defeat the bandits and cultists that roam inside... or somehow get through unnoticed.

name: Castaway of the Ardusta Sea
short_description: Going on another solo adventure, Aisha sets off by ship. Unfortunately, a sudden storm and the incursion of a giant sea monster hinders her path. Through the turmoil, she is thrown overboard and wakes up on an unknown island. Aisha must find her way home and survive the pirates and monsters that lurk both above ground and in the deep.

name: Riders 2491
short_description: Riders 2491 is an action shoot'em up game that pays homage to the classics of 90’s arcades with modern visuals.

name: The Cabbage Effect
short_description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter on procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

name: Bugz!
short_description: Venture into the world Bugz to capture, research and compete with your team of Bugz!

name: Jurassic Fantasy
short_description: Follow a young wizard in his path to find the Magical Stones and himself in this Jurassic Fantasy!

name: GUNBARICH
short_description: Shoot back the enemy bullets! The breakout-like shooter with a variety of items and gimmicks! With online rankings!

name: ZERO GUNNER 2-
short_description: Go through the 360 degree siege! The top-down shooter to operate a attack helicopter. And with online rankings.

name: SAMURAI SHODOWN
short_description: SAMURAI REBOOT! A brand new SAMURAI SHODOWN game takes aim for the world stage!

name: Nofrills Solitaire
short_description: A fresh take on Solitaire Klondike with no distractions.

name: Himeko Maid
short_description: Join Suzuka as she enters the first Himeko Maid contest! Choose your maid, complete the events, and become an expert in Night Service Training!

name: Mad Games Tycoon 2
short_description: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

name: MadGuns
short_description: Multiplayer free-to-play first-person shooter. Crazy weapons, battle strategy, dynamic gameplay. Win the battle for territory with your team.

name: Everlasting Guilt
short_description: if you’re into Doom, Furi \ Titan Souls, this game will fulfill your needs with its FPS, fast-paced gameplay that heavily focuses on Boss fights, each with a unique approach that has its own mechanics, and a load of enemies to unleash your anger and test your arsenal upon.

name: Burning Lands
short_description: A tactical multiplayer first-person shooter in the Vietnam war era. It will be, what we coined, an “accessible tactical simulation” (ATS) - striking the best possible balance between realism and accessibility,

name: [TDA02] Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 02 REMASTERED
short_description: Muv Luv Unlimited: The Day After continues! The Shogun has come to Seattle, and with her, an installation that might solve the ongoing food crisis. But tensions simmer beneath the surface, as an unseen enemy waits for its chance to strike.

name: Hard Night VR
short_description: Post-apocalyptic zombie shooter. Survive.

name: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion
short_description: Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat in your fully customized armored suit as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous world on land or in the air. Take on titanic boss battles with alone or with up to two other friends in online co-op!

name: Psyber
short_description: Psyber is an educational game that teaches players the fundamentals of Computer Science. Explore an alternate reality world of robots filled with fun interactive puzzles and dangerous traps while learning the fundamentals of programming.

name: Bad Apples
short_description: Bad Apples is an online multiplayer survival action game featuring fruits that ripen as they ripen over time. Change your or your opponent's stats according to the degree of ripening (if the fruit ripens too much, it rots) and use weapons and special moves to win the battle!

name: Orb and the Stars
short_description: This stellar story will require reflexion and dexterity! In the spirit of vintage marble board games with puzzles and mazes, use gears and gizmos to lead an orb trough constellations and rekindle all the stars!

name: Dolphin Trainer VR
short_description: Become a dolphin trainer. Start training, complete all tasks, obtain certificates and start working in the Dolphinarium. Work, train and play with the dolphins, love them ... but also try to free them.

name: Hyperspace Harvest
short_description: The whale is sick, dear child. Grow crops on its skin. Fight cells in its flesh. This is your purpose in this world. For the whale is god and it is sick and you are the remedy.​

name: Oneons: Prisoners
short_description: Oneons is a hard coffee-break roguelite. Explore 12 floors. Uncover dangerous enemies, each with unique abilities. Turn-based combat: fight or use your skills to blast enemies or heal. Balance exploration, energy, and combat. Die. Get stronger. Retry. Turn-based and easy to play, difficult to master

name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest
short_description: Explore the myths and monsters of Europe’s last primeval wilderness. Play as Maia, who arrives at the ancient Białowieża Forest looking to explore her family history. Discover Rage in an adventure game inspired by the experience of the legendary tabletop roleplaying game Werewolf: The Apocalypse.

name: Rappelz
short_description: Everyone can kill monsters, but have you tried to be friends with them? In this world, any monster can be tamed and made your ally. He will help both in PvP and PvE and grow with you! Choose a class and become the hero of this world in an absolutely free classic MMORPG!

name: Relic Guardians: Complete
short_description: Rock, paper, scissors meet anime turn-based fights and time travel!

name: Cobots
short_description: Manipulate time and cooperate with yourself to solve challenging puzzles! Delve into a colorful world filled with a variety of dangers and unique mind-bending puzzle mechanics.

name: Radiolight
short_description: Ashwood Creek, 1985. A child disappears without a trace. A local policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

name: Truzzle
short_description: Take the ball to the end, without interruptions.

name: Moose Life
short_description: Moose Life is a trippy, psychedelic trance shooter. Created in the style of a 1980s arcade game, Moose Life offers you an exhilarating ride into the trance zone. Spectacular shooty action and a top techno soundtrack will raise your mood. If you have VR, immerse yourself for greater satisfaction.

short_description: Weapons, traps, environment — choose smart, act quick. The enemies — 18 types — won’t fall before the same stick. A brother in arms won’t hurt — help hares (not rabbits!) fight their way out of the dungeon in this co-op roguelike together!

name: Farmageddon
short_description: Farmageddon is a turn-based strategy RPG about farming in the post-apoclayptic desert wastes of New San Fransisco.

name: Soldier Warfare

name: Ronald's Run
short_description: Help Ronald use his magic to defeat the crazy nanoos. There are 3 levels to choose from and you can collect as many coins as possible. A fun single-player as Ronald gains experience with every nanoo vanquished.

name: Sentience
short_description: Sentience is a multiplayer team hide and seek game set in a sci-fi dystopian world. Work together to take down the system or put a stop to the newly sentient resistance.

name: Cartridge Monsters
short_description: Cartridge Monsters is a VR Creature Collector. Capture and train over 65 unique monsters and navigate through four expansive dungeons, two in each town. Defeat formidable bosses and thwart the evil Django.

name: Requiem Aeternam Eden

short_description: Bomber - a funny time killer game with 20 levels

name: PUFIWEHO
short_description: Protecting Us From Incredibly Worrisome Extremely Hostile Oddities...is what you will be doing with your football! Defend the Earth from the invading disciples of the Deranged Octopus, and learn the ultimate secret of the Universe.

short_description: Play ball tag with your friends in the most appropriate places for kids! Compete with others, avoid the traps, interact with levels and build your own!

name: Winter War 1939
short_description: Epic World War 2 battles. Finland vs the Soviet Union.

name: Toys 'n' Traps
short_description: Protect Toy’s Town in this action-filled tower defense. Build crazy traps, shoot enemies, lead your own minion army, obtain new traps and upgrade them to defend your car base across 4 different environments with visuals inspired in toys.

name: Twin Horizons
short_description: You may think this is a simple rhythm action game with the simple controls of tapping and holding the keyboard, but what's that above? Yes, you need to pay attention to those as well! Can you handle the 8-lane madness?

name: DF-41 Simulator
short_description: 3D visualizer and simulator of the Dongfeng-41 (DF-41 东风-41) road-mobile intercontinental ballistic missile.

name: Comic&Picture Shelf
short_description: Comic&Picture Shelf is a software for managing and browsing comics、pictures.

name: Arena of Ruins
short_description: It consists of Lan mode multiplaying and several simple acts of single mode.

name: 策魂三国
short_description: 《策魂三国》采用的是经典六角战棋模式，游戏中有近百位精心设计的武将登场，不同武将携带不同的兵种（枪、戟、弓、骑、冲车、井阑、投石车），配合上几十种不同的兵法，上百种效果各异的宝物，演绎出丰富多彩的战斗模式！

name: Hoffnunigans
short_description: "Your arrival has been long awaited by the most spirited Hoffnunigans. Destiny has led you to our shores. Join the cause to rebuild what has been lost to the outside world. May your most heroic years be spent here, shaping a better future for all Hoffnunigans." -Hoffnung Travel Office

name: Dystopia Punk - Zero Hour
short_description: Dystopia Punk: Zero Hour is a single-player cyberpunk rogue-lite where you fight to reclaim a city ruled by Megacorps. Infiltrate, sabotage, and seize districts in a world that fights back. Unlock abilities, recruit allies, and shape the resistance-one mission at a time. Will you rise or be crushed?

name: Citystate II
short_description: Create your own Nation, build cities and bring prosperity to your people. Citystate II is a unique city-builder featuring realistic economics and complex political options. Slums or skyscrapers, experiment and bring about your vision of the ideal society.

name: Stoirs VR
short_description: You find yourself closed in the multi-storeyed bunker with a mysterious artefact, a monster and the anomalities. If you want to survive, you must find a way to leave it.

name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
short_description: Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign’s Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island’s hidden secrets.

name: 春と修羅｜Haru to Shura
short_description: Explore a mysterious world as the protagonist in this short adventure game with pixel graphics.

name: HAAK
short_description: HAAK is a Metroidvania-Platformer. As the mysterious wanderer Haak, you embarked on an epic expedition across the vast cyber-wasteland to find your lost brother. Explore deserted cities and metro, refine your weapons and hack skills, and uncover the secrets behind metal and dust.

name: Eloquence
short_description: Collect, repeat, and shape your own sentences in this award-winning narrative Metroidbrainia! Speak in a universal symbol language to save an island. Explore a vibrant and non-violent world inhabited by charming islanders and uncover the volcano’s mystery.

name: The first titans
short_description: The first titans is an indie VR game where the shooters, tower defense and strategy games meet together. You will land in a hostile planet where you have to protect your crystal reactor. Recollect resources, build towers and kill the aliens trying to destroy you.

name: My Isekai After Life is an RPG!?
short_description: You have died. You choose to live your after-life in a turn-based RPG game with no one but beautiful goddesses to talk to. Laugh your way through a comical story-line as you battle monsters, unlock new powers, and recruit goddesses to your party!

name: SCP: The Foundation
short_description: An everyday, routine assembly takes a rather dark turn amidst some rumours of a containment breach...

name: Hoplichess
short_description: A turn-based strategy game set in ancient Greece. Lead your very own Greek forces to victory in this simple but endearing game of ingenuity and tactics. Master the command of your troops, dominate the field, and prove your mettle as a general.

short_description: Dance, style, and spellcast your way through hordes of dazzling and dangerous baddies on your way towards fame and glory in this groovy discofest! There's one catch though, all your spells get randomized every 30 seconds!

name: The Path of Calydra
short_description: The Path of Calydra is a beautiful 3D adventure platformer set in the fantastic world of Calysgore. Featuring the young boy Matheus joined by a mysterious entity called Calydra. The two embark on a quest of finding four crystals that represent lost elemental powers.

name: The Night of Joe
short_description: The Night of Joe is an action-horror game set in a supermarket at night. Joe is trying to exit, to do so he has to find and activate some escalators while a monster is chasing him. He has a special flashlight to help him see through the dark but also to transform and stop the Night for a few seconds

name: CAPITAL
short_description: The city is gone. Can you survive? Yuri is a soldier who is on training by C.A.P.I.T.A.L. which is an international military corporation. Can Yuri get out of the capital of Turkey alive and uninfected?

name: Infected zone 感染之地
short_description: In this open world game, you need to survive in the city where a virus just broke out. You could obtain materials for survival and fight by gathering, sowing and trading. Find more fellow players to complete tasks with you to unlock more areas. Finally escape the infected city if you are lucky!

name: Five Dates
short_description: Five Dates is an interactive rom-com about the unpredictable world of digital dating. With five potential female matches, Vinny explores whether compatibility, chemistry and connection is still possible in a world where physical touch is no longer an option.

name: Gravity SQUARE -グラビティ スクエア-
short_description: Part-time work urgently needed! Beginners welcome! Manipulate the gravity of the planet Square and earn your wages by collecting the many aliens that spring up! Compete for income with other part time worker from around the world!

name: Make the Burger
short_description: Make burgers with assorted ingredients, memorize orders and be quick before time runs out. Make your customers happy by eating delicious hamburgers, but remember, nobody likes to get wrong orders.

name: Ski Doom VR

name: Queen's Conquest

What is Vairon's goal in this whole story ? Save the kidnaped villager and return to enjoy his birthday in peace.

short_description: You are Zack Kuroneko, a 20-something college grad living blissfully with his long term boyfriend, Spencer Waters. One day, however, Zack begins to notice something strange. Feels strange. The sun feels so nice to lay in, and the birds look all too fun to chase. Zack has become a Werecat!

short_description: Artifice: War Tactics is a turn-based roguelike where enemies show their next move. Evade, strike, and combo with your champions to flip the battlefield in your favor.

name: The Soldiers Factory
short_description: The Soldiers Factory is a top-down stealth game. Stay undetected and sneak past enemy soldiers or kill them stealthily. Overcome security cameras and laser barricades. Experience a thrilling story and an old-school stealth experience.

name: Lockdown Hero
short_description: The perfect video game to play during Lockdown!

name: Zombies Must Die

name: SKYLECT

Gather resources, build homes, challenge demons and create a thriving city while preparing for winter.

short_description: What, you can easily pass all the obstacles you face? So, are you our last hope? So, do you want some absurdity? And are you doing all this to beat the ZUMBEKUKKA at downstairs? Dude, you are really brave!

name: Artificial Life 2061: Cybersys - Diva Of The VRworld, Babel Project: "Kodota Komori 1416" [Made by: Joseph Sanz]

Explore the area in a top-view mode. Perfect for beginners and experts alike. Discover how the creator of a robot singer will change our destiny.

name: Gude! Jump n Run
short_description: Challenging 2D Platformer featuring a glowing Cat.

name: LOGIC ABUSE
short_description: Enter an extraordinarily abstract representation of the world at Planck-length scales, running a hardcore bullet-hell simulation. Experience extremely intense audio and visual effects as you fight hordes of difficult enemies, trying not to die even a single time.

name: JUST A GAME
short_description: "Just a Game" is a sci-fi flying shooting game, you will control the robot protagonist zero and lead the partners in this exclusion of artificial intelligence in the world to survive, there are many camps in the game, you can choose to join them or one side.Build your fleet and fight the world.

name: Lost Island Atlantida Advanture Game
short_description: Lost Island Atlantida Advanture Game is an open world game with action-survival elements. Immerse yourself in the relaxing atmosphere of the ocean with many islands inhabited by goblins and menotaurs. Explore the islands and the underwater world, get resources, build housing.

name: Glum Buster
short_description: Take a mind-bending trip through a mysterious, haunting alternate reality. Use your newly discovered magic, wits, and curiosity to cleanse the world of glum and find a way back to your family. Experience the wonder of this 2009 AIGF Showcase winner and indie cult classic.

name: Fetish Locator Week One
short_description: Play as a young college student exploring love, lust, and sexual fetishes with the hottest women in town. Score points in the Fetish Locator app, which has taken the campus by storm. Make choices and decide the fate of the story in Fetish Locator!

name: In Silence
short_description: In Silence is a multiplayer horror game. One player takes on the role of the monster who has hypersensitive hearing abilities and is almost completely blind. The other players(2-6) play as survivors, trying to escape or hunting the monster.

name: Vampires Dawn 3 - The Crimson Realm
short_description: Vampires Dawn 3 is a 2D retro pixel RPG full of vampires, blood and tragic moments! Follow Asgar Serrans bloody path through a world in which humankind only has the sacred crusade to prevent extinction.

name: Living the Nightmare
short_description: Living the Nightmare is a fast-paced, turn-based, Horror Roguelike about a Slasher who just met his end. Be the Faceless, a Killer slain by a would-be victim and cast into a dark, purgatorial realm. There may be a way out... but there's a lot of monsters to turn inside out first.

name: DeRailed
short_description: When a domestic terrorist resurfaces it falls on an overburdened police department to discover his plot and put an end to it, and as a washed up detective leading the renewed investigation things begin to not appear as they seem.

name: Nano.wars
short_description: WELCOME! To Nano.wars. A next gen procedual fps action game. Do you have what it takes to become the next Nano.wars Champion? Lets wait and see....

name: Battle Royale: For Your Heart!
short_description: A battle royale themed romance parody game! Select your avatar, player voice, gamertag, and possible duo partner, as you venture into an expansive virtual world alongside a colorful cast of characters.

name: Magic Fluids
short_description: Click the screen and experience an amazing, lifelike simulator of fluid physics that you can interact and play with. Gorgeous visual effects give a out of this world feel. Experiment with infinite configurations, find the perfect one and create beautiful images or just sit back and enjoy the view!

name: Stellaren II
short_description: A space sci-fi visual novel in post-apocalyptic worldCombines a unique visual novel experience with multiple mini-games!Travel across multiple locations across space and meet a diverse set of interesting characters.

name: Vapor Music Tour
short_description: This is a tour of Vapor Music’s West Post Production Studio Location in Toronto, Canada.

name: Rainy Neon
short_description: It is a fast-paced cyberpunk Battle Royale game which aims to be competitive and dynamic. It takes place in real city Baku in the possible dark future.

name: Leaving
short_description: After completing the game, you will learn something about yourself that you did not even think about. Will you act on your conscience or leave everyone to their fate?

name: Hot Tiles
short_description: Hot Tiles is a small puzzle game where you have to find the correct place for each tile judging by its color: the 'hotter' it looks, the closer it is to the required location.

name: The Grand Lord
short_description: Thrust into power unwillingly, how would you rule? Travel through your kingdom full of idiots, hot heads, and crazies, and unite them all. Or, tell them all to go to hell. The choice is yours. Rule your way as you try to become the Grand Lord.

name: Timewalk Tower Defense
short_description: An asymmetric Tower Defense/Third Person Shooter

name: REPTRAILS
short_description: Singleplayer 2D RTS Chemtrail / NWO Simulation

name: I'm a love interest in my childhood friend's reverse harem!!!
short_description: A not-so-generic otome game with BL possibilities.Play as the male childhood friend, as he either tries to romance the female heroine, or make the other two male love interests fall for him instead.

name: BAL Solid
short_description: A Relaxing Ball Physic Puzzle Game

name: Insulated at the bottom
short_description: Insulated at the bottom - An atmospheric third-person shooter, meet and destroy enemies on your way, cope with difficult platforming and plunge into the atmosphere of an abandoned military base.

name: Fleeting World
short_description: Fleeting World - a city-building game where the landscape around you is constantly changing. Build a settlement, collect resources, adjust it to the changing terrain, avoid natural hazards, offer the resources to the gods.

name: Kujlevka
short_description: A flying saucer crash-lands in a distant Russian village, turning a rundown kolkhoz into the first, thin bridge between civilizations. As the first point of contact, you must dictate how this encounter unfolds and ultimately determine history’s outcome.

name: 东方栖霞园 ~ Blue devil in the Belvedere.
short_description: Mysterious red eyes popped up in forest, the shrine was raided by unknown vermin, ominous black magic diffused everywhere, while the scarlet devil had been awaiting for opportunity... Is it an magic outbreak, or a conspiracy? Now, set out on a journey to the truth and unravel the enigmas!

name: Defold
short_description: Defold is a free and open game engine used for development of desktop, mobile and web games.

name: Tales Of Chandar
short_description: Tales Of Chandar is a turn-based strategy RPG, where you have to survive the dangerous lands of Chandar, and take back the kidnapped princess to her father.

name: City Of Thugs
short_description: City of Thugs is a turn-based roguelite RPG, set in the modern world, where you'll have to fight your way through a city full of randomly generated thugs.

name: Fate in the Darkness
short_description: RPG-sandbox in board game style, with a gothic fantasy atmosphere. А living own life world, which you can interact through the game character, attended events, tasks and game deck. The goal of this project is to port board game.

name: Mystika 4 : Dark Omens
short_description: Sarel, a power-hungry dragon, stole the book "Dark Omens" causing the activation of an ancient inter-dimensional portal located north of Lumina, allowing evil creatures to invade the world.Help Alrik and Tenebria seal this gate! Explore the world of Lumina through 160 magic levels.

name: Shadow Walls
short_description: Kill a variety of enemies with your pistol or swing your bat. Collect letters while you trying to find your sister in dark atmospheric action top-down shooter 2D game.

name: VR Hentai room
short_description: This VR game allows you to have an erotic experience with a beautiful girl. You can choose position, putting on and taking off clothes, and speed. Immerse yourself in a world of alone with girl and have a happy time.

name: Dream Of Salmon
short_description: Adventure-type Control game with high difficulty. Dream Of Salmon is a challenging game. Only a special person can succeed. Challenge yourself to become someone special! If you are impatient, give up

name: Bromeliad
short_description: In Bromeliad you are stranded on a pacific island where you are a Human-Bear. You will have to survive, gathering materials to build tools and bases. You will need to hunt for food, explore, tame animals, then, at night strange creatures will appear. Survive and find an element to return to normal.

name: Trench Simulator
short_description: Trench Simulator is a 50 vs 50 Online World War 1 Third Person Shooter simulator. Packed with authentic weaponry, vehicles , beautifully designed trenches and stationary weapons, Trench Simulator aims to recreate the epic charges across No Man's Land you often see in World War 1 footage.

name: Refraction
short_description: Jackie Shields wakes up to find everything in her world a little different than she remembers it. Trapped between her own dimension and a parallel one, she soon realizes that nothing can remain unchanged in her life. Especially not herself...because the other dimension has a Jackie of its own!

name: Push Blox
short_description: Block-pushing puzzle game with challenging high quality levels.

name: Azalea
short_description: A short, cute puzzle action-adventure through the tense and dangerous Forbidden Forest.

name: Child Arms
short_description: In this 3rd person sword-fighting game, Child Arms has you facing your opponent head on in one-on-one fights. Beat all opponents and see your characters ending, fight against your friends local or online, or improve your skills in practice mode and mini-games.

name: Floral Town
short_description: Floral Town, the adorable Life Sim with a focus on interesting characters and relationships!

name: Greedy Dungeon
short_description: Greedy Dungeon is a Deck-Building Roguelike game that you have to build a deck with your playstyle and embark upon a random-generated-dungeon swarming with dangers and favors. Your greed won't punish you, perhaps sometimes would.

name: Top Billiards
short_description: A billiard game for one players

name: She Is My Sin
short_description: A retro-inspired 3D Action RPG set in an imaginary multidimensional world, served with a gripping sci-fi story.

name: Rog & Roll
short_description: Rog & Roll is a fast-paced, fluid 2.5D platformer from a new perspective. Control a tiny enemy monster named Rog on a quest to save his fellow minions! Rocket through levels using Rog's roll ability, or hunt for secrets and unlock hidden paths!

name: Tower of Origin/起源之塔~地底的欲望探险之旅~
short_description: 很久之后，地表已不适合生存，人类被迫转入地下。 却惊扰了原本居住在地下的炎魔一族 经过漫长的战争，人类驱逐了炎魔。并建立了名为“塔”的地下空间。 时间有过了数百年，炎魔一族渐渐恢复了元气，并且派遣一个名为红叶的女间谍。 希望找到人类的破绽，夺回地下空间。 你将扮演红叶，开启一段充满欲望的扭曲的地下之旅。

name: DumbLab
short_description: DumbLab is an engaging virtual reality game that blends physics-based mechanics with challenging puzzles. The game’s standout feature is the versatility in character control, allowing players to switch between characters on the fly and utilize them in unique ways to solve intricate puzzles

name: Soul Device
short_description: Soul Device is a 2D platformer shooter with features of the roguelike genre. On your way you will encounter various items that will strengthen you, equipment that will give you new abilities, and several weapons that will be responsible for your attacks.

name: BLOOD RITE
short_description: A gruesome human resources game. Mine gems to spawn new minions. Sacrifice these minions to keep ahead of the fire. Then use their blood for special powers like shields, power-ups, and daggers to defeat incoming foes. Towers will turn minions into archers, electrocutioners or human crossbow bolts.

name: Kill It With Fire: HEATWAVE
short_description: Kill It With Fire: Heatwave is a free chapter of a first-person action game about hunting spiders and causing collateral damage. The full game is OUT NOW!

name: Try to Survive!
short_description: Try to Survive! - is an endless game where the player have to survive and kill creatures that want to kill him. At the same time, improving skills will affect the style of his game. The goal is to survive as long as possible and reach the best score.

name: Shine's Adventures 0 (Zombies Reload)
short_description: Shine woke up in an unfamiliar place, and she found many horrible zombies around. In order to survive, Shine needs to explore this unfamiliar place. She needs to collect weapons, medicines, items and so on.Everything is to survive.

name: LuPR: Lunar Post Recruit
short_description: Dive into chaotic combat in this fast-paced party FPS for 1–4 players! Battle with or against AI bots across six retro-inspired game modes. Snipe, set traps, launch black holes, and fight for your faction in explosive split-screen action—no DLC, just pure couch mayhem!

name: Cellular Harvest
short_description: A lo-fi game about photographing aliens so that your employers can turn them into toothpaste. Explore. Photograph. Catalog. Harvest.

name: 炼器师
short_description: "Smelter" is a simulated game. There are nine levels of refiners in the game: Apprentice, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced, Master, Grandmaster, Excellent, Horcrux, and Artifact. Exercise yourrefining ability and gradually become a magic refining master,who isadmired by the world.

name: Dungeon Limbus
short_description: Explore the dungeon by growth of villages and weapons through repeated deaths. This game is a game that combines turn-based rogue-like and deck building.

name: The Good Chicken
short_description: Chickens fighting chickens, in 2D! Chicken based PvP platform combat.

name: Dyson Sphere Program
short_description: Build the most efficient intergalactic factory in space simulation strategy game Dyson Sphere Program! Harness the power of stars, collect resources, plan and design production lines and develop your interstellar factory from a small space workshop to a galaxy-wide industrial empire.

name: Explore Girl · Rope Sprite
short_description: A control bondage of the heroine fighting, stealth, adventure game.

name: MiLE HiGH TAXi
short_description: Crazy Taxi meets The Fifth Element! Deliver passengers, dodge mile-high skyscrapers & pedestrians. Beat the clock. FREE Race Mode DLC Coming August 18th 2023!

name: RESONARK X
short_description: RESONARK X is an unprecedented rhythm game that offers a different way to play on the desktop and in VR. In desktop mode, players use 7 lanes + alpha and corresponding keyboard keys. In VR mode, you use a two-handed hand controller to clap your hands and manipulate six strings as you play.

name: Fox Simulator
short_description: A simple and casual fox game, you will grow from a 1-year-old little fox to a 14-year-old big fox. You can catch small animals, fight with other animals, upgrade your abilities according to your preferences, find a spouse and mating.

name: COLD DEPTH
short_description: COLD DEPTH is a first-person exploration survival horror game set on the "Oasis" underwater complex. Whether you survive or not depends on finding, recycling and 3D printing items and supplying energy to the right parts of the stations.

name: San Diablos
short_description: Horror-themed First-Person Time-Trial shooter in a modern setting.

name: Quintus and the Absent Truth
short_description: Quintus and the Absent Truth is a Horror-Adventure game featuring a Man and his Mouse. A story-rich game with a unique art style, fun puzzles and an adorable little companion, your new best friend, Quintus.

name: Memory Battle
short_description: Memory match card game with more than 200 hand drawn cards, local multiplayer and unique Battle mode.

name: Vidiot Game
short_description: WARNING: VIDIOT GAME MAY CAUSE BRAIN DAMAGE. PLAY AT YOUR OWN DEMISE.

name: Airline Technician
short_description: Airline Technician is a game about the important job of Airport Line Technicians. Their responsibilities include coordinating ramp operations and aircraft movement via radio, fueling, towing aircraft, operating ground support equipment, reporting malfunctions and keeping the airport operational.

name: Magic Chess Online
short_description: Take advantage of the Magic Chess Online experience and enjoy stunning graphics. Well-known and animated environments, ranked modes, annual championships, and much more! The most complete and modern chess game ever created!

name: The Last Wulin
short_description: Playing as a master and taking over a wulin-family in the end of the Ming Dynasty. You can: Build your family; Acquired the Wuxue-Arts; Recruit disciples; Make different choices in different events; Improve the master's skills after each game time;

name: Pecaminosa
short_description: Activate your detective skills in this noir-influenced police action RPG. Grab your gun and prepare to face the strangest case of John Souza's career by helping the ghost of a dead mobster get "justice". Hit the streets in search of intel, befriend the scum and beat those who will try to stop you.

name: Crosshair X
short_description: Overlay custom crosshairs on every game you play. Choose from thousands of unique crosshairs created by the Crosshair X community or design your own using the designer.

name: AccrO
short_description: AccrO is a Full Acrobatic Quadcopter Simulator, with realistic flight behavior and complex physics simulation. A training tool for freestyle drone enthusiasts.

name: Quiz Pro - Guess Pictures
short_description: This quiz game is a great choice when you want to learn something, when you feel boring, or when you want to kill some free time. Can you find the words for every picture? Train your brain and learn new words by solving guessing the pics.

name: Jected - Rivals
short_description: Dive right into the crazy mix of extreme sports, vehicular destruction and break-neck speeds in a winner-takes-all elimination tournament between 18 players. Master the unique ejection mechanic allowing you to take to the skies to leave your rivals in the rear-view!

name: Rainbow Laser Disco Dungeon
short_description: It is the year 2084. Earth is ruled by evil robots. All music has been outlawed. Dancing is strictly forbidden. Still, in the underground, the beat goes on. Rainbow Laser Disco Dungeon: Half twin stick shooter, half rhythm game, half dungeon crawler. 150% groovy!

name: Time Gap Puppies
short_description: A bullet hell shooting game that you can go back in time and use time lapse to always be successful, go back in time whenever you want and show all your skills.

name: Driver4VR
short_description: Driver4VR is a versatile virtual reality solution that provides many useful VR features. You can use it for body tracking, head & hand tracking, controller emulation, utilities, and alternative VR configurations.

name: Saturday Morning Sandbox
short_description: Open world physics-based adventures with a side of arcade-like chaos. This is the casual sandbox game you've been looking for! Set in a lively small town. Find ramps to drive off of for stunt cams, photograph and share weird situations, complete side missions, and find collectibles.

name: Community College Hero: All Things End
short_description: The thrilling conclusion to your heroic journey! The Manipulator has destroyed the Speck campus, forcing you and your friends to flee the only home you’ve known. Can you survive the challenges of a new school while preparing for the ultimate showdown against the world’s most powerful villains?

name: Kingdom of Wreck Business
short_description: The depths of the Atlantic hide more than 12,000 sunken ships out of which at least half haven’t been located yet. As a depth explorer you will earn money from extracting valuable cargo from wrecks, grow your company, buy exploration vessels and real estate.

name: Becloudead
short_description: Becloudead is a horror story driven, hack and slash cinematic platformer, set in a post-apocalyptic world plagued by a zombie virus. Featuring close combat fighting with a unique time based modular combo system, puzzle solving, nerve-racking boss fights and more...

name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
short_description: This is a free-to-play team battle action game based on the "Mobile Suit Gundam" series of the Universal Century. Whether by land or by space, lay waste to your foes using either your favorite Mobile Suit or roam the battlefield as infantry and capture important objectives.

name: I'm Oh, So Busy...: A Week with Yoshimi
short_description: A dark comedy/drama slice-of-life kinetic visual novel that follows the life and times of a girl starting the next chapter of her life.

name: Child of Abyss
short_description: Child of Abyss is a 2D rougelike strategy card game where you play as the child who is trying bring its beloved dog back from the dead.

name: FoxVoltex
short_description: The stage is a robot town where everything is mechanically driven A sudden lightning strike in this peaceful town! The function of the town is down, and the security robot loses control and runs away In an instant I was caught in a vortex of confusion.

name: Wetlands
short_description: Beautifully animated with a mix of 3D and hand-drawn elements, this atmospheric sci-fi shooter features fast gameplay and a gritty story rich with sci-fi, film noir and cyberpunk overtones.

name: Planet's Edge
short_description: Travel between dozens of stars, harvest resources to repair and upgrade your equipment, meet and negotiate with friendly (and hostile) aliens, and do whatever it takes to stay alive and bring Earth back in this groundbreaking sci-fi RPG.

name: Allied Ambush
short_description: Defend your city from the onslaught of the dark army. A game of skill and strategy. Deploy machine gunners, snipers and towers. move your men into towers to increase their shooting range. Three challenging levels to conquer.

name: Wild Gun
short_description: You are the sheriff. Robbers roam the village and pillage. Your mission is to catch robbers and bounties. Fight them to protect your town.

name: Neon Cyborg Cat Club
short_description: A relaxing and peaceful experience set in a post-apocalyptic future where only mechanical cats remain.

name: Blue Pill Glitch
short_description: Enter the simulation with friends to locate Meow & get to the bottom of the Blue Pill Glitch!

name: Arabel
short_description: 3D adventure game telling the story of a lost knight, searching her way out of the strange and twisted lands of the Abyss. Safe journey to you !

name: BATTLESCAR: Punk Was Invented By Girls
short_description: Are you punk enough? Battlescar is a coming of age immersive film narrated by Rosario Dawson that takes place in a 1970's New York City. Join Lupe and Debbie, two runaways who's adventures in starting a punk rock band take them to places they never expected.

name: Blade Assault
short_description: Blade Assault is a 2D action rogue-lite platformer with beautiful pixel art set in a desolate sci-fi world. Fight against the corrupt military of Esperanza as part of the resistance force of the Undercity. Bring the corrupt to justice by becoming stronger and fighting alongside your trusty comrades.

name: Close Combat: Cross of Iron
short_description: In Close Combat: Cross of Iron you start off as a junior officer leading your men into battle in real-time, focusing on the Eastern Front of World War II. Earn promotions as you deal with an unforgiving enemy. Fight and survive through the frozen winter, hot dusty summer and muddy autumn.

name: Close Combat: Modern Tactics
short_description: Close Combat is a pausable real-time wargame series, heavily focused on historical accuracy and realistic soldier psychological profiles. Close Combat - Modern Tactics was originally released in 2007, and re-released on Steam in 2021.

name: POLYGON: Life
short_description: POLYGON: Life is a video game in which you will have to earn a living doing work to pay your bills, but working is not everything, there is a lot to see in this world from here to the future.

name: Destructive Behavior
short_description: Brick breaker arcade action with unique features

name: The Cost of Recovery
short_description: What would you do if someone close to you suddenly went through major trauma? What sacrifices would you be willing to make to keep your family together? Experience the different perspectives and emotional journeys of four protagonists when their worlds are suddenly turned upside-down.

name: She Salutes
short_description: Turn-based combat, fast-paced, tactical RPG in a post-apocalyptic environment with NSFW elements.

name: One Line Coloring
short_description: A vibrant world of colorful shapes awaits! Connect the dots to uncover charming objects in this colorful take on a classic paper puzzle game. Complete lively dioramas and relax yourself in the pastel world of One Line Coloring.

name: Furry Woof and Nya
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Perseverance: Part 2
short_description: 🔪 Perseverance: Part 2 is a 2nd installment in the horror/crime thriller visual novel series. Play as Karen, a calculated assassin on the prowl for her next target, and witness the gripping story of secrets, passion, and violence. 🔪

name: a completely normal dating simulation that is definitely completely sweet, innnocent and normal: SOMETHINGETH ANIVERSARY EDITION
short_description: a fun dating sim where you get to date stick figures! but... is that all it is? i doubt it. why don't you find out? find out just how much more there is in this game than simply a fun dating sim where you get to date stick figures? spoiler: there is also a baguette

name: Fake Illusions
short_description: Uncover cheating optical illusions, with your brain and eyes deceiving you at every opportunity... Experience these popular eyetwisters interactively like you've never seen before! This minimalist, but surreal game will make you question all senses you have.

name: Rekt: Crash Test
short_description: A high-octane, stunt, arcade game with an addictive combo and trick-based gameplay set in a retro arena. Get behind the wheel - jump, drift, stunt, and compete with others on the way on top the global leaderboard. It’s time to GET REKT!

name: Kingdom Rush Vengeance - Tower Defense
short_description: It's payback time! Lead your mighty dark army and make the Kingdom tremble with every step. Build powerful towers, choose your arsenal for destruction, and find the deadliest combination - train legendary heroes and lead them to victory!

name: GiseiHero
short_description: Among the 18 people who have a heart of justice, there is an evil that seeks murder. It is a mysterious and malicious death game of justice ADV. This is a free game made by an individual. Please note that this is an unfinished work.

name: Tormented Souls
short_description: Classic survival horror is back! Inspired by the original Resident Evil and Alone in the Dark series, Tormented Souls modernises with a fresh twist on the fixed perspective adventure - as Caroline Walker investigates the mysterious disappearance of twin girls in a terrifying mansion-turned-hospital.

name: Domestic Defense
short_description: Home invasion horror game. Manually set up security cameras to try to locate and eliminate the threat from your household. Deal with distractions from others, and work to stop the intruder before it is too late. Not too serious. More of a fun, gameplay oriented experience.

name: Charge!
short_description: Charge is a level-based puzzle game where you control the flow of charge around a circuit board. Arrange pre-built components into wondrous machines that take advantage of available resources and design your own modules from scratch.

name: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing
short_description: In Tony Stewart’s All-American Racing, it’s always a Saturday night at the local short track! With three different styles of racing to choose from and a variety of tracks, it’s sure to be a good time for all!

name: Dixotomia
short_description: Dixotomia is a VR shooter in a world of a sci-fi dystopia. Become a SpecOps contractor, fight vampire cult and its vile bosses. Experience immersive action with brutal guns and vampiric abilities. Can you uncover dark secrets of a distant planet and return back unchanged?

name: General War Memories
short_description: "General War Memories" is a 2.5D style MMO. It allows players to be involved in the endless battle of World War II and allows players to truly feel the scene of World War II.

name: PLUGGED
short_description: The year is 3397. The prison systems have been long abolished. Convicts' bodies are destroyed, their consciousness plugged into the mainframe to compete in eternal gladiatorial combat. Run, fly, and shoot your way to victory through the mainframe. Get plugged, and enter the arena...

name: AOD: Art Of Defense
short_description: AOD is a new gameplay in the traditional tower defence genre. You must protect your base from waves of approaching enemies. Build and improve your towers and units and destroy your enemies in any way you can. Don't be weak, destroy them all, show who's in charge!

name: Flying propeller
short_description: You need to shoot back from hostile aircraft, including fighters, flying mines, helicopters

name: Baby Coyote
short_description: The Arts And Craft Islands Awaits for your arrival, Join Coyote and General Warthog on a tropical Platforming Adventure across this creative archipelago, to save The Craft Kingdom from the Evil Captain Fat Cat.

name: Damned Hand
short_description: You're in the home of a psychopathic art lover. and that isn't happy about this situation.He'll scare you. You have to be careful!

name: Critterland
short_description: Critterland is a fast-paced 2D real-time strategy (RTS) game that pits you against the forces of nature. Solve puzzles in the campaign, discovering synergies between species while enjoying the atmospheric OST. Alternatively, conduct your own ecological research in sandbox mode.

name: Chronomancer
short_description: Engage in a tactical, grid-based fantasy card game! Summon powerful cards using mana, position units to trigger linking abilities, and disrupt your opponent's strategy with unique player powers. Outsmart rivals in this turn-based battle, where every move and formation brings you closer to victory!

name: Aeloren Tactics

name: 百詰怪軼與金魚
