name: CLT
short_description: Explore a sexual tarot deck and lose yourself in its labyrinthian meanings.

name: Controller King
short_description: Battle to be crowned the "Controller King" while you traverse through a kaleidoscope of vivid, mind-altering visuals while being ensnared by an auditory tapestry that will throb in your veins and ignite your soul

name: B-17 Squadron
short_description: Take control of a B-17 in a realistic bomber simulator. Destroy key targets by dropping tons of bombs on them. Command each member of the crew and feel their stress and tension. Take part in the historical campaign across occupied Europe.

name: Z-Blood Mission
short_description: A slasher game with elements of horror and survival. 3D action with old school side camera view.

name: Corona Samurai
short_description: This is your chance to get personal revenge on the infamous virus. It's coming for your village in untold numbers, but with just your swords and shurikens, you'll show the world how it's really done.

name: The Mermaid of Zennor
short_description: A short, dark visual novel set in the UK about a young autistic girl's destructive obsession with her older brother.

name: Slime Sprint
short_description: Sprint through lava ridden dungeons and attempt to achieve the best time possible in this arcade style 2D platformer. With 30 levels to play and many slimes to unlock, can you achieve the medals needed to become the slime sprint king?

name: The Sisters - Party of the Year
short_description: Let’s get into mischief! Join Maureen, Wendy and all their friends in this new video game adventure! Challenge your friends in crazy mini-games and explore the Sisters' city.

name: Winter Sleigh
short_description: It is the weekend and Timmy with his sister and dad are having fun in the snowy hills. Pick your sleigh and join them! There are many tracks to try, some easier, some more challenging. Can you complete them all?

name: The Smurfs - Mission Vileaf
short_description: Go on an adventure to save your forest! Gargamel, the evil sorcerer just created the VILEAF, a plant that has the ability to attract and capture the Smurfs... but it's also TOXIC! Embody 4 iconic Smurfs and heal the plants on your way to Gargamel's hovel: the whole forest depends on you!

name: Story of a tiny earth, the symbolic ages
short_description: Deliciously retro ! Spherical and labyrinthine levels full of traps and mysteries, with actions, puzzles and strategies. Find your own way, escaping malicious opponents and defending biodiversity !

name: Alien X
short_description: Alien X - is a hardcore game where you will have to survive playing like a monster Bomber who is on an unknown planet.

name: Darkest Hour
short_description: In Darkest Hour, you find yourself in an alumni meeting of your class at your old school gym. However, after an unexpected blackout, you are stuck at school and will try to face the adversities you encounter and the haunt that surrounds the school. Will you be able to escape?

name: Security Guy vs AI: The Dawn of AI
short_description: Security guy vs AI is a short top-down shooter game with a mysterious story. Reveal the truth about what happened at your workplace and stop the Evil Artificial Intelligence from spreading out.

name: Neon Parkour
short_description: In Neon Parkour, where you control a blue cube, make challenging tracks and reach to the other blue cube! Be careful, this game is really difficult.

name: Untrusted
short_description: Untrusted is an online multiplayer (10 to 16 players) hacking / social deduction game: as an hacker, hack your target - as an undercover agent, disrupt the operation. Follow your objective or kill everyone - the choice is yours.

name: Crazy Party
short_description: The rules are simple! 2 teams with the same number of players the rule of the game is to kill each other and ambush the other team your team must have the most players compared to the other to win at the end of the time limit.

name: Dobo's Heroes
short_description: Dobo’s Heroes is a puzzle platform game, where you need to help Dobo leave the depths of his world. For that to happen, use his grandchildren’s powers to get to the portal of each mission.

name: Agent Intercept

name: Street Football

name: My Familiar
short_description: MY FAMILIAR! A turn-based, buddy-cop Isekai RPG

name: Dungeon Delver
short_description: Test your mettle by fighting your way through waves of increasingly difficult enemies. Cast spells, earn loot, and upgrade your character to see how far into the dungeon can you delve.

name: Re;Lord 2 ~The witch of Cologne and black cat~
short_description: Wilfried and his allies return in the second installment of the Re;Lord trilogy! With the district of Herfort liberated, Wilfried turns his attention to Cologne, controlled by the Witch of Ruin, Iris. Aid Wilfried and his allies in liberating Cologne and all of Groessen in this strip battle RPG!

name: Gun Witch
short_description: Help Beretta become the best witch ever in this 2D action platformer shoot 'em up! She's going on an adventure to beat up monsters, talk to cute NPCs, and discover the dark history of Luninsula all while making lifelong friends.

name: Escape Machine City: Airborne
short_description: It has been two days since the once vibrant Air City went completely silent and now it seems to be flying on its own

name: Whiskey Bravo
short_description: A sci-fi strategy board game, where nerdy dice rolls determine the outcome of battle. Command your Spider Cannon and zany troops in a turn-based tactics game that plays like a cross between Advance Wars and Warhammer.

name: Probably Tuesday
short_description: The story of Probably Tuesday focuses on detective called Robert Lovell going around yet another typical tuesday (probably). Then suddenly he gets contacted by femme fatale called Anne Gony. So Robert takes his pistol maria and our suspenseful story begins.. Where will this journey take Robert?

name: DNA: Episode 1
short_description: DNA 1 a hand drawn episodic game with anime story in each stage episode, created by only 1 Solo Developer. Play as Leo, a genetically modified with Extraterrestrial life Elite Nova Corp Troop, as he chooses to break free from being a Nova Corp pawn. Thus begins the epic universe story of DNA!

name: Prison  X - Chapter 1: The Devil and The Sun
short_description: Heavy doors open and you're swept into the surreal world of Prison X, an infamous Bolivian jail in the Neo-Andean underworld. As you navigate amongst devils, saints, wicked characters, corrupt prison guards and even a Western filmmaker; hold onto your soul so La Diabla doesn't snatch it away.

name: The Nightmare Begins
short_description: The Nightmare Begins puts players in the role of two detectives searching for missing family members in a terrifying dream realm. They explore eerie landscapes, solve puzzles, and face supernatural threats, uncovering dark family secrets as they fight to escape this relentless nightmare

name: Jack Axe: The Trial

name: Quarantine: Global Pandemic
short_description: In Quarantine, you make the pandemic policies and funding priorities for your country as the head of the Health and Human Services Department. You will have to save your country from this global pandemic, while trying to keep the public and government officials happy...

name: Joe Kowalski Chronicles: Murder in a flat
short_description: Joe Kowalski Chronicles: Murder in a flat is a dark neo noir point and click adventure game where you start as a police detective Joe Kowalski and try to solve a murder that happened in Joe's neighborhood.

name: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book DX
short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Sophie" is the 1st instalment: a chance encounter between Sophie and a sentient book Plachta takes them on an adventure to recover Plachta's memories.

name: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey DX
short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Firis" is the 2nd instalment: after Firis encounters alchemy and is able to leave town, she is taken on a magical journey that has no limits.

name: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings DX
short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Lydie & Suelle" is the 3rd instalment: after discovering a mysterious painting, Lydie & Suelle get closer to their dream of running the best atelier.

name: The Chaos Gene
short_description: The Chaos Gene is a Indie casual fighting game. Inspired by some of the classic fighting games I grew up playing in the arcades.

name: Purplis Sandbox
short_description: Create your own worlds, build interesting mechanisms and just beautiful buildings, everything depends on your imagination.

name: ダリアの惑溺～団地妻・亜希子が堕ちる事情～
short_description: ――口説けない女はいない。 そう豪語する新入社員の快斗に一枚の女性の写真を見せて提案する。 ――この女のいやらしい姿が見たい。 それは自分の妻、亜希子の写真だった‥‥

name: Don't Be A Baby!
short_description: Embark on a whimsical run-and-gun adventure with “Don’t Be A Baby!” Dash, skate, and fly through animated cutscenes, break the 4th wall, and groove to a fantastic soundtrack.

name: Liegecraft
short_description: You are the King. Lead your vassals, build your feudal realm and conquer foreign kingdoms in this blend of turn based 4X and realtime rpg. Attend feasts, host tourneys and fight duels. Every character has their own mind so promote the loyal, scheme against rivals and imprison the disobedient.

name: Elementite
short_description: Elementite is a third-person shooter RPG that fuses natural elements and futuristic firearms in a vast chaotic open world of challenges and secrets in a way never seen before.

name: Brickmasters

name: Muslim 3D
short_description: Muslim 3D is an educational simulation. Begin your journey in virtual Makkah. Visit the Holy Mosque, explore the Virtual Museum or go back in time to relive a historic moment.

name: PePiBo: Peregrino Pinata Bowling
short_description: The ancient evil Lava Dragon has awakened the Volcano of Maconda! It is time for you, young Peregrino, to save the island by challenging the Dragon to... a Piñata Bowling duel! Use your bowling skills and ingenuity to clear surprising piñata bowling puzzles!

name: Octarina
short_description: Use the sticky abilities of an octopus to jump, climb and cause mayhem in the sushi factory. Discover your way to regain freedom!

name: Cyberpunch
short_description: Cyberpunch is a post apocalyptic beat em up game.

name: Francisca 2
short_description: Francisca 2 – a first-person indie horror game. Every day you’ll have to survive in your own house. At the start of each level, you need to place video cameras inside the house and in the yard and conceal yourself as well as you can, because a ghost girl is going to visit you soon.

name: Drunk Soccer is the Best Soccer
short_description: Drunk Soccer is the Best Soccer– a third-person soccer simulator. The main feature of this game is that all the players on the pitch are drunk as skunks.

name: Temporal Purge: Z
short_description: Become an interdimensional zombie slayer in Temporal Purge: Z, an action-packed zombie-survival FPS. Face the zombie onslaught as you eradicate countless undead monsters on your quest to save the future.

name: Children's Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: This puzzle game helps your kids develop matching and fine motor skills. Your children will just love these wonderfully hand-drawn pictures and will improve their spatial skills while having fun!

name: Groov
short_description: Groov is a frenetic dual-stick shooter that makes you the conductor of an intergalactic jazz fusion orchestra. Every action in Groov has a musical reaction, and with three unique modes, randomized music, and powerups that slow down the song (and your enemies), no two playthroughs are ever alike!

name: DreamScapes Dimensions
short_description: A free to play, medieval fantasy, MMORPG. Pre-Alpha | Solo Indie | Versatile Character Creation | Tutorial Quests | Harvesting and Crafting | Skills and Spells | Player Building | Procedurally Generated Random Adventures | Daily Gifts

short_description: "Lacuna/Draft" (ラクナドラフト) は敵を避けながら素早く駆け抜ける緊張・爽快横スクアクションゲームです。

name: Paradigm Shift
short_description: A group of young adults, gifted with elemental powers by the anomaly, are forced to go to battle with these unknown forces. Sooner than later, they come to find out that they're a lot more connected to the unfolding chaos than it seems...

name: FarmZone
short_description: The goal in FarmZone is to survive and protect your farm. You are just a farmer in the world full of zombies. You have to fight them to protect yourself and your farm. Travel the open world, explore new towns and grow your farm.

name: Minit Fun Racer
short_description: Buckle up: Minit Fun Racer is a peculiar little racing game with 100% of developer and Devolver's profits going directly to charity. Forever.

name: Epic City Builder 4
short_description: In Epic City Builder 4 you build a whole nation across multiple maps. Pass laws at the national level. Fiddle with the budgets at the city level. Manage your taxes and spending well and later you could be laying out whole cities at once.

name: Range is HOT!
short_description: Learn to shooooot! Speed through courses with guns blazing. Learn target placements, increase your accuracy, and get the lowest time. Climb to the top of the leaderboards to be the king (or queen) of the range.

name: Arm of Revenge Re-Edition
short_description: "Arm of Revenge" A arcade style platform action game, get more experience, learn new skills, upgrade equipment, Touching story, smooth moves, more than 30 skills to combo, 3 types of arm to change, survival mode...and more!, quickly with the hand of revenge kill all enemies.Enjoy it!

name: [Chilla's Art] The Caregiver | 終焉介護
short_description: The Caregiver | 終焉介護 is a psychological Japanese horror adventure game about a caregiver.

name: Rules of Alchemy
short_description: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

name: Inglorious Aztecs
short_description: Inglorious Aztecs is a 2-4 player online multiplayer game centered around fast-paced versus matches with a high fun factor. Mine the terrain with your Pickaxe, Block incoming bullets with blocks placement, and kill your friends in a plethora of ways!

name: Nordicandia
short_description: A semi-idle action RPG with a deep and unique crafting system. Collect epic loot, craft and merge items, and level up your character to beat the World Bosses!

name: Ballfrog
short_description: BallFrog is a challenging ball rolling platformer with experimental controls! Use your Tongue to grapple and swing.

name: 中年失业模拟器When a man lose his job

name: The Alpha 001
short_description: Role-playing simulation of robots in the Middle Ages, the population of which has become extinct.

name: TeamPlay
short_description: TeamPlay is a game where you can achieve maximum team chemistry. Play with friends against each other on the same device or create a team to play cross-network matches. Your team can consist not only of living people, but also of trained artificial intelligence.

name: Tomorrow
short_description: Rescue your bunny from the hands of the artist known as Jaye!

name: Negative: The Way of Shinobi
short_description: 2D action platformer game with ninjas. Stylized graphics and a narrative-driven story will emphasize the gameplay. For those who see themselves as hard core players. This game will make you fail... a lot. Will you accept the challenge?

name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 4
short_description: Hentai puzzle with elements of RPG and meaningful dialogue choices. Flirt with all the Neko girls!

name: Hover Ship
short_description: Hover Ship is an arcade game in which you have to control a floating ship on an obstacle course, collect coins and set new records.

name: JAB!
short_description: Stab, shoot or blow up your friends. JAB! is the physics-based party game where you collect silly bobbleheads and fight with guns and lightning bolts and stuff.

name: Ascendum
short_description: Help 2 twin vessels on their journey through the afterlife! Overcome platforming and mind-bending puzzle challenges, and defeat scary enemies and bosses while controlling both characters at the same time or working together with another player in local Co-op.

short_description: Playground VR It is an open-world game where you can experience the beautiful essence of VR. Do you want to fly a balloon? Fly! Are you not afraid of being fired from cannon? Launch yourself! Do you want to take to the sea waves? Swim! Do you want to climb the building? Free way! Yes, you can do it

name: Grandiose
short_description: Grandiose is a calming and creative base builder game full of botany, building and strategy. Land on the island that will become your domain in a universe soon to be borrowed from the ingenious and creative abilities of your mind.

short_description: Hello Guest, beloved Hello Neighbor 2 pre-alpha, a stealth horror thriller with an advanced, self-learning AI. You take the night shift as a security guard at an abandoned Golden Apple Amusement Park where a creature is hiding in the shadows. What can go wrong?

name: Ink Shapes: Book One
short_description: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

name: The Penguin IQ Test
short_description: Can you save the penguin? Help him get back to the ice floe. This game will pretend to measure your intelligence quotient and give you a result between zero and one hundred eighty.

name: Skyratz
short_description: Take to the air as one of six unique heroes and soar through Avion City as you perform tricky maneuvers, hunt for weapons and armor, and battle in the skies to claim your spot on the pecking order!

name: Paper Planet
short_description: Paper Planet is a planet-defender, arcade roguelike with a doodley, Flash-inspired artstyle. Battle through waves of unique enemies and bosses. Combine items with strange and wacky effects for insanely overpowered runs. Play with 1-4 players, for some chaotic co-op fun!

name: My Last Memories About You
short_description: My Last Memories About You is about a husband who is fulfilling the last wish of his late wife in this short first-person exploration game. The game is short, but in exchange delivers an emotional and heartwarming story, which stays with the player long after experiencing this adventure.

name: Azure Sky
short_description: Azure Sky is an action, puzzle and platform game. You need to take on the role of a young man, who will later gain power over his consciousness and learn to master magical abilities.

name: GOC Royale
short_description: GOC Royale is a competitive multiplayer card game that takes you to randomly generated islands to take part in battles to the death.

name: CrushBorgs

name: Anime Catgirl Runner
short_description: Anime Catgirl Runner is a 2D Endless Runner Game, where you take the role of a cute Catgirl!

name: Happy Day

name: Lost Assassin - A Tale of AI Corruption
short_description: 2D Side-Scrolling Action Shooter. The Assassin has a wide range of weapons, jetpack, mining, ragdoll physics. All original hand crafted artwork. Explore maze like levels with interactive elements and mine resources to buy and craft supplies.

name: Fruit Girls: Hentai Jigsaw Photo Studio
short_description: This is the perfect game for those who want to enjoy the famous and juicy Fruit Girls while playing with just one hand! Complete puzzles by choosing your challenge level and indulge yourself in the most delicious photo shoots you've ever seen. Unlock all Fruit Girls for a special surprise!

name: Through the Helios
short_description: Action adventure dungeon crawler where you sling spells and slay monsters, in a bid to retrieve a stolen relic.

name: bridg
short_description: Bridge walking simulator

short_description: Echo of Starsong is a visual novel style adventure game. Eda, a girl who can hear mysterious sound waves known as starsong, crosses paths with a young man in search of their source. Together, they venture out to the heart of space to unravel an ancient myth.

name: Cultivation Tales

name: VR Wonderland 2：Adventures in a Fruit Boat
short_description: In the game you will become a villain smaller than an orange, and then row a boat made of oranges, sailing on the sea.

name: Zero-G Revolution
short_description: A single player sci-fi Adventure game for VR device.

name: Arc Wizards 3
short_description: The war of the wizards begins! This is an exciting action game with a 16-bit taste!

name: VR Plane Crash
short_description: We will all be curious about some experiences. But we also hope that everyone will not encounter such experiences.For example, what does a plane crash look like? This game will let curious you have some VR experiences. Hope there will be no more plane crashes in the real world.

name: Find Yourself
short_description: Explore the truly frightening subway cars and find out what fears the main character will have to face.

name: 그랑 엠파이어
short_description: 강대국들과 이들에게 둘러싸인 인간의 왕국은 말하자면, 동아시아의 모에화와도 같습니다. 위기에 처한 인간의 왕국을 구원하고, 강대국의 지도자인 그녀들의 마음을 노리세요! 미연시적인 요소와 전략적인 요소를 경험하실 수 있도록 최선을 다했습니다.

name: Cloud Jumper
short_description: Jump into a grand sky-faring adventure as you help Olive find her way home after a fierce storm has pulled her into a wild and wonderful new world in the clouds.

name: Surprising My Neighbors 2
short_description: Surprising My Neighbors 2 – a first-person game where you will be leaving your surprises at the doors of your favorite neighbors. You moved to a new city a year ago. One morning, you went outside and found poop at your door again. It looks like someone of your new neighbors left it there.

name: Harpy Star
short_description: Follow Duri and Radi as a normal delivery takes an unexpected turn! Take flight in a world long after humanity, and work together with your best friend as you unravel long buried secrets, in this 2D story-driven Metroidvania!

name: Fractal Evolution

name: Sakura Mochi

This game has permadeath and relies on planning ahead so you can stay alive. Whether it be zombies, players, or AI, they are all out to get your blood.

name: Blockdown
short_description: Roll around on a wibbly wobbly grid through space. This peaceful puzzler is a 3D twist on a classic 2D game.

name: Roboggled Sokoban Game
short_description: Roboggled is a brain-twisting Sokoban puzzle game where you take control of a clever little robot on a mission to outsmart tricky environments and deliver crates to their precise drop zones.

name: Mothercore
short_description: A tower defense game with weird and wacky towers and enemies. Play in the two modes, Story mode and Arcade mode. And follow a weird story about an organization and last power source humans have.

name: 荣光的见证 Glory's Witness
short_description: "Glory's Witness" is a platform jump shooting game that supports attribute addition. You will play the AI intelligent robot that survived the last days, guided by the "God", and embark on an adventure to "witness the glory of human civilization".

name: Wind Wind
short_description: Wind Wind is a puzzle adventure game. Lead the souls to the top floor of the tower, avoiding robots and the black star which are in the way

name: Inkslinger
short_description: As an Inkslinger at Brassknee's renowned Wordshop, it's your job to write letters for the citizens of Isle Shammer. But through the veil of work lies forgotten trauma. A voice begins to speak to you in recurring daydreams, telling you about your tragic past in Nomania.

name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
short_description: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

name: Art Syndicate
short_description: Put your management skills to the test as an art gallery owner, exhibit the most brilliant paintings, create your own, and if you've already broken your moral compass try to snatch some precious artworks from your competition - "Exitus acta probat"!

name: Chicken Invaders Universe
short_description: A deliciously addictive core of finger-blistering shooting action, surrounded by delectable morsels of galactic exploration, spacecraft customization, and community competitions.

name: PRIM
short_description: PRIM is a creepy-but-cute point’n’click adventure game full of dark humor. When her mother dies, Prim finds out she’s Death’s daughter and now has to live with her father. But the Grim Reaper has strict rules and when Prim breaks them, things take a fatal turn. Can you breathe life into her misery?

name: Immune Simulator Type Z
short_description: In the game "Immune Simulator," the world is losing to zombies. The protagonist finds a computer with historical records of conflicts. Altering data changes the real-world balance, affecting her companions. Is it a divine salvation or devilish trap? Unravel the hidden secrets to find out.

name: Toy Tinker Simulator: Prologue
short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a toy tinker? Here you can take the first step to become one! This is a tiny portion of Toy Tinker Simulator, which includes only three toys.

name: Toy Tinker Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a toy tinker? This is a unique chance to become one! Repair toys and start your toy-museums to make everyone happy!

name: Buried Under Rocks
short_description: Would you choose the lie over the truth? Buried Under Rocks is an action and puzzling game with two different endings.

name: Anime Arena: Infinite War
short_description: Anime girl fights and survives on a deadly zombie arena!

name: Pocket Watch
short_description: A time-traveling adventure game on a tropical island. 🌴⛱️ Talk to animals, solve puzzles, and save the island from destruction . . .

name: Everybody Wham Wham
short_description: Compete to build the best snowman in a story-driven, winter adventure! Make friends at the festival, tune in to the Wham Wham Radio Station and uncover the hidden truth behind Wham Wham the Snowman-man. Can you build, decorate and sabotage your way to the festival grand prize?

name: ZADETTE
short_description: A great 2D retro-action-platformer! To the lovers of big pixels and screeching synthetic sounds we dedicate this masterpiece to you.

name: dev_hell
short_description: Join the tech industry and contribute to the downfall of society in this first-person roguelike deckbuilder.

name: Hajji Tours

name: Auto World Tycoon
short_description: Auto World Tycoon is a tycoon game based in real-time. Purchase Auto Dealerships new or used, exotics or motorcycles, commercial or brand name, the choice is yours. Start small with used cars, gas stations and car washes as you work your way towards owning giant Auto Malls.

name: The Virus
short_description: Play as a White Blood Cell whose home has been invaded by viruses. Your job is to protect the red blood cells by collecting them. Navigate through a variety of challenging levels, collecting all of the red blood cells and avoiding the viruses in hopes to rid your home of The Virus.

name: Hollow Ghost
short_description: Enjoy a nice lit and graphically processed environment in the fog, darkness, which looks like drawn horror environment.

name: The Great Plague Exodus
short_description: The Year is 1665 and the Great Plague has struck London. Guide your family through the darkest period of English history as you flee across the country. Navigate 100s of random events that challenge your ethics and your drive to survive.

name: Cartoon Magic world

name: Briddle
short_description: A wonderful riddle game, where you need to solve 25 riddles with just a few hints. Can you reach level 25? I will be waiting for you there. You will receive some hints for each riddle, and then, is up to you to find the right answer. The difficulty will grow each level, can you reach the end?

name: Guardians of Gridvale
short_description: Push enemies into water, cast fireballs on oil patches to create explosions and use the environment to your advantage in this tactical, turn based roguelike with timing mechanics, environmental effects and stupid jokes. Equip and level up your heroes and take control of the Guardians of Gridvale!

name: Out of Sight
short_description: Unwind while you play at your own pace exploring vibrant microcosms, in your search for hand-placed hidden objects, set to a chill lofi soundtrack.

name: Pilfered Liberty
short_description: Your crew aboard the Pilfered Liberty has been abducted by pirates! Shoot through hordes of aliens while avoiding traps and drops to rescue your crew in this action-packed 2D platformer. They’re relying on you, Captain. Can you save them all?

With six unique romance routes, erotic books to read and a special extra route, who will be the love bomb of your choice?

name: Great Paintings VR
short_description: Great Paintings from the Great Museums of the World in Virtual Reality. More than 1000 famous paintings to admire and enjoy.

name: Decabristov Street
short_description: Take a walk through one of the courtyards of the city of Moscow on Dekabristov Street. Four houses surrounding the yard, a skating rink in the middle, a few garages and solitude...

name: Laser Attraction

name: Super Toy Cars Offroad

name: Vector Race

name: Ragnarra: Might of Muskets

The Queen Ragnarra strives to defend the Capital and the last big city inhabited by people - The Asgardian Citadel.

name: Ann
short_description: Ann, an art student finds herself trapped in the school when she accidentally broke one of the school's rules. With the help of the school's security guard, help Ann navigate her way out and uncover the secrets of the school before she becomes a permanent resident of the school.

name: Dread Days

name: Legend Of Vengeancev
short_description: "Legend Of Vengeancev"is a horizontal version of the pixel story puzzle game, the game through the complex and full of suspense story, let the player like reading a complex and full of suspense detective novel, as long as 8 hours of game flow and 3 game endings, you will be very addictive ~

name: Grass Cutters Academy - Idle Game

short_description: The most complete motorcycle simulator that allows you to ride every type of motorbikes including ATVs, 3 Wheelers prototype and Sidecars. Challenge your online friends on TrackDayR and climb the leaderboards of players all over the world. TrackDayR, Trackday Everyday!

Build structures like Mines to generate resources to build ships and engage in fleet battles with NPCs and other players.

The bloody war started between the gangs of the city. However, a true enemy turned out not to be common gangsters, but men much scarier

short_description: Boot up your Z5 Powerlance and dial into Last Call BBS, the last game from Zachtronics! The Barkeep’s loaded up his retro computer with a full set of puzzle games for you to download and play. No need to worry about copy protection, they’re all fully cracked and ready to enjoy!

Customize your slime, play alone or with a friend, collect weapons and gear, battle challenging enemies and bosses, gain skills, and combine them to create your own abilities to suit your playstyle!

Cooperation, rather than conquest will save the day, so prepare to harvest, build, research, and explore the void in this wholesome turtleback builder.

Whether you're watching the snow gently fall, collecting resources, the world is yours to enjoy. Relax, breathe, and let the world embrace you.

Form player orgs, mine resources, & build fleets to back up your starfighters. Take a break & fly in friendly races or wargames, but beware an alien foe threatens all.

For each level there is a leaderboard with the fastest times. Difficult jumps, ice slides and wallrunns awaid you.

short_description: Save an magical village in this extraordinary Match-3 game! Use the ancient runes to cast magic and defeat the dark powers.

name: 夏日的回忆
short_description: 这是一款传统的AVG的文字游戏！讲述的是……青春……校园……您的选择会影响主人公命运，引领这他走若干不同的结局……没有暴力，也没有色情。这关于……爱……友情……亲情的故事！还有……疑惑……不解……和全体通过后的一丝丝的奇怪的感觉。

name: Karma - Chapter 1
short_description: Karma is here, and he will protect the innocent!

name: Escalation!
short_description: A visual novel with 3D model animation featuring BDSM (Bondage, Domination, Sadism, and Masochism).

name: Saghala: Heroes of the Last World
short_description: 2081. Earth, now known as Saghala, was destroyed by nuclear war and coronal mass ejections. Despite the devastation, humanity lingers on. Sixty years after the End, four factions vie for control of the Core, the last fusion reactor. Decide the fate of Saghala in a classic, top-down cRPG!

name: TWO MONTHS
short_description: Explore Mrozek Mansion, fight monsters and retrieve the components to assemble the perfect mobile device: the Pyra! Based on a true story.

name: Antimatter Elevator
short_description: Connect non-matching pieces to reach level 99.

name: Shutter Stroll
short_description: Take a break and relax! No rush – enjoy the journey and soak in the sights. Capture stunning photos across millions of unique islands in this tranquil walking simulator.

name: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm
short_description: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm is hex-based world building software that utilizes procedural generation to create highly detailed maps. Alternatively, import your own map and begin sculpting your world and writing your lore. Become a Master Keeper!

name: Plumber
short_description: Challenge yourself with plumbing problems. Each level have input and output water pipes. Your job as a plumber is to figure out how to arrange the given pipes in order to distribute the water properly and efficiently!

name: AudioTheory Piano Keys
short_description: The ultimate piano reference toolkit. View every note you play across a customisable set of interactive diagrams designed to enrich your understanding of music theory.

name: Phucker in the Ashes
short_description: The ultimate telling of the legendary Phucker Saga. Includes new content, improved graphics, features, characters, and surprises the likes of which have never been seen before.

name: Table Tennis Pro
short_description: The Ultimate Table Tennis (Ping-Pong) Simulator!

name: Safe Cracker
short_description: Test your reflexes and keep your mind sharp with this challenging and fun cyberpunk themed game about cracking safes... in space! Train to become better and better, and place higher on the leaderboards. Are you the fastest amongst your friends, on Steam, in the whole world? Prove it.

name: Transporter Manager Tycoon
short_description: In Transporter Manager Tycoon you will control your own carrier, you will manage freight, buy new trucks and even expand your carrier to a distributor. Start small, and with a lot of dedication and effort become one of the biggest carriers in the game.

name: FEEET
short_description: FEEET is a radical, indie take on the beloved pipe-puzzle and virtual novel genres.

name: Gun Bots
short_description: Customize your Gun Bots to fight through 7 unique worlds with different weather conditions that become more challenging as you progress.

name: Stalked
short_description: Sarah is returning home from work, She will face her worst nightmaress, strange things start to happen to her, will she escape alive or declared dead?

name: Fono
short_description: A puzzle platformer that abuses particle effects for its lidar-like game mechanics and its unique visual style.

name: Wizardry Squared
short_description: Wizardry Squared is a physics-based spell-crafting action RPG. You are a young wizard who must fight against the system for revenge and Wizardry Squared.

name: Elly
short_description: A metroidvania style 2D adventure platformer. Speak to the locals, level up your power and seek to find the truth.

name: Pond Scum
short_description: Life is about sacrifices....Well in this case it's about eating, shooting, killing, reproducing and then deciding when to sacrifice your offspring. Pond Scum is a Top-down shooter survival game. You must Eat, shoot and move your eggs to safety, or alternatively sacrifice them....

name: Crystal sword
short_description: Fantasy dot-eating-action

name: Warriors Of Titus - F2P
short_description: Warriors of Titus is a first-person MOBA (Mutliplayer Online Battle Arena)for VR. Finally you can be immersed in a MOBA as you battle to reclaim Titus.

name: Strange Nightmares
short_description: You wake up to a mysterious voice in the darkness, and enter a world of unknowns, a room full of darkness and doorways that lead to familiar, yet twisted and foreign places. Armed only with your mind, a flashlight, and a mysterious voice in your head, you must survive and search for a way to escape.

name: The Unbreakable Chain
short_description: We've been doing this since 580,000 BC.

name: Textreme 2
short_description: A fully functional text editor topped with lots of juicy animations and effects that exaggerate your every action.

name: Red Galaxy
short_description: This is a retro space shooting game, where you only fight against the strongest enemy. There are 15 unique bosses in the game, and players need to use different weapons and strategies to defeat them. Dedicated to you who are both challengers and retro game lovers.

name: Gaia Project
short_description: Gaia Project is the digital adaptation of the boardgame Gaia Project created by Helge Ostertag and Jens Drögemüller and published by "Feuerland Verlag". It is a 1-4 player strategy game. It plays in the same universe as Terra Mystica and continues the adventure in the far future.

name: ATC Infinite
short_description: In ATC Infinite you can play different airports where you need to manage and control departing and arrival aircraft.

name: Red Mist: Rivers of Blood
short_description: You play a traumatized former Special Forces war veteran who sees red when his wife is abducted. In your pursuit of revenge, you must negotiate a dangerous urban environment. Avoid hazards and deadly drops as you shoot, kick and slash through hordes of enemies in this grueling and gritty platformer.

name: CompactO - Idle Game
short_description: CompactO is an addicting idle game where you create colorful squares on a plane. Dominate the 3D Realm and infuse your planes into complex shapes to buy tons of upgrades!

name: Super Retro World
short_description: Super Retro World is a 2D platformer which is based on the idea of classic platform handheld console games like Super Mario Land.

name: Vectors
short_description: Avoid obstacles and reach the end of each level by controlling the direction of Vectors. Can you manage your actions without going off the tangent?

name: Ministry of Pandemic
short_description: Ministry of Pandemic is a strategy and simulation game that forces social and economic balance during the pandemic. Formulate your strategy for survival while keeping all aspects of society steady.

name: Unknown Woods
short_description: A brutal horror action FPS where you will be fighting for survival against creatures of the woods and finding out the mysteries that lie around in the dark forest

name: HyperShot
short_description: The more enemies you shoot, the more enemies spawn! 300 levels. 15 boss battles. Over 20 enemy types.

name: RC Airplane Challenge
short_description: Fly model airplanes in RC Airplane Challenge in this arcade styled flight sim. Fly by yourself offline or with up to 32 other players in online gameplay.

name: De'Vine: Heavenly Acres
short_description: Welcome to your farm on Heavenly Acres! Farmland that presents many opportunities. Harvest trees & plants. Grow Crops. Romance with other misfits. Collect up to 200 unique monsters and compete with monster battles! Indulge in the underground for buried treasure and dangerous monsters!

name: Zombie Groove
short_description: A bit different game that challenges you with a sense of rhythm. Focus on the groove of the music. Then you'll enjoy the upbeat rhythm you've never experienced before.

name: Alien Marauder
short_description: “Alien Marauder” is a real-time strategy game with survival and confrontation theme. In this game, you will be the leader to a treacherous alien planet, build and defend base to survive against the vexan waves. Make the right decision!

name: Cat Colony Crisis
short_description: You are tasked with helping a colony ship full of space-faring cats deal with a mysterious disease outbreak! Will you act fast and stop the spread of this disease or will it spread unchecked and ravage your Cat Colony.

name: 春秋
short_description: 此为以春秋时代为背景，历史战略类即时制游戏。两千多年前华夏大地锦绣山河一眼尽收，可在其间建造城郭，构筑关隘，修筑长城，农商、车船、战阵行走其间。礼崩乐坏，百家兴起、诸侯争霸、异族入侵、合纵连横，列国之伐兵、伐交、伐谋就此展开。磅礴壮丽的春秋画卷待君前来指点江山！

name: Eshina Princess Cultivator
short_description: Eshina Princess Cultivator is a princess raising political rpg in which you foster the growth of Eleora Eshina so that she may one day govern the Imperial Realm of Ekaria.

name: RASPBERRY MASH
short_description: Fantasy, weapons, violence!"Roguelike game" in pixel art.

name: Exigent
short_description: Decide between bad and worse options as you try to keep an abandoned spacecraft together long enough for a safe enough landing.

name: Warhaos
short_description: Karekterini oluşturup yaratıkları kes, görevleri tamamla, deneyim kazan ve bir efsaneye dönüş!

name: Evil Seal
short_description: Evil Seal is an action horror game inspired by the Apocalypse of St. John. The story begins when the first of the Seven Seals is broken and the first of the Four Knights begin to spread confusion and destruction on Earth.

name: Beyond Horror: Episode One, A Father's Journey
short_description: The game is the first episode of a survival horror first person adventure, featuring action, stealth, shooting and puzzle solving. Every chapter has a specific theme and will play differently according to the plot, with tons of references to the classics that made the horror genre what it is today.

name: Flying Frags World Tour
short_description: Robots have torn open a portal to invade earth, everyone has mysteriously disappeared, the world has begun to tear apart. Sprint across the skies of robot-invaded Earth as you try to end the invasion.

name: Shard of Kronos
short_description: The ever peaceful sky lands of Tygardia are being threatened by a destructive meteor. This meteor can only be destroyed by activating an ancient beacon, guarded by monsters and puzzles. Can you prevent this mysterious catastrophe from happening?

name: The Fun of Asmodius
short_description: A dungeon exploration RPG with a real time map system

name: After Meeting
short_description: A man and a woman who live in the same apartment often meet each other when they take the elevator. How will the story develop when they have crashed on each other? This is a casual love decryption game, you need to find the rules. In the process of passing the game, you can discover the story.

name: Tiny Defender
short_description: Tiny Defender is a game that combines CCG and tower defense. Build your own deck and clear various stages.

name: BOX THE BEAT VR
short_description: Customize almost everything what can be customized in a rhythmic music game! In each location are unique visualizations to the beat of the music! You can also join the chill area. Sit down, move around the different locations and chill to your music!

name: Vedelem: The Golden Horde
short_description: Védelem: The Golden Horde is a medieval Real Time Strategy and Survival game set in the 13th century. Build, expand and defend your lands against the deadliest Mongolian invasion ever witnessed. They will seek to destroy your walls and salt your earth. Will you survive the Golden Horde?

name: Under The Ghost Mountain
short_description: Under the ghost mountain is a platform shooting Roguelike game. Random terrain, permanent death, platform jumping, shooting, chain reaction, destructible terrain, and plot creation are the features of this game. Inspire by Spelunky and Downwell

name: Ancient Rituals: Stonehenge
short_description: Ancient Rituals: Stonehenge is a ludic VR experience, where you will experience our interpretation of an ancient pagan ritual. A ritual that is beyond linear time and three dimensional space.You are in an exploration to find yourself

name: Mindcop
short_description: Mindcop is a non-linear „whodunnit“ detective game. It mixes a story driven adventure with real-time puzzle gaming. As the infamous Mindcop, you can dive into the minds of your suspects to uncover their secrets and unravel their lies.

name: The Daunting House
short_description: You are a Paranormal Researcher who is accidentally trapped in a village near the foothills of the Himalayas along with his colleague. You have to make a safe escape, try finding some help in the mysterious place. Good Luck.

name: Crazy Factory
short_description: Crazy Factory VR is a bunch of silly virtual reality mini-games in an automated robotic factory. You are a robot working in a factory directed by an artificial intelligence. Carve shoes, punch pickaxes, throw crystal glasses and uncover the truth !

name: Visiting a celebrity
short_description: Imagine yourself as a journalist traveling the homes of the world's most popular people. Get passports to fly from country to country. Earn gold to buy everything you need.

name: CHESS with LASERS
short_description: Obliterate the enemy's king with your laser by strategically moving/rotating mirrors, portals and more in this mind-bending chess-like game. Challenge your friends or battle an AI (includes Level Editor)!

name: Battlefield™ 2042
short_description: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

name: 1000 Shards
short_description: 1000 Shards is a game in which you control a spaceship. Your main task is to collect bright white shards and avoid obstacle blocks. Use the ship's maneuverability and your reaction to last longer. How many shards will you collect?

name: From The Darkness
short_description: From the darkness is a psychological horror game with a scary atmosphere, the game takes place in an old Soviet abandoned apartment.

name: Hidden Memory - Neko's Life
short_description: Follow a cute stray kitten journey until he finds a home and use the opportunity to disconnect from the world with this beautiful and relaxing minimalist puzzle!

name: PACT - Process Affinity Control Tool
short_description: PACT is a tool that allows you to section different programs in to different cores/threads on your CPU automagically.

name: Everplant
short_description: Discover an infinite procedural world, unite with monsters, discover the universe and create your own one with some friends.

name: Mars Mission
short_description: The Mars Mission offers real companies and work processes for career orientation! Explore different professions and work processes and find your dream job! You can currently choose between 10 professions and simulate their work processes.

name: Star Aegis
short_description: A shmup without shooting. Reflect the bullets with one of your two shields. Bite-sized arcade action. Cover humankind's retreat and make it count.

name: Daughter of Essence
short_description: The largest and most powerful empire wants you captured at all costs. Their enemies want to control you for their own benefit. The world itself seems to want you dead. You just want to be a normal girl.

name: Peaceful Gunner
short_description: Peace, love, and... GUNS! Peaceful Gunner is a shooter-defense game about good vibes. Shoot some magical flowers to turn soldiers into hippies and make the world a better place (or not).

name: Horatama
short_description: A horror game about taking care of cute and murderous retro virtual pets!

name: Foglight Online
short_description: Foglight Online is a multiplayer horror survival game. One player plays as the Legendary Farberto, a monster with a bloodhounds nose, that can smell the other players. The other players have to hide or fight back in this intense nail-biting multiplayer experience!

name: Sparkles & Gems
short_description: Two characters face head-to-head using their paddle and ball to shatter colour-matching gems and cascade rocks down on their opponent. Collect items and level up in Treasure Mode. Play through a visual novel-esque Story Mode. Or battle with a friend in 2P Mode!

name: Droplet: States of Matter
short_description: Change between the different states of matter in this 3D platforming adventure!

name: Space 'n Lasers
short_description: Do you like space? Do you like lasers? Do you like puzzles? 70 mind-bending, spaced themed puzzles with mirrors, wormholes, beam splitters, switches, explosives and more. Try the fun, stay for the challenge!

name: Astrokicker
short_description: Mixing old and new, Astrokicker is inspired by classic shootemups going back to the 80s, with a few twists. The player gets to fly in any direction, and using a combination of skill and strategy, takes out the starbases controlling warpfields.

name: Anarkade
short_description: Anarkade is a Multiplayer Arena Shooter with 2D platforming mechanics that features multiple weapons, randomly generated arenas, and humorously bloody animations.

name: 反图灵测试/Anti-TuringTest
short_description: Fiction style DBG strategy game: During the game you will walk among the gigantic artificial city, bloody battlefield, ancient ruins. They are full of danger, waiting to be challenged. Only by getting stronger you can understand the ultimate purpose of this trial.

name: Miska's Cave
short_description: Miska's Cave is a unique action-centric side scroller with strategic components and animated with pixel art. If you love completing challenging games that require varying strategies, this game is for you.

name: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story
short_description: Dive into the streets of Tokyo as a love hotel manager and embark on a thrilling journey of romance with stunning women in this casual and erotic dating-sim. Who will capture your heart in this Love Hotel Story?

name: StalakMiner
short_description: StalakMiner is a third-person action adventure digging game that presents strategical and timed mining challenges to you as a miner tasked with reaching the depths of the planet. Collect rare metals and minerals to sell for credits used to upgrade your vehicle.

name: SynthVR
short_description: A modular synthesizer environment for virtual reality.

name: Bonkey Trek Quimdung Edition
short_description: Running low on food, 100 miles from home, and you don't know if you'll ever see your love again

name: Rebirth:Beware of Mr.Wang
short_description: This is a plot-oriented interactive puzzle game. The gameplay uses mouse clicks or drag-and-drop methods to promote the development of the plot. The game tells the story of an ordinary young man who pursues love, grows up in the process of hard work, and finally reaps friendship and love.

name: Aeterna Noctis
short_description: Aeterna Noctis is a challenging metroidvania that majestically combines action, exploration and adventure. With 2 game modes and difficulty based on action or the exclusive Noctis mode where a level of difficulty is added in precision platforming never seen in the metroidvania genre.

name: CooKing: Around the World
short_description: 8 menus are included in the game, each of which will accommodate 10-12 dishes, accompanied by at least 200 ingredients. All menus take place in the cuisine of different nations. We will turn around e.g. American, French, Hungarian, Italian lands of flavors.

name: Tales From The Cache
short_description: Dive into the exciting world of treasure hunting. A geocaching expedition that has you discovering secret locations, solving challenging puzzles, and exploring abandoned places. Cache in, adventure out!

name: Run Tank Run
short_description: Drive your tank, blast everything blocking your way, and rush forward with exhilaration.

name: Freelancer Life Simulator: Prologue
short_description: Freelancer Life Simulator: Prologue - a free game that contains events before Freelancer Life Simulator. In this story, you play as the uncle of the protagonist. You will find out why uncle left the city.

name: Build Em' Faster
short_description: Build Em' Faster is everything about old multiplayer arcade. As it might be seen as a modern party gaming, it is indeed a true revival of both base building and tower defense concepts.

name: Dystopians
short_description: A cyberpunk colony simulator where you take over, manage & build bases, create & lead the crew to survive in a dark cybercity. Every member of the society makes their own decisions based on various factors and stats, for you is to decide and point out what would be best to do next!

name: Dear Mom
short_description: A short narrative adventure about mom, which will leave you with unforgettable incredible emotions about your mom.

name: Car Mechanic Manager 2023
short_description: Car Mechanic Manager is a tycoon management game that lets you manage your own car mechanic business! Build, expand and modernize your car workshop to maintain a good reputation and attract more customers. Manage your business efficiently and destroy the competition!

name: Evil Mansion
short_description: Evil Mansion is a first-person 3D Werewolf game with real-time voice chat. The game has a variety of occupations (such as security, doctors, detectives).and the vote system is not for vote out player, but for mark the position of the player with the most votes.

name: Agent Murphy
short_description: Agent Murphy: Hardcore pixel platformer shooter with unlimited pistol, MP5, shotgun, and grenades. Navigate 20 levels, battle random enemies, and face epic bosses with a clockwork soundtrack.

name: My Father My Son
short_description: Two castaways: a father and son end up on a deserted island after an unexpected storm. The sailboat cruise that was to bring them together turns into a deadly fight for survival. The characters can only count on each other.

name: Spells & Secrets
short_description: In this rogue-lite adventure, you free the Academy of Greifenstein from magical creatures by using your spells creatively. Explore this modern magical world alone or in local co-op mode with friends and family, customize your character, solve mysteries, and find powerful artifacts.

name: PATHFINDER 08
short_description: Pathfinder 08 is a fun and challenging adventure. It is a platform game with a focus on exploration and retro inspiration with some RPG elements.

name: Two Guys One Cabin
short_description: The life of the old stalker Valera began to change radically after the young stalker Sanya stays with him overnight. Experience the incredibly dramatic adventure of two experienced stalker men.

name: Minesweeper Versus
short_description: Minesweeper Versus requires tactics and strategy to uncover hidden mines before your opponent beats you to it. It's a modern take on the classic free minesweeper game, for two players.

name: Pirate Simulator
short_description: Start a rebellious career as a poor sailor and climb your way up to become the richest and the most dangerous captain of the archipelago. Take over sea routes, set up hideouts, build fleets and fight enemy crews to lead a legendary pirate life!

name: Higgs Boson: Minimal Puzzle
short_description: Higgs Boson: Minimal Puzzle is a relaxing and minimalist puzzle game where the player must rotate pieces to assemble a particle accelerator.

name: UnearthU
short_description: UnearthU is a 7 day multimedia experience about self-improvement, healing, and transformation. Made by reusing found digital materials, the game consists of found footage videos, discussions with an A.I., guided meditations, writing reflection prompts, and a habit tracker.

name: Theme Park Mystery
short_description: What sinister power has forced the Magic Canyon Theme Park to close down? Why does the mere mention of its name send shudders down your spine? What terrible secret drove its former owner mad? You're the inheritor of this mysterious park - only you can find the answer!

name: The Killing Cloud
short_description: Can you breathe new life into a desperate city that's gasping for air and grasping for help?

name: Eiyu*Senki Gold – A New Conquest
short_description: A young man takes up his sword and leads an army in search of his missing past. Carefully plan strategic turn-based battles against adorable portrayals of historical and mythical world heroes, as you conquer the globe... for not well explained reasons!

name: MakerKing
short_description: Become a King (or Queen) at making levels! Join a community designed around level creation and online play. The level editor is simple to use and lets you create anything, even living creatures!

name: Essence of Time
short_description: Essence of Time is a story rich, hand-drawn RPG. Craft modular moves in a sphere grid as you build friendships, unravel mysteries, and explore timelines and their consequences during the final days of battle school. While students compete to be the next emperor, can you find a future without war?

name: System Zero
short_description: System Zero is a hacker simulation game. You must use your hacking tools for accessing to the devices. You will become a black hat who wants to make his living.

name: Chaincards
short_description: Chaincards is a JRPG where you play as Chain, a young wizard whose goal is to find out his master’s magic notes to reveal the secrets behind his mysterious death

name: Revertia
short_description: 2D puzzle action like Reversi!

name: Pretty Girls Panic! PLUS
short_description: Popular Arcade Game "Pretty Girls Panic!" is back with more power. Expand the area steadily and dodge enemy attacks and avoid capture. There are 40 stages in total. Conquer all stages and Complete the rescue of these Pretty Girls.

name: VR Girls’ Room in Darkness
short_description: In 2008, a girl named Kimmy disappeared strangely. Her parents searched for her for a long time but failed to find her, so they left this sad land. Twelve years later, you found this uninhabited house during an accidental trip.

name: Exodition
short_description: You won't survive this game. Let yourself pull into this atmospheric narrative focussed experience .. If you are ready.

name: Nevermore: The Chamber Door
short_description: NEVERMORE: The Chamber Door is an indie game developed by just one person, with fluid combat in the style of hack n 'slash and lore inspired by the work of Edgar Allan Poe.

name: Re: LieF ~ Shin'ainaru Anata e~
short_description: "Re: LieF ~ Shin'ainaru Anata e~" is produced by Japanese visual novel brand Rask. First launched in 2016, it was praised as a "Dark Horse of the year" by visual novel users. It also won the Golden Award for the screenplay of Moe Game Award.

name: Maru and her make-believe world
short_description: Maru is a game about our childhood, it is about our sweet nostalgia of the kid’s life. This is a story-driven adventure quest in the imaginary world with exploration elements that will suit best for those who would like to chill and immerse in their own childhood memories.

name: Koi Farm
short_description: A koi breeding game.

name: Horse Club Adventures
short_description: Horse Club Adventures carries you off to the wonderful world that revolves around the Lakeside Riding Stable. Together with Hannah, Sarah, Lisa, Sofia and their horses, you experience lots of thrilling adventures!

name: Gravel Gang
short_description: Gravel Gang is a simple but challenging real-time strategy/tactic casual game. Make smart plans and show your strategic skills, fight and conquer the challenging maps to WIN! You will be richly rewarded for victories, you can buy epic heroes and show your skills with them.

name: Across
short_description: Explore a world filled with mystery, ruins and unknown creatures as you reveal the memories of the Cub’s owner Estelle and her parents as they make their way to the city while a war approaches the kingdom.

name: Triblock
short_description: A little bit of Tetris, a little bit of match 3.

name: Fun Forbidden
short_description: Fun Forbidden is a VR steampunk-themed sandbox filled with element combinations, collectibles, and adventures. Let your mind run wild in this fantasy world and become the master inventor!

name: Conductor: Creative Joy Engine
short_description: Conductor is an audiovisual experience creation engine that encourages you to craft, save, and share funky environments with its vibrantly creative tool-set alongside all of your favorite media.

name: Degradation(Alpha)
short_description: COOP Modular tank combat with Rougelike AI generation.

name: Confusing game
short_description: Do you want to test your reaction time, quick thinking, and ingenuity? Then this is the logic game for you.

name: Kamikaze Veggies
short_description: A stealth adventure game with an absurd-driven story and third-person perspective for a single-player or co-op. Complete secret war missions, solve the showy puzzles, and save the veggies world!

name: Boom
short_description: Boom is a logic puzzle game with a relaxing atmosphere, which builds clear links,An exciting new twist on a classic game without the element of guesswork!

name: Kombi Travels - Jigsaw Landscapes
short_description: Escape urban life in a sweet Jigsaw Puzzle about Love, Travel and Life. What awaits you when you set the last piece?

name: SGS Heia Safari
short_description: The only campaign where forces of Imperial Germany fought victoriously till the end. From 1914 to 1918 in East Africa, you play general Von Lettow and his skilled Askaris or Allied troops from the Empire, Belgium and Portugal. Get the ‘African Queen’ feel when playing this exotic campaign.

name: SGS Taipings
short_description: The game recreates the Taïping Rebellion (1851-64), the deadliest Chinese civil war, costing the lives of millions. Play the Taïping rebels and their allies, fighting to create their own state, or be the Qing Emperor and crush the revolt and its foreign devils allies before it topples your dynasty.

name: SGS Halls of Montezuma
short_description: Halls of Montezuma recreates the Mexican-American war of 1846-1848. Play the USA and conquer Mexico City before Whig opposition in Congress forces a negotiated peace. As Mexico, hold desperately against the enemy’s onslaught, to gain enough time for America's internal politics to end the war.

name: Welcome to ParadiZe
short_description: Paradise isn't exactly what you hoped for: it's infested with zombies! Thankfully, you can control them. Capture them and teach them to farm or fight. They will help you defend our camp while you explore the world looking for… a new paradise.

name: ChillaxVR
short_description: Go to different beautiful, relaxing and chill environments using VR, taking a break away from the real world and virtually stepping into a land you only wished you could travel to. Become involved in the game and the environment where you not only play the game – but also become part of the game

name: [Neolithic]To the End
short_description: A modern-day open-world RPG about a secret world. With the help of your companions, some demons, some cats, and any supernatural entities you can bend to your will, all the different ways to solve problems, you may still fail to save the world. Life is simply unfair. But, will you stop trying?

name: Slavic Winter Simulator
short_description: Doomer's Paradise

name: President Rocket Game
short_description: Lloyd Kinski - an arch conservative ex-president and and Liv Lundgren - a young militant climate activist need to save mankind. YOU will need to make sure they work together. What the hell could possibly go wrong?

name: Duck Flight Simulator 2021
short_description: Duck Flighting may just be the ultimate experience in duck hunting simulation! And if it's not ultimate, we definitely guarantee it's an experience of some sort! With guns to fire, ducks to hunt, and a gorgeous nature scene to enjoy, we wish you all a fun time with our little project.

name: Dashing Dinos 2
short_description: Project S.E.N.S.E is asynchronous multiplayer game where you either play a mutant, robbed of all it's senses or a special force hunter, tasked to bring it back.

name: Dude Simulator 4
short_description: Dude Simulator 4 – a first-person open-world sandbox game with a plot. Some new adventures are awaiting the dude. The main character of the game decides to meet a girl through a mobile dating app, but during a date someone attacks him.

More than 70 cars from six manufacturers from different countries to buy, an extensive campaign mode, dozens of circuits, rally stages, championships, and much more awaits you!

With multiple game modes, including the challenging safari forest hunt and the adrenaline-pumping night forest hunt, each session offers a unique and intense experience.

It's full of fun elements such as agriculture, craft, cooking, guild, pets, dairy farming, and home remodeling!

name: Heart Seals
short_description: A puzzle game about sliding seals. Each animal reacts in different ways. Use their abilities to help other animals reach their bubbles. Be careful, large animals like to stay connected and small animals dislike the water. Be surprised by the different things you can do in this puzzle game.

short_description: Follow the story of Amimi Imai, an 18 year old student who's recent move from home has left her succumbed to a new high school and new life. The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is a single path/ending visual novel about love, acceptance, and a good ol' awkward budding teenage friendship.

name: Swords & Bones
short_description: Swords & Bones inherits the spirit of the great 16-bit classics from the 80s and 90s, enriching the game experience with modern mechanics! Undead hordes and demons await you in this epic adventure!

name: Hyper Light Breaker
short_description: Enter the Overgrowth, a new realm in the world of Hyper Light. Play alone or with friends to explore open worlds, create new builds, rip through hordes and overcome the Crowns and the Abyss King.

name: Floor Plan 2
short_description: Explore a tower of hilarious escape rooms and solve mind-bending puzzles in this absurd elevator adventure for virtual reality. Step out onto each floor, meet bizarre characters, unravel their secrets, and figure out how everything is connected to find the lost artifacts your boss is looking for.

name: Behold The Dark
short_description: Behold The Dark is a 2D isometric action, adventure game with pixel graphics and survival horror elements emphasizing on lighting mechanics. Fight off monsters, interact with people, stay in the light, do whatever it takes to fend off that horrible oblivion.

name: 风之界限 the border of wind
short_description: Wind Boundaries is an adventure RPG game. Due to some mysterious reasons, the ancient continent has once again fallen into crisis, helping the people of the kingdom solve their problems, exploring here to uncover the final fog, and eliminating the conspiracies and threats brought about by darkness.

name: VR Guardians
short_description: Wield your weapons and face the wrath of colossal creatures. Fight your way through a barrage of projectiles, fireballs and gargantuan teeth and claws as you stumble into the terrifying stages where the VR Guardians dwell. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Ascii the Brave Cat
short_description: Ascii the Brave Cat is a retro-style 2D action game with awesome new mechanics, cute characters, and memorable gameplay. Meet the never seen puzzles, collect upgrade items, fight creative funny bosses, and push yourself beyond the limit to save someone (or something) you love.

name: Rushmore
short_description: Rushmore is a third-person, hero-focused, shooter/hack-n-slash hybrid. You play as the four Presidents of Mount Rushmore sucked into the future to face off against alien hordes with weapons and abilities inspired by American history.

name: Terminus: Zombie Survivors
short_description: Terminus: Zombie Survivors is a 2D turn-based survival roguelike set during a zombie apocalypse. Each journey is unique, and every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Can you brave hunger, cold, and the undead in order to reach the Terminus and find salvation?

name: Bird by Example
short_description: Just add water! The Kafkaesque bird-based artificial intelligence sandbox driven by real-time neural networks and your own sick perversions! Acquire love! It is time to throw fear to the birds!

name: Go Home
short_description: This is a match 3 game with a dog theme. The game has an innovative goal achievement system. There are also four other types of mini-games. In the game, you help the dog find its way home. Cute puppies are looking forward to your help.

short_description: Incremental Idle Breakout Japanese Anime RPG! Explore the vast map (~ 10^21 meters) through breaking many blocks and defend your base from various monsters!

name: VR Kyoto: Beauty of Japan
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Japanese beautiful places / towns for about 20 minutes.

name: Nadir: A Grimdark Deckbuilder
short_description: Nadir is a roguelike deck-builder with a twist: the cost to play a card is an enemy reaction you can predict. Craft your own cards to slay powerful demons. Gather resources, expand your city, grow in power and conquer the underworld.

name: Lust for Speed
short_description: Street Racing + Date Sim. Pimp your Ride! Win in a Drag-Racing competitions! Earn Reputation! Date the Racer Girls!

name: Mobile Mechanic: Road Service
short_description: Take a part in car repair missions on the roads. Grow your small business into the best roadside assistance in the town. Help customers in need and save their cars from breaking down. Emergency Road Services Simulator will teach you how to deal with minor and major car breakdowns.

name: Middle Age Conquest
short_description: Start Your Country With The Most Suitable And Advantageous Flag For You, Always Make Your War Team According To Your Possibilities. Develop Your Country And Bring The End Of Other Kingdoms.

name: Rocket Skates VR
short_description: Imagine having a rocket booster strapped to your hands and a hot pair of roller skates on your feed. There is a mountain road in front of you and all you can think about is racing downhills with rocket power. The premise might be simple but the fun is guaranteed.

name: Nadir: A Grimdark Deck Builder - Prologue
short_description: Nadir is a roguelike deck-builder with a twist: the cost to play a card is an enemy reaction you can predict. Craft your own cards to slay powerful demons. Gather resources, expand your city, grow in power and conquer the underworld.

short_description: Sonucido: The Mage is a grid-based, turn-based Dungeon Crawler RPG. Find the mage in the depths of Sonucido!

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 4
short_description: Explore Pinecreek‘s fabulous new features and facilities including the American Indian Reservation, Red River Canyon & Geyser, Whitewater River Rafting, Lakeside Campground & Cabins and the Hill Country Cafe. Walk past Waterfalls, along the Apache Trail and explore gorgeous outdoor locations.

name: Venus: Improbable Dream
short_description: Born with a birth defect that he hates, Kakeru struggles with severe anxiety and depression. Guide his timid decisions as he takes a brave step into a new world - joining his school's music club, making unexpected and inspiring new connections, and daring to dream again.

name: Virtuxy
short_description: Help two robots combine their skills to find their lost friend on a planet full of puzzles and challenges.

name: Opening Night at the Großen Schauspielhaus - Berlin 1927
short_description: Visit Berlin 1927 and explore the VR-reconstruction of the famous theatre. Three storytellers, Walter, Fritzi and Otto, invite you to share their anticipation of the opening night – behind the scenes and on stage. Our digital theatre opens new perspectives; cultural heritage comes alive virtually.

name: Stream Toys by Zokya
short_description: A collection of chat-interactive games and toys that you can use to engage with your audience. Includes "Plinker" a multi-player skill game that turns messages in your chat to tokens that 'plink' and bounce down a peg board. Land a plinky in the bucket to score a point!

name: Eggcelerate!

short_description: Welcome to the one and only tiny split-screen racing tournament! Grab a friend (or none if no one is around), strap on your seat belt, and hit the road in more than 24 hot and lovely designed mini tracks. It’s fast, it’s fun, it’s exciting. It’s time for Mini Car Racing.

name: CyberTown
short_description: CyberTown - Is a game about interplanetary colonization where you create new cybernetic cities. Build, develop and strengthen your cities. Natural disasters, diseases, the needs of the population and much more will not let you get bored in this new cybernetic world.

name: The Alchemist Alekki
short_description: This is a game about running a potion shop and saving time! Alekki has been accused of creating a potion that caused areas of time to merge together. Help her uncover the truth by defeating powerful Echoes of time in different Time-Warped areas.

short_description: Cut, squash, and headbutt other tofu ninja in this adventure searching for the truth of the Pythagoreans' Theorem! Explore various world permutations and collect rare Alogon history as you break and link different worlds to create the true Number Line.

short_description: Scrap Seas is an action-roguelike shooter about customizing your murder-boat to battle robots, dieselpunk pirates, sea monsters, and huge bosses! Travel through a generated campaign of fast-paced battles, broken up by shops and random events. Just don’t die, because death is a permanent condition!

name: Hunt N Cloak
short_description: Hunt N Cloak is an online multiplayer game with a fantastic fun old skool element of "Hide & Seek" Set in a variety of environments including Outdoor desert, Internal Office, Vehicle Garage & Old Towns, you embark as either the Hunter or the Cloaker swapping roles after each round.

name: Kakuro Blend
short_description: Kakuro Blend is exactly like the puzzle Kakuro, but with colors instead of numbers! It is simple, colorful, and challenging. If you enjoy tough puzzles, this game will satisfy you for hours with 40 unique puzzles each with its own unique solution.

short_description: Welcome to Endless Furry Clicker! The third installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! Just a basic clicker game. Click the Furry and stack your score!

short_description: Fire all the bullets! "Private Agent" is a VR gun shooting game. Switch between various weapons and conquer stage bosses. short_description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Assimilation X
short_description: Embody the simulation of a dead mysterious man as he is revived as part of Project Engram. Descend down the various levels of the increasingly mind-bending twisted simulation in order to destroy this electronic universe and end the suffering of millions. The Ultimate Platformer!

short_description: Betaverse is a rather unique (in a way you wish didn't exist) digital experience, a network of 3D virtual worlds created by Microtaur's troubled imagination. Play free with your friends and change the world around you in this not-so-intelligent indie MMO sandbox.

name: Football Academy Clicker
short_description: Football Academy Clicker is a clicker game where you train footballers and lead your team to glory. Transfer new players and train them. Sell your players at high prices to increase your budget. Upgrade your stadium and hire coaches. 5 leagues waiting for you to conquer!

short_description: A classical science fiction point and click adventure which takes you into a deep story and murky atmosphere, while solving logical puzzles. Accompany Tessa Carter and her talking robot as she finds out about herself and searches for a way to survive.

By exploring containment strategies hands-on, you'll develop an exponential growth model to determine when the virus overwhelms your city's hospitals to save the city!

Fight and dodge your way through the randomly generated maps to rescue your friends. Find upgrades along the way and save up arcane fragments for permanent blessings from the gods.
