short_description: 東方Projectでおなじみ、上海アリス幻樂団様制作の音楽CDシリーズ「秘封倶楽部」の二次創作ノベルゲームです。選択肢はありません。物語中で入手した記憶の欠片「フラグメント」や、プレイヤー自身の知恵によって物語を分岐させ、彼女達の冒険―蓮台野夜行―を成功に導きましょう。

name: Finsterwald
short_description: “Finsterwald” is a survival horror adventure VR and 3D game, based on Dark Ages period European myths about Ancient Guardian of the Forests – Waldschrat. Observing the behavior of visitors, he watches over the peace and safety of trees, birds, animals, other fosterlings on the entrusted territory.

name: 肉牛养殖计划
short_description: 《肉牛养殖计划》，是一款乡村农场养牛模拟游戏，体验养牛的苦乐相伴和美好的田园悠闲感。玩家在农场里学习养牛，设计自己的养牛计划。从养1头牛新手，到养100头牛专家，克服养殖过程中的重重困难与挫折，终有突破，成为养牛产业的带头人，带领一方村民养牛致富。

name: Clean Slate
short_description: A suspense visual novel replete with life-or-death situations, puzzles and six different endings. Make your own decisions, solve riddles and reach the truth about the disappearance of the world's leading geneticist - and your best friend.

name: 花妖物语/Flower girl
short_description: " Flower Girl " is a "Sexy Flower Elf+ Flower Match-3 game + GALGAME" combination of casual games. You will play a mission as a "Royal Spirit Master". In order to save your lover, you will go to the legendary land of flower elf, and encounter all kinds of flower elf on the way......

name: True Spring Love
short_description: True Spring Love is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Torn Away
short_description: Torn Away is an award winning interactive story with a unique blend of adventure games, side-scrollers, and cinematic first-person levels. Help little Asya find her way home in the middle of war.

name: Football Manager 2022
short_description: The closest thing to real football management. FM22 brings new, progressive ways to find your winning edge, instill your footballing style and earn it on the pitch.

name: Vivid Knight
short_description: "Vivid Knight" is a "party-building roguelike" game in which you collect friends who have been turned into jewels and fight by combining their abilities! Explore the ever-changing dungeon and harness the gems you have gathered to challenge the labyrinth!

name: War of Kosovo: 2033
short_description: War of Kosovo: 2033 is heavily based on its realistic city style and attractive game mechanics every season. Each season continues with new maps and special stylized wearable skins, graffiti, weapons, effects and sounds.

name: Asset Flip
short_description: The game you didn't ask for, like that game that keeps popping up yet nobody wants to see. Just another asset flip. Only this time, an honest one.

name: P3TT
short_description: Solve puzzles by creating portals and manipulating time. Inspired by Valve's Portal and Portal 2.

name: Glyph☀️
short_description: Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure starring a mech-scarab and his trusted guide, Anobi, challenged with rebuilding an ancient civilization buried under the desert sand. Jump, double-jump, smash and glide through the air in this vertical platformer with amazing controls.

name: A Way Back
short_description: Solve challenging sokoban-like puzzles to help a little penguin clean islands from nasty plastic trash and find A Way Back home!

name: The Kotonoha Sisters and the Legend of Lysant Island
short_description: This game is a turn-based action RPG that moves around in a 3D space where you can enjoy various scenery with cute 2D characters. Operate the Kotonoha sisters and explore a fun and mysterious island!

name: Brewmaster: Beer Brewing Simulator
short_description: Brew your perfect beer in this relaxing home brewing sim. Use a realistic chemistry simulation to brew hoppy IPAs to creamy stouts. Customise your brewing space, create recipes and label your beer, unlock new equipment and enter competitions. Learn to brew, refine your craft and become a Brewmaster!

name: Stickman Clans
short_description: Defeat stick warriors and win total war in Stickman Clans game

name: Abermore
short_description: Inherit the role of a mythical thief and pull off the heist of the century in Abermore, a first-person RPG where stealth is your key to fame and fortune. You have 18 days to ransack houses, sell stolen loot, acquire new gear and form alliances to prepare for the ultimate heist.

name: Evolve Lab
short_description: In this roguelike auto battler, every enemy you face was created by another player! Modify and improve your creatures' behaviour after each battle and see how far down you can make it. Do you have what it takes to be the first to reach depths, where no one has gone before?

name: Why It's Empty Here: The Game
short_description: Action-survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open-world teeming with various creatures. Explore the world devastated by a mysterious virus. Search for supplies, craft weapons, and battle creatures.

name: Dwarves Craft. Father's home
short_description: Dwarves Craft - Father's Home - reveal the hidden pictures! 150 engaging levels for all ages!

name: I Make Saints (Steam Edition)
short_description: Explore the guilt-ridden mind of a deeply deranged individual in this short first-person psychological horror walking simulator. Discover the unspeakable nature of their crimes in this dark, narrative-driven underground cult classic.

name: Triple Dungeon
short_description: Control three adventurers simultaneously in this experimental split-screen dungeon crawling adventure!

name: Spellfarers
short_description: Farm, fish, craft, and cast spells with your friends in this idyllic, magical multiplayer farming sim. Befriend the townsfolk of Wenngrove, learn their trades and stories, tend your home with your friends and Familiar, and make magic in Spellfarers.

name: TEOCIDA
short_description: Solve riddles, puzzles and platforming challenges as you descend the cryptic pathways of a distorted microcosm reality fueled by a symbolic landscape of faith and erotic nightmares.

name: IRMÃO Grande & Brasileiro 2
short_description: IRMÃO Grande & Brasileiro 2 é o mais Grande e mais Brasileiro simulador de cárcere privado competitivo que o dinheiro pode comprar. Você monta um elenco formado pelos seus amigos, personagens ou celebridades favoritas, enfia todo mundo numa casa, e assiste o circo pegar fogo.

name: Top Gang
short_description: Top Gang is a very chaotic platform game for up to 4 cooperative players. You need to eliminate all enemies in the level to be able to advance at the same time you will have to rescue the "Nuggets" and take them safely to the exit. Your friends can be a big help or a stumbling block.

name: Dread X Collection 4: The Hunt
short_description: A horror anthology shooter in the Dread X Collection series. Co-produced by DUSK creator David Szymanski. Featuring 7 new short games, a robust launcher world set in an abandoned arctic base.

name: The Simplest Game
short_description: The Simplest Game is a 2D logic game with pixel graphics. Yes, this is actually the simplest game ever! Every level in this game is the same. But try to get out of the level and not break your brain!

name: Blue Prince
short_description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

name: OnlyFuck - RuRu's Adventures
short_description: RuRu wants to make money and have fun at the same time! Join her in this simulation of the very popular OF platform!

name: Lab Rags
short_description: Enjoy failure as it fuels your success in Lab Rags, where you get to use your ragdoll bodies to solve puzzles!

name: Palladise Island
short_description: Palladise Island is a easy idle game that is suitable for someone who want to relax or mess around.

name: Tank Side Story
short_description: Tank Side Story is an homage to a great handheld tactical game series, thrusting its legacy and aesthetic into modern, competitive gameplay. Outmaneuver your opponent using classic military tactics on a grid with a flair for the dramatic.

name: inPixio Photo Studio Pro
short_description: Photo editing has never been easier!

name: Snapshot
short_description: Magic and science. Past and future. But what of the present?

name: Hero Realms
short_description: From the makers of the award-winning Star Realms Deckbuilding Game ®, Hero Realms combines the fun of deckbuilding games with the interactivity of trading card game-style combat.

name: Attack Of UNDO Zai
short_description: High definition furry anime characters in a non-stop action shooter with team.

name: A Shiba Story
short_description: A Shiba Story is a game about everyday life with a Shiba Inu. Play as a rookie dogsitter who’s asked to care for Sunday, a Shiba Inu so proud he refuses to be pet. Can you win his friendship?

name: Ninja Ming: Wu
short_description: A mini 2D puzzle platformer with double teleport mechanic. Brainstorming is as important as hands-on experience. Thinking clearly before taking action can make it easier; If you are confident in your operation, you can engage in simple thinking.

name: Lab BreakOut
short_description: Lab BreakOut is a hardcore precision gravity-shifting platformer with minimal graphics.

name: Betray Me Not
short_description: Control your feline friend to cooperate by playing mini-games and avoiding being turned into gold by other greedy cats.

name: Magicians need to learn healing magic
short_description: The protagonist in the game is Bai Bai, a magician who is preparing to go to the royal capital. Bai Bai will see the story of a character named Yukihito. Yukihito didn't know where the other world was at first.

name: 24 Solar Terms
short_description: 24 Solar Terms is a seek and find puzzle game with the theme of the traditional Chinese twenty-four solar terms. The game connects the climate and farming of various solar terms through farming proverbs, myths and fables. Help local farmers solve problems and experience the story of 24 solar terms.

name: Shades of Rayna
short_description: Shades of Rayna is a free to play and early access ARPG with lots of loot and endless gameplay content.

name: Westerlands: Girly runaways story
short_description: A runner game in which you have to escape from prison and explore an endless road through the wild west.

name: Mumbai Gullies
short_description: Come and experience a thrilling and exciting story based in Mumbai, the city of dreams!

name: Fried Chicken in Wonderland
short_description: This is a story about a guy who loves his girlfriend and Parmesan cheese powder.

name: Saphyro
short_description: Saphyro - is a casual game where your task is to collect white cubes, for which you get points. The difficulty is that you need to dodge the colored platforms that randomly appear on the playing field and the cube, which you control constantly in motion. And how many points can you collect?

name: Sword and Fairy 5
short_description: *** This game is only available in Chinese*** 《仙劍奇俠傳五》是仙劍奇俠傳系列的第六代作品。本作的主題為「心願」。遠古血族，再度覺醒。人性與魔心，宿命與血緣，道義與愛情，當這些同時擺在前面，該如何抉擇？千年的封印，連接兩界的神魔之井成為震動六界的焦點，眾人的命運逐漸交織在一起。

name: Ziode Shadow
short_description: WARNING: This game requires you to think for yourself! Ziode Shadow is a 2D platform/puzzle game about a hungover planet explorer, and his unwanted bot companion. He must utilize many different objects, and manipulate his surroundings, enabling both him, and his support pod to navigate the terrain.

name: One4
short_description: Beat the AI, or your friend in this massively puzzling game in the cubes

name: Paid Trade
short_description: Paid Trade is a frustratingly addictive game where you guess if a random item is worth more than the one you currently possess. The worth is based on Amazon prices. How good are YOU at estimating the value of a completely random item? Try it out now! What is the best streak you can get?

name: Neon Dimension
short_description: Welcome to an old-school arcade game with a modern design, in which you will enjoy exciting visual effects and excellent physics. And the relaxing gameplay is so easy to learn that you'll understand the whole idea after a few tries!

name: Pandemic Heart
short_description: Pandemic Heart is a relaxing visual novel game with multiple endings that set about a wild story of love in the Pandemic or the Outbreak.

name: Haunting At Cliffhouse
short_description: Untangle the story of the family that has occupied Cliffhouse for so many years. Search for clues, solve puzzles, talk to guests, get summoned to a chapel, discover a luscious Japanese garden and find your way through the rainforest. There is so much to discover about the family, the land and the lore.

name: No Parachute
short_description: No Parachute is a fast-paced arcade game with a pixel art style, in which you will dodge various obstacles in free fall. Try to find out what is on the other side of the tunnel, and save your arms and legs along the way!

name: Rotego
short_description: A puzzle platformer where you must tether to finish! Hold space while jumping to shoot out a tether, which will shift the gravity towards any surface it connects with.

name: Curiosity
short_description: "Curiosity killed the cat, but after satisfying it she was resurrected." This game is a visual novel. Features of the game - puzzles and several endings, depending on your choice.

name: Friendly Fire: Arena
short_description: Friendly Fire Arena is a free-to-play 1v1 arena FPS that features parkour, combat and vertical mobility with intense gunplay. Enter the simulation as Sam or Vince and get ready to fight to the death, but don’t worry, no ones really harmed, after all… It's just Friendly Fire.

name: In the Wild
short_description: Play as wild animals in a relaxing open-world island. Discover hundreds of glowing orbs that teach you real-world facts about the animals you control. With dynamic weather, day/night cycles, and narrated facts, In the Wild is a peaceful way to explore and learn.

name: The Bounty Huntress
short_description: In this a Metroidvania style game made in crispy pixel art, Join Rhea , a bounty huntress with a task to save some people who have been kidnapped and taken to an old abandoned castle where there are many dangers, she needs your help to rescue these people and to bring peace to the city of Vaunard

name: Dark Siren
short_description: Be careful not to be captured by the Dark Siren, find the note left by the sailors, uncover the truth, and escape.

name: Frogun
short_description: Join Renata as she adventures across a world of mystical ruins with the titular FROGUN! Frogun is an old-school platformer with the soul of the PS1/N64 era, in which your frog-shaped grappling hook is a your best friend!

name: Once Upon a Sea
short_description: Once Upon a Sea is a poetic, interactive XR documentary telling the tragic tale of the legendary Dead Sea.

name: Seedlings
short_description: An atmospheric 2D puzzle platformer made using real photos and videos from New Zealand's native forest. Become a seed that can possess different plant creatures with unique abilities. Solve the obstacles in your way to discover the secrets of the Seedlings.

name: Fruit Ninja VR 2
short_description: The sequel to the juiciest VR game of all time! Build your collection of blades and bows. Slice your way through unique levels and minigames. Explore the vibrant world of Fruitasia and become a true Fruit Ninja master!

name: Symbiotic Love - Yuri Visual Novel
short_description: Symbiotic Love is a coming-of-age Yuri Visual Novel set in an All Girls' High School. What has fate in store for love so perfect, so symbiotic, that they could only live, and perish together?

name: The Royal Game of Ur 3D
short_description: The oldest board game known to mankind!

name: Alder Forge
short_description: Play as the Five Members of the Fourth Squadron and battle your foes using the game Adaptive Turn-based Combat System. Shape your path in a political fantasy story-driven game, and witness a tired feudal society progressively morph into something new.

name: SOL CRESTA
short_description: SOL CRESTA, rise like the phoenix and take back the sun! Neo-Classic shooting strikes back! Dock, split, and form up! Pilot 3 fighters and take back the sun from the clutches of evil in this free-form shooting game with the spirit of 80s shooting classics Moon Cresta and Terra Cresta.

name: Love Decision
short_description: Kingdoms rise and fall. Everyone has their goals.

name: SNK VS. CAPCOM: THE MATCH OF THE MILLENNIUM
short_description: Back in 1999, SNK and CAPCOM brought their best fighters together for a fighting game extravaganza! The dream collaboration that can fit in your hands can now be enjoyed on Steam!

name: BlasterBeat
short_description: BlasterBeat is the award-winning PvP rhythm-shooter. Master shooting to a unique variety of tracks in dynamic and innovative gameplay in arenas that shine on the beat.

name: Super Maze Labyrinth
short_description: It's time to relax and enjoy the art of finding your way out of the mazes of Super Maze Labyrinth. Park the haste, enjoy the music and the experience through the 100 mazes divided into 5 visual themes that this game offers you.

name: AutoChess of Gensokyo
short_description: "AutoChess of Gensokyo" is a Touhou Project multi-player AutoChess-Like game. Draw character from the deck, build your combination, upgrade the character, and fight with other players. Keep optimizing your combination to win the game.

name: Descending I - House of Nightmares
short_description: Descending is a VR horror game with puzzle elements. You play as the new owner of a house and your goal is to break the curse that was cast upon the estate.

name: ShapeVS
short_description: ShapeTECH welcomes you to participate in their latest aptitude assessment program, ShapeVS. Gather your friends, family members and even colleagues as you participate in a variety of mini-games designed to test your capability of supporting our new society.

name: Flawless Abbey
short_description: You are a dreamseeker. At least, that's what she wants you to believe. Play every role, open every door, and delve into cosmic debates with dolls that seem to know far more than they should. But remember, above all - don't break her heart.

name: Wander Stars
short_description: Unleash custom attacks by combining words in this Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG! Collect all 200 words, earn Pep Ups from honorable victories and become a Kiai master. Befriend your rivals, uncover dark mysteries, and seek out the pieces of the Wanderstar map in a wild race across the universe.

name: ArcRunner
short_description: Traverse 'The Arc' in this beautiful, Cyberpunk-styled action rogue-lite as you attempt to reset an evil rogue AI. Experiment with different weapons and augments as you fight hordes of machines programmed for your annihilation! Collect Nanites & power-up after every run either solo or with friends!

name: BasCatball Saturn: Basketball & Cat
short_description: Play basketball. In Saturn. With cats. Are you ready for the whole galaxy's hardest matches? Solve puzzles and win the Bascatball intergalactic championship!

name: UpGun
short_description: Face your friends in UpGun! Use each round to accumulate skills and overtake your opponents in this crazy deathmatch!

name: Old Stories: Fireheart
short_description: You play as an adventurer, who got stranded on the island called "Keron". Assemble other adventuers and take them in your party, defeat monsters, fulfill quests, get stronger and defeat the 'Fire worshippers'.

name: Cyberdunk Anime Edition
short_description: Cute waifu are ready to thank you for your help, hero. Quickly save the city from enemies to free all of them.

name: Sins of a Solar Empire II
short_description: Battle for galactic dominance in this real-time 4X strategy game with unrivaled scale! You’ll explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate through military force, diplomacy, trade, culture, influence, and other underhanded tactics.

name: Wisly and the Chickens!
short_description: Wisly and the Chickens! Is an 2D platform runner. The game tells the comical history of the chicken coop revolt against a lovely weasel. Help Wisly to find the cage parts to capture the evil Galinacio and thus to explain to the chickens this big misunderstanding. Let's RUN!

name: The Exaggerated Epoch of Edward O'Hare
short_description: The Exaggerated Epoch of Edward O'Hare is an action-adventure story game set in an imaginary toy world! Players will traverse the toy-filled landscape and story while combating enemies along the way. TEEEO takes players on an odyssey that will usher nostalgia and excitement for all!

name: Tuesday JS visual novel engine
short_description: The editor is designed to create interactive fiction, graphic or kinetic novels without knowledge of programming languages.

name: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~
short_description: This is a story about finding love to overwrite the feelings for the one they held dearest. A girls love visual novel about summer, love and adolescence.

name: Twisted Tower
short_description: Blast your way through an abandoned theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win the prize and the love of your life.

name: Pain Party
short_description: Pain Party is a game that combines precise movement mechanics with the chaos of a game show. Fight through the story mode or compete with up to 24 players in the online party mode. But remember, one hit and it's all over. Let the party begin!

name: Saighead
short_description: Saighead! Play as a bow and arrow through multiple levels aiming to hit the target. With bounce-pads, portals, and gravity fields to get through, hitting the target is not as easy as it looks.

name: Super Pixel World
short_description: A fun platformer game, where you're after a "friend" that owes you money, you'll find or buy abilities, discover new exits until you defeat the final boss, so you can set your friend free... Or not?

name: SuperOffice
short_description: SuperOffice is an intense top down view shooter experience where time moves only when you move.

name: Heisen Bay
short_description: A beautiful, 3rd-person exploration and adventure game. Tommy, the main character in the game, is trying to find out what happened to his comrades in Heisen Bay, an area that leads to multiple mysterious events.

name: IdolDays
short_description: Can a delinquent girl transform into an idol?! A love-adventure game where you can enjoy the heart-pounding roommate life of a rookie producer and a delinquent girl turned idol.

name: 2002XX
short_description: The Ultimate Trip

name: JUNK: The Legend of Junichi Kato
short_description: This is the story of Junichi Kato after he reached the top of the world. On December 31st, New Year's Eve, Junichi is suddenly captured, and when he wakes up, he finds himself there... The world of 200 years later and the true identity of the Katroid are revealed. Save the world with your friends!

name: mir
short_description: You are lost, you are small, and the forest is ever-changing. Exchange favours with monsters in classic adventure fashion to escape the increasingly dark expanse, or succumb to the horrors that reside within.

name: LumberQwaxes
short_description: Chop to it!! It's time to get your girl back. You play as Qwackeric in this side-scrolling action adventure. Play through ten lumbering stages. Left and right keys move and up arrow to jump, space to attack and escape to pause the game. Our Hero Heads to Start his new life as a LumberQwaxes!!

name: Protoplasm-Mutiny
short_description: When the defense collapses, the rebels invade the base and escape has become the only choice. Take the people you care about and get out of the siege.

name: An Un-epic story: The adventure of Enki and Tiny Freddie
short_description: Enki and Freddie's contract was simple: defeat a nearby river monster. They knew tentacles would be an issue, but there are other complications too… For example, who left the strange marks on their hands? How do they get rid of them? Find the answers to these mysteries by reading "An Un-epic Story"

name: The Shadow of Yidhra
short_description: Delta wakes up from the explosion。 Found the surrounding area has been overrun by zombies。 In the escape from the Institute on the way to save the strange girl named Rei。 Find out the truth about the world and lead the survivors to live through this disaster。

name: Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to the big show! Ready the camera, unleash your creativity and and pile up the profits! Grow your operation with your razor-sharp business sense and usher in a new era for filmmakers worldwide.

name: Dr Iwan: Evolution
short_description: Dr Iwan is a hardcore turn-based roguelike game. Obtain, manage, upgrade your abilities during programmed generation journey. Last character who was built and ended last game by you will become final boss in new plus game. Defeat yourself and become the stronger one!

name: Blair Witch VR
short_description: Blair Witch: VR Edition is a story-driven psychological horror game from the creative minds behind the critically acclaimed The Medium. Experience first-hand the toll that fear can take on the mind in an original story inspired by the cinematic lore of Blair Witch, designed for Virtual Reality.

name: REPLIKATOR
short_description: In this twin stick roguelite shooter, you play as one of the galactic mercenaries, explore a mysterious scientific complex and uncover the secret of the REPLIKATOR project.

name: Blightseeker
short_description: Jump and dash through unknown, labyrinthine worlds in this VR adventure. Fight back against maddened creatures, or cure them of the blight that fuels their rage. Collect treasures, tools, and powers as you search for the source of this ancient ill, and decide whether to quell or unleash it.

name: Black Trail VR
short_description: Black Trail is a VR shooter, set in an epic war in the Old West. Play as a seasoned bounty hunter and a vengeful Native American warrior, follow their interwoven stories, use a wide range of weapons, explore ravaged lands, and fight as you chase newly discovered artifacts to change the fate of war.

name: Memento Vivere
short_description: Dekar is a noble warrior who has a estranged relationship with his father. After abandoning his rights to the throne and choosing to live a simple life, everything changes for him when a Winged One crashes into his village asking for his help. The fate of the world now lies on his shoulders.

name: Ultima Adventum
short_description: It lies upon the shoulders of Alana and other three Arises, fated individuals, to stop the plague that is to come. Through the darkest dungeons and longest journeys, they must build the courage and power to save their world.

name: Dark Sheep
short_description: Dark Sheep is a block-pushing puzzle game with horror elements, and a love letter to the Commodore 64. Classic Sokoban, new twists. Throughout the game, you'll be accompanied by a soundtrack created with genuine 1989 technology.

name: CLOCKWORK PUSSY
short_description: A young mechanic and former nymphomaniac sex worker inherits a massive vehicle repair workshop from her late client. However, this workshop is located on a remote island, in the heart of a neighborhood controlled by a dangerous gang of criminal outcasts.

name: Sociopat
short_description: Sociopat is an absurd comedy driven game that combines point and click adventure with action packed FPS game. Play in a role of an anti-hero and do some mischievous acts, NOW!

name: WaveTiles
short_description: A two-player co-op puzzle platformer. Use colored energy Waves to activate the corresponding Tiles in order to create paths that lead to the end of each level. You are challenged to communicate constantly and advance together while facing danger and hidden traps with the help of magical abilities!

name: Otaku Club
short_description: Otaku Club is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: DownhillVR
short_description: DownhillVR is the ultimate virtual reality mountain biking video game that brings the thrill of extreme downhill racing right to your living room. Experience the rush of speeding down challenging tracks and catching air off jaw-dropping jumps, all while immersing yourself in stunning environments.

name: Legend Of Maratha Warriors
short_description: The best action game dedicated to our beloved Warrior King ‘Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj’. Immerse yourself in one of the fast paced horse riding casual action game, with stunning visuals and sound. Defeat the enemies and get pass through the traps set on the way to secure the fort.

name: Stories of Submission: eNTeR the cuck
short_description: Alex always got whatever he wanted. Then he met Stacy and she started giving him what he needed. Follow his netorare adventure as Stacy molds a worthless, spoiled man into a good cuck.

name: Matraquinha PAIR
short_description: Boost cognitive and visual skills in a fun way with Matraquinha PAIR! A matching game designed for autistic children and teens, with delightful illustrations, gentle sounds, and evolving challenges that grow with each player.

name: Mission Mars
short_description: Mission Mars is an action FPS inspired by the shooters of the '90s. The game features an intense single player experience set on Mars in the 22nd century.

name: Left Alone: Rebirth
short_description: Left Alone: Rebirth is a first-person psychological thriller, with a heavy focus on story and exploration. Delve into a sinister world, with atmospheric and chilling interiors. All is not as it seems in these eerily tranquil and gut wrenchingly realistic environments.

name: PLAYBOOK
short_description: PLAYBOOK is a new approach to a music video network - playable music videos.

name: Armageddon Empires
short_description: Armageddon Empires is a computer turn based strategy game that takes the best elements of collectable card games, board games, and computer games and brings them all together to provide a unique interactive strategy war game experience.

name: One Escape
short_description: Three friends. One Escape.

name: Gravity run
short_description: Run to the finish line across planets and space objects

name: Superhero Recruitment Simulator
short_description: Miss being in the office? Want a career in recruitment? Obsessed with superhero's? Superhero Recruitment Simulator is your opportunity for you to work within the industry as a recruiter!

name: WWII Online: Chokepoint
short_description: WWII Online: Chokepoint is an authentic F2P WW2 multiplayer tactical shooter, driven by teamwork and built-in voice comms. Jump in feet first with the US Airborne or join the Wehrmacht and fight to control iconic chokepoints as an infantryman in Europe between 1944-45. Are you ready for WAR?

name: FPS Tactics
short_description: Control a group of special agents, find a monster on the map and place the agents so that they can defeat the monster

name: Ball Challenge

name: Battle for Sea 3D
short_description: Naval battles of ships. Turn-based tactical battles.

name: Labyrinth Hearts
short_description: Single-player GACHA game with side battle system. Upgrade your town and befriend/romance many of the characters you collect!

name: Wicked Lands
short_description: Slay your enemies, explore a wicked fantasy realm and unleash crazy combinations of items, artefacts and arcane spells! Break the time loop that grips the Wicked Lands in the ultimate fusion of turn-based tactics, deck-building, and rogue-lites!

name: Russian Mailman Simulator
short_description: This is an epic first person simulation game where the player defends his mail truck, while delivering letters to the local Russian population. The player must upgrade his gear, survive radiation sickness, and fight wave after wave to fulfill his duty!

name: Baron Magic
short_description: Baron Magic is a Medieval indie action game in which a wizard will try to save his village from monsters. In his arcane arsenal he has elemenatis powers of fire, Ice light and shadows and various magical artifacts to expand his power and help him on his dangerous journey.

name: Where is my mom
short_description: Where is my mom [/] The game tells a story about the fate of a girl who was stolen.Waking up in the house, she does not understand how she ended up there.All she wants now is to escape from captivity and find her family.A side-scrolling game.

name: Rooten
short_description: There is only you and the Forest. In "Rooten" there are no compulsory tasks, time just goes by, and days pass by independently of you. You can explore the Forest, try to get out, or even do nothing at all. The forest has always been here, and always will be. You won't change it no matter what.

name: Melody of Seasons
short_description: Farming RPG and Life Sim. Harvest crops, raise livestock, forage, fish, mine, craft, and cook. Get to know the locals. Collect items and uncover mysteries. Customize your appearance, upgrade your house and improve your farm. Get married. Have a kid. Make grandpa proud! Live the farmer life!

name: Spacey Vade
short_description: Synth-wave styled physics based 2D puzzle shooter filled with nods to the golden era of classic arcade games. Think upside down Peggle crossed with Space Invaders and enemies crafted from the blended remains 70's, and 80’s gaming.

name: Elevated
short_description: Jump into Elevated, an action arcade shooter where you must battle to survive against constant, ever growing waves of robotic enemies. Unlock new weapons, face harder opponents, and smash your friends high scores on the online leaderboards!

name: Perseverance Mission - Astronaut Charlie
short_description: Perseverance Mission - Astronaut Charlie is a puzzle game set on Mars. Charlie is a cat astronaut aboard his Rover and he needs your help.

name: RescueTeam
short_description: A single player TPS game where you must go on a rescue mission and return undercover agents to safety. Explore open world maps , collect coins , buy weapons and reach the highest score possible. Multi player mode , a TDM game with 2 teams fighting each other for the win .

name: Aquarist - My First Job
short_description: Get your first job in the Aquarist! Learn how to set up aquarium, decorate it and take care of your fish!

name: Medieval Machines Builder
short_description: Medieval - times of constant sieges. Acquire plans, gather resources, create most powerful and destructive machines and then test them in battle. Thanks to your creations you will conquer more than one castle. The knights wage wars, but thanks to your machines they win them.

name: TrinityS
short_description: TrinityS condenses the thrilling elements of MMO RPG endgame encounters into a white-knuckle, "Boss Rush" cooperative online action game for up to three players. Skip the MMO level grind and face off against fearsome foes that require precise coordination to defeat!

name: Devil, It's me
short_description: Devil, It’s Me is a game where you can build your own castle to defend against the waves of heroes set forth to defeat Magrandes. You play from the perspective of Magrandes to manage your castle. Fend off the endless hordes of heroes, overcome the odds and uncover the truth!

name: Cloud Cutter
short_description: Cloud Cutter brings you classic arcade shoot ‘em up gameplay in top notch graphics. Enjoy intense fast-paced explosive action full of epic destruction, arcade style power-ups, lasers and of course huge multi-stage boss fights.

name: Green Phoenix
short_description: Green Phoenix is an on-rails arcade-like space shooter melted with a deep narrative experience which focuses on the concept of ego and the true meaning of freedom.

name: Dark Frame
short_description: Simple platformer in a dark setting

name: Plan A
short_description: Carefully plan your team's tactics in close quarters battles. Use the timeline to synchronize each door breach, grenade throw and room entry with precision. Watch your team execute your plan autonomously in epic cinematic replays. Take on challenging roguelike campaigns or standalone missions.

name: The Hero We Need
short_description: Create your own distinctive towers, enhance only the necessary components, and experiment with them in quick battle mode. THWN enables you to craft each tower individually using runes that determine the projectile and its effects, giving you the freedom to adopt strategies that suit your play style.

name: Duck Creator
short_description: Duck Creator, Create your own Duck!

name: AGAINST
short_description: AGAINST is a combat rhythm VR game that will immerse you in a dark comics story. Follow the beat to shoot and slice your way through evil henchmen of Dr. Vice. Empowering music is your only way out from these crime-ridden streets.

name: JumpBeard
short_description: Challenge awaits you in this platformer journey, where you take control of one legged captain called Rupert the JumpBeard in your tactical jumping adventure where your only way to go is upwards to find a mythical treasure but be wary, every missed jump will result in a fall back where you started.

name: Faerie's Bargain: The Price of Business
short_description: Become the greatest of the goblin merchants in this gaslamp faery-tale! Buy and sell secrets and memories! Trade in time, shadows, and stranger things!

name: Hungry Galaxies
short_description: HUNGRY GALAXIES is a deadly space survival game. Seek out constellations of Star Matter to grow your mass and evolve, increasing your gravity and gaining new abilities. But watch out! Space is a dangerous place.

name: Lakeburg Legacies
short_description: Take fate into your own hands in Lakeburg Legacies, a social-based village management sim where love is your favourite resource. Play matchmaker to create the most effective, and most loved up, couples and help your kingdom thrive. How long will it take you to crown a sovereign?

name: Park Story
short_description: Unravel handcrafted puzzle dungeons and confront your demons in Park Story — a reimagination of the classic top-down action RPG. Trapped, Parker must defeat Caim to escape haunted Mahagow Glen Country Park, helping friendly ghosts with unfinished business and unlocking the park’s deepest secrets.

name: Lost in Labs
short_description: Control the mind of your enemies in this stealth platformer. In Lost in Labs, Lucian will have to save his best friend, Amber. For that, he'll have to sneak around, distracting and possessing those who are in his way, in order to proceed.

name: Warhammer Quest: Silver Tower
short_description: Turn-based strategy battles in the Age of Sigmar! Dive into one of our huge campaigns, or jump in to a Daily Quest. Over 35 Champions from the Age of Sigmar to collect, each with unique gameplay, weapons and skills. Pick your best team, level up, and go adventuring!

name: JUNKPUNK
short_description: JUNKPUNK is a factory management, base building, exploration game where a New World Robotics ship has crash landed. You and any survivors must restore this ruined planet and prepare it for habitable life. Craft, build, explore, discover, and grow to terraform the planet.

name: Dark Forest: Lost Story VR
short_description: In this horror game we will tell you truthful stories about demons and ghosts.

name: Death Upon Us
short_description: Death Upon Us, is a game in which you will use your arsenal of guns to pull off cunning, exciting, and adrenaline pumping maneuvers to conquer levels in this game. Watch as your skills take you from killing a small horde of zombies in the School Yard to killing an abundance of zombies in the Temple.

name: Cliffhanger: Challenger of Tomorrow
short_description: Punch out Fascists and unravel conspiracies in this pulp adventure set in a retro-futuristic 1930s world of airships, fast cars, and two-fisted action!

name: Snow War
short_description: In the cold of an arctic apocalypse the human race is stuck in the 80’s and the only thing left to do is sling snowballs at your friends and foes!

name: The Cryptologist Room
short_description: The Cryptologist Room is a puzzle driven game that will test your cryptology skills to the limit! With the most difficult puzzles you can imagine! Are you able to escape the building in time?

name: VERSUS: The Deathscapes
short_description: When a new threat emerges on planet Versus, you and your allies are forced to explore the dreaded Deathscapes to survive.

name: Secrets of Egypt
short_description: Secrets of Egypt is a casual puzzle game made in 2D graphics.

name: Drova - Forsaken Kin
short_description: Drova is an Action-RPG that marries the dark grim tones of its genre with the mysticism of Celtic mythology. Encounter a society where ancient restless spirits and divided factions battle for dominance. Uncover forgotten abilities and unravel the secrets of a past shrouded in mystery.

name: MechaNest
short_description: Explore Scifi third person action-adventure game MechaNest. City on the planet Merador where the citizens are overthrown by Ai and Mecha's. But be careful MechaNest is full with traps, mazes and vicious Mechanics.

name: Melatonin
short_description: Melatonin is a rhythm game about dreams and reality merging together. It uses animations and sound cues to keep you on beat without any intimidating overlays or interfaces. Harmonize through a variety of dreamy levels containing surprising challenges, hand-drawn art, and vibrant music.

name: CorePiercer
short_description: Because of the increase in solar radiation, the surface of the earth will soon be unable to sustain life, and people will need to move to the ground in the future. Therefore, scientists have developed high-tech trains that can shuttle underground efficiently.

name: Dead Ice
short_description: In the future, humans conquered the stars and colonized other planets. In the bowels of the icy planet, scientists have discovered a natural and safe source of energy. But at the same time, they awakened an ancient alien life form. There is a conflict on the planet. Volunteers come to the rescue.

name: The Space Between
short_description: The Space Between is a surreal short narrative experience in three acts about the walls we build for us.

name: Restart Zero
short_description: In 2237, a global health crisis leads a high-tech lab to use their AI supercomputer to find a cure. It realizes humans are the problem and creates an algorithm to control them. Strange things happen worldwide, and the player, in a cyberpunk city, must stop the supercomputer and save humanity.

name: Survival Z
short_description: There are 3 rules for surviving the zombie apocalypse: Shoot, Survive, Repeat.

name: Stellar Raid
short_description: Stellar Raid is a side-scrolling run and gun game inspired by the greatest classic games of the genre! With a variety of weapon upgrades at your disposal (including a support drone) you’ll charge through hordes of enemy mercenaries to take down one of the Universe’s most notorious space terrorists!

name: Live/Wire
short_description: Live/Wire is a competitive multiplayer arena FPS with a sci-fi edge. Players face off in intense 4v4 matches, wielding an arsenal of electricity-powered guns, and a recharging plug that doubles as a grappling hook. Swing around the city, call down the thunder, and then bolt before the cops show up.

name: Throb of Lovegirl: A Ero Waifu TD
short_description: A roguelite tower defense game. Deploy your soldiers and dominate the battlefield with their unique abilities. Choose your path in adventure and make your soldiers grow. Alpha rewards her soldiers 😏

name: Code Zero
short_description: Code Zero is a counter strike-inspired 5 vs 5 tactical shooter where each team has a set amount of lives before they are eliminated and the round is lost. Code Zero puts an emphasis on team coordination and precise gunplay.

name: Gjallarhorn
short_description: Two years following the Second Great War, the Osirian Empire wrestles with finding a new ruler. While each faction sees a different future for their people, decisions are made by strength, not through ideals, and only the dead have seen the end of war.

name: Bullfrogs
short_description: Bullfrogs is the flagship title from Thunderworks Games designed by Keith Matejka. It’s a light, family-friendly card game that offers strategic gameplay through simple rules.

name: Torii
short_description: Let's fall together.

name: Trash
short_description: A co-op adventure crafting game where you restore balance to a trashy world. Jump, Glide, Shield or Smash your way around a wild open world, complete procedurally generated challenge zones, interact with rubbish creatures and customise your character with crafted forms & abilities.

name: The Power Latch Kid
short_description: Play as the Power Latch Kid in this classic arcade style twin-stick shump! Enjoy the complex gameplay experience of physics melding with shooting anarchy! How long can you stand to dwell within the crushing madness of the Amalgotron?

name: BloodType
short_description: BloodType is a "Type'em Up," word-based, wave survival game. You must form words from randomly generated word scrambles to defeat your opponents. Test your vocabulary knowledge through 30 different stages all while under the pressure of advancing enemies.

name: Escape - The Speedrun Game
short_description: The premise of the game is to escape the game level as quickly as possible. This is a great game for speed running!

name: Anima Island
short_description: Anima Island is a 2D virtual pet monster-raising rpg with strategic real-time battles and handpainted 16-bit SNES-style pixel art!

name: Engine Evolution 2021
short_description: Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of the World of Tanks. With each PvP race against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, which you can use to buy various upgrades or unlock the next motorbike.

name: After
short_description: In the thick of a dustbowl—where the poor beg for scraps from the rich—play as a driver trying to survive the wastelands taking any job he can to get by. Caught between a hail of bullets and a colorful cast of characters, the fate of the community rests on your decisions. Drive fast, choose wisely.

name: Denari
short_description: Denari is a narrative action game about a boy with telekinetic powers who must fight to save his people from the invasion of an empire.

name: Lords of the Darkreign
short_description: Descend into the sunless lands! A three-way civil war ravages the realm, while an enigmatic order tries to conquer all for their draconic master. Take the role of a lord leading an army, and bring triumph to your cause! Annihilate all who defy you, and stand alone beneath the swirling sky!

name: MAYBE I CAN
short_description: Welcome, we're putting you in the brain of Tyler Lee who wants to destroy the world. But it won't be easy. Tyler is going to get in a lot of trouble. Let's see if you can get Tyler Lee to achieve his goal.

name: Tower Of Wishes: Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: Tower Of Wishes is a family friendly, fun Match 3. The game also includes mini games such as Hidden Object, Find Differences, Chain Solitaire and Sliders for that bit of extra fun!

name: 便利商店‪6
short_description: 打造最輕鬆易玩的經營遊戲 ! 建設最有特色的【 便利商店 】! 玩家可以輕輕鬆鬆來經營一家或多家【 便利商店 】的模擬遊戲小品，透過不同的地區選擇、裝潢、擺設、貨架、請人、進貨及宣傳等等，都可以由自己隨意處理，享受一個更易玩的經營作品。

name: Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale
short_description: Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale is a relaxing puzzle game with colorful visuals, beautiful music and a fully voiced modern fairy tale told in rhyme. Solve intuitive puzzles, collect feathers, gems and coins, discover new mechanics as you progress and enjoy the unique themes each chapter unlocks.

name: Don't Ask Succubus
short_description: "Don't Ask the Succubus" is a yuri novel in mystical setting, mix of 2D and 3D images. The light humor of the narrative turns into the heat of passions and terrible challenges for heroines.

name: Colorize Inspect
short_description: In this little game you have to choose the appropriate color.

name: Tales of the Black Death
short_description: An interactive story that pins your morality against your survival.

name: LaserShotz
short_description: LaserShotz is an online PvP competitive arena shooter! Compete for the best rating on the leaderboards!

name: Endless Furry Ping-Pong
short_description: Welcome to Endless Furry Ping-Pong! The 7th installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! This game is a simple recreation of the classic Pong game, but with a furry twist!

name: Project Hunter
short_description: Stealth and tactic game that give you the control of an alien that evolves, adquire new abilities and face levels in various ways.

name: Color Souls
short_description: Color Souls is a Fast-paced Splatformer where platforms are invisible and you have to paint them. Walk, Jump, Double Jump, Slide and Wall Jump to paint everything, A vast amount of difficult levels for you challenge and powerful bosses to beat.

name: Acras
short_description: A High Fantasy top down Strategy RPG. Featuring a colorful and diverse cast of characters, free movement turn based strategy combat, a unique spell and inventory upgrade system, topped of with an engaging and dramatic story. Built from the ground up to support how you like to play your rpg's.

name: eteeConnect
short_description: eteeConnect is the accompanying software to your eteeControllers. Configure your eteeControllers to your preferences and keep them updated to the latest software and driver versions.

name: Car Drive
short_description: Car Drive is a game where you need to get to the finish line by transport.

name: Alone in the Office
short_description: You will play as office worker who was left to finish the job. While working on last documents you starting hearing strange sounds. How could this be? You are pretty sure that you are alone in the office.

name: Liberte
short_description: Liberté is a deck-builder roguelite inspired by the French Revolution and body horror. Brave the war-torn streets as Rene - a regular Parisian entangled in a civil war caused by a cryptic invader from another dimension, Lady Bliss. Collect cards, nurture alliances, and try to stay alive!

name: Shillelagh
short_description: Shillelagh (Shil-lay-lah) is a fast and frantic arena shooter where players are armed with the aura of nature to defend against destructive, undead monsters.

name: Self-Delusion
short_description: Self-Delusion is a first-person survival horror in the original setting of Slavic fairy tales. You will faces such unique monsters like: Kolobok, Leshy, Boggart, Lapot and other creepy creatures. Explore, hide or run. Just don't get devoured by them.

name: Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane
short_description: In Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane, you play as a defense attorney who practices law in a world of fantasy and wizards. You must defend clients accused of various crimes committed using magic and use the rules of magic to prove them innocent.

name: Junkpunk: Arena
short_description: Junkpunk Arena is an arena combat game in which the player controls robots that they designed from various pieces of junk. The gameplay consists entirely of online competitive multiplayer in which the player's robots are pitted against each other.

name: Cube Space
short_description: Cube Space is a minimalist arcade Shoot `em Up game set in space. You control a spaceship and your task is to score as many points as possible by destroying enemies and obstacles in your path.

name: Partitas
short_description: The melody-based puzzle game. Enjoy listening carefully to the instrumental classics and restore all the sheet music. How far can you take your hearing talent?

name: Bro Falls
short_description: Bro Falls is an asymmetric massively multiplayer party game with chaotic elements, trap activations and big Falls. Up-to 60 online players in a showdown party and only one who can get the victory. Play as Brokkoli to activate the traps or avoid them as a juicy food and win the rounds.

name: Lasagna Boy
short_description: An adventure horror game with a Gameboy aesthetic. Lasagna boy brings a mix of puzzle, adventure, and platforming along with some minor shooting elements, all packaged together in a charming yet haunting pixel art style.

name: He Needs His Medicine
short_description: You have been dispatched for a 911 call. From the moment you step inside the apartment, you realize something is really wrong with the place. You are gonna make Him the last dosage. He needs his medicine.

name: Bonhomme 7 Heures
short_description: An exploration horror game set in a typical 1850 house which revolve around the myth of Bonhomme 7 Heures, an urban legend from Quebec.

name: ACE Overheat
short_description: Battle in exciting 2D Roguelike air combat. Choose your plane, face enemies and bosses. Manage heat levels to keep it performing well. Buy items and upgrade skills to make your plane stronger. Explore beautiful maps and tackle challenges. Fly high, stay cool, and become the air combat elite!

name: YoyoMonkeyAdventure
short_description: “悠悠猴大冒险”是一款多人平台合作游戏。相互配合，不断移动，为了取得的圣雪莲前进！

name: Snow Daze: Redaze
short_description: Critical Bliss and Outbreak Games join forces to deliver a retelling of the original hypno romp! You play as Jason, a fledgling musician who has strange desires for his family. Unable to keep his lust in check, Jason comes up with a plan to hypnotize all the voluptuous women in the house.

name: OmniGrav
short_description: A gravity-bending 2D platformer where you are tasked with retrieving items from a hostile planet. In order to get around you must bend the laws of time and space by shifting the direction of gravity and reversing the flow of time.

name: Before Began 开始之前
short_description: A word adventure game with open world elements Time change as time goes by in reality and in the game Different NPCs have their own living habits Players can control the character to explore the city Trigger the mutual influence of various events, affect the final outcome of "Li"

name: 外兽祭·兽人们的冒险酒馆
short_description: 以Furry为角色的传统日式RPG。 操作犬兽人“托姆”在剑与魔法与科技（？）的世界中体验邂逅同伴、冒险与奇遇的故事。

name: OPPAI Academy Big, Bouncy, Booby Babes!
short_description: Get reincarnated into a fantasy world, take on the role of the protagonist Takumi, and use your magic to get all the girls! Clear various quests to progress the main story of this gorgeous FANTASY VISUAL NOVEL, and capture the attractive heroines' hearts along the way!

name: Savior of the Abyss
short_description: Savior of the Abyss is a horror adventure game. To avoid sudden death, always pay attention and be suspicious of things around you. Collect and use a variety of tools to get to the surface. Please lead the protagonist safely so that the protagonist can achieve his or her purpose safely.

name: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2
short_description: A young girl needs to find her friends, unravel a dark mystery and escape the clutches of her cursed toys.

name: Erotic Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: Challenging 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzle featuring soft erotic sex scenes by Lolita LineArt, on a smooth luxury graphical background.

name: PandaSG
short_description: A little cute panda, holding a gun to defend its little hometown...

name: My Military Life
short_description: 전역은 오는가(My Military Life)는 제작자의 군 생활을 바탕으로 만든 추리·군대 쯔꾸르입니다. 저와 함께 군 생활을 하면서 사라진 분대카드를 찾아 무사히 전역하도록 합시다.

name: The Dinosaurs Are Here
short_description: The Dinosaurs Are Here is a physics-based sandbox game set in a huge park where you control a dinosaur. Hunt for humans and try to survive against the park security guards!

name: Helping the Hotties
short_description: Helping the Hotties is a unique adult visual novel harem game filled with gorgeous girls, humor, exciting secrets, and spicy romance set in a hot summer. It’s time to enjoy your summer in a whole new way.

name: JARS
short_description: JARS is a strategy game featuring puzzles and elements of tower defense. Join Victor in his spooky yet endearing world and prepare for a quest to uncover the secrets of his family’s basement. Will you save the world or get grounded by mother?

name: Metal Slug Tactics
short_description: METAL SLUG makes an explosive return! Dive into this dynamic tactical RPG with a roguelite thrill and experience the iconic run'n'gun action of the original series, redefined. Grab your weapons, assemble your squad and conquer the battlefield to defeat the infamous Rebel Army.

name: Russian Pawn Store
short_description: Take on the role of a Soviet pawnshop owner! Buy a variety of goods in your boutique and sell them at auction. Find used equipment in the junkyard or find interesting items in neighboring blocks of flats. Trade and get rich! Enjoy the nightclub scene, fight the competition and show who's boss!

name: Depths Of Horror: Mushroom Day
short_description: This is a 3D first-person adventure and horror game that lets you plunge deep into your fears. A unique cave system, enemies and screamers. While picking mushrooms in a clearing, you stumble upon an abandoned hut. Exploring it, you find yourself in a cave full of unexpected inhabitants and surprises

name: DeadOS
short_description: DeadOS is an early access zombie outbreak simulator by Benn Powell that focuses on city-wide scenarios where you have access to fully customize your apocalypse experience from beginning to end. Simulation. Sandbox. Survival!

name: Craft & Survive
short_description: Are you ready to survive in a zombie apocalypse world with your friends? Virus is spreading in the open world and undead zombies are everywhere. Now you need to use all your survival and shooting skills to stop them! Prepare yourself for FPS game - Craft & Survive.

name: Forgive Me Father
short_description: Forgive Me Father is a dark retro horror FPS set in a comic book style world inspired by the novels of H.P. Lovecraft. As the only one left with full senses, you begin a journey in search of answers and relief. How long can you last?

name: The Wave Story
short_description: A totally mysterious and enigmatic game, can you discover the end of this story?

name: Namnokh
short_description: Namnokh is a Puzzle-Platformer where you take on the role of the nomadic Wanderer. After discovering an ancient sentient Box, you must use it's powers to bounce, change it's weight and pass through certain parts of the environment to traverse the ruins of Namnokh.

name: Woebegone Woods
short_description: Woebegone Woods is a casual worker placement game with a focus on relationship building. Enter the Woebegone Woods, a small, warm village in the middle of a cold and remote forest!

name: Run Eternal Depths
short_description: Can you escape? Explore ever-changing dungeons, face dangerous enemies, and challenge a powerful boss. With each floor, the trials grow harder, and the foes become stronger. Test your skills and prove that you are the one who can triumph and earn your freedom!

name: Help me please
short_description: You can't negotiate with zombies, you can't bribe or promise something in return, they will slowly but surely follow you wherever you go to destroy you. It's impossible to hide from zombies, they always sense where you're hiding. The only way to escape is to destroy them first.

name: The Station: Escape Room
short_description: Escape the confinement of the space station and restart the systems to gain freedom. Cooperative Escape Room style game to challenge yourself and your friends. Seven rooms to solve the amazing and challenging mysteries before the timer runs out!

name: Idle Roboto
short_description: Build levels to collect scrap metal. Unlock more blocks with different purposes! New robots with different reactions to them!

name: Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's
short_description: 90's teen Delia has disappeared in an abandoned arcade and it’s up to you to find her in this thrilling VR escape room adventure! Solve challenging puzzles and discover mysterious clues, all while playing awesome retro 90's arcade games!

name: SCP: Undeads Winter's
short_description: Undeads Winter's is a fps zombies shooter with a short story based on "o5 ordinary man" using "scp 108".

name: Death Walk
short_description: The world is different. The virus has changed people, they are alive, well I think. they have become canibal. I don't understand, am I too infested? can mankind still be saved?

name: Experience the Energy: Take the Tour
short_description: Experience conventional and automated drilling, SAGD, mining, processing, natural gas and liquids pipelines. Get up close and see the careers and leading-edge technologies that are transforming the Canadian energy industry.

name: Tamarak Trail
short_description: In this deck-building roguelike, you'll use a customizable dice set as you battle through randomly generated trails - full of loot, mysteries, and danger to protect inhabitants from the evil that has corrupted the trail.

name: Lo-Fi Life
short_description: Get up? Or stay in your bed just a few more minutes? A peaceful, small-scale life sim. Go through your mornings and forge your fate with the consequences of your everyday choices.

name: Best Friend
short_description: A 3rd-person exploration game explore a series of dreams and reconnect with your childhood best friend: your French Bulldog. Take control of both a human and French Bulldog as you experience a violently emotional story. Beware of the collectibles. They determine the fate of your friendship.

name: Skyjunk
short_description: Blast and slash your way across the sky in this action roguelite. Armed with your grappling hook and an array of ingenious weapons and gadgets, contend with a mechanized army in procedurally generated levels.

name: Tree Simulator 2022
short_description: It's exactly what it sounds like, but now with 100% more multiplayer. You are the tree and so is everyone else! You are equaled by no other, except maybe the forest... Relax and be the best tree you can be.

name: Dear Future
short_description: Dear Future is a multiplayer wandering game where you photograph a procedural city using an inherited camera. After your session ends, the next player will receive the camera and continue. What will you pass on to those that come after you?

name: World Racing '95
short_description: Race like it's 1995! Classic arcade racing action with split-screen support, a single player story mode packed with 30 tough missions and a cross-country highway with branching routes makes this one of the meanest racers around.

name: Night Blade
short_description: Night Blade is a Multiplayer, Fast-Paced Arena Fight game. Players(2-8) fight in various game modes to win in a cyberpunk arena. Every win will increase the rank of player. Higher ranks, higher rewards.

name: Slime Kingdom - An Unlikely Adventure!
short_description: An adventure with the most unlikeliest of heroes. Gather support from unexpected places as you journey through an expansive, episodic story, full of cheesy humor, quirky characters, monologuing villains and TROPES. Many, many tropes!

name: Uncle Nook's Monster Emporium
short_description: Explore your way through a procedurally generated haunted mansion. Watch out for monsters and deadly traps that block your way. Only with creativity and persistence will you make it out alive!

short_description: Endless waves of enemies are attacking as you attempt to stay alive during your ill-fated quest. Show your honor by fending them off for as long as you can.

name: Hmmsim Metro
short_description: Line 1, the most complicated subway in Seoul, is now coming in PC version. You can feel high immersion with the graphics that realize the actual Seoul scenery, the train driving sound, and the realistic train driving system. Experience the operation of the Seoul subway!

name: I Am The Prosecutor: No Evidence? No Problem!
short_description: I Am The Prosecutor is a non-linear Visual Novel about defending a cute Tomboy named Sophie where you're given just 30 seconds to make the right choice each time. Help make Sophie's case against her abusive mother and give her much needed closure.

short_description: "Wedding" is a true plot based on southern Taiwan in the 1970s. The unique style of shadow puppetry creates intoxicating horror scenes. An abnormal mother, a hanged friend, the source of all visions is directed to the fiancée who died unexpectedly

short_description: This is the story, pure and sometimes frustrating, of two girls intertwined through their fumbling efforts to communicate. Learn a new language and the universal emotions behind our words!

short_description: 《猫头鹰和灯塔》是一款关于黑暗童话的休闲收集游戏。神秘的森林里有一座古旧的灯塔，住着一位沉默的老人，和一只活了1400年的毒舌猫头鹰。日月星辰，四季轮转，无数的客人叩开灯塔大门，述说离奇的故事。光怪陆离，人间百态。

name: Clownfield 2042
short_description: Clownfield 2042 is an FPS where you take the role of a no-clown, equipped with arsenal to fight anyone ahead and win the front. After the 2022 crypto-crash caused by NFT's, the majority of nations collapsed and a union of "No-Clowns" was formed. You are one of them, arm up and get ready for war.

name: SAMURAI WARRIORS 5
short_description: A new SAMURAI WARRIORS begins. After a 7-year wait, a new instalment in the tactical action series "SAMURAI WARRIORS" is finally here!

name: Hard Minus Classic Redux
short_description: Brutal, savage, acid 2D action, where skill of shooting and movement need to be win.

name: Tiny Vikings
short_description: TINY VIKINGS: JOURNEY TO ASGARD is an action adventure game revolving around a gang of Viking children who embark on an adventurous journey to seek the favor of the gods and save their home village from an evil curse.

name: Mondealy: Day One
short_description: Mondealy: Day One is a prologue for the 2D adventure game Mondealy. You can see how adventures in the magical kingdom of Dargratt begin.

name: Traxion 2
short_description: Welcome to TRAXION²! Again you take the role of a daring starship pilot, embarking on a series of break-neck missions into the caves of a dangerous alien planet. This time around, you can join forces with a second player, or challenge each other in deadly deathmatch mode!

name: Bone Mayhem
short_description: Bone Mayhem is a first person shooter versus waves of enemies, where player can apply modifications to weapon and active abilities.

name: Go home, go home?
short_description: 原本閒暇無趣的生活，因一隻白兔全變了調。要趕快找到回家的路，還是留在這瘋狂的世界呢？這是一款以《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》奇幻文學發想的解謎 RPG 小品，採用多結局劇情與獨特的美術風格，並塞入了許多愛刷存在感的蜥蜴比爾。

Cooperation is key as neither of you have the full picture of the case! Play on two devices, local or remotely, all you need is a voice connection.

name: Open Mod 2024.2
short_description: Open Mod is an entirely free to play, niche, tactical, extreme hardcore first person shooter with immersive aspects that may not have been seen before.

name: DEATHRUN TV
short_description: DEATHRUN TV is a fast hardcore rogue-lite twin-stick shooter set in the world's biggest and craziest game show. You'll experience real-time blistering speed and bullet-dodging action as you compete for glory...assuming you’re able to survive in this 2D bullet hell where only “likes” really count.

name: Ultreïa: Prologue
short_description: A little robot becomes a pilgrim and crosses a wild post-apocalyptic world to find the meaning of life.

name: Undying Symphony

name: Liberty Fighters
short_description: Liberty Fighters is a fast-paced top-down extraction shooter with mixed RPG elements. Explore the vast open world space, loot gear or materials and sell it for the best price. Upgrade ships or buy new ones to fight in action tense space combat missions.

name: Avoid The Demons
short_description: Survive the relentless pursuit of demonic entities in "Avoid the Demons." Evade, outsmart, and unravel the mysteries of a haunting realm in this atmospheric and adrenaline-fueled game. Will you escape the darkness or succumb to its malevolent forces?

short_description: Live a year in a small town basketball association. Follow the stories of Fanny, Alex, Remy, Ajiba, Laura, Odile, Benjamin, Amir, Kariem and Meng as the season passes by. Some will join, some will leave. Relax and play some basketball.

name: My Universe - Interior Designer
short_description: Set up your own agency and become the best in town. Listen to your clients' needs and begin to renovate and refurbish their homes by selecting the style most suited to their personalities. Gradually, your reputation will grow and you'll be able to land more and more prestigious projects!

name: The Hurt in Secret
short_description: “The Hurt in Secret” is a visual novel game adapted from true events. Players play a role as practice teacher to experience teachers’ life. They will involve in a troublesome case. In the story, the chosen dialogue will affect directly to the ending.

short_description: There is only Chinese summary about this game. For more information, please change the language to simplified Chinese. There are no words in the game, so the language of the game is all languages. Players all over the world can play the game freely without language restrictions.

name: Randy Blaster 3D
short_description: Battle endless waves of Randy’s evil minions in this retro-style survival FPS. Unlock new map regions and purchase weapons and power-ups from Dandy Randy’s Handy Pantry. Explore Deep Twitch Integration, a new technology allowing streamers to engage with audiences in real-time like never before.

name: Demonsions: Industry
short_description: Demonsions: Industry is an open world, procedurally generated block crafting/building game. Everything can be mined. Enjoy crafting, building, and fully automating your survival in this strange world.

name: Evil Wizard
short_description: Evil Wizard is a humor-filled action RPG that puts you in the shoes of a former Final Boss. Rise from defeat, rediscover long lost powers, and fight to reclaim your castle from an army of so-called heroes.

name: Bean

name: Metal Mars
short_description: Metal Mars is a real time strategy game where you race to gather resources and build on mars! This game can be played locally with a shared screen with up to three friends (4 players total). There are also 30 challenges to complete against the CPU!

name: Play Me
short_description: Play Me is an NSFW sex simulator game that will make you a love guru. Get your skills tested and try to make your girl come to the climax. short_description: Rescue Ryan’s friends from Dark Titan and his evil allies! Explore four worlds packed with slime, hilarious characters, and unlockable costumes on an unforgettable platforming adventure!

name: Fantasy Dungeon VR
short_description: Fantasy Dungeon VR is a roguelike dungeon crawler with gesture-based abilities. Use more than just your sword for fighting.

As the King of the Dead, you can infect humans, turn them into zombies and rule the world!

short_description: Welcome to Suthseg! As the newly commissioned airship captain, forge a mercantile empire across the archipelago, until the great powers of Europa turn their attention toward it. name: Grim Tales: The Final Suspect Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you prove your innocence?

short_description: The Apocalypse came and went. All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of zombies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds.

short_description: 无氪金！休闲养肝！一款有诚意的放置RPG！化身成为梦想调查全世界的魔物而只身一人踏遍整个大陆的有志青年（什么鬼）！

name: Covenanted: Prologue

short_description: Traverse shadows by manipulating light in this 2.5D puzzle platform game. Escape a haunted school as the sibling duo: Skia, who can move across other shadows on the wall, and Lux, who can manipulate the size and placement of shadows for his younger sister to platform across.

In this short game, you play as Lieutenant Alekseï Ivanov, a soldier awaken from his cryo-sleep to face a terrible threat happening in the soviet spaceship "Astralis" lost in an unkown part of the universe. Astralis is FPS horror sci-fi game with retro graphics and sounds.

name: Elewder
short_description: Imprisoned deep within the Succubus dungeon for eons, an opportunity to break free of your shackles presents itself. Rise to power once more, and enact your revenge! Elewder is an erotic top-down, twin-stick shooter with rogue-like elements, can you escape???

name: City 20
