short_description: You're so exhausted you can only crawl, but still refuse to sleep.

name: 此刻探索中
short_description: 這是一款有關迷宮探索的文字遊戲

name: Robin Hood: Hail to the King
short_description: Welcome to Robin Hood's third incredible adventure! From its comical campaign to its hilarious bonus chapter, you will love guiding the legendary Robin Hood and his friends in this new time-management game.

name: Eternal Cycle 永劫之环
short_description: "Eternal Cycle" is an AVG game with adventure and puzzle theme. The protagonist explores caves by various props. Throughout the exploration process, the protagonist escapes from different monsters to seek survival. As the exploration continue, the protagonist himself undergones some subtle changes.

name: Beans or Bones
short_description: A fun 2-player online co-op pirate game for having a good time with your best buddy. Stranded on a cannibal island, your only chance of survival is to make the cannibals like veggie food. Go on quests, fly with birds, paddle in a barrel, and use your bubble shooter to fight sharks.

name: Armored Xpress
short_description: Armored Xpress is a new unique story-driven Match 3 game built with rich RPG elements and an ATB battle system.

name: Wild world
short_description: Survive waves of merciless enemies as an engineer defending generators. Use agility, firearms, and strategic towers. Choose from explosive or piercing weapons. Upgrade, adapt, and conquer in dynamic landscapes. Stunning graphics, intense gameplay – your courage is key to victory.

name: Shanhe
short_description: 联机修仙，多人爬塔！《山河伏妖录》是一款重现上古神话的多人联机策略冒险游戏，你受命于乱世，修习奇门功法，斩尽魑魅魍魉，还天下以太平。

name: 魔法与高塔
short_description: 一款轻度rogue的地牢类游戏 使用不同元素组合魔法进行战斗

name: Silly Polly Beast
short_description: This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

name: Life of Fly 2
short_description: Life of Fly 2 features 13 short stories each revolving around the life and weird thoughts of another fly. Be prepared to experience some very unusual content, some interesting thoughts that go way beyond the normal life of a fly, and some entertaining short stories with a twist.

name: A Boy's Journey
short_description: Influence obstacles and gain power-ups in this beautiful skill-based platformer. Aim for the best highscore and if you don't like that one level, just generate a new one! Freeze and destroy obstacles or create a whole new path. Or give yourself a speed boost and invulnerability.

name: The Excrawlers
short_description: Action-RPG slasher in which you have to get into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

name: Magnus Failure
short_description: Magnus Failure is an isometric exploration and adventure game with logical elements. The protagonist of the game is a person who, for unknown reasons, finds himself in the isolation of other people and scans the radio in search of a signal.

name: ARK and ADE
short_description: ARK and ADE is an action-jammed VR FPS shooter in which you get to experience the glory of the 80’s arcade era in a neon fused setting 🤘😎. Shoot your way through retro-futuristic levels filled with enemies, iconic over the top bosses and never ending bullets. Insert coin to play! 🤖

name: Tinykin
short_description: Catch hundreds of tinykin and use their unique powers to bring Milo back to his home planet and back to normal size!

name: Stardiver
short_description: You're a Stardiver on a mission. Descend into the depths of an underwater world filled with wonder, mysteries, and peril. Discover the story behind the abandoned base. Explore this submerged planet and learn its history.

name: Slow and Steady
short_description: Slow and Steady is a game where you make the slowest tortoise ever reach the finish line.

name: The Great Pickle Adventure
short_description: In The Great Pickle Adventure, a pickle-based platformer, you can compete for the best level times, relax in an RPG world or try your skill in a game of breakout. Become a master of gravity and find your favorite among multiple unique weapons. Explore 20+ unique themed levels and special levels.

name: Pavel Repin's Collection
short_description: Try games of various genres and styles, from sports, to games with a deep plot. Discover new game universes and explore them alone, online or in co-op mode on one screen.

name: Warlike
short_description: Lead your band of mercenaries to victory in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Manage your resources, customise your army and wage epic battles against orc clans, barbarian hordes and legions of the undead. The art style may be cute, but this tactical roguelike is anything but forgiving.

name: Voxelia Defenders
short_description: Voxelia Defenders - is fast-paced, fun and engaging tower defense game, that will take you into the magic world of Voxelia!

name: 5 Force Fighters
short_description: 5 Force Fighters is a 2D fighting game with a cast of unstoppable characters, and a combat system that boasts universal offensive and defensive options. Unravel the story of 5 teens blessed with elemental powers, but cursed with scarred pasts that have led them to a common, but destructive, goal.

name: Line of War
short_description: Line of War - is a classic 3D shooter with surviving elements where the story of one military man during the Vietnam War is told.

name: League Space
short_description: The space league has started! It's time to prove yourself and bring victory to your team. Decide who you want to be on your team and win the war against aliens from other galaxies to stop the invasion in your world to end.

name: BORIS RUSSIAN BEAR
short_description: You play as a Russian soldier who is trying to defend the border of his homeland from foreign invaders.

name: Crazy Race
short_description: Crazy Race is a fast-paced arcade racing game with low poly graphics and great physics.

name: DressMaker Pro
short_description: Dressmaker Pro is now available! It's now available with more features than ever!

name: Wildmender
short_description: A desert gardening survival game. Start from a tiny spring and cultivate a blooming garden. Explore a vast world amid the sands and uncover its mysteries. Can you defend against the relentless forces of nature and mysterious wraith corruption, to bring life to a dying world?

name: Lost Ark
short_description: Embark on an odyssey for the Lost Ark in a vast, vibrant world: explore new lands, seek out lost treasures, and test yourself in thrilling action combat in this action-packed free-to-play RPG.

name: Word Hunt Fever
short_description: Word Hunt Fever combines the mechanics of two popular types of puzzles: word search and match-3, with some rules designed to make the game interesting and addictive. Swap the letters to find the words, go up the levels and get the higher scores!

name: Mauled
short_description: Mauled is a Free-To-Play, Third-Person Shooter with online CO-OP gameplay. Battle through a variety of maps against endless hordes of ferocious creatures. Arm yourself with multiple weapons available for purchase in citadels between rounds.

name: Rusty Rangers
short_description: Rusty Rangers is an action platformer and roguelike with elements of metroidvania. Choose your ranger and explore procedurally generated dungeons. Will you be able to defeat all the bosses?

name: Shadow of Nyx
short_description: The gods gree left the world in ruins. Explore the vast islands left over by the overflown river Styx and uncover artifacts with the power of the gods to appease the river and enable passage to the dead.

name: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Patches' Infurno
short_description: Patches is dragged to school for the first ever cat-and-dog school day! All he needs to do is get this damn collar off and wreck some havoc! Will he prove cats and dogs can get along, or will he make this the Purrfect Apawcalypse?

name: One Way Road
short_description: One Way Road is a story-driven action game combining elements of Scroll Shooter, Top Down Shooter, and Tube Shooter. Take the helm of a space cruiser, explore the galaxy, and fight in stellar battles to save humanity.

name: Deadly Threat
short_description: Deadly Threat is an action-adventure game with RPG and first-person shooter (FPS) elements. You have to control the hero and explore mysterious locations in the dungeon.

name: Sacred Cubes 2
short_description: A logic game with many exciting levels of varying difficulty.

name: Little adventure
short_description: Little adventure is a 2D platformer adventure game with beautiful graphics. You have to play as an assistant to the blacksmith named Ben and, together with the blacksmith, go to the castle to the king to give the legendary sword! Immerse yourself in a fantasy world full of danger and adventure!

name: Topsy Turvy
short_description: Race the clock in this fast paced, precise pseudo-3D platformer. Reach the finish line while navigating numerous hazards. As you train your reflexes, beat the speed records for all 24 distinct levels. Every level has tools that can help you or hurt you; will you be left topsy-turvy?

name: Wanderer
short_description: Built from the ground up for VR, Wanderer has a unique blend of escape room style puzzles, tactile hands on interactions and action arcade sequences to bring you the ultimate time travel adventure. Are you ready to walk in the footsteps of those who have gone before you?

name: PlateUp!
short_description: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

name: Tiny Planet Protectors
short_description: Welcome to the TPPA! Your assignment: Protect, Clean, and Discover. Collect resources and encounter the inhabitants of nearby galaxies as you also fill your home planet with alien plants, futuristic tools, and uncover the greatest threat to the universe.

name: Planet Miner
short_description: Remove fog, look for and mine minerals, construct buildings, upgrade the rover and reach the portal.

name: Sackboy™: A Big Adventure
short_description: PERFECTLY CRAFTED FOR PC. PlayStation® icon Sackboy bursts into action on PC in a huge 3D multiplayer platforming adventure. An epic journey stuffed with platforming challenges. Deeply immersive controls. Collaborative, chaotic and joyful multiplayer fun.

name: Offroad Truck Racing
short_description: Offroad Truck Racing - innovation rally simulator offer a thrilling experience of track racing by replicating the unique challenges of driving through diverse landscapes.

name: Street Racing: United
short_description: Street Racing: United - innovation autosimulator about Street Racing. This is Story about Street Racer, who want to be the 1# in his city. In the beginning you have some money for buying the first car. Then you can Ride to the streets of the city and Race with rivals.

name: WORDLAND
short_description: WORDLAND is a minimalist puzzle game. A mix of puzzle and crossword. Answer the clues, arrange the pieces and discover the words.

name: Magic Exposure – Yuri Visual Novel
short_description: A cute and short furry yuri kinect visual novel about a rabbit who falls in love with a demon and both experience their first love.

name: Super Nova Stadium
short_description: Join other alien contestants in a ricochet battle at the Super Nova Stadium! Chose your blaster, harness solar power to charge your weaponry and knock our your opponents to claim victory! Compete as a team in two game modes: Standoff or Overcharge in intense, ricocheting combat.

name: The Crow King
short_description: The Crow King is a 2D side-scrolling action-strategy with a unique Handmade style, where you have to explore and gather resources to improve your strength until you lead your army to victory.

name: Eternia: Pet Whisperer
short_description: Tired of the daily churn, only to come home to an empty apartment? The Rainbow Dome shelter will help you find the perfect partner to spice up your life! Check out our exotic selection of pets and you'll surely find the piece of you you've always been missing!

name: Mystery Trackers: Forgotten Voices Collector's Edition
short_description: Attendance is down at Misthill College!

name: ZeroSpace
short_description: ZeroSpace is the first ever RTS where all game modes(single player, co-op, PvE, and PvP) are played in a shared MMO galaxy map. Contribute towards the war effort through conquering planets and fortifying alliance strongholds. Wishlist ZeroSpace now to get updates about our launch!

name: 宇宙终极秘密-灵魂The ultimate secret of the universe：Soul
short_description: The dialogue content of the game is based on the cosmic cycle, 33 dimensional space-time and religious theology.

name: Babol the Walking Box
short_description: Begin your adventure with your new friends! Babol the Walking Box Yes, it's game about Box that can walk, nope, just kidding hahaha UwU Explore the amazing world of box, from the wilderness, desert, to super duper cold snowy mountains!

name: SpaceShips
short_description: A tense exciting space battleship shooting game. with developer strange voice. to collect space ships whilch you like.

name: Zombie Survival online
short_description: ZS Online is a top-down 2D shooting multiplayer game that you can enjoy in 10 to 16 minutes. Pick up items, combine them, and survive the longest among other players in a large city where zombies appear at night! As the days go by, the sort of zombies increases, and poisonous gas hits the city...

name: Q'Redux
short_description: Play a Magician-Healer on a journey to rescue a mentor. Discover a world of unique Spirits & powerful Sorcery. Learn magic to Summon & Bind Daemons, change your shape, soar the skies, jump through shadows, or even control minds. Choose your own spell-style in this episodic adventure!

name: The Tower of Wowers
short_description: Battle your way up 60+ floors of hand-drawn enemies in this satirical RPG!

name: Trilogy KING MAN
short_description: Three classics from the past are celebrating a glorious return, bringing you all new features, modern tweaks and the soul of the late 80s and early 90s in one funny package!

name: 下一站江湖Ⅱ
short_description: （“创新工坊”现已推出，当前已更新10个免费玩法资料片）《下一站江湖Ⅱ》是白玉京工作室研发的第二款3D单机武侠游戏，是一款包含了沙盒式的剧情主角养成、无缝大地图任意采集建造模拟经营、骑砍Like式门派霸图玩法的开放世界游戏，无内购、可离网游玩！

name: Heck Deck
short_description: Heck Deck is a bullet hell card game where all the bullets are cards and time only progresses as you move. Explore 5 stages full of unique enemies and bosses, discover dozens of cards, and visit shops to buy and sell cards for health!

name: Pleasurepunk: Drug Dealer
short_description: In Pleasurepunk: Drug Dealer you are a hacker trying to find compromised photos of a drug dealer wanted by the FBI. Destroy the blocks and see the most hot pics of her.

name: Hentai Aim Trainer
short_description: Now you can train your aim with hentai girls. Enjoy and relax while shooting boobs!

name: Puzzle Light
short_description: Swap the pieces to form the circuit and turn on the lights in this puzzle game.

name: Conquest of Elysium 5
short_description: Conquest of Elysium 5 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

name: Square Off
short_description: Square Off is a fast-paced, platforming arena. Control physics-based battle squares in a series of speedy combat challenges whilst shooting your friends into oblivion!

name: BunnyShot
short_description: Play as an Easter bunny, score points and save chickens using Easter eggs in BunnyShot!

name: Galactic Refugees
short_description: A beginner-friendly old-school shmup meets bullet hell

name: Alive Cursor
short_description: Replace your cursor with Mods! Keep it busy (display time, respond to audio, play games)!

name: Steel Rain - Dawn of the Machines
short_description: Steel Rain: Down of the Machines is a third-person shooter game, with characteristics of shmup. Control vehicles and have in hand a vast arsenal of weapons to fight against waves of different enemies with the objective of ridding the planet of a great threat.

name: 暴打萌鼠
short_description: 暴打萌鼠是一款个人独立游戏，轻松有趣的萌系塔防策略类游戏，画风清新明快。主题是一群呆萌的老鼠从地下通道往地面冲，进入粮仓或是蛋糕房或是超市偷吃东西，玩家可用各种道具阻止它们。与一般的塔防游戏最大的区别在于使用障碍道具可以改变萌鼠的行进路线，部分凶猛的老鼠有不同的技能，可以防御攻击，破坏道具。每关开始前先要研究萌鼠的行进路线，合理布防。另外还有超爽的暴打模式。免费抽奖获得钻石，钻石能购买超爽大杀器.

name: SCORCH
short_description: SCORCH is a noir-inspired stealth, first-person shooter. Takedown thugs as you try to break away from your former life. Stalk the shadows, gather evidence, and get out of town. SCORCH is first and foremost a stealth game before it is a shooter.

name: The Killer of Dishonor
short_description: The Killer of Dishonor - is a hardcore 2D platformer with surviving elements where you will have to fight to ancient evil playing as a hired killer.

name: Rescuer
short_description: Martin a science-loving priest arrives in the ZPriot region, meets people and starts to become influential in the area and then decides to put his plan of domination into practice.

name: Train Tycoon
short_description: Manage your own train company! Be a businessman in the train industry, with control over everything in your business. Work, earn, invest and expand!

name: Chonkymon
short_description: A cuddly 2D-builder game where you breed animals called Chonkymons. Build homes for them, design their rooms and make them happy with food. Create unique and custom Chonkymons by combining them in fusion tanks. Expand your island and home to fit more animals into your Chonkymon Island!

name: GrandMa Badass - a crazy point and click adventure
short_description: Grandma Badass is a 2D cartoon adventure game. This point and click video game immerses you in the shoes of GrandMa, an old woman who will work to find her black cat Marius, missing and probably kidnapped.

name: Zen Cube
short_description: Zen Cube a game where your hobby will be your greatest fun. The Zen cube arose from the idea of the Zen Chess game that allows the player to perform only the checkmate of the chess move, with the Zen Cube you can make the last 2 moves to finish the Magic Cube.

name: Comet Crusher: Block Breaker
short_description: While exploring deep space, you have come across our solar system. It is up to you to crush each layer of every planet in our solar system in this beautiful block breaker. See if you can complete each set of levels corresponding to each planet in order to unlock the next.

name: Coin Dash
short_description: Coin Dash is a time based coin collecting game that makes addictive. Be sure to avoid the dangerous cactus or your game is over!

name: Unlock the Block
short_description: In unlock the block your objective is to activate a button, but for that you will have to push your way through and destroy blocks. This may seem easy but know one thing your movement is limited.

name: Somniphobia
short_description: Survival horror in a girl's nightmare. Complete puzzles and survive in a nightmarish hand-painted world of Susan's mind. If she wakes up, she'll have the same dream again. You must keep all of her nasty thoughts and memories away from you to stop her from waking up.

name: Instrumentalist
short_description: Feeling musician? Want to be a pianist or a drummer but you can’t afford it or have no room for it? Do you have a VR set? Now you can be a great musician by playing instruments on your VR set. Start smashing keys or drums with your VR hand to make a great melody.

name: FTD2
short_description: A Fantasy based Tower Defence Game. Strategically construct different towers to direct monsters for most damage possible. Additional one shot skills might get you out of that sticky spot. Can you get on the global leaderboards ?

name: Kukus World
short_description: This world is filled with Dokis, little robots with a big job, to cleanse the world of its toxicity and stabilise the ecosystem, and you’ve taken on the task to help them, because there are somethings little Dokis can’t fix.

name: Gun'eM
short_description: A fun objective based single player first person shooter game similar to classic shooter games. Unique levels, fun objectives, and rewarding gunplay.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle VR
short_description: Assemble Jigsaw Puzzles in Virtual Reality!

name: Undergrowth: VR Maze
short_description: In this VR simulator, you can explore the sandbox with your Steam Index, HTC Vive, or Oculus Headsets and interact with certain parts of the environment. Jump and just be inside the simulator. Relax and enjoy yourself in the green environment.

name: The Mystery of Caketropolis
short_description: A bakery falls to arson and a city falls to chaos. With the harmony between human and dragon crumbling, can Rimentus solve the Mystery of Caketropolis before his kind face exile?

name: Squeaky Clean
short_description: Psychological horror set in your favorite place: a nice hot shower.

name: Ronin Trail
short_description: The war ends and your skills are no longer needed. Aimless and starving, you set out on a journey to Edo, the City of Opportunity. Travel through the countryside and find your purpose as a wandering nobody. Can you make a name for yourself?

name: Ouroboros Dungeon
short_description: All the pleasure from the 90's Action RPGs put into a quirky infinite procedural dungeon. Explore, find treasures, loot and clear hallways from enemies within.

name: Buy Me Some Soup
short_description: Heya! Long time no see. I just have a small -tiny- little favor to ask of you, could you buy me some soup? ...How? Well, that's for you to find out!

name: Half Wing
short_description: Rita and her parents lived in the spirit family but the demons invaded the spirit family, Rita survived and embarks on the journey of seeking the truth. This is a free and refreshing RogueLike game, designed a lot of weapons, magic skills and strike action, will let you indulge in them.

name: Evertried
short_description: Evertried is an isometric, tactical rogue-lite where strategic positioning and quick wit in grid-based combat are the key to success. Make clever use of attacks, movement, skills and hazards to clear floors of enemies and advance higher toward your destiny in the afterlife.

name: The night of fire stealing 2/盗火之夜2
short_description: It's a difficult retro RPG game. No maps, no directions. Explore the dungeons as a team of four, moving freely through the maze and deftly dealing with various enemies. Fight the old gods in the eastern Tiantang city .

name: Linares: Bullet Fever
short_description: In a world where magical creatures called Alebrije roam the dream lands. You and your friends will be pitted in Mechanized Alebrije mayhem, an intense team based sport.

name: Lust Theory - Season 1
short_description: Lust Theory is an adult Visual Novel in which you take control of a 20-year-old guy whose life is turned upside down when he finds out the same day is repeating. The game is packed with sex, humor, romance, drama and mystery.

name: Valley General Hospital: NiVR
short_description: An exciting new approach to training and simulation in Healthcare.

name: Magical Girl Noble Rose
short_description: This game is an RPG with a classic storyline that features Noble Rose, a girl who transforms into a magical girl to fight an evil organization. Use special attacks to wipe out the enemies and help the women in the city from the Bio Soldiers!

name: Big Quest 2: the Adventure
short_description: A casual quest adventure with dialogues, investigations, puzzles in a beautiful vibrant world.

name: Mona
short_description: Mona is an immersive third person exploration and puzzle game set on an eerie island filled with fantastic creatures. Explore the world and uncover its secrets to figure out what ancient evil decimated the people who used to live there.

name: Cyanotype Daydream -The Girl Who Dreamed the World-
short_description: Kaito wakes to find himself in a strange room, with no memories, and a taciturn girl named Yonagi by his side. Upon learning of his role, he immerses himself into three wondrous dream worlds with her. When all three stories meet a bitter end, Kaito recovers his memories, and the true story unfolds.

name: Mail Time
short_description: It's Mail Time! As a newly trained Mail Scout, put on your pack, grab those letters, and deliver them across Grumblewood Grove! The forest animals eagerly await the sight of your mushroom hat in this cozy, cottagecore light-platformer adventure!

name: MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE
short_description: Pick your favorite character, team up and fight to be the last ones standing in the new 24-player Battle Royale free to play game "MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE"!

name: YUME 2 : Sleepless Night
short_description: In times of war people are on edge and it is more difficult to trust people. People will consider how to survive in the corner of the chaotic world, and so does Monghan. Players can experience the difficulties of wartime life from various angles.

name: March March!
short_description: A unique mix of mechanics = 💀 Roguelike + 🎲 Autobattler + 🧠 Tactical battles + turn your enemy into a chicken! 🐥

name: 汽车帝国
short_description: Remember those cars that throbbed you? Now you finally have the opportunity to build it yourself...Enter the world of "Car Empire", get venture capital, establish a company, become the CEO, build a superb car, and sweep the global market! A hero is needed here, will this person be you?

name: Game Design Studio：游戏设计工具箱
short_description: 游戏设计工具箱是一款专为游戏创意人员量身打造的一体式创意应用，可助您实现待办管理，记录创意，表格数据导出，智能图片压缩，获取配色方案等功能，帮助实现高效自动化的游戏设计。

name: Afterlife Beans
short_description: You are a bean that is about to go to the after life but someone won't let you to do that! find out who it is in this game! collect coins, shoot enemies and terrible puns are awaiting you, so what are you waiting for? join the bean in afterlife beans.

name: Occupation 2.5
short_description: Attack from Outer Space. Classic old-school First/Third person shooter. Fight against zombies, mutants, monsters to save the Earth!

name: Memories of East Coast
short_description: An immersive visual novel experience that brings you on a journey through memory, nostalgia, and guilt.

name: Uniboom-War of Unicorns
short_description: 3D-realtime tower defense game with (rainbow-) UNICORNS!

name: Virtual Near Death Experience
short_description: Short and intense!. We want to create experiences in VR that are impossible in the ordinary world You take off into another dimension, otherworldly beautiful sounds, float without a body. Our artistic interpretation of hundreds of readings about near death experiences. A first person experience.

name: Escape
short_description: Welcome to CHEYNE escape game series, this is the first work, of course, this is only the first chapter, the follow-up will soon update the second and third chapters, Please look forward to it.

name: 最后一搏 The last fight
short_description: "The last fight" is a game in which developers develop various interesting modes against the background of the end of the wasteland. At present, the plot mode has been launched, and there is a new adventure mode . Multiplayer game mode will be launched in the future. Please look forward to it!

name: Schmutznik
short_description: A 2D, platforming game with a telescoping robot and short, intense caves to explore.

name: Treasures of the Aegean
short_description: What happened to the Minoan civilization? Join parkour master Marie Taylor and treasure hunter James Andrew in a historical action thriller, as they unveil the secrets of a forgotten kingdom which has been tragically trapped in and endless time loop.

name: Kepler Project
short_description: Build rockets and shoot them into space. Once you reach orbit, you are halfway to explore anywhere in the Solar System.

name: Cute Girls Love Books
short_description: Cute Girls Love Books is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
short_description: Virtueror is an RTS with 4x and RPG elements. Your mission is to conquer new worlds and to extend your domain over the whole galaxy. Build your base, command your units, gather resources, set up defenses and crush anyone challenging you. Have no mercy and the universe will be yours!

name: Bite At The Museum
short_description: Play as Tony the baby Tyrannosaurus and rex shop like never before. Tricera-top the scoreboard as you styrac up dino-mite combos! Veloci-rip through 3 unique exhibits! Stego around and ptero down all sorts of displays and cause a giganto mess! Ankylosaurus!

name: Retrowave Illusions 𝔸𝕖𝕤𝕥𝕙𝕖𝕥𝕚𝕔𝕤 𝔼𝕕𝕚𝕥𝕚𝕠𝕟
short_description: Retrowave illusions offers above all a visual and sound experience that will delight fans of the genre and will surely make those who don't know it yet discover this wonderful universe. Retrowave Illusions is unique experience of being immersed in wonderful world for at least a few moments.

name: Arcade Drift
short_description: Feel the taste of arcade drift. Be the first on the leaderboard!

name: Secret Agent HD
short_description: Return to the remote island classic world of rewards and traps in the HD remake of Secret Agent! Guide 006 through puzzles & arcade challenges of your favorite missions, then uncover the whole new Episode loaded with all new puzzles, enemies, challenges, hazards & help 006 finally defeat DVS!

name: Bread & Fred
short_description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

name: Rimebeard
short_description: Create, remove and push blocks of ice strategically to extinguish all flames in each level. Use various other elements like rocks, crates, pipes and more to your advantage.

name: Mecha Tactics
short_description: Build mechas, command your squad members to victory and conquest.

name: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder meets dark fantasy: Choose one of seven unique classes, explore the vast nether, and fight for salvation - solo, in co-op, or PvP!

name: Endless Zombie Tower
short_description: Hard single/coop roguelike-strategy-shooter game. Reach top of randomized tower-building and kill all zombies alone or as team (8 players).

name: Gun on the Chickahominy
short_description: Gun on the Chickahominy (GotC) is a casual pixel target game set during the American War Between the States. Players take command of a small cannon crew situated on the banks of the Chickahominy River and attempt to stem the Federal invasion of Virginia.

name: Truffle Hogs
short_description: Hang out and play with friends! Search for buried truffles—or steal them from other players! Decorate your treehouse, unlock cool hats, or just run around emoting.

name: Ele-Mental
short_description: The one of a kind fast paced hardcore arcade action multiplayer quick thinking ele-ment absorbing mental workout for everybody

name: Planets Battle
short_description: Naval battles of ships. Turn-based tactical battles.

name: Water Drift
short_description: Drift in water on boats.

name: Cub Gym
short_description: A challenging and fun crazy scavenger hunt game.

name: Drake's Odds: Survive
short_description: Play as an alien who must survive on the planet Earth, which is unknown and adverse to him. Fight, craft and make use of the powers and technology in your possession. Collect KP from Earthlings; control the NPCs; fly over the skies and shoot with the spaceship.

name: 梦落凡尘 Dreams of falling into mortal dust
short_description: This is a plot based RPG game. The plot of the game is humorous. It tells the story of the protagonists who like Tang poetry and Song Ci all the way chasing their dreams, defeating the devil and saving the world.

name: School For The Friendless
short_description: Harold is sent to a school for people with no friends. The teachers observe and then pair them up, making them roommates. What will happen when Harold ends up sharing a room with a girl?

name: Unchosen: Forsaken
short_description: VR horror rouge-like game where the player will need escape a purgatorial environment by completing a set of objectives and finding useful tools and equipment while avoiding and out-smarting hostile monsters and traps.

name: Castle Morihisa
short_description: "Castle Morihisa" is a roguelike featuring strategic deckbuilder. You need to build up your deck through constant battles, acquire powerful talents, and wield the power of the Fallen Heroes to unveil the truth behind the rebellion in Castle Morihisa.

name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION
short_description: CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- REUNION is a remaster of CRISIS CORE featuring updated graphics, combat systems and soundtrack. Follow the tale of SOLDIER operative Zack Fair, as he discovers the secrets of Shinra's dark experiments.

name: Attack of the Giant Crab
short_description: Take control of the Giant Crab and cause the maximum amount of destruction while brushing off the military's puny attempts to stop you.

name: Splash Girls
short_description: 「Splash Girls」is a game to play with cute girls. Please enjoy spending time by the water.　 The game has beautiful graphics and passionate voice.

name: Fusion Relics
short_description: (In Development) FUSION RELICS: A 2D side-scrolling, creature collector, RPG platformer with arcade hack and slash mechanics, hand drawn art, and character customization, where you battle giant titans, hatch unique creatures, and restore the balance between Light and Dark to a corrupted world!

name: Infested: Space Colony
short_description: Infested: Space Colony is an intense action top-down shooter in a dimly-lit environment where aliens roam in shadowy darkness. Explore various sections of the colony ship. Hunt down aliens before they hunt you down.

name: The Far Kingdoms: Forgotten Relics
short_description: In this Solitaire game you have to travel through 4 kingdoms and find stolen relics - play 150 Solitaire and Hidden Object levels!

name: Jungle Rumble
short_description: Become a fearless soldier, face off against the evil Skull and his army in the heart of the Amazon jungle. Survive deadly traps, ambushes, and explosive battles to restore peace. Will you emerge victorious?

name: Sentry:Obelisk Of Dawn
short_description: “Sentry:Obelisk Of Dawn”is a VR-like MOBA game. The game supports 5vs5 sports at most, and players can customize and cultivate their own combat characters to participate in fierce battles on the battlefield.

name: Planet of Lana
short_description: A young girl and her loyal friend embark on a rescue mission through a colorful world full of cold machines and unfamiliar creatures. Planet of Lana is a cinematic puzzle adventure framed by an epic sci-fi saga that stretches across centuries and galaxies.

name: Soralio: Cooperation mystery solving game
short_description: Sora and Rio are brought to a mysterious house. Let's solve the mystery and escape by talking. Communication is the key.

name: FILMECHANISM
short_description: RECORD and RESTORE are the keys!Use your puzzle brain and action brain to complete the the puzzles!

name: GNOSIA
short_description: The Gnosia lie. Pretending to be human, they’ll get in close, trick and deceive, and then eliminate one victim at a time...

name: Codename Prodigy
short_description: A Couch-Play Platform fighter with Traditional fighting game aspects that focuses on using your stage against your opponent, with each character taking advantage of the stages in unique and different ways

name: A-Spec First Assault
short_description: Command Corvette class warships in the immersive space combat sim A-Spec First Assault. Customize armaments, lead tactical fleet assaults, and master true Newtonian physics to defend the Akkadian Empire from the Sumer Dynasty’s ruthless advance.

name: Maroon
short_description: Maroon is an immersive learning experience supporting more than 20 experiments from the fields of physics, chemistry, and computer science. Enter the virtual laboratory to try out all kinds of interactive simulations.

name: End of Despair
short_description: End of Despair is a mix of narrative rogue-lite, bullet hell, WOW-moments in gameplay. This is story about burnt-out office workers who, on the border of nightmare and reality, understand personal problems.

name: Vermillion - VR Painting
short_description: It’s time to discover your inner artist! With Vermillion, you get a fully equipped oil painting studio in your home, without any of the mess. Ready for the unrivaled sense of accomplishment from creating your first painting?

name: Stinky Company Simulator
short_description: In Stinky Company Simulator you play as the owner of a company dealing with the collection and disposal of waste. Earn money by completing new jobs. Grow your business by buying new tools and vehicles. Also, beware of competition that will not hesitate to use mafia-like methods if the need arises.

name: Hellslave
short_description: Hellslave is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler where you make a pact with the Devil to fight back a demon invasion. Customize your character with powerful demonic abilities, explore a cursed world, and battle nightmarish enemies to save humanity if you can resist the darkness.

name: 青之镇物语
short_description: The betrayal of your partner makes you choose a different life. Although you have a vengeful heart, in this complex world, you still have new hopes and choices. Do you want to live with a mission, or let go of your obsession, or run your own hospital,or do you want to kill your enemy?

name: Warstride Challenges
short_description: Blast hordes of demons at lightning speed in bloody gunfights, and race against the clock to overcome everything that comes your way! Die and retry to get the highest score in increasingly intense trials. Create and share your own runs, enjoying hundreds of levels created by the community.

name: Warrior Bloodline: Path of Survival
short_description: An epic journey of the fellowship of the children bonded by blood, escaped an experimental camp, wandering the woods and struggling both to survive and to reveal their destiny. An immersive, story-driven exploration game with a strong focus on realistic survival.

name: Firegirl: Hack 'n Splash Rescue DX
short_description: Take on the role of a young rescue officer starting her career. Armed with a trusty axe and high-pressure fire hose that also acts like a jetpack, Firegirl responds to emergency calls across the city. Can Firegirl save all the trapped civilians caught in each blaze?

name: AI Drone Simulator
short_description: AI Drone Simulator is an FPV drone simulator. Huge, dynamic environments. Virtual copy of your own drone. Total customization for maximum pilot power. Community sharing of drones, maps and tracks !

name: Thyria
short_description: Thyria is an RPG, a unique combination of dynamic exploration, turn-based combat and crafting. Summon and train a team of Guardians, who will accompany Thyria into the minds of the cursed villagers. Help them vanquish their nightmares.

name: Ballistic Machines
short_description: Build the world as you move, fight monsters and defeat your friends.

name: OTXO
short_description: Enter an inexplicable, abstract mansion to rescue a loved one in this fast-paced, brutal, and dark roguelite filled with precise but savage gunplay and time-bending slow motion. Face your inner demons and unveil the secrets of the Mansion.

name: Overhaul
short_description: Solve your way through this fast-paced rogue-lite puzzle game and outwit unforgiving creatures as you venture into the mysterious Power Plant!

name: Miko Adventures Puffball
short_description: Miko is a raccoon who lost his way while wandering through the forest, he discovers a portal and upon touching it he finds himself in a world full of dangers. Miko is transported into another dimension and your goal is to help him find a way back home but it wont be an easy journey, are you ready?

name: Grid Leaper
short_description: VR Platforming taken to the next level. Jump. Climb. Grab. Swing. Fly. Dodge. Do whatever it takes to reach the goal. Taking place across 90 levels, Grid Leaper brings you on a journey through 20 unique environments designed to harden you into a master.

name: Seas of Kahtaone
short_description: A fantasy naval combat action-adventure game. Explore the open ocean and fend off pirates with your cannon broadsides and magical arsenal. Summon the wind to boost your ship forward and release fireballs to light up your enemies. Upgrade your ships armor, weapons, and much more to win the day.

name: The Burnt School
short_description: Adventure game with a focus on the story, where you play with a boy who he was recruited to save lost souls trapped in the school where he studies.

name: Yummy Girl
short_description: The girls are very hungry, feed them, they are waiting for you.

name: Space Marmalade
short_description: Space Marmalade is a sci-fi turn-based strategy genre, bending the geometry of grid-space for an interstellar environment. Move from star to star, dispatching waves of procedurally-generated enemies. Each level is its own Solar System, with planets and asteroids to hide behind.

name: The Last Stand Legacy Collection
short_description: Survive the zombie apocalypse and make humanity's last stand in this three-game legacy bundle, revamped for modern hardware. Explore, build, and survive for as long as you can in The Last Stand, The Last Stand 2, and The Last Stand: Union City.

name: Ravenous Devils
short_description: A horror cooking simulator where the secret ingredient is crime. Improve your shops, buy new tools, expand your menu, and above all, make your customers happy.

name: The Neroe
short_description: Catch and control the amazing creatures that inhabit the world to defeat the enemies hiding in the dungeons and get the items that allow you to advance in your adventure towards your destiny of becoming the new hero.

name: RANGER VS. DRONES
short_description: This is a VR study.Your participation begins with our online survey.Please follow the link in the external links section.

name: Hexio
short_description: Connect all the nodes into beautiful and abstract shapes in this exciting puzzle game. Enjoy a relaxing piano soundtrack in your delightful experience.

name: Serpent Showdown
short_description: Serpent Showdown is a competitive arena fighter for all ages! You and a friend go head-to-head in a battle of the ages! It is time to don your... cardboard armor, and grab your trusty crayon?! Play as two classroom pet snakes, battling it out to see who'll reign victorious.

name: Machina Blade
short_description: In Machina Blade what matters the most is your skill. Choose a character and fight your way through hordes of Machinas in this short game with up to four players on local co-op.

name: Wolfriders A Sniper Adventure
short_description: Wolfriders is a sniper game with a comic book style storytelling. Read the comic book chapters and play the short sniper and assault levels to unveil the immersive story.

name: Trigger Impact
short_description: A deadly virus breaks out and spreads the world with infectious predators and animals. You will have to Rise and defeat rivals by searching & scavenging for firearms, weapons, food, and water used to survive not only the night but each other as everyone is forced to fight for resources and life!

name: Cube
short_description: Cube is a puzzle/platform minimalistic game with a rotation mechanic, your logical thinking, dexterity and precision will be challenged, try to get the best score while pass through 49 levels with progressive dificulty. It can be harder than it looks.

name: Dice Knight: Mystery of the Moirai
short_description: Play as a heroic gun wielding knight and explore a world where everything is dice. Money is dice, health is dice, weapons shoot dice and the story is about dice. Before you blast your way through hordes of enemies you must only ask yourself one thing: do you feel lucky?

name: ORO
short_description: ORO takes you into the story of the legendary retired demon "Oro", who must stop an evil force that arises to destroy the world. He tries to do the right thing, but his destiny prevents him from doing so. Help him become a great demon or a superhero while sleeping with as many ladies as possible.

name: [International] Absented Age: Squarebound
short_description: Absented Age is a fresh mix of genres: an action RPG outside of combat that becomes a roguelike-style strategy RPG during combat.

name: G-MODEアーカイブス17 フライハイトクラウディア3
short_description: The thoughts reflected in the distant sky are the ties that bind a new world... Here and now, all the mysteries will be revealed.

name: Motor Town : Behind The Wheel Playtest
Elite Fighter
short_description: This is a casual shooting game with the background of future space wars. Players need to fight to the death with many beautiful pilots.

name: Soaring Machinariae
short_description: A girls' adventure story, told through a traditional action RPG! Control Iris the Machinariae to explore fields and dungeons, and fight against monsters with sword combos, items, and special moves!

name: RealityMinds
short_description: A young aspiring soldier and a mysterious girl switch bodies. An RPG with a ripple effect that changes the minds of everyone involved.

name: Bomb!Bomb!Carnival!!
short_description: Third-person sports bombing, where you compete with other players using a variety of bombs.

name: Glitch Busters: Stuck On You
short_description: It’s a normal day on the net, until a virus outbreak turns everything upside-down. Only your squad of GLITCH BUSTERS can take on the net’s kookiest bugs in an online world gone haywire in this 1-4 player co-op 3rd person shooter.

name: LineArt Jigsaw Puzzle - Erotica 5
short_description: Nice 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzle featuring erotic line drawings, hand drawn by LineArtBabe, on a smooth luxury graphical background.

name: General Population
short_description: Experience the brutality of prison life in this first-person RPG. Survive as an inmate amidst the violence and politics of the penal system or enforce the rules as a corrections officer. Tattoo and craft, or bribe and murder your way to the top. But remember, your reputation is everything.

name: Mystery Of Camp Enigma
short_description: Explore areas, collect hidden objects and take in your surroundings. You will need all of your puzzle solving skills to put together a plan to make your way through the island of Camp Enigma, solving riddles and down the many paths of mystery.

name: LineArt Jigsaw Puzzle - Airplanes
short_description: Challening 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzle featuring line drawings of iconic airplanes by LineArtBabe, on a smooth background.

name: Tom´s Adventure
short_description: Help Tom hack-and-slash his way though a dream from which he cannot wake up. A hand-drawn action-adventure through a dreamy world filled with fleshy monsters, insane situations and strangers that needs help.

name: NETCORTER: City 2179
short_description: NETCORTER: CITY 2179 is a sci-fi storytelling third-person shooter(TPS) with a cyberpunk aesthetic and Bullet Hell and Roguelite elements. You would become a Netcorter (S-class hacker) and dive into a chain of events that followed the disaster in 2178.

name: Chronicles of Taldun: The Remainder
short_description: Interactive story about two magi trying to survive a failed ritual. Learn from their deaths and untangle the mystery before you. Guide their actions as they come to terms with their past mistakes, and find forgiveness and love for each other.

name: PhotoWorld: Smooth Сorners
short_description: PhotoWorld: Smooth Corners is a third person 3D visual game in which the world is created for the player.

name: Little Hearts
short_description: Turn-based strategy simulation RPG in a fantasy world of swords and sorcery, featuring light dot-drawing animation.

name: Exodus H
short_description: Take command of your own colonial ship. Ensure the survival of your inhabitants and try to find a new habitable planet. This is the goal of the the Exodus H Space Commanders.

name: Eyewitness Hopper
short_description: Eyewitness Hopper is a runner-style arcade game. Where you have to jump up and down avoiding many enemies and obstacles in your path and gain points setting new records.

name: Ninja Frog
short_description: A cute and easy platformer game.

name: Action Commando
short_description: As a time travelling Spartan Soldier, you must stop the Cult of the Fallen Gods that are turning people into burger meat. Grab your sword and assault cannon and deal death to these disfigured freaks in the name of humanity.

name: Bunker Builder "Atlantic Wall"
short_description: Build Atlantic Wall fortifications, battle bunkers and train your troops to be counter the invasion. Become the key player in the war machine of the Third Reich and prove your worth before Inspector General Erwin Rommel.

name: Scraftion
short_description: This game is a multiplayer survival game with multiple maps. To survive, you have to find the right materials on the right maps. Build your base and have a good time with your friends.

name: Dragluttony
short_description: Dear fellow wizard, get ready to enter our frantic 4-player arena party game! With your powerful (but random) spells and potions, feed your little cute Draglutton to make it so big it devours all your friends in a colorful and quirky chaos (without any dragon body shaming here)!

name: Dininho Space Adventure
short_description: Dininho sees an imminent threat on a planet within his system. Taken by a mixture of euphoria and concern, Dininho jumps into his ship and without thinking twice, takes off towards what may be the most dangerous and heroic adventure of your life.

name: Solbane
short_description: Battle against bosses in a shoot'em up combined with RPG elements. Choose between three diverse classes, and create your combo build from a pool of over 50 abilities. The game features a variety of bosses that require different strategies and builds to conquer.

name: Alien Planet Explorer
short_description: Alien Planet Explorer is a 2D side-scrolling platformer in which you have to find your way to the ancient sanctuary of an extinct civilization.

name: tERRORbane
short_description: tERRORbane is a comedic adventure where bugs are your FRIENDS! Enjoy exploring a crazy and outlandish world, full of unique, quirky characters and homages to the history of videogaming, challenge the Developer with your creativity and be the Bane of Errors!

name: MageCosmos
short_description: MageCosmos is a creative VR community for those who look for diverse experience in a single game. Join us to discover more and more!

name: Setup Developer Tool 2021
short_description: Beginner setup tuning - SDT2021 steps the user through the major areas of race car setup creation and tuning, asking simple questions about the behavior of the car and the user’s feel.

name: Good Heavens!
short_description: Good Heavens! is an open-world crafting and building RPG for 1-8 players. Be a warrior, sorcerer, explorer, or artisan and roam the promised lands, bursting with quirky races and cultures. Lead the heavens to salvation or, who cares, find the best werewolf tavern to get hilariously drunk.

name: Mad Wild Fairy Tale
short_description: Take control of the undead king. Manage your legacy domain and protect it from mortal trespassers. Mad Wild Fairy Tale is an Action RPG Strategy with hardcore survival and PvP-Trespassers mechanics. The game is set in a beautiful dark fantasy world.

name: ArmaCulture
short_description: ArmaCulture is an indie factory-builder RPG set in the midst of a bitter, industrialized war between two nations in a fictional world similar to our own. The game combines illustrated character art with stylized pixel art to create a unique and dark historic atmosphere.

name: Santa Soccer
short_description: Santa Soccer is a casual soccer shooting gallery type game. Featuring a golf mode and a present, if you can manage to hit it. Have fun!

name: Thirsty Suitors
short_description: Thirsty Suitors is a surreal story-driven game which throws turn-based RPG battles, skating and over-the-top cooking mechanics together in a spicy fusion! This isn't a dating sim - it's a breakup simulator. Battle your exes. Disappoint your parents. Find yourself.

name: Paper Sky
short_description: Fold, Glide, and deliver your message in this semi-open world Paper Plane adventure. Uncover heartfelt notes left by other players, upgrade your paper, and transform into a plane, a ball, a boat and more. Whether you’ve got 5 minutes or 5 hours, Paper Sky is easy to pick up and a joy to return to.

name: The Faraway Land
short_description: The Faraway Land is an open world survival simulator. Plunge into the relaxing atmosphere of a magical world filled with cute and dangerous creatures.

name: Mezzanine
short_description: A psychotronic office adventure set in the heart of Multimedia Gulch on the eve of the year 2000.

name: Desperation
short_description: In Desperation, you are an elite soldier, tasked to survive in an unknown location. You will be facing many challenges, such as building shelter, finding food and water, fighting off zombies, killer robots and even other soldiers. Will you stay solo, or will you group up? How will you survive?

name: Bridge to Another World: Endless Game Collector's Edition
short_description: These enchanting worlds can be deadly…

name: FLOW
short_description: FLOW is an extremely short psychological horror adventure video game. Wake up in the shoes of Flo, a 19-year-old, and embark on an adventure into a strange and wonderful world. The more you investigate, the more you can learn about the truth behind the universe.

name: Logistics Simulator
short_description: Logistics Simulator As an active member of a shipping company in a major city around the world, you can play with up to 10 friends in a multiplayer co-op mode or single player mode to help you understand what the cargo workers are going through, and maybe will make you rich.

name: Bunhouse
short_description: Bunhouse is a cute, simple, bunny-filled game focused on growing plants and managing a greenhouse with fellow buns. Take care of your leafy plant buddies by balancing the amount of water and light they get. Play with friends and upgrade your greenhouse for wholesome, relaxing fun.

name: Panqueca & Paçoca: A Friendship Jigsaw
short_description: The friendship's love between Pancake and Paçoca. Discover a true friendship story between two distant friends in this innovative puzzle game, told in 5 handmade illustrated scenes. Have a calm and relaxing experience.

name: Fight Party
short_description: Fight Party is a splitscreen/online multiplayer fighting game that has combos, weapons and throwable hazards to defeat your enemies. Be the last one standing in the maps to offer, each having their unique theme and style that makes different strategies and fights to occur.

name: Oversight
short_description: Compete to secure critical intelligence in this turn-based espionage game. Order your agents to infiltrate the opponent’s network and root out moles within your own. Vary your tactics to control the board while completing your objectives.

name: Super Swarm Smash
short_description: Super Swarm Smash is "Tower Defense" game. Armies of hungry insects are attacking your garden. Arrange groups of Plants along the path of the of bugs to stop them.

name: Cat of Monte Cristo
short_description: A short RPG that is a parody based on the Count of Monte Cristo, with many liberties taken that make it not very close to the original story.

name: The Scorchfarer
short_description: A scarred kingdom, a mourning god and an unfulfilled promise made with the past. Uzu and Zuhaar, two continents ravaged by a cosmic event are the setting of The Scorchfarer. The story follows Mikaela and Yukiharu, a Terramagi team tasked with healing their world and unraveling its secrets.

name: Survive Avalon
short_description: Open World, Survival, Crafting, Dungeons

name: Frontier
short_description: Challenge your friends in a many mini games. Build your own Map or download others.

name: Vikings: Age Of The Axe
short_description: Vikings: Age of the Axe is a first person slasher with both singleplayer mode and online cooperation. Prepare to go on expeditions for blood and gold around the 10th century. Become a respected chief, plunder far lands and slay your enemies for the glory of the Norse gods.

name: Cam Circle VR
short_description: Cam Circle VR is a mixed reality (MR) tool that shows part of your real world in VR. Activate it by double tapping the headset or by pressing both grip buttons.Cam Circle currently supports HTC Vive, Vive Pro 1, Vive Pro 2 and Valve Index headsets.

name: Neon Light
short_description: You have to play as a little boy who found himself on an unknown and forgotten planet, now you need to do everything to leave it.

name: Kin's Chronicle
short_description: You are Kin, a slumbering imp awakened by a less-than-stellar Arcanist who wants to fix the damaged world. Use new powers granted to you by new allies to recruit monsters and travel through time.

name: Cleithrophobia
short_description: Exploring the forest quickly turns into a nightmare, as you fall through the ground into an enourmous cave. Having no way but forward, you continue through the massive cavern, being met with hostility from the local wildlife, and exploring a lost human civilization, destroyed by an unknown force...

name: Imprisoned Hyperion
short_description: Imprisoned hyperion is an imersive sim, first-person rpg. Explore the dark and dangerous dungeons of a world that has survived its end. Survive by finding safe resting places and cooking food. Help different creatures and learn the dark history of this world and your own.

name: Head 2 Head
short_description: Head 2 Head is a one of a kind fighting game experience. You fight through a gauntlet of enemies, using ALL HEAD JUTSU to prove that you are the best. Collect Skulls and Roguelike stat buffs each time you defeat an enemy to get further along the road to becoming the HEAD MASTER.

name: Blast Ensemble
short_description: A classic match 3 game. But this time you just have to click on the lines of the same shapes instead of moving them.

name: Battle Force 2249
short_description: BATTLE FORCE 2249 is a PvE sci-fi shooter where your choices shape the fight. Pick your character, customize your loadout, and uncover a galaxy-spanning conspiracy. Quest, loot, and battle your way through hostile worlds — the future is yours to reclaim.

name: Monkey Hit
short_description: Go through long levels filled with various enemies and dangers.

name: Hentai War
short_description: Try to overcome various obstacles and Hentai girls!

name: Titan Nebula
short_description: A Sci-fi procedural spaceship exploration game, where you unlock new weapons and abilities as you complete missions and gather bounties. Deploy your advanced tactics mech unity, in this 3rd person shooter game!

name: Synth Retro Vapor Wave
short_description: Relaxing game, players drive the car to avoid colliding with other vehicles on the road. Support importing local music and car decal pictures. There are currently 12 maps, 5 cars, 20 music, AI co-driver, dynamic raindrop windows, and a large number of custom effect options.

name: Lock & Key: A Hunter's Legacy
short_description: Become an unlikely hero by exploring, building new gadgets, jumping, and shooting to delve into a mysterious tower that has emerged from the ground without warning and awakened a terrible power...

name: Lingering Legacy
short_description: The Dark God has ravaged the lands against his brother, letting his demons wage war through the once peaceful world. As the Guardian, you travel the land, purging the foul stain of the demons while in pursuit of the Fallen Guardian to restore balance once again.

name: Whack A Rat VR
short_description: Whack A Rat VR is a casual arcade experience that players of all ages will love. Stomp out rats with a collection of different hammers and take on different modes to try to get the biggest high score!

name: WICKED
short_description: Wicked is a first person co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. They say something evil lives in the house. Explore the house with your friends and find out if the rumors are true.

name: ScreamCap
short_description: ScreamCap is a team of paranormal investigators live streaming their dives into the unknown to an audience of believers.

name: Speedbreak Hyperdrive
short_description: Speedbreak Hyperdrive is a high speed, action platformer. Rush through thrilling, action-packed stages with speed and style.

name: 窓の中の先にあるもの
short_description: This game is a puzzle game in which you aim for the goal window by switching between two perspectives, one viewed from the side and the other viewed from above. The biggest feature is that when you change the viewpoint, the depth and height also change.

name: 恋爱关系/Romance
short_description: It is a love oriented short visual novel, which contains a wealth of interesting games and a large number of exquisite CG pictures. The man lives in the same apartment with his friends, works in the same company, and leads a monotonous life. The appearance of interns has changed the repetitive life.

name: The Alien Way
short_description: The Alien Way is a high-speed platformer made in 2D pixel art.Jump from platform to platform, bypassing saws and the space abyss. Open all skins with unique characteristics and pump them in a special shop in the main menu.

name: Idle Tentacles
short_description: "Hello, I wish to speak to you about our Heavenly Father and Saviour, Cthulhu."

name: TRAIN CREW
short_description: It is a game where you become a driver of the fictitious railway Tatehama Electric Railway and drive a train. Currently, you can drive up and down 28 km from Akayamacho Station to Tatehama Station.

name: Zombie Strike
short_description: Zombie Strike is a strategy RPG with AFK gameplay and various elements. Survivors can recruit heroes, transform zombies, build a mighty team to defend their home! This game has high intelligence AI automatic play. Let's say goodbye to manual operation, free your hands!

name: Mirror Of Life
short_description: Episode 1: A murder has been committed and it is unknown who committed it. Will he be able to solve this murder with Detective Oliver and a person he doesn't know? In this process, you can choose not to trust anyone...

name: Do You Care?

Avoid challenges and happy endings with heroines to continue on your journey back to your homeland.

name: CRASH EFFECTS Inc.

short_description: Beyond The Gates is a 2-4 player online co-op horror which mainly focuses on the storyline. Discover the truth behind a dark mystery that has been hidden until now.

name: Atahion - Tower Defense
short_description: Build your defense base to repel alien invaders. Atahion is a strategy and tactical defense game in which you have to extract resources, build defense towers and use bonuses to complete the mission.

name: Fancy the Frog
short_description: Be a hero Fancy the frog. finish levels and avoid dangerous enemies

name: Dungeons 4
short_description: The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
short_description: Discover the vast Chornobyl Exclusion Zone full of dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and powerful artifacts. Unveil your own epic story as you make your way to the Heart of Chornobyl. Make your choices wisely, as they will determine your fate in the end.

name: Les aventures de Fierot
short_description: Fierot est en retard pour l'école. Guide-le à travers des forêts de Val-Caron.

name: Hook Master
short_description: Hook Master will test you ability and reflexes controlling a grab and taking car parts in a conveyor and putting them in the correct deposits, collecting money and upgrading you equipament. Are you capable to control a dynamic, intense and full of obstacles line of conveyors?

short_description: The game is split in four campaigns: The Flying Circus (1917), Battle of Cambrai 1917, German spring offensive (1918) and Hat In The Ring (1918). Several airplanes are available, including the Sopwith Camel, the Nieuport 28 and the Fokker Dr.I

name: Zagu Espionage
short_description: Zagu Espionage is a single player, 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of the main character, Zagu, a spy from the Tracha colony, who is traveling to seven different regions to defeat the Rogan empire.​

name: Mutant
short_description: -15 Huge Levels. -Nine Mutant Special Abilities. -Hold Up To Four Guns At Once. -Beat Your Enemy With Crates, Barrels, Or Cars.

name: The Pirate King Ultimate
short_description: imagine you wake up in a sea world, and you have to become a pirate, so if you want to survive, you should gather all materials needed to build your own ship to travel the world and To return to the real world,By finding the lost treasure.

name: Suzy Burger
short_description: Welcome to Suzy Burger. Wear gloves and get ready to serve customers.

name: Broken Legends
short_description: Broken Legends is an adventure RPG where you control a possessed 16-year-old. Whatever is possessing this boy is turning him into a villain! Will you stop this force or become it?

name: Project PULSE
short_description: A co-op rhythm action game taking the rhythm elements of combat and pulling them into a thematic world. Play with your friends as characters that represent Melody, Bass, Harmony, and Percussion. Fight your way through your city and complete missions to build different musical weapons!

name: Swordfish
short_description: Swordfish is an efficient multimedia management tool for organizing and browsing image and video files. It helps users easily find needed files. With powerful search and filter functions, users can quickly access favorite media content, enhancing management efficiency.

name: Silent dream
short_description: In the dark corridor as wide as a labyrinth, avoiding numerous pursuers who are aiming for their lives. Will you be able to save the missing person and escape safely!?

name: SparkMutts
short_description: Explore a Massive procedurally generated Steampunk world full of smart Dogs. Meet Villagers, Brave dangers in procedural Dungeons, Buy or build your home, Craft Innovative Gadgets and explore vast biomes with fantastical mechanical Beasts on this Brass Filled Adventure.

name: Visitors: First Contact
short_description: A retro Sci-Fi First Person/Third Person shooter game similar to Star Wars: Battlefront and Rogue Squadron series. The player can choose to battle the alien race and their monster creations in Single-Player or in Multiplayer mode.

name: TOBE YUIMA - Bless You
short_description: 『TOBE YUIMA』はシングルプレイ型で、ボスバトルを中心とするシューティングアクション。 Ain dodoにインスピレーションを得た本作はバカゲー＆鬼畜ゲー要素を散りばめています。 音楽もU-Hey作曲の疾走感あるTRANCE MUSICを使用しています。 猫アレルギーのゆいまがアレルギー症状と戦いながら奇妙な世界を冒険！ 新たなアクションや強力な必殺技を手に入れて様々なボスとの戦いを繰り広げよう！

name: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love
short_description: Manipulate, freeze, and unfreeze objects in 3D first person puzzles. Explore school, meet new friends, and enjoy an anime-style story as you clear each level. Solve each puzzle to confess your love in DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're in Love!

name: Age of Jura
short_description: The Jurassic RTS dinosaur game. Prepare for an extinction in a long forgotten age, the Age of Jura, where humans are still living among dinosaurs. Take the human race to the top of the food chain. It's now or never: Kill or be killed.

name: Antediluvial : Yalroc Island
short_description: Freshly enrolled in the Empress's personal guard, you are assigned to investigate an island cut off from the world and whose inhabitants refuse to submit to the authority of the empire. Discover the secrets of the island, doomed to disappear in a ruthless flood. You have 3 days to change everything.

name: Slaycation Paradise
short_description: Are you tired of the same boring old vacations? Then boy have we got the tonic for you! Slaycation Paradise offers the ultimate in multi-dimensional apocalyptic tours. Slay away your worries with Twin-Stick action mixed with Tower Defence as you visit the end-of-world scenarios of your dreams!

name: Fog Factory - Game Maker
short_description: Game Maker-Create quest, level and adventures in free dungeons. Share your creativity with others. Fight in the levels of others. Solve environmental puzzles.

name: The Colossus Is Coming: The Interactive Experience
short_description: All seems calm. The multitude of towering trees sway in the breeze... But something feels wrong. Something is watching you, something omniscient. The feeling that you may not be alone grows ever-stronger... It's coming... find the tapes...

name: HorrorDriven: A story for the road
short_description: A first-person horror game set in a desolate radioactive zone. Explore the world both on foot or with your car which also acts as a mobile base on your journey. Scavenge for resources, lose your mind and try to piece together what made this nightmare come to life.

name: Miasma Chronicles
short_description: From the creators of Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden comes a beautifully crafted tactical adventure you won’t forget. Embark on a quest across a post-apocalyptic wasteland torn apart by a savage force known only as the ‘Miasma’.

name: Digital Expo Center
short_description: Digital Expo Center is an innovative virtual platform which is designed for various interesting exhibitions for everyone and everywhere

name: Two Point Campus
short_description: Build the university of your dreams with Two Point Campus, the sim with a twist from the makers of Two Point Hospital. Build, hire staff and run an academic institution packed with wild courses.

name: Knight Crawlers
short_description: Spawn your own enemies in this wobbly physics based rogue-lite action RPG and mow down hundreds of foes to your heart’s content. Fend off the Hordes of the Corrupted Realms by choosing powerful skill cards, enchanting equipment, and extracting living essence to upgrade your crawler.

name: Returnal™
short_description: BREAK THE CYCLE Fight to survive as this award-winning third-person shooter brings Selene’s story to PC. Take on roguelike challenges. Engage enemies in bullet hell-fuelled clashes. Share your journey through Returnal™ with another player.

name: VIVE Hub
short_description: VIVE Hub unlocks additional features for your XR headset by harnessing the power of your PC. No base stations or external sensors needed. PC VR with DisplayPort mode, mixed reality, eye tracking, and full-body tracker support.

name: The Wind: A Story of Surrender
short_description: A short side-scrolling platformer about a little bird who lost the ability to fly. With about 40 minutes to an hour filled with parkour and puzzles, this cute little story aims to teach an important lesson to people who struggle to overcome emotional trauma.

name: Mémoire d'Arumac
short_description: Aidez Mia à suivre les traces de son grand père en retrouvant le trésor perdu ! Explorez, résolvez les énigmes et collectez d’anciens artefacts.

name: Deep Lake: Prologue
short_description: "Deep Lake: Prologue" visual novel In the neo-Gothic genre, with a psychological story. Our hero's name is Sali. Sali is a former forensic photographer for the crime department. The accident that happened to him reveals in him a mysterious gift that can lead him to a terrible death.

name: Theatre of War
short_description: Engage your opponent in this unique real-time strategy game set on a surreal tile-based board game battlefield. Clash swords and fire arrows in the Medieval style, roll tanks to victory in the Great War setting, and gain air superiority in the Contemporary mode.

name: TTA 1
short_description: Tower Test Area is a classical tower defense game with puzzle elements. Build towers to defend yourself against the attacking enemies. Can you beat every level on hard? How far can you get inside Monster Power?

name: Football Bus Battle 2021
short_description: Oh no…The rival team has stolen the Football Cup before the tournament even started! The teams have deprived you of the big win. It's up to you give chase, hunt down the thieves and claim victory for your nation! Score enough Soccer team busses to become the 2021 Football Bus Battle Champion!

name: Mrs. Fantastic's Freaky Figurine Shop
short_description: Three lost souls find themselves stuck as figurines in a toy maker’s shop. They must use their new found bodies, a bear, a tiger, and a monkey, to escape the circus themed toy shop and return to their previous selves. Can they work together to find a way out?

name: Sundermead
short_description: Sundermead is an open-world, casual RPG where you can build a farm to live peacefully out in the wilderness with your friends. Beware though, there is more to this land than first meets the eye!

name: Dash Lamb
short_description: Dash lamb is a single-screen platformer. Dash to avoid the darkness below, your fire is our ruin...our salvation.

name: Super Grave Snatchers
short_description: Use necromancy to smash villages, scare townsfolk, and generally cause a ruckus.

short_description: Berserk Mode is a visceral time-attack fantasy rogue-lite. Become the Berserker and wade into a dungeon battlefield swarming with monsters. Unleash the absurd power of your Beast in a storm of blood and gibs. Prepare to enter Berserk Mode.

name: Star Iliad
short_description: Dive into the guts with Star Iliad, a retro-future action adventure game. Play as Blythe Braves, a star ranger stranded within the labyrinthine organs of the mythical Star Whale. Fight fearsome foes, sling spells and bullets, and befriend a charming set of castaways in your quest to escape.

name: xiuzhen idle
short_description: This is a xiuzhen simulation placement game! From the refining of qi, building the foundation to the ascension of the celestial realm, crossed into the divine realm. （The game has been updated with the english mod, but you will need to select the "english" beta in the properties option to update it）

short_description: Krut: The Mythic Wings is a fast-paced hack and slash, side-scrolling platformer based on a 2018 Thai CG animated feature-length film "Krut: The Himmaphan Warriors", following the adventure of a Garuda warrior on the enchanted Island, Himmaphan.

name: Bullet Wave
short_description: Bullet Wave is a driving first-person shooter straight out of the 90s. Go to the space station to fight against hordes of zombies, combat drones and infernal evil spirits.

name: News Tower

short_description: Eliminate hentai girls and clear off the censor effect.

short_description: Find the answers to the main questions and learn the whole story of the lone Bolo.

short_description: A single-player third-person / first-person action-adventure shooter set on a mystical island. With a companion by your side, fight your way through scores of deadly creatures. name: Merge It
short_description: This puzzle game is about creating new objects by colliding other ones. Also you can change instructions that say how exactly this process works.

name: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
short_description: Scholar of the Arcane Arts is a Roguelike Action RPG where every spell you cast interacts with one another. Learn new spells, solve puzzles, unlock secret dungeons, and defeat monstrous beings to save the world invaded by five Planes of magic!

name: Neon Moon
short_description: Embark on a gripping journey through Neon Moon, a dynamic Metroidvania where you confront ancient adversaries, unleash extraordinary abilities, and unearth potent relics, driven by the sole desire to conquer the enigmatic Dark Night haunting Nightlight.

short_description: Delve into the infinitely AI-generated, ghastly haunted mansion of TORUTARU. Use talismans, maps, your wits, and the friends you make along the way to fight off the angered spirits and survive. Every playthrough is a unique experience.

short_description: Low-priced practical erotic game! Try to make this headstrong, uppity, over-30 woman with a super-sexy body submit to you.

short_description: Minotaur Maze is a simple action puzzle game about navigating a maze and avoiding a monster. Somewhere out there lurking, The Minotaur is honing in on your location and hunting you down! With each new level, the difficulty increases because the maze gets larger and the Minotaur gets faster.

name: Lost EVE
short_description: Lost EVE is a dark, atmospheric puzzle-platformer, the story of which unfolds in a post-apocalyptic future about 3 thousand years after a nuclear war.

name: Galaxy Highways
short_description: An indie story-driven space shooter with intense battles, escalating enemy waves, and massive boss fights. Choose and upgrade ships, unlock powerful weapons, and protect your allies. Upgrade your base and construct a battleship to take on even stronger enemies. All set to a rock & synth soundtrack.

name: Academy Quest | アカデミークエスト
short_description: ■Synopsis The hero of the story has a special ability to power up the opposite sex. He is hired as a teacher by the state for his abilities. But the time limit is " 2 weeks". He has to raise the girls to be brave in 2 weeks.

name: Randy And Teddy Adventure Road
short_description: A game of friendship and skills! Check Randy and Teddy as they walk on the Adventure Road. They take on challenges and puzzles and learn along the way. Have a try, the game is free and superb!

short_description: Sci-Fantasy Defence is a physics based roguelite tower defense with switching between building/combat. Procedurally generated levels, local co-op on one PC.

name: Yin Yuh
short_description: A Japanese arcade style game based on a cookie-loving spirit named Yin Yuh. Jump, drop, stomp, and throw orbs at your enemies through 20 levels. If that's too easy, try is on Hard mode and Insane mode!

name: Workshop Simulator
short_description: Workshop Simulator allows you to repair and refurbish items using a range of restoration mechanics such as disassembling, cleaning, sanding and painting. The accompanying story will immerse you in the nostalgia of tinkering with your grandfather.

name: Red and White
short_description: Restore color to a vast, empty world. An abstract puzzle metroidvania game focused on exploration.

name: Nightmare Frames
short_description: Nightmare Frames is a supernatural thriller where you'll step into the shoes of Alan Goldberg, in the search for the scariest horror film of all time. An enthralling journey through the streets of the Hollywood of the 80s, a small haunted town, and even Hell itself.
