short_description: Circuit Runner is a fast-paced cyberpunk game where you collect resources to escape a dystopian tower. Use active and passive skills to outwit enemies and overcome obstacles. Compete on Leaderboards for ultimate bragging rights in this thrilling race for freedom.

name: Flight 74
short_description: Do you have what it takes to survive and become the ultimate pilot? Run missions for the South American Cartel and prove your worthiness.

name: Sokobear: Winter
short_description: Help Maintenance Bear during his winter job! Solve sokoban style puzzles in order to fix the 40 pools at the snowy Spa. Break the ice to create your way. The pools are freezing and the neighbourhood folk want them bubbling hot!

name: To Kill A King
short_description: Explore a world that deviates from the cliches of the genre and does not take itself seriously. Enter Rots….a foul-mouthed, short-tempered, and belligerent undead female warrior "erected" to serve the Ignoble King completing his mundane tasks and honoring his frustrating requests.

name: Grim Tales: Threads of Destiny Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you free Jackie’s parents from their deadly fates?

name: Dot Dash Dot
short_description: "You were the only applicant. You have been accepted. Please report to Locke Key by Monday." Take the role of a lighthouse operator, and use your spacebar to send Morse code messages to ships in the sea.

name: Loopmancer
short_description: Loopmancer is a 3D platformer roguelite action game with realistic graphics that takes place in a cyberpunk universe. Players play as a detective who comes back to life after an unexpected death, and battle in this lifelike and futuristic city of the east.

name: Graveyard Shift
short_description: Scavenge, tiptoe, and fight your way to the surface in this dangerously cute puzzle and stealth game where everyone can hear—but not see—everything you do.

name: No!Ah!'s Ark

name: Chambers of Devious Design
short_description: Chambers of Devious Design is a tactical tile placement game, where you are tasked with building an evil lair for an evil mastermind. Come up with creative designs and sabotage your competitors!

name: One more game
short_description: This is a single player self-propelled chess game including the mechanism of chess synthesis, relic, magic, front and back row position and so on. Players need to buy pieces, choose relic, defeat more and more powerful enemies and finally win

name: Sisterhood
short_description: A unique story-driven, third-person adventure shooting game set in the alternate medieval-styled universe, dominated by church. Complete missions with your sisters, rescue them from troubles, gain their affection and unlock interactions.

name: Galaxity : Bangkok VR
short_description: Galaxity is a wonderful virtual world. In this game, you can create an avatar and customize it with a variety of costumes. You can also talk to people and become friends with them. Join Galaxity, and enjoy various mini-games and fun videos together!

name: Pyramid Rush
short_description: This is a diverse puzzle-platformer, that constantly breaks the fourth wall. Resolve physics-based puzzles, go through challenging platformer levels and beat bosses! This game was intended to be a simple "Indiana Jones" rip-off, but something went wrong and it is YOUR mission to fix the game!

name: Zombie Apocalypse 2021
short_description: Zombie Apocalypse 2021 is a fast old-school shooting game in platformer style. Kill all zombies and protect your city in this super fast game!

name: Loopindex
short_description: Test your wits on the unique “loop mechanic” with single player or co-op multiplayer.

name: Dandy & Randy DX
short_description: Play either alone or with a friend on this cute adventure game!

short_description: Crown of Pain is a match-3 RPG. Heroes venture to the castle to find the elusive crown of pain, an artifact which is said to take away all of their worries.

name: Wellness Hero
short_description: Wellness Hero is a role playing and strategy game that teaches wellness and therapeutic methods to heal mental, psychological, and emotional pain. To practice mental health challenges, before we go through them. Do you practice meditation, journaling, habit tracking, therapy? You are one of us.

name: Oftalmogarden
short_description: Oftalmogarden is a fast and chaotic roguelike sci-fi eyeball monster shooting game. Shoot your way through hordes of enemies, collect upgrades, weapons, and gadgets to grow stronger, but accumulate curses over time. Speed is your best ally to survive, the sky is watching and death will not wait.

name: Burnit Quest
short_description: Blast baddies and burn calories! Burnit Quest is a mobile enhanced fitness platformer, connect your phone to your PC to and get ready to sweat!

name: The Unnamed Game

short_description: FISTICUBES! THE ULTIMATE ONE-BUTTON BOXING BASHER! Fisticubes is a goofy physics-based one-button boxing party game where up to 4 players compete to destroy each other! Avoid anvils & bombs, eat vegetables and use springs to turn the tide of the fight!

name: Gos Castle Runner
short_description: Run against time, jump holes and saws before time runs out. Gos Castle Runner it's a 2D platform game of running and jumping. In this game, you control a small ghost that has to pass through the castle by jumping holes and dodging saws to reach the end of the level.

name: Touhou: the Unreachable Oneiroborder
short_description: “The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a beginner-friendly Touhou-styled Bullet Hell shmup. Indulge in a uniquely Touhou experience with intricate patterns and stylish effects.

name: Time Knight Adventures
short_description: A single screen retro platformer with a ticking clock, large maps to explore, upgrades to find and lots of secrets.

name: Gladiator Immortal

Build up your town, hire and level up warriors, find powerful weapons and armour, learn and develop new skills and win favour with the gods.

name: POG 3

name: Tiny Life
short_description: In Tiny Life, you control a set of people that live together in a household. You take care of their daily needs, build their skills, forge new relationships... or just mess up their entire life in whatever way you can think of!

name: Harvest Hero Origins
short_description: A wave defense game in classic arcade style. Play the infinite survival mode alone or with a friend (co-op), or play story mode and experience the origin story of the Harvest Hero!

name: Holy Grain
short_description: Holy Grain is a celebration of absurdity and over-the-top comedic brutality. It’s a full-on attack against political correctness and wholesome family values. In this roguelike, you’ll team up with two characters—the Counselor and the Entity—to save the world from its impending doom.

name: Memories with my Kitten
short_description: Remember the trips with your cute kitten in this beautiful photo album in puzzle format.

name: Fabledom
short_description: Set in a wholesome fairytale world, Fabledom is a laid-back City builder. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, interact with your neighbors and defend your kingdom from magical creatures. All to find true love and live happily ever after!

name: BeerLeague Superstar
short_description: BeerLeague Superstar is a Basketball Simulation RPG that lets you take control of your very own superstar. Customize his appearance and skillset then lead your team to BeerLeague glory and win the ultimate prize: The BeerLeague Championship.

name: Last Night of Winter
short_description: Wake up and walk, Warden! Because the siege continues. We must find the Heir... And finally put an end to this cursed night.

name: Homewords
short_description: Dive into "Homewords," a captivating, story-driven RPG without any combat. Explore Orbtüse with Zoë, a rude child, as you skillfully interrupt and guide her through conversations. Use the power of words to overcome conflicts, unravel mysteries, and help Zoë learn the art of empathy.

name: The Colorful Creature
short_description: The Colorful Creature is difficult platformer with puzzle color mechanics. Play over 350 levels with diverse gameplay that have many items and hazards, in-game level editor, local multiplayer, endless run, customizable skins & hats, steam workshop and more!

name: Balloon Jump
short_description: There is only one thing to do: JUMP! Can you stay alive?

name: Tube Rolling
short_description: A fast-paced arcade ball rolling in a tube in which you have to dodge obstacles, unlock new skins, and constantly improve your latest score.

name: Christmas Stories: Puss in Boots Collector's Edition
short_description: Why would anyone stop Christmas?

name: Another Path
short_description: A single-player puzzle exploration game sets in a desolated land in the mysterious world. Switch between a boy and a canine to explore this obscure island, and discover its mystical hidden artifacts. Solve the puzzle and escape the mysterious world!

name: Slime Rancher 2
short_description: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys across the Slime Sea to Rainbow Island, a land brimming with ancient mysteries, and bursting with wiggly, new slimes to wrangle in this sequel to the smash-hit, Slime Rancher.

name: Mr. Sleepy Man
short_description: In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

name: Cactus Cowboy 3 - Fully Loaded
short_description: Cactus Cowboy is back, in a fully fledged story shooter made for experienced VR Gamers.

name: Virtual ULTIMATE Beach Dancer [HD+]
short_description: Virtual ULTIMATE Beach Dancer [HD+] for your Windows devices...

name: Ultimechs
short_description: Your mech is ready. The crowd roars. Welcome to the arena! The thrill of professional athletics meets the precision of purpose-built machines in Ultimechs, the latest multiplayer VR gaming experience from Resolution Games.

name: Combots
short_description: Combots is a multiplayer robot war shooter set in fully procedurally generated maps with the physical environment.

name: VR Office Experience
short_description: ‘Vr Office Experience’ sanal gerçeklik oyunu hem gerçek dünyada yapılan içerik gözlemlerini hem de sanal dünyada bu içerikleri deneyimleme şansını sunmaktadır.

name: 3Cushion Masters
short_description: This is a game that has signed an official license contract with a professional sports league hosted by the Professional Billiard Association (PBA).

name: Quiz Carnage
short_description: If you love a great quiz, especially one that is action-packed with unexpected twists and turns, then Quiz Carnage is your game!

name: PrototypeOutpost3
short_description: A third-person shooter game, play the protagonist, walk in this apocalypse that has nothing to do with you, and experience the truth behind it.

name: Anime puzzle
short_description: Anime puzzle is a classic puzzle that offers you to put the picture together from a huge number of details!

name: Crown
short_description: Dare to fight in the world of Crown, a world in which seven kingdoms try to resist the arrival of Nephalem. Create your team of five brave warriors and face off other players in a strategic turn-based combat system while enjoying our personal anime style!

name: I Am Future: Cozy Apocalypse Survival
short_description: I Am Future is a relaxing single-player survival game about building a cozy rooftop camp amid a flooded post-apocalyptic city. Set up a farm, go fishing, tinker with gadgets, craft new tools, manage a team of cute robots to automate and expand your base, explore the mysterious world, and chill out!

name: Really Weird Pool
short_description: Really Weird Pool is all the fun of normal pool but with weird shaped tables. Play with friends or strangers online or locally, or play against the computer.

name: Aces in the Dust
short_description: Take command of a team of three elite Airmen! Each of them pilots a warplane equipped with the most powerful experimental weapons to date. Shoot down enemies using machine guns, missiles, energy cannons and… a laser beam? Venture into enemy territory and wreak havoc in this rail shooter.

name: Dual Gunstrike
short_description: WARNING! Dual Gunstrike is a 100-Mega Shock!/32-bit inspired horizontal shmup. Choose between 4 heroes and blast into space to stop a mysterious multi-dimensional creature from destroying humanity!

name: Moonstone Island
short_description: Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

name: Gosh A Ghost
short_description: Gosh A Ghost is an online multiplayer action game set in a haunted mansion. The ghost hunter with the most points wins the round!

name: Witty witch
short_description: Witty witch is a 2D puzzle platformer with handpainted graphics. Suitable for a wide audience of all ages and preferences. 100 levels, filled with a variety of monsters will force you to show ingenuity and dexterity. And a funny story will give motivation to reach the end.

name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising
short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising is an action RPG set in the same world as Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Features town-upgrading mechanics, fast-paced combat. A prequel to the world of the Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

name: Wolf of Stock Street
short_description: New gameplay, fresh style, unique stock market themes, so you can't stop playing! How to combine financial games with adult content? Invite you to experience the unprecedented, ridiculous but unstoppable way of lewd wolves in the stock market!

name: Dress-up Pups
short_description: Pattie is an animal-lover, working at the Dress-Up Pups fashion agency for dogs. Help her deal with ten different clients, each with their own dog and their own special requests, in this hilarious and exciting Match-3 adventure.

name: Albert and Puzzle Mansion
short_description: Albert's cat has been abducted! Enter the mansion and solve puzzles in order to find and rescue the cat!

name: The Mountain Hunting
short_description: Whether you hunt freely in the open world with the "Free Hunt" mode, or try to complete the missions given to you with the "MISSION" mode. Besides that this mode also includes interestingly extraordinary missions from time to time.

name: AudioClash: Battle of the Bands
short_description: Create a band and dominate the competition in this new music-themed auto-battler developed by Big Boat Interactive in conjunction with The Living Tombstone. Take part in 4-player battles and unleash your abilities to win and earn rewards. AudioClash features all members of The Living Tombstone!

name: GrubDash Driver: Food Delivery Driver Simulator
short_description: It’s the year 2020. A mysterious, unknown event has decimated the economy and the only source of income that remains is delivering food. Open the GrubDash game and start delivering now!

name: EQDRIVE.IO
short_description: High precision soft body physics for cars, trucks, airplanes, drones, ships and theme park rides. Supports SteamDeck

name: Thukothea Defender
short_description: A strategic tower-defense where you control powerfull drones. Unlock new tower and use specific technologies to defend your base on Thukothea!

name: Virtual Becomes Reality: A Stanford VR Experience
short_description: With Virtual Reality technology widely available, it’s more important than ever to understand its impact on people and society. Explore highlights of nearly two decades of research from Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab and discover how we can use this medium to enhance our everyday lives.

name: Bullion - The Curse of the Cut-Throat Cattle
short_description: A frantic brawler for 1-4 players with a cast of bovine buccaneers and a unique blend of PvP and co-op gameplay: grab the most loot and stab your friends.... but be sure to keep at least one crewmate alive as you battle to become the sole survivor of the Curse of the Cut-Throat Cattle!

name: Idle Atomic
short_description: Idle Atomic is an Incremental Idle RPG in a post-apocalyptic world. Level up skills, refine your salvaged materials and hunt mutant creatures to survive!

name: Space Drone: Rescue Mission
short_description: Space drone is a minimalist open world puzzle game with grid movement where you remotely control a drone to find and rescue your lost mates in space. Every movement spend energy, be aware to don't be without it!

name: SNIPERPUNK
short_description: We are a student team with a passion for multiplayer games. Grab your Gun and select a Punk in local or online 1v1 BULLET-HELL ROGUE-LIKE gameplay! With each round, players pick their upgrades and create a better build to defeat their opponent. Use character guns, skills, and abilities to WIN.

name: Revelation
short_description: Revelation is an intense arcade-style puzzle game from Krisalis where you spin color-coded interconnected dials inside clockwork locks to match colors and create chain reactions to open each safe. Thinking ahead is crucial, as each lock will affect adjacent locks when spun.

name: Grandmaster Chess
short_description: Whether you’re a beginner or a veteran, this fully featured chess game from Capstone has all the tools and features you need to learn and master the game of chess. Challenge an opponent with five adjustable skill levels from beginner to grandmaster.

name: Vampire Slave 1: A Yaoi Visual Novel
short_description: The world's most ancient vampire, a young & unprepared new leader of a centuries old vampire-hunting organization, thrust together by fate. Thalos knows he's found his beloved, but Dusty must never let himself grow close to a vampire. A kinetic visual novel that grows spicier with each installment!

name: 汉字大冒险
short_description: 汉字大冒险是一款以汉字组合为玩法的解密游戏。汉字与汉字间的合成，迸发出无限可能！

name: SpellHunter
short_description: A puzzle game for young and old ... to relax on the bus and train or learn to read and write for the younger among us. The atmospheric pictures and music pieces relax and motivate in equal measure.

name: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
short_description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. From your castle base, rise to become the lord who leads the battle against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

name: Blazing Aries
short_description: The game tells the story of a new adventurer named Aries. She visits all kinds of cities, travels around the unknown world, fights against the "Calamities" that spread all over the world. This game's core is the orthodox action fighting mode!

name: End of Lines
short_description: Travel across landscapes devastated by a catastrophic climate meltdown, following a small family in search of somewhere habitable. With limited supplies and facing potential death at every turn, your choices will decide their fate. Will they manage to settle down?

name: Overmorrow
short_description: Overmorrow is a serene, nonviolent, exploration adventure game that deletes your save after 30 days.

name: HITMAN World of Assassination
short_description: Enter the world of the ultimate assassin. HITMAN World of Assassination delivers the definitive stealth action experience, putting you in the shoes of Agent 47, a master assassin. Explore immersive locations, uncover hidden secrets, and eliminate targets with complete freedom of approach.

name: Creatures Docking Station
short_description: Raise and train a troupe of cuddly virtual life creatures that live on a Space Station. Because they have neural network brains, Norns can be taught right from wrong, but because they also have their own, individual personalities, they may not always do what you want.

name: Charisma X: Bulk Instagram Media Downloader
short_description: Charisma X: Bulk Instagram Media Downloader is a software for downloading Instagram profile, photos, videos, your saved post or insta feed or any specific insta item in matter of seconds with just a simple click. etc in bulk with single click.

name: THE LAST DEFENSE!
short_description: A classic tower defense game with ordinary graphics didn't fascinate you? Well, let's give a try and see how long you can defend! Show your commanding skills and prove no enemy can break your defense! Be a hero and save humanity with the LAST DEFENSE!

name: REMEDIUM
short_description: The fast-paced twin-stick shooter game in the grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. It had been more than a hundred years since the terrible plague devoured the whole continent and turned almost everyone there in the maddened mutants.

name: Unholy Neighbourhood
short_description: Embark on an amazing mission in Unholy Neighborhood - an atmospheric adventure game point and click, full of surreal locations and plot twists. Find the missing wife of Peter Grim and face the forces of evil. Experience a mysterious cataclysm that will change the world forever.

name: SUPER 56
short_description: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores. Outlandish chaos awaits you in Hell!

name: Snowboarding
short_description: Snowboard on slopes and on ramps, perform stunts and get points.

name: TD Worlds
short_description: TD Worlds is a dynamic, highly strategical game that challenges your skill. Build an impenetrable defense and get ready to plunge into a new, unknown world to uncover its secrets. Use Twitch integration and play with your viewers.

name: BoF1LL: A Withering World
short_description: Together two companions will explore and restore their shrouded landscapes. Playable solo and in Couch Co-op!

name: Crossed Wires
short_description: Navigate your oblivious companion through a world filled with dangers such as lasers, rush hour traffic, homemade flamethrowers and aggressive cleaning robots by solving a variety of puzzles in this hilarious and unpredictable adventure. Can you keep him safe from himself?

name: Uninvited Guest
short_description: Uninvited Guest is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1930. You play as a villager who was destined to end up in an old mansion.

name: Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening
short_description: An open world party-based RPG set in an original fantasy world called Neebota, where Zeebo and his friends hunt for portals from our earth, and in doing so, uncover secret powers, ancient lore of their world and a vast conspiracy across space and time. With music by legendary David Wise.

name: Sprite Sequence Chapter 2
short_description: A short wacky adventure about the discovery of one's self. In this second chapter, our nameless hero learns to fight and survive alone in the wild before discovering the reasons of his ordeal.

name: Hour Night
short_description: An online multiplayer game with 3-10 players where you survive against a shapeshifting monster. Do you know who you can trust?

name: The Last Chimera
short_description: This is RPG use only mouse. The player "chimera" changes to next generation by execute specific events. You will know the meaning of "your birth" when you get to "that place". There are three levels of difficulty. If it's "Easy", you can enjoy the story purely without any trouble.

name: Be The ONE
short_description: You are the last survivor. Your friends and allies got killed during a raid. Can you survive the endless waves of enemies?

name: Townseek
short_description: Embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

name: Feyght
short_description: A small Real-Time Strategy game with a cute drawn style. Your villages are under attack! Collect resources, build up towns, defences and prepare small armies to survive.

name: Hideout: Face your fears
short_description: In this third person stealth game set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by an artificial intelligence, you will take on the role of May in her quest to save her brother. Avoid the robots, explore the town and find its secrets!

name: Dungeon Lad
short_description: Explore a randomly generated dungeon as you juggle your health, gold, and remaining time. Complete floors and defeat enemies in order to unlock more powerful upgrades for subsequent runs to delve deeper and deeper. Unlock more upgrades, enemies and more as you explore infinite dungeons.

name: UNCHARTED™: Legacy of Thieves Collection
short_description: Play as Nathan Drake and Chloe Frazer in their own standalone adventures as they confront their pasts and forge their own legacies. This game includes the critically acclaimed single-player stories from both UNCHARTED 4: A Thief’s End and UNCHARTED: The Lost Legacy.

name: Mouse Hunter
short_description: Mouse Hunter - a puzzle game with a top view, executed in 2D graphics, where you have to catch the mouse.

name: Gray Death
short_description: In a world full of demons and the undead, a man searches for his lost wife. Resources are limited. Death is instant and waiting in the darkness. You will be running, jumping, climbing and searching in this 2D or 2.5D puzzle platformer.

name: Project Theta
short_description: A made for VR hero shooter with fast paced action powered by an advanced movement system that provides the player unparalleled freedom of movement. Sprint, jump, slide, dash, climb, vault, wall run and lean around cover for a true VR parkour experience while hunting down the enemy team.

name: Invertigo
short_description: INVERTIGO is a first-person sci-fi puzzle-platformer where you have to manipulate gravity to solve puzzles. Explore the abandoned facility and make use of gravity manipulation to advance through the rooms.

name: Party Demon
short_description: Party Demon is a tower defense, deck-building game where your main goal is to protect a Lady Demon’s birthday party from human intruders. Build your castle on a budget and defend it in real-time with a deadly Trap Deck full of demonic weapons.

name: Nekoba RocknRoll
short_description: The ultimate 2D action game where a cat with a bazooka fights! A variety of missions await you and your cat. Regain love and peace!

name: Fallow
short_description: Clinging to the memory of her vanished sisters, an isolated woman wanders a dying reality.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
short_description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection contains thirteen prior released classic games. This collection is a great place for gamers to experience these popular titles on Steam.

name: The Midnight Wind
short_description: The Midnight Wind is a sarcastic single-player pixel art RPG following the story of four hosts of the souls of a dead star. The story loosely takes place in Indonesia, where players will embark on a bare-bones journey to protect themselves and their people.

name: 7th Chance
short_description: 7th Chance is a short (20-30 minute) story-based exploration adventure game. Waking up from a night of heavy drinking ... something isn't right.

name: Bunny Flush
short_description: Just go up, don't look down. You will be addicted to this platform game that will challenge you to the fullest.

name: Devileader
short_description: Devileader, a fearsome space demon who once have destroyed countless planets of the solar system is about to be resurrected by his minions and fanatics, who want to bring chaos to the universe. Pilot the agile space interceptor Deviship and survive the terror of this demon lord.

name: Puzzle Cafe VR
short_description: Puzzle Cafe VR is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game made for VR. Relax in a nice cafe and solve some jigsaw puzzles, complete challenges and upgrade the cafe scenery.

name: Sweet House
short_description: This is a relaxing and casual little game. You need to help the beautiful girls to find their lost things.

name: Figurine Scene Simulator
short_description: Figurine Scene Simulator is a sandbox game where you build a character portfolio from a huge library of figurines. You can place the figurines in scenes and set them to animations to compose artistic expressions and take screen and video captures. You can also expand your character options via DLC.

name: Mystery of Camp Enigma 2: Point & Click Puzzle Adventure
short_description: A thrilling puzzle adventure, inspired by hidden object escape room games. Picking up from the radio tower. You discover a remote signal being transmitted from somewhere on the island. Your objective to investigate, along with your continuing mission to discover the missing army personnel.

name: Antecrypt
short_description: Save mankind's last hard-drive with your rechargeable laser-beam in this tight single-stick top-down shooter!

name: Paper Enchantress
short_description: Paper Enchantress - это романтическое приключение полное магии, судьбоносных решений и прекрасных принцев. Что откроется за таинственной дверью?

name: Upaon: A Snake's Journey
short_description: Help this sympathetic Snake on her journey to the hidden treasure, solve puzzles that mix mechanics of the classic game Snake with Sokoban

name: Aloft
short_description: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

name: Laundry Simulator
short_description: A point-and-click time-management game where cats rule. Manage your hectic laundromat and get your cat through law school to defeat Laundrocorp.

name: Decent Into Sector 32
short_description: Descent into Sector 32 is a 3rd persons flying mystery game. You are dispatched on a search and rescue mission to sector 32, a giant asteroid field with many mysteries. Make the right choices or your squadron might need rescuing yourself, and the truth is, nobody is going to come for you.

name: Redacted Epilogue
short_description: Set a few years after the events of the comic book "REDACTED: Revival", this 2.5D first-person RPG with turn-based combat continues the story of the former Black Ops experimental soldier known by the codename "The Black Anvil", as he prepares to defend civilization from another latent threat.

name: Neon: Eternal
short_description: Neon: Eternal is a 2D Retro-styled Arena shooter. Blast your way through seamlessly never-ending action-packed levels of radiating colors while eliminating over 50 unique enemies!

name: Swooping Justice
short_description: A humorous tongue in cheek Action-Adventure game. You're an Australian Magpie, swooping and pooping on societies wrong doers. Inconsiderate parking inspectors, Abusive cops, Corrupt politicians, scooter and roller blade kids at skate parks, drop bears...the list goes on!

name: Tale of Serendipity
short_description: Tale of serendipity is a third person survival horror with multiple endings, in which the search of your lost feline will make you question yourself the limits of reality and obsession When facing danger is not an option, the only thing left is survive.

name: ATOLL
short_description: The earth has been struck by an extinction level meteor, eliminating most of humanity. Survive by managing resources beneath the ocean surface in a single-person submarine craft. Test your survival skills to see if you can once again reach the ocean surface and uncover the fate of the earth!

name: Rain Island: Orange
short_description: Rain Island: Orange is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

name: H-Isekai Loves
short_description: What will you do when you are accidentally transported to another world? Looking to survive and return to the old world ? Or become the main character of this story? Try our new game. And of course, this is your chance to make your own Harem. Definitely !

name: Monmusu Gladiator
short_description: A board game, card game, and monster girl-raiser all in one! Build the perfect deck in this cute & casual roguelite action RPG! Will you prioritize raising your monster girls? Making them fight? Or maybe you're more of a shopping fiend!

name: Ultimate Physical Wrestling
short_description: A professional wrestling game that can be played with that "ring-shaped controller"! Four wrestlers stand in front of you! Use your own body to make your move!

name: Master Boy
short_description: "Master Boy" is a happy-paced cartoon casual role-playing game with Chinese cuisine as the theme. Players can accept tasks in charming urban areas, help friends defend farm and beach, exterminate invaders and collect ingredients to get rewards and improve their own attributes. Just enjoy it.

name: 99 Pixel Cats
short_description: A cargo full of 99 Pixel cats crashed on Venus. Abort your asteroids mining mission. Your priority is now to rescue the cats by digging your way down into the puzzling underground caves of an old hazardous industrial planet.

name: Colors Assemble
short_description: Help Brad reunite with his family and complete all hand-crafted 2D platform challenges in a colorful twisted world.

name: RE:Jump Boy
short_description: Jump one by one small steps, take a rainbow bath in the last toilet, and you will enter the next level

name: Wildlife Match
short_description: Jungle animals are going missing and Agent Blonde is on the case! Help her and her friend, Professor Fox, get to the bottom of the mystery! Match fun animal shapes, complete missions and face down powerful monsters on your quest to save the jungle!

name: Endless Love
short_description: Endless Love is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: The Wolf's Den
short_description: The Wolf's Den is a suspenseful first person experience through a dark atmospheric mountain. Explore a mysterious train tunnel on your way to escape from a tragic accident that destroyed you and your partner's lab and uncover the truth behind the mysteries that surround you. Enter The Wolf's Den!

name: Way To The Woods
short_description: A Deer and Fawn must embark on a journey through an abandoned world of the unknown to get home. A third person adventure game solo developed by ant tan. Featuring soundtrack from aivi & surasshu, composers for the show Steven Universe.

name: Hoples
short_description: Hoples - 2D hardcore precision platformer with time limits.

name: Arausio
short_description: Explore the ancient theatre of Arausio and discover Roman antiquity in this narrative exploration game!

name: Party Host 85
short_description: Party like it's 1985! You're the host of the wildest party of the century and have to plan and execute a succesful event. Get to know all the crazy characters and discover what they will do once the party started.

name: Animal Diner
short_description: Run a Diner while preparing, cooking and serving various animals their favorite dish. Design, decorate and expand your Diner as you attract new kinds of animal customers with new unlocks, items and dishes. Manage the Diner all by yourself or take help of your friends in up to 4 player local co-op!

name: Pirates
short_description: (Sandbox Game) You play as a pirate on a remote island, surviving alone or with other players as you battle hostile skeletons. Construct a shelter and gather resources to fortify your survival.

name: Chess Valley 2
short_description: Play chess in a way you've never played. Face a board like a labyrinth and try to cross it with the king to join his army.

name: SHINORUBI
short_description: Inspired by classic Japanese shooting games, SHINORUBI is a pure dose of adrenaline and frenetic arcade action with all the best aspects of Japanese bullet hell games, optimized for modern PC in ultra HD, all in a polished, accessible with many levels of difficulties.

name: KIDDO
short_description: KIDDO is a point-and-click adventure game packed with clever puzzles, a striking hand-drawn art style, and an ironic sense of humor... because if you’re going to hit rock bottom, you might as well do it with style.

name: Selene's Nightmare
short_description: Selene is trapped in a nightmare, and will have to fight her worst fears along the way to the end.

name: Azimech
short_description: fight against waves of enemies to bring down the major forest entities !

name: Shoal
short_description: Hungry for shark games? Start fishing! Go fish for food as a hungry shark swimming in a shoal of fish.

name: Karanos Solitaire
short_description: Karanos Solitaire is a relaxing combo-building card game designed for short solo gameplay sessions.

name: Die Like a Hero
short_description: Die Like a Hero is a rogue-lite with turn-based combat, where the best strategy is to attack at the right moment. Fight like a die or die like a hero!

name: Manta
short_description: Sci-fi combat flight-sim featuring underwater stealth-action, and real-time strategy. Pilot the unique biological fighter Manta through the skies and through the depths as you command a fleet of warships, and mine the ocean floor for resources.

name: Vacancy Unlimited
short_description: The dead fill the streets you grew up on. It's time to leave home in search for your father. Uncover the magical secrets of your family's past that will shape the apocalypse as you know it.

name: Yellow Ballman
short_description: High Speed 2D Ball Action

name: Crimson Glaive Sigma
short_description: Enjoy this 2D metroidvania-like bullet hell platformer. Jump, dodge and traverse using your jet pack. Find weapons and abilities. Fight bosses and escape an old space station drifting through the cosmos. You are alone, with nothing but a space suit and a gun. Just keep going! Persevere and triumph!

name: Circus Electrique
short_description: Circus Electrique is part story-driven RPG, part tactics, part circus management, and completely enthralling– all with a steampunk twist. When everyday Londoners mysteriously turn into vicious killers, only the show’s talented performers possess the skills necessary to save the city.

name: Soer Dolls
short_description: Soer Dolls is a horror adventure game in which you need to find enchanted dolls in order to save the small town of Lazyiville from the terrible curse that caused ghosts and monsters to appear in the city!

name: Parasomnia Verum
short_description: Parasomnia Verum is an atmospheric horror game about a recurring dream.

name: Hentai Waifu Girls
short_description: «Hentai Waifu Girls» - is an addictive hentai game that combines beautiful art, good music and interesting puzzle mechanics! If you want to relax after a hard day - this game is definitely for you!

name: Candy land
short_description: In front of you are cards with different "delicious" images. The images are hidden from you. You need to find all pairs of identical images. You can open two cards at the same time. Remember the pictures, look for their pairs, and try to use as few attempts as possible.

name: Tiny Golf Adventure
short_description: Challenge yourself in a simple, arcade-like golf game set in a cartoon world and unlock new skills and accessories.

name: Astra: Fading Stars
short_description: It's you who can make a change. Use your soul to fight the corruption that leaks in the mysterious and atmospheric universe of Astra. Dive deeply into the essence of this world and navigate around danger leaning on truths and secrets. The Stars are Fading! Soon the darkness will swallow them all.

name: Write 'n' Fight

name: Deep Despair 2
short_description: Deep Despair 2 is an open world survival adventure action game with procedural generation and complete freedom of action: building, crafting, hunting, farming, livestock, brewing, cooking, traveling, fight, and more.

name: Pipe Dreamin' VR: The Big Easy
short_description: Pipe Dreamin' VR: The Big Easy is a single player casual puzzle game set in the chaotic, watery and silly world of subterranean New Orleans. As a player, you will use custom VR mechanics to catch raining pipes, avoid the rising waters and build unique pipe structures to escape flooding rooms.

name: SAVE THE UNICORN
short_description: Is a sidescroller game in which you need to fly a helicopter piloted by a cute panda, and save falling unicorns from evil opponents

name: Minimal Moba
short_description: Minimal Moba is a minimalist version of the popular capture-and-hold arena game mode. Two teams compete in a circular map with a total of 5 capturable towers. Players create their own loadouts by selecting a combination of abilities and runes which can be swapped out anytime in the spawn area.

name: Mayday: The Survival Island
short_description: Mayday is an exciting open-world survival game. After a mysterious accident, you are on a desert island and need to survive. Collect resources, craft tools, hunt, fish, farm and explore an archipelago, full of unique islands and secrets to discover.

name: Saber Punks
short_description: Cyberpunk VR Fighting Game that lets you sling sword beams in head-to-head online combat. Block or dodge incoming attacks while performing combos to imbue your attacks with special powers. Block to gather your meter and summon ultimate weapons to overwhelm your enemy.

name: Catching a Ride
short_description: Drive at night seeing the road only through the light of other cars, in this tiny adventure about feeling lost, and making friends along the way.

name: Strawberry Samurai
short_description: Strawberry Samurai is a samurai-themed action platformer with a fruity twist. Slash oranges, blueberries, and more in a world filled with bloody combat, sentient fruit, and an obnoxious amount of fruit puns. Oh, and bathe in the juice of your enemies.

name: Idle Heros
short_description: 《IDLE HEROS》 is a special placement game, invite your friends to form a fixed team, come to participate in the battle, placement can easily obtain a variety of resources

name: AirFighter
short_description: Air Fighter is a 3D game in which you can fly your personal plane from World War II and take part in air battles against other planes.

name: SLOMI
short_description: You are casual pilot of cargo plane, that transporting wheat grain from point A to point B, your job is routine. And once *BOOM* your plane crashed, you landed at mistery land that you need to explore and main thing Survive! Become a truly colonizer and try to escape it, good luck lost soul.

name: Match3 mania!
short_description: Match3 mania! - a hardcore challenge for fans of the genre! Timekiller with a constant race against time, which is always short. Break blocks according to the rules of match3 games and collect big combos for extra seconds to help you reach incredible records!

name: Pingo's Revenge
short_description: With logical moves you'll be able to push all the diamonds together and thus master the levels. Make your own way through the different areas and kill the enemies with the help of ice blocks to save your girlfriend.

name: Train'em
short_description: Train’em is a creature-collection adventure, with real time combat and an open world to explore. Explore the world of Regione Lazina alongside your team of companions, fight other trainers, play with friends, achieve emblems and trophies, win tournaments & become the master of this world

name: Monster Maker
short_description: This is a Xiuxian style role-playing game! In the game, build caves, capture spirit animals, and plant miraculous drugs. 360 degree lockless combat mode, even when flying in the sky, you can wave your long sleeve to move mountains and reclaim the sea.

name: Yoshimitsu Hatsumi
short_description: Yoshimitsu Hatsumi is an addictive mix of RPG and classic side-scrolling combat.

name: X-Force Genesis
short_description: This game that brings back all the charm of shmup games from the 80s/90s. X-Force Genesis is a frantic and chaotic space shooter created from big and beautiful graphics with insane boss battles. Embark on epic battles and stop enemies from establishing a military base in orbit around X-planet

name: It's Better Alone
short_description: A weathered man, haunted by the past. A burdened robot, living to atone. Switch control between two characters, and have them work together in this single player puzzle platformer. Journey through a world in ruin, and discover the events that led to the end of the world.

name: Discord Bot Workshop [EARLY ACCESS]
short_description: Make Discord bots faster, smarter, easier with Discord Bot Workshop.

name: QuestNotes
short_description: QuestNotes is an MMOTRPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Table Talk RPG). As a player, you can not only explore the fantasy world of swords and sorcery. As a master, you can become a storyteller and create scenarios and sessions. Up to four players can form a party and adventure together.

name: Project: Vaccine A
short_description: Firewall, vaccine, cleaner... Place various blocks to protect your CPU! Vaccine A is a sandbox defense game, filled with parody of various programs.

name: In Cold Dark
short_description: An interactive point-and-click space story about rediscovering a life, our friendships, our choices and regrets.

name: Plush Madness
short_description: A summoning has gone wrong.Now the house and all plushies are possessed. Can you make it through the maze, activate all symbols and defeat the demon? Plush Madness is a Horror Fighting Game optimized for VR and playable for Flatscreen too.

name: SlideNSlip
short_description: SlideNSlip is a cute, casual, and challenging top-down puzzle game, in which the goal is to maneuver Mac and his penguin friends around so that Mac can get to his jet ski and escape the icy island he's stuck on.

name: Nexonauts
short_description: Use your ship to explore a massive galaxy. Land on planets and gather resources to maintain and upgrade your ship! Invite your friends to help and set up jobs and missions.

name: Fear Protocol: Shadow Paradigm
short_description: It's another nice dark day in Escondido, California and special agent Jack Banger goes from out of the frying pan and into the fire. The disgusting biomonster creatures are continuing to terrorize the city and there's only so much time before the plague spreads across the nation.

name: Platformer::Execute();
short_description: This is a puzzle game platform, focused on completing each level using programming.

name: Dreamlands: Cotton Candy Hunt
short_description: Avoid Spikes and cannons, run fast, jump precisely and collect enough candies to see all levels of Dreamlands. Once you have mastered the basics new challenges are waiting for you.

name: The Witch Eye
short_description: The Witch Eye is an indie psychological horror game . As a local hunter vicky explore valley of majuli village and try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets of the witch "nale ba"

name: 408 - The Forbidden Room
short_description: 408 - The Forbidden Room is a psychological horror game, inspired by a horror movie story, discover the mysteries behind this Hotel, and try not to be just another victim.

name: Before Akhira
short_description: Journey into the world of Before Akhira to help a young dreamer awaken and return to the real world. Explore the metaphors of Islamic spirituality as you rediscover the afterlife of the virtual world.

name: Overworld Heroes
short_description: A randomizer adventure where you play as a hero trying to bring order to a land that changes locations, loot, key items, and dungeon order!

name: Spooky Bricks
short_description: Break them bricks but beware of spooky creatures and critters!

name: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
short_description: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

name: P1441vr
short_description: P1441vr is a gun target simulator with a variety of game modes to sling lead in while perfecting your gun skills. Run 'n' Gun through challenging steel target courses John Wick style or rescue hostages in Simunitions mode.

name: Zeo Effect
short_description: Zeo effect is a top down shooter with rogue-lite elements, global map and item accumulation where time runs only when you take action. This allows you to adapt to the situation at a comfortable rhythm and destroy enemies with an extensive arsenal of weapons.

name: idolYAKI: From Delinquents to Pop Stars
short_description: Become friends or foes with the three most notorious criminals at your school as you help them transform into pop idols and compete in a nearby contest! A short, quick game with six possible endings!

name: Arena of Kings
short_description: ARENA OF KINGS is a fast-paced team arena brawler. Experience MMORPG-style combat without the grind. Create a hero from 10 unique classes. Level up, learn new spells, and collect epic loot. Casual, Ranked, and Tournament game modes. PLAY FOR FREE!

name: Loop Room
short_description: The loop room is a horror game from the first person point of view, and the goal is to operate 5 panels in 100 repeated rooms and escape to the emergency exit. Run away from the endless room through various equipment and items.

name: Untangle
short_description: Untangle is a first-person, single-player, school-violent-themed survival horror game. Though it's not a game based on a true story, it is built on an intention to raise awareness of school violence at the same time when you're playing a game.

name: NeverDeath
short_description: NeverDeath is a fighting game set in our own solar system centuries in the future. Explore the intricacies of the unique left/right fighting system while battling across the solar system as nine distinct characters.

name: 中华富甲三国
short_description: 这是一款大富翁与三国结合的益智类游戏，胜者为王。玩家扮演某个君主与其他1至3位君主进行运气与智商上的较量，通过点击不同等级的转盘或者使用特定锦囊决定行动步数，走到城池、建筑、商铺、特殊地点等触发对应事件，最终达成地图目标或者击败所有君主者获胜。这里有策略上的尔虞我诈，有商战中的弱肉强食，有运气上的天命所在，有城池经营，有武将养成，有投奔背离；战场上，有猛将间的热血单挑，有名帅中的纵横驰骋，有谋士间的神鬼技能，有不同地形的武将能力，有攻城时的天气系统。游戏系统可以很复杂烧脑谋夺天下，也可以通过各种开关设定简化内容运气为王，还可以给电脑加强能力长久为战，不同的设定甚至可以使玩法大相径庭，趣味丛生。

name: Queen of Honor
short_description: Queen of Honor - is a classical 2D platformer with surviving elements where you have to do different levels as a brave queen Hola.

name: Bopl Battle
short_description: A couch/online game where you battle your friends with unique and wild abilities. There are many choices such as a shrink ray, creating black holes, stopping time and attaching a rocket engine to the stage to send it flying. Choose a combination that synergizes well to win the round!

name: Kolobok: the Return
short_description: A preachy game based on a Russian fairy tale.

name: Furry Puzzle
short_description: An exciting casual puzzle game featuring beautiful furry characters. Enjoy an amazing atmosphere, great music, and high-quality furry artwork—perfect for relaxing. Made with love by furry lovers, for furry lovers!

name: 傻瓜式SGB粗陋心得
short_description: This is an experimental RPG, which is used to test the author's mastery of the development tool smile game build (SGB) and experience steam's launch process. All materials come from the software itself and DLC, except two ending texts and a modified cover.

name: TIERRA - Mystery Point & Click Adventure
short_description: A mystery puzzle adventure, inspired by hidden object escape room games.

name: Fading Afternoon
short_description: Seiji Maruyama is a middle-aged yakuza recently released from prison. Known as "Gozuki" (one of the demon generals from Buddhist mythology) he is the power that his oyabun counts on. But there is one thing his aniki is not taking into account: Maruyama is getting old.

name: The Savoury Inspector
short_description: A silly jaunt into the world of The Savoury Inspector! You the apprentice, the inspector your mentor. Together, embark on a journey to solve the mysterious puzzle of the unsavoury.

name: OneForAll
short_description: This game takes place after an apocalyptic attack and you're one of the last survivors. Your goal is to survive, complete quests, explore the huge wild world, eliminate enemies, level up, and create a safe place for the rest of the survivors.

name: Follow Your Heart
short_description: Follow Your Heart is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Toadomination
short_description: Toadomination is a rogulite, bullethell, looter shooter game that takes you into an ancient confrontation that lasts more than a decade, in a battle between a toad and a viper. Equip yourself with the most powerful weapon, collect capital and meet face to face with the sworn enemy.

name: TeleNovela
short_description: Embrace your inner Latino and write the greatest love story that will run for about six months on prime time before being replaced by an even greater love story!

name: Lord of the Click 2
short_description: Orcs,goblins and other evil spirits are getting closer, and very soon they will get so close that it will simply be impossible to get out of the kingdom. The king himself is ready to stop the army of dishonor. It will be difficult to determine how this battle will end if you don't help him!

name: Ayoub Episode 1
short_description: The boys in the elite class always find themselves up against a masked guy who appears in the most mysterious ways. Read the episode as the story begins here.

name: Bugged Dungeon
short_description: Dodge obstacles and solve puzzles in this ZX homage! Help Bumble undo the curse on his family, and re-gain your controls one by one in each of Bugged Dungeons’s 20 brain-bending rooms. Create your own levels and share for other players to play them.

name: Lostria
short_description: - BETA VERSION - Lostria is an online turn-based tactical game in a fantasy universe. Players build teams and compete among themself in tactical battles to become the best strategist in the world.

name: Era of Combat: Boxing
short_description: Era of Combat: Boxing is a multiplayer VR experience that strives to reward physical and martial prowess. Grab a friend, or a complete stranger, and face-off for a heart-pumping, head-thumping good time! Make 'em sweat!

name: BlackSky
short_description: Travel from one solar system to the other in this space action puzzle game. Match tiles to fire your ship's deadly weapons at a multitude of monsters. Upgrade your ship and its weapons to fight stronger enemies

name: The Dead Rooms
short_description: The Dead Rooms is an immersive horror experience with Roguelike elements. Can you survive? Explore a never ending world of rooms, as you push further into the Dead Rooms, trying to find what supplies you can and avoiding the monsters that call this place home.

name: Leaf Me Alone
short_description: Leaf me alone is a game where a little cleaning robot tidies fallen leaves, empty cans and even toy ducks. This game can bring satisfaction even whilst you are resting. The exciting journey that you’re about to experience with your cute cleaning robot A-12 is now ready to start.

name: Buoy
short_description: Fight the undead or learn all the ways to sneak and hide among them. Dig through the ruins of the Old World and complete missions from different factions and survivors to earn valuable resources.

name: Starlight Explorers
short_description: Master physics in one compelling physics puzzle after another. Aim the launcher and adjust its power, using your understanding of gravity wells to correctly plot their courses in a variety of challenges. Complete a light-hearted story and then test yourself in the endless Expeditions mode.

name: Fate Chapter 2 : The Beginning
short_description: Fate chapter 2 is a psychological horror game from the first person perspective and offers a complete story and experience. The game includes many different regions and puzzles. See you right around and solve the mystery and the most important SURVIVE!

name: Tell Some Story: Foz
short_description: Action-adventure + Third person shooter. The year is 2042, the near future, the gloomy world of cyberpunk will offer you the role of detective Foz. Random circumstances drag the hero into a showdown between gangs and corporations, where he has to make a choice on whose side he is.

name: ARIA: Genesis
short_description: Blast, bomb and bang you way to finding a cure that can save your boyfriend from dying. After all, how else will you be able to enjoy his di- I mean, his amazing personality for years to come?

name: Starfighter Aces
short_description: Massive battles rage in the stars! As a new pilot in the Allied Starfighter Corps, help turn the tide against a ruthless enemy. Hundreds of ships struggle to achieve victory in huge, team-based missions. Shoot down fighters, torpedo star cruisers, and duel famed enemy aces!

name: Forever Alone
short_description: Travel through a handcrafted world as a young kitten looking for comfort after a tragedy occurs by looking into another reality, revealing various paths to get past obstacles!

name: Dirty Beastly Muscles
short_description: Gay. Furry. Muscles. Adult. The game centers on RPG, character customizations, tactical combat, mini-games, puzzle solving, resource collection and management, and multiple endings. 16 different selectable characters, each with their own kinks, outfits, skills, and story lines.

name: Factory Trashcension
short_description: Factory Trashcension is a first-person open-world factory creation and optimization game with unlimited possibilities. Play with your friends and design efficient factories to TRASHCEND without worries and explore a v a p o r w a v e inspired universe!

name: Pixie Farm VR / ピクシーファームVR
short_description: Pixie Farm VR is a pixie raising simulation VR game where you raise only pixies in a world that seems to have dragons and phoenixes!

name: Z Mutants
short_description: Something is happening in town. People are going crazy attacking each other. Can you survive to find out what's causing this insanity? Who's behind this zombie outbreak?

name: Dumb Bomb Game
short_description: Use explosions to launch your character through each level. Avoid the danger that sits between you and a high score!

name: Stolen Crown
short_description: Stolen Crown is a deck-building game with dynamic combat, diverse encounters, and powerful relics. Three different classes, paired with hundreds of spells and abilities, means each run has something to offer!

name: DEX : Speed Run - Level Maker - World Records
short_description: Play together with the leader, take the first places, create levels in this action platformer! New levels every day

name: Elder Ring
short_description: As a Grand Immortal Cultivator(you), facing your greatest crisis! Having lost your body, your soul hides within a ring. Many people with different personalities will become your "master". Some of them are smart, some are stupid, some are greedy, some are righteous...

name: Showa American Story
short_description: SHOWA AMERICAN STORY is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Chouko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

name: Bear's Restaurant
short_description: The award-winning indie adventure game finally arrives on Steam—now with more content than ever before! A story of love, loss, and fine dining that’s sure to warm even the most jaded of hearts.

name: ASTRO-NOT
short_description: Go fast and avoid stuff as you explore the galaxy or compete for the fastest IL replay. Create and share levels for others who love to go fast and avoid stuff :)

name: Rogue Rising
short_description: 2D roguelite action. Exhilarating action with easy controls. Grab the relics and use your skills to conquer the tower as many times as you can. Even the toughest bosses will be easy depending on your luck!

name: Mars Base
short_description: Welcome to Mars Base, humanity’s foothold on the Red Planet! Join the expedition as an interstellar botanist and make history: turn barren soil into fertile farmland, grow food for colonists’ tables, and unearth the secrets of Mars! Are you ready to science the “crop” out of everything?

name: LAST CLOUDIA
short_description: A fantasy RPG that weaves a sprawling tale with quirky characters and cinematic effects. Its gorgeous, fast-paced battles feature pixel art characters sweeping though 3D playspaces.

name: Crash Time - Undercover
short_description: In Crash Time - Undercover you will experience non-stop racing action, and embark on a high-octane manhunt, with thrilling car chases and lots of explosive missions! Are you ready? Highways are waiting for you!

name: Everdine - A Lost Girl's Tale
short_description: Everdine finds herself lost in a forest of eternal twilight. Help her gather the needed ingredients to perform a magic ritual to escape before the dangers of these woods devour poor Everdine. ~ A short, atmospheric, fairy tale vibes RPG Maker horror adventure.

name: IRON WORLD
short_description: IRON WORLD is a top-down open world RPG. Experience the unforgiving life of a space settler travelling across the post-apocalyptic world. Drive your own car, fight, explore.

name: Noyah: Corrupted Memories
short_description: Noyah: Corrupted Memories is a roguelike deckbuilder, in pixel art, with random battle generation, day and night cycle, climate events, advanced rune system, that allows you to create endless possibilities with a single card.

name: THE ADVENTURES OF LWANDA MAGERE
short_description: This is an action-adventure game based on the history of a famous Kenyan hero, Lwanda Magere and his encounters with other African heroes at large. Lwanda Magere was invincible to physical attacks, and had the ability to takedown entire armies.

name: Heliopolis Six
short_description: Embark on a cosmic odyssey as the director of your own space station in a galaxy full of wonders. Skillful management is vital as you construct and connect station components, oversee resource handling, and guide your space haven to reach new heights amidst the stars.

name: Larry The Unlucky Part 1
short_description: Follow Larry's life to find the source of his lack of luck. Discover his intriguing story and solve puzzles to understand how his life plays out.

name: Cavern Commandos
short_description: Inspired by classic platformers like Rick Dangerous, Cavern Commandos offers a challenging gaming experience with numerous weapons, hundreds of foes, and dozens of labyrinthine caverns.

name: Boo Party
short_description: Are ghosts and monsters real? Explore a haunted mansion, find items, take photos, and prove once and for all that they are REAL and SEXY.

name: Robots n Lasers
short_description: Robots n Lasers is my first Project to be published. It is a shooter based on fast reactions, aim and a little bit of patience.

name: The Journey of AutUmn
short_description: The Journey of AutUmn - A classic point-and-click adventure game with completely hand-painted graphics. The player controls an android that crashes during its mission through a variety of lovingly designed environments and solves classic inventory puzzles.

name: Jeremia: Nightfall
short_description: Jeremiah: The Nightfall Our memories are what tell us who we are. But what if, suddenly, you had none? What if you had to emerge from the darkness on your own strength? Will you be ready to face your demons?

name: Fm45's Sprite Man Adventures
short_description: ​In this game you will run around chopping enemies, dashing into them, and shooting arrows. Pick up chests around the map to earn health, exp., and even coins! Will you be able to defeat the boss?!

name: Hidden Shapes Black Skull - Jigsaw Puzzle Game
short_description: Relax with beautiful hand-drawn puzzles inspired by the world of Pirates, created exclusively for you to have fun and be amazed by beautiful art with each puzzle solved!

name: Puzzles with cats
short_description: Puzzles with cats is a classic puzzle that invites you to put together a picture from a huge amount of details!

name: Water Physics Simulation
short_description: Water Physics Simulation & Sandbox! Build ships and let them sink! Build cars and let them sink! Use bombs and destroy ragdolls. Play with natural disasters or create towns.

name: FlyChivements
short_description: Play and have fun in the new game that has no analogues! Try to get your hands on all our achievements!

name: SimplePlanes VR
short_description: SimplePlanes VR is a flight sim with an ever-expanding collection of hand-crafted aircraft to download and fly for free. Airplanes, helicopters, cars, boats, and more are available and new crafts are added every day.

name: Historic Fighters
short_description: Historic Fighters is a single-player turn-based game. Pick a class of fighters ranging from warriors from ancient Sparta to gun-wielding cowboys and win battles!

name: Quantum Conquest
short_description: Conquer the battlefield in Quantum Conquest! Outwit opponents by strategically placing Tokens, engaging in intense combat, and fortifying your position with unique Forts. Explore diverse gameplay options that challenge your tactical skills. Are you prepared for the ultimate turn-based showdown?

name: VR Military Reporter in Middle East (with tanks & helicopters)
short_description: This is a VR leisure tour game. Players can wear a helmet to tour the Middle East.

name: Queen of Tower Defense
short_description: A Tower Defense game

name: Orb Tour
short_description: Snowy the snowcone is an alien who has been asleep for many years. When he wakes up, his people have VANISHED! He is the last of his kind, and he needs your help to find all 30 of the missing power orbs, so he can rebuild the mothership and bring his people back, before they face extinction.

name: Ninja Simulator: Prologue
short_description: This version of the game is a free prologue in which you will get acquainted with the game mechanics, go through the first ninja combat mission and check what it is like to be a deadly assassin.

name: Soul Invictus
short_description: Soul Invictus is a voxel survival game where parties of powerful heroes fight to defend their homelands from marauding barbarians and enemy factions in ancient warring Britain. Craft weapons, build villages into sprawling towns and protect your fledgling nation by leading your armies to war!

name: Within the Range
short_description: This game is no longer updated, do not buy!! RTS with physical details. Formulate strategies based on terrain and unit characteristics

name: Pop's
short_description: Save the toys!

name: Synthwave Burnout
short_description: The lost highway awaits you to take you beyond the horizon. Relax and let the sounds of synthwave open the way into the realm of neon - a world of revived imagination and fantasy, more real than reality itself.

name: Dirty and lascivious awakening RPG by lecher knight Reika
short_description: ※All the characters in this game are over 18 years old. Reika visits the village of Seille as a bodyguard for a female merchant Fomia. Although Reika is inferior to Fomia, she is a reliable female knight. An easy-to-play, battle-free RPG!

name: Magic Thief
short_description: Become a Magic Thief in a new reinterpretation of the classic minesweeper game. Immerse yourself in the world of the magical Middle Ages, open chests, use charms and avoid encounters with mysterious crystals!

name: THE MADHOUSE | Infected Mansion
short_description: THE MADHOUSE | Infected Mansion is a survival horror game. Contains Fear, Stealth, Exploration/Puzzle solving, Item management. Moreover "Multiple First-Person Views" provides a new level of fear, immersion, strategy. Steal the vision of "something" lurking in the abandoned house and try to survive.

name: V.R.G.
short_description: V.R.G. is a FPS cross between a retro-style and a modern-style , Defeat enemies and get combos to improve operability, and eat scatter pieces of meat to recover.

name: Fomalhaut Flowers
short_description: Go in search of rare flowers and uncover the terrible secret of Fomalhaut.

name: Lucky Joe
short_description: “ Do You Like Dying ?” Lucky Joe is a unique action game that combines shooting and platforming in 60 large 2D levels. Core gameplay easy to learn but hard to master, intense gunfights, a touch of humor, tons of enemies, a bit of reflection, great sound tracks… Try, die and retry...

name: ONCE IN MY HEAD
short_description: The creators can also lose the ground under their feet.

name: PROPHECY OF THE NUN
short_description: The path of a group of friends falls on a mysterious mansion, and the extraordinary events that take place in the mansion are told.

name: Zone B Korosu
short_description: A story-rich zombie adventure with a mix of side-scrolling combat, top-down exploration, interactive narrative scenes, and some classic SNES-style flair

name: 二逼青年的救赎
short_description: this game is about a hero who save the world at the end of world. a man who called mao want to upon ship safely at end of world. In this game,you will find many old funny story about Chinese internet. you also can pk will monsters and answer the questions to get the key item.

name: Cursed House
short_description: Cursed House is a first-person psychological horror game. It can impress you with a realistic and spooky home environment. Can you lift the curse?

name: Make a Path for the Chicken
short_description: After falling into a hole, this Chicken finds herself on a journey to find her chicks. Solve puzzles and make a safer path for the chicken to complete this journey.

name: Hodl Simulator
short_description: Ape investors have to know when to hodl them, and know when the fodl them. But with the dark potassium pool manipulation of Monkeydel investments, this is becoming harder and harder each day. This corrupt corporation makes their living by crashing honest banana companies the only solution to HODL!

name: Puzzle Soccer
short_description: Puzzle Soccer is a game for those who enjoy the strategic aspect of soccer games. In this game, you'll need to think tactically to execute precise player movements in order to score a goal. Don't waste your moves and organize your plays intelligently to successfully score a goal.

name: Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition
short_description: One of the most innovative Real-Time Strategy Games comes back totally renewed and improved to the smallest detail, with epic large scale battles, new civilizations, unit customization system never seen before in a game, 8K support, and much more.

name: Yugo Puzzle
short_description: Yugo Puzzle is a minimalist, relaxing, and satisfying puzzle game. Move jelly blocks left and right to merge them with the same color. It may sound simple, but it’s deceptively challenging. Enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.

name: Supplice
short_description: Supplice is a stylish throwback shooter inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh.

name: Dann Fox & The Time Machine
short_description: A third person platformer with fast paced combat, beautiful cartoon graphics and challenging levels that explore different time periods in History! Upgrade your character and use a variety of weapons to fight enemies and bosses!

name: Winging It

name: Where is the meaning?
