short_description: A combination Shooter and Action-Adventure game where the player is the hungry fox that needs to hunt food (Chickens, Rabbits, etc.). There are large predators (Bears, Wolves, etc.) that the fox must shoot using bullets that are earned as rewards.

name: Toy Sports
short_description: With Toy Sports, you will return to an exciting and very special place: your childhood memories. Now it is YOUR time to be the toy you love, drive cars, compete in various sports for points, prizes and glory. Prepare your engines and play with the whole family!

name: Umbilical
short_description: Umbilical is a Metroidvania-inspired top-down shooter that has you exploring an inhospitable world to stop some nasty parasites from wreaking havoc. Face off against hordes of creatures, seek out new abilities and upgrades, and take down powerful bosses as you fight to stop the parasites.

name: Cursed to Golf
short_description: Cursed to Golf is a challenging golf-like adventure where every shot counts. Players are tasked with making it out of Golf Purgatory to become a Golfing Legend. With insane hazards, otherworldly power-ups and tons of replayability, will you make it back alive or will you forever be… Cursed to Golf!?

name: Pathless Woods
short_description: Embark on a cozy open-world survival journey inspired by ancient China's heritage. Gather resources, cultivate crops, build your dream home, and defend it from marauders. Team up with friends to explore and uncover a world where adventure meets serenity.

name: If you win...you lose !
short_description: A quite difficult and quite original platform adventure game, die and retry.

name: Old Gods
short_description: It looks like you have died. But neither heaven nor hell await you. Assigned a fate from the two creators you will be sent back to life with the task of overthrowing the false gods. Exciting fights, difficult puzzles and a colorful world of different creatures await you.

name: No Straight Roads: Encore Edition
short_description: Start a rock band & end the EDM empire in NO STRAIGHT ROADS, a rockin' action-adventure that mashes together rhythm-infused third-person combat with a kick-ass soundtrack!

name: Potata: Foxy Tale
short_description: Potata: Foxy Tale is a fairy tale themed platformer adventure game in a beautiful world of dark forests. Your goal is to restore the balance and assemble the fragments of the Woodland Spirit.

name: The Babysitter
short_description: The incredible story of Alice searching for a kid who got lost in a fantasy world.

name: The Last Defense
short_description: Take part in the war through King Severin’s perspective. Follow the unique narrative in this Fantasy Tower Defence and lead your mages, strategically deploying them to defend the last kingdom standing - Murgaz.

name: Game Developer Simulator
short_description: In the Simulator of a game developer, you will be able to understand all the subtleties of this profession, understand how the game industry works and all the difficulties of a single developer.

name: Beauty VS. robot
short_description: "Beautiful Girl vs Mecha" is a card RPG game with the theme of the future eschatology. Players will be transformed into army commanders, and they will fight through card battles by means of instant battles and four different occupations.

name: Peter's Adventures in English [Learn English]
short_description: Take control of Peter as he travels across the kingdom, solving puzzles, making friends and defeating monsters. This game is designed to be accessible to a very broad range of players, including young children and people learning English as a second language.

name: Gothica : The Devil's Shadow
short_description: Gothica: The Devil’s Shadow is a single player, steampunk-influenced, adventure puzzle game designed for VR. You'll need ingenuity to tackle the physical puzzles, eyes in the back of your head to spot the dangers and lighting reactions to fight off the Dark Lord's minions.

name: Adventure of Rikka - The Cursed Kingdom
short_description: The Adventure of Rikka is a top down 2D action RPG with a focus on puzzles, exploration, secrets and collectibles. You must defeat the dark forces that has cursed the lands, fight enemies using your sword and an arsenal of items such as the bow and fire wand and save the kingdom!

name: The Death | Thần Trùng
short_description: The Death | Thần Trùng is a Viet Nam psychological horror adventure game made by three Vietnamese people from a tiny indie studio. The game takes place in Hanoi city in 2022.

name: Seal of Evil
short_description: SEAL OF EVIL is a mythical take on the tumultuous time marking the fall of the Zhou imperial dynasty. Out of this chaos emerges an uncompromising ruler, Ying Zheng, who has vowed to either unify China or bury it in fire.

name: Flyland Wars: 2 Not Yours Mine
short_description: A sci-fi flying person vs. robot battle game. A stolen asteroid on this flyland contains a labyrinthine mine named Not Yours Mine, and may still have murderous minedroids and a security force-- but certainly does have poison-gas-spewing spiderbots. You have to destroy them all!

name: Toaster Arena
short_description: Toaster Arena is a first person multiplayer arena shooter where players battle it out on different maps and game modes. Use Advanced movement to traverse obstacles and gain the advantage on the battlefield.

name: The Circle Of Suffering
short_description: This game is a psychological horror in which the main character wakes up in an unfamiliar house and must pass all the levels by solving puzzles.

name: Buramato
short_description: Explore a vast fast-paced Action RPG inspired by traditional Bornean mythology. Slay monsters with stylish combos and discover the Old Lords’ cursed lands to unravel the secrets behind your lost memory.

name: Marble Mage
short_description: Dash and roll your way through 60 fast-paced levels to try and find the way back home after a magic exam goes wrong, leaving a young mage stranded in a strange dimension. Marble Mage offers classic marble-rolling platforming with a unique twist: Charge up and release to blast off in any direction!

name: Bill's adventure: Alien war
short_description: Bill's adventure: Alien war is a 2D platform game with shooting elements in which you'll fight to end an interplanetary war between robots and aliens in a futuristic world where humans have gone extinct.

name: Downtown
short_description: A post-apocalyptical, beat 'em up game where you learn new combat moves as you advance through challenging levels and fight increasingly difficult boss battles as you try to make your way Downtown.

name: stopDrop.
short_description: Explore a unique survival-puzzle hybrid game unlike any other. Outsmart your opponents and reach the exit before your life ticks down. Time only moves when you move, and your life is on the line.

name: Star Age: Space Combat
short_description: Prove you're the most feared pilot in the galaxy in this multiplayer arcade space shooter!

name: Citadel 's Keeper
short_description: Protect your cities against waves of enemies. Manage your resources and plan accordingly to develop your city and armies to survive!

name: World of Grimm
short_description: Dive into the enchanting universe of Grimm Fairytales! Collect powerful cards, engage in fast-paced battles, and rewrite the destiny of iconic characters. Unleash your strategic skills in this captivating and fast-paced collectible card game. Join the adventure now!

name: You Must
short_description: In the social network, the main character plays the quest "Hide and Seek", but this time the organizers decided to move the quest to the real world. They indicate the coordinates of the place where the quest item was hidden, the one who finds it first will receive a cash prize.

name: Hidden Cats in Santa's Realm
short_description: It's Christmas time! The Santa's Icy Realm is in full steam!! Join the fun and search for all the Hidden Cats one by one among the elves to reveal the final colored art. More than 970 hidden objects! This time with an extra bonus level, SNOWBALL FIGHT!

name: Curse Crackers: For Whom the Belle Toils
short_description: Curse Crackers is a fast-paced acrobatic platformer where you bounce, vault, and fight your way through a whimsical world with the help of your loyal companion. Eat snacks, collect items, and travel the world to stop Bonnie and her band of troublemakers!

name: Surface: Virtual Detective Collector's Edition
short_description: Where are the missing players?

name: Droopy Balls Simulator 2021
short_description: Can you keep your balls out of the water, all the while dodging poop, piss, and more! Droopy Ball Simulator 2021 will be the test of that! Keep that sack in control!

name: Apocalyptic Adventure: Episode 1
short_description: A unique twist on survival by combining action, adventure, and strategy in virtual reality. Apocalyptic Adventure is a game where players must manage resources, plan defenses, and explore to survive.

name: Nebraska
short_description: Nebraska takes place as a journalist writing a book about mid-west America, who runs out of gas in a rural area of Nebraska. Players will explore and uncover the secret facility that lies beneath the attraction and discover the terrible experiments that have taken place there.

name: Hidden Kittens: Kingdom of Cats
short_description: Find the Hidden Kittens in the Kingdom of Cats and enjoy a cute, relaxing adventure that will warm your heart. 🐱✨

name: RoboWarehouse
short_description: A business simulation game in which you take an autonomous robotics company from a garage to a multi-national powerhouse!

name: Where's My Lunch?!
short_description: Where's My Lunch?! is an action stealth adventure game, with the quest of finding your lunch during the zombie apocalypse. Use impromptu weapons such as rakes, vacuums, wax machines, good ole Sally, and more! Set up zombies in environmental traps to help you move closer to your glorious lunch.

name: YuuYuu Jiteki no Yuukarin
short_description: The story of Yuuka Kazami, the flower master of the four seasons who loves "flowers" more than anyone else in the world. A game that seems easy? A game that looks kind? Don't be fooled by the appearance. Please enjoy the world of adventure that becomes harsh as you progress to the end.

name: 爆战联盟
short_description: "Ghoul League" is a doomsday treasure brush shooting game. Any corpse ghost seen in the game can be caught against humans. "Two person game is the future". The game also supports multi person mode. You can break through customs and brush suits with your partners!

name: Absylon 7
short_description: Absylon7 - is a first-person survival-shooter with psychological thriller elements, in which you will have to find the culprits of a large-scale scientific disaster and save your family from death.

name: iB Cricket Companion
short_description: With the iB Cricket Companion app, everyone can watch iB Cricket live matches and those playing iB Cricket in standalone Quest2/Quest headsets can access local PvP right from their desktop. Bowl to your friends and compete with them.

name: RX Racing 2021 Pro
short_description: RX Racing 2021 Pro is an arcade rallycross game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2021 in different categories. The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race. But be careful because depending on the driver you take, it will be more difficult to win the race.

name: 69 Summon Succubus
short_description: 69 Summon Sucubus - is a game in which you take on the role of a succubus trainer.You have become the owner of a magic book that allows you to summon the succubus Lilith. You need to choose skills for training and complete tasks. After each workout, your succubus will get stronger.

name: Legends of Dionysos
short_description: Legends of Dionysos is a 2,5D Action RPG that combines RPG elements with fast paced gameplay and hordes of enemies! Minmax your character, level up and find precious loot. Venture through a beautiful open world and slay loads of orcs, demons and giant dragons!

name: CYNOROID FORSAKEN
short_description: CYNOROID FORSAKEN is a free aim platformer that uses the mouse to aim and It is a free aim platformer where you aim with the mouse and move with the WASD keys. With multiple weapons, a laser chainsaw that can be used by right-clicking, and the ability to eat enemy carcasses.

name: NeverAwake
short_description: A girl who never wakes up. She has been fighting monsters in her dreams... "NeverAwake" is a nightmarish twin-stick shooter with a unique worldview and original game rules.

name: Kittens in Post-Apocalyptic Fantasy San Francisco: Battle School for Only the Most Awesome Monsters
short_description: Save a fallen land from despair and doom via recruiting and training adorable but deadly (and awesome) monsters!

name: MINDHACK
short_description: Change the minds of evildoers…for good! MINDHACK is a text adventure game where you meet unique evildoers, hack their minds, and rewrite them into happy people!

name: Summoner's Mess
short_description: You've made a mistake trying to summon a beast from the depths. Explore a huge manor to solve your mess. Can you find the sacred grimoires before being consumed by the darkness?

name: The Hero of Bangaona
short_description: The Hero of Bangaona is a 2D Side-scrolling Action game where you play as the Hero of Bangaona kingdom whose mission is to capture the enemy bases in order to rescue the Princess who got kidnapped by the soldiers of the Weins Territory.

name: Murderous Muses
short_description: Solve a sinister murder by spending three reality-shifting nights in a haunted art gallery. An infinitely re-playable murder mystery blending deduction, exploration, puzzles, collectibles and FMV.

name: Project: Cow
short_description: An extremely difficult strategy game focused on stealth mode. Your objective is to lead the cows on their escape through the spaceship. Go from hiding to hiding so as not to be seen by the aliens and be patient with the granny cow. Are you qualified to fulfill this mission?

name: Phoenix Pro Theater Media Player
short_description: Phoenix Pro Theater brings an ultimate theatre experience to your living room. Any movie of choice, available in your PC or laptop, can be played in the Phoenix Pro Theater with a vast array of settings.

name: Box Party
short_description: You've been invited to the biggest party of the year! But the food has gone bad, and are threatening to shut down the party... forever! Only you can stop them!

name: Captain Diarrhea and The Shartening
short_description: A top-down action shooter. Use gross and weird movement mechanics and abilities. Survive, and enact revenge on the black military division that abducted you and made you the way that you are. BRING FORTH THE SHARTENING.

name: Midinous
short_description: Midinous is a grid-based non-linear MIDI sequencer usable with any Digital Audio Workstation or hardware that accepts MIDI messages. Midinous can also generate its own simple sounds either for reference, or for normal use.

name: BASIC ROGUE
short_description: BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.

name: Dyflexion
short_description: A vertical scroll shooter where deflecting enemy projectiles is key to success.

name: Secrets of the Middle Ages
short_description: Walk through the bright and colorful locations of a luxurious medieval castle in search of various items !

name: LOST INSIDE Act 1
short_description: LOST INSIDE is a non-traditional, character-focused, action-adventure RPG about a human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World.

name: Yamafuda! 2nd station
short_description: We created a game that can be played by anyone, using cards to hike mountains. You choose a card for each station. If you make gears along the way, you can hike more comfortably. Let's enjoy many mountains!

name: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero
short_description: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero tells the tale of Brunt, an anthropomorphic wombat on her first adventure in the fantasy world, Eridal. Embark on this epic 3rd person action-filled adventure, uncover how this world came to be, and meet new legends that will help shape the future of Eridal!

name: GRANDMA
short_description: Join the battle to save earth from aliens and robots. Choose to play on the side of humans or aliens in battle. 1. Play alongside up to 50 online players 2. Choose various levels 3. Play in various modes such a s capture the king, rush, team deathmatch, conquest.

name: THE SPIRIT LIFT
short_description: THE SPIRIT LIFT is a cute spooky card game blending deckbuilding rogue-likes with story-driven indie horror. As teenagers from the '90s, players explore an ever-changing retro 3D hotel with the help of a magic elevator. Be Kind, Rewind, and Seek the Truth Lost Behind...

name: Crazy Invader ShootEm Down
short_description: Enjoy fast paced action in this retro inspired arcade ShootEm Up Style game

name: Neighbor Diana
short_description: Neighbor Diana is a first-person adventure. In this game you spy on your neighbor Diana. At some point, you get the idea to put a webcam in Diana's room to monitor her. You will need to solve puzzles and complete various tasks to set up a webcam.

name: 死寂（Deathly Stillness）
short_description: This is a boring zombie game with no plot, not an officially released game, please don't have high expectations.

name: Space Yandere
short_description: Space Yandere is a cute, dramatic story experience about love in space, featuring beautiful art and music. About 45 mins play time. One main ending, others are short gameovers.

name: Home Office Tasker
short_description: Keep track of your plans and their deadlines. This is the best solution for organizing your home workflow!

name: Vita Fighters
short_description: Vita Fighters is an epic fighting game with a mixed cast of fighters partially based on anime, pop culture, and existing fighting game characters.

name: Old Salt
short_description: A Naval Strategy With No Reinforcements On The Way. Command a Custom Fleet with faction abilities in Multiplayer matches or Faction Campaigns.

name: Mars Tactics
short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

name: Arena Warrior
short_description: Jump, Slide and Wallride your way across a multitude of arenas fighting off waves of enemies using different weapons and movement equipment to survive. Fight epic bosses and gain new abilities to strengthen your run in this fast past rouge-like arena fighter.

name: Tentacle Prawn: (Actually) A Cthulhu Dating Sim
short_description: It's got action! It's got romance! In this RPG-Dating Sim, gather your party and try to settle a centuries-old dispute among your monster and human classmates! The fate of Winter Prom is at stake!

name: Society
short_description: Post-apocalyptic shooter in the CIS setting

name: Diamond Hands: To The Moon
short_description: A game with one objective - to get to the moon. A game for apes by apes. A game as frustrating as stock market manipulation, a game that will make you want to hold on for dear life...

name: The Judgement of Q
short_description: Don't EVER press Q.

name: Happy Bones Infernal
short_description: Upon arriving at a correctional facility located in a remote mountainous region, a young man named Roan quickly finds his surroundings are falling into disarray in this Horror-Themed JRPG!

name: 指示厨
short_description: Instruction Chu is a liver game. The liver needs to control a poor head and retrieve his body under the guidance of the audience.

name: Cyberpunk Samurai VR
short_description: An ultra-realistic multiplayer sword fighting game. Physics drive everything. Clash blades with competitors in neon-lit streets. Create your own style from endless possibilities. Become a legend. Parry, pivot, and thrust your way to victory.

name: Hope Trigger
short_description: HOPE-TRIGGER is a handcrafted 2D action RPG. Switch between Original Sin fighting styles, wield Enchanted Artifacts, and master magical skills. Death may awaken the Destiny’s Written Revelation system—bringing powerful buffs and story fragments.

name: Gorge
short_description: Gorge is a first-person puzzle-platformer, where you use telekinesis and wall-running to solve challenging interconnected obstacle courses.

name: 13 WOOD ST
short_description: 13 WOOD ST, a night in October: a long road, a dark forest and the house mentioned in the last will, making you the owner of a mysterious property. Welcome to 13 WOOD ST, a story rich horror game! Remastered 2022.

name: Roseblight
short_description: Roseblight is an RPG about a gardener with a dark secret and a visitor from the cosmos. Explore the wild, challenge foes, recruit allies, and embrace your chains in an unforgiving world plagued with malice and destruction.

name: Vroom! Obstacle Racing
short_description: Vroom! Obstacle Racing© is a new multi-round battle royale style game in development.

name: Alone: Recode
short_description: Step into the world of Alone - a new take on the classic turn-based fantasy RPG. Featuring challenging bosses and asymmetric world design Alone will defy your expectations of gameplay and exploration. Whether you are an RPG veteran or new to the genre, you must experience Alone.

name: Nano Racing
short_description: Race around a number of tracks in miniature cars all with ultra realistic next gen graphics. Choose between a number of cars, each with its own driving style. Participate in single player events or race against others online

name: Flipping Beat
short_description: Flipping Beat is an intense rhythm game where you blow up the beats of adrenaline-pumping music as they fly towards you, surrounded by an abstract world.

name: Tower Stacker
short_description: Build a huge tower! how far can you go? Try not to miss, and build the highest building in the city!

name: Astral Shipwright
short_description: Build and upgrade your personal ship to travel around a strange planet.

name: Veil of the Volcano
short_description: Create a tribe to survive the natural disasters of the island. Prepare your community for the day the volcano blows. You'll need to survive until the Spring when life returns.

name: メイジズメイズ　PLAY　～淫魔の洞窟に挑む冒険者～
short_description: Blend in with the many AI-powered adventurers and explore the cave filled with a lurid miasma Become one of the randomly generated adventurers as they explore on their own. You'll be one of the randomly generated adventurers as they explore on their own, and there's even a special set of PLAYs.

name: Decide 4 God
short_description: The final entry of the Abime Series. Six intruders and six captives share a high-tech prison where their moral dilemmas may lead them to a fate worse than death. Can they overcome the wiles of Empathy Systems? What dark secrets lurk behind that institution? When does knowledge become a curse?

name: 狂の世界-Crazy World-
short_description: This work is a Japanese-style survival horror game. Operate the hero who got lost in another world and return to the heroine and her original world who also got lost in another world.

name: 蛛火Spider fire
short_description: This is a tank shooting game. You will control a spider car to find an exit in the maze. Of course, you need to find the key to open the exit. Some strange robots in the maze are not friendly to you. You can find some props in the boxes in the maze. They will help you deal with your enemies.

name: Dirty Fighter: Hollow Point City
short_description: Get ready for an intense, fast-paced, beat 'em up, with many quirky twists! An eccentric game filled with death traps, outlandish humor, and general ridiculocity.

name: CTFS(ctfs)
short_description: A game.

name: Phantom Thief Mew's Secret Prima
short_description: In an unexpected turn of events, Miu becomes a phantom thief. As a phantom thief, you have to carry out various mission along with her childhood friend, Chinatsu. To complete your mission,you have to sneak into the targetted location and dodge the obstacles in the way to proceed.

name: THORN DEMON HUNTER
short_description: This is an AVG game similar to Metroidvania. The player will perform a demon hunter exploring and decrypting the castle in the Gothic period and hunting the corrupt soul

name: I wanna go home
short_description: Can't stand working overtime anymore! Must find some properties to get rid of this ugly office,be aware of the mean boss,don't get caught by him!

name: My Cozy Home
short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of. The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

name: 阴缘

name: UncleOffice:uncle Dating Simulator
short_description: You can play as a newcomer, start a new life, and date 12 uncles

short_description: Kirkileons is a single player Tower Defence game. The game includes 2 planets containing 20 missions each(40 missions). The game relies on an original spawning method. The amount of foes depends on the percentage of magic energy VS anti-magic energy that your generators produce.

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword V
short_description: *** This Game is only available in Chinese *** 本游戏为回合制RPG。主角陆承轩身负强大力量却无法控制，阴差阳错来到神话中的山海界，在此结识了众多不同物种的奇妙伙伴，一路抽丝剥茧，解开山海界、黄帝、轩辕剑之间的过往密辛，展开高潮迭起的精彩旅程。

name: Phantom Thief Sylphy
short_description: Phantom Thief Sylphy is an Erotic Stealth Adventure Game. Sneak, evade capture and solve puzzles as you steal from the rich and powerful and expose their corruption. Try not to get caught though, lest you become another victim.

name: 致命游戏-Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle
short_description: “Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle”is a suspense reasoning emotional work based on werewolf killing rules.A group of college students accidentally came to a mysterious villa. They wanted to play a game of werewolf killing.You have only five days left to refute the truth.

name: Detention Club: School's Out
short_description: Detention Club: School's Out is a femdom game featuring a visual novel interface that blends seamlessly with gruelling turn based boss fights to progress the story.

name: Beyond The Darkness
short_description: 💀🧩🕹️ Beyond The Darkness is a horror adventure game with puzzles where you help little girl Milly battle nightmares in the darkness to find her missing family. You will find yourself in bizarre worlds of memories, distorted by fears, and your only weapon will be the light of a small lamp...

name: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

name: Falling As Lightning
short_description: Plan and build a deck of cards to represent your government, then use the structure you created to mobilize the military and unite warring star systems under the guiding light of your political ideology.

name: Rush Rally Origins
short_description: The definitive top down racer

name: Roads of Destiny
short_description: Roads of Destiny is an action RPG game featuring a sorceress and a magical dog as the main characters.

name: Legendary Tales: Stolen Life Collector's Edition
short_description: “Legendary Tales: Stolen Life” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Legendary Tales: Cataclysm Collector's Edition
short_description: A dreadful prediction came to the oracle — the cataclysm is coming. The renegade witch is about to save the world or ruin it… “Legendary Tales: Cataclysm” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Terranova
short_description: A nostalgic interactive fiction game set in the early 2000's. Chat with your friends, update your LimeJournal, and discover yourself through a rich world of storytelling, love and friendship.

name: Angel's Tale : An extraordinary love story
