name: Space Docker VR
short_description: A hardcore flight simulator for VR! Get in the cockpit, pilot a ship, and navigate hazardous environments on a journey to become an expert docker!

name: Beneath the Mountain
short_description: In Beneath the Mountain, you play as the King of a new Dwarven civilization seeking to find their fortune beneath the mountain. You dig your way through the mountain, encountering many dangerous foes along the way, all while defending your kingdom from periodic Orc invasions.

name: CANNON
short_description: CANNON is a minimalist puzzle game made with cannons that shoot balls to destroy cubes. Activate the cannons in the right order to destroy all number cubes in the scene.

name: Vortex
short_description: Welcome to the VortexLabs testing facility. Here we will test your ability to solve various puzzles in order for you to make your escape.

name: Phantom Fury
short_description: Shelly “Bombshell” Harrison is back in this highly interactive mix of first person action and road movie adventure. Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey around the USA. Use an enormous arsenal of weapons and skills to battle treacherous soldiers and vile mutants, all while trying to save mankind.

name: Turbo Kid
short_description: A nostalgic metroidvania adventure with insane weapons, skills, and pixel gore. Ride your BMX and blast your enemies as you discover the secrets of the Wasteland.

name: Eelah
short_description: A baby girl is kidnapped and taken to a strange and mysterious place for unknown reasons. You must save her!

name: TheNuWRLD
short_description: A third person multiplayer virtual dance club featuring live DJ performances

name: My Stepmom is a Futanari 2
short_description: You're in-between jobs and living at home. Your dad is out working most of the day, leaving you all alone with your bitch of a Stepmom. She's a real ball-buster--and naughty boys get spanked. Good luck...

name: One Fateful Night
short_description: One Fateful Night is a horror game where the player attempts to survive the night inside a scientific research base that has appeared mysteriously. The player must explore and use things they find to survive and escape.

name: The Final Frontier
short_description: The Final Frontier is a retro multi-directional shooter inspired by the likes of Asteroids and Galaga. You destroy waves of endless enemies while trying to survive as long as possible by upgrading your ship's abilities along the way.

name: RUM - Rust Utility Mod
short_description: The Rust Utility Mod or RUM for short, is a tool for calculating costs for raids, materials, set timers for furnaces, and more. It has a sleek and understandable user interface and a low CPU/RAM footprint making it great for running alongside Rust.

name: Dreamy Love Voyage
short_description: "Dreamy Love Voyage - My happy Vacation with My Girlfriend" is a quintessential RPG game with a pure love theme. You will play as a powerful swordsman, embarking on a delightful adventure in a seaside city, romancing the local beauties, and experiencing a plethora of intimate content..

name: Lirica
short_description: The world of Opera is fading away! To bring the spirit of music back to life and help restore Lirica to its former glory, join Renatta and new musical friends as they explore the world, solve music puzzles, and restore life to Lirica.

name: Diner Bros Inc
short_description: Join the Bros once again as they defend their precious restaurant! Co-operate or compete against your friends in this frantic party game for up to 4 players. Beat quick sequences of crazy minigames, fight a mysterious villain, and collect gems. Quickly! Before time runs out!

name: Looking for Aliens
short_description: Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

name: Bit Sword
short_description: A 1-bit retro platformer ready for action

name: Alpine - The Simulation Game
short_description: Welcome to the beautiful world of the mountains! In Alpine - The Simulation Game you can expect a varied story mode with many missions, and all this in the middle of a lovingly designed game world in the snowy Alps.

name: Cursed Pantsu
short_description: Kaori is a good girl who always does the right thing. But one day, succumbed to temptation, she stole panties in the Mall... Cursed Pantsu is a story-driven action-adventure game with RPG and platforming elements about Kaori’s adventures in the Hellish Mall.

name: Lawnmower Game: Battle
short_description: New part for Epic lawnmower game series. Now collect different weapons and destroy evil enemy ai lawnmowers in different arenas

name: Selfmade Devil
short_description: Hang up a magic casual game.

name: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games
short_description: Pardon or kill. Let the madness begin! Take on the nefarious attractions of Yurukill Land for a chance to prove your innocence!

name: Slime Factory
short_description: Slime Factory is a game in which you have to develop your factory for breeding Slimes. Manage resources and construction, unlock new building types, and explore a variety of biomes in an open world!

name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 2
short_description: Break into the new apeX of 2D action! INTI CREATES is proud to present new apeX of cutting-edge 2D action with Luminous Avenger iX 2!

name: Warhammer 40,000: Battle Sister
short_description: Welcome to the grim darkness of the far future! Experience the war-torn universe of Warhammer 40,000 brought into jaw-dropping, visceral reality for the first time in VR. Immerse yourself in a gripping, action-filled story spanning the galaxy.

name: 仙侠镇尘箓2
short_description: "Treasure Town 2"is a game that simulates the operation of a cultivation sect. Players can hire cultivators to explore secret realms, cultivate spiritual plants, or refine pills and magic treasures, ultimately enhancing the sect's reputation and becoming the first sect in the cultivation world.

name: Galaxy Edge
short_description: Galaxy Edge is a SpaceShooter game in which you are a spaceship that has to battle against aliens to save planet earth from destruction.

name: Necropolis Suite
short_description: Necropolis Suite, is an immersive narrative-driven cosmic horror game about discovery, knowledge, and the meaning of transcendence. Can you escape the terror that lurks in the suite?

name: Touhou Silver Night Festival ~ Freedom Train
short_description: Once every thousand years, the Silver Night Festival held in Gensokyo! Strengthen your Hakurei Reimu and enjoybullet hell!

name: Touhou ~Red Empress Devil.
short_description: "Touhou ~Red Empress Devil." is a bullet-hell shooting roguelike action game. Set in The Scarlet Devil Mansion, the inhabitants of Gensokyo go on a rampage!

name: Frog Legs
short_description: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

name: Concerto on White
short_description: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

name: Search of Galaxy
short_description: After the supernova explosion, the Thermian race was destroyed. All knowledge, technologies and data about the past were lost. You must to restore civilization and explore the territories of your home system in search of lost technologies and artifacts.

name: WHATEVER
short_description: Inspired by true events. Drifting the giant cargo ship through a tiny, winding canal... What could go wrong?

name: Triple Take
short_description: Triple Take is a fast 2D precision platformer where the stage evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasing difficult levels in vibrant colored worlds!

name: Royal Frontier
short_description: Create your party of heroes and cross the dangerous frontier! Protect the caravan, fight bandits, get gold, rewards, and experience to survive another day.

name: Card Storm Idle
short_description: Card Storm Idle is an incremental game with both idle and active playstyles. Research and craft card deсk to earn as much resource as possible! Build up your power and see how far you can get. Bring the card storm down on monsters!

name: Dungeon Delvers
short_description: Dungeon delvers is a third person action fighting rogue like. Slay hordes of monsters with ever increasingly powerful gear. Hunt for synergies to unlock godly powers and destroy ever increasingly more difficult enemies.

name: Brutal Orchestra
short_description: Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into Purgatory finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.

name: POWERTRIP
short_description: You've been called out in the middle of the night to fix an Emergency Generator. Not a great start to the evening.

name: Chronomaster
short_description: You are Korda, the Chronomaster. You must re-start time and right the wrongs of a war-plagued past in this epic quest for vengeance. Journey through man-made "pocket universes" full of cyborgs, pirates and witches who provide deadly puzzles. It's up to you to return justice to the stars.

name: Timewreck Tales: A Rogue RPG
short_description: Fix the Timewreck in this story rich rogue-like RPG. Build up your team and collect time crystals as you battle, outwit, and discover different dimensions as Independent Time Specialists for Epoch Inc. Epoch Insurance does not cover brain warping or injuries from alternate versions of you.

name: The Pioneers: Surviving Desolation
short_description: Deep and innovative space survival simulation experience. Build your station, manage your crew and explore the harsh environment of Io, the innermost moon of Jupiter. Are you brave enough to survive?

name: Mental Hospital - Child of Evil
short_description: Mental Hospital is a truly scary first-person stealth horror game. Discover heart-thumping terror, chase and scary creatures in this atmospheric horror game.

name: Spellborn
short_description: In this open-world medieval RPG, use your magic and acrobatic abilities to combat the monarchy and bring freedom back to the people.

name: ROUGH KUTS: The Thirsty Dead
short_description: Interactive Film: THE THIRSTY DEAD

name: Neondrops
short_description: Turn your mice and keyboards into independent midi controllers or synthesizers. Use virtual ports to send MIDI to your DAW or plug in your own MIDI keyboard. Sampling functionality included.

name: Kingdom of Heroes
short_description: An RPG game that grows by defeating monsters to level up and making a variety of items.

name: HOPE VR: Emotional Intelligence Assistant Playtest
One against the wind
short_description: A first-person shooter in which there are two game modes. 1. Destroy the enemy generator. 2. Steal the enemy's documents.

name: Robosnow
short_description: Robosnow is a casual racing game. Collect bonuses to increase your speed. Challenge yourself in a new personal record time with precise turns and obstacle avoidance.

name: Yingzinue:Donghei
short_description: Yinznüe: donhei (original project code: the rest of life) is a round role-playing game independently developed by the independent game author Dai frog, with the revival of Hanfu as the main theme.

name: INCISION
short_description: All old-school FPS action. No Bullshit. Lots of blood & gore. Slaughter your way through nightmarish industrial mazes, transformed cityscapes and surreal alien structures to cut down the Growth in this ultraviolent, fast-paced, and merciless retro-styled first person shooter.

name: Kriss' Journey
short_description: A science-fantasy retro-flavoured textual adventure running in your terminal

name: The Cruel kings
short_description: The Cruel kings is a top-down game in which you must either kill or survive. Each round starts with a split screen. The goal of the players is to destroy each other in 1 minute. There are also coins. If the players have an equal amount of life, then the one who collected the most coins wins.

name: Cubyrinth
short_description: Cubyrinth is a 3D puzzle game. Will you be able to navigate and find the correct solution in the labyrinth located on the 6 sides of the cube? This game will provide you with an infinite number of auto-generated 3D labyrinths!

name: Pixelpart
short_description: Visual effects for your game! Design animated effects in this particle-based editor and play them in your games. Use the game engine plugins or export effects to sprite sheets, image sequences and videos.

name: Cheeky Princess
short_description: Princess Ida is a proud student of the Royal Academy of Heroes but her father returned from the war and decided to arrange his daughter's personal life. How will his gamble turn out?

name: Story of Nararale
short_description: The "Story of Nararale" is a 2.5D tactics turn-based game that focuses on tactical management. You take the role of a General who must command your troops to achieve victory.

name: Sacred Curse
short_description: After awakening from a deathlike dream, Charlotte's life turned into a terrible tale.

name: Shiba Army
short_description: Try to survive with your character on an imaginary path to the moon. Collect as many coins as possible, play to get the highest score, so that you can be your own captain in the Shiba Inu army.

name: Visual Novel Sisters
short_description: Visual novel based on the tale of two sisters.

name: Inspector Detective: Private Eye
short_description: Everyone in town has their version of what happened at Timmons Manor. None of them were there. Everyone has their theories about why a Timmons relative has not set foot on the property in 100 years. None of them are correct...

name: POWERNAUT 2
short_description: POWERNAUT 2 - A tough retro style platformer! Using a variety of weapons and special powers, you must fight through an unending series of levels! Each one is randomly generated so you'll never have the same experience twice!

name: Planet Hotpot
short_description: Planet Hotpot is a VR shooter where you run around shooting aliens as an employee of a galactic megacorporation to recover corporate espionage left all over the world by your bungling coworker.

name: Pumpkins
short_description: Pumpkins is a Halloween themed arcade style puzzle game. Traverse through a set of pumpkin patch mazes while avoiding pests and collecting pumpkins.

name: The Netrunner Awaken1ng
short_description: Hack the Matrix. Speedrun, dash and jump from wall to wall on a dynamic electrobass music in procedurally generated levels to steal Datas and escape before the Disconnection() in this parkour Hack 'n' Dash game.

name: Pathological Tires
short_description: A challenging, racing-themed puzzle game about finding and choosing the fastest route. Find the right balance of maintaining momentum by avoiding sharp turns and obstacles, while also keeping the distance as short as possible.

name: Duck and the Land of Flightless Birds
short_description: Duck and the Land of Flightless Birds - A charming platforming adventure where you play as a fat duck that can't fly.

name: Gravekeeper Academy
short_description: Every choice you make brings you closer to Death. Dive into death, spirits, and your subconscious in this gothic fantasy visual novel told in six thrilling parts. (Parts 2-6 in development)

name: Reed The Robotanist Plus
short_description: Reed the Robotanist is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you use the recoil of your gun to navigate and blast your way through numerous crazy levels, all to take down a megalomaniacal oil baron!

name: High Elo Girls
short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

name: Tea Time
short_description: Bad guys have stolen the world's tea supply! Brave the obstacles of five different stages to collect as many falling tea items as possible!

name: Museum of Mechanics: Lockpicking
short_description: Welcome to the Museum of Mechanics: Lockpicking. We're happy to have you! Explore an interactive exhibition of meticulously recreated lockpicking minigames from throughout video game history.

name: Pushy Worm
short_description: Help daddy worm as he embarks on a puzzle filled adventure to gather fruit for his hungry little family. Solve puzzles using grid-based Sokoban movement, climb fences, balance items on your head, avoid falling on to spikes, do whatever it takes to collect all the fruit and keep those kids happy.

name: The Last Tree
short_description: A 2D pixel-like Metrovania game, exploring the game world with a unique atmosphere. In a mysterious and huge tree world, as time goes by, trees and plants have withered, the ecology has become worse, life has become scarce, and who will save the world that is about to break.

name: HAJWALA LINE
short_description: HAJWALA LINE Game that designed to match your requirements. New challenge make you collect coins and buy new cars and open new levels.

name: SlimeSlider
short_description: SlimeSlider is a puzzle game about navigating levels by pushing boxes. In each level, you must push boxes in order to overcome (or take advantage of) your tendency to slide in order to direct the blob to the exit portal.

name: Stones Keeper: Prologue
short_description: Control your own flying castle. Take part in the campaign for the Order of the Screaming Griffin against the forces of the undead that have invaded your provinces. Try to penetrate the secrets of the world around you.

name: NAGARE-BOSHI
short_description: NAGARE-BOSHI is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls. The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Gest!
short_description: Try easy and comfortable gestures by using only a mouse. You DON'T need to purchase any extra devices for these functions. Select specific gestures for each programs. You can also disable them for certain programs.

name: Shorticulture
short_description: A cozy 3rd person solar-punk puzzle adventure. Playfully combine alien plants with broken tech - this is the art of Shorticulture! Repair a shuttle using only space junk and vegetation. Manage multiple characters and resources. Solve puzzles and witness the evolution of strange new life.

name: Necrowave
short_description: Necrowave is a game about the emotional life of a zombie stuck in a microwave. It's a 2D platformer with critical thinking based combat where each different enemy feels like a puzzle to solve instead of relying on brute hack & slash tactics.

name: Dessert Tank: The Saga of Hansel and Gretel Prologue
short_description: Dessert Tank is a single-player real time strategy game. Players can combine different parts to create tanks that do different things and build their own army of tanks. Players must quickly adapt to the situation on the battlefield against waves of enemies in order to achieve victory.

name: Pale Roots
short_description: Work. Earn money. Pay for survival. Speak with crazy characters as tragedy unfolds. You have sixteen weeks before the town ends.

name: Fake Hostel
short_description: Fake Hostel is a classic pipe puzzle game with lots of fun scenes and pleasing artwork. You play as Pedro, the plumber. Since your house attracts a lot of attention from young girls, you decided to rent it out to them. Your task is to take good care of the girls.

name: Voice Visualizer
short_description: Voice Visualizer is a webcam alternative in which you can let a personalized picture pulsate with the sound of your voice. Express yourself with up to six emotes you can present to your audience.

name: 実録パワフル野球拳スラッガー山田
short_description: - 野球拳 - それは投と打を駆使する伝説のマーシャルアーツ

name: Steampunk Gravity
short_description: Steampunk Gravity is an action-simulation game where you pilot a ship, in the air and in the sea, with the objective of recovering very heavy explosive charges through confined spaces underground.

name: Rolling Balls
short_description: This is a physics-based ball racing game where you compete against your friends in Coop-Mode or if you choose to play alone there is an option to race against Time in the Singleplayer-Mode.

name: Multiply Factory
short_description: Multiply Factory is a factory building game. Build your own multiple-layer factory within a 3-D space with belts, inserters, factories and stairs. Enjoy the fantasy of manufacturing.

name: Farmers' Market
short_description: Farmers’ Market is a strategy game which requires the farmer to harvest crops and sell them at the local market in a set amount of time. After each harvest, money is gained and improvements can be made on the farm to increase production.

name: Monkey Mansion
short_description: Monkey Mansion is a high-paced online co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Your mission is to obtain the priceless relics hidden inside a lavish 1920's Russian mansion. Recover them all without getting caught by the old pet proboscis monkey that was affected by the maniacal rituals performed there.

name: rote² (roteSquare)
short_description: rote² - an expanded classic rhythm game.

name: Back to the Dawn
short_description: You were framed and incarcerated. Learn to survive in prison. Explore every inch and exploit any weakness. Manipulate and scheme. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

name: Mystery Box: Hidden Secrets
short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game where you have to solve intriguing riddles around different boxes and discover some cool stories about popular inventions!

name: Mission 1985
short_description: This game is a tribute to the Run "N Gun games (Commando, Ikari Warrior, Heavy Barrel, Guerilla Wars, Mercs...) from the mid 1980's that you could find in arcades or on 16 bit consoles.

name: Drake Frontier
short_description: Welcome to Drake Frontier! A Space Western action RPG featuring real-time combat, organic roleplay, and a deep narrative. Meet different factions, friends, and foes, shape your own interactive story and explore the distant planet Drake.

name: SICK
short_description: Sick is a mixture of intense thriller and exploration of a small surrounding world. A first-person game with a frightening atmosphere. Once in Hell, you play as Jack Willis, who roams an endless loop of suffering, pain and fear.

name: Paper Bride
short_description: Paper Bride is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game. You will play as the groom to search for the truth and have bizarre encounters, gradually learning about the dark mystic custom in the bride's home village and a story from the past...

name: Maison Rouge
short_description: Это история об обычном человеке, живущим во времена экономического кризиса во Франции. Страна на пороге революции. Главному герою предстоит выбор, на чью сторону встать. Руководить восстанием или отстаивать честь короля. Предать ли друзей ради благой цели или поставить на кон всё - решать вам.

name: Love Flute
short_description: Play the piano, play the flute, and enjoy a ghost story as you use the profits from your street performances to buy new instruments and furniture! Let's shoot for fame and fortune!

name: 异星夺宝
short_description: This is a game that uses shooting to solve puzzles! You're a graduate student in interstellar Archaeology, and for your summer internship this year, you're flying solo to exotic alien ruins in search of hidden treasures!

name: 双腕のソルダート The Soldat with Twin Arms
short_description: The Soldat with Twin Arms is 2.5D side-scrolling action game with focus on a exhilarating and comfortable battle. Let's clear the stages by using various skills such as wire action using two extended arms! Crush problems by going back and forth between the cyberpunk world and virtual spaces!

name: Demolish & Build VR
short_description: Demolish, construct and grow your business! You can purchase new land properties, earn orders and have fun at the same time. It's up to you whether you use a hammer or one of the newest tools and machines. Will you be able to build a strong empire? Get to work!

name: Gambit!
short_description: Gun up and wreak havoc in Gambit! – a 4-player campaign-driven shooter-adventure in a world of gangs, guns, and mayhem.

name: Drag Engineer
short_description: If you are interested in programming, you will like the game. You will play an engineer, use the mouse to drag various instructions to write programs, and let them run normally to meet the requirements of the boss. Some levels test your logic ability very much. Please think carefully before you act.

name: Sealed Gate
short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

name: Might of Merchants
short_description: Might of Merchants combines an economic and trading simulation with role-playing elements in a medieval kingdom. Experience a unique and lovingly hand-drawn world in which you have to prove your skills as a merchant.

name: 独行旅者 Solitary Traveler
short_description: Is the world ravaged by demon armies, depopulated, disordered royalty, missing gods, saved or destroyed? Over to you, alien traveler ~ Meet the test of the world, start the adventure of life!

name: Code Dread
short_description: Code Dread is a survival horror game for 1~4 players. You are on a mission to investigate an old abandoned hospital. Be prepared to fight against a ferocious monster lurking in the shadow!

name: Home Designer - Makeover Blast
short_description: Help your clients in this match3 game turn their drab living space into fantastic rooms! Solve matching puzzles to design and decorate the perfect home with beautiful furniture!

name: They Are Coming!
short_description: They are coming! Ravenous, insatiable, and absolutely unstoppable zombies, a Wunderwaffe that went horribly wrong. It’s up to you to usher in the age of the zombie, by munching on every brain in sight! Build up a horde, dodge enemy weapons, and gnaw a mark on human history!

name: Crime O'Clock
short_description: Crime O'Clock is a hidden objects investigation and time exploration game with a deep storyline. Investigate cases through time and evolving maps by unveiling a multi-eras linked story. Will you be observant enough to solve the mysteries? Crime waits for no man!

name: LIBLADE
short_description: Slash, slash, slash. Sometimes you have to dance, sometimes you have to be precise. "LIBLADE" is a side-scrolling action game where you slash and slash by playing the stick. Use the twin-stick slash action to slash down everything and defeat the strongest enemies that stand in your way.

name: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle 3
short_description: Challenging 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzle featuring epic fantasy female characters.

name: Hentai Sakura 🌸🌊
short_description: Hentai Sakura is a casual physics-based puzzle game. Challenge yourself to get 10 sex animated scenes with Live2D. Go on a fascinating journey through ancient Japan and our Samurai girls. Connect the balls by drawing lines to win!

name: TramSim Munich - The Tram Simulator
short_description: Discover with TramSim Munich a new city with numerous landmarks as well as the low-floor tram model R2.2.b! Transport your passengers on three detailed tram lines in full length through the centre of the Bavarian capital.

name: Mage Tower: Call of Zadeus Playtest
Colonize Prologue
short_description: Colonize Prologue is a combination of survival game and building strategy that takes place during the colonization period - the 17th century. It tells the story of a settlement in the new world and all the difficulties encountered by the early settlers.

name: The Little Spirit of the East
short_description: 동쪽의 꼬마신령 -구원-은 소원을 빌기 위해 소환된 '꼬마신령'의 저주를 피해 갇혀버린 구교사를 탈출하는 미스터리 어드벤처 장르의 게임입니다. 플레이어는 수많은 퍼즐을 풀어 구교사를 탈출함과 동시에 단서를 모아 이 사건이 벌어지게 된 이유를 파헤쳐 내야 합니다.

name: YOGA MASTER
short_description: Yoga Master is the first wellness game of its kind built entirely in 3D and designed by experts to help you reach the perfect balance between mind and body.

name: Lazy Girl
short_description: Action-platformer with puzzles for the most hardcore gamers! Help the young wizard to save her loved one. Use your reaction, intelligence, and some gravity-changing magic to complete ten dungeons and fight the evil technomage.

name: Anxiety Treatment with Relaxation Demo
short_description: Dr. Lora Heugens talks about anxiety, how to calm down and feel good about yourself. She talks about common scenarios that normally makes people anxious and goes into details to react to them. She describes the process that will enable you to calm yourself quickly and efficiently anytime.

name: ShadoWave - Revenger
short_description: Shadow Wave is a Metroidvania-style action rogue lite. Explore different biomes always with different arrangements. With the help of your faithful companion, move fast, be precise in combat and watch your powers grow stronger. Evolve in death and enjoy the path.

name: Deflector
short_description: Deflector is a top down action rogue-lite set in a deadly microcosm. Dive deep into hostile worlds teeming with viruses. Strike down increasingly challenging enemies with your weapons and their own deflected projectiles. Live, die, grow stronger and become powerful enough to reach the Source!

name: Weakpoint Delta
short_description: Asteroids go boom. Zoom around in your lil' ship and learn how to accurately hit weakpoints on asteroids to extract the precious crystals within allowing you to purchase upgrades.

name: Shambled Spiral
short_description: Singleplayer Genre - Weird/Casual/FPS Purchase now to possibly get a much better version in the future for FREE!

name: Queen of Succubus
short_description: One day, Rim, the daughter of a demon king, is told by her mother to go and defeat a brave warrior and goes on a trip to the human world. She reluctantly decides to go and defeat the hero.

name: Lawnmower Game: Space Fight
short_description: Epic Lawnmower game series continue now at space. Now you control super powered lawnmower space ship and fight against enemies at different space levels.

name: Sanae Toumaden X2
short_description: A mega X Touhou fangame with no X again.

name: Last Devil
short_description: You are the Demon Lord Kuro on a mission to protect demonkind. Use your abilities and charms to capture and ensnare others. Tumble with different personalities and fetishes in this 2D rogue-lite shooter!

name: Solanaceae: After All
short_description: Join Battam, an exiled witch, on his quest to make a brand new type of coven! Explore a colorful world, gather ingredients for potion brewing and cooking, immerse yourself in a long and detailed story, all while viewing some optional and super sexy scenes in this hybrid visual novel!

name: Fantasy General
short_description: Fantasy General invites you to enter a world of heroes, swords, magic and beasts. You must lead your army into battle with the Shadowlord’s forces and defeat each of his lieutenants across varying terrain and battlefields.

name: Pacific General
short_description: Pacific General explores the Pacific front of the Second World War. Taking control of Axis or Allied forces, you must strategically battle your way through the Eastern and Western front of the Pacific war, using a wide array of land, air and naval forces.

name: War Wind
short_description: War Wind is a real-time strategy game that allows you to view an epic battle through the eyes of four unique races, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. The game features 28 ready-to-play scenarios and a story of such compelling depth you won't believe it's just a game.

name: War Wind II: Human Onslaught
short_description: War Wind II: Human Onslaught is a compelling must-play for any real-time strategy fan. The game offers a great variety of vehicular, mechanised and special units, intense and exciting maps, along with a combat model that offers a dynamic balance of play.

name: Catch Me!
short_description: Compete online against your friends and other players in this chaotic and fast paced 4-player game of tag! Race across different locations, jump through windows, electrocute the other players or throw cats at them. (No cats were harmed in the production of this game.)

name: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
short_description: 一款以悬疑、犯罪、黑色幽默主导的剧情游戏。 在精心打磨的美术和扣人心弦故事中，乌山大佛消亡史徐徐开幕。

name: Gobby Island
short_description: Gobbies, punches, and retrowave

name: Forbidden place
short_description: A zombie virus appeared in the spacecraft. Please collect the materials in the spacecraft and try to escape.

name: Fantasy Heroes 4D / Character Maker
short_description: Fantasy Heroes 4D is a 4-directional character editor. Create and customize human characters, save them as sprite sheets and use with different game engines to make your game! You can also use Fantasy Heroes for prototyping and visual reference.

name: Faster Than Possible
short_description: Try to get the lowest time by abusing triple jump, wall climb, and wall hugging mechanics! The fastest time wins!

name: Solomon Division
short_description: Solomon Division is a co-op horror game where you play as an employee of agency that hunts demons invading your country. Play together with your friends as Technician or Medium and seal the demons. Walk the path from a beginner agent to the veteran whose name makes the Devil himself shiver in fear.

name: SIT DOWN, PLEASE
short_description: Step into a scientist's shoes in a story driven game which leads you to discover a mysterious and unknown world by torturing characters. In order to find out all the hidden secrets, try to keep the guinea pigs alive for as long as possible by using the scientist's machinery.

name: OplitisAV
short_description: You are a Ferocious Anti-virus Systemic Trucidator (FAST), you are injected in an infected system, and your sole objective is to eradicate all virus life forms.

name: Blobby's Quest
short_description: A simple, singleplayer 2D Platformer

name: Koru
short_description: Play as aspiring botanist, Koru, on her journey to Wilder County to start an apprenticeship with the elusive Dr. Linny.

name: Heroes of the Galaxy
short_description: Space adventure with open world, FPS shooter and a lot of missions. Choose your own carrier. Are you a space pirate or a brave space ranger? Choose your destiny. The galaxy needs you, commander! Openworld game with multiple worlds to explore.

name: Ultimaze
short_description: Ultimaze is a tile-based puzzle game about navigating small labyrinths.

name: Undying Lantern
short_description: Undying Lantern is a third-person action game where your goal is to subdue otherworldly criminals who are on the run. Locate them by exploring mysterious locations and overcome their challenges by mastering the lantern's powers and understanding their weaknesses.

name: Traffic Command: Reborn
short_description: Traffic Command Reborn - Take command of the traffic in the streets, redirecting cars, and telling them when it is okay to stop, and when it is okay to go. One big game of Red light green light keeps you on your feet in this addicting traffic driving game.

name: Air Strike
short_description: Air Strike is an action simulator of air combat, where every man for himself.

name: 来自女巫森林的法师
short_description: This game is my first game.Do not buy this game now,because it is too early.This is a plot-oriented 2D role-playing game, with dialogue and plot as the main gameplay.

name: Spirit and Katana
short_description: Are you ready for an epic, yet adorable, adventure?! Join the guild waiting for you in the land of Celedain. This is a story about teamwork, friendship, and good times along the way. The bards will be sure to sing soon of your heroism in Spirit and Katana!

name: Shadows of Forbidden Gods
short_description: Take on the role of a Dark Elder God and lead your agents to bring about an apocalypse in a fantasy world. Work in the shadows, avoiding the heroes who will try to stop you, as you bring about plague and famine, ice age and volcanic destruction, madness and never ending night.

name: Iron Age
short_description: Iron Age is a First-person dungeon crawler set in a Sci-Fi Fantasy world with Realtime melee combat.

name: Hedgie Simulator
short_description: Trapped within the offices of a large hedge fund called Sipadel Finance. It's your job to take a sip and make the apes dip while playing this idle clicker game.

name: FORTRESS DEFENDER
short_description: This game, "FORTRESS DEFENDER", is a side-scrolling power-up shooting game with an 80's flavor. Defeat the enemies that appear one after another, dodge their attacks, and aim for the boss that lurks in the depths of the stage. There are a total of eight stages with various tricks and bosses.

name: Texture Assembler
short_description: Texture Assembler - is a tool for quick and easy manipulation of RGBA image channels. For example, it can be used to convert textures between different engines.

name: Katana Punk
short_description: Katana Punk is a roguelike deck builder set in neon-lit dystopian Tokyo about rewriting your cards to discover illegal synergies.

name: You VS Drugs
short_description: 'The Enemy' can enslave anyone, anywhere. By taking on the role of real-life Agents who exist in our brain and embarking on an adventure that will defy your imagination, you will be empowered to better protect yourself, and the people you love —if you have what it takes!

name: Project Shanto Rancher
short_description: Project Shanto Rancher is a Creature Collecting game, in which you create your own ranch, and fill it with the creatures you capture along the way. Explore 6 different regions and unlock the mysteries of the world of Shanto.

name: Floppy and the Sleepy Planet Playtest
Ghosted: The Puzzle Master
short_description: Guide the ghosts home by solving color puzzles. After solving color puzzles designed by a unique master, you will soon become a puzzle master too. Oh, and don't miss Master's big band music.

name: Idol Showdown
short_description: Made by hololive fans, for hololive fans. Idol Showdown is the definitive fan-made hololive fighting game experience, powered by rollback netcode. Engage in exciting duels as your favorite hololive talent and prove once and for all who the strongest idol is using the game’s easy-to-learn controls.

name: Kingslayers
short_description: Kingslayers is a free-to-play tactical strategy game. Choose from various units and skills to build your ideal team formation then outsmart your opponent to slay their King before they slay yours.

name: Purify
short_description: "Purify" is a 2D action RPG game in which a cleaning robot aims to reach the deepest part of a closed underground laboratory. Become the cleaning robot "Zero" and engage in tense battles with robots that have gone out of control.

name: Fishing at Lotus Lakes
short_description: This is a leisure and entertainment game that simulates fishing. You can experience the fun of fishing with a simple mouse and keyboard. Enjoy fishing time and browse the beautiful scenery around you. The scoreboard will also record the type and value of the fish caught.

name: Demon Lord: Clicker
short_description: A Steam-Drop Clicker with real game mechanics in a high fantasy setting. Click for drops, then choose to combine them for stronger/rarer variants, equip them for power! Amass wealth and glory! Be the hero, assault the Demon Lord! (No fruit is harmed during gameplay)

name: Mary Knots - Garden Wedding
short_description: Mary is a a truly inspired Wedding Planner. Help Mary restore and decorate the garden! Buy garden decorations to make it the perfect wedding location. Mary Knots features Hidden Object scenes, Match3 minigames and lots of decoration fun! Come, help Mary make her dreams come true!

name: Eco Park
short_description: Eco Park is a game about ecology and lo-fi hip-hop. Manage a dynamic ecosystem with creatures eating, breeding, and dying in real time. You’ll need to introduce species to increase biodiversity. Keep population sizes under control, or one species might extinguish another.

name: Sandfall
short_description: The Sand War, a destructive conflict that took place over 30 years ago, still inflicts collateral damages on the continent. Our heroes must discover the the truth behind the war and bring peace once more to the continent while dealing with their own inner conflicts.

name: Hymns of Resurrection
short_description: Calder and Ygritte are the King's elite soldiers. They come upon Karandir and the Occultists' wicked plans and become the ones responsible for preventing an evil resurrection and a new war.

name: Electric Car Tycoon
short_description: In Electric Car Tycoon you get to start the electric car revolution with your own car company. Start with an experimental model in your garage and grow your company to hundreds of factories and workers around the world. Research new technologies and improve your models. Create the best electric car

name: They came from another planet
short_description: A twin stick, fixed shooter, bonus hell, pixel art, shoot 'em up. Aliens have invaded and you, a blue housecat with a stretchy head, are, of course, our last hope. Fight the aliens on earth, under the ocean and in space in this risk/reward based fixed shooter inspired by old school shoot 'em ups.

name: Andromeda Acolytes
short_description: You play all four heroines in this big multi-chapter sci-fi text adventure. Negotiate underwater mechs, AIs, abandoned cities, crime, friendship, suspense, horror, humour, an art exhibition, virtual realities and a tank. Experience each PC via first-person prose as you puzzle, converse and explore.

name: TARAKAN - Mystery Point & Click Adventure
short_description: Tarakan is a puzzle mystery adventure, inspired by escape room style games. Take control of a submarine and visit multiple coastal laboratories. Solve puzzles as you go to unlock the tools you need to solve the mystery!

name: Submarine VR
short_description: Submarine VR takes you on a adventure-filled underwater simulation experience! Dive deep and cruise through the endless uncharted nature of the ocean and you will see clownfish, dolphins, penguins and mysterious sea animals. Get close to the sea surface and sail in the open sea with your cruise ship

name: Sweet Desire: Hentai Puzzle
short_description: Puzzle game with a lot of hot and sexy anime girls! Juicy NSFW hentai arts.

name: Esports History
short_description: Esports History is an RPG sim where you start as a regular guy, and work your way up to the very top of esports. Defeat bosses in tournaments, make a name for yourself within the esports community, and become a real pro!

name: Instinct
short_description: Instinct is a die & retry oriented platformer with intense combat.Will you awaken your ▓Σℿ╖?

name: Ayna: Shattered Truth
short_description: Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this newly crafted fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.

name: Green City
short_description: Green City is a Free-to-Play, Eco-Focused City-Builder. Create your own beautiful sustainable city, manage resources and balance economic growth with environmental impact.

name: COP BASTARD
short_description: COP BASTARD is a classic first-person shooter set in early 90s Japan, offering non-stop action inspired by action movies.

name: 西游记2021
short_description: This game takes Sun Wukong, Tang monk, pig Bajie, sand monk and little white dragon as the protagonists. It tells the story of their journey to the west to learn scriptures, going through difficulties and dangers, subduing demons and subduing demons, and finally obtaining the Scriptures.

name: My Newborn Life In A Harem
short_description: One day, after a woman cheated on you, you got desperate and got killed by a truck… Then, a demoness with horns on her head saved you and changed your face… But you had a debt of 20 million dollars! You had no choice but to help this girl with horns collect "love". But what was "love"?

name: Eternal night
short_description: This is a thriller survival horror game. You will play the role of a dark past, uncovering the secrets buried in the hospital, the tragedy of the family, and the madness of human nature.

name: My Dear Frankenstein -English Edition-
short_description: Play as man-made boy, Adam, in this emotional adventure. Explore the city at night in search of the fragments of his heart!

name: Wreckdigger
short_description: Dive into a short story about stranded rebel fighting for his survival on a foreign mysterious planet which is a spaceship graveyard. Encounter scavengers fighting for valuable ship parts. Meet other survivors -help others to help yourself. An action platformer with metroidvania elements.

name: My journey to your world
short_description: A casual free-to-play puzzle game with randomly scrambled puzzle pieces that can be solved under a certain time to win.

name: Monster Tamer
short_description: Catch, raise, and fight monsters in a fantasy world! Fuse monsters with simple drag and drop to evolve them into powerful monsters in no time! Raise your own unique monsters to your liking, and fight and capture the toughest enemies that stand in your way! Will you be the best monster tamer?

name: TEMPUS
short_description: TEMPUS is a puzzle adventure game with time travel. Each time you advance, you will see the island where you live change over thousands of years. You can only travel forward so it is a one way trip, how far will you go?

name: Perish Song
short_description: Perish Song is a 2D action rogue-lite. Traverse through different environments as you battle unique enemies and bosses. Discover the secrets of the world as you dash and blast through anything standing in your path. Each death is an opportunity to learn, adapt, and overcome.

name: Spirits of the Hellements - TD
short_description: Assemble legendary Spirits and defend against the endless hordes of Hell. A tower defense where you must shape the battlefield and create a maze using the three Hellements. Use Fire, Lightning, and Wind tiles to trap your enemies, or augment your defenses.

name: Sudoku Minimalist Infinite
short_description: Classic Sudoku distraction-free. Just you and the game.

name: Requiem
short_description: Slash enemies, morph into beast form, and raise the dead to fight for you in this grim-dark souls-like.

name: Greek Tragedy
short_description: Greek Tragedy is a retro-styled indie survival horror game with puzzle elements. Help Amy keep her life on the college campus overrun by cultists and maybe save her relationship in the process. Uncover conspiracies, sabotage occult rituals and run for your life! Nostalgic PS1 aesthetics included.

name: Ribby: The Game
short_description: An indie RPG adventure following the story of Ribby, an altruistic frog girl on a journey to get back home down a pathless road.

name: Delta Zero
short_description: A fast-paced action platformer with non-linear world progression and level design! Challenging gameplay with 3 difficulty modes, 2 playable characters and local co-op! Fight bosses in any order and experience the world change with each victory, enemies become harder, faster and smarter!

name: Dark Age Empires
short_description: Dark Age Empires is an open world survival game that can be played in single player mode or as an online multiplayer game on a dedicated server.Do you have what it takes to not only survive in this dark age, but to rise up, fight back and create your own Dark Age Empire?

name: break
short_description: A new and nostalgic suspension action game is about to begin. You and them, let's go on an adventure!

name: TIMESCAPE: Altitude
short_description: The pilots are gone, You are locked to a seat, and have been left to die on a plane. Best to get out, as quickly as possible. Solve a series of puzzles to escape and jump to safety. You will need all your wits on this mission.

name: Aebal
short_description: Aebal is a procedural generated rhythm game where your goal is to avoid the red enemies. The more enemies on the board when your hit, the more points you lose. With your own music in this bullet hell, theres nothing but the music to defeat you.

name: Card Game Simulator
short_description: Create, Share, and Play with Card Game Simulator

name: Empyrean Scout
short_description: Maneuver your scout corvette through a wonderous but hostile domain. Abuse its superior agility to grind enemies for gear and XP, empowering you to venture further. Empyrean Scout is a space combat Action-RPG, built from the ground up for VR.

name: Iron Tracks TD
short_description: Arm and defend your train, and when you need it done good, take control and shoot the enemies yourself! Mend the damage, get powerful crystals, and figure out the mysterious meteor at the center of it all.

name: ファントムゾーン　クリプトファシア
short_description: The future is just a toe away, where supernatural phenomena are frequent. Two identical twins, Akihito and Fuyuto Shirahane. They are caught up in a strange phenomenon in Yomori City, a town where various legends swirl around them.

name: Wings Of WW2
short_description: Take to the skies in this 2D depiction of World War 2 in the 1940's. You will be constantly under attack from Enemy war birds hell bent on taking you down.

name: The Forest Prison
short_description: In 2160, political dissidents were not sentenced directly to death but were sent for 'cognitive and orientation tests' to a prison from which no one had ever escaped alive. This is the story of James Webb, who was sentenced to life in prison.

name: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling
short_description: A short psychological adventure about a stressed girl who wants to explore her ceiling.

name: Poly Puzzle: Furries
short_description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with furries.

name: Lifeflame Compendium
short_description: Lifeflame is the essence of all life. Harness it! Wage war or make peace while you farm crops, breed, befriend and play as animals in a 2D Top-Down RPG with platforming and a novel combat system where you fight with swords and magic.

name: Narco Lolita
short_description: "Fire that rocket in your pants into her from behind." Nasty and silly, comedy visual novel. You are a young mobster and your mission is to find Lolita ― of a crime syndicate. Engage with women to investigate or to just accept the temptation.

name: Against Death
short_description: Action adventure thriller "Against Death: dead-end road " takes place in the harsh world of the beginning of the apocalypse due to an unknown virus. The John Carter is a former military man, and now a simple biker who is in search of himself.And this day was supposed to be the same...

name: One Last Memory
short_description: One Last Memory is an emotional story driven exploration game about an old man who re-discovers his own past and lost memories on his journey through the beauty of nature. It is an adventure filled with joy, sadness and breathtaking locations and environments that are waiting to be discovered.

name: Robo pocket: 3d fighter with rollback
short_description: A 3d robot fighter with rollback netcode.

name: Escape from Rowei
short_description: Strategic puzzle, your every choice will be decisive to save Leycla or not!

name: Night Cascades
short_description: The city is on fire, and the Devil is to blame - or is it? Two women must solve an occult-themed mystery set in an alternate 1980s while unraveling the secrets of their past. Hunt for clues and interrogate suspects in this interactive yuri visual novel.

name: Sidequest
short_description: Once up a time in a world far far away, there lived a group of heroes bound together by fate, chosen to battle dark forces, on an epic adventure. THIS IS NOT THAT STORY Join, magog, Faiza, Arcturus, and Laira, on a journey the likes of which, has admittedly been seen many times.

name: Abettor
short_description: Abettor is a top-down shooter where enemies constantly spawn all around you. In this game, not only does the world generate around you, but the enemies do as well. Kill as many enemies and achieve your highest score. How many can you kill in Abettor?

name: I, W.O.M.A.N.
short_description: Battle dangerous robots that have been taken over by a malicious alien program. Customize your character, then fight your way to the Bridge, using power-ups and specialized weapons, to reboot the Central Computer before the berserk robots make it to the human passengers aboard the spaceship.

name: Touch from a Raindrop
short_description: Touch from a Raindrop is a storybook adventure game in a first-person fantasy kingdom. A magical stranger enters a small town and changes their lives forever.

name: Close Quarters Supremacy The Legis
short_description: A sci-fi third person action shooter, Close Quarters Supremacy The Legis, is a journey into the power struggle over advanced A.I.

name: LOVE! TRUTH! PUZZLE!
short_description: LOVE! TRUTH! PUZZLE! is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Spectrum
short_description: A beautiful puzzle game

name: Time of the Clones
short_description: Thanks to an unsuccessful experiment, the scientific complex found itself in a time loop. Any ideas how to fix this?!

name: Welcome to Free Will - Episode 1
short_description: Welcome to Free Will - Episode 1 is the first episode of a choice-driven, adult Visual Novel game. You play as a young man who travels to a small town looking for his missing mother. As you soon find out, the town is packed with many beautiful women.

name: Lola - The Escape
short_description: In this challenging action platformer. Help the little cow Lola to escape from the Martians who kidnapped her. Explore and avoid obstacles in each level. Her main ability is to float while she falls.

name: KOSHMAR
short_description: KOSHMAR is a psychological horror game, in which you have to face an evil entity that seeks revenge!

name: Infinite Widgets
short_description: Elevate your desktop with Infinite Widgets, the ultimate tool for creating and sharing custom widgets. Monitor system performance, hardware temperatures, control media, create dock/taskbar widgets, and more with the built-in editor and our Lua and JavaScript implementation.

name: SCP: Doki Doki Anomaly
short_description: SCP-8008-1 IS A HORROR DATING SIM WHERE THE BEST YOU CAN HOPE FOR IS SURVIVAL. SMOOCH SCP-173, SCP-682 AND EVEN SCP-096. DO NOT RUN THIS SOFTWARE WITHOUT CLASS-4 AUTHORIZATION.

name: YetiFree
short_description: YetiFree is a retro role reversal of the 90's classic SkiFree. Smash, slam, and blast your way down the slopes to rack up the highest score. The Yeti must feed!

name: FORGOTTEN: THE GAME
short_description: Experience all the stages of dementia in this mood-swinging psychological horror game that we call FORGOTTEN. Travel as a fox through progressively disturbing stages searching for memories explaining the protagonist's life. Pay close attention to what the fox is trying to offer before it's too late

name: Firebird: Legend of the Crystal Goddesses
short_description: Firebird: Legend of the Crystal Goddesses is a love letter to classic RPGs of the SNES era, inspired by 8-bit and 16-bit classics of the 90's, with some self-aware meta humor for fans of the genre. Come experience a unique fantasy adventure!

name: Danglebox
short_description: Danglebox is about creating physics based structures to hunt for resources or just for fun. Build with various materials, lift with balloons, pull with ropes and push with thrusters to enable your designs to withstand the weight of trains, buildings, containers, weapons fire and more.

name: Dirty Wars: September 11
short_description: Historical indie videogame about the suburbs of the Cold War in South America.

name: Mireille and Amrita, the Forest of Illusions
short_description: Mireille was a nun living in a small village in the mountains. One day, her sick father's illness takes a turn for the worse. To find the materials needed to cure his illness, the girl goes out on an adventure.

name: RFVR
short_description: A medieval fantasy VR RPG set in a massive open world with deep player progression, fast-paced physics-based combat, and classic RPG game mechanics reimagined for VR. Full dive into the world of RFVR, there's something here for everyone.

name: Horny Elves and a Moral Orc
short_description: Donovan - a kind and honest orc - survived the destruction of his species, vowing to the Goddess that he would never lay with an elf upon pain of death. Unfortunately, his quiet hermitage has been discovered by 2 horny elven sluts who crave nothing more than the legendary orcish spearhead!

name: Running Water
short_description: You are a "Runner" known as subject #0076101, created out of water by a tyrannical A.I. that runs the facility. During testing an error occurs and you are released unexpectedly into the basement where you must run, jump, climb and fight for your freedom using the tools found along the way.

name: Teravit
short_description: Welcome to "Teravit", a sandbox game created by players! With its three elements of "Create, Play, and Share", you can travel to the world of adventure and endless creation, alone or with friends!

name: 心灵迷宫（ Mind maze）
short_description: Operating instructions：walk：↑↓←→、jump：Z、attack：X、shapeshifting：C

name: Axon Hero
short_description: Axon Hero is more than just a puzzle game - it's a creative playground where logic meets imagination. Build, code, and conquer your way through many hand-crafted challenges, each one more mind-bending than the last.

name: 100 Doors - Escape from Prison
short_description: This escape logic puzzle game takes you to Megan, a young journalist, who gets trapped inside an old prison and needs all the help she can get to solve brain-teasing logic puzzles. No one finds the prison pleasant, so put yourself in her shoes and help her open all the doors till she's rescued.

name: Typer Hero (打字英雄)
short_description: Your village is being invaded by monsters。Every monster has a word above them, defeat the monster by typing out the word . Defend your village by stop the monsters from reaching the bottom of the screen.

name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted: Reinvented Edition
short_description: Sir, You Are Being Hunted: Reinvented Edition presents a savagely funny world of procedurally-generated stealth and survival. Roam wild in spooky British landscapes, all the while being hunted by a menagerie of bloodthirsty robots. A beautifully remastered new edition of the cult survival game.

name: *NEW* FINAL SCUFFED WITH A LITTLE POLISH BHOP EXPERIENCE 2029 BRAIN ROT EDITION (POG CHAMP)
short_description: The third and final entry in the SCUFFED BHOP trilogy. With a brand new single-player campaign and levels for players to beat and speedrun. With lots of easter eggs and (un)funny memes.

name: Dip The Frog
short_description: Follow the story of a joyful little frog who goes on an adventure in this super-tight platformer.

name: The forgotten phobia
short_description: The forgotten phobia is a horror puzzle game made in 2D pixel graphics.

name: Orph - The Lost Boy
short_description: Orph - The Lost Boy is a first-person horror game where you have to find out what happened with your son. Explore an old orphanage, uncover secrets long forgotten and solve puzzles.

name: One Military Camp
short_description: Build your own military camp, manage the economy, recruit the best candidates and train them to become elite specialists. Send them on missions across the land to end the war once and for all!

name: HYPER DEMON
short_description: HYPER DEMON is an FPS like no other. a pearl of lightning. a dream from the future. a drop of poison. a swan song. The faster you slay demons, the harder the game and the higher your score. There is an end. Will it see you?

name: Hexmet World
short_description: In Hexmet World you can create your ideal world, build your strategy, attack the enemy, and enjoy the beauty of the created places!

name: Sainthood
short_description: Sainthood is a cozy strategy game about serving your community and growing your faith. Explore a miniature world and help the islanders by constructing buildings, delivering resources, and volunteering. Pray and attend to other spiritual activities as you rise to become a Saint!

name: Evil God Korone
short_description: An unexpected collaboration from Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades daily life, and VTuber Inugami Korone, from VTuber group hololive. Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. Now, chop your finger and give it to her.

name: FlipWitch - Forbidden Sex Hex
short_description: Use your newly-acquired genderbending abilities as a 'FlipWitch' to conquer evil monsters, giant bosses, and Monster Girls across the land! You'll have to use your wits in this quirky adventure to seduce everyone around you!

name: Jaksaljabi
short_description: Jaksaljabi is a kinetic novel that you can experience unique set-up and story.

name: RASKOPNIK: The Trench Warrior
short_description: World's first Dungeon crawler in World War II setting! Crawl around the trenches, dig your own path, beat the Nazis and try your best to stay alive. The Motherland's fate depends on your success!

name: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
short_description: The second game in the unique Voice of Cards series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

name: Curse of Elmwood
short_description: A folklore-inspired, eerie action-adventure dungeon crawler about preventing a curse that requires your blood to complete. Master your weapon, explore a world brimming with items, abilities, and spells, and ensure that endless night never befalls your hometown of Elmwood.

name: Evolution: Moon Warfare
short_description: Low gravity sci-fi FPS team deathmatch game.

name: Crystarise
short_description: Explore a vast world, create your own sky island, the island gives the girl the power. An open world-action RPG that you create more and more and become stronger and stronger.

name: King's Helper
short_description: Have you ever wondered what the King's life is like? King's Helper is an extraordinary FPP game in which you have a chance to become his right hand. Travel back to the Middle Ages and assume the role of the King's helper.

name: 猫不语
short_description: Cat Silence is a horror suspense puzzle game with urban legend themes. The story takes place in an abandoned experimental middle school. With the deepening of the investigation, the unknown and long-buried bloody stories of this school slowly emerged, putting together a chilling truth...

name: Soccer Boss
short_description: Be the Boss of your own soccer club, choosing from clubs from the biggest leagues across Europe. Make decisions based on tactics, training, staff recruitment and player selection. Spend your transfer budget wisely during the transfer window whilst keeping the board satisfied with your performance.

name: KAIJU MONSTER VR
short_description: You play as a giant monster whose only desire is destruction. Confront enemy units, ravage cities and cause as much destruction as possible.

name: World War ToonZ
short_description: Navigate across the city while surviving wave after wave of zombie attacks in this high-action zombie apocalypse. As you progress deeper into the apocalypse, join your fellow troops in multiplayer to discover who will reign supreme as the final survivor.

name: Extinction
short_description: Extinction is a singleplayer horror game where you explore The valley of Extinction. Your job is to explore it while also keeping yourself alive from monsters who want to end your life.

name: QUIZxRPG
short_description: Do you like Quiz? Experience the perfect combination of RPG and Quiz. Challenge your own understanding, learn new knowledge while getting rewarded with powerful equipment, gold coins and interesting characters.

name: Royal Order
short_description: Intrigue, betrayal, deaths! A LGBT+ survival Raising Simulation in a high-fantasy royal court setting with RPG elements.

name: Trials of Proelium
short_description: Experience a colorful world full of vibrant characters through the eyes of Letha, a young warrior on the hunt for district masters in her pursuit to become Proeliums new emperor in this anime style turn-based RPG.

name: The Tipping Point
short_description: Developed in collaboration with researchers, The Tipping Point is a fun and educational game about climate science. You play as an arctic climate researcher and must get off the ice sheet before it collapses. On your way, you will gather and analyze data about the ice sheet, before it is lost.

name: Revasion
short_description: Revasion is a minimalistic action arcade game with an energetic soundtrack. A challenging colorful bullet hell survival experience. A hybrid gameplay experience inspired by bullet hell and breakout classics.

name: Early Quest 2
short_description: Join Weiry, one of the protagonists of Early Quest, on her new adventure in a magical world ...

name: RollRiddle - Cube'n'Roll
short_description: RollRiddle-Cube'n'Roll is a unique adventure game where players take over 100 levels, each with its unique themes and obstacles. Players can change the appearance of the ball with various skins available to personalize their experience. This game offers a fun, and challenging gameplay experience.

name: 2pupp
short_description: This game features more than 30 levels that feature platforming challenges.

name: Human Madness
short_description: Human Madness is a multiplayer shooter game

name: Hostile Planet: Survival
short_description: Hostile Planet: Survival is a harsh adventure on an uncharted planet that full of danger and trials.

name: Tile Connect - Onet Match
short_description: Tile Connect - Onet Match is a super fun matching game with cool challenges and brain teasers! Enjoy hours of fun connecting lovely images. Test your skills by matching and linking the same kind of images and work your way up to victory!

name: SCP-970 The Recursive Room
short_description: SCP-970 is a spatial phenomenon wherein a collection of rooms are looped on themselves. In all cases found, this is by means of a series of doors appearing in the walls, all in a straight line, such that it is possible to walk forwards and end up at the starting position.

name: String Rush
short_description: String Rush is a puzzle-platformer where you don't control your avatar in real time, but you have to enter the movement commands (input) inside a string and execute them all together.

name: Tails & Titties Hot Spring
short_description: After shutting down a shady company hell bent on chopping down a forest, the local spirits and monster girls repay you with an unforgettable hot spring experience! (it's unforgettable because you have sex, ok?)

name: Netherspace
short_description: A sci-fi shoot'em'up game with heavy focus on upgrades experimentation, featuring two unlikely heroes that must work perfectly together, despite their share of secrets, to surpass their limits and succeed in eliminating a threat that might destroy both Earth and Andraxia if left unchecked.

name: Love Is Dangerous
short_description: Love Is Dangerous is an action-adventure game featuring simple but flawless platform gameplay, amazing pixel art using modern techniques, engaging and powerful story, charismatic and funny characters, comic-book-style cinematics and lots of love.
