short_description: A Sci-fi FPS set on the mysterious planet ADACA. - Use your GRAVITY-MANIPULATING arm to HURL objects at your foes or even RIP weapons directly from their hands! - EXPLORE and manipulate the environment in this EERIE and HOSTILE world!

name: Hidden Caves
short_description: Find the caves elements that are hidden on the map.

name: Hidden Lands
short_description: Find the land elements and animals that are hidden on the map.

name: Tranquil Cove
short_description: Your mother recently passed away, and her mysterious childhood home in a small town called Tranquil Cove was passed down to you. In an attempt to learn about your mothers mysterious past, you go to investigate. Nothing could prepare you for what you find there...

name: Cat Fish Island
short_description: A relaxing adventure of island fishing. Collect wood and fish to build and bait the most amazing fishing rod the world has ever seen. Start your adventure to catch the mythical fish of legend thought to be only an old tale by the island's inhabitants.

name: Hard Hero
short_description: Heroes are doing many things to save the world. Fight with enemy, dirve vehicles and combine to robot. Player control the vehicles and combine each other during avoid enemy's attack. Player can feel how hard to saving world. Challenge to being hero.

name: Gimle: The Broken Prophecy
short_description: Enter the dark world of Norse mythology in a new role-playing game. Play as Brand, a brave warrior on whose shoulders rests the future of the New World. Use his supernatural abilities and make difficult choices that affect the fate of the mythical land.

name: Chezzle
short_description: An endless, thought provoking, meditative Chess puzzler with a twist. Clear the board by chaining together moves.

name: Miasma 2: Freedom Uprising
short_description: Turn-based planning and realtime battles, with a choice-driven story, all set in a dystopian future

name: PuckOFF
short_description: PuckOFF is a seriously unforgiving story-based hockey goon simulator only missing rules. You can do whatever it takes to win a game with different ways to do so; you can either outscore or outlast your opponents. Expect lots of cheap shots and opponents who won't hesitate to put you down.

name: Path of Ra
short_description: Accompany the spirit of a Pharaoh reincarnated as a hieroglyph on his final journey. Help him understand the circumstances of his death and overcome the obstacles of his tomb. Will you uncover the identity of his murderer?

name: Force Reboot
short_description: Force Reboot is a fast-paced FPS with rogue-lite elements. Force Reboot is entirely focused on nonstop gameplay. You need to get past all of the rooms as fast as you can.

name: HumanitZ
short_description: HumanitZ is a co-op, isometric, open world survival game in a world ended by the zombie outbreak. As one of the few human survivors, try to last as long as “humanly” possible. The past can’t be changed, but you can make a difference today for the future of humanity.

name: Pirates Bay
short_description: Pirates Bay is a low poly multiplayer open-world pirate adventure filled with numerous mysteries and discoveries. Become a pirate and go on a journey to search the treasures. Cross endless waters and fight with mystical creatures. All of that and even more awaits you in the world of Pirates Bay!

name: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
short_description: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

name: Robo Vacuum Simulator
short_description: Play as a cleaning robot, as you vacuum a variety of unique environments. Whilst listening to a relaxing soundtrack, in this fun and casual simulator.

name: Line Strike
short_description: In Line Strike game, you get the role of the commander of a small army. All you need to do is select the type of troops and install it on the battlefield. The game does not require a quick reaction and microcontrol, only knowledge of the stats of your units and tactical ingenuity.

name: Cards Matching Memory Game
short_description: Welcome to the Card Matching Memory Game, a classic and engaging game that will put your memory skills to the test. Get ready to exercise your brain and challenge yourself as you flip cards and try to find matching pairs.

name: Apocalich
short_description: Apocalich is an RPG where you race against time to defeat the Lich King, alone or couch co-op with friends!

name: Druid: Test of faith
short_description: Make a move on a fascinating journey through the fantasy world, where interesting encounters and amazing stories await you. This wonderful world is waiting for its hero. Will you have the strength to save him? Or will it all come to an end? It all depends on you!

name: Don't run out of Soda
short_description: Can you escape a humble cook? If you don't, you will become his meal. You have five tries.

name: Mazey Village
short_description: Mazey Village is a cozy town-restoring adventure where a tornado scatters homes, villagers, and their precious belongings. Find what was lost in the whirl as you solve mazes, rebuild houses, and fill the village with warmth and life again.

name: Join Rush Attack / 加入突袭
short_description: Run the crowd until you reach the castle at the end of the level. Crush your rivals in the final battle and capture the fortress!

name: Chibi Dash
short_description: Chibi Dash is a fully procedural endless Running adventure. Explore unique Magnificent world using characters from different time periods.

name: Splodge Royale
short_description: Use Gyro Aim to Paint and Power Slide your way around while defeating Monsters, building platforms and avoiding the deadly Squog (Square Fog). Single Player and up to 4 Local Players for Co-op and Versus. From the maker of Zombie Death Quota.

name: Manhattan
short_description: Manhattan is a hybrid music editor and coding language combining MIDI sequencing with powerful procedural generation features. Designed for both newcomers and experts, and running as a plugin or standalone, Manhattan makes both music and coding more accessible and expressive than ever before.

name: Professor of Magical Studies
short_description: Professor of Magical Studies is an interactive magical school novel by Stephen Granade, where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

name: Heroes of Book & Paper
short_description: HB&P is an old-school RPG inspired by gamebooks and conversational adventures. Your decisions will determine the ending of each adventure you take. Every story has different and random components, what it means that the stories will vary every time you play.

name: LONELY, LUSTFUL, ARROGANT, HATEFUL
short_description: Solve puzzles and conquer challenges in a brutal and unforgiving dystopic gameshow. Meet new friends along the way, get to know them and discover their motives. Can you keep everyone alive until the end? Are you after glory, love or vengeance?

name: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition
short_description: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition was created to be the perfect bitesized roguelike dungeon crawler. Choose your champion and face a relentless crawl through the card-based dungeons, collect items to power your abilities and defeat the gruesome monsters facing you. But keep going FORWARD!

name: qingping Bookstore
short_description: It contains Xiaole elements to complete the elimination requirements

name: The City Must Grow
short_description: A new city will be established on a flat plain and its administration has been given to you. In order to keep the administration in your hands, the city needs to develop continuously.

name: ClayTown Horror Part One
short_description: Come, friend, and explore the decaying ruins of this once beautiful home. Overcome relentless monsters, tricky puzzles, and your own mind as you struggle to find a way to escape the estate. Or, perhaps you could look deeper into the horror around you and see if you can untangle its grisly mystery.

name: ItemShop
short_description: 【ItemShop】 is the application that you can attach cute items to your VRM, a common format for 3D avatars. ItemShop includes more than 75 kawaii items such as ribbons, catnips, tails, glasses and more! Decorate your VRM avatars with ItemShop!

name: 毛蟹穴
short_description: 毛蟹穴是僑光科技大學2021年畢業生的畢業專題，遊戲是改編自清朝嘉慶年間臺中沙鹿地區活人陪葬真實事件，結合臺灣傳統技藝皮影戲作為美術風格，遊戲為2D橫向捲軸解謎遊戲，中間加入煎藥及抓雞的小遊戲。遊戲共分為五個章節，作為學生專題，我們把第一章的故事完整開發完成，遊戲時間約為40分鐘。

name: UNDEMON
short_description: Go on a mysterious adventure as a ghost. Various stages that stimulate a sense of challenge are waiting for the ghost Luna. If you want to feel the genre of 2D platformer in the 90s, try it!

name: Weird Cinema
short_description: If you were put in a horror movie, would you survive? Play multiple roles in various classic horror films. Try to survive in horror films by decrypting and fighting

name: Destroying The Asteroids (Along With Unfair Hurdles)
short_description: I have Created this Game For those who likes to go through the Challenges in the Games. Just Destroy the 2 Asteroids in this Game and that's it. But it is not easy. Unfair Hurdles will not allow to do it easily.

name: The Operator
short_description: Welcome to the FDI. As our newest Operator, your role is to use your detective skills to assist our field agents and investigate mysterious crimes. Use cutting-edge FDI software to dig for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth.

name: Nyaaaanvy
short_description: Physics sumo-wrestling game! A heated battle for dignity among mysterious cat-like creatures. Nyanvy who wins the battle can be a true cat!! Could it be...?

name: Souls of White Star
short_description: Souls of White Star is a sci-fi turn-based card wargame Roguelike strategy game. The different design of [double-sided technology moving cards] and [bandwidth draw cost] will test your judgment and decision more!

name: Mirages
short_description: Mirages is a 3D narrative and horror game with folk stories. One night, seven brides headed to the Captain Mansion but strayed into a place full of ghosts - Regret City. Horror haunts the small town. Due to destiny, actors, warlords, and offspring of the town are drawn in. They are closer to truth.

name: Unveiled
short_description: Unveiled is a visual novel game with a unique twist of having a turn based strategy added in it. The story is taken from the super popular Isekai genre from Japan, about a boy who died and reincarnated in a fantasy world.

name: Nonlinear System Tools
short_description: Writing branching stories made easy! NST is a full suite of tools for creating, analyzing and rendering branching and nonlinear texts and media.

name: Eat Colors
short_description: Face extreme challenges in a precision platformer where every move is a daring jump! Use your skill to fling yourself and stick to surfaces, navigating adrenaline-filled scenes and unpredictable obstacles.

name: Frontline: New Revolution
short_description: Humanity's last chance. Enlist in the Legion and fight for freedom against a tyrant in a galaxy far, far away in this fierce, frantic, treacherous and fast-paced third-person shooter.

name: WordKiller
short_description: This is a simple, funny and fascinating game for learning ENGLISH words or CHINESE words while you are playing.

name: Flappy Octane
short_description: Flappy Octane is an endless level, speed increasing game. You pick a car, and jump through rings. The rings are generated at random heights and the speed of the game increases. ​How far can you get? Can you get #1 on the leaderboards?

name: Karapath
short_description: Karapath is a tactical move-to-move-decision-heavy randomized puzzle-thinking rpg-themed game with gambling-based combat.

name: Grey Heritage: Faded Vision
short_description: Command a rebellion as Leon Beaumont, Exiled Prince of Astrea, against the king that betrayed him. Engage in a classic turn-based tactical RPG experience as you unravel untold secrets from the past. Recruit allies, manage inventory, and train your soldiers in this JRPG inspired journey!

name: The House
short_description: Find the 5 keys and survive to escape the house.

name: 重装燎原
short_description: 没有无聊的教学关卡？直接开干 爽！爆射敌人的快感？爽！双摇杆射击？爽！大量技能卡牌堆叠升级？爽！强大的增援轰炸让你越战越强统统都有！随机生成任务给你，驾驶机甲大炮战车横扫千军！每一次随机的BOSS战斗都是男人的挑战！

name: Animals Fight
short_description: Animals Fight is an entertaining fighting game. In this game you will find beautiful battles and duels in which you can fight with animals. Engage in intense melee combat in Animals Fight and become the king of the martial arts!

name: Blood Red Fists
short_description: Explore a vast and crime ridden city, fight your enemies in first person mode, talk to random strangers, steal and sell various items, gamble with your money, gain experience and spend it on helpful skills. But above all, try to stay alive in this 2d retro beat 'em up.

name: Dungeon Color
short_description: Dungeon Color is a top-down puzzle game, where you switch between flames in order to achieve the rainbow flame in each room. Interact with special obstacles and melt your brain to find the exit. Cute, colorful, hard, fun.

name: Toy Tactics
short_description: Become a master strategist in this physics-based Real-Time Tactics game! Command minifig-inspired armies and customize strategies with hand-drawn formations. Conquer unique campaigns for all five armies and unleash massive battles in both single-player and multiplayer modes. Victory awaits!

name: Bad Guy: Neighborhood
short_description: A bad guy roams a violent neighborhood full of chaos and secrets

name: Stop the Bus!
short_description: Bus simulation record breaking 3D game.

name: Aeroplane Blaster
short_description: Aeroplane blaster - Become a test pilot and test the latest fighter jet to defend your country from attack! Fight hostile aliens in different dimensions to rid the world of the alien threat!

name: Village of Zombies
short_description: In Village of Zombies you can fight against zombies and mutants together with other players or alone on different maps, the goal is to survive as many levels as possible. The game always starts at level 1 and with each level increase, more zombies and stronger zombies come.

name: Zombie Hunter
short_description: This is an action game where you fight zombies and move forward. If you kill zombies, you will get coins. If you collect coins, you will get a bonus item. There are five scenarios prepared. There are also missions that are very difficult.

name: 知更鸟-The Robin
short_description: “The Robin”tells the story of a school bully who kills a girl named "Robin." Thirteen people involved are kidnapped and embark on a desperate journey to survive. The work revolves around who is behind the black hand and who is responsible for the death of "Robin" these two questions unfold.

name: Help Me
short_description: A horrific choices matter adventure game where you need to get out of the house!

name: June
short_description: June is an adventure game set in a dystopian future. Jump and climb your way through atmospheric sci fi levels, sneak past enemies, avoid deadly traps and solve complex logic puzzles as you make your way through an abandoned city.

name: Airborne Motocross
short_description: Fly with your bike. Race others. Explore. ― “Once you’ve got the hang glider mounted on your dirt bike, you’ll spend a lot of time in the air. Especially if you combine it with a nitro booster.”

name: Tails and Pines
short_description: Two friends, whose paths once diverged, meet again after many years. However, both have changed and now inhabit different worlds. Can they overcome the old grudges in their hearts and become something more than just friends?

name: Mushy
short_description: Mushy is a round based first person shooter. The attackers plant a bomb and the defenders defuse it; all while engaging in armed combat!

name: Rusted Moss
short_description: Rusted Moss is a twin-stick shooter metroidvania where you sling around the map with your grapple, blasting your way through witches and rusted machine monstrosities alike. This wasteland once harboring mankind has since fallen, and Fae long forgotten now knock on humanity's door...

name: Dragon War
short_description: A real-time combat game played by the flying dragon in the third person. At this stage, the game mode is mainly chaos. The main themes of the game are flying dragon and magic.

name: Dead District: Survival
short_description: Dead District is a multiplayer and single-player survival sandbox game in an open world where the player has a wide range of options.

name: Para Bellum - Hold the Line
short_description: Para Bellum - Hold the Line is a 3D real time small unit tactics game. Your task is to hold off enemy attacks wave after wave using a variety of different Units and Supports in your arsenal to the best of your abilities in Campaign and Skirmish modes.

name: Trauma - Visual Novel
short_description: Welcome to Trauma, a free-to-play short visual novel full of mysteries. Will you ever be able to smile again?

name: Outbreak: Contagious Memories
short_description: You’re trapped in a city ravaged by the undead - can you make it out alive? Join Lydia in her desperate struggle to escape, either alone or with a friend in co-op, in this chilling love letter to classic 90s survival horror.

name: Shoot Trip Die
short_description: Shoot Trip Die is a psychedelic, arcade, rogue-like romp! Finger blast your way through dozens of levels mowing down strange monsters and collecting even weirder items, all to get back to your pissed stained mattress! It's got Kick! It's got Bite! And It'll Mess. You. Up! You got what it takes?...

name: Second to Nun
short_description: Second to Nun is a top-down budget-friendly pixel-art retro top-down fighting classic game. Beat your way to the top and become the top nun through the gruelling challenges on the Island of Trials and Tribulations!

name: Grow The Hell Up
short_description: Grow The Hell Up is an absurd experimental adventure VR game. Solve unique physics puzzles, decipher codes, collect hidden items, and do totally normal, totally non-weird things like an adult should do.

name: Fey: Distant Daydream
short_description: Your job: An old mansion, a mysterious letter, a box of old memorabilia. Explore the present and past to uncover the secrets of the extraordinary family that lived here. Remember a time long gone as you set foot in this late 1990s-inspired mystery with intricate puzzles and eccentric characters.

name: The Matriarch
short_description: Play Hide & Seek in a diabolical convent where everyone is an imposter.

name: NMNE
short_description: You find yourself inside your dream, which turns into one continuous nightmare.

name: Train Mechanic Simulator 2025
short_description: Take on the role of a qualified Train Mechanic. Repair broken steam locomotives using your fully stacked workshop. Find out how complex and difficult this job really is. Become one of the few that know how to repair an old train.

name: Coin Treasures
short_description: Coin Treasures is a Coin Pusher/Coin Dozer on Steroids including incremental progress, realistic physics, numerous upgrades & unlocks and stunning graphics.

name: DESKTOP MONKEY
short_description: A challenging game where you fight for the best places on Steam Leaderboards. A funny little Monkey living on your screen will prepare you for everything.

name: Don't Get Distracted
short_description: Don't Get Distracted is a horror themed rage game. Just press and hold the buttons that pop up on the monitors, easy enough right?

name: The Northern Gate : Special agent
short_description: Save the world from the monsters invading! With your flying board, keep moving, get weapons, and kill the monsters! Don't forget to make strategies before every combat because it won't be an easy fight!

name: tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly
short_description: tERRORbane is a comedic adventure where bugs are your FRIENDS! Enjoy exploring a crazy and outlandish world, full of unique, quirky characters and homages to the history of videogaming, challenge the Developer with your creativity and be the Bane of Errors!

name: Skeeter's Grid
short_description: You play Skeet, master defragmenter, in this sit-and-chill isometric puzzler. Spin, move, and swap pieces as you restore sectors, each of increasing complexity and variation. Collect cores along the way to improve your functionality, and meet the AIs, who may or may not be benevolent.

name: Assassin at Crimson Keep
short_description: Assassin at Crimson Keep is a short, point and click visual novel set in a dark, quasi-fantasy world. After a botched assassination attempt, you pursue the King into his lair known as the Crimson Keep. Your small choices can have great consequences, either for good or for evil.

name: Ooze Redux
short_description: A NES hard game, made to run and play on original hardware. Ported to the PC. 7 hard and unique levels. An original gripping ChipTune sound track! 8 bit glory in this side scrolling shooter platformer!

name: Astral Space
short_description: Have you ever controlled a game without using a keyboard or a mouse? Yes, This is possible. We have developed a Artificial Intelligence-based game that gives you the ability to control the ball's movement and directions via hand movements, the challenge is to gain as many points as possible.

name: Baldwin's Bear
short_description: It's the magic of a carnival through the eyes of a child! From a fishing pool to a bouncy castle to a ghost train, each minigame is unique from the last, and holds its own little tricks and secrets. Collect tickets as Baldwin to afford the teddy bear, or race a friend for it in versus mode!

name: Tiranogg
short_description: Help a badass female mercenary and her frail male priest reclaim her throne as the rightful heir of Sangreal!

name: The Tree
short_description: The Tree is a minimalist building and puzzle game in which you recover a forest after natural disaster on floating islands high in the sky.

name: Laboratory
short_description: The game is all about the challenge. It has no in-between levels, only boss fights. Each boss is unique and will challenge your instincts and reflexes. Every boss you defeat will grant you a valuable upgrade.

name: Cloudburst
short_description: Enter a world of chaos where survival is just a beginning. Take the role of a Scavenger or a Void-Walker to battle machine swarms, hostile players, and a dynamic environment. Build, scavenge, and fight for dominance in this fusion of Survival and Battle-royale. Choose your fate - survive or perish.

name: Kill Spree®
short_description: First-person mayhem in grand stadiums.

name: Hack and Slime
short_description: What could be scarier than a massive dungeon-tower infested with skulls, ogres, and dragons? That those same monsters ride the largest multinational in the world with it. You know; business is business.

name: Cardseer
short_description: Cardseer is a deckbuilding game combining roguelike elements with a sprawling campaign. Choose your hero and fight your way across diverse maps filled with fearsome enemies, all while crafting your deck and collecting powerful artifacts. Can you rise to the challenge?

name: Hermit: an Underwater Tale
short_description: Underwater, a new threat slowly emerges. Playing as a helpless hermit crab, use your shells to defeat countless waves of monsters and giant sea creatures in this action packed 2d game.

name: Megacraft Hentai And Zombies
short_description: Megacraft Hentai And Zombies is a small Survival Shooter in an open world where your main goal is to survive. Collect useful resources, find a safe shelter and fight off whole hordes of hungry zombies!

name: Vacation Adventures: Cruise Director 4
short_description: An Exotic World cruise aboard USS Liberty of the Waves As Cruise Director in charge, enjoy a truly sensational Cruise of a Lifetime aboard the fleet’s super luxurious flagship, USS Liberty of the Waves.

name: 100 hidden dogs
short_description: Hidden object game in the alien setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. A large location and cute dogs.

name: Power Pushout
short_description: Power Pushout is an epic turn-based asian-style strategy game with martial arts elements. Choose your warrior and master figures and fight with them in a wild battle to rule over the game board. Either you throw your opponent off the board or you conquer the opposing towers to win the game.

name: Mystical Islands
short_description: A massively multiplayer RPG in a truly massive world. Supports thousands of players in the world where is thousands of kilometers square. Create your character, join a guild or create your own and go on adventures to earn more gold and experience. Build your own home, farm or castle.

name: Gematombe
short_description: Gematombe is an action-puzzle-vs-game where you can play one-on-one matches against your friends or the computer.

name: Impious Pumpkins
short_description: Impious Pumpkins is a cute/spooky real time tactics game where you take control of your own ghostly army to defend their resting places from hordes of evil pumpkins!

name: Christmas Tree Clicker
short_description: Get Christmas Tree companion for your Desktop! Earn quintillion Gifts, open thousands of this and find all the Toys to decorate your Dream Christmas Tree in the new gambling Clicker!

name: Pet idle
short_description: Pet Idle is a simulation game where you can take care of various virtual animals! Build and manage your home to be a cozy home for many pets!

name: Escape Halloween Forest
short_description: A whimsical First Person Adventure Platformer with retro gameplay and aesthetics. 1-3 hours of comical spooky fun!

name: QontoWars
short_description: A simple multiplayer FPS game with a sci-fi/space-like atmosphere, offering multiple gamemodes, weapons, skins and gaming styles.

name: Frog Ball Rerolled
short_description: Collect pineapples as you roll your way to victory in Frog Ball Rerolled! Frog Ball Rerolled is a deluxe version of Frog Ball, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. With over 35 full levels and over 1,400+ customization options, you'll never get bored!

name: Elysian Eclipse
short_description: Elysian Eclipse is a Sandbox Evolution Simulator, letting you evolve from an amoeba into a space traveling sentient being. Create your own creatures, buildings and vehicles to conquer procedural planets. Turn the galaxy into your personal playground!

name: Abeyance
short_description: Abeyance is a roguelite, sci-fi, dungeon-crawler. Salvage wrecked starships in a gritty, post-apocalyptic world. Fight mutants and mechanized defense systems. Battle your inner demons to save your soul… and reclaim your humanity.

name: Jubilee
short_description: Challenging precision platformer based on tight, fluid movement. Open map layout with multiple routes. Collect gems and save animals.

name: Thrive
short_description: An evolution simulation game. Take control of your species in the environment and edit your species as a whole. Compete with other evolving species for resources on an alien planet.

name: JAMM
short_description: JAMM is a map maker that makes it simple and easy to bring your vision to life quickly giving you more time to focus on the story. Make perspective and orthographic maps as well as 3d immersive images in minutes.

name: Pieces of Beauty 2
short_description: Deemed a Master of the Chinese Bird and Flower Painting Style, Ohara Koson produced hundreds of prints during his life. Discover 16 majestic pieces made by one of Japan's most celebrated artists while you sharpen your brain and relieve stress playing this Jigsaw Puzzle Game.

name: 天国病院-Heaven's Hospital-
short_description: This game is a horror game set in a hospital. Cute gods of death live in the hospital where they were hospitalized. From midnight to 6 am, the gods of death come to reap the lives of the patients. Survive by making full use of special abilities and various items.

name: Anime Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle 3D
short_description: Puzzle game in 3D Epic naughty puzzles full of charm! With colorful characters with careful design in a world of medieval fantasy that will not leave you unscathed ...

name: Humankind in a nutshell
short_description: "Humankind in a Nutshell" is a compelling 4X strategy game with slot mechanics. Starting in the Ancient era, players manage their tribe's needs, fend off barbarians, and advance through tech to build a thriving nation. Construct diverse facilities for strategic superiority and aim for victory.

name: Bugs From Space
short_description: A fast-paced VR arcade shooter, where you fire guns, shoot energy bows, and toss explosive spears to defend your base from an alien infestation. The bugs shoot back, so don't forget to duck!

name: Kalasta
short_description: Kalasta is a roguelite deckbuilder fish game with real time strategy mechanics. Play cards to spawn fish, feed them and defend your fish from waves of monsters!

name: My Name is Mayo 3
short_description: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!

name: AllBlocksWantToBeStacked
short_description: This is a simple game in which the objective is to artfully stack seven different types of blocks that fall according to gravity. During the game, a countdown is given, and each time the count reaches zero, a block will fall one by one. You can move the blocks to the left or right, or rotate them.

name: Bass Monkey
short_description: Bass Monkey is a free Hack and Slash arcade game. Up to 4 friends can compete (or co-operate!) in this short, low-stress, musical platformer. Collect bananas, smack away hamsters, and try to get on the high score leaderboards as you battle through a 5 song EP.

name: Galactic Federation
short_description: Classical 3D space combat simulation with unique 100% dynamic destruction engine, allows you to realistically damage and burn through your enemies exactly where you hit them with blasters, causing their onboard systems and armor to melt away and fall apart. Made by solo developer.

name: Donut Dodo
short_description: If a long lost arcade game from 1983 resurfaced today, it would be Donut Dodo - a classic 2D platformer from the golden era, tough as nails and challenging for the whole family! Ready to top the high score table?

name: Project Runner
short_description: Project Runner is a Survival Game where the protagonist is trapped in a maze with the main objective is to scape the maze.

name: Farm Renovator
short_description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

name: Cosmo Player Z
short_description: A Sci-Fi action game for a single player bringing you to fight rebellions, level up your character and choose new skills, dress up your character in the epic space wars.

name: Us Against Aliens
short_description: Us Against Aliens is a survival shooter game on a spaceship that flies towards Earth. On the ship, something is constantly happening and you need to solve these problems along the way by shooting back from aliens who are constantly hunting you

name: I am Your King
short_description: Be a King and rally your countrymen to fight on the field of battle. Build an army and survive as long as you can while defeating the invading enemies, kill points are multiplied by the size of your army at the time of the kill.

name: Find the heart
short_description: There are sixteen hearts hidden in sixteen worlds. They are so hidden that they can hardly be found. But if you collect all the energy balls of a world, you will get a hint when you pass. Even so, to find them, you still need to have extraordinary ideas and precise operations. Can you succeed?

name: Proto Shooter Lychee
short_description: This is an action shooting game where the girl defeats the monsters that come at her.

name: So long as there is Mercy
short_description: Lead Spe, the game‘s protagonist, through an eerie dollhouse in an effort to find her little brother. On her way, Spe will encounter the ghost-children, who are also trapped, and can use their different abilities to solve the environmental puzzles in order to escape the house.

name: SEARCH ALL - ANIMALS
short_description: Is a game in the genre of "hidden object", in which you need to find all the animals in a large location drawn in the style of "doodling". There is a medieval castle on the game location, and in front of the castle there is a watermill with a pond

name: Skeletal Skism
short_description: War has broken out between the undead... All for one sole purpose: to determine the ONE - TRUE - SKELETON - KING. Do you have what it takes to claim the crown?

name: Scufflers
short_description: Knock opponents as far off-screen as possible. A platform-fighter with extremely simple controls. Game is played in rounds, where everything resets when someone is knocked off the screen, until someone is the last character standing.

name: The House Before
short_description: A narrative adventure game where you play as a house filled with strange creatures.

name: Moka Future
short_description: ⟪末卡未来⟫是一款2d像素风格的俯视角类幸存者游戏。末卡大陆正在遭受魔物的入侵，你必须抵御魔物一波又一波的进攻……

name: MUNCHIES
short_description: Warning!!! This Game Is Early Access!!!! Survive alone or with others in this Post Apocalyptic, Horror, Survival, Looter/Shooter with Base Building And Raiding. Join the community to watch this game grow and Get Exclusive Rewards and Content. https://discord.gg/S6dwXe8p9X

name: Deadly Infestation
short_description: Collect resources, hunt, mine, build your base, weapons and objects to help you survive. Are you able to discover the real reason for your journey?

name: Pacifist Outside
short_description: Pacifist Outside is a classic cinematic platformer. An uncompromising experience, where failure is frequent and progress is hard-earned. Play as a brave tribal leader, grappling with strange trials and unknown forces, as he makes a spiritual journey through a dark cave.

name: Stardander Revenant
short_description: Griselda just wants to be friends with Dianthus... but Dianthus can't stand her! Love or hate, they have to work together to keep the forest safe from dangerous Fae. Will working together help bring them closer? And can Griselda somehow pass Blantree's class?

name: Geometry Waves
short_description: Shoot your way through waves of enemies and extreme bosses in this Roguelite space shooter. Advance in the ranks, upgrade your ship and unlock new mechanics, ships and mods that will make the game more challanging and interesting.

name: Dismal Reverie
short_description: A short FMV puzzle about a woman trying to escape from her reality. Or is it just a dream?

name: Play Outside Simulator
short_description: Play Outside is a game in which you can do your favorite activities ... on your PC! (without really going outside).

name: Goo Keeper
short_description: Lead Rolly in his adventure within the wonderful world of Shroomast, and explore its deep semi open-world underground. Goo Keeper is a pure metroidvania with tons of unique bosses, hand-crafted worlds and creatures, and tons of awesome abilities.

name: Salome's Kiss
short_description: A dark lesbian / yuri gothic romance tale set in Victorian England, in which an anxious governess is aggressively pursued by her unruly, tempestuous pupil.

name: Asterism: Apex of War
short_description: First and third person single player sci fi action shooter. Destroy the Neurobonded menace and prevent humanities extinction.

name: My Furry Detective 🐾
short_description: A mysterious crime that no one could solve now rests on your shoulders. Well, not just yours; you also have a partner from your department whom everyone makes fun of. But who knows—maybe she’s actually a great detective in disguise?

name: A Gift of War
short_description: A Gift of War is a role playing game about a young man going on a mission to assist his country's war effort against the bordering enemy. It features simultaneous turn-based combat akin to a roguelike, but its levels are carefully crafted by hand.

name: Elven Tales - Rise of Darkness
short_description: In this first part of "Elven Tales" you will be presented the story that will be the basis for future adventures.A main character full of internal conflicts and discriminated by his appearance, Elves in a quest and an ancient god hungry for souls.Join this different adventure!

name: Megacraft Hentai Apocalipsis
short_description: Megacraft Hentai Apocalipsis - This is a first person shooter set in a low poly open world. How long can you survive in the post-apocalypse?

name: Seeds of Calamity
short_description: Take part in healing after the Great Calamity. Tend your farm, complete quests for the villagers, and explore dungeons filled with challenge and treasure in this cozy, solo-developed farming sim. Build a new life in a recovering world with your fluffy Spellbook Companion.

name: The Phantom Keeper
short_description: The Phantom Keeper is a monster-collecting RPG adventure where you are a fallen Soul trapped in the land between the living and the dead. Take up the mantle of Keeper to train and care for ghostly creatures known as Phantoms!

name: Nonorelia
short_description: A nonogram puzzle game and sci-fi visual novel rolled into one. Solve puzzles to overcome obstacles as Noah Von Sterne struggles to save his colony and reunite his family, or unwind and sharpen your mind with our relaxing Picture, Random, and ASMR Modes.

name: Take As Needed
short_description: Assume a lead drug development role at Mazer- the foremost pharmaceutical company in the world! Create groundbreaking drugs for your customers, work hard to impress your bosses, and try not to ruffle too many feathers...

name: Racecar Bed
short_description: A Social Sim + Turn-Based RPG with a 3rd grade protagonist! 📆PLAN your days, 🧑‍🤝‍🧑BEFRIEND characters, 🧱COLLECT+CRAFT unique attacks, and ⚔️FIGHT in Turn-based combat with Action Commands!

name: Maze Mayhem
short_description: Welcome to the my game, Maze Mayhem! A small, simple game with loads of gameplay revolving around compact, maze-like levels filled with secrets, puzzles, and more action then you would think you could find in such a game. Try the demo and see what my mazes have hidden for you today!

name: Geranium:Tale of Dawn's Desire
short_description: The story follows the journey of Geranium, a female swordswoman with amnesia.

name: Keep This Land
short_description: Heavy metal, battle wizardry and blood of monsters from the deep. Will you keep this land from evil?

name: Crazy Empress
short_description: If you love first person puzzles and games, Crazy Empress is going to be one of the best games for you. The user-friendly intuitive interface and relaxing music will let you enjoy the puzzles. Collect all the puzzles and the Empress will thank you for it!

name: Challenge Dream Cat
short_description: Control the cute cat to move forward. Break through the Various traps and terrain to get a treat. This game is a 3D casual run game that anyone can enjoy.

name: Laptop Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to Laptop Tycoon!Compete with the tech giants! You will have the opportunity to show your skills in business management. Start your own laptop company! Choose and hire the best people for your company, buy and upgrade your own office and start building your dream laptop.

name: Find The Murderer
short_description: Someone committed murder in the village. The detective arrives at the crime scene. Help him find the murderer.

name: Let's Puzzle
short_description: "Let's Puzzle" transforms your memories into jigsaw challenges. Enjoy collaborative, real-time puzzling, personal music integration, and custom puzzles with varying levels of difficulty. Relax, play, create.

name: Hello World
short_description: Hello World 是一款以复制道具和推动NPC来与场景交互为核心的横版解谜游戏，背景设定在有中传校园和动画学院元素的幻想咖啡园中，你将扮演一位某天发现咖啡树枯萎的小机器人，于是带着NPC小伙伴们踏上了一路解谜拯救咖啡树的旅程。

name: Eletar Hero
short_description: Eletar Hero is a 2D platformer where you use the ability you have acquired from an ancient alien race to traverse through different maze-like levels, defeat many bosses and collect the other abilities the ancient Eletar left behind; all to stop a madman from taking over the world.

name: Cyber Runner 2048
short_description: Cyber ​​runner 2048 - at the factory for the production of cyborgs, a failure and hordes of hostile mechanisms filled the streets of your city. The government sent you to fight against huge forces, do not lose their confidence!

name: Mr. Rainer's Solve-It Service
short_description: When the last thread becomes entangled, their song will be heard.

name: Golf Solitaire Simple
short_description: A simple Golf Solitaire game with several common rule variations and a challenge mode! Can you beat all of the levels?

name: Christmas Slots - Casino Game
short_description: Step into a world of festive cheer and excitement with Christmas Slots, the ultimate casino game that combines the thrill of spinning reels with the joyous spirit of the holiday season. Get ready for a merry gambling experience filled with colorful symbols, jingle bells, and the chance to win big.

name: The Quiet Apocalypse
short_description: 'The Quiet Apocalypse' is a first-person story adventure set in a beautiful open world. Join your father on a dangerous trek through 400 km² of pristine wilderness, as you race to save the life of a very special child.

name: Gruta
short_description: A child runs away to fight the monster she thought was causing trouble in her family. What she found was not what she was expecting. Fight your way out and find the truth about this mysterious place. A narrative-driven platform game, told through hand-drawn cutscenes, completely without text.

name: Buggy Game
short_description: Retro rally racing with a simulation twist

name: Chastity Catastrophe
short_description: Chastity Catastrophe is a action platformer where instead of beating up enemies, you break your friends out of chastity equipment!

name: One by One
short_description: Phobias have awoken in this dark roguelike shooter One by One! Dive into procedural dungeons, unlock forbidden equipment, unleash the might of your soul and strike down bosses to save the world.. or is it late?

name: Skull Bullets
short_description: Skull Bullets is a roguelike game with RPG elements. You are a risen from the dead shooter who is trying to get out of the endless forest with the undead. Upgrade your skills, get new weapons and deal with a whole crowd of enemies. Will you be able to get out? It all depends on you.

name: The Vellescian Gambit
short_description: Play the role of a merchant's apprentice in this 1600s-inspired realistic setting full with trading companies and business ploys. A short (2-3h) but replayable visual novel/RPG with logistics and trading aspects, brought to life with beautiful baroque paintings and classical music.

name: Cyber Sweep
short_description: Mines are randomly distributed. Find where they are by removing blocks. Beacons will guide you by showing how many adjacent Mines there are, if any. You win when all Mines have either been surrounded or have been removed. Be careful not hit a Mine!

name: OVERLOOK
short_description: Search for missing people, lost objects, or even help people solve their problems by handing them over their required items. OVERLOOK is hand-drawn, cozy, relaxing, and funny. btw, watch! there might be a cat hidden in bushes.

name: Rakuten
short_description: Rakuten is a physics based space shooter where you pilot your own rocketship, shoot down enemy spacecraft, and unlock upgrades to further increase your capabilities and available weaponry.

name: Soulless Legions
short_description: Breaking the limits of strategy games by hosting thousands of ability combinations. Soulless Legions is a Free-to-Play Online PVP 'Tug O' War' Combination Strategy game that allows players a lifetime of customization and strategic inquiry.

name: Kobold Garden
short_description: Befriend and raise small lizard-like creatures called kobolds in Kobold Garden! Make new friends, solve puzzles, and more all with your kobold companions by your side.

name: 流放之域
short_description: A small strategy game . Players need to rely on reasonable strategies to survive in this mysterious field.

name: Dreadful Wake
short_description: Dreadful Wake is an intense cooperative first-person shooter. Diverse level design governed by procedural generation. Punishing roguelike-style gameplay, trapped within ever-changing mazes.

name: The Tale of Fighting Nymphs
short_description: The fighting game looks like anime style.

name: Nott Longa
short_description: A folk horror graphic adventure about nostalgia, lost futures & decay, designed as an interactive nighttime story to enhance your dreams. Collect hidden objects, help strange inhabitants, solve arcane riddles: find your way home through a ruinous reality haunted by glitches and folkloric creatures.

name: 그랑 엠파이어 : 아마네
short_description: My love in this world, let us defeat the devil! The story of an incompetent warrior's adventure.

name: Adult Puzzles - CamGirls
short_description: Challenging jigsaw and sliding puzzles with various levels of difficulty, featuring sexy webcam girls.

name: Loch Ness
short_description: Loch Ness is a 1-4 Player Co-Op Horror Hunter. You and your team must navigate precarious waters, use your equipment to hunt for Nessie’s feeding ground and lay bait to lure her out. But be careful, for lurking deep beneath the lake is a creature more ancient than all mankind…

name: Cthulhu Dungeon
short_description: 《不可名状的地牢》是一款以克苏鲁的呼唤跑团为背景的 战棋+DBG+Roguelike游戏，通过战棋与DBG结合，造成与众不同的全新体验。并且结合了跑团的元素。你将带领你的角色卡，突破这个迷一般的地牢。本游戏提供非常开放的自定义Mod支持，可以自己制作自定义 角色，敌人，卡牌和地图等。

name: Queue Simulator
short_description: Queue simulator brings you your favorite part of MMORPG experience - waiting in Queue!

name: Knockball pool
short_description: Play against yourself or the computer in this physics-based billiards hit!

name: Inquisitor’s Heart and Soul
short_description: Summon demonic invasions, punish heretical enclaves, punish traitors and renegades. Do not deny yourself anything - after all, you are the hand and anger of the highest good. Give the apostates darkness, so that they learn to appreciate the light!

name: Drafting Towers
short_description: A dynamic tower defense/deck-building game with roguelite mechanics! Build towers, protect your pyramids, and create your own strategy. Drafting towers is an addictive real time strategy game.

name: Sumy Shelltris - ICEBLOCKS 1
short_description: Tetris? Not! Mutant Tetris!

name: Fallen Flowers
short_description: Strange atmosphere, strange things, but the performance is so "familiar". How "strange" does the familiar room and familiar her look? Why does everything start? Where will it go?

name: Pine Hearts
short_description: Pine Hearts is a cosy little narrative-adventure game set in the sleepy scenery of Pine Hearts Caravan Park. Explore the great outdoors as you uncover items, unlock new paths, and discover all the little secrets stuffed throughout the Park.

name: Fishing Paradiso
short_description: Embark on a relaxing tropical adventure in this cozy fishing RPG! Explore wondrous locations and befriend a charming cast of characters on your quest to become a master angler and discover the true meaning of paradise!

name: Super Kakuro - Cross Sums
short_description: Learn and play the popular Japanese game of Kakuro (Cross Sums). Play a variety of different board sizes and use in-game assistance to solve the toughest puzzles.

name: Robin Hood: Spring of Life
short_description: As you overcome obstacles, gather resources and rebuild ravaged villages, you'll turn the pages of a fun and adventurous story packed with twists, turns and laughter!

name: Amnesiac Adventurer
short_description: Our brave adventurer is almost at the end of his heroic journey, but realizes that his memories have been jumbled! Now filled with questions and doubts, he must recall what happened in the past, and remember why he was here in the first place!

name: BlockStar VR
short_description: BlockStar VR is a VR shooter where you put your reflexes to the test by shooting blocks and completing challenges in an action-packed futuristic tournament. Play the 40-mission story mode and show that you have what it takes to flex on the leaderboard!

name: Sing Together: VR Karaoke
short_description: Sing Together is a VR karaoke that aims to be the Earth's Biggest Karaoke.Sing your favorite songs, from the latest hits to old favorites, with people from all over the world in a variety of spaces

name: Electrician Simulator - First Shock
short_description: Learn the ropes from your Dad to become an electrician. Repair and assemble sockets, panels, strips, plugs, chandeliers and even change light bulbs. Oh... and don't mix up the wires! Results might be shocking.

name: The Flow Experience
short_description: The Flow Experience is a classic 2D action game about evading and blocking enemy attacks through rythmic interactions on your path to personal growth. Move, dash, and guard to protect yourself and find your true potential on this zen-like twist on traditional arcade bullet hells.

name: IMMORTAL: And the Death that Follows
short_description: A Kungfu-Noir prison drama based on Buddhist myth. Plan the perfect escape, create your own unique fighting style, join an Asura gang, and defeat The Death that Follows herself in this rogue-like character-action game.

name: Happy Summer Quest
short_description: Happy Summer Quest - Vacation is a great time for adventure! Therefore, you decide to go on a journey to find precious stones in distant lands, despite the unpredictable dangers that may meet you on your way.

name: /tilt/
short_description: Tilt is an action-racing game with expressive three-button controls and shortcut incentivizing topdown maps. Upgrade your modules and expand your moveset. Escape time-traveling explosions through different solar systems.

name: Promenade
short_description: Go on an adventure in a world packed with secrets helped by your friend, a poulp with many abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, wander across dungeons, blast through races and much more in this cute game inspired by the best 3D platformers

name: Déjà-vu VR
short_description: In the city of “Evia” several residents are infected with light. A girl discovers what appears to be the host. It befriends it, feeds it and houses it. Not to the delight of the other residents. They want to drive the landlord away. A persecution begins ...

name: MyJapaneseTeacher
short_description: Visual erotic novel with real Japanese learning. A real native voice, lots of useful materials and a sexy Japanese teacher who wants to motivate you to learn in any way she can.

name: In Shape
short_description: In this minimalistic arcade game, you have to move along a winding plane and switch the shape of your figure to match the passing figures.

name: Fireboy & Watergirl: Fairy Tales
short_description: Fireboy & Watergirl are back! This time with fairies to help you!

name: Jumphobia: Homeward Bound
short_description: Jump, skip, hop and leap! Go as far as your little wheel can take you! Play as a little delivery bot from a far-flung future controlled by the monolithic "MARE" corporation, and find your way back home through the perilous deserts, dead forests, and untold wild lands that lie ahead.

name: NotiVR
short_description: NotiVR allows you to wirelessly sync your Android phone's notifications to your SteamVR compatible headset. Please check system requirements before purchasing

name: Run Willy!
short_description: Slide on your belly, jump, run, avoid enemies and fly with the help of cannons to complete all the levels and bring Willy home There is no checkpoints, unless you give away your "Cool rocks."which you will collect by passing through the most dangerous paths.

name: NoRoY
short_description: A dark adventure full of tense moments that will test your skills. Your main goal is to climb to the top while avoiding difficult obstacles and disturbing creatures. NoRoY is very agile, but a single mistake can cause you to lose all your progress. Inspired by games like: Celeste + Getting Over it

name: Metal Hunter
short_description: Top-down 3D shoot 'em up game in which you play as a robot that fights for survival against other robots. Your only goal is to kill all your enemies until you are the last one standing.

name: Bounce Castle
short_description: Control powerful heroes in a magical fantasy world to defeat monsters that threaten the kingdom. This turn-based physics/strategy game will have you bouncing and booping enemies using a mixture of precision and chaos to save the realm from all kinds of hand-drawn baddies.

name: Anivenge
short_description: An arcade style game where you play as an animal hopping around a road trying to crash cars. Work your way through different levels or play in survival mode - how many can you crash before you're run over?

name: Valley Knights
short_description: Recruit a company of heroes to save a world in ruins after a devastating cataclysm. Valley Knights is a turn-based, tactical, roguelike, RPG set in a dark-horror fantasy world out of the 1980s, where every decision matters, and no one lives forever...

name: Spermicide
short_description: Play as a microscopic spermicide craft with only one goal. Don't let the sperm reach the egg by any means necessary! Don't like preventing pregnancy? Cause it! With Be The Sperm!

name: Hentai Detective
short_description: Enigmatic psycho challenges famous detective. Help detective solve riddles and overcome challenges on his way to save the local town from bombing by stopping a mysterious madman.

name: Unstrong: Space Calamity
short_description: Sure, the world exploded and you're just drifting through space now, but you WILL find a way to make your planet whole again. Nothing can stop mad scientist ladies like Glasses! Soar through space and explore planets, moons and asteroids in this action-packed 3d platformer.

name: 502's Arcade
short_description: 502's Arcade is a collection of fast paced arcade games. Ghost hunting in a procedural dungeon crawler, fast reflex puzzle solving in a potion shop, blasting through alien enemies and more! Get good old arcade fun featuring modern mechanics and challenge your way to the top of the leaderboards.

name: Vheda
short_description: Dive into the story of Vheda, a 2D hack 'n' slash where Vheda, born from the Light, must restore peace in Cilizam with the help of Smor, her loyal companion. Face dark enemies and uncover secrets on an epic journey.

name: Fly Dangerous
short_description: Extremely high skill-ceiling 6dof flight racing in a variety of environments with leaderboards, multiplayer and VR support

name: Shadow Life
short_description: Explore temples and caves. Slay monsters and avoid traps and hazards. Uncover hidden rooms. Destroy the Book of Dark Magic to defeat the evil spirit that inhabits this world.

name: Rorys Restaurant Deluxe
short_description: Rory just graduated from culinary school but she's too broke to pay for her school debt! Help her open a small restaurant and earn money to pay her debts! Play Rory's Restaurant: A unique Match3 and Cooking game! Enjoy familiar Match3 game mechanics in 70 challenging levels!

name: 里帰り | Satogaeri
short_description: "里帰り | Satogaeri" is a J-horror walking simulator game set in rural Japan in the late summer of the 2000s.

name: Legends of Pindorama
short_description: In the west of the Holy Lands lies an ancient and unheard place, sailors and soldiers will to explore that intriguing land, with tribes and also scary and heinous animals. The earth of Vera Cruz hides secrets and wealths

name: Hardwork Simulator
short_description: A game about fooling others! (6th place Innovation Category Ludum Dare #49 Compo)

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
short_description: The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is the back story to the previous game, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge for the full series. You return as Youngho, the hero from The Coma 1, as you once again venture forth into the terrifying mirror dimension…

name: Nakornsampan
short_description: A match-3 city building strategy game with building interaction, resource management, and more!

name: Sigil of the Magi
short_description: Sigil of the Magi blends roguelike deckbuilding with turn-based combat for a deep tactical experience. Navigate a world full of dangers and mystique as you craft your deck, obtain relics, and prepare your party of champions for any challenges ahead!

name: Mini Island: Winter
short_description: Mini Island: Winter is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

name: The Mighty Quest
short_description: When evil is growing, it’s time to stand your ground and do your Mighty Quest. Fight your way through the hordes of enemies and tricky bosses in the 2D RPG with the elements of platformer

name: Serendipity Hotel
short_description: The detective is invited to the Serendipity Hotel. What will the detective experience in the hotel? Become a detective and participate in the Serendipity Hotel event

name: Universal Enemies
short_description: Join Riana and her team to stop a conspiracy of monsters that have gone berserk. A depth-scrolling action shooter with lots of characters and monsters!

name: Bloxi: The Word Game
short_description: Create words with the letters in the falling shapes! Flex your vocabulary, learn new words, and tactically use powerups as you avoid the blocks from stacking to the top! See if you can clear all the letters, how long you can last, or how high you can get your score.

name: Blue Max: Aces of the Great War
short_description: Fly high in 8 historic fighter planes such as Albatross DIII, Fokker DVII, and more! Shoot down enemy planes or fly skillfully over enemy territory for surveillance as you engage in captivating gameplay featuring multiple mission options and several historical locations.

name: Das Boot: German U-Boat Simulation
short_description: Will you be victorious? Only if you can withstand the pressure. Strategize to defeat Allied forces in sea, surface and air - all rendered in full 3D. Multiple missions available - taking you from the Strait of Gibraltar to the coastlines of Norway.

name: ZERO Sievert
short_description: ZERO Sievert is a tense top-down extraction shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...

name: 1/2 Red Riding Hood
short_description: There is this girl known as the Red Riding Hood. She has the strength of ten men. This is a completely different story about the familiar fairy-tale character Red Riding Hood. A much darker and twisted version.

name: OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK
short_description: 2D action-adventure game set in the rich world of the epic dark fantasy, Overlord. This latest installment in the series features an original story overseen by Overlord's creator, Kugane Maruyama. Find Clementine's missing memories and make your escape!

name: Metaisland
short_description: Metaisland stands as a AAA Metaverse product crafted by seasoned gaming veterans and experienced crypto developers. This unique concept seamlessly bridges the Gaming and Crypto industries, boasting unparalleled innovation that is sure to capture the attention of both investors and gamers alike.

name: Klaus Veen's Treason
short_description: Treason is a 3-16 player party shooter of teamwork and betrayal, set among Italian mobsters. Use proximity voice chat, unique abilities, and strategy to prove your innocence or deceive others. Update 9: Set up your own lobby and play with your friends!

name: Horny Goddesses Quiz
short_description: This is a quiz game in which you can meet the beautiful 10 ladies.

name: The Medieval Psychologist
short_description: You're a stranger who has come to Lostworth, a town full of people lost in the darkness of the Middle Ages. Your purpose: help them spiritually. For this, you've only books, potions, spells and words. In time, as you uncover the secrets of the city, you'll also have to face threats from the past.

name: Campground Owner
short_description: Simple tycoon-like game. Choose where to place your guests, increase your reputation, and count money.

name: Safari Cannon
short_description: Explore the wilds of the African Safari and discover all the wild beasts of the savannah. From elephants to monkeys, you'll encounter a host of creatures who will try to stop you. It's a fun game for the whole family - so come on, join the adventure!

name: Book Hunter
short_description: In this stealth adventure game you'll guide ArgentoBOT through an ancient library to find the hidden treasures resting inside of it. Survive the dangers crawling in the shadows, use objects to stun or distract your enemies end use strategically the lights to hide from threats.

name: Voxel Farm Island
short_description: You now have a dream island right away! Take care of the farm, develop business, Expand transportation, and there are more interesting things on the island, such as magical giving tree, fishery and the mine full of treasures... You have a most important task - to solve the mystery on the island!

name: Roommate

name: Office No.41: Prototype Edition
short_description: A prototype version of upcoming horror game "Office No.41". James Loderick goes to closed specialized music school '' Lim Donna '', in which he studied to find and take something that could make his dream come true. But right after he comes to school, he realizes that something is not alright.

name: MyDockFinder
short_description: MyDockFinder is a software for quick system startup and control viewing system functions. You can drag and drop to add your favorite programs or files, and drag and drop to directly use the program to open the file. Based on WinUI using GPU rendering, smooth animation effects.

name: Out of Bounds
short_description: Out of Bounds is a puzzle shooter where you need to "create" a game while "fixing" bugs!

name: Cute Chess
short_description: Cute Chess is all the fun of regular chess but with cute little characters, scene designs and music to make the game even more fun. Improve your chess skills by practising against computers with a range of different difficulties or take your skills online and compete against friends.

name: Futanari Jigsaw Puzzle

short_description: Take Command of the latest Multi-role Assault Carrier. Fly strikes against enemy positions, deploy powerful amphibious tanks into combat as you assault islands from the sea and capture key islands while customising your fighting vehicles. Manage logistic supply lines as you move forward.

name: メーアステイル  小さな国のアイテム屋さん／Mearstale  our little item shop
short_description: "Mearstale" is a national strategy adventure game where you become the lord of the country and develop the town significantly. Sell ​​everything from stones to real estate, build buildings, and sometimes interact with people to explore the world within a given period of time.

short_description: Sent to camp against your will, find a way to escape to freedom. Craft goods to trade with other inhabitants for objects to use in your planned escape. Can you strategize and execute an escape plan through the perimeter of patrolling guards?

name: First Light
short_description: As a Search and Rescue officer, you're no stranger to remote areas. After a freak blizzard strands two people in a remote cabin, you've been sent to help. Play tandem stories of past and present, all while being hunted by a malevolent being of winter and hunger in this story-driven survival horror.

name: Tear of Time: Lost memory
short_description: Is an adventure game. You play as a character who, waking up in a house on a remote island, realizes that she has lost her memory. Player will have to find out the reason for the loss of memory, explore the island, find ancient treasures, explore the ruins with secret locations and solve puzzles.

short_description: Nailed It is a VR puzzle game. You will make a path to your agent to reach its target.

name: Starflex-VR
short_description: In this platform, you can enjoy various performances of top K-Pop idols with s3D VR. Not only K-POP but also drama, movie, fan meeting, and making film contents will be opened. High quality software is provided through Multi-Camera system. Please join us. We'll guide you to VR metaverse platform.

short_description: Between turn-based management and farming game, AgriLife puts you in the shoes of a farmer. Plant your crops in a living soil, move on to the next week and watch their evolution! Master this little world, try several strategies… or just enjoy the sunshine and birdsongs.

name: The Glade
short_description: The Glade is a beautiful open world survival set on a stylized island which has been struck all over from large and mysterious meteorites creating a bridge for evil creatures from another world to enter and destroy anything in their path.

name: Falconet
short_description: Falconet is a retro-style twin stick shooter with smooth weapon switching and quick reaction gameplay. Travel through unique levels, solve puzzles, and use your diverse arsenal of weapons to efficiently eliminate an army of rogue machines, rescue human survivors, and rack up high scores.

short_description: "Cryweard" is an action RPG developed by a student, with the focus on the fun of bargaining and tense moments in battles. A nameless warrior explores the world to unravel the mystery of "Cry" and confronts a powerful enemy called "Weard" while making full use of his magical powers.

name: ASCENDANT
short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure three biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

name: Deer & Boy

name: Void Slayer
short_description: Void Slayer is a fast-paced shooter with a unique twist, where the arena is also your health. Armed only with your magic gloves, fight through countless hordes of enemies, advance your power and fight to avoid falling into the Void.

name: Project Umbra
short_description: Project Umbra is a demanding twin-stick shooter. Through a journey through the great historical periods of an alternate world, awaken your competitive spirit and destroy your enemies in the most optimized way to be the best in scoreboard.

short_description: Control your Koala and collect treasure while avoiding dangers in this non-traditional Golf Game. Play through Challenges or with friends, Local or Online!

name: Late for Class: Variety King
short_description: Use 9 movement mechanics to climb your way to school. 'Late for Class' is a tribute to punishing games that are difficult, frustrating, yet somehow satisfying. Expect lots of falling and getting back up!

name: Lemon vs. Teddy
short_description: Become a lemon and destroy the world with sausages before Teddy does it in this combat-focused RPG.

name: Incubus - A ghost-hunters tale
short_description: You are on your first solo ghost hunt, under the watchful instructions of Bear and Jen from the O.P.G paranormal team. Use real gadgets in a real location, a house investigated by the developers on the request of three different owners. It is a case worthy of a video game, so welcome to Incubus.

short_description: Tiny Frightened: a thrilling multiplayer game where you and your friends become voodoo dolls in a tiny and terrifying world, evading an evil pursuer. Help your friends and sew their eyes back on... and their eyes are buttons! Find valves to open the exit and escape.

You need to control the pinball through your own micro operation to complete the adventure of the level in the fastest and most perfect time. Swap cards to create poker hands and clear each board, fortify your deck with boons, break curses, and test your fate in a variety of special events!

The game also provides more than 100 popular folk classic chess scores for you to learn and study. Finally the game also offers hundreds of chess scraps from simple to complex to wait for you to crack.

Follow the story of Sang as she looks for her long lost kin.

Featuring over 8 worlds and 60 levels, this game is a relaxing, completionists dream. Your journey in Element Runner awaits!

short_description: An adventure awaits you on Mars where you need to save a team of sexy girls from an unknown disease. Making them... sexually active.

The bottles and cans that can be taken easily at ordinary times have become inaccessible mountains in front of you!

short_description: It's On You is a narrative driven FMV game where your choices matter, affecting the outcome of you, the player as Curtis and those around you. Stuck between a world of crime and violence, in the wake of gang grooming gripping the community and a potential career of international football.
