short_description: Lead your own DnD-like adventuring party on an epic adventure narrated by Laura Bailey. Invite your friends for free to the group with the Friends Pass, or strike out on your own. Cooperation, betrayal, and the luck of the dice… what wild escapades will you and your teammates get up to?

name: Scoop Kick!
short_description: Help Ms. Cream and her friends on their quest to retrieve all the stolen ice cream from the evil Juice Bunch! Venture through more than 5 different worlds in this arcade inspired game where your goal is to kick scoops and assemble ice cream cones. Aim for the high score or try to get the best time!

name: Pretty Girls Speed
short_description: An easy to play fast paced game! Here comes the "Speed" card game! Quickly put out the cards that connect sequentially to the numbers on the table, and when all your cards are gone first, you wiin! Play a serious game with PrettyGirls and aim for the "Speed" throne!

name: Jules
short_description: In this action 2D-platromer, inspired by retro games, you'll hop from level to level, fight against various enemies and show your skills in 6 boss fights.

name: Darxanadon
short_description: Explore a massive interconnected labyrinth of grottos, castles, and groves in this 2D retro-inspired Action RPG.

name: Merge Hero
short_description: An idle RPG game with infinite possibilities. Merge items, upgrade stats and fight deadly monsters and bosses

name: Omi Oh My AI
short_description: Go on a captchavating adventure and solve over 100 unique puzzles generated by our quirky AI, Omi! Learn to see the world the way AI does with image, word, and number puzzles in this game inspired by AI, the 90’s, and the constant need to prove you’re not a robot.

name: Wordle 5
short_description: Wordle 5 is the culmination of the Wordle series with brand new puzzles 10 new categories, 500 puzzles

name: Sunny Love
short_description: Sunny love is a short visual novel where you play as a young photographer who didn’t strike big in the capital. He decides to visit his hometown to get some inspiration and new ideas for a comeback. Lady Luck smiles at him as he meets a certain redhead muse...

name: Blades of Heroes: Samurai Rising
short_description: An Action Adventure 3rd person hack and slash game set in Mythological Japan. Travel as a trio of Samurai Heroes and switch between them as you fight enemies with the help of an Ally system. Perform special combo attacks as you travel across Japan, hell-bent on destroying the forces of evil.

name: Way Down
short_description: Live this action-packed spy adventure based on the movie The Vault.

name: MeteoHeroes
short_description: If you like platform and adventure games, get ready to enjoy MeteoHeroes, a game full of action and fun, fight for a clean and safe planet and take your superheroes to their final destination where they will have to face the fearsome Doctor Makina and the Maculans.

name: Cyberpunk Girls
short_description: Cyberpunk Girl is a brutal action shooter set in the year 2169 in the cyber metropolis Oplot. The city of the future, which has become a save heaven for thugs, hackers, and gold diggers. Win the most breathtaking battles. And remember that everything comes with a price.

name: Late photographer 2
short_description: This is a game of changing clothes for beautiful women. You may change the character's hair, clothes, jewelry, etc.

name: Werewolves Revenge
short_description: A first person social deduction game where deception, strategy, and manipulation are your greatest weapons.

name: Surreal Nightmare
short_description: Surreal Nightmare is a stealth survival horror game about a lab-created beast that escapes and burrows deep into a cave.

name: Slime Village VR
short_description: Slime Village VR is a 3D sandbox in cute Lowpoly graphics, created especially for virtual reality glasses.

name: Upheaveal
short_description: Enter Upheaveal! Play as one of several representatives of alien races and a variety of different objects in your environment to KO your opponents. Aim to be the last one standing in this physics-based 3D multiplayer party game! Throw everything, become Champion, and cause Upheaveal!

name: Slide Furry Futanari
short_description: Be a good boy, or girl, and enjoy this puzzle game with sexy furry futanari girls.

name: Friendmocracy
short_description: Friendmocracy is the party game where voting wins points! Players vote based on fun, wild, or even spicy (Adult Mode) prompts—match the majority to score. Add your own prompts for endless fun! Perfect for friends, debates, and surprises. Will you vote wisely?

name: How To Bathe Your Cat: Impossible Mission
short_description: Bathing a cat is a difficult task, but sometimes it's necessary. Use drills, blowers, rockets and a grappling hook to destroy the ground and make the water reach the cat! Can you complete this hard mission?

name: Death By Tomato
short_description: Death By Tomato is an arcade style slicing game. In it the player must use bladed weapons to slice on coming food that is thrown at you. This game is for fast passed rhythm fun.

name: The Hike
short_description: The Hike is a first person horror/survival game in which you must survive the horrors that start while investigating a mysterious emergency message in a simple hike through the Red River National Park. Your chance of making it back to society relies entirely on your legs, you're no fighter.

name: Candy Monsters
short_description: Candy Monsters is a match 3 game! Allowing you to make different matches !Create bombs with various effects !Use bats to crush the candy! with more than 500 levels, super fun and challenging! game with over 200 hours of game play! distract and call your friends to have fun! play now

name: WrestleQuest
short_description: TAG TEAM WITH DESTINY! Pro wrestling and RPG fantasy collide in the ultimate pixel powered adventure. “Macho Man” Randy Savage and tons of other icons offer guidance as you powerbomb your way to glory beyond the ring. This hero’s journey ain’t just an epic quest, it’s WRESTLEQUEST!

name: Homestead Arcana
short_description: Become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with Miasma. Discover the secret behind its appearance, grow plants to power up your spells, and use nature’s magic to heal the land.

name: Solar Ash
short_description: From the creators of the award-winning Hyper Light Drifter comes the high-speed and gravity-bending world of Solar Ash.

name: Armageddon War:Old Era Wreckers / 大鏖战:旧时代的残党
short_description: This is a turn-based historical chess simulation game Players will experience major battles between 1840 and 1920 The game consists of four conquest scripts, each with three different modes and 60 free conquest years to choose from, where the player takes on the role of a commander

name: Silverblood
short_description: Years after leaving her family to join the Sisters of the Whiterock Coven, Edith is anxious to finally return home. But first she has to pass her Trial of Ascension, a harrowing task bestowed by her patron deity. Together, Edith and her bully must complete the trial, no matter the consequences.

name: Final Space - The Rescue
short_description: The Final Space universe has expanded to VR! Join Gary, Avocato, Nightfall, and Tribore as they embark on a brand new journey to rescue their dear friend from the clutches of a new, but familiar, threat.

name: Mannequin The Passing
short_description: Mannequin The Passing is a single-player psychological horror game. Get through the stages watching the mannequins carefully as some show signs of wanting to stop you. Use patience and observational skills to get through and survive the passing mannequin experience.

name: SokoWinter
short_description: SokoWinter is a sokoban game with slippery floors. You will have the opportunity to get to know one of the curious hobbies of four stylish penguins: pushing large ice cubes. Why do they like this activity so much? Well, that we don't know, as our knowledge of penguins is limited...

name: 观星VR / Oriental stars
short_description: Starry sky is the common spiritual home of all mankind and the origin of all human civilizations in the world. Let's learn about the oriental traditional astronomy in leisure, understand our civilization, experience Chinese traditional astrology, and heal our mood with the starry sky.

name: Bicycle Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Run your bicycle workshop and repair bicycles by your own hand. Tighten the screws, adjust the chain, and then do some personalized printing. It's not just your sweat that makes you a bicycle repair master, but your attention to detail and skills.

name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log1
short_description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure.

name: Like Dreamer
short_description: A pop and cute bullet-hell shooting game from Cosmo Dreamer "Outside". Both beginners and experts can enjoy speedy and active playing.

name: Underlab
short_description: The spiritual successor to Project Winter, Underlab is a mashup of role-playing and social deception set in a secret deepsea laboratory.

name: For Sparta
short_description: One million Persians invaded Greece and only you can stop them in this fast-paced single-screen arena roguelike with +200 gameplay-changing items. Die for freedom! Die For Sparta!

name: 艾利欧斯的狩猎Eliosi's Hunt
short_description: Lead Eliosi, a wanna-be bounty hunter, into making his dream come true in this hardcore top-down shooter and platformer.

name: Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx
short_description: Obtain the sword of victory together with Princess Kiera and the Wild Lynx Mercenaries! Mercenaries Rebirth is a tactical RPG set in a fantasy world.

name: Orbital Mechanics
short_description: Orbital Mechanics is a sci-fi, third-person shooter, single player game in which the player jumps between spherical asteroids whilst combating enemy forces.

name: BIG DRUG
short_description: BIG DRUG - Cooperative, Power and Bank Robbery, where you are looking for a robber in the role of a Policeman so that you will not be fired from your job. Your whole life is at stake. Can you find the culprit!? It all depends on you!

name: Wonky Works!
short_description: Unite the FELLAS and fight for FREEDOM!

name: SugarKiss!
short_description: A story about enjoying the spoony on of a cool older sister.

name: Witch Sacrifice
short_description: Witch Sacrifice - you have to defend your lands from three cruel kings. A huge army is advancing on your swamps, which you have to stop.

name: Jigsaw Novel - Public Toilet Sex
short_description: Jane decides to dress in a provocative way and look for casual sex in a public toilet.

name: Horny Sakura
short_description: Horny Sakura is a puzzle game, the ultimate goal of which is to swap the blocks to collect the image. But remember, the purpose of this game is to let you relax and enjoy the process.

name: I Am Two People
short_description: This is a story about myself and myself. "I" has two bodies and lives two kinds of lives: self-discipline "I" is responsible for learning, and freedom "I" is responsible for entertainment. Two "I" in high school were assigned to the same class. I play two different characters...

name: NPUnrealSample
short_description: NPUnrealSample Features 1. WebBrowser - It provides common WebBrowser features like chrome and firefox. Move pages, watch videos, download files. 2. Account Menu - Provide account functions such as login, logout, user information inquiry, current platform inquiry, UUID inquiry, etc.

name: Aztlan Uncovered: Prologue
short_description: Explore an archeological site long lost to the ages. Use your time-reversing equipment to reveal the past and discover the secrets amidst the frozen wasteland.

name: World Empire 2027
short_description: Lead your empire in turn based strategy war game. Select your country and start to play.

name: Trapped VR
short_description: Trapped VR is a VR puzzle game that focuses on how the player interacts with the game world. To win you must solve the puzzles surrounding you to figure out the secret code that unlocks the container doors.

name: Everblade
short_description: Avenge a crumbling world in this varied platformer. Jump, fight, climb, and fly through worlds full of hazards and puzzles. Discover hidden treasures and develop new skills and devastating attacks to aid in your fight against the hordes of evil. Will you succeed and restore order to the world?

name: Return Ace
short_description: Be shot and shoot back! Rule reversal type Shmup "Return Ace"What you have been given is the power to take advantage of the oncoming malice and return it.Please enjoy the unique sense of incompatibility, tension, and striking that the experience of bullet energy weaves.

name: Peace Maker VR
short_description: Peace Maker VR is a game in a fantasy world where you defend a village with guns and magic.

name: Periphery Online
short_description: A refugee capsule lands on an uninhabited planet. You have to survive, rebuild civilization and, if possible, regain control over the Earth. One big universe, one endless pvp session for all players.

name: NecroFarm
short_description: Turn your crops into minions and they will fend off waves of enemies in this top-down horde survival farming game. A mix of strategy and fast-paced farming that challenges you to defend the farm with your crop minions or even harvest them for gold! Gain new seeds and grow your army!

name: DEAD GUN
short_description: DEAD GUN is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements. Take control of a soldier of the elite squad Z-800 and go on an operation to clear friendly worlds from enemies in order to save them.

name: Crawling Silence
short_description: Uncover the mysteries of an old, long forgotten building with a dark past, or choose to try and escape the creatures lurking within it with friends! But beware of the things inside trying to get you...

name: Inu's Adventure
short_description: Inu's adventure is a fun platformer die&retry where you play a dog against robots, lasers, missiles, platforms, squeaky toys, and a mad robot professor to get out of a secret laboratory.

name: Fayburrow
short_description: In a world of fairies, a childhood friend suddenly calls Beatrice back to her old hometown. Yet when she arrives, her friend is mysteriously missing.

name: IDEA
short_description: IDEA is a game about discovering and sharing. Explore gorgeous landscapes, roll down highways and stumble upon welcoming cottages and abandoned dumpsters. Help your ideas find their way – and share them with the world when they stop, before beginning your journey anew.

name: Collect Objects
short_description: Collect objects, how more you can? You need to solve puzzles to collect objects.

name: Fracked
short_description: Stranded in a remote mountain facility, you play as a reluctant hero forced to defend the planet in a final stand against a legion of interdimensional enemies. Take aim and run head-first into explosive action as you shoot, ski, and climb your way across an extreme adventure.

name: Dungeon Crawler
short_description: Dungeon Crawler is a round-based, third-person, rogue-like, fantasy-style, atmospheric indie game. On your journey through a set of caves and rooms you will slay monsters, loot equipment and gain XP to level up and access perks that help you grow and sustain.

name: 3D PUZZLE - Old House
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house

name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
short_description: When Max Caulfield finds her friend Safi dead in the snow, she tears open the way to a parallel timeline. Here, Safi is still alive - and still in danger! With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

name: Robert: Space Stories and Battles
short_description: Space shootouts and fascinating stories.

name: Blobbs: Remastered
short_description: The Blobbs are Back! Rebuilt from the ground up in a brand new engine with fully remastered graphics. Ping, pop, zap and explode your way through 50+ levels featuring 16 different types of blobbs (including 4 new ones!) in this colourful and quirky real time puzzle game.

name: ファントムゾーン・タロン・フィクションズ　phantom Zone Talon Fictions
short_description: The near future is just a few toes away. Journalist Iselda Aronica A man is asked to conduct an investigation in a certain town. The name of the town is Angelovale. The name of the town is Angelovale. It was a town where people still existed.

name: Shredders
short_description: Break into the snowboarding event of the year in the hope of scoring a wildcard entry to an exclusive invitational. To prove you’re up to the challenge, master the art of park riding, buttering, rails and massive kickers and earn your place in the world of snowboarding.

name: Vorax
short_description: In the gripping world of VORAX survival takes on a new terrifying dimension. As you step into this Open World Survival Horror game brace yourself for a journey where every moment is a battle for survival. Every choice, every move, every breath could be your last. Are you ready to face the unknown?

name: I don't think I've walked this stretch of road before
short_description: Walk the length of your memories on a lonely country highway. Follow the signal. Return to the place you left behind. Piece together a truth you can live with. A short, ambiguous narrative adventure game.

name: GO
short_description: Go is a simple and minimalist game in which you have to position the launch of a ball to eliminate all the existing obstacles. Very good to pass the time, it contains 100 stages.

name: RPG Town
short_description: "Mr Mayor, we have an emergency! A party of adventurers just arrived in town! They're looking for an apothecary, a bladesmith and an inn to spend the night... but we don't have any of that stuff! These guys are getting kinda restless - what should we do?"

name: Far Away From Home
short_description: Far Away From Home is a story-driven tactical RPG. Battle foes in turn-based combat, turn monstrous enemies into friends, customize your party with a variety of builds, and craft powerful gear to enhance your playstyle. Unfold the mystery of your lost party as you try to find a way home.

name: WILD WEST
short_description: WILD WEST - is a hardcore 3D shooter with survival elements where you will have to fight various enemies playing as a sheriff James.

name: Karolina
short_description: "Carolina" is a story-oriented game about a girl with a difficult fate.

name: Mini Mini-Golf
short_description: Mini Mini-Golf - a minimalistic game about golf in the casual genre.

name: Don't Push Me
short_description: Square off against your friends in this life-or-death shoving simulator! 2 Player Local Competitive 1v1. Best played with gamepads.

name: Hentai Student
short_description: Alice is a 19 year old student girl. Studies at the Faculty of Journalism. And she needs your help in finding the right book to write a report on one of the subjects.

name: Potionomics
short_description: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

name: Mori
short_description: The arcade shoot 'em up where getting angry is just a game mechanic.

name: Knightlife
short_description: Four villages in a war. You are the only hope for a peaceful life. Play as a knight in this cute open world RPG and loot through many different weapons, magical spells and bows. Become the strongest knight and end this war.

name: Peep Invasion
short_description: Forge your team from a variety of different creatures, each with their own strengths and abilities, and stop the never-ending invasion of Peeps!

name: MoonFire: A Seeker's Saga
short_description: Slice into a dark fantasy world of celestial magic and violence-devoted talking animals in this visual novel RPG. MoonFire intertwines personal mystery and complex characters within a landscape of political intrigue, all unknowingly set against the threat of a looming cosmic apocalypse.

name: Infinadeck Medieval Maze
short_description: A twisty-turny castle maze designed to show off the strengths of the Infinadeck omnidirectional treadmill. Designed for both slow and fast walkers, this experience is fun for all ages when paired with a full virtual reality setup.

name: DIVE
short_description: DIVE is a Nier-inspired 3rd person shooter with light puzzle and platforming mechanics. Explore an artificial and abandoned world while trying to overcome its trials and enemies.

name: Room Box
short_description: Fight your way through the mazes of Room Box. A minimalist 2d-style TopDown shooter. Your only way of escape is to survive countless and unique rooms. Fight dozen of enemies and defeat merciless Bosses

name: 浮生箓 Floating Life
short_description: 《浮生箓》是一款剧情重开模拟游戏，互动式轻量小说游戏。支持创意工坊自由编辑与上传自己的剧本，融合如修仙、武侠、玄幻等小说题材的背景，可自由选择出生的剧本，体验千变万化的人生，从出生开始让你体验到丰富多变的剧情，多种多样的选择，不同选择带来不同的变化，各种有趣的梗。来吧，开始你的浮生之旅，随着进程生成自己的浮生箓！

name: Tower Words
short_description: Word game that mixes tetris, categories game and word search.

name: Volleyhalla
short_description: A frantic fantasy ping-pong battler! Also sheep!

name: Elf World Adventure: Part 1
short_description: You are gamer who likes to play computer games. One day, returning home from the store, along the way you became a victim of an accident. At the last moment you think that your story is over, but some force has given you a second chance in another world that is completely different from yours.

name: Secret Series : BJ
short_description: Let's uncover their hidden privacy

name: 月夜赞歌 Melody in the moonlight
short_description: A difficult RPG puzzle game. Because of an accident, the two sisters entered a wrong time and space. Please help them find the hidden truth in this false space and time.

name: 秋恋物语 Autumn Romance
short_description: 这是个普通的故事，因为主角是个普通的阿宅，而情节是我们视而不见的日常；这是个值得怀念的故事，那是我们不会再有的时光。当平静到暗淡的大学生活因她们而掀起波澜，生活开始发生了变化。这是个氤氲着青涩懵懂的秋天，被时间和她们推着成长的你，会不会在多年以后感叹那些日子因为她们而灿烂。

name: RUNNER RTX
short_description: RUNNER RTX is a classic runner game with a procedurally generated world but with cinematic graphics.

name: Familiar
short_description: Familiar is an illustrated puzzle misadventure from Damsel Stone, following a witch's cat trying to undo a spell gone-wrong. Use a combination of platforming, problem solving, potion drinking, and people pleasing to undo the ongoing disaster and bring familiarity back to your home.

name: Tuition Academia
short_description: Take control of a customizable female protagonist in an exciting, role-playing, life simulation game where you try to pay off your student debt. Work several risqué side jobs while trying to balance the day-to-day of college. How far will you go to earn that money? Will you remain innocent?

name: Ninja Noboken
short_description: Ninja Noboken a 2.5D side Scroller Fast-paced action-adventure combat with Magic skills. Short clips to follow the adventure with plot and twist will be all along with the game.

name: Bullwagon Business
short_description: Smash the reins and set off in a bull-drawn wagon to explore the beautiful countryside, have adventures, but most of all, trade. But don't expect it to be easy. There are bandits and other vermin everywhere, and if you don't fight them off, you'll lose them! Get in!

name: REAL LIFE OF SOLDIERS
short_description: Every city has been taken over by a virus, citizens are sick... Collect medicines and vaccines and take it to the city hospital to cure patients infected with this dangerous virus. Only on the way you will find "the viruses" to destroy and people to rescue. That's your mission, soldier.

name: Dead End City
short_description: A post-apocalyptic arcade shooter. Collect fuel and dodge enemy fire as you fight back against the evil Scorpio gang. Mixes cars, shmups and themes that would have been right at home in 80's anime and arcades..

name: Hot wife Tara
short_description: HWT is a choose your own adventure story that puts you in the shoes of Harry, a married man who, along with his wife, Tara, want to embark on a sexual journey together. With multiple branching paths and eight unique endings, can you help Harry ensure that his wife has the best birthday of her life?

name: Capelord: Bounty Hunters
short_description: Capelord:Bounty Hunter is a multiplayer lateral action shooter for up to 4 players, play campaign missions alone or as a team, compete against other players for loot by defeating the area boss.

name: LOST EMBER - VR Edition
short_description: Explore the remains of a fallen world from fascinating perspectives! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights, dig underground as a mole, climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, and many more!

name: Adult VR Game Room

name: Zombie Good Guy
short_description: You are the Last Zombie on Earth and You are the Good Guy. The Evil Humans are trying to destroy You. Can You Survive ?

name: AquaPhobia
short_description: Work as a team to beat the underwater depths of this weird planet, but be cautious... Some people don't want to work in teams.

short_description: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby Union Management Game”. Rugby Union Team Manager 4 gives you full control of managing your own Rugby Union team. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors, facilities and more. MUCH MORE!

name: Trapped In Stone - World War II Horror
short_description: Linear World War 2 horror game where you play as a German Soldier who gets trapped inside a Bunker By Americans. Looking for a way out, things take a darker turn when he discovers a human war weapon.

short_description: You got fired recently, No money, no girlfriend, no prospects. You then see a woman looking for people to teach in Japan. The only problem? You don't know a single thing about Japan. Still, you find yourself taking the job. What's worse, you're stuck with two eccentric spirits for the next year.

name: DreadMoon
short_description: Take the form of a powerful werewolf and right the wrongs your people made to free the land from the vampire lord Balthazar’s deadly clutches.

name: Titan Station

name: SQUID GIRLS 18+

name: Covid Carl

name: Aery - Calm Mind 2
short_description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

name: TRYP FPV: Drone Racer Simulator
short_description: Fly freely and perfect your skills as an FPV pilot without the risk of breakage, with hyper-realistic visuals and flight sensations. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, TRYP FPV is the next-generation simulator that immerses you in the pure adrenaline of FPV drone flying.

name: The Masters: Survival
short_description: Tana (Katana) is testing the new Virtual Proxy Simulation, which is going to be used for training, as she fights the evil creatures known as the Shadow Dwellers. All is not what it seems however as she dives deeper into the system and faces off against an old foe, Master Nether.

name: Command Line Mazer
short_description: Command Line Mazer is a casual strategy game using Unix-like command-line interface. You will command virus to gather resources while avoiding being caught by anti-virus.

name: ProBee
short_description: A fast paced, team based arena game, in which the players control cybernetic athletes to measure their skills at Ultimate Frisbee and Parkour. Strategically place yourself around the arena to catch your team’s passes.

name: Greedy Rabbit
short_description: Fun arcade and logic game, where you are greedy rabbit. In each level you have to collect all the vegetables and possibly stars. Then look for the open portal to the next level. Do this with the best result.

name: Phonetic
short_description: Phonetic is a casual brain teaser game. A simple game in which the player deciphers the phonetic spelling of various words. Try it out and see what highscore you can set!

name: Any World
short_description: Any World is an open-world 3D platformer. Travel through seven unique locations, each with its own style. As the alien Ottis, repair the portal device and uncover the secrets of the planet Emria.

name: Pluto's Island
short_description: Artsy and super weird action adventure RPG with roguelike sauce(elements) on top. Inspired by 90's RPG's, comics, and cartoons. Made by one human.

name: RED
short_description: A science fiction adventure based on the Little Red Riding Hood fairyrtale.

name: Lewis & Clark Expedition
short_description: Lewis & Clark Expedition is a Strategy game with elements of RPG. As a Corps of Discovery leader, you'll conduct the expedition throughout the unexplored interior of North America with the goal of finding a convenient passage from the Missouri River up to the Pacific Ocean.

name: Shadow Burglar
short_description: Play as Jean, a thief with the mystical power of morphing with the shadows. Creating yourself an improbable path in the dark and carefully dealing with guards in the light, you will try to steal back your deceased brother’s paintings. Do you have what it takes to avenge his legacy?

name: The Odyssey of the Mammoth
short_description: Through lavish but perilous landscapes, assist a mammoth mother and her child escape from their extinction. Discover breathtaking views from 12,000 years ago. Beware of the increasingly hostile environment. Protect your offspring from the hunters tracking you and send them flying!

name: Exodus Vigil
short_description: Explore the Dark and Dangerous Temples and Tombs of Ancient Egypt in this story-driven 3D puzzle maze adventure game. Exodus Vigil is designed for academic students to learn how to build & publish their own games. Exodus Vigil is being developed by a small Indie Game Development Education Studio.

name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days
short_description: The ultimate digital Vanguard experience that includes an original story set in the world of overDress! Compete with players worldwide with "Ranked Fight," play solo casually with "CPU Fight," and enjoy the game and experience the world of Vanguard at your own pace via many other fight modes.

name: DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create
short_description: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features!

name: Fatal Blade
short_description: Fatal Blade is an action RPG that provides the best combat experience in a fantasy world.

name: admeowture
short_description: This is a third person shooting game. Players just need to hold down the mouse and let go. Throw out the synthetic drink and you can play. Right click to knock down the cats in an abnormal state, and you can take food from them. Then we'll have a delicious meal.

name: MEDIEVAL KNIGHTMARE
short_description: Hordes of monsters has invaded the village, the last opportunity to avoid them reach the king is you. Arm with weapons and fight the hordes solo or with a team.

name: AI CG Generation Engine
short_description: This is an AI software for fast CG photo generation, which is good for both game developers, artists and hobbyists. It can quickly convert an ordinary character photo into an anime cartoon style game CG image that you own the genuine copyright.

name: Escape The Living Nebula
short_description: Turn-based spaceship battles in a tense fight for survival

name: A Hero's wish
short_description: You will be the heroine and have a mission to defeat the devil. You will encounter many people and monsters on your way to the devil. Depending on your choice, someone will be an enemy and someone will be allies. Check now for the ending you will reach with your choice.

name: 江湖客栈-The Jianghu
short_description: Hey,you! This is not a place where the Beggar's can come in and beg for help! Without 100k silver coins, never think you can use our "Jianghu Inn" sign. what? Surprisingly, we managed to get together! Do you really want to give it a try?

name: MARY
short_description: MARY - is an adventure shooter with surviving elements where you will survive in zombie apocalypse playing as a girl named Jane.

name: Midnight at Forest
short_description: Try to escape from the Forest as you setup camp, then realize you were locked in there by a Park officer. There were 5 keyholes, so you had to find one key for each one.

name: Undawn
short_description: Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world.

name: Bitlands
short_description: Platform across strange, magical terrain while meeting even stranger friends and enemies! Discover the history behind the Bitlands, and unlock new allies and powers to traverse the dangerous worlds of the Bitlands, and restore peace to a broken kingdom.

name: 3 DAYS: Ghosts of War
short_description: In the heart of the Afghan wilderness, amidst the chaos of war, you awaken to the stark reality of your mission: three days to navigate the perilous landscape, uncover hidden truths, and confront the ghosts of the past.

name: CatNab
short_description: The cat's outta the bag! That's why we're bringing a barrel. Compete for high scores by nabbing as many cats as you can.

name: ボクロボ ~Boxed Cell Robot Armies~
short_description: The game is an auto-battler game with voxel robots that is both comically and tactically challenging.

name: Maze Twister
short_description: Rotate the maze to make the ball reach the destination.

name: Hikari no Valusia
short_description: In a big city in the desert called Valcia, only young people called 'adept' are allowed to go out. The city used to be covered with a canopy, but people can see the sky and a lot of people visit the city through the canopy now. But this inflow of people gradually changes the city...

name: Heard of the Story?
short_description: Forge a medieval community with intelligent AI villagers. Gather resources and transform the village into a town, or simply listen to captivating stories from various simulated and evolving lives. All in a beautiful, relaxing, and immersive fantasy world.

name: Reimei no Gakuen - Otome/Visual Novel
short_description: A visual novel of modern-day fantasy, bonds, and a mystery that brings misery to the children born with a strange power.

name: Am I?
short_description: After being sent into space, Laika find herself exploring some asteroids, meeting weird characters and solving puzzles to figure out what the hell is happening to her. She will lose herself in time, space and even in herself, if that makes some sense for you. The big question is: is she dead?

name: Craft Hero
short_description: Gather resources by day, build and recruit by noon, defend your village by night! A new minimalism sandbox survival with countless new ideas – Craft Hero

name: Hentai Sea Battle
short_description: Classic sea battle. Destroy all enemy ships faster than he can destroy yours to win the battle.

name: Destinesia
short_description: Destinesia is a sci-fi metroidvania which you are looking for a new home for humanity. Parkour your way through most dangerous jungles and explore the ancient dungeons. Upgrade your suit with the remains of your ancestors. Reveal the oldest secrets of Homo Sapiens.

name: Ultra Mega Cats
short_description: Blast your way through hordes of enemies in Ultra Mega Cats, a cooperative roguelike third-person shooter. Play As one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs with a wide variety of abilities and escape captivity from your Rodent and Bird Overlords!

name: Decisive Campaigns: Ardennes Offensive
short_description: Decisive Campaigns: Ardennes Offensive is the fourth wargame in the Decisive Campaign series. Covering the battles in the Ardennes between December 1944 and January 1945, it brings to life Operational wargaming by lowering the scale to just above tactical level.

name: 山海皆可平
short_description: The game is a single-player action-adventure game based on the Chinese mythical story.

name: Starship Empire
short_description: Starship Empire is an intense PvP-filled space MMO where you not only lead your ship into epic battles, but manage the entire crew inside!

name: GACHI ADVENTURE: Billy's Legacy
short_description: GACHI ADVENTURE: Billy's Legacy is a truly open-world role-playing game. You will find a diverse plot with a unique atmosphere of Gachimuchi, a whole city available for free study, and intense card battles.

name: LiDAR Exploration Program
short_description: LiDAR Exploration Program is a relaxing atmospheric game with light horror elements, where you explore in complete darkness using a scanner to reveal the world around you.

name: Krek Da Frog
short_description: Funny and relaxing game, player can control the frog he choose in menu select unlocked level and complete eating missions on multiple locations. To achieve all achievements player must eat at least 500 butterflies and open all levels.

name: Rockstar Life
short_description: Rockstar Life is a casual life simulation game. In this game you get to write songs, organize tours, record singles and albums while you deal with the everyday drama of a wannabe Rockstar through random events.

name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection One
short_description: The Forgotten Realms Archive - Collection One allows you to journey through the set of adventures: the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, a collection of first-person, real-time role-playing games.

name: Maze Workout - Western Lost Solo Car Racer
short_description: It's a retro western styled, maze racing game with 50 levels and 30 western style musics "check the music in the video", find the checkpoints and laps to the next level.

name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two
short_description: The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay.

name: ELEVATED
short_description: ELEVATED is a multiplayer (8 vs. 1) thriller action game where eight death row inmates try to complete the given tasks to gain their freedom while being chased by the 4th horseman of the apocalypse, "The Death".

name: Sweet Surge
short_description: Navigate the unending ocean of Cioko. Build, direct, compose and customize your crew. Overcome the greatest crews and challenges on your rise to ultimate juicy sweetness.

name: Godtail: First Cut
short_description: After what seems like a dull day of school and track practice, Violet overhears some conversation about some monster sightings. Afterward, her friend Hannah tells Violet to let loose and pay no attention to it – but maybe she should have.

name: The Walker
short_description: The Walker is a single player survival horror game. Peaceful days have passed, you no longer work to eat, but try to survive. Find out what's behind all this, hope you make it out alive.

name: Mob Hunter
short_description: Challenge the most terrible and severe monsters! Find out the truth about the order of hunters in a new third-person slasher! Unique combat system, customization, pumping and a bunch of monsters!!!

name: Learn Programming: Python - Remake
short_description: An interactive text-based game for learning and practicing how to program in Python.

name: Creators
short_description: Creators is a first person shooter where users participate in massive battles either online or locally with AI. The game comes with a powerful in game scenario editor, ensuring that the only limit for what is possible is your imagination. Creators was meant to be fun above all else so enjoy!

name: Ranchlife
short_description: In RanchLife, build your farm alone or with friends, raise animals, sell products, and help expand the town. Over time, you can open your own store and sell your goods directly.

name: Smithy Shop
short_description: Combine materials and create countless swords combinations for your clients at the ever burning forge in Smithy Shop. Manage your materials and choose your swords bearers wisely, as every sword counts towards a cause, and you'll soon discover their repercussions, good and bad.

name: Cattails: Wildwood Story
short_description: Become a cat! In this cozy life sim RPG, you'll lead your colony into the mysterious Wildwood. Hunt prey, harvest herbs, collect magical treasures, & defend your new home from intruders. Build a thriving town to recruit new cats. Get to know the residents, fall in love, & raise a litter of kittens!

name: Zombie Shotgun Rampage
short_description: All that's left is you, the endless swarm of zombies, and the beer they stole. Shoot every rotten scoundrel in your path and bring back the coveted drink, which is a pleasure to while away the days of a fading future!

name: MECH PUNK
short_description: This game of being kidnapped against your will, with fishing

name: Memory Novel - The Sex Sauna
short_description: Train your brain with this memory game, revealing a small sex story in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match,

name: FALL GIRLS
short_description: FALL GIRLS is a casual arcade runner with unique setting.It`s a competition, where you should pass the levels one by one.You will play as a female protagonist.

name: Ella - a study in realism
short_description: Ella, a study in realism

name: ...Knew the Beginning
short_description: A world you don't recognize anymore. You wake up inside a bar after the apocalypse. The barkeeper of said bar is in trouble. Do what you can to help him, after all he is all you remember.

name: Polyhedron: Tales from Krasnoslavia
short_description: Polyhedron: tales from Krasnoslavia - is a dynamic first-person shooter in the Eastern European cyberpunk setting. You can expect cool firearms, numerous unique abilities, diverse gameplay, and much more

name: Hero for Hire
short_description: Open world RPG where every quest is small puzzle.

name: Sex Adventures - The Job Interview
short_description: A visual novel about a young woman named Jessica, who is willing to do almost anything to succeed at her job interview.

name: The Winter
short_description: Little platformer

name: Bigger Than Me
short_description: (Mis)adventure narrative-driven game about Max, a young man full of uncertainties with a peculiar problem: he becomes giant everytime he hears the word 'FUTURE'!Puzzles, minigames and existential crises spiced up with humor in a story about growing up in a world that seems to be ending.

name: Pleasure Kingdom
short_description: Pleasure Kingdom gameplay is a mix of traditional CCG mechanics with thrilling visual novel.

name: Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse
short_description: Project Timi: Sasha's Curse is a 3D rhythmic puzzle-packed action game mashup. Use the rhythm of the music to activate magic traps, fight nightmare creatures, explore the dream worlds and unveil all the secrets that are hidden in Lucity Town.

name: Detective Agency 2
short_description: A colourful Hidden Object Game with a thrilling storyline! Solve the puzzles and find the banker's wife!

name: Cluck
short_description: Cluck is an extremely fast-paced fps arena shooter. Spawn with only a pistol and find weapons, armor, health and powerups such as the Quack and Speed along the map. Jump pads and portals are also around the map, enabling you to get to your destination. And customize your own chicken!

name: Space Maxwell: Arcade
short_description: Shoot your enemies and try not to let them multiply themselves and turn the game into a chaotic space battle! Space Maxwell is an arcade shooter where your spaceship has the ability to destroy or to multiply your enemies. Climb the leaderboard and try to survive as long as you can!

name: My Little Dictator
short_description: A satirical dark-comedy parody of WW2, featuring genderbent anime dictators and generals! A ridiculous visual novel with turn-based battles, decision branches based on player choices, romance, drama and lots of fun things to play and unlock...

name: Nuts Protocol
short_description: You might think this is yet another Tower Defense game. Well, friend, you are not wrong! The twist? It's fast-paced! Your greatest resource is positioning - and moving around is a must. Also, you control an orange Squirrel equipped with more-than-military-grade turrets! OMG - can it get any better?

name: Multi Idle
short_description: An idle RPG featuring a large focus on the customization of your play style to make every run unique. Create unbreakable skill combinations and advance your fighter to the point that even boss monsters will fear their strength!

name: Infinilands
short_description: Infinilands is a pixel art sandbox survival game that lets you explore and modify a procedurally generated world full of unique plants, creatures and ruins. You can build houses and fight monsters with your friends in online/split-screen co-op. This game also supports dedicated server.

name: Mupple
short_description: A colorful and animated world starring sweet animals and 2D Platformer focused on obstacles and challenges seems to be a perfect mix for... Deadly traps, absurd challenges and an insane adventure. Help Bilbo on his quest to retrieve the fruits from the forest and return home

name: CycloHex
short_description: CycloHex is a twist on the classic board game Hex. Despite it's simple rules, there's a world of strategy in CycloHex and countless ways to out-think your opponent! Play against your friends locally or online, or take on the built-in AI!

name: Lucie's Potager
short_description: Farm and sell exotic plants with Lucie in this shopkeeping RPG!

name: HEART of CROWN Online
short_description: The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

name: Minima
short_description: This minimalistic platformer is all about simplicity and chill vibes. Sit back, relax, and hop your way through 25 unique worlds... or race your friends to the top of the leaderboards!

name: 安特卫普的尼洛 Nello in Antwerp
short_description: Nello in Antwerp is a free-to-play experience set in the world of A Dog of Flanders (in development). You will play as a young boy in 19th century Belgium, penniless but with an artistic dream of painting. You will use pencil and brush to record the landscape you see.

name: The Symbiant
short_description: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

name: 小艺的异世界冒险-Xiao Yi's strange world adventure
short_description: An adventure decryption type of game It mainly triggers the decryption level through the plot mode. In order to save the mainland, you embark on an unknown adventure, look for the mysterious badge of light, and get the power of the great magician!

name: Lofi Furries
short_description: Lofi Furries is an adult-only jigsaw with sexy furries and a relaxing lofi soundtrack.

name: 逃出动物园丨Escape from the zoo
short_description: 这是一款用RPGMaker制作的JRPG解谜游戏游戏，主人公将在一座动物园中愉快观光，途中通过遵守动物园规则来尝试解开隐藏在动物园中的谜题。 游戏支持简体中文。

name: Hentai Lagoon
short_description: Hentai Lagoon is a puzzle game, the ultimate goal of which is to swap the blocks to collect the image. But remember, the purpose of this game is to let you relax and enjoy the process.

name: Symptom of love
short_description: Plunge into this story and see what happens!

name: Herbheim's Mine
short_description: Last warrior of the Herbheim's clan, it's your duty to defend the last family mine

name: Clive vs Hives 2
short_description: Blast aliens to pieces and start a rebellion in this fast paced pixel art top down shooter where sprinting kills.

name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
short_description: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

name: The Final Rescue: Escape Room
short_description: The world is plagued by a deadly virus. You are the last human to survive in what is left of the city, and perhaps even the world. Your only mission is to find a way to reverse the effects of the virus.

name: Drag Battle Top Fuel
short_description: Drag Battle Top Fuel is a racing simulation where you race a Top Fuel dragster over a quarter mile drag strip. The action is fast pace and intense, and things can change in a split second. Reaction times will be the difference between winning, loosing and crashing.

name: The Forked Road
short_description: The Forked Road is a story about traveling through a dead world in search of a place to call home. Which path will you choose, and can you not lose yourself?

name: Escape from the 70's
short_description: You need to get out of the USSR of the 70s in the present day, by searching for clues and solving problems. Atmospheric puzzle, Search for objects in 3D format, Game environment restored from photos of the 70s.

name: Craggenrock
short_description: Forge weapons and armors while improving your skills as the new blacksmith in town! Experiment with materials, haggle your way to profit and discover new recipes in this cozy, crafting shop management game Craggenrock.

name: Azrael
short_description: Azrael is a first-person Detective/Horror Game in which you play as a detective capable of reliving crime scenes. Explore different environments, find clues and try to find out who is the serial killer in a murder case among a group of friends.

name: Ableford
short_description: A 2d exploration game. You play as Casey and do some odd jobs for folks around town so you can build your machine.

name: Timeline
short_description: Timeline is a turn-based strategy game where you can play through the human history from stone age to modern times. In the game you command wide range of units, make them collect resources and build buildings, towns and cities, explore the map and meet other players controlled by AI.

name: Hypermind
short_description: Hypermind is a first-person puzzle game inspired by Portal. As a tester, you have been given four powerful abilities, and you will need to solve a series of interesting puzzles with combinations of these abilities and a touch of imagination.

name: Three Mazeketeers
short_description: Help these girls to finish the task by journeying through the labyrinth. Use different forms to see different perspectives and to tackle various challenges. Solve puzzles, make ways through the labyrinth, and find the source of the problem by utilizing all the abilities you have.

name: The Unfamiliar Story of Grandfather's Heritage
short_description: Returning to her grandfather's house years later, a woman finds herself in an adventure with ghosts from her past as the only way to uncover a terrifying truth.

name: PACK MY STUFF
short_description: Unleash the fun with PACK MY STUFF! Discover and pack objects into boxes in this exciting puzzle and hidden object game. As a mover in Neuberg, assist residents in packing their possessions. Enjoy the simplicity and thrill!

name: Video Game Tutorial
short_description: Have you ever dreamed of a game, where each level demonstrates a separate video game genre, uncovering it's specific features with a litlle irony? Well, today is your lucky day.

name: Истории ужасов: Воскрешение
short_description: Хоррор от первого лица, рассказывающий историю отчаявшегося мужчины потерявшего свою жену при загадочных мистических обстоятельствах. Потратив долгие месяцы чтобы связаться с женой в потустороннем мире он отправляется на поиски книги мертвых.

name: AI Roguelite
short_description: World's first RPG in which all entities are AI-generated and all game mechanics are AI-directed.

name: Hyperbase
short_description: You find yourself in a mysterious alien base from which no one has ever escaped. Explore the base's perilous inner labyrinths to uncover ancient secrets, escape from this hellish trap, and warn humanity of the impending danger.

name: The Backrooms: Survival
short_description: Survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomized levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity, ensuring a new experience every time. Play alone or with up to TEN friends online! Cross-platform multiplayer with Nintendo Switch.

name: Jigsaw Bestiary
short_description: Let's put the pieces together and meet amazing creatures. Here, the true mythologies behind the monsters are explained after solving each jigsaw. The beasts were illustrated by Alexandre Rocha (@semdizer) in his unique artistic style.

name: Project XMAS
short_description: Project XMAS is a retro style, horror, single - player game where you need to return to your home... The map is completely procedurallygenerated so every approach will be differend and specific.

name: Archrebel Tactics
short_description: Archrebel is a sci-fi turn-based strategy war game inspired by the classic Rebelstar released back in 1986. In Archrebel, players can control a few dozen of units in a grid-based map, performing actions limited by a classic action-point system similar to the one found in the UFO: Enemy Uknown.

name: Paper Trail
short_description: Paper Trail is a top-down puzzle adventure about leaving home, set in a foldable, paper world.

name: Maze Of Realities: Flower Of Discord Collector's Edition
short_description: Several mysterious worlds remained unexplored to humans until a detective took up a new investigation into the disappearance of a group of explorers in Greenland.

name: BALLYGON
short_description: BALLYGON is a physics marble-rolling game with over 150 unique stages! Clear courses quickly to get a high score or activate Modifier Mode to create a customized physics playground. Keep your eye on the ball and go for the goal!

name: Chest Mate
short_description: A precision based tower defense/puzzle game that focuses on optimization! Control your cannon, optimize your defenses and defend your mate! Chest Mate is a challenging aim-based strategy game.

name: Bobo Bay
short_description: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions.

name: Just another Jump And Run
short_description: Play this classic timed platformer alone or with friends and try to place your best times as high as possible on the leaderboard.

name: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant management simulator. Build and decorate, manage employees, create hundreds of classic dishes and drinks, make decisions and become the number one in the world.

name: Detective Max - Double Clues
short_description: Get ready to solve dozens of puzzles, use your sharp mind, explore mysterious locations and find evidence to find the killer. Can you become a true detective?

name: Looking Inside Cells
short_description: Looking Inside Cells is a set of interactive Virtual Reality simulations for learning about cellular biology. Users can build cells by arranging their organelles, as well as transform them into specialized cells, such as red blood cells and e. coli bacteria.

name: Shinehill
short_description: Yet again they dumped the toughest job on you. Now you are on a Shinehill Island, where you suddenly replaced one of the new residents. Explore the world, meet charming townspeople, do farming, fishing, cooking and try not to reveal yourself.

name: The Prison
short_description: Dive into The Prison, a modern reimagining of the classic late 90's game. Experience a vividly detailed prison world and strategic multiplayer gameplay. Customize your inmate, follow a gripping storyline, and discover new items and secrets. Will you escape or rule from within?

name: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II
short_description: An old-school hack-and-slash action RPG awaits! Pick one of five heroes, defeat monstrous enemies with weapons and spells, loot treasure and level up in this classic D&D fantasy adventure.

name: The Odarian Accounts
short_description: Come on Cedric! We don't have time to waste the Prince's Army are at our door steps we must defend defend ourselves. Remember to be firm and strong!

name: Granite Casket
short_description: Granite Casket is a claustrophobic horror about crawling with six degrees of freedom through caverns. Careful positioning and awkward angles will be needed to find the crevices within the earth no human was ever designed to go.

name: Tactics Adrift
short_description: A competitive turn-based tactics game with simultaneous planning.

name: Fly&Poop
short_description: Adventure-exploration 3D game. Fly, deliver messages, poop over people and cars to rescue Dovy. Funny, relaxing (but not so easy) game.

name: OOZEscape
short_description: Jump through obstacles as Ooze in this challenging 2D platformer where you can push your skills to the limit.

name: PROJECT : KNIGHT™ 2 Dusk of Souls
short_description: I saw that tall castle in my dream where normally there was an island... I'm now lost and there is no turning back... A lonely knight on top of a deadly castle... This game is a real time combat collectathon in the style of Dark Souls where you have to collect emblems to progress through a castle...

name: Ship of Heroes
short_description: Superhero sci-fi MMORPG with magic. Create your unique avatar and show your heroic side. Select and custom-augment your powers as you rise through the ranks. Team up to defeat enemies, or try the hardest content solo, if you dare… Harvest. Craft. Trade. Gain fame, wealth, and power.

name: 9-nine-:NewEpisode
short_description: Enjoy short after stories for the heroines of the 9-nine- series in 9-nine-:NewEpisode!

name: An Indie Game a Month: Unreal Journey
short_description: A collection of indie games developed for a month by a single person.

name: A Spirits Journey
short_description: Enter a hack and slash adventure where you gain spirit based skills to aid your journey. As you uncover plots to alter reality and seek revenge on the one who murdered you, or will you decide to aid your killers instead? Unravel your Story!

name: POG 7
short_description: Cute, minimal physical puzzle.

name: Figmin XR - Tilt Five
short_description: Figmin XR is a multi-purpose application for easily creating, collecting & playing with holograms. Powered by Tilt Brush Anything is possible! Create physics games, educational experiences, storytelling, art, visualization, e-commerce, marketing, or anything that you can imagine.

name: Danger Close VR
short_description: A VR Mil-Sim by Rockedge Studios

name: Trailthread
short_description: Trailthread is a turn-based JRPG where players weave together brand-new attacks each turn. Follow three young adventurers as they scale Anvite Mountain and tumble through time to defeat the Obsidian Drake. Use game-changing Augments to cast dynamic combos and carve your path to the summit!

name: Athemore
short_description: Explore the underground ruins of Athemore and learn about the forgotten past. Will you make it out alive?

name: Rogue Blight
short_description: Rogue Blight is a souls-like, rogue-lite, combat focused RPG. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Meet other struggling heroes. Death will be punishing, but you will get stronger with every journey. Are you up for the challenge?

name: drowning
short_description: immerse yourself in the world's first drowning simulator

name: Greed Hunters
short_description: Earn rewards for your greed in this chaotic, multiplayer rogue-like game. Explore randomly generated dungeons with up to 8 players in a world where greed is the currency. To survive, you must outsmart and out-hoard your teammates.

name: Pizza Arena
short_description: Finally fighting and cooking action as a local multiplayer game combined! Pizza Arena is a chaotic, competitive Cook’n’Slash party game for the whole family - and friends. Kill monsters, collect ingredients, bake pizzas and satisfy the spectators with delicious pizza!

name: Golden Jetpackman
short_description: help Golden Jetpackman go through the levels and defeat his enemy that is setting everything on fire. Atari 2600 style platformer 14 different stages. Includes achievements. Ajude Golden Jetpackman a vencer o inimigo que pôs fogo em tudo. Jogo estilo atari 2600 Com 14 fases diferentes

name: SynCo 2321
short_description: SynCo 2321 is a thrilling third-person action RPG shooter. Explore stylized environments ranging from ruined cities to alien worlds. Uncover the greatest plot to ever threaten humanity as you battle your way from an underground bunker across the galaxy.

name: Moa: The Cheyenne Promise
short_description: Explore the world as Moa, a 19 year old Cheyenne warrior who's best friend is a talking Orca whale named Mochie! Adventure with Mochie on more than 100 quests!

name: Radiometric Dating
short_description: A visual novel/dating simulator where you can date rocks! You play as a geology student who gets transported to a magical world during field camp. Meet handsome princes and navigate through magic encounters to find a way home!

name: Tide Up
short_description: Tide Up is a rather dark and gloomy adventure game. Accompany the girl in a dreamlike world of wonder. Collect the pearls scattered around the world and help the girl escape!

name: Triga
short_description: Slap triangular tiles down in this cause and effect, chain reactive, radically funky puzzle experience! Collect as many golden triangles as you can to unlock new levels, but don't sweat it if you aren't a triangle-brained genius: Each stage has 3 goals ranging from casual fun, to extreme puzzling!

name: SUPER NANARU
short_description: 「Nanaru」 the baker girl vs. 「Yako」 the devil! Save the town and take back the stolen bread from Yako in this side-scrolling action platformer!

name: Headpunk: The Comic-Style Battle Chaos

Compete in many competitive game modes or work with friends to solve puzzles and sling through the world together. Did we mention there are lasers?!

name: Jigsaw Pink
short_description: A traditional Jigsaw Game focused on cuteness and fashion. Complete your Wardrobe Gallery by finishing all the puzzles!

short_description: Визуальная новелла с глубоким сюжетом о парне, который не умеет жить эту жизнь. Помогите ему разобраться со своими тараканами, познакомьтесь со множеством интересных героев и узнайте, в чём смысл жизни!

name: Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum
short_description: Delve into the enthralling world of Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that'll take you on a moving journey of self-discovery.

name: Terra Forma: Tower Combat
short_description: Terra Forma is a pixelated 2D tower defense, inspired by Flash-age classics. Build a dozen unique towers and create even more fusions by combining shock, ice, fire, and iron. Prove your command prowess one final time, and defend mankind's final hope.

short_description: A JRPG/Visual Novel hybrid designed like the legendary RPGs of old! Follow Sabrina and friends as they travel across the world to defeat otherworldly forces that threaten Earth! Full of memorable characters, hidden secrets, challenging bosses and a rockin' soundtrack!

short_description: A fast-paced ARPG / roguelike hybrid with lasers, alien bugs, WASD / twin-stick controls, random loot, and procedurally-generated levels. Wield legendary weapons, unlock devastating skills, create overpowered builds – and turn your enemies' attacks against them. Try the free demo!

name: Trade Bots: A Technical Analysis Simulation
short_description: Trade Bots is an educational simulation game featuring technical analysis and algorithmic trading. Buy or sell an unknown stock using its real, historic data based solely on patterns and technical indicators. As your profit increases, unlock upgrades that help expedite + automate gameplay with bots.

short_description: In "Rolling in the Maze", players operate a small ball to challenge the maze. In order to reach the end, players need to crack according to the different level mechanisms of each level.

name: VEREDA - Mystery Escape Room Adventure
short_description: Vereda is a 3d escape room puzzle adventure. Play as a secret agent assigned a mission to recover a secret dossier set in an unusual town. Explore areas and take in your surroundings. Use all of your puzzle solving skills to make your way through the town and recover the missing dossier.

name: Phoenix: The Fall
short_description: Phoenix: The Fall is a multiplayer FPS featuring intense close-quarters combat, a dark near-future setting, and tactical team-based gameplay.

name: Z-Rush Survival
short_description: Survive in your Virtual Reality (VR) space in this Horror-Thriller based shooting Game. Stay alive by shooting down Zombies that surround you at 360 degree angle. Test you agility, precision & strategy

name: There is Still Hope
short_description: There is Still Hope is a single-player, adventurous, story-rich, mystery game. You play the character, Tom. Your job is to find your missing wife. To find her, you must go through a dark forest. You have a few tools and an uninvited friend to navigate the woods.

name: Knights of the Deep
short_description: Knights of the Deep is an online, action-packed arena fighting game with crustaceans. Choose your favorite brawler from the seas and duke it out against each other using a variety of weapons and special abilities. Each crustacean has a unique playstyle, learn them all and climb the hierarchy!

name: NUN
short_description: NUN is a third-person narrative and cinematic open-world adventure game, with action and RPG elements and a 1970s horror aesthetic. In 1820, Sister Mary-Martin, a Templar agent, is sent on a mission to the land of Winchester to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a young nun.

name: Outdoor Adventures With Marisa Kirisame
short_description: Go fishing, talk by a cozy campfire, and even hold hands with Marisa Kirisame from the Touhou Project as you go out with her in this short and cozy visual novel!

name: 最適解 Saitekikai Spy Simulator
short_description: In this game, you control a group of industrial spies, such as "head of household" and "drug addict" (to be added in the future), and infiltrate them into facilities that are hostile to your company. The aim of the game is to accomplish the requests without letting the spies get caught by security.

name: Graphwar
short_description: Graphwar is an artillery game in which you must hit your enemies using mathematical functions. The trajectory of your shot is determined by the function you wrote, and your goal is to avoid the obstacles and your teammates and hit your enemies. The game takes place in a Cartesian Plane.

name: ITRP _ Volatile Vertex
short_description: If you see a ledge, it means that it is needed for something. A three-dimensional puzzle platformer about the change of gravity in three axes. Walk on the walls and hang from the ceiling. Do whatever you want. The main thing is to get out of here.

name: Himbo Harem Homicide
short_description: A classic whodunit – but with a harem of himbos! Determine which of your hunky housemates is killing off the other handsome hardbodies before you’re left with not a handful of hotties, but just one murderous, monogamous man.

name: Maneater and the Golden Teacher
short_description: Maneater and the Golden Teacher is a dark and emotional 2D point and click visual novel set in the aftermath of nuclear Armageddon. A post-apocalyptic recon unit recruit makes his first voyage to the surface world and questions the reality of his lifestyle and the underground society he grew up in.

name: MALFUNCTION FPS

short_description: A horror anthology in the Dread X Collection series. Featuring 12 new games from up-and-comers along with veterans, all wrapped up in an old, run down party venue that may be hiding more than it's letting on...

name: Increment
short_description: Press buttons, pull levers, and use your body to discover a strange world in this numerical escape room. There’s nothing “idle” about this game. Immerse yourself in weird, colorful, reactive environments in this short, experimental, thought-provoking incremental adventure.

name: Grapple Gear
short_description: Grapple Gear is a fast-paced speed-running game focused on using the grapple for movement.

name: Dolmenjord - Viking Islands

name: Monster Island
short_description: Destroy all the monsters and save the island!

short_description: Gehena is a single-player first-person horror game. The only way out of the cursed town is to make the right choice and not get caught in the fog. Is what you see real or is your mind playing tricks on you?

name: PunjiVR: The Vietnam War
short_description: PunjiVR is an unforgiving tactical shooter set during the Vietnam War. Gameplay is non-linear, replayable, and intense. This is not just "another VR shooter" or a tech demo. The jungle wants you dead, will you give in?

name: Battle for the Droid Station
short_description: Battle For The Droid Station is a RPG shooting game now available on Steam. Feel the adrenaline as you run and gun down hundreds of rogue mechs and droids causing mayhem on the space station. Take control of your droid character and try to clear the space station from invading droids and robots.

name: The Night Watch
short_description: The Night Watch is a retro-styled survival horror set in an abandoned shopping mall. Investigate overnight vandalism reports as a night watch security guard. Restore every corrupted computer, and unlock new areas. Take on the night watch in online co-op mode, or venture in on your own.

Brave hordes of deadly creatures alone, or band together with your noblest of champions in co-op mode available both online and locally. Take on the challenges in three different campaigns, or build your own custom scenario.

An adventure set in a vertical world filled with floating villages, towns and temples Along the way, you will meet friends and enemies and puzzles will challenge you to gain more mastery of your flying skills.

Players embark on a journey of self-discovery and healing as they explore the enchanting world and uncover stories that come to life.

short_description: Expand your shelter in a unique take on the post-apocalypse genre, thrown straight into a wild world where women reign supreme across the wastelands. You are the last male, and all is for your taking.

Endlanders features two main characters with diverging storylines in the same universe, fighting their way through unknown planes.

Depending on the situation, you can collect the garbage in the subway so that your cleaning bar does not fall or you can beat the gang members who cross your path in the subway.

The Mage
