short_description: A fanmade game about Mr. Fruit and the Dream Team. A semi-linear turnbased RPG puzzle game where you play as Fruit, Rob, Blue, and Poppy to save reality from permanent sleep. Plenty of references, and a story deep enough to have things to spoil.

name: Meridiana - A demon's madness
short_description: You take on the role of Meridiana, a demon summoned to a high-fantasy world, and interact with others through her. As you travel the world, will your demonic nature take over, or will you learn from others how to be a good person?

name: RC Death Race: Multiplayer
short_description: "RC Death Race" - is a Racing Multiplayer RC Electric Car Combat game. You'll get to drive, shoot and and ram opponents in over 60,000 unique tracks. Destroy your friends in this demented shooting racing game using attack and defense powerups and be the first to see the checkered flag. ;)

name: Why Me
short_description: 3D 3rd Person Perma-Death Climbing/Running/Swimming Game with progressive difficulty. Some Traps are unfairly tedious. Set a Record Time or Record Death Count. The Question is "Can you beat the game ?"

name: Mystery Solitaire. Powerful Alchemist 2
short_description: Return to the Middle Ages and become a powerful alchemist! This is a new sequel to the beloved game.

name: Mystery Solitaire. Grimm's Tales 5
short_description: Help Little Red Riding Hood reach her grandmother's house and protect her from the evil gray wolf.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats
short_description: A new game in the series of 1001 Puzzles. Cute, funny, cozy cats will melt even the coldest hearts! Assemble the puzzle pieces and enjoy the cute faces of pets.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Wild Animals
short_description: Another new addition to the 1001 Puzzle series. Amazing wild animals in their natural habitat! Put the puzzle pieces together and observe the habits.

name: Package Inspector
short_description: Plunge into the dystopian land of Taxien and check packages at the local customs office! Which packages need to be sorted out? Which ones support the rebels and which ones support the state? Which side will you choose? And will you earn enough to pay your useless taxes?

name: Party Quest
short_description: Party Quest is a 2D MMO platformer chalked full of mini games (Party Quests), secrets, and more! Each unique Party Quest that you find and unlock will challenge you and your fellow party members to accomplish various tasks in a set time limit.

name: Spoils Of War
short_description: Spoils of war - Dirty thieves have made their way into your treasury and are trying to take out all the spoils of war! What does the insatiable spirit of destruction and revenge do in such a case? Treats guests with plasma clots and guards his treasures!

name: Lucky Villager
short_description: Lucky villager - The luckiest villager goes hunting for gold! Take all the treasure from the evil leprechauns before they chop you into juicy bacon in this hardcore platformer!

name: I am OK
short_description: Join the talented photography student Neera on a captivating journey through her memories. Haunted by recurring nightmares, her life spirals into chaos, questioning everything. Involuntarily, she returns to a place she once left behind: her childhood home.

name: Crane Game - Claw Machine Simulator
short_description: Play all your favorite claw machines! Features fully simulated physics for a fun and fair experience! Win and collect all prizes. Use these prizes in the photo mode and unleash your creative side!

name: Leviathan
short_description: Play as one of 3 factions as they fight for control of Domusalus. But beware of the Kaecillian menace as they threaten both the locals and the invading factions. Deploy with your gear, search for loot and escape in time to keep it.

name: Ghost Bros
short_description: Ghost Bros is a 1-4 player co-op ghost investigation game where you and your crew scour the globe for proof of the afterlife...and stream it for profit. Travel to real-life haunted destinations, search for the supernatural, use CPU companions, and build an audience as you risk your health for fame.

name: Stay away from zombies
short_description: When you wake up, you find that you are in some unfamiliar gloomy place, reminiscent of an old abandoned basement.

name: CRASH TEST IDIOT
short_description: You must destroy every car in the city.

name: SCALEPLANET
short_description: Somewhere in the third dimension there lives an alien Joe. He can't sit still. He constantly travels and explores the world and galaxies. This time he came across a new planet.

name: Avanzar
short_description: Avanzar is a fast-paced FPS Roguelike set in an ancient Aztecan temple. Reach the heart of the ever-changing temple by stacking up synergistic weapon upgrades and mastering the advanced movement mechanics while overcoming the guardians of the temple.

name: World of Stickman Classic RTS
short_description: World of Stickman - classic war strategy with stickman heroes. Collect resources, build your base and hire a powerful army.

name: Frontier Fortress - Tower Defense
short_description: Frontier Fortress is medieval-themed tower defense game. You are the leader of your nation. In the harsh medieval age you have to defend your land against foreign invaders. Fortify your frontier with defense structures and let none of them pass through your fortress.

name: The Reflection
short_description: The Reflection explores the connection to an alternate dimension that contains all the matter of the world inverted. From the surface, there appears to be simply a reflection of light, but submerging into the water reveals that this world is completely tangible, mirroring the world perfectly.

name: Psychosis
short_description: Fight against demons and your own mind to save yourself from a never-ending hell in this retro-style survival-horror game about mystery, psychology, and the coldness of killing. Banish demons with deadly weapons and reassemble the mysterious pieces of a family gone missing in Psychosis.

name: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition
short_description: Ready the Peashooters and prepare for the craziest, funniest shooter in the universe: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

name: Camae
short_description: Help Camae to get his colors back in this action puzzle adventure game. Fight to earn experience to improve your skills and solve a lots of hidden puzzles to get items that will help you on your adventure

name: Llanthmar
short_description: Llanthmar is a turn-based, strategy game that tasks you with ensuring the survival of your lost colony on an unknown planet. Gather resources, manufacture supplies, and fight back against anything that threatens to take them away.

name: Saber Ship
short_description: A musical rhythm game with a variety of strange gameplay

name: Cosmic Ball Tournament
short_description: Cosmic Ball Tournament is a single-player, first-person platforming arcade game where your objective is to quickly get through stages whilst accumulating a high score. Use speed and precision to progress and become the Cosmic Ball Champion!

name: Banner of Blood
short_description: An ever-shifting action RPG rich with Rogue-like elements. Lead your troops across randomly generated battlefields as a commander. Clash blades with savage orcs, and call a hail of arrows to vanquish monstrous foes.

name: The Original Wizard
short_description: The game is a Dungeon Crawler, where the player must survive the succeeding dungeons and defeat Impeficus on his throne.

name: Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War
short_description: Crisis in the Kremlin is a global real-time political strategy about the Socialist world in its final decade. Shape the fate of the world as you manage economy, foreign relations, and domestic policy. Engage with countries across the globe, using diplomacy or even proxy wars to expand your reach.

name: xVATrainer
short_description: xVATrainer is a UI-based machine learning app used for training TTS voice models using video game voices, for use in xVASynth.

name: Unsleepable
short_description: "Unsleepable" is a 3D horror game with a suspense story. The main character -- Mike Sorris ,had to find out the truth in this village, and leave the village.

name: Advanced Chess/Traditional
short_description: If “chess is the gymnasium of the mind,” as French scientist and philosopher Blaise Pascal once said, then I say "American Catur is the Full-Distance Ironman Triathlon of the mind" CEO Eric J Curtis. We have two fundamental tactic offensive and defensive bombs controlled with a roll 6 & 8 sided die

name: Whiskered Away
short_description: Whiskered Away is a fun, stress-free 2D platformer starring Gilbert and Skye!

name: Erstwhile
short_description: Erstwhile is a top-down roguelike adventure set in a long-forgotten past, where eerie atmospheres blend with uplifting moments. Level up by battling a variety of menacing monsters that inhabit your region and face colossal species bosses.

name: Respawn
short_description: Action packed roguelike for the fans of hard sci-fi. You're just a clone who woke up inside a human experiment. Fight your way through countless robotic opponents, destroy the maze itself!

name: Labyrinth of Zangetsu
short_description: Fight Japanese-folklore-inspired Yokai in a ink-brush illustrated Dungeon Crawler! Set in the moonlit city of Ido, the world has blackened under the 'Ink of Ruin' disaster. Conscript & customise your team of warriors as you venture deep into labyrinths and ink your destiny in a winding narrative...

name: Xheres
short_description: Either FPS or TPS, choose your play style and survive the apocalypse on your own or with your friends. But one must know for sure it ain't gonna be easy, there are hordes waiting for you. Not even considering tough ones... Nevertheless it's gonna be fun.

name: Far Star
short_description: Far Star is a story-driven action-adventure game with Metroidvania influences. There is something fishy going on in this galaxy, but this won’t stop your intergalactic general services crew from doing their job using a varied set of skills, weapons and outfits.

name: Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action Playtest
The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log4
short_description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

name: Deadland 4000
short_description: A turn-based post-apocalyptic roguelike set on a straight line. Scavenge food, sneak past enemies, find loot, and survive by any means necessary in the year 4000.

name: Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations
short_description: A short, single player, third person, tactical stealth action game set in the early 1990's meant to be finished in one sitting. Use the shadows, shoot out lights, stun enemies, and conceal yourself in the darkness through 5 Missions.

name: Tempus Island
short_description: An evil being has stolen the king's daughter and is on their way to bring ruin to Nakimbo island, fight through dungeons and rescue the king's daughter, just make sure not to destroy the world whilst you're at it.

name: Pizza Synthwave
short_description: You’re a parkouring astronaut in a retro-neon dreamlike world hurling trough the vastness of space in order to get the last slice of pizza. Wallrun, jump, climb, use your grappling hook and portals to get the fastest time! For fans of Mirror's Edge, Beat Saber and CS:GO Surfing.

name: Virium
short_description: Navigate and explore the twisted organic world with the ability to walk on anything! Climb large creatures, solve puzzles, unlock different forms and abilities, and uncover secrets in this atmospheric Puzzle-Metroidvania.

name: DreamPusher　メダルゲーム
short_description: Easy operation with just a tap! It's a medal pusher game like in an arcade! The maximum number of JP payouts is 99999, which is a threat!

name: Cards of the Dreaming Dragons
short_description: How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family. Figure out what they are thinking and deceive them to win. Play with 3-8 players.

name: Robot-X
short_description: A fast-paced platform shooter inspired by 90s classics. Follow Robot-X on a journey to protect the city from a new danger, fight bosses and jump over pits in this retro experience.

name: Fruit Basket TV
short_description: Fruit Basket is the world's premier lethal obstacle course gameshow. Contestants run, jump, and dodge their way to a shot at one million credits, while the timer on their lives ticks down. Join the competition, shoot for the best times, and unlock the most fashionable of hats in order to stay alive.

name: Building destruction
short_description: Building destruction - an exciting physical game aimed at destroying buildings and various structures.

name: The Ambassador's Coterie
short_description: Slow-burn kinetic short story about two Ambassadors of differing stations, empires, and species reclaiming their common ground -- and other common 'areas'.

name: Battle of the Four Towers
short_description: Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points, but if they defend they lose nothing.

name: Twilight's Final Judgement Prologue
short_description: Twilight's Final Judgement is a noir turn-based RPG. Players will explore a 1940s New York where the secret elites of the world are the Greek Gods. You will level up and build upon 4 playable characters. Players will also talk with NPCs learn secret lore and form bonds.

name: Scarecrows of Illyria
short_description: Sole survivor of a terrible incident, you find yourself in the company of new friends and new conflict on the island of Illyria.

name: HexTD
short_description: HexTD is a tower defense game where players can choose from 3 classes to defend their base. Deploy your machines, soldiers or elementals to create the enemies path and guard against powerful bosses, playing solo or with a friend to create a new experience in tower defense genre.

name: RecMaster Pro - Gameplay & Screen Recorder
short_description: RecMaster Pro is a super-easy and lightweight gameplay recorder, screen recorder, and audio recorder. It helps record HD/4K videos with the best quality and the smallest file size automatically without complicated settings. The advanced settings are also available and easy with clicks!

name: Psycho Crab
short_description: A 2D physics platformer with an unusual control scheme, Psycho Crab is a game where you will fall down. A lot. Possibly into lava.

name: Venture Towns
short_description: Make your own metropolitan utopia! Stores, mansions, towers--anything goes!

name: Mega Mall Story
short_description: Design a towering mega mall in this mall management simulation game.

name: Pocket League Story
short_description: Train your team to battle to the top in this sensational soccer team simulation!

name: Wildlife Planet: The Incremental
short_description: Wildlife Planet is a Simulation & Idle game with the theme of wildlife and nature. You will unlock more and more species as you level up and learn the species knowledge. This is a game with refreshing scenes, immersive background music, and different kinds of wild animals and plants.

name: Little Ninja
short_description: You are a young 8 year old boy named Liam, you recently got a ninja mask for a birthday present! You must protect the house from evil doers! You must be sneaky, and make sure to not get caught!

name: Dimensional Drift
short_description: Race through 4 unique dimensions in a ton of different cars with arcade-style driving. Unleash your inner racer as you explore these beautiful worlds. Upgrade your cars, paint them, make them monster trucks. Put on your seat belt, lets do this.

name: Space Out
short_description: Space Out blends elements from Breakout, pinball, and a space shooter to provide a unique, fast-paced, and challenging arcade experience.

name: Linelith
short_description: Solve puzzles embedded in rocks and crystals as you explore a colorful, serene alien asteroid. Discover a few clever twists as you progress in this short and sweet puzzle experience.

name: ANETHA
short_description: 아네사는 호러 어드벤처 게임입니다. 당신은 실종된 딸을 구하기 위해 해킹범이 전송하는 파일의 암호를 풀어야 합니다. 그러나 그 파일들은 모두 실종된 딸의 숨겨진 비밀을 품고 있습니다. 파일을 풀고, 딸의 비밀에 접근해 나가세요. 당신은 "왜" 이런 비극이 일어난 건지 알고 싶다면 말이죠.

name: Descending Horror
short_description: Find your self in a long lost place with not a sane sentence spoken.

name: Power (of) Metal
short_description: Power (of) Metal is a 2D hack/slash platformer, journey of Maleqqi who want to fulfill his emptiness inside of him and he will find the Power (of) Metal

name: Sea Of Minds
short_description: Sea of Minds is an immersive game in which you have to move through a crowd by slipping into the bodies of the people present. As you move from body to body, listen to their thoughts, listen to their problems and try to help them. They'll sure be grateful.

name: Magnetic Structures
short_description: Colourful magnetic rods and balls are at your command, Well, everything is ready, so it's time to build. Beautiful 3D magnetic structures will be made by your hands.

name: Base Craft: Desolate Survival
short_description: Co-op twin-stick base building survival game.

name: Unmurk
short_description: You only see the outer edges of the puzzle. Put the puzzles back into place to reveal a hidden voxel object.

name: For Your Information
short_description: First person, single player game about employee who think's that leaving overtime (not paid) in this company is simple.

name: Shapebreaker - Tower Defense Deckbuilder
short_description: A fusion of tower defense games and roguelike deckbuilders. Use your cards to build towers and to upgrade them in unique ways. Gain rewards to customize your deck, defense and playstyle. Break the shapes before they break you!

name: QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory
short_description: QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory is a tactical card strategy game based on the work of Miguel de Cervantes. Lead Don Quixote on his heroic journey and experience some of the most familiar episodes of the classic novel published in the 17th century.

name: Lost In The Space
short_description: Lost In The Space combines frantic top-down action with fast, fluid and very addictive gameplay, with instant response to player commands

name: Arcadia Fallen II
short_description: In this sequel to the award-winning Roleplay Visual Novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at Seven Wind’s Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as they navigate school life during a time of great change.

name: Vampiric Crown
short_description: Vampiric Crown is a side-scrolling action RPG set in a strange gothic world. A young vampire girl decides to rebel against her race, upon discovering that her sister will be the victim of a macabre plan to unearth the prince of darkness ...

name: Word Crystal
short_description: A daily word guessing game with four linked words of five letters apiece.

name: ISEKAI FRONTLINE
short_description: You are the only 'guy' in this zombie apocalypse world! Fight with endless zombie hordes and have a good time with cute girls!

name: CYBERHUNK
short_description: Collect crazy power-ups, upgrade your weapons into tools of destruction, and escape from the robotic zombie horde - alone, or with friends.

name: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
short_description: An iconic course for motorbike fans. 200km of open roads to practise on. Challenging physics. A simulation for the best riders.

name: Phantom Spark
short_description: The best feeling racing game out there. Precision time-trial racing against npc champions in the campaign or other players on the leaderboards.

name: Crane Logistics Simulator
short_description: Crane Logistics Simulator, Grow your logistics network!

name: Shooting Covid
short_description: Years and years after the virus outbreak, humanity has been suffering. Alpha Zen sends their last hope, Bella, to save humankind from the apocalypse. Bella's mission to restore hope and hunting for vaccines is risky and hazardous. She cannot do this on her own. So, she needs the best sidekick, you.

name: Pixel Pirate
short_description: Pxel Pirate - 2D-platformer about pirates, made in pixel art.

name: King of the Savage Realms
short_description: Real-time resource / defense game. Advance your build level by destroying enemies. Enemies are spawned from camps on either side of your territory. Eliminate the camps (and all spawned enemies) to end the raids and conquer the Scenario.

name: Bargue
short_description: Bargue is an online role-playing game with 12 people. You can be a good customer, a bad mafia, or a neutral thief. To survive each round, you must convince the opponent with voice chat. At the end of the day, the surviving team wins!

name: Lil' Guardsman
short_description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

name: Slurpy Derpy
short_description: Breed ever-stronger Derps. Use them to Bake, Conquer, Research and Evolve!

name: Dashing Orange
short_description: A 2D precision platformer about a little Orange that can dash and jump around this abstract world to avoid all the traps in the way to reach your goal.

name: Binary Run
short_description: The Reformat is inevitable. The Virus Spreads. Keep Running. Binary Run is a fast paced retro shooter inspired by 80s synthwave and retro shooters. Kill, collect and run your way through a corrupted digitial world, Keep Running.

name: Hand of Doom
short_description: Sign a contract in blood! Travel throughout the planes of existence slaying or befriending powerful doomlords in this wizard simulator inspired by the FMV games and dungeon crawlers of the early 90's. Learn powerful spells to solve puzzles and combat the dark forces amassing against you.

name: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
short_description: Fueled by love but driven by rage, Cherry embarks on a blood-soaked quest for revenge, explores the massive Megastructure, and eviscerates the armies of Infornet in a best-in-class action-adventure that breaks tropes and bones.

name: Directly Drink Milk from Cow　【直に牛乳を飲め】
short_description: The main character comes to work part-time at a ranch and takes care of 16 Holstein cows and their calves. He has to chase the cows with his dog, milk the cows, feed them, and carry the milk in buckets slowly without spilling. You can also take a car to explore and talk to the villagers.

name: Light The Lamp Hockey
short_description: Old School Hockey Gaming in a Beer League coat of paint! Welcome to the most dynamic 8-ish bit hockey experience you could have ever asked for. Built on simplicity and full of depth, Earn Points and Challenge for the Cup!

name: Cursed Dungeon Raider
short_description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

name: College Kings 2 - Episode 1
short_description: College Kings 2 is the highly anticipated sequel to the popular choice-driven Adult Visual Novel. Dive into a world of parties, sex and love as a college freshman and make your wildest fantasies come true.

name: Gigantic: Rampage Edition
short_description: GO GIGANTIC! THE UNIQUE MOBA HERO SHOOTER RETURNS!

name: Parabellum Beta
short_description: A semi sci-fi online PVP FPS shooter game with multiple maps, various weapon categories to master, incredibly fast paced movement with cool futuristic jetpack and jumppads around the map. Pickup armors and take control over enemy spawn to completely annihilate them

name: Mr. Honeybunch
short_description: A point-and-click adventure game taking place within a single room. Equipped with some trash and a makeshift time machine, and aided by a neurotic version of yourself from 5 years ago, you must traverse time, collect objects, solve puzzles, befriend a large zombie bee, and escape the madness.

name: My student loves me!
short_description: A short visual novel VR for adults where the story and play changes depending on your choices! You can become a tutor and fall in love with your student. Your student loves you and confesses her love to you. Let's make out as much as you want!

name: Sokobalien
short_description: Do you have what it takes to build the biggest space farm in the galaxy? Help the alien reach this goal in this classic Sokoban puzzle style game! Push cows, sheep, pigs and chicken so that the correct UFO beams can abduct them. (Also, as a side-quest, collect all the hats you can!)

name: Seekers
short_description: Seekers is a cooperative electronic board game in which a group of adventurers roam the world so they can decipher the hidden secrets of the universe. It can be enjoyed in groups of 2 to 4 players or in solo mode.

name: Sphere Shootout
short_description: "Blue Warrior 4" is a 2D cover tactical shooting game. The key to win in the game is not the shooting technique but the tactical walking.

name: MILF Conditioning
short_description: You happened to save a MILF who happened to be the wife of your landlord, yet she had a weak character that didn't match her status – she couldn't refuse others. Having learnt that, would you take advantage and sleep with the beautiful landlady?

name: Sight and Sound Town
short_description: Explore the town and Chat with palsTake on rhythm based challenges from the bizarre Clay CreaturesComplete these challenges to unlock MusicRetake challenges that you’ve beaten

name: Night Janitor
short_description: A first-person horror game where you clean up after rowdy high school kids while also keeping a lookout for clues as to their disappearance. Scrub, vacuum, clean... die?

name: M-1グランプリへの道　～俺たちの出囃子はもう鳴っている～
short_description: This is an exciting horizontal scrolling action game set in the world of "M-1 Grand Prix". Numerous rivals stand in the way stopping you, a comedian duo, from reaching the stage. Who will be waiting for you when they reach the final stage?

name: 捍卫SafeGuard
short_description: This game is a first person shooting game, players could choose different characters to join match, cooperate to occupy the stronghold.

name: Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore
short_description: A NEW interactive animated adventure! In this action-adventure game, Arzette must explore the Kingdom of Faramore, slay fearsome foes, acquire powerful items, discover secrets, assist colorful characters, and defeat the evil Daimur!

name: Kamiwaza: Way of the Thief
short_description: Join honorable thief Ebizo on the streets of Mikado, and put your thieving skills to the test! Will you walk the path of honor for the sake of family? The choice is yours to make.

name: StudioS Fighters: Climax Champions
short_description: An entire generation of StudioS characters all fighting to be #1! Fight your way to the top with satisfying and easy to execute combos! A unique retro-style game inspired by 90s era handheld fighting games!

name: Muse:Valkiri&Dungeon
short_description: This is a combination of third-person and first-person shooter game. As a warrior, you should break through seven stages to rescue Valkyries from demonic control.

name: Jello
short_description: Jello is a physics-based platformer redefining movement mechanics. Jump, slap, slide, swim and roll using your controller or mouse in an unconventional, tactile way

name: Fury Life
short_description: Fury Life is a Conway's Game of Life simulator where cells are visualized as animated creatures called "Octos".

name: Get Out Of My Space
short_description: These damned people have been reigning in our part of space for too long. They kidnap our people and conduct experiments on them. We cannot afford to be treated like this.

name: The Antarctic Sphere
short_description: The Antarctic Sphere is a sci-fi narrative game in which you decipher an unknown language in order to communicate with a mysterious sphere that has been found under the ice of Antarctica.

name: Warplanes: Battles over Pacific
short_description: Warplanes: Battles over Pacific opens the next chapter in aviation history. Become a World War II pilot and take part in the campaign against the Empire of Japan. The sequel to the hit Warplanes: WW1 Fighters, takes dogfight to a new level.

name: The Butcher
short_description: Fighting your way through hellish enemies to seek vengeance in this dark-fantasy action game.

name: Jewel Match Origins 2 - Bavarian Palace Collector's Edition
short_description: Travel back in time to the Romantic Era and build a magnificent castle in this royal match-3 adventure! Explore 200 huge levels and collect resources to construct a majestic palace for the Bavarian King. Enjoy 3 different modes: timed, relaxed, and moves limited!

name: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
short_description: A first-person psychological and survival-horror experience. You are lost in the Backrooms and you have to find a way to survive in this dangerous universe. Explore the different levels, meet the Entities and other Explorers, and find clues to reveal the Backrooms’ secrets.

name: Spirittea
short_description: Hey human, we've got problems! This town is crawling with troublesome spirits, and you're the only one who can see them. You'd better get that old bathhouse up and running, maybe that'll help them chill out!

name: Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer
short_description: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.

name: Dreamsettler
short_description: Sleepnet. It's where dreams are literally made. But sometimes dreams need a little help, and that's where you come in. They say a private eye never sleeps, but to crack these cases you'll need to be out cold.

name: CyberScope
short_description: CyberScope is a hybrid first-person shooter and puzzle platformer where you create, code, jump, and hack your way to defeat the rogue AI who is planning to eliminate humanity. Will you stop the rogue AI? Or will you join their ranks?

name: Sticky Struggles
short_description: Inspired by the classic Sokoban games, Sticky Struggles is a uniquely challenging puzzle game that will test your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking. With 50 levels of increasing difficulty, along with a set of bonus levels, Sticky Struggles will keep you entertained for hours.

name: Hexagonal Tower
short_description: [Hexagonal Tower] is a tower defense game with cards and roguelike random elements. Try to deploy your turrets and various reinforcement components in the dungeon to form a unique and powerful defense. Darkness is coming. Guard the last fortress of mankind with your wisdom!

name: Z-STOP
short_description: You are the last human, abandoned on a zombie infested island. There’s only one thing you must do, escape alive. Scavenge through what remains to acquire weapons and tools to help along the way. Outrun the horde, stay inside at night and discover what horrors led to the island’s downfall.

name: Hate's Offering
short_description: After losing his family to the killer he seeks to unmask, Detective Jack Whiting is kidnapped and locked in a basement of harrowing puzzles, soul-crushing decisions, and hellish sacrifices. Survival comes at a great cost, but before you can survive, you have to truly open your eyes.

name: Lost Skies
short_description: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

name: Bleeding Abyss
short_description: Bleeding Abyss is a chaotic, fast paced, overwhelming bullet hell game. Plan and manage your survival by investing your hard earned rewards into resources and unravel the secrets that lie in the underground. Do you have what it takes to escape?

name: MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE

name: Sanctum Breach: Rebirth

Venture forth as you struggle to find your place in the world, a Nomad, wandering from village to village attempting to unravel the mysteries of your place here in Petura. An Endgame focused ARPG full of customisation, loot and more!

name: The Detective
short_description: Detective vintage game. Ask questions, search for clues, and items. Objects can tell stories too. In your notebook, you will mark who is lying and who is telling the truth.

name: Wizards of Chaos
short_description: Become the Wizard who brings Chaos and Destruction to the world of Evil before It gets you! Destroy and loot everything in this Action Roguelike RPG. Find Artifacts, learn spells and expand your game with every achievement. Control your Wizard with only your mouse or one stick.

name: Simon the Sorcerer Origins
short_description: Simon the Sorcerer Origins is the official prequel to the acclaimed point-and-click adventure series. Get ready to return to the Magic World and discover new backstories about the most sarcastic wizard in video games!

name: Karate Beasts
short_description: Karate Beasts is a story based simulated 2D game you have to train your beast in order to be the best and restore your family's pride by beating the villain named Dark Sensei's beast.

name: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights
short_description: Immerse in a multiplayer world where high-speed racing blends with intense vehicle combat. Choose from a variety of uniquely armed cars for strategic battles across vivid cyberpunk cities, focusing on skillful driving and deep customization.

name: Quantum Apex
short_description: Sci Fi Stunt/Street Racer With Nitrous. Strong emphasis on fun. I need time to morn my baby boy :( progress halted until further notice.

name: Roll Player - The Board Game
short_description: Create the ultimate Fantasy character by rolling dice, building attributes, purchasing weapons, gaining skills, and discovering character traits in Roll Player, a digital adaptation of a popular board game of dice manipulation and strategy!

name: Subway Simulator
short_description: Have you seen those old subway stations? It’s time for a makeover! Renovate them using a wide range of tools. Fix old tracks, put in new ones, and clean up the debris. Turn stations into beautiful spots by adding benches, posters, and plants. Create your own unique designs in the Subway Simulator!

name: Nobody Wants to Die
short_description: Lose yourself in the dystopian world of New York, 2329; immortality comes at a price that someone has to pay. In this interactive noir story, lead the investigation using advanced technology, as Detective James Karra who risks it all in pursuit of a serial killer targeting the city’s elite.

name: Angst
short_description: Escape the cube.

name: The Price Of Flesh
short_description: An immersive choose-your-own-adventure survival horror with optional adult content featuring hand drawn backgrounds, sprites, and over 150 pieces of full screen art- and 50 endings.

name: Rooted
short_description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

name: Murder Is Game Over
short_description: Join the investigation in Murder Is Game Over, a pixel art point-and-click game where you and Cleo try to solve the murder of a famous game designer. Can you uncover the clues and catch the killer before it's game over?

name: Times Tables Hunt
short_description: A funny game for kids to learn and practice the times tables

name: 三国仁义传 the Romantic of Righteousness: SanGuo Playtest
Tiles and Towers TD
short_description: A 3D tower defense where not only the towers matters but also the ground that alters the towers. Spiced up with randomized wave modifications, skilltree, unique towers and spells. Voila! You get Tiles and Towers TD!

name: PROTOTYPE
short_description: In the neon-lit world of PROTOTYPE, 07Vanguard, a powerful AI prototype, battles hordes of menacing robots. Equipped with combat techniques and a vast arsenal, it faces increasingly challenging enemies. Power-ups aid its survival, but the ultimate test comes with the appearance of formidable Bosses.

name: Oil Invasion
short_description: You are super soldier whose mission is to find captured oil which is captured from evil army from East

name: Chill Town
short_description: A unique blend of a Soothing Simulation and an Idle Game with Music, Decoration, Fishing, Cooking, Farming and more...

name: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League Playtest
Bunker Renovator
short_description: Find and buy abandoned bunkers and underground shelters to turn them into an estate of your dreams - a shop, a modern flat, a warehouse or maybe even an underground club!

name: Ellisar
short_description: Dive into this magical underwater adventure. Explore a corrupted environment moving with your two transformations to help fix the disaster that almost ended life around your world. Ellisar is a third person contemplative exploration and adventure game.

name: Nature's Habit
short_description: A game by Swinging Pixels is set in the year 2060 when the earth's ecosphere is on the brink of collapsing. You play as a smart synthetic waterdrop whose main objective is to traverse the environment created by a group of scientists and ecologists named "Clepsydra".

name: Darkest Dungeon® II
short_description: Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

name: Ultra Mission™
short_description: Embark on a dangerous investigation in Ultra Mission™, the latest game by Gumbo Machine™. As an agent of the Stellar Exchange Commission, you must traverse the 20 dizzying levels within Otto Labs, each littered with powerful automatons and questionable experiments. This is going to be a blast!

name: ReTAKE
short_description: "ReTAKE" is the latest fantasy 2D side scrolling combat game! Upgrade your favorite characters, collect rare items that allow you to unlock special skills and spells, get monsters as pets, and join your friends to defeat the hordes of enemies and numerous giant bosses!

name: Lonely Knight
short_description: Lonely Knight is a story that immerses you in an epic adventure in the medieval era. Avenge your wife as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast-paced combat, castle sieges, and more.

name: Dogfight
short_description: Arcade shoot-’em-up action is back! Team up with the entire family for explosive action, signature humor and thrilling adventure. Join the Sausage Bomber Corps for daring missions to defend the nations of Relishtonia and more against the world-conquering ambitions from the mysterious Vega Nation.

name: Starri
short_description: Starri is a body-controlled rhythm game you can play with just a webcam, no VR required. Feel your heart pumping as you slash or catch the beat, dodge obstacles, and turn the wheel. Engage your body with more than 50 songs.

name: Tilebreaker
short_description: Destroy blocks through 20 levels and 5 unique bosses with different mechanics. Do it in the best possible time!

name: Soda Sabotage
short_description: Soda Sabotage is a Sci-fi 2D top-down shooter, where the player guns his way through 25 levels and 5 bosses belonging to a soda weapon factory using their own weapons against in order to disable the evil soda weapon making factory. Shoot, dash but most importantly survive!

name: Liberty Castle: Home of the Free
short_description: As The success of Freedom Castle hinges on the strength of the community, our focus will always be centered around creating a positive environment for attracting original thought. Our intent is to bring out peoples innate desires for open discussion and immersive social experience.

name: PVNP
short_description: A classic Sokoban game but with a modern take. 50 levels to test your brain in a semi-open world.

name: True Demon
short_description: The devil has a new stock broker. In this game you'll play as True Demon who sets out to bring the corrupted back to hell. It is an adventure rpg with weapons, armor, dungeons, bosses, and treasure hunting. Come join True Demon in the Hell's trading floor.

name: Peasant TD
short_description: Peasant TD is a fantasy tower defence game with card game elements. Towers are built and upgraded through cards that are bought in the shop or crafted from the forge. This means every game will be unique, you will not be able to rely on a specific build order or strategy. Adaptation is necessary.

name: Lich Queen's Curse
short_description: An interactive fiction role-playing game. With a non-linear story line, your choices determine how the story plays out. Recruit allies to join your party, form relationships with party members, and even find romance. Will you choose a path of light? Or a path of darkness?

name: The Creator
short_description: The Creator is a peaceful meditative game-simulator where you create unique designs for locations and territories. Enjoy the creative process without searching for resources or fear of making mistakes, as you design stunning interiors and exteriors in picturesque corners of the world.

name: Scary Wife HD: Anime Horror Game
short_description: You wake up in your house but there is a girl here. She said she is your new wife and you are the husband. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with her. Is it some kind of prank? Something is very creepy about her, say hello to your new scary wife!

name: Monster Stalker
short_description: Monster Stalker combines card battle and RPG. Monster invasions have occurred all over the world. You survived from a monster attack and started to investigate the reason of monster invasions. You will collect cards, build your deck and fight various monsters. Go fight and save the earth!

name: Fortress Building Puzzle
short_description: Fortress Building Puzzle is a puzzle game where you need to remove all the cubes to bring your castle to the ground, which is quite high.

name: Booty Farm [18+]
short_description: Congrats, you just inherited a farm and your hot neighbors will not let you be! Erotic hijinks ensue on your neverending quest to expand your farm! Discover spicy romances and intertwining stories in this bizarrely relaxing farm simulator.

name: Lands of Vodria
short_description: Climb the throne in this tactical game with clever maneuvers in card battles, as well as long-term strategy on the map.

name: Amarantus
short_description: Roadtrip across the country. Confront a tyrant. The revolution will be messy—but the relationships will be messier.

name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Rei
short_description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

name: Golden Mine Pickaxe 2: Mummy Tombs
short_description: Golden Mine Pickaxe 2 is a sequel to the sandbox game of the same name with RPG elements. Your hero goes to ancient tombs to find even more gold and new resources. Move deeper into the tombs, upgrade your weapons and defeat new enemies to collect as many resources as possible!

name: Outcasts of Dungeon:Epic Magic World Fight Rogue Game Simulator
short_description: Outcasts of Dungeon is a third person fantasy action Being in the role of a powerful War Mage with dozens of deadly weapons and spells, defend your kingdom fortress from a rampaging mob of beastly invaders.

name: Feartten Noir Story
short_description: Feartten noir Story - is a 2d platformer with a mysterious horror theme. Go through the cursed depths of hell and try to get out of the nightmare of a boy. Are you ready to go through all the circles of hell to overcome your fears?

name: The Jelly Adventure
short_description: The Jelly Adventure is a puzzle-casual game peefect for kids or even for those who had a more stressful day.

name: Lucky Pikinini - Zombie Rampage
short_description: First-Person Story-Telling Game with a 7 Chapter Story Campaign, Verde Diamente Presidente Francisco Antonio Rodriguez Mobilizes La National Policia And Military To Combat A Nation-Wide Outbreak Of Zombies, Calling For The Manhunt & Prosecution Of 3 Scientists Who Engineered It.

name: Flightless
short_description: Help the flightless bird, Dover, build confidence by teaming up with 5 partners in this turn-based RPG where your timing matters! Solve puzzles, beat baddies, and tackle platforming challenges to uncover the mysteries of a quirky island, save Dover's family, and... dethrone the Mothia?!

name: Nora's AdventurEscape
short_description: Do you seek an adventure? Maybe an escape from daily struggles? Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and escape rooms.

name: Colors Live
short_description: A powerful and fun painting app/game!

name: Project: Artificial Legacy Saga
short_description: Embark on journey through the "Project: Artificial Legacy Saga" a four-part series, crafted to feel as if it was released across four console generations. Follow Kirana on her heroic journey, as she protects her family and her homeland from a mysterious evil force.

name: Sleep Paralysis: The Uncanny Valley
short_description: Trapped in a relentless cycle of terrifying sleep paralysis, your grip on reality begins to slip. One night, you awaken in a place that feels like home—but something is deeply wrong. Uncover the mystery and shape Thomas' fate through meaningful choices.

name: Cool People Club
short_description: Join the Cool People Club in an epic quest to prove their coolness to the world! Dodge bullets, fight powerful foes, and determine your fate in this surreal 3D bullet hell adventure.

name: Football History Football Simulator
short_description: The Football History Simulator provides play creation for football coaches. It can be customized to accommodate the user's branding from team uniforms to stadium field markings.

name: Dancin Divas
short_description: A robbery has taken place! Four Diva's from around the world are showcasing their treasures at the local lounge but things have gone south. It's time to fight back!

name: Inn Keeper
short_description: Embody an innkeeper in a unique first-person management game set in a medieval-fantasy world. Build your inn, adapt to your clientele and establish a thriving economy.

name: Super Turbo Racing
short_description: Super Turbo Racing is your drag racing game. The main goal of the game is to defeat all rivals, earn money in-game and become the ultimate car collector, own every luxury car in the game.

name: Tonikk Tycoon
short_description: Tonikk Tycoon is an open world simulator, where you can make money and spend that money. Go from working a typical job at a restaurant to owning multiple businesses that you built up, and massive homes with garages full of your personal cars!

name: The Cub
short_description: From the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Return to their whimsical, neon-lit apocalypse in a Jungle Book meets The Armageddon fusion. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a child being hunted, while catchy end-of-days tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.

name: Burrito Bear
short_description: Burritos are raining from the sky - Bear wants to eat them, but colliding with dangerous falling garbage causes serious gas! Before indigestion strikes, Bear needs your help to eat them all!

name: theBootCamp
short_description: This game is a prototype to demonstrate the LuckyGene Indie Studio - LuckyGene Games' Development, Game Design, Animating, Environment Design and Gameplay Development expertises. We have published this project since 2021 to add it to our portfolio.

name: Masks Of Deception
short_description: Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... otherwise the demon will slay you first.

name: Escape the Ayuwoki DEMAKE
short_description: Re-experience the classic Escape the Ayuwoki adventure through this Demake, solving more complex puzzles and exploring new places with the old camera angles of 90’s horror games.

name: Kenosis: The Liminal Tapes
short_description: Enjoy this single player horror experiences to explore, solve puzzles, find recordings and documents with lore, escape the monster, and try to find your way out of the creepy places of each tape.

name: F.I.D.O.
short_description: Follow the very unique premise of an indie horror game about a demo-.... ok maybe not so unique, but we have a dog so there's that.

name: Bulletproof
short_description: Shooter: Immerse yourself in this incredible simulation of shootings and fighting, which brings you different levels in different times that will make your imagination fly. / Endless Runner: Do you think you can be bulletproof? Try the innovative shooting simulator.

name: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter
short_description: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

name: Garage: Bad Dream Adventure
short_description: You are thrown into a weird world by the machine Garage. Can you escape from it?

name: Starfall Protocol
short_description: Starfall Protocol is a Starship colony sim with RPG adventures in a galaxy with millions of explorable planets!🌌

name: Groovy
short_description: Groovy is a fast-paced precision platformer where you can manipulate the colors of the world. Use your color powers to avoid traps, walk through walls, and launch through levels.

name: Barbarq 2
short_description: Fun Competition & Clan Exploration, Dive into the Barbaric World

name: Bullet Quest
short_description: An RTS inspired resource management TD. Takes place in a bleak mechanical dystopia were the factory reigns supreme.

name: Futuristic Museum
short_description: You can see the museum of the future through VR. Touch, feel and experience mysterious places with various themes!

name: Toilet Chronicles
short_description: Toilet Chronicles - is a first person horror-comedy game with a mystical setting where you're trapped in a public restroom and need to find a way out with the help of your toilet neighbor. Every choice you make brings you to a different outcome.

name: sobosuba
short_description: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.

name: Strategy
short_description: Unlimited stream of Roguelike cards. The infinite world in the infinite universe is waiting for you to explore, it is time to set off. Bring your favorite cards, take your favorite relics, and call your comrades for a grand carnival adventure!

name: theBestiary
short_description: Risk and fight with vampiers and other creatures ,explore a medieval world and find hidden secrets .theBestiary is about survive and explore ruined Kingdom of Toprak ,upgrade your safe place and make quests in the chase after money and power .Be the best mercenary and find the lost book.

name: Soul Street
short_description: Psychic Sleuth: Street of Falling Souls is a deductive adventure game that combines narrative and puzzle solving, with rational reasoning to obtain relevant and important information to advance the story and unravel the truth of the case, as well as the mysterious forces behind the organisation.

name: hehe
short_description: this game is 2d platform survivor game. Once upon a time, there was a small sugar cube, onece they were playing a game with their friends, they were attacked by the tea monster! and the tea monster threw all sugar cubes into it, only our sugar survived (drink your tea without sugar)

name: Layers of Fear
short_description: All stories must come to an end, even twisted and eerie ones. The canvas. The stage. The novel. This narrative-focused psychological horror experience is ready for its final brushstrokes, its curtain call, its final chapter. Are you ready to return and face your fears one last time?

name: Demomen Ltd. - Demolish And Construction Simulator
short_description: Demomen Ltd. allows you to become an Outback Demolition Expert and manage your crew in some of the craziest demo jobs this continent has ever seen! Gear up, hire the most incompetent employees, have a cold one, and build your own demolition business! (Grog not included)

name: Mechanical Sunset
short_description: A mechanical Scandinavian puzzle/adventure where you face a catastrophe that is looming on the horizon -- threatening the existence of the Walking City of Machines, home to thousands of robots. You are its last hope, and the only solution is through machinery.

name: 心Soul
short_description: This is a brain-burning puzzle game, with well-designed puzzles everywhere, find clues, analyze the hidden meanings in the clues, solve the puzzles, and finally unlock the secrets of the whole world. Let your brain turn at a high speed, ding, and enjoy the thrill of solving the puzzle!

name: Midway:Sink the Japanese Aircraft Carriers
short_description: This is a Battle of Midway simulation game. You need to fly a dive bomber, dodge Japanese anti-aircraft fire, drop bombs and destroy the carrier. The Japanese gunfire is extremely fierce, please be careful. I hope war only exists in games and I support Ukraine.

name: Ponster 怪武大师
short_description: In the game, weapons will revolve around small monsters and launch them at the right time, causing damage to the enemy. The unique real-time turn system makes the launch time of weapons very important. Acquire weapons and relics to arm yourself and ascend the throne of weapons master!

name: Isle of Arrows
short_description: Isle of Arrows is a Puzzle Tower Defense game in which you build a fortress in the sky. Place towers, expand the isle, and build your own paths. Can you find the perfect spot for each tile to beat the RNG and defend against waves of invaders?

name: All Alone with Mannie
short_description: All Alone with Mannie is a difficult, quick reflex, survival horror game where your only tools of defense is a flashlight and a dingy flower blanket. ...Your only downfall, is your eyes...

name: Astrocat: Milky Way Journey
short_description: Skylar is an astronaut cat who took a lot of cool pictures of the Milky Way, but she needs to gather the pictures to send to the scientists of her planet, help her and discover lots of data and curiosity about our galaxy in this 2D puzzle.

name: Ukrainians: Our battle
short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of military events, become one of the volunteers of the country, where your every decision can become critical. Explore locations, make decisions, complete challenging missions. Everything is in your hands. Good luck!

name: Love In a Bottle
short_description: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can live on her own, but the CUTE SINGLE LADIES IN HER AREA might turn out to be a distraction! Can she settle down and find love?!

name: Trailer Tales
short_description: A charming story-based puzzle game that replicates the soothing and satisfying challenges of camping in bite-sized isometric spaces. As you meet and walk in the shoes of other campers, you discover more about yourself in relation to others and the world around you.

name: Delivery in Space
short_description: In this puzzle game, your goal is to navigate to the planets using cards to move around the grid. Each card has a type and movement amount. Make your strategy to calculate the best route, crossing space obstacles and reach the planet successfully!

name: On the Dragon Wings - Birth of a Hero
short_description: Get ready for the Best Dragon Riding Experience! You are not born as a Hero. But you can become one of them! Bruce and Ursula are brother and sister. One day their life starts to change with a Dragon. Now, It is time to become a Hero by saving their captive father from Dark Rider.

name: Broken Edge
short_description: Broken Edge is a 1v1 VR fantasy sword fighting game where you embody iconic warriors in deadly duels. Claim victory in the arena as a fierce Samurai, a valiant Knight, an untamed Rōnin, or one of the 5 other fighters (and more to come)!

name: Natural Spirit
short_description: Natural Spirit is a third-person adventure game where you will play as the shiba Yukito, to help the spirit Aura to save the tree of life from a certain death that would doom us all.

name: PIPI IS YOU
short_description: PIPI IS YOU IS a platform box-pushing game that solves puzzles by firing bullets to push boxes and changing the rules of the scene, completing levels with smooth, multi-stage jumps.

name: Cosmic Ascension
short_description: Arcade Action Roguelike set in a 2D Sci-Fi setting. Destroy countless enemies, fight bosses, discover artifacts, unlock new ships and upgrade your current ones.

name: CYCLE
short_description: Help Lana find the truth about her mother's death in this exploration-based platformer game!

name: SPLIT
short_description: Create your own path by splitting your character and the world in this 2.5D puzzle-platformer. In the World of Abstraction, you must navigate through the bizarre levels and use your splitting power to bend the world to your favor and eventually escape.

name: Terralora
short_description: Everything has gone to crap, you know your end will come soon enough, but you decide you’ll face your fears. Take on Beth’s final wish, set out to purify Aerlysia of all great demons, and seize the power of the Dreamstone.

name: Ashen Arrows
short_description: Ashen Arrows is a Nordic mythology-themed VR archery game featuring roguelike gameplay, tower defense elements, and puzzles.

name: Hidden Harbor Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Zom Tom
short_description: Zom Tom is a 2.5D shoot' em up dungeon-crawler where you slay zombie bodies, survive the hell-spawn onslaught, and full send copious amounts of lead downrange.

name: KAOS SurVival
short_description: Get ready for chaos in KAOS SurVival! Explore an open world, gather resources, and build shelters to survive. Form clans, raid other players, and craft essential items. In a world where everything can be destroyed, only the strongest will reign. Prove your strength and dominate the chaos!

name: Oroboro
short_description: Explore an open world and fight foes for loot and resources in a 2D side-scroller action RPG. Then return and share with your friendly NPCs, manage relationships, gossip, progress skills, and rebuild the destroyed town.

name: Five Stages of Pink
short_description: Horror mystery about a boy who desperately wants a Normal life in the most abnormal city in the world. Help Timor understand his cruel life in this supernatural city while trying to survive one more day. In a universe where Sleep is an illness. This is a visual novel with point and click features.

name: Heartstop
short_description: Heartstop is an emotional, story-driven game, taking place in a world where every living being has suddenly stopped moving. Uncover the mystery of this eerie event while building a dynamic relationship between the only two people remaining, through the many impactful and hard-hitting choices.

name: Uootoy 3671
short_description: The legendary comic action puzzle "Uootoy" from 1984 is now available in its ultimate version with all the elements enhanced! The combination of various simple tricks is easy for anyone to understand, and the various stages that stimulate your creativity will keep you hooked!

name: Angel Perversion
short_description: Angel Perversion is a kinetic visual novel. The guardian angel Umabela is not satisfied with the life of her protégé, so she decides to break the rules and make his life much easier.

name: Last of Humanity
short_description: Welcome to Last of Humanity, an online open-world sandbox multiplayer zombie survival game. Travel the zombie wasteland as you attempt to rebuild society controlling key locations to manufacture & produce equipment for survival. Forage, Craft and shoot your way to survival from the dead and living.

name: Death's Dungeon
short_description: Survive the onslaught of Death's Dungeon in a rogue-like dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Shoot and melee your way through various dungeons with four different classes.

name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution
short_description: Hunted by the seemingly unstoppable Axeman and facing off against the Tower’s latest push for total dominance, discover what connects these new threats together before it’s too late. New faces, places, weapons and gear all await you on your journey to a final showdown for the city's fate.

name: Fidget Spinner RPG
short_description: Fidget Spinner RPG is a clicker/incremental RPG game in which you craft items and level up abilities to make a fidget spinner spin at absurd, ever increasing speeds.

name: Advenclave
short_description: Join the Grand Archive in Advenclave - an open world action RPG. You are tasked with filling a magical grimoire with your own story. Learn spells, engage in thrilling combat, and work with the Head Librarian to chronicle your adventures. Explore different realms and cement your place in history!

name: Two Sisters
short_description: Witness the obscure scenario of a massacre, in the shoes of the photographer Bárbara, who received an unusual proposal: To photograph a village with bizarre secrets from decades ago.

name: LiMiT's Escape Room Games
short_description: Try to solve the puzzles of the 2 levels (apartment and office) alone or with your friends to escape from the rooms. Both levels are designed for 1 to 1.5 hours of play each. Can you beat this time?

name: polyemisokos
short_description: An abstract puzzle game about connections.

name: B.I.N.D.
short_description: A visual novel with an overwhelming scenario volume equivalent to three light novels! The love-hate drama between a new female guard, a prisoner, and a senior guard is finally complete!

name: The Nihil War
short_description: The Nihil War is a game that blends cinematic platformer, base management, and strategy into one package. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, you will take the role of a young prince accused of being involved in your father's death. Build your forces, traverse the beautiful world, and unveil the truth!

name: The Pit
short_description: A flashy, fast paced, third person action roguelike filled with exciting characters, biblically accurate enemies, fully procedural environments and build customization to fit your play-style and become an unstoppable god.

name: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor
short_description: You are in a barbarian land. They are trying to kill you. The Queen demands you tame them. So what now? Escape into an exciting, open-ended story and cunning tactical combat. Epic, indie fantasy adventure. Freely explore a huge world, fight for fame and power, and shape the world as you choose.

name: Vox Siege
short_description: Vox Siege is a an Action-RPG Tower Defence game. Where you play as a hero who build towers and use hero abilities to help defend Vox on their journey to close all dark portals that is wrecking their land Fiora.

name: Being a Penguin
short_description: A short exploration open world game about a penguin who doesn't want to be a penguin. Bump and slide your way through a little frozen world with penguin physics.

name: Automatrain
short_description: Automatrain is a game about building automated railroads and industry, in a world governed by an omnipotent AI. Manage production and traffic to unlock more trains, factories and advanced gameplay features.

name: Coffeehouse Simulator
short_description: Have you ever dreamed of owning a small place where you can sell coffee, tea, and cake to your lovely customers? Coffeehouse is exactly that! Take care of customer orders, make coffee, resolve customers problems and lose yourself in this first-person management game!

name: OPUS: Prism Peak
short_description: OPUS: Prism Peak is a narrative-driven adventure game where you play a weary photographer who finds himself caught outside of reality. Using your old camera, you’ll explore an ethereal realm and its ties to the world you left behind, uncover its mysteries, and ultimately find your way home.

name: Recreation Room
short_description: Your personal holo-deck, escape the stressful real world and take a nice walk!

name: beat refle
short_description: This new take on rhythm games has you massage beautiful women in time to the music. The patrons of your massage parlor have not only sore bodies, but unique worries weighing on their hearts as well. Use your secret massage technique to clear all the stress out of their minds and bodies!

name: Boxing Gym Story
short_description: Create your own gym, train boxers, and aim for the championship!

name: Moonstuck
short_description: Relaxing rage game in a cutesy wholesome Moonstuck land. Delicate jump-balancing rage platformer where your job is to escape, while staying relaxed.

name: Lab Remnants
short_description: Lab Remnants is a monochromatic roguelike full of secrets and challenges. Play as an artificially made creature and make your way through your own creators to escape from their crazy experiments.

name: Time Thief
short_description: Time Thief is an action adventure game where leaving your village makes the clock tick. Manage your time to stay alive, stealing seconds from creatures around its overworld with your sword.

short_description: There is a girl, searching for something she lost... Tamayura Mirai is a midsummer fantasy visual novel of humans, spirits, and sorcerers that's won several industry awards in Japan.

short_description: Based on interdisciplinary research in VR, HYPNOSIS REVERIES takes an abstract and minimalist approach to tell a story about growing. Through a 20-minute experience, you will step into a mental maze, looking back at the important moments that changed you, and see yourself again.

short_description: A dark, story-heavy puzzle game. Enter the mind of Mayu, as her soul is invaded and dug through by a seemingly evil witch. Can you stop her? What if you were able to get the upper hand, and invade her back? Would you show mercy, or destroy her? Jishogi will test you in more ways than one.

name: Zetria
short_description: An adult-only 2D pixel-art platformer!

name: The Lab - Escape Room
short_description: Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are these mysterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned? Could you escape from The Lab?

name: Monsterlands
short_description: Monsterlands is an exciting rogue-like survival game. Fight against the monsters and try to survive by upgrading your weapons and items.

name: Hard Block Girls: Sex Life
short_description: The legendary tile-matching skill is now being used to get laid! Crack the puzzles to make the girls reveal some great soft skin. Destroy all the anxiety blocks to win and unlock spicy pics from three hot girls.

short_description: Customize your ship. Defeat or escape from chase enemies. Destroy city walls. Drive your ship to machine city. Begin to believe.

name: Party Universe
short_description: Party Universe invites you to a cosmic celebration of friendship and competition! Gather your crew and embark on adrenaline-pumping adventures across a galaxy of fun. Unleash your teamwork skills and outshine your rivals in this ultimate multiplayer experience!

Battle emus and hire kangaroo mercenaries. Scavenge supplies, gather and trade materials, recruit followers and rebuild society.

name: DragonScales 7: A Heart of Dark Flames

name: La Vie La Rue
short_description: Cartoonish 2d game made by two brothers. Unique art all around these wonderful locations. Try and go to the furthest possible to beat your highscore and maybe be the first one to reach the end.

short_description: Fofiño and Lily are always in pursue of fun, particularly boxes! Help them to move the boxes around in this puzzle adventure! ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

name: Crazy Cook
short_description: You have to peel, cut, shoot and smash crazy ingredients in rythme to the music ! It is a very good exercice if you want to get fit. Crazy Cook is a fun and crazy musical cooking game for the whole family ! Your goal is to create great recipes…with a twist : the ingredients are a bit hostile !

name: Extinction Eclipse
short_description: You are in command of the human fleet, searching for asteroids to mine, extract resources and build bases and more ships to defeat aliens invaders. This simple and short action RTS has a full and exciting campaign, and a skirmish mode that allows you to play a different mission on every match.

name: Running on Magic
short_description: Woosh! Get ready to flee! Welcome to Running on Magic, a forced-scroll platformer where a quirky wizard is being chased by a tireless Grim Reaper. Hurry through procedurally-generated mindfully drawn environments as you defeat unalike enemies. Don’t let the Grim Reaper get to you!

name: Is Simon There?
short_description: A few months have passed since the death of my son, Simon. Ever since that tragic day, I find myself falling into the darkest emotions I could ever imagine. I am haunted everyday with what I have done; But sometimes, I am haunted by more than just my emotions...

name: The Mystery Cleaner
short_description: Play the role of a janitor who specializes in "unusual" orders. Clean up the most iconic locations in the world and uncover their (dirty) secrets. Highly guarded facilities, unusual situations, all that mess to deal with... sounds like a challenge!

name: Yuma Will Burn
short_description: Yuma Will Burn is an experimental narrative survival game where choices have long-lasting story and mechanical consequences. Harsh survival mechanics exist alongside a dynamically changing narrative in an uncaring and sadistic world of triage, poverty, and fear.

name: Blue Oak Bridge
short_description: Blue Oak Bridge features breathtaking 2D hand-painted art in a storybook world of powerful witches, ancient magic and royal secrets. Farm, forage and fish throughout the island of Eloria and use all you discover to brew potions, make produce and help your new friends.

short_description: Taiga is an atmospheric first person horror game with elements of survival. Explore the maze like forest, Uncover dark secrets that lay beneath pine and spruce. Save your colleagues if you can, but most importantly. Escape with your life.

name: Sakura Succubus 6
short_description: The sixth part of the Sakura Succubus series. Hiroki thought his harem of adoring women couldn’t get any bigger, but now a genuine European princess had taken a liking to him. What’s a (disgustingly) popular guy to do?!

name: Otaku Puzzle

name: Askaya: Remnants of Ajuna
short_description: Askaya: Remnants of Ajuna is a 3rd person adventure-RPG where players embark on a series of adventures that are generated through the roll of story dice. These dice rolls are interpreted by our custom AI system to generate a customized story, with unique settings, goals, and avenues to success.

name: PROJECT: PLAYTIME
short_description: PROJECT: PLAYTIME is a Free-to-Play multiplayer horror game where six players attempt to create one giant toy while surviving a terrifying monster that roams the toy factory. A seventh player controls the monster and is given only one goal: Find and kill everyone.

name: 3D PUZZLE - Farm House
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

name: Ukko & Guará: Stellarbound
short_description: United by a fallen star, a reindeer and a maned wolf should cooperate using their own differences of environment and weather to help them solve a sequence of puzzles in a smooth and peaceful adventure to restore the magic of the star.

short_description: Nosy Little Fly is an unique 2D side scroller. Instead of moving sideways, you can add force to your character in any direction. You must manage your inertia in order to finish the levels. It is very funny and challenging! Are you skilled enough, though?

name: FIND ALL 3: Travel
short_description: Look for hidden cats, raccoons, other animals and objects, color this painted world. You have to go on an exciting journey through different levels. More than 1500 items of varying difficulty are waiting for you!

name: Darfall
short_description: Darfall is a hero-based RPG city-building game that puts you in the role of a hero who must protect their home and help it grow! During the day, grow your hero’s might, find epic loot, master new abilities, and fortify your settlement. At night, survive the hordes of undead, until you triumph.

name: Poker Warlords
short_description: Bet. Battle. Conquer! Poker Warlords fuses high-stakes poker with autobattler combat—turn cards into armies, outwit opponents, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

name: Charmareians
short_description: Planet Charmara's situation grows more dire every passing day. Will the Misfits be able to stop the world from falling apart underneath them?

name: Run n Jump
short_description: Run n Jump your way through dangerous obstacles to save the lost maiden at the top. Find yourself dropped into a treacherous world running full speed while trying to avoid being massacred by the obstacles in your way. Do you have the skill to rescue the lost maiden?

name: My Girlfriend’s Special Place
short_description: One day, our hero is headed home from Akihabara when he's mistaken for a molester. The person accusing him is his childhood friend, Fuyuka Akiyoshi. "If you want me to forgive you, then become my butler!" Recently reunited, these two end up in an unusual relationship as their story begins again...

name: Ball Go Home
short_description: Roll, jump, and fall through over 100 levels in this fun, difficult 2D physics platformer. Master a unique control scheme as you get your ball home!

name: Gordianaut
short_description: A very short puzzle platformer set on an alien planet centered around a moving-platform mechanic.

name: Unlock the Feelings
short_description: Luck can be useful, but the more you improve your strategy, the less you depend on it. Unlock the Little Inner Monsters we all have, in this codebreaking strategy game inspired by Wordle and Mastermind. As you play it regularly, create your own diary of feelings and reflections.

name: One Way Trip
short_description: Stealth will be your only defense in this 1-4 player Sci-fi horror scenario while you attempt to escape an ever learning AI. Be quiet, stay hidden, and remain calm, or face certain death.

name: Raven Estate
short_description: Become the bullet-hell as you play a crow on a mission to expel the monsters from his newly acquired estate in this high-octane shoot-em-up!

Die and rise again from your ashes and learn new summoning spells.

short_description: Ambushed is a 4-player online co-operative horror game. You are trapped in a forest haunted by the ghosts of those who have died here. It's dark. It's cold. But you have nowhere else to go. If you want to live you'll need to finish the ritual and cleanse the forest of the spirits residing there.

short_description: A 3D deck building roguelike game. Collect over 240 abilities; level them up, enchant them, pair them up with over 100 trinkets, and synergize them with your companions' abilities to create endless combinations to defeat your foes.
