short_description: Stories from the Outbreak is a turn-based roguelike zombie RPG. Lead a group of survivors from the doomed city of Riga towards a ferry sailing across the North Sea. Scavenge for supplies, battle the undead, decide the fate of your team. What are you willing to sacrifice in order to survive?

name: Kung Fu Legend
short_description: This game is fucked up! and that's why you should buy it!

name: DesktopMMD4:Born to Dance
short_description: The fourth generation of DesktopMMD born to dance,Brand new Theater-Mode, Fully supports using of MMD's VMD format dance motion file and PMX/PMD models directly , It's never been easier for MMD models to dance on your desktop. Support MMD's physics engine, Support STEAM workshop.

name: Secret of the Vikings - Mystery island
short_description: After a severe storm a group of Vikings and the brave Finnja strand on a strange island and face unknown challenges and dangers.

name: Warplane Quest
short_description: Warplane Quest tells the story of a young pilot destined to become a legendary flying ace. The game features intense dogfights, varied missions, beautiful landscapes and procedurally generated battlefields.

name: Thirayan
short_description: Thirayan is an action platformer game set in India. A hand-drawn action platformer game offering players new experience with its story and art.

name: MEATGRINDER
short_description: Meatgrinder is a chaotic and fast-paced FPS. Use agility and guns to jump your way through insane levels on top of speeding trucks, trains and planes. No cutscenes or storylines, just pure action.

name: Paracreat
short_description: A parallel universe with monsters you can tame!

name: Bounty of One
short_description: Fallen hero of the Wild West, you’re wanted and in disgrace! Grab your guns, survive endless hordes of bounty hunters and fight to clear your name! Bounty of One is a fast-paced casual roguelite bullet hell for 1 to 4 players. Dash, Dodge, Shoot, Repeat!

name: Legend of Rome - The Wrath of Mars
short_description: Experience a challenging match 3 game and help the Roman people appease Mars, the god of war! Build and restore the proud city to its original splendor.

name: Alkali
short_description: Explore the world as an Alkali metal in this innovative precision platformer! Explosively react with water and other elements to traverse obstacles, while picking up chunks of metal before you deplete your alkali metal body.

name: Meteor Blasters
short_description: Meteor Blasters is a non-stop action space shooter. Inspired by Asteroids, this game will see you choose between 6 different ships each with their own characteristics and utilize a variety of weapon powerups to eradicate the space rocks. Play 4 players Co-op or Versus Mode with friends.

name: Only Furry 18+
short_description: Only Furry 18+ is a casual clicker adult game that looks like a popular social media.You should help main character to earn enough money to make a post. After every reached goal you will get a beautiful 3D picture or awesome 3D animation with girl.

name: Accursed
short_description: Accursed is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world and survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare.

name: Scarlet Maiden
short_description: Join Scarlet, the last remaining Maiden of the Sacred Flame, in her sinful quest to defeat the Prime Evil. Explore the randomly generated dungeons of the Underworld, learn new abilities, equip Scarlet with powerful equipment, and engage in lewd activities along the way.

name: Fix Me Up - Hospital Edition
short_description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to be a Doctor?

name: Art Mahjong 4
short_description: Excellent entertainment awaits you in this latest version of the popular "Art Mahjong" series. The game offers many challenging levels and mahjongg boards that, once unlocked, reveal beautiful backgrounds.

name: Nazralath: The Fallen World
short_description: Nazralath: The Fallen World is a story-driven, dark fantasy game inspired by the works of Zdzisław Beksiński; focusing on a compelling narrative and exploration through a rich, strong sense of atmosphere.

name: Decorporation
short_description: Decorporation is a fast-paced violent FPS that combines roguelike mechanics (random procedural level generation and permadeath) with skill-based style scoring.

name: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station
short_description: In Yupitergrad 2, the players have extended mobility, a wider selection of tools, and a much richer game world with an open-ended structure. This is a VR adventure worth waiting for. The legend is back, bigger and better.

name: SMYS : Show Me Your Stairs
short_description: SMYS is a 2-4 player local-multiplayer party game. Challenge your friends in this building race to the top! Gather blocks in various minigames and then use them to build your stairs as fast as possible, use your special items wisely to disturb your friends' minds and reach the objective first.

name: Couple Last Conductors
short_description: A co-op roguelite experience set in an apocalyptic world, where cooperation with your partner is the key to continued survival.

name: UnderWay: Graffiti Game
short_description: Game based on graffiti and spray painting. The world is your canvas! Explore alone, or with friends and paint wherever you want. Acquire supplies by either buying them at the city's stores or by other less legal means. Try and avoid security as you paint the walls and subways of the capital.

name: Path of the Midnight Sun
short_description: Protect a noblewoman reckoning with unholy powers as she wards off the soul of the Demon King sealed inside her. Doubt your own companions, survive against unforgiving hordes of monsters. But beware; every choice has consequences in this epic JRPG adventure of betrayal, romance & self-acceptance.

name: A Building Full of Cats
short_description: A Building Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to pet all the cats in the building. Don't leave any cats behind!

name: MIGHT'N MOW'EM: CO-OP SURVIVORS ONLINE
short_description: Multiplayer Survivors: Meet MIGHT’N MOW’EM. Mow thousands of enemies with an ever-growing arsenal of weapons and magic, solo or with friends. Classes, upgrades, ultimates, quests, and group buffs add a rewarding meta game to a dopamine-filled core loop.

name: Trash Patrol - Academic Version
short_description: Trash Patrol is a local cooperative multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Break into a house, look for something to steal together with your raccoon friends. Don’t forget to wash and dry all items carefully! And watch out for the homeowner - They are not amused to see you within their home

name: Formula Bwoah: Online Multiplayer Racing
short_description: Formula Bwoah is a free-to-play, cross platform racing game with pit stops, engine modes and changing weather. Download now to experience a game that rewards skillful play and risk taking in online multiplayer.

name: The Murder Hotel
short_description: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel.

name: Tirsy's Tale
short_description: The Great Migrations of beasts begins. Join young Tirsy on a great journey to the Land Beyond. Traverse vast locations full of challenges from hostile creatures to nature itself. Meet companions along the way to assist you as well as troublemakers who make your journey more difficult!

name: Pact of Darkness
short_description: Pact of Darkness is an action game with souls-style hack-n-slash combat. You have been trapped by a contract and have lost your memories, explore and fight against corrupted creatures and find out why you are there.

name: Ewephoria
short_description: Herd sheep, avoid cows, terrify wolves, fly fighter jets, sail the seas, and other related sheepherding activities in this exciting new party game. Gather your friends around the screen and use your phones to control your sheepdogs and save the day in Ewephoria!

name: Automaton Kingdom
short_description: 2D turn-based puzzle game with a medieval setting and two game phases. Allied and enemy characters will behave automatically after setting them up in the edit phase. you can see the outcome of the different iterations of the level in the game phase.

name: Demeo Battles
short_description: Demeo Battles is a competitive PvP turn-based strategy game. Choose your champion, assemble an army of monstrous minions, and team up with fellow champions in your quest for turn-based glory!

name: Elena's Journal - Unfinished Expedition
short_description: Help Elena discover the City of the Amazons in a Time Management adventure!

name: LEGO® Party!
short_description: LEGO(R) Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO® and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

name: FERRUM inc
short_description: Become an operator who controls a robot of FERRUM inc. Participate in 5-by-5 battles where you can choose your fighting machine and use a unique camera control system. Time to spill the oil!

name: 戦乙女 ikusaotome
short_description: Freely adapted from the Nordic mythology our戦乙女: search for spirits, do competitions or fly races. It is designed for fun, but you can adjust the challenge mode also it needs some practice for the advanced options.

name: The Struggle of Combat
short_description: The Struggle of Combat is randomly generated side-scrolling shooter. After mysterious enemy launches attack on the prison, all of the worst criminals have escaped! Join the action to capture those criminals and find out who was behind this attack!

name: Desert Revenant
short_description: Desert Revenant is a strategic Roguelike Deck Building RPG packing a huge variety of cards to do battle with. Think about your every move and make careful decisions in hand-crafted encounters as you cut deals with Jinn and humans alike in your adventures amongst the dunes of Elmyr.

name: Sunday Gold
short_description: Sunday Gold is a point-and-click, turn-based adventure game set in grim, dystopian future. Play as a ragtag trio of criminals to hunt down and expose the dark secrets of an evil mega-corporation and the malevolent billionaire behind it.

name: Joyride
short_description: Joyride is a low-poly style racing game, You will drive your vehicle through roads with different scenery in different seasons, In this game, You can race with yourself, And even operate a drone to watch your driving process, Good luck

name: Closer Than You Know
short_description: A cozy, updated spin on the familiar point-and-click adventure games. Sam is on a big quest to save her home planet--where Hope has been outlawed. Solve puzzles and uncover the mystery in this charming adventure.

name: Paranormal Preparatory School
short_description: This school for supernaturals isn't hell, but it is a hellmouth! Can you make peace between the vampires and werewolves, and close the portal to hell?

name: Shenanigans
short_description: Shenanigans is a chaotic party board game for you and your friends, where anyone and anything can change the course of the game at will. Don't let pesky rules stop you from winning. Just change them in your favor!

name: Tankitos
short_description: Tankitos!Even the name reveals what is this game about, game inspired by old school game "Battle City" originally on NES in modern stylized style is full of tanks and tank battles in various arenas. Check out more.

name: Your Computer Might Be At Risk
short_description: Your Computer Might Be At Risk is a first-person narrative puzzle game. Locked up in a room after a mysterious car accident, you must figure out how to escape while surviving dangerous trials.

name: Post Solis
short_description: Post Solis is a real-time sci-fi strategy game. Your only ally is a tiny ray of the sunlight. It moves across the planet, and you can only build in its area. Anything plunged into darkness is destroyed. The game is built around the key mechanics of following the slipping ray of light.

name: Formula TOP
short_description: Formula TOP brings all the excitement of formula racing to a 3D top-down racing game. Work your way from backmarker to champion by planning perfect pit strategies around dynamic weather conditions and racing to victory.

name: Delta Manifold
short_description: Explore a strange interconnected world, find weapons to shoot those that stand in your way, and discover hidden upgrades and abilities to discover even greater secrets in an action adventure first person metroidvania.

name: Aqorel
short_description: Cook up different solutions to elemental puzzles as you make deliveries on a strange planet. Combine and use the elemental seasonings in this unique system to create your path forward.

name: Capture Note
short_description: Super fast notes on screenshots. Just take screenshot and add note and save it.

name: Enter the Chronosphere
short_description: The tactical bullet hell game. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items, and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

name: Legacy of Sin: Blood Oath
short_description: Legacy Of Sin: Blood Oath combines defense games with role-playing games, wrapped in the distinct style of 90s animated series! Hold your own against an onslaught of orcs, using an army of upgradeable, distinct warriors with their own unique abilities. Defend, control, win!

name: Dadish 3
short_description: A new Dadventure! Help Dadish rescue his children once more, in his most fun and challenging adventure yet.

name: RoastTogether
short_description: A casual game that relies on your drag-and-drop hand speed and simple strategic decisions.

name: Downpurr
short_description: Mimi's platformer-shooter adventure through a land of magic, cats, and rain!

name: MACHI KORO With Everyone
short_description: Gather up to THREE friends to join you in "MACHI KORO With Everyone"! The mulit-million selling hit game from Japan is now on Steam! Online, offline, play how you like with whom you like!

name: Battle Teams 2
short_description: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries.

name: Some Synergy
short_description: In this local co-op 2D platformer game, you and your friend cooperate to reach the end. Two of you simply needs to progress right. With different platforms that provide different challenges, how will you and your friend progress?

name: Tomb Explorer VR
short_description: Tomb Explorer VR is an Experimental Physics VR Adventure game where you explore ancient ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and embark on a quest for historical treasures, relics, and artifacts.

name: Decisive Strike
short_description: A sci-fi team-based Third Person Shooter where strategy is as important as your reflexes.

name: Super Hero Flash Fist
short_description: Battle monsters and maintain the peace, as "Flash Fist" an elite L City superhero! Make sure to fend off the monsters' sexual harrassment and lewd attacks!

name: Light Bringer
short_description: Light Bringer is a 2D side scrolling fantasy strategy game with development elements. Explore, gather, build and then when night falls, survive! All in the style of beautiful hand-painted graphics. Will you bring the light?

name: Touhou Fairy Knockout ~ One fairy to rule them all
short_description: You will role-play as playful fairies with unique personalities, and accomplish your own Gekokujō in Gensokyo where the strong gather! Make your own favorite fairy character the strongest with your own hands!

name: 东方华心传Touhou Blooming Soul
short_description: A classic pixel side-scrolling action game with Rogue-lite. Play as Hata no Kokoro on a journey of self-discovery and use combinations of different emotions to fight battles as beautiful as a dance!

name: Fibula
short_description: A new dark fantasy multiplayer action adventure role-playing game. Hone your combat skills, master the arcane arts, or turn a house into a home in the world of Fibula.

name: Temple of Starlight
short_description: Temple of Starlight is an abstract first-person puzzle game with a striking retro visual style. Use colored lights to clear obstacles and explore an ancient temple along with its forgotten history.

name: Tomboy Adventure

name: Miho Adventures
short_description: Miho adventures is a platformer pixel game where you control Miho in an adventure across an island filled with monsters and enemies of all kinds.

short_description: Love can wound and heal. It is a feeling inherent in everyone. But can you get love by force or deception? Find out in this new game!

short_description: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

name: Presentiment of Death
short_description: Do you hear that? Sounds of classical music and an arrow rushing by. Burst your way through the enemies inhabiting on different game levels and come out a winner. Remember, all in your hands — a bow and a chance to survive...

name: World of Buh
short_description: Take control of the destiny of a Buh as he makes his way through an adventurous retro wave world populated by many other Buhs. Some may help you to find what's this all about... but most of them will try to get in the way and do what only the one and only choosen of the Buhs can do.

name: Whisper Books
short_description: Whisper Books is a collection of high-profile visual novel, artistically expressed based on literature, with hand-painted illustrations, dubbing and interactive options. The gameplay is weak relative to storytelling, suitable for players and readers who like stories.

short_description: Dynamic turn-based strategy game inspired by the hyper hardcore genre, where the player as a chief man of his tribe, will lead it to the glory, watch out for food and lurking predators!

short_description: Forage, craft, build, hunt, explore. Tackle the wilderness and anything lurking in the shadows in this single-player survival horror adventure.

name: 沙漠花开 Desert Blossom
short_description: In the deserts of the Baihe Continent, a girl named Mars was born, breaking the curse. -- Embarking on a journey, composing an epic adventure about courage, life and love.

name: Garden Galaxy
short_description: Discover, collect and organise to create your own unique garden in this relaxing idle / creative sandbox!

name: Missing Persons
short_description: Missing Persons is a horror-survival game that you play as Calvin to survive against the scientist who kidnapped you to run tests on you.

name: Brave Survivor
short_description: Brave survivor - In this heart-pounding beat em up, you take on the role of a brave survivor whose fist punches a path to freedom through hordes of enemies. Beat bad guys mercilessly, collect bonuses and destroy bosses in this incredible game!

name: Long Journey
short_description: Long journey - Many people know that a large amount of sweets is bad for teeth .. But not for this skeleton! Embark on a long adventure with this skinny sweet tooth and collect all the donuts!

name: CARDMON
short_description: CARDMON is a new adventure inspired in old monster-catching games. Jump in and explore the TOJO region while trying to catch all the Cardmon. Defeat every carder and become the Regional Cardmaster in this aestethic world!

name: Mystery Quest
short_description: Mystery quest - Mysterious things are going on in the magical world. Help the young sorceress collect all the scattered things and put things in order in the possessions of her teacher, and maybe then she will share the secrets of magic with you..

name: Bobbi Adventure
short_description: This is a kind dwarf Bobby, who travels through a fantasy world.

name: Backpack Hero
short_description: The inventory management roguelike! Collect rare items, organize your backpack, and vanquish your foes!

name: Fearless Rider
short_description: Fearless Rider is an exciting driving game where the player must avoid hitting or getting crushed by obstacles.

name: Duterra
short_description: An isometric action RPG set in a medieval world of corporation-like guilds, you'll embark on a journey to pull your family out of debt, choosing to assist or betray the very guilds that hold power over you. At your disposal is an arsenal of melee and ranged weapons to fight opposing factions.

name: Murdo's Quest
short_description: Rescue your family and defeat Count Othar in this old-school platformer. Inspired by the "Addams Family" game for the NES. This game presents a unique and challenging platforming experience.

name: Push Comes to Shovel
short_description: Push Comes to Shovel is a snowy sim-adventure set in the frigid town of Windrow. Become the Blizzard Wizard you've inspired to be and clean up the town. Upgrade and utilize a variety of plows, snowblowers, shovels and tools to complete chill jobs.

name: CowboysShowdown
short_description: Cowboys Showdown is a platforming shooter with waves of enemies, bounty hunters and high-ranking criminals who will be well paid to kill. Boxes with bonuses and the ability to buy new weapons will help you in your hard work. Game Features: - hardcore - Pleasant musical accompaniment -Pixel Art

name: Sex Diary - Swingers Yacht
short_description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of two college buddies sharing their gorgeous soon-to-be wives on a luxury yacht.

name: BeachRun
short_description: - Difficulty is an integral part of the game - Pixel art drawing style - Music will not make you bored

name: Magic War
short_description: Game Features: - Beautiful Pixel Art - Dynamic Music - 30 levels - Hardcore

name: SpearFrog
short_description: Game Features: - Hardcore - Pixel Art - Atmosphere

short_description: Explore, Platform & Plunder a large Volcanic Isle in search of Coins, Gems, Crowns, and the 5 hidden talismans!

short_description: Epic, classic-style fantasy role-playing game. Single player, party based, featuring real-time with pause gameplay. Combines open-ended exploration with an overall quest. Deep, complex role-playing system, with many skills, powers, spells, and items.

name: EvoMon
short_description: Evomon Is a creature collector in tamagotchi version. Take care of your evomon since its infancy and discover its new evolutions, have fun playing the mini-games, adventure in mysterious expeditions, battle intensely against different monsters to reach the title of Evomon Champion.

name: VOSS Turbo
short_description: VOSS Turbo is a retro styled, on rail, twin stick shooter; with controller and keyboard support. Gameplay difficulty will climb as you visit and conquer new worlds. 30 stages to explore, with secrets to uncover, and bosses to whoop. Explore everything the multiverse has to offer!

name: Falinere Fantasy
short_description: Falinere Fantasy is a turn-based RPG Dungeon Crawler played via Twitch Chat. Your viewers can change between 8 different classes (Alchemist, Bard, Crystalsmith, Druid, Rogue, Solicitor, Warrior, and Wizard) and run through dungeons, leveling up and gaining skills as they traverse the land.

name: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind
short_description: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind bestows bites of tactical roguelike action, which will quickly fester into a deep, lingering, and strategic obsession. Bargain with gods, equip your spoon and pick your battles, before retreating into the healing darkness. But beware… there are still many monsters to face!

name: Denos City: Complete Game
short_description: Final version of Denos City. Adult Visual Novel. The game includes a walkthrough so you don't miss any scene of the game.

name: Symbiotic: Invasion
short_description: Symbiotic: Invasion is an RPG Visual Novel that's been meticulously crafted over the years. Throughout development, the game has undergone many changes to achieve a quality level I'm proud of. Battle monsters, explore, uncover secrets, and immerse yourself in an emotional rollercoaster of a story!

name: Abort, Retry, Fail
short_description: Abort, Retry, Fail is a top-down roguelike action adventure in which you play as a lazy programmer that has to generate his own weapon and shoot his way through hordes of enemies. Are you brave enough to help him escape from computer hell of Windows 98?

name: My Furry Maid 🐾
short_description: Welcome home, master! Would you like tea, coffee, or perhaps a hot maid for dinner? Oh, wait, it seems we’ve run out of tea and coffee, so...

name: Peacemaker: Glorious Princess
short_description: A classic JRPG. Play the role of a surviving princess. Gather companions, save the kingdom, make peace, and uncover the hidden truth in a desperate situation.

name: Soul Slayer
short_description: Unlock, equip, upgrade and create your build. Combine different elements for their powerful element reactions and slay THOUSANDS of enemies. Are you able to defeat all Soul Lords and the Soul King?

name: Timeless Heart VR
short_description: Timeless heart VR is an action VR roguelite game, As the second work of Timeless Stories series, this work further simplifies and enriches the unique sword skill system of the series. Advancing in the unknown labyrinth with Lycaena, and break through this blockade from fate!

name: Line Path
short_description: A mind-bending puzzle game about filling all in one line Relax and enjoy

name: Public Restroom Simulator 2022
short_description: Public Restroom Simulator 2022 is a first-person-shooter that truly captures the feel of what it feels like to use a public restroom in the current year. You can either play one-on-one matches or just try to survive as long as possible in the single player mode. Either way it is gonna get messy.

name: Jusant
short_description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

name: Happy Hops
short_description: Endless hopping fun! Relax and unwind by jumping between Lilly-pads to earn points. Earn bonus points for collecting lotus flowers. Collect enough to earn new high scores! Supports controllers and keyboard controls

name: Rebel Engine
short_description: Rebel Engine mixes the stylish combat of a Hack n' Slash with the speed and gunplay of a '90s FPS in a unique, fast-paced action game. Combine gunshots with melee attacks to create devastating combos! Lead the rebellion against the Concrete megacorporation and liberate all of robot-kind!

name: DELETE AFTER READING
short_description: Turn on your ghost detector and join your new pals in a funny, thrilling, and lovingly-presented interactive text adventure. Brain-teasing puzzles, a cartoon visual style, and engaging audio design - Delete After Reading weaves a delightful interactive tale.

name: Ralph's party RPG
short_description: Ralph's party RPG is easy and fancy RPG game. Complete the game by going through all the dungeons, but be careful - there might be some enemies waiting for you. It has simple desing, good music, and great levels.

name: Aery - Last Day of Earth
short_description: “Aery – Last Day of Earth” is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bird that is on its non-violent journey through time, space, and different dimensions to discover an alternative reality for our planet.

name: Super Indiemania
short_description: Whip your way through hordes of supernatural monsters and bosses! For fans of classic-vanias and linear 2D side-scrollers with a goal of mastering each stage and destroying its boss! Discover hidden items, secondary weapons and even vehicles!

name: School Bus Driver Simulator
short_description: The School Bus Driver Simulator game offers you the chance to contribute to our future, namely, to transport the children to school.

name: Chords Enchanter
short_description: A music theory based puzzle game where you need to fill in the missing notes to complete a chord.

name: Thieves' Paradise
short_description: Welcome to Shopper's Paradise! Thieves' Paradise is a stealth action game where you will break into the capitalistic wonderland known as Shopper's Paradise in order to steal what you need. Explore 3 different storylines and 9 individually designed heists!

name: Escape From Zombie U:reloaded
short_description: If you thought the school system has reached its lowest levels... Think again!

name: Akari - The Five Eyed Fox
short_description: Play as Akari, a magical fox imbued with the power of light in this fast paced Metroidvania. Slash and Dash your way through an army of darkness and explore diverse, beautiful worlds.

name: One-armed cook
short_description: One-armed cook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for up to 4 people. Work as a team or cook on your own, set your own pace, and don't let the stress of a full restaurant catch up to you. The goofy physics-based aspect of the game gives this cooking game a new twist.

name: Long Gone
short_description: Decades have passed, play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the secret lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and platform through overgrown streets in this 3D pixel adventure inspired by games of old. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

name: Twogether: Project Indigos Chapter 1
short_description: Twogether: Project Indigos is a single player third person puzzle adventure. Set in the frightening Hexacells facilities, Twogether will pose original puzzles that will only be solvable by collaboration.

name: ELEGIES: Aya
short_description: After losing his parents and barely escaping his burning home, Zach wakes up in the hospital where he meets Aya, the ghost of a girl. Who is she, and why can only Zach see her? Together they try to investigate Aya's past, which quickly awakens new dangers.

name: Endless Bullet Heaven
short_description: In this endless bullet avoidance game, you join the fallen angel named Brace in her fight to reach the heavens in which she once resided!

name: My Little Sister's Special Place
short_description: Our hero used to go to Akiba a lot when he was younger. It wasn't to have fun, but for his little sister's sake. One day, his younger sister is gifted a Christmas trip, and they spend time together as if they're a couple. This is the delightful and touching love story of these two siblings.

name: HoverRider
short_description: This is a racing game in which the player drives through a world that combines cityscapes designed for the year 2090 with modern natural landscapes. The hovercraft controls are different from those of conventional games. You can experience a world that you have never experienced before.

name: Hexes
short_description: In Hexes, you move gems on a diamond shaped game board. Matching three or more gems of the same colour will remove them from board. Keep finding matches to prevent your board from filling up.

name: HyperNova
short_description: A 2D side-scrolling shooter in which you advance by defeating enemies in a world where everything is made of voxels. Defeat enemies, collect reinforcement items, and take on powerful enemies that appear one after another!

name: Skylost
short_description: Skylost is a 3D exploration and crafting game where you climb and glide your way through dangerous floating islands in search of your lost love Amelia.

name: Bonza Boom
short_description: Bonza Boom is a new turn-based battle shooting game, it is also the first card battle enlightenment game. Simple but fun, and free to play, you can share with your families or children, enjoy your happy hour~

name: Shinonome
short_description: A haunted house where ghosts and vengeful spirits lurk around every corner. Your courage and wit will be put to the test in order to survive. Use trails and sounds as clues to progress in this exciting new roguelike escape game.
