short_description: LOLLIPOP: SUMMER! is an exciting puzzle game with delicious, sweet candy combinations! In the game LOLLIPOP: SUMMER! You will find many bright and varied visuals and very beautiful music.

name: Tilted Tennis
short_description: A competitive paddle and ball game, with a twist! As you hit the ball around the arena, the camera follows it. Spin the ball to disorient your friends and win the match, but take care not to lose track of which way is up yourself...

name: Mortmentum
short_description: Fight endless waves of different enemies using your grappling hook in clever ways while trying hopelessly to stay alive just a little longer so you can get a higher score.

name: Royal Legends: Raised in Exile Collector's Edition
short_description: Save the king and his kingdom! Don't let a cunning and unprincipled villain ascend the throne! You are the only one who can influence the course of history. Are you ready to accept the challenge?

name: Cryospace: Prologue
short_description: You are not a soldier. Not a fighter. Just an ordinary maintenance guy. Yet you have to fight. And you are forced to run. But chiefly: you must help the frozen crew survive on a spaceship. You are the only one who can save others. You are made a hero against your will. You become a leader. A slayer.

name: Me and the Zombies
short_description: Me and the Zombies is a shooter game. You’ll find weapons and ammunition you’ll need to fight your way against the zombies. You’re in a remote place and the only way out is through a tunnel. Find it!

name: Marine School Simulator
short_description: School life experience on island in the tropical sea... with Flying Shark! Go to school, play with friends in town, and exterminate dangerous creatures. Experience the life of a student on a mysterious southern island.

name: Police Stories: The Academy
short_description: Welcome, trainee! Use tactics and special equipment to become a true cop in the free version of Police Stories: The Academy. Neutralize criminals, search for clues and find a "rat" in the police station alone or in co-op with a partner.

name: Jacktus Green: The Fluffy, the Spiky and the Spicy
short_description: Chase Guindilla to retrieve your beloved Cattus! Jump, dash, and hook around in this 2.5D platformer. Discover different levels, fight enemies, ride minecarts and meet the bizarre neighbors of Sofrito Town.

name: MetälBörn
short_description: Techno has taken over your neighborhood. Honor your metal god Kilmister, arm yourself up to the baffles, raise the volume and show these punks which is the music that makes the shells shake. The metalheads are not dead, but the technos will be…

name: Seeking Light
short_description: Seeking Light is an action adventure game in isometric perspective with a focus on boss fights. Fight your fears as Sunny and overcome the demons of your past. Explore your inner world, facing the personification of your phobias, and discover the story behind them.

name: Insurrection: Cyborgs Awakening
short_description: Kick some asses in this cooperative retrowave game!!! Use powerful abilities and combos to destroy the evil minions of the Driftonics mega corporation and free humanity from the cyborg threat.

name: POPGOES Arcade
short_description: Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...

name: Growing My Grandpa!
short_description: Growing My Grandpa! is a Cronenberg-inspired point-and-click adventure game with virtual pet elements that puts a heavy emphasis on exploration and lore.

name: BLOCKED ZONA
short_description: BLOCKED ZONE is a 2D shooter in which you play as a special unit mercenary who has gone to an infested area infested with zombies in search of the R-327 military chip. The fate of the world is at stake. Arm yourself with the best military weapons and go into battle!

name: SU the Son of Gaia
short_description: Explore the land of Panacea and its secrets in this vibrant and colorful pixelart Action RPG and help SU in his adventure to recover the balance of the contaminated ecosystems.

name: Elspell
short_description: In Elspell you will run into a variety of monsters and challenges you must overcome by casting a wide array of elementally-aligned spells. The core gameplay comes from its unique spellcasting system, where stringing together specific arm and hand movements casts spells.

name: Forward Defense
short_description: Forward Defense is a top-down 3D singleplayer tower defense game. Join the United Coalition Force and defeat insurgent forces armed with Technicals and Armored Personnel Carriers in a war-torn region of the Middle East.

name: Phone Seller Simulator
short_description: Phone Seller Simulator is a game that includes selling a phone, repairing a phone, and swapping a phone.

name: The Legend of Chibi Ninja
short_description: CHIBI NINJA is a ruthless 2D Puzzle platformer. Play as The Legendary Hero and destroy hordes of mechanical beasts to save your world from a mind controlling extraterrestial parasite using detonable BOMB SHURIKENS. Be very wary though, you can only endure one single hit. Are you up to the task?

name: Knights of the Exploding Table
short_description: Knights of the Exploding Table is an explosive platformer that harks back to the late 90's era of 3D games. Place, kick, lift, and throw bombs to navigate your way to the end of each stage. Collect gems to buy hats and unlock extra stuff. Challenge your friends to exhilarating Explosion Battles!

name: Heroes of Time
short_description: Join young adventurers from the future on a quest through time, battling ancient evils and futuristic threats to save the world.

name: Metal World: Street Scraps
short_description: Do you like cars? Driving at high speed? Metal World is a racing game of the endless runner genre, where the player drives flying vehicles in a retrofuturistic world! Test your reflexes and show your skills at high speed!

name: The Journey - Episode 2: Words of Wisdom
short_description: The second step that you never knew you needed to take to get to wherever you're wanting to go... You won't regret this experience. You have nothing to lose, and everything to gain...

name: Inside the Backrooms
short_description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

name: 虚幻宇宙：重启
short_description: 目前只有第一人称射击模式，穿越时空，在虚幻宇宙，与不可描述的力量作斗争，各种类型的怪物，消灭纳粹丧尸，清理被核废水感染的怪物，抗击小丑资本家，在各种异空间中不停的战斗，你有无限子弹无后座力的双持AK，高级的人工智能，怀中抱妹，各种状态

name: Arclight Beat
short_description: Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music.

name: Fertile Heroine Seaworthy
short_description: Expect monstrous sex, pregnancy and birth-giving in this turn-based roguelike. (P.S.: the combat system is actually unique and replayable too)

name: 棋物语 Stick Go story
short_description: Stick Go story (棋物语) is a single-player indie game. It attempts to link strategy board games with fighting RPG games. The stickman-like characters can be regarded as 11 Go pieces, and you can fight against enemies by moving these pieces with some strategy.

name: The Kobolds Left Behind
short_description: A tear-filled story game about the bittersweet last day of three abandoned kobolds.

name: Enatus Radi
short_description: After the protagonist wakes up, he finds that he has lost his memory. The first girl he met named Ena also lost her memory. In order to find the reason and the truth, they embarked on a journey to the world.

name: The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
short_description: It's a sandbox cultivation game where players recruit and train talents, build their own homesteads, practice alchemy and crafting, battle monsters and collect materials. The combat mode features automatic side-scrolling battles with companions, meanwhile player can decide cards to execute attacks.

name: Arth Island
short_description: Gather resources, set up a camp, choose your class, level up your skills, don't die of cold or starvation and battle the other failed experiments to survive as long as possible on this procedurally generated island

name: Mebula
short_description: Mebula, seal Mebulies, train them and fight to be the best!

name: Cyberpoly
short_description: Cyberpoly is an open-world, third person shooter, and RPG set in the Dark City — a dangerous city dominated by money, crimes, and illegal trades. You play as a mercenary who takes missions, works in secondary jobs, builds prestige, and unlock upgrades.

name: Seasons
short_description: Take a journey through the seasons with this simple but charming 2d platformer. 48 levels to see and conquer with a few secrets to unlock.

name: Death Relives
short_description: Escape the clutches of the Aztec god Xipe Totec in this immersive first-person horror game. Experience horror, stealth, and survival mechanics as you navigate a world filled with fear and deadly challenges. Can you survive the terror?

name: Call Sign is Magic Liner
short_description: Call Sign is Magic Liner is an old school Shmup with a new twist. You can strategically draw lines and defeat your enemies.

name: PARANECRO
short_description: Our character is a detective with a busy business life. But it has a bad history. He lost his wife and 1-month-old child in his womb in a traffic accident. That's why he's a bit of a psychiatrist. After losing his wife, he experienced strange events.

name: BYTE CATS
short_description: Delve into a story-driven adventure and channel your inner kitten in this challenging old-school platformer. Perform wall-jumps, evade deadly obstacles, hunt mice and use powerful abilities to destroy everyone who stands in your way!

name: Gem Setter
short_description: i'm gem setter, a block sliding puzzle game about moving ice in an abstract world. solve clever puzzles using ice blocks to change your shape and open new paths, then build your own levels using the built-in level editor.

name: 勇者与亡灵之都
short_description: 《勇者与亡灵之都》是一款在半开放世界探索的回合制RPG游戏，游戏借鉴了NPCDream、Blacksouls等rpg，采用了ATB行动条的设定，加快了战斗的节奏和策略性。 亡灵、魔物亦或是人类，只要阻挡在你面前的尽管杀光就是。勇者就是这样的存在啊... 游戏带有多结局与二周目元素，突出一个量大管饱。

name: Save All Monsters!
short_description: Puzzle game where you place all the monsters in safe squares before the time ends! Analyze the chess-like attack patterns of weapons to avoid danger. Use resistant monsters to protect normal monsters from ranged attacks! Keep social distancing with bomb monsters! Discover and save all the monsters!

name: No Son Of Mine
short_description: No Son Of Mine is a survival horror game focused on combat, stealth, exploration, puzzle solving and uncovering a gruesome mystery.

name: Via Mortis
short_description: Hunt, capture demons, train them to become your allies in this first-person dungeon-crawling game. Get stronger and learn new attacks and fight in new worlds. Make your choices to shape the new world the way you see fit.

name: Case #1472
short_description: A mysterious woman is sitting in front of you. Who is she? And who are you? And why are you both there? Case #1472 is mystery information digging interrogation thriller game where there are more things going on than what meets the eye, but are you able to unravel what has happened?

name: Intergalactic Taxi Co.
short_description: Intergalactic Taxi Co. is a casual puzzle game about picking up and dropping off passengers across a colorful, low-poly galaxy. Plan your route carefully to avoid running out of fuel and get everyone where they need to be!

Psychedelic 3D maze-runner. Each level is more difficult than the last one. Fight an onslaught of enemies as you try to find your way to the center of the island. You play as a revenant, avenging your death, and trying to free your sister from prison.

name: Lone elven wanderer
short_description: Lone elven wanderer is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements. You have to go on an incredible adventure through different worlds in search of gold, jewels and fame.

name: Arc Intelligence
short_description: Arc Intelligence is an adventure simulation and strategy game about an artificial intelligence that tries to take over the world. What would you do if your mind was inside a computer? Do you have what it takes to become the arch intelligence in this arced adventure?

name: Super Sushi Roll
short_description: Super Sushi Roll is a 2D roll-a-ball platformer where you control platforms and launch sushi to dinner plates. Master the mechanics, mind the time limit, unlock new sushi rolls, and search for hidden collectibles!

name: Kinetic: Break All Limits
short_description: Fast, fluid, and exhilarating. Jump, dash, bounce, and swing through a world of freedom. There is nothing holding you back. Destroy enemies with your energy blasts as you race to the finish, fight friends online, or free your home planet from an invasive menace in adventure mode!

name: Smiths & Legends
short_description: Smiths & Legends is a top-down co-op blacksmithing RPG. Craft recipes within the time limit with your friends while defending your shop from monsters. Go through the 60+ levels, fight monsters and bosses, and level up your party!

name: Silent World
short_description: Get rid of fatigue in Silent World! Listen to relaxing music and casual skateboarding in the sunset or early morning. It’s just a simple 2D pixel game.

name: DreamIsland
short_description: This game is an action exploration game where you complete various missions and collect 51 cards. The map is an open world, and you'll have to solve people's problems and unravel the mysteries of the world from a vast map!

name: Ruptured
short_description: Ruptured is a metroidvania where the world is split in two. Rupture between the two similar but slightly different dimensions to navigate your way to the source. Discover what broke this world.

name: Fight For It
short_description: Turn-based, rogue-like adventure of randomness. Roll lots of dice to test your luck.

name: Another Generic Space Shooter
short_description: Choose your ship and command it against an army pitted against you in this wave-based arcade-style bullet hell space shooter. Fight for as long as you can with powerups acquired through the catalog, and blast through everything in your path.

name: Flappy Butt
short_description: Flap around as buttcheeks propelled by your own gasses whilst trying to dodge pipes!

name: Little Learning Machines
short_description: Welcome to Little Learning Machines—a simulation where you train your real AI companions to solve challenges together, across whimsical islands. Shape their abilities and personalities while leveling up your skills with the games’ no-code AI system.

name: Holy Journey of Salvation
short_description: Holy Journey of Salvation is a cinematic Immersive Sim FPS. As the Spirit Ascender, you must embark on a Holy Journey to ascend in the Holy Chamber! In this Post Apocalypse setting, your tribe has deep understanding of Chemistry... but did they get it right in all the wrong ways?

name: PITCHvr™ Vision
short_description: Virtual Reality training for baseball. PITCHvr™ Vision is an immersive baseball training system designed by athletes, engineers and scientists for serious competitors. PITCHvr™ is no game, but it will help improve yours.

name: Tarabish
short_description: Tarabish Online is a trick-taking card game that brings friends, family, and new players together. Everyone can join in on the fun!

name: T-night
short_description: A quiet family life ended at the moment when the Doomsday came. Nightmares in the dark have come to life and are thirsting for your blood

name: ROTA: Bend Gravity
short_description: In ROTA gravity bends beneath your feet! Move blocks and twist gravity to solve puzzles. Collect all 50 gems and explore 8 vibrant worlds!

name: The Collector's Legends
short_description: A deck-building RPG roguelite with lots of loot, deep interactive mechanics, and extensive character and card customizations.

name: Not Your Mama's Autobattler
short_description: Invite your friends, build your team and prepare for battle.

name: Holy Shit
short_description: Click to the Shit and collected many Points.

name: Piggy Jump
short_description: Here is the Hardest game ever made! Game about Piggy, who is a basketball player with a dream to defeat everyone. Jump, Dodge, Dunk and Fly with Piggy to complete all 45 Levels and mini games. Piggy Jump is a big challenge for thos who like difficult games!

name: Path of a Player
short_description: This Game is loosely based on Solo Leveling

name: Astortion
short_description: Astortion is a minimalistic, atmospheric puzzle-platformer that revolves around gravity. Explore the ruins of the most pivotal research facility on earth, unlock new abilities that mess with spacetime itself, and get to the bottom of what is going on.

name: Rogue Soulstone
short_description: Collect the Rogue Soulstones in this physics-based, fast-paced action roguelike RPG to achieve ultimate power. Learn spells to create powerful synergies, decimate hordes of corrupted souls, face titanic bosses, die, upgrade and try again with a new build.

name: Moving in with My Step-sister
short_description: One day, I received a phone call from my folks informing me that my stepsister was moving to the same city for work. It turned out she would be staying in my flat for the time being. A bright pink comet barreled into my humdrum routine. And so, my exciting life began with my stepsister moving in...

name: Shrine Maiden Kanna's Meatheaded ExorFist Record
short_description: A Pixel Art Beat 'em up Scrolling Action Game. This hot-blooded meathead shrine maiden, by the name of Kanna, will resolve all problems standing in her way... with her MIGHT! Defeat waves of enemies with her M(uscular)ystical Miko Powers!

name: The Girlfriend From My Novel
short_description: I was an obscure professional writer. A heroine of my work appeared in front of my house and asked to move in with me?! Half resisting, I let this female thief from a fantasy world live in my house. With her insistence, my ordinary, unchanging life began to change... But why did she appear?

name: Night Dreams
short_description: "This is not a world for you to live in" – those were the surreal words of a mysterious man who broke into your home. Your steady life at university used to be a cycle of the same routine. The only way to get back to reality was to face your own heart. Should you trust that person's words?

name: My Royal Maid R
short_description: In a mansion, the housekeeper you've known for many years retired and found a new maid to take over her job. From then on, your ordinary life began to have a different color, and a relaxed and erotic cohabitation story unfolded...

name: Slave Doll
short_description: An easy and relaxing simulation game! Interactive animation game made entirely in LIVE2D!

name: Dream State Warriors
short_description: As a first-class magician, Gorudo goes to a castle full of dangers in order to defeat a succubus who was once his teacher.…

name: Constantine
short_description: [ Server Closed ]Sorry but Server is closed now.Indie MMORPG game,Constantine! Do Adventure And be strong!The Constantine is a world that exists inside Nathan's tree.After spring, summer, autumn and winter, the world goes to sleep.

name: It's Dark
short_description: There has been a containment breach in a secret facility located deep underground. Experiment E.C.H.O has escaped and is running loose. The lab has gone into shutdown mode, and it's dark...

name: Almost Home Now
short_description: A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.

name: Eat Fish, Get Achievements
short_description: Eat Fish, Get Achievements is a relaxing arcade-style game where you eat fish and unlock new playable characters. The game involves moving around a 2d environment and eating smaller fish than yourself. Some fish have abilities and some change the rules of the game. Get achievements and high scores!

name: Krimzon hoard
short_description: Experience the joy of looting hoards by fighting through the hordes of enemies and then plunder the chests of there loot, Play the one room challenge mode to learn the gun skills and surviving to high rounds and then Explore and find your way through the multiple levels of the campaign.

name: Mega Demon Blaster
short_description: Blast demons until you can't escape no more! Mega Demon Blaster is a casual arena based shooter where you create builds for your weapon and try to break the game before you die! Enemies comes in waves and they get stronger and stronger but luckily you do to.

name: Stickman Synthwave Escape
short_description: Play as stickman, escape the mysterious secret laboratory and collect all the pills! Stickman Synthwave Escape has stunning colorful graphics, hand-crafted levels, tight controls, fun gameplay and synthwave soundtrack.

name: MAGITERRA
short_description: Magiterra is a farming simulator game with RTS controls. With a little bit of added fantasy elements, create your crop fields, produce hundreds of resources, fulfill many different missions, help your kingdom prosper and live in wealth!

name: QUO
short_description: A first-person dystopian sci fi-liminal adventure that mixes mystery, liminal spaces and science fiction. In this mission you are QUO, an autonomous robot explorer. Find the trail of the lost crew, dive underwater and investigate a reality full of enigmas. Now it's your turn.

name: Arsolid Productions
short_description: Your dreams and wishes have come true in this immense new world of adventures and stories, in a game like never seen before.

name: Egglien
short_description: A retro space themed action shooter where your bullets send you flying through the air!

name: Omni Magic!
short_description: The Kingdom of Elaire was protected by Goddess. When the treasure was stolen, the King called for investigators, whose mission was to research monsters and bring the treasure back. The newly appointed magician Anemone goes on the adventure, using the item-based magic, "Omni Magic"...

name: Rabbitoad
short_description: A frog-like rabbit is the main character's high-difficulty 2D action In order to fulfill the wish that "I will not be mistaken for a frog" Aim for the place of the goddess.

name: Sword and Shadow
short_description: This is a moba type game. In the game, players can choose one of five different characters and destroy the enemy crystals to win. The game provides a variety of weapons, players can buy equivalent weapons according to their money reserves, or sell weapons.

name: Monstrous Realms
short_description: Monstrous Realms is a Grand Strategy-Tactical RPG Hybrid in a medieval fantasy world. Govern a kingdom, directing heroes and monsters to conquer the continent. Victory is grasped through warfare, research, city development, diplomacy, trade, dungeon delving, crafting, and unit customization.

name: Upirja
short_description: Upirja is a first-person horror adventure game set in 19th Century in the Balkans. Find clues, fight the wolves and rid these lands of an evil ghoul that haunts them. Be a woodcutter lost in the forest, be a hunter against packs of wolves, fight hordes of revenants and... be the murky vampire!

name: Akapulka - The Rainbow
short_description: Akapulka is a meditative game about floating across unique ancient ruins and collecting flowers.

name: Jacob Larkin's Wild Europe
short_description: Welcome to Jacob Larkin's Wild Europe! Survive and Thrive as one of many lovingly recreated European species.

name: Land of Viewers
short_description: Land Of Viewer est un projet reliant les diffusions en direct de Islide et le jeu. Chaque bâtiment disposé dans le projet appartient à un viewer présent au moment de sa création, et celui-ci évolue au fil du temps. En jeu vous pourrais donc explorer le monde pour découvrir son évolution.

name: Toons City
short_description: Toons City is a modified version of the classic city simulation. The game introduces gameplay elements to reproduce the sensations and difficulties inherent in creating and managing a real small town.

name: 2D Brick Breaker Game | REMASTERED
short_description: 2D Brick Breaker Game | REMASTERED is a relaxing/casual retro game where you shoot balls and break the variously colored bricks. There are also a lot of different powerups to make the game more immersive. The game has 100 unique levels.

name: Element Fighters
short_description: Element Fighters is the only third person multiplayer Arena-Shooter where you fight against players around the world using the four elements: Air, Earth, Water and Fire. Chose your nation and decide your destiny!

name: Neon Nights 2
short_description: Continue with Kate's lewd story in the continuation of the original Neon Nights, now taking part at the police station after she got arrested! Will she find a way out of this mess? Or will she have to spend the night in a cold, lonely cell?

name: Cazzarion: Demon Hunting
short_description: Demons are troubling here. Kill the brood of evil and send it back to hell. As opponents, the demons of hell are fighting against you. You landed in the middle of the Demons Apocalypse, choose your weapon and shoot.

name: Mantra
short_description: Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Corrupted AI code caused thousands of industrial robots to turn into human-killing murder machines. As the former lead developer for Tenso Corp, you feel its your duty to right the wrongs that brought chaos to the world.

name: Bullet Chase
short_description: You must rescue a body from an invading virus by assisting the immune defense system. An action survival puzzle game, you go from room to room eradicating enemies who relentlessly chase you down by leading them onto bullets being fired from openings on the walls.

name: Escape From Meat City
short_description: A fast-paced, roguelike first-person shooter with hand-drawn visuals. Escape from the slaughterhouse, shoot your way through hordes of Federal Agents, and collect enough change for the bus!

name: Disco Tomb
short_description: Disco Tomb is a sci-fi retro FPS / boomer shooter made just like in the good ol' days!👾 Use magic spells AND guns to fight your way through huge waves of enemies in freaky dungeons or out in the open desert against the hordes of the invaders! Oblivion awaits!🛸

name: Workplace Malice
short_description: A monstrous entity looms over the employees of an insurance company. Theo, A normal office worker, finds himself engulfed in a deadly nightmare with no way out as secrets about the workplace are uncovered.

name: The Fairy's Secret
short_description: In this sequel to the fantasy yuri visual novel, The Fairy's Song, Marnie and Lisbeth return to Fenchapel to visit Marnie’s grandmother. Things soon become complicated, however, when they run into two figures from the past who ought to be dead.

name: Winter tramp
short_description: Winter tramp - A story about a tramp who has to overcome many trials, pain and mysteries on his difficult path. The next 40 kilometers are filled with robbers and wild animals.

name: BoomCrash
short_description: BoomCrash is a small physics-based game aimed at destroying buildings and other architectural structures using explosives.

name: Sincerely, Stampy
short_description: Abducted... by aliens? No! By Astral Entities!! Welcome to the Astral Plane. You and four other Humans have been selected. In the next two weeks, please explore the facility, collect stamps, make friends, and uncover multiple endings. We'll be watching your progress. Best of luck, Human.

name: Ned Kelly: Armored Outlaw
short_description: This game is an alternate history themed FPS. Based on Ned Kelly, an Australian outlaw in the 1880s. It all kicks off where the real gang met their end. Can you survive the initial police raid at Glenrowan?

name: Survive 10 Minutes Please
short_description: Survive 10 minutes please is an action roguelike 2D zombie game where you have to survive a zombie horde by any means. Kill them, Upgrade yourself, Choose your abilities and try your best to survive in a challenging game.

name: Memorabilia
short_description: Find notes and clues that will lead to memories. Change the present by manipulating your past. You must save your childhood friend in order to escape the mansion of memories.

name: No More Giants
short_description: Fight off The Inventors as you search for answers in a world once shepherd by Ancient Giants in this first person game inspired by BioShock.

name: Lord of Darkness: Prologue
short_description: Lord of Darkness: Prologue is a fantasy game made in pixel-based graphics, just like in the good old days of the early dawn of Japanese rpg. An epic adventure full of dangers and hardships awaits you.

name: STEIIARIA
short_description: STEIIARIA - Endless space lo-fi adventure for all lovers of puzzles and fun! Mahjong, space and planets come together to give you the ultimate gameplay and music enjoyment in this game.

name: DouDas Danger
short_description: Doudas Danger - Unusual platformer will throw you into the thick of a hot skirmish in the depths of a magical forest! The undead, slugs and mimics rebelled and stole all the treasures of the forest - your task is to return them.

name: Slime Dungeon
short_description: Slime Dungeon: 2D action-adventure. Play as Gubby, duck warrior. Save world from evil slugs. Find artifacts, beat bosses. Unforgettable smiley-faced slime battles.

name: CHICKWEED
short_description: CHICKWEED - A strange creature has escaped from the lab... and that creature is you! Fight your way to freedom through hordes of enemies, dangerous traps and treacherous ambushes in this hardcore platformer and uncover the mystery of the running bush!

name: EpicRecovery
short_description: A shooter game with endless fun of turning back and forth. The game system is simple, with a short stage lasting less than one minute, in which you aim for a high score until you run out of remaining airplanes.

name: 30 days in red army
short_description: Hello guys, Eny Project Studio presents our first PC game. 30 Days in red army is a simple text RPG with pixelated graphic and randomized events and results. Game was created to reflect our attitude against war activities by you know who and his incompetent army.

name: Chaotic Loop
short_description: Chaotic Loop is a little game, where your objective is to complete the level you choose, also everytime you play something in the game will change and this makes the loop of finishing the level chaotic.

name: Deer Journey
short_description: Deer Journey is a third person walking simulator game. Outcasted by the other deers, an albino fawn is forced to go deep into the forest to find a place to live. Join him on his journey through a world too big for which he may not be yet ready.

name: hopeless.
short_description: Since her parents passed away, she was forced to live by herself. Now her normal life is taken away, and she has to find her own food and bed. Her adventure starts in this crisis.

name: Picking Wheat
short_description: This game is mainly composed of two parts: you are forced to watch some author's nonsense, and some simple puzzle levels. There are 9 preset levels to help players understand the basic rules of the puzzle. Free level editor, players can edit and upload levels, Download them, and give your likes!

name: QuickMatrix
short_description: The QuickMatrix tool makes it possible for you to find files and folders with one click. You don't have to worry about huge number of folders and files, and you don't have to worry about the new tool blocking your desktop. Come and use it to increase your efficiency.

name: NanoHive
short_description: Manage your hive of nanobots in a Free-to-Play top-down arena shooter and exterminate all the bacteria and viruses infecting the body. Multiply the hive by absorbing bacteria to save people's lives as fast as possible while competing with others in order to become the fastest NanoHive Operator.

name: Monos: The Endless Tower
short_description: Guard the last remaining tower with an array of weapons and magical powers! In this unique tower defense on a tower game, the horde of monsters coming from down below is relentless, and it is your duty to dispatch them.

name: Zoo Chess
short_description: Game based on chess where each piece on the board has its unique ability. You can play against the A.I or with your friends online

name: Pit Fighter Tycoon
short_description: Abduct. Enhance. Battle. PROFIT. You're an alien that abducts humans to build the most powerful gladiator team in the universe! Surgically enhance your humans, or grind them down for profits. Become the worst kind of corporate overlord in this creature-collector RPG with auto-battle combat!

name: Flora and Sauna
short_description: Flora and Sauna is an 18+ visual novel set at a spa with some unique services. Explore the spa and meet a fun cast of interesting characters! Help them out, and they'll be sure to reward you in their own special ways~

name: Police Scanner Radio - Real Live Audio - Happening Now!
short_description: Police Scanner Radio gameplay is free world racing and exploration behind the wheel of a luxury sports car while listening to Police Scanner Radio live audio feeds of real police and fire radio streams!Drive your luxury sports car to find easter eggs and hidden surprises.

name: FIRE HEAT
short_description: FIRE HEAT is a 2D simulation sports game! Immerse yourself in the world of sports and entertainment. You will have a completely unusual approach to sports games, knock down skittles with a butterfly knife throw, throw glass bottles into rings or kick a cake instead of a ball.

name: Space Turbo 2
short_description: Space Turbo 2 - Continuation of a dynamic arcade game in which you have to fly a futuristic space plane through an endless tunnel and avoid various traps.

name: House of the Soul
short_description: Begin a journey of deception and discovery in 'HOUSE OF THE SOUL', a first-person exploration and story based experience. Explore an isolated mansion and descend into its lower levels as you discover the hidden secret project of the obsessive inventor who lives there.

name: Pax Dei
short_description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

name: CATACLYSM: Even Angels Sin
short_description: CATACLYSM: Even Angels Sin is an FPS Bullet Hell with UNLIMITED movement. Breach the Sinner's Paradise as the Heaven Breaker and reclaim the divine realm from hordes of false Angels.

name: Reborn : Fate Of Gods
short_description: Reborn is a first person psychological horror game. You have to survive from gods awakening and need to find out how to get more strength while you are surrounded with enemies.

name: Hypnosis Prison
short_description: The world is frozen over and you are locked in Prison City with no way out. But you can turn your situation around by using hypnosis on the prison’s inhabitants. I will hypnotize you, high and mighty Warden Snow!

name: The Block
short_description: The Block is the world's smallest city builder. Place randomly generated buildings on a square and build up a tiny but perfectly formed city block! It's a very small game - more of a tiny little toy with no goals or challenges - hence the very small price :)

name: Anime Armpits
short_description: Anime Armpits... It can't get better than this...

name: Twilight bride :VORMSLEGEND
short_description: "Alice" silently protected "Philip" who broke into the underworld. She thought that after many tests, she could find the never withering rose symbolizing love and go to the wedding banquet hall. Who would have guessed that their ordeal is not over yet? How will it develop in the end?

name: Champ's Nightmare
short_description: Champ's Nightmare is a horror immersive audio game for the visually impaired which prioritizes ears over eyes.

name: Trade Post Forest
short_description: Trade Post Forest is an open world exploration game about a successful trade post in the middle of the woods. Explore the trade post and the surrounding land to discover new landmarks and tools. Don't get lost.

name: Dream magic will
short_description: This is a highly difficult magic strategy tower defense exploration game. You need to explore the big map and collect all kinds of cards, heroes and magic to fight. There are many levels in the game. You need to make strategic arrangements to resist the attack of all enemies and win.

name: Aliens After Ava
short_description: You are Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion. Fight back as you dodge, jump, roll, and use advanced technology to navigate your escape across terrain and extraterrestrial foes!

name: Zodiac fantasy
short_description: The little sisters have an important date (maybe several!) Now they need your help to cross the obstacles, use jumping or climbing flexibly to reach the date, the girls will thank you for it!

name: 天若有情
short_description: 《天若有情》是一款全新3D爱恋MMORPG游戏！游戏拥有次世代完美画质，清新细腻的地图场景，恢宏大气的3D无缝大地图，重现端游视听感受，丰富的社交玩法成就相伴相守；专属DIY捏脸，千万组合，彰显个性；自由立体飞行坐骑，带你畅游四海八荒！百变灵殊任你选，可爱小鸡，喵狗全齐。特有的王权交互系统，助力成就帝王梦。

name: Shadow Angel
short_description: This game is a domestic third person RPG action soul game with female protagonists. In the process of fighting against the dark forces, you will continue to become stronger. Use multiple skills flexibly to defeat the enemy in bloody battle.

name: Pixel Survivors : Roguelike
short_description: A rogue-lite game where you must face hundreds of monsters with increasingly difficult bosses that strong enough to take you down. Choose your abilities, build your favorite combat style, become stronger and survive as long as you can!

name: Afterdream
short_description: Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction. Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence. Find the purpose of your nocturnal visit in a vivid and dreamlike setting.

name: Aerofly FS 4 Flight Simulator
short_description: We promise you will feel like a pilot flying airliners, helicopters, fighters, gliders, historical and aerobatic aircraft in a photorealistic world! Over 10,000 real world flights, highly detailed cockpits and scenery are awaiting you.

name: Count Pumpcula
short_description: One misty moonlit night, Count Dracula is attacked by an orange object from the sky. He finds himself awaking on a mysterious island with a pumpkin stuck to his head. With the new power of the pumpkin that protects Dracula from sunlight, he must find his way off the island and back to his Castle.

name: Jelly Forest
short_description: Help the cube jump over the steep rocks and get as far as possible before he loses all his three hearts

name: Grid Words
short_description: The next generation of word games has arrived…

name: Crow Country
short_description: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, Crow Country. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of Crow Country to find them…

name: YAYS - Your Adventure Your Story
short_description: Fantasy Turn-Based RPG. Make group of 1-4 characters and wander across world with rich lore, that you can fill by your imagination. The world that is never the same thanks to randomise mechanism. Every player has own story and unique experience. It is Your Adventure and Your Story! YAYS

name: Vapor World: Over The Mind
short_description: Lost in darkness, a boy drawn into a twisted dream, no way out. Vapor World is a narrative-driven souls-like platformer focused on deflection combat set in atmospheric world of dream. Descend within shattered mind seeking lost memories. Face dark, beautiful world born of anguish and regret.

name: Cordbot
short_description: Short game about solving wire puzzles with an adorable robot protagonist. Solve various puzzles involving cords, electrical wires, lasers and more. Pick up plugs and place them in sockets to open doors and turn on devices. Complete over 30 handcrafted stages.

name: Sakura Hime 3
short_description: Arrive at the Cherry Blossom Garden and spend a sweet daily life with beautiful girls. Faced with their continuous barrage of temptations, how many days can you hold out?

name: Forest of Tails: Arena
short_description: Forest of Tails: Arena is a real-time action arena game that pits you against bugs, animals, and even other mice. Fight your way through waves, gain new skills, and loot powerful equipment to fight your way to the top.

name: Caerulean: Beneath and Beyond
short_description: The year is 2058. Ocean sea levels have risen considerably and several coastal cities have been abandoned. As Laura Deckard, you will explore underwater stations and surrounding areas, help clean underwater ecosystems and interact with the other denizens of the blue world.

name: Paws for Adventure
short_description: Hunt, Fight and Meow your way to saving the cat colonies. A purrrfect adventure for cat lovers.

name: End of Night
short_description: 1943. You are sitting in a boat with Josef, rowing from Nazi-occupied Denmark to safety in neutral Sweden. As he crosses the ocean, the sea gives way to the streets and people that populate his mind. Your journey becomes a living landscape of recollections from the night of his escape.

name: Escape from Ever After
short_description: A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! When a greedy megacorp from the real world starts taking over fairytales for their cheap labor, a newly-hired storybook hero must climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back!

name: I commissioned some bees
short_description: I paid 10 artists to hide bees in their artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Dicefolk
short_description: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure. As a Chimera Summoner, recruit and create your perfect team of mythical beasts and command them to victory using unique dice mechanics.

name: Psychedelia: The Psychonaut
short_description: A surreal action adventure about rebellion, altered states, and finding your stolen motorbike. Take drugs. Fight back. Get free

name: Skator Gator 3D
short_description: Stop the mayor from polluting the swamp in this short, 3D adventure! Explore new open locales with skateboard in hand or while grinding on pipelines — Greenjamin's skating into the third dimension in SKATOR GATOR 3D!

name: The Purge Dilemma
short_description: Do you have the intuition and cunning to successfully save yourself from the purges of a paranoid dictator? Prove your loyalty to the Tyrant in this social deduction game designed for 5-10 players.

name: Bow-Bots
short_description: Bow-Bots is a VR Multiplayer Bow and Arrow Shooter with a unique item system. Shoot targets to gain powerful arrows or recharge your shields. The better your aim the better the reward.

name: Witchy Witch
short_description: A single player adventure game where you take the role of a witch. Explore the world, solve puzzles and restore your shattered cauldron.

name: Monolith Dominion
short_description: As the Guardian Avatar of the realm you'll harvest the souls of your opponents and use their powers to your advantage. Use the ancient Monoliths to summon minions powered by the souls of your enemies. Explore the world, evolve your powers and ultimately forge your dominion in this tactical ARPG.

name: Bonelords
short_description: Build up yourself & your defenses in Bonelords! Defend against waves of enemies in this Souls-like, Terraria-like, Rouge-like experience!

name: Byte Lynx
short_description: Byte Lynx is a fast-paced RTS with no units. Build defenses, dismantle your enemy, and steal their buildings in this deeply tactical building combat-based strategy game. Expand your arsenal across a series of diverse levels!

name: Dungeon Keeper Gold™
short_description: Build your dungeon & protect it with a labyrinth of dark corridors, a web of deadly traps, an arsenal of powerful spells, and an army of bloodthirsty demons

name: The Courtson Manor: Prologue
short_description: Unravel the mystery of this top-down paranormal investigation story, what is going on and why? Solve puzzles and figure out clues while something in the darkness creeps and sneaks... Will you solve the mystery or be the victim, which end will you find ???

name: Fowl Scourge
short_description: In this Dark Fantasy Action-RPG you are part of a plague doctor guild where every encounter with your patients is a boss fight.

name: Sokolor
short_description: Sokolor is a sokoban game with innovative mechanics. Push the colored cubes into their correct positions, but first you need to paint yourself the same color to be able to push them!

name: Exfiltrator: Cyber Stealth Missions
short_description: Participate in an advanced cybernetic stealth training program.

name: Zombie Spree: The Dawn
short_description: Relax and shoot zombies in Zombie Spree: The Dawn - a static shooter with a variety of weaponry. Turn them into a pile of blood without the need to move around. Enjoy the perfect game for chilling after a tough day!

name: Beastly Muscles
short_description: You are a talented bodybuilder, now you need to become a citizen of a famous bodybuilding capitol. Plan your schedule, watch your stats, take jobs as you like and climb the rankings to become a top bodybuilder.

name: Keita's Adventures on the African Savannah
short_description: The game tells the story of Keita, an African boy who followed migratory animals from Serengeti National Park to Masai Mara Wildlife Sanctuary to seek medicine for his family. On the way, he confronted dangerous wild animals…

name: The Last City
short_description: "Survive and thrive in the desert! Lead a group of colonists, build a thriving colony, gather resources, craft tools, and research technologies in 'The Last City' - a challenging survival strategy game."

name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
short_description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

name: Mystical Riddles: Behind Doll’s Eyes Collector's Edition
short_description: What's hidden in an ordinary toy? Is it possible to bring the dead back to life? Find answers to these questions using your wits, knowledge of the paranormal phenomena, and your special equipment – a magic camera! Are you up for the challenge?

name: Entity Researchers: Prologue
short_description: You just got hired by EIRI; researching and battling the Visitors, a dark sci-fi RPG with themes of exploration and survival.

name: Super Barista
short_description: Delivering coffee shots...in space! Fast-paced cosmic mixture between Tower defense and Matchmaking, in an always unpredictable universe full of quirky customers from the entire galaxy. Brace yourself for a caffeinated journey like no other!

name: 国際指定怪異123号 廃村
short_description: 毎年出現する「廃村」と呼ばれる奇妙な無人村には、必ず１人の少女が生贄として幽閉される… 廃村に突入する３人の特殊部隊と、監禁された１人の少女を操作し、脱出を目指します。

name: Excommunicado
short_description: Rogue-lite deck-builder set in the gritty neo-noir world of assassins and killers. Play as one of 5 unique specialists, power up with permanent upgrades, beat the game and then strap in for the next ride with end-game modifiers for near limitless challenge.

name: Yakiniku simulator
short_description: Simple and easy game! Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!

name: BURST WITCH
short_description: A bullet hell game with the classic scrolling shooter gameplay

name: The Gun Goes; BOOM!
short_description: Oh no, you have lost your legs! Use your sci-fi gun to rocket jump your way up, but be careful; one wrong move and you might just fall right to where you started.

name: Kingdom Square
short_description: A tile-based minimalist city-building and automation game set in the middle ages.

name: Beast of Reincarnation
short_description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

name: Spintales
short_description: The world has succumbed to the curse of gold. You too, start to feel the drag of it... Can you cleanse the world of the curse, once and for all? Pick up your sword and shield, and venture into a unique roguelike adventure!

name: A Crown of Thorns
short_description: A Cyberpunk visual novel in a post Apocalyptic world that is a cross between Sin City and Blade Runner. Based on the IP of the 3 time award nominated feature film script entitled “Blade n Blood” .

name: Snaccoon
short_description: Be nimble. Be clever. Be finding snacks. Snaccoon is a stealth/exploration game starring a raccoon.

name: Operation Defensive!
short_description: Operation Defensive is a tower defense game but instead of monsters following a track they follow a player. place down towers to fight those monsters and try to get to the highest wave you can! have fun!

name: Spermination: Cream of the Crop
short_description: You may have beaten off others and came first a thousand times, but you've never tasted the sweet Cream of the Crop. This sequel is harder, faster and will blow your crusty socks off! Choose from 3 difficult leagues: Hand, Mouth and the coveted Cream Pie! Crack the egg & unlock your bundle of joy!

name: Raspberry Cube
short_description: Azuma Satoru has sworn a life to do good on others with the lofty goal of one good deed a day. Upon his return to his hometown, things are going well as he helps the girls at his school but soon his life is about to get a little more chaotic...

name: My Academy's Special Place
short_description: Our hero's homeroom teacher is also his big sister, Yaeka. She's popular with the students, but at home, she's a slobbish drunk. There's Maika, an exchange student and Akiba nerd. She's always asking him to go to Akiba with her. But Maika is told to return home. Two love stories are about to begin!

name: StarMech
short_description: Transform your mech to fight, upgrade, and survive long enough to jump to safety in this bullet hell roguelite.

name: Future Mirror
short_description: "Ten years from now, I will be dead..." A coming-of-age fantasy adventure tale, Future Mirror is a visual novel that explores fate and the choices that affect our future, tragedy, relationships, and happiness.

name: Keeper's Toll
short_description: Delve into Keeper’s Toll, an action-packed roguelite brimming with challenge and despair. Survive against an onslaught of relentless hordes and grueling bosses with skill-based ARPG gameplay. Embrace the darkness and cleanse these cursed lands.

name: Death Bowl
short_description: Death Bowl is a 2D precision platformer where you race through a deadly obstacle course to compete for the fastest time. The odds are against you, but with the help of experimental drugs, you just might live to see another day.

name: Story Time
short_description: Story Time is a fast-paced multiplayer PvP tactics game. Play locally or online, dive into Story Mode, or create your own adventures with the Story Maker. Discover powerful combos and lead your teams to victory.

name: Make It In Time
short_description: Alicia Hudson and her fellow survivors must find a way to escape a dying planet after their spaceship crashes. This third-person shooter action game features RPG elements, a variety of weapons, fast-paced combat, massive enemy waves, challenging defend the city missions & much more..

name: Detective: The Mountain City
short_description: You are a detective who newly arrived in the mountain city, helping the local police to solve the crime. You need to be able to use your powers of deduction to find the killers and bring them to justice. Enjoy your trip to the mountain city.

name: Little Town Shooter VR
short_description: This game is a VR shooting game. You need to get money by killing opponents and unlock more weapons. Finally find a way to defeat the final boss.

name: The Robot Girl Meets The Human!
short_description: This is an adventure game that takes you on a journey through a world after humans have disappeared. Lead the robot girl "Scarlet" to find the surviving humans.

name: Caddywack
short_description: Strap in for Caddywack! Dive into a high-octane blend of arcade-style driving and inventive platforming in this physics-based puzzle game that's all about precision and speed. Navigate through thrilling levels where each stage presents a new passenger and a challenging route packed with obstacles

name: ♡beAt! -After the Summer-
short_description: A visual novel about identity crisis, friendship and growing up. Spread your wings, after the summer sky.

name: 停留此刻 Stay in the moment
short_description: 《停留此刻》是一款单线路的短篇视觉小说，讲述了白小夕与律晓文的师生之间，因为一本诗集所引发的互相改变与和解的故事

name: Easy Poetry
short_description: Writing your own Chinese Poem is not as difficult as you thought. With the help of Easy Poetry, you could be a poet, too!

name: Home Solo Car Racer
short_description: It's a small toy car home racing game with 51 indoor levels. You are alone in the game. it's a single player game. But with the option to save multiple user profiles. Also "check the music in the video".

name: SpiritBelowTheWaves
short_description: EXPLORE, SURVIVE the deep ocean a beautiful new world awaits. Unravel an amazing story about the player at your hand. Experience a roller coaster of emotions in this new unexplored world.

name: SHPR
short_description: SHPR is an arena survival roguelike in which you have to buy items while creating amazing builds and synergies that will help you defeat enemies and bosses to be able to pass to the next stages.

name: Youmandriver
short_description: Take on the Youmandriver challenge: a demanding simulation and management game. Face dense traffic on narrow roads with ultra-realistic vehicle physics. Choose your missions, manage your career and budget. Experience intense and authentic driving !

name: Otaku Engine
short_description: Explore, build, and share virtual galleries created from your favorite hard drive or website images.

name: Chloe Puzzle Game
short_description: "This charming pixel art puzzle game features adorable visuals across 72 puzzles, with each puzzle boasting its own unique logic that will put players' wits to the test. Every puzzle features a new design where players have to get Chloe and Bunny safely to their Targets"

name: Tales From Hoia Baciu Forest
short_description: Stranded in the depths of an eerie forest after your car breaks down, you set out in search of help. But as you navigate the darkness, an unseen presence stalks you—until it finally strikes. The adventure begins. First-person horror that will introduce you to Hoia Baciu lore.

name: SeaOrama: World of Shipping
short_description: Experience the challenges of running a successful shipping company with Seaorama: World of Shipping.

name: 吞食一统中原Tunshi  unifying plains
short_description: "The Conquest of China" is a RPG role-playing game centered around Liu Bei of the Shu Kingdom. Unlike other Three Kingdoms RPGs, the game does not start with the usual storyline, but instead begins with the murder of Liu's mother by the Yellow Turban Rebellion, setting Liu on a path of revenge.

name: Delilah
short_description: Eastern Europe is the newest Circle of Hell, but outside its walls things aren't much better. Relentless action, pixelated gore, 256 colors. That is Delilah. And yeah, it is inspired by other shooters starting with a 'D'.

name: Get Trolled
short_description: Can you beat all the levels while getting trolled or do you quit ?

name: Kingdom Legends: The fallen kings
short_description: Kingdom Legends: The fallen kings is a roguelike experience that lets you take control of an adventurer king exploring a long forgone fortress after a disastrously multi nation invasion gone wrong.

name: AI UNDER TEST
short_description: The fear of artificial intelligence is nothing new, but will it always be for the bad? Solve puzzles and follow the creator's and creator's conversation during the testing phase, until the moment they are interrupted by external matters.

name: Kingdom Legends: The fallen kings Playtest
CubeShooter
short_description: this is a tower defence game, character cant move,but you can choose your weapon,and your evolution way and get special result ， randomn map, random weapon and random enemies; we add some roguelite elements and character can get permanent upgrade.

name: Tales of Violet Valley
short_description: A 4 player co-op horror game that takes you through the horror and mysteries of Violet Valley, a town that doesn't officially exist.

name: King Arthur's Petaldust Saga
short_description: 800 years under the spiked heels of the English. WE DO NOT FORGIVE, WE DO NOT FORGET, NEVER SURRENDER! Journey with King Arthur in this unforgettable visual novel, as he engages in frivolous antics throughout England. Encounter ghastly apparitions, ragamuffins and gasp... ENGLISHMEN! ARGH ARGH ARGH!

name: Midnight Renegade: Recollections
short_description: A Victorian 2D action platformer where you shoot and slash through grunts until you reach their boss, the Chief Constable.

name: Cube Control
short_description: Help a lone cube navigate through sixty electrifying levels in this isometric puzzle-adventure game. Carefully manage the use of your limited moves in order to complete each level successfully, all while avoiding dangerous obstacles through careful timing and creative movement choices.

name: Gossamer Matrix
short_description: A retro-inspired, jumbled-up arcade shooter with disorienting gameplay mechanics set during the height of corporate militarization.

name: Raiden IV x MIKADO remix
short_description: Buckle up and blast off with Raiden IV x MIKADO remix! This classic arcade shoot ‘em up comes fully equipped with new music, battle modes, vertical screen play, and more!

name: Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX
short_description: Soar sky-high in Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX, an electrifying entry in the classic arcade shoot-‘em-up series! Customize your music, wallpapers, game mode, and more before launching into high-octane aerial action!

name: Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess
short_description: Join Kururu on her journey to find true love and experience the charm of Rhapsody II's storybook adventure!

name: Rhapsody III: Memories of Marl Kingdom
short_description: Dive back into Marl Kingdom through a series of charming stories that concludes the tales of Rhapsody I and Rhapsody II!

name: Super Skeleton Butler
short_description: Protect your treasure from hordes of do-gooder adventurers! As a skeleton butler, it’s your duty to keep out the riff-raff using a variety of traps and good old skeleton magic in this tower defense/platformer mashup.

name: Arcade Flight
short_description: You're controlling a plane that is going forward in an infinite and randomized space filled with barriers. Use your reflexes to dodge the incoming barriers in high speed. Collect coins along the way to later spend them in the store section.

name: Perseus: Titan Slayer
short_description: Defeat the Titans as you battle your way into Tartarus to stop Chaos from conquering Olympus and destroying the world. In this rogue-like dungeon crawler adventure, you will play as Perseus, a demigod tasked with one mission; stop Chaos and the evil forces that surround him.

name: Monsters Domain: Prologue
short_description: Defend the Monsters’ Domain. Kill heroes and collect their treasures. Play the Monsters’ side and loot foolish warriors who dare to explore your realm. Build up your forces, upgrade them and equip them with better weapons, skills and tricks to lure and kill even more shiny forces of the light.

name: Orc Warchief: Prologue
short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

name: Day Of Pixel
short_description: Top Down open World/ 2D Platformer Wild west, Farm, Restaurant, Explore, Shoot!

name: Scary Mansion Horror House HD
short_description: Welcome to your new mansion, on the Scary Mansion: Horror House 3D!

name: TitTok 3
short_description: TitTok 3: FINAL CHAPTER. An adventurous 2D puzzle-platformer with Cats, explosions, portals and deadly lasers! An epic conclusion to the enchanting trilogy. TikTok ≠ TitTok

name: PSI Masquerade
short_description: PSI Masquerade, an online action fighting death game for both PC and smartphone.

name: Smokyflex
short_description: Game Features: - Pixel graphics - Hero weapon upgrade system - Final Boss - Soundtrack

name: Binary Syndrome
short_description: The year is 2101, in a near future where the line between man and machine is fading. Through counseling, the film unravels the disease of inoperability caused by 21g, which has suddenly increased in some androids. It is a PC-98 respect command-click ADV with FM sound music and 20 color dots.

name: Wallpaper Alive
short_description: The free and open source animated wallpaper utility for Windows! Transform your desktop with animated gifs and videos.

name: Merge Beasts - Defense Game
short_description: Prepare for an extraordinary adventure in Merge Beasts, a unique blend of merging mechanics and tower defense gameplay. In this captivating defense game, you'll embark on a quest to defend your kingdom against waves of menacing beasts by merging and evolving your powerful creatures.

name: Eternal Rome
short_description: A city builder that combines futurism and the aesthetics of ancient Rome. Lead your people into the future era by researching new technologies, creating modern infrastructure, and withstanding external forces. Make Rome an eternal city!

name: Plane Attack
short_description: Control an airplane with a third-person view, and your task is to destroy all enemy equipment on the battlefield. Stock up on armor and fuel to last longer on the battlefield. The plane is equipped with an endless supply of missiles and bombs. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

name: Match Village
short_description: Match Village is a minimalist puzzle and strategy game about merge buildings to create villages on colorful islands.

name: Undivine Comedy: Hank's Inferno
short_description: A comedy roguelite set in 7 circles of hell. Hack, slash, upgrade and insult your way through numerous enemies. Square off against challenging bosses. Explore hidden paths and find valuable booty. After this you'll never look at hell the same way again.

name: Bonk'd Audio Visualizer
short_description: Lightweight 3D audio visualizer with a minimalist, modern design.

name: Moonatics
short_description: MOONATICS is a hyperactive 2D fighter with a focus on KICKING ASS... featuring a colourful cast of freaks and misfits, rollback netcode, and stylish hand-drawn animations OOZING with character!

name: DEMON TOMB
short_description: A first-person survival horror game, solve puzzles and search for supplies to arm yourself with as you explore to uncover the secrets of an old mansion. Fight, run or hide from all sorts of twisted horrors.

name: Toroa: Skycall

short_description: is a 2d puzzle game about dating. You need to help the boy or girl find the other half and complete the date in different scenarios.

name: Invasive
short_description: Grow crops and expand your farm. Using invasive species to help control other pests or environmental factors you can build an agricultural empire. Or use the invasive species to slow your competition. Nature can be your friend. Or nature can be your enemy. Choose wisely.

name: 东方异乡录 ~the Apocryphal Gensoukyou
short_description: 《东方异乡录 ~the Apocryphal Gensoukyou》是一款东方Project主题的短篇视觉小说游戏。主要讲述了在河城荷取的邀请下，雾雨魔理沙、爱丽丝·玛格特洛依德、帕秋莉·诺蕾姬三人在虚拟世界“Apocryphal Land”中冒险的爆笑喜剧故事。

name: Neko Cosmo Police
short_description: This twin stick shooter is about Neko fighting with their all cost. In 2565 UC. the Cosmos has been altered by MadBotz gang. The last hope is rely on the Neko Cosmo Police team, "Kuro" and "Shiro"

name: Bolu
short_description: Bolu is a survival and building game with a story set in Lake Abant.

name: GRINDSHIFT
short_description: GRINDSHIFT is a stylized hoverboard game with ramps, rails and jumps. There are no gameplay objectives or unlockables, just endless hoverboard riding and score counting.

name: H.I.v.C.A.: Human Intelligence vs Computer Algorithm
short_description: "H.I.v.C.A." is a strategic game where every choice matters. Gather resources, develop technologies, and strategically place your forces to ensure victory over opponents. There is no room for a draw in this game - only one can become the absolute ruler of the new world.

name: A toad well travelled
short_description: "A toad well travelled" is a short, but challenging, side-scrolling platformer about a young toad that sets off to explore the world outside the safety of his pond. You as the player, will guide the inquisitive toad through diverse, dangerous environments filled with not-so-friendly creatures.

name: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni Playtest
Dormiveglia
short_description: Dormiveglia is a 2D metroidvania starring Quinn, the whip-wielding hero of Spring Plaza. Join Quinn as they team up with the other heroes and allies of Elysium, and search for the four sacred Runes hidden about before they fall into the hands of Somnia!

name: Hollowmoor
short_description: Grow crops, brew potions and search for mystical creatures in this cozy magic life sim. As a budding Witch or Wizard you’ll also befriend and date the townsfolk as you bring magic back to the town of Hollowmoor!

name: Astra Protocol 2
short_description: Monitors have received notification of an unknown event, referred to as ASTRA PROTOCOL. You have been designated search and reconnaissance to determine the meaning of this ASTRA PROTOCOL. SECONDARY OBJECTIVE: Find evidence of survivors. PROBABILITY OF HOSTILES: HIGH.

name: Dreamward
short_description: Dreamward started as a student pitch project at Carnegie Mellon University, Entertainment Technology Center. We created a puzzle-solving game experience combining novel gameplay with amazing art and music inspired by Tang and Tubo cultures.

name: Boulder Island
short_description: The game is a first-person survival battle game, which requires players to defeat the enemy in the game through operation and collection.

name: Die in the Dungeon
short_description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

name: Maria Blanchard Virtual Gallery
short_description: This Virtual Gallery is dedicated to the painter Maria Blanchard. 65 works as never seen before, it has several rooms marked by key dates in her history accompanied by a virtual character who, from some monitors, explains his biography in an entertaining and didactic way.

name: Night At the Gates of Hell
short_description: From the sick mind behind Bloodwash, Jordan King, comes his latest experiment in terror. Inspired by the Italian zombie flicks from Lucio Fulci and Bruno Mattei, Night of the Gates of Hell promises to be a blood dripping, neon soaked, flesh rotting experience.

name: Deadly Night
short_description: Carol is down on her luck, hitchhiking across the country. She arrives at a small roadside motel but there's something strange about the owner. As the secrets unravel, she finds herself entangled in a long, DEADLY NIGHT! Can she escape from hellish nightmare or will she die trying?

name: Happy Trap House
short_description: A fun 3D roguelike trap runner where you, as a toy zombie, must rescue your zombie friends from a house. But be warned, the house is full of deadly dangers!

name: Project RBG
short_description: A fast paced FPS party game. Each round is a different minigame. Collect points to buy upgrades and destroy your friends in The Final Round. Last one standing takes the cake!

name: Tvö
short_description: Tvö is an online cooperative puzzle game where two players must use their wits and communication skills to find a way into the heart of the labyrinth. This game can be played using our in-game voice chat or a third-party option.

name: I commissioned some bees 2
short_description: I paid 10 more artists to hide bees in their artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Power Drill Massacre
short_description: A DRILLING good time!... a VHS era, Lowpoly Slasher

name: WOE
short_description: Dismantle horrific monsters in real-time gallery combat, descending through random dungeons in search of new weapons, tools, and bizarre artifacts to stave off death a little longer. Woe to all who enter...

name: ShipRect
short_description: Transform through various levels as Greg! Human now turned rectangle. Greg's spaceship crashed and he landed on a planet named Egg-12B and he is on his anxious quest back to Earth. Help Greg, he needs it.

name: LiMiT's Escape Room Games 2
short_description: The next chapter of the Escape Room bundle with better controls and jumping! ;) This time you (alone or with friends) can expect 4 levels, which differ in difficulty. The rooms are designed for a gameplay of 1-1.5 hours each. Can you beat this time again?

name: Protect My Cheese
short_description: A stunning and chaotic tower defense strategy game where we play as cats to defeat the cheese-hungry rats. Survive against waves of enemies and guard the cheese.

name: SIMBA THE CAT
short_description: Discover all the different worlds with Simba The Cat. Find all the things that Simba the cat likes, you will unlock extra levels.

name: Silver Wire
short_description: Zombies and bats have appeared in the night hall. It is also the maid's job to eliminate them. Her weapon, the silver wire, binds and cuts the monsters. Let's get down to work.

name: Become a pig
short_description: Online cooperative puzzle solving game using voice recognition

name: Perfect Jump
short_description: This is a relaxing casual game, you need to operate the character to keep jumping to get points

name: Chamrosh
short_description: almost thousand years ago , A Covenant was made Chamrosh Legendary Champion have been choose to protect Persia Nation to eternity, the other Legends called gods and Kaveh the blacksmith made an spell on him to make him immortal but this curse will turn him to stone .

name: The Haunted Library
short_description: Psychological horror game in VHS style. In which your goal is to record evidence of paranormal activity in your house. Find items, solve puzzles and record as mutch as you can.

name: Stunts Contest Police Car
short_description: Going on the most dangerous curves, you will really show who is a master in extreme races. With 5 police supercars, decently equipped, you have all the chances to become No. 1 in the stunt contests.

name: RUUUUUUN
short_description: RUUUUUUN - The game is a puzzle. Move the pawns in the right sequence to move to the next level.

name: Hanako in the abandoned school
short_description: This is a walking simulator game where the story takes place in an abandoned school.You must escape the curse of Hanako and escape alive.Explore the school and collect the materials left behind to uncover what once happened in this school and find a way to escape.

name: GoreBox
short_description: GoreBox is a chaotic physics-driven sandbox where creativity meets destruction. Use the Reality Crusher to spawn, manipulate, and obliterate anything. Customize, battle with friends, roleplay, or face devious creatures. In this world, your imagination rules—and chaos is your playground!

name: Wanderer
short_description: Play as a brave cat in Wanderer, a top-down action roguelike. Reclaim your stolen sausages, battle enemies, and upgrade your cat to grow stronger in a heartwarming adventure full of charm and surprises.

name: After the Inferno
short_description: An adult visual novel set in an original fantasy world. Featuring animated and voice acted scenes, both NSFW and SFW.

name: Ball Torture
short_description: Ball Torture is an exciting 2D puzzle game where you control a bowling ball, trying to escape from the recycling compartment. Overcome sharp saws and other obstacles, reach 30 checkpoints, and collect stars to become the winner among the balls in the recycling compartment!

name: Lost In The Open
short_description: An unexpected assassination plot leaves you wounded and fleeing across no man's land. To survive in this roguelike, low-fantasy tactical RPG, you must recruit strategically, fight desperately and repent sincerely.

name: Sexy Sharks
short_description: Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring 3 shark girls on the beach with different personalities and fetishes.

name: Project: Name
short_description: Project: Name is a hardcore Perma-Death first person platformer. Try to beat all three levels!

name: Blastonier
short_description: A 2D physics-based puzzle game inspired by old flash games and arcade tasking you with shooting a ball into a cube.

name: 피랍 일지 - 그 남자로부터의 탈출
short_description: 어떻게든 돌아갈 거야. 가족이 기다리고 있는 집으로.

name: 鬼魂街
short_description: Third person shooter! With infinite bullets, can you kill ghosts and escape from ghost street?

name: Paramnesia
short_description: Uncover the truth with detective Maria in the interactive visual novel, Paramnesia. Explore the depths of her mind and solve the mystery as she grapples with understanding her own identity as a member of two conflicting sects.

name: Monster Crawl
short_description: Hack & slash your way through monster hordes with fast paced, active combat. Well timed attacks can annihilate entire rooms, but don't get caught! Explore diverse builds using multiple heroes, abilities & relics. Fight through dungeons full of treasures & traps, and challenge mighty Bosses!

name: non-binary
short_description: "non-binary" is a video game that mixes text choices and bullet hell to tell the story of two non-binary people's journey of self-discovery. Make your choices. Dodge words. Go through things that hurt without breaking down. If you can.

name: My Therapy
short_description: A visual novel about cute melancholic girls!

name: Valkyrie Champions
short_description: Team up with up to 4 online players and defeat hordes of monsters in this action based looter-shooter! Unlock powerful tiers of weapons and equipment to develop your character into an unstoppable champion!

name: Zombies Invasion
short_description: Zombie Invasion is an arena shooter with a top view. Move through the levels, the further into the forest, the more dead people. Hold out and kill everyone!

name: Hellvivors
short_description: Hellvivors is a survival roguelike inspired by Binding of Isaac and Vampire Survivors. Face hordes of hellish creatures, level up, choose cards and make crazy broken builds to survive this hell.

name: 11号小镇综合症
short_description: 欢迎来到11号小镇，在这个诡异的小镇里，您是一位新来的画家。为了完成镇上居民们的绘画委托，您需要收集对话中的关键词，将关键词提炼成绘画素材组合到画布上。面对居民们奇怪的委托，您能顺利完成作画并融入镇子，证明自己是“正常”的吗？

name: The Kindeman Remedy
short_description: The most blasphemous, diabolical and insane management game ever created. Aided by a lascivious nun in a grim prison, rig executions, conduct horrid experiments and do the unspeakable to cook up your cure-all: The Kindeman Remedy. Do not be afraid. This time, you're the monster.

name: Command & Control: Spec Ops (Remastered)
short_description: Tower Defence about the war against the Syndicate.

name: Neko Loop
short_description: A cat girl facing a multitude of enemies, bosses, secrets and challenges creates the cutest roguelike game you've ever seen.

name: Project ST
short_description: Jump into the madcap world of Project ST, a free online multiplayer party shooter stuffed with colorful characters, wacky weapons, massive robots, and fast-paced battles!

name: A Game with a Kitty 1 & Darkside Adventures
short_description: Foil a little nerd's world domination plans with Kittey in A Game with a Kitty 1 and help a grumpy little Archchancellor solve a mystery in Darkside Adventures! And as a bonus, the collection also features Treasure Hunter Man 1.

name: Repetendium
short_description: Fight against an army of elemental creatures hell bent on your destruction. Compete with other players on the leaderboards to show who is the master of Repetendium !

name: Rotate: Collective
short_description: Walk on walls and solve physics puzzles as you explore a massive underground facility. Uncover its dark secrets and try to escape with your life.

name: Graveyard Girls
short_description: Graveyard Girls is a halloween-themed yuri visual novel about complicated grief and overcoming hardships. Collect Elle’s “scribbles” to learn about her struggles, befriend a mysterious girl, and have a conversation about death.

name: Star Overdrive
short_description: Star Overdrive is a high-speed action adventure set in an open world. Race across an alien planet on your Hoverboard, mastering tricks, battling enemies, solving puzzles, and using your powers to overcome challenges and shape your destiny!

name: XGamer - AI revolution
short_description: "XGAMER - AI Revolution" is a sci-fi third-person RPG game. In the main world, it is divided into 4+1 areas, the first 4 areas are: phantom, earth, void and heat. Each core has 20 programs. Find out The Key is. By getting to know The Key and finding the world code, you will know the truth.

name: TEFFECT: Wall Breaking
short_description: Open world + Tetris =? Answer is Tquest: Wall breaking! #Open the world for adventure, and complete the level freely #Collect more than 5 spells, including frost, fire, hurricane and lightning. There is always one for you #Tetris is not only Tetris, but also joint puzzles for you to challenge

name: Rolling Rush
short_description: Rolling Rush is a time attack game where you can challenge yourself on desert , ice amongst other tracks. Competing with other players through worldwide leaderboards , may the marble roll in your favor.

name: Nuclear Fighter
short_description: Is a fun and fast 2D platformer with a side view. Your goal is to escape from the city and survive.

name: Limited Lifetime Corp
short_description: Lead your LLC to its inevitable destruction in this day by day management sim. Harvest resources, make a profit, expand your Corp. But be careful; from the local fauna to the Syndicate, no one wants you to succeed.

name: 미연시 시뮬레이터 : 미소녀 게임의 주인공을 조종하는 게임
short_description: 이것은 『자칭 평범한 고등학생』 인철 군을 조종하여 해피엔딩을 보는 게 목표인 게임입니다.

name: DnD Adventure: Rogue's Choice
