short_description: With debts to pay to the underworld, you need to make a lot of coin fast! Perhaps worse, you're wanted by the King's men for desertion. Survival is your first priority...

name: Bloody Hell Hotel
short_description: Renovate, upgrade and expand your hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

name: TSE: Reloaded
short_description: In this new 2d action platformer, roll around as an oblong shape as you traverse the level geometry. In 'The Sleek Ellipsoid: Reloaded' (TSE: Reloaded) you can roll, jump and move around the level with total freedom!

name: DnD Adventure: Demon's Choice
short_description: You're Azizella, Binder of Souls, and you have just escaped the Abyss. Now, a free demon, you seek to outwit the fiends that hunt you as you plot your own rise to ultimate power.

name: Poosh XL
short_description: Poosh XL is a neon-infused, one-button arcade score chaser where precision and timing are everything. Launch yourself past obstacles, collect powerups, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced, endlessly challenging game. Simple to learn, hard to master, perfect for quick, addictive gameplay!

name: Rainbow Runner
short_description: Play as THE Rainbow Runner

name: Monster Bullets
short_description: Monster Bullets is a first-person roguelite where each monster has a specific weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to slay the goblin king!

name: 不思議の大冒険 チルノ見参!
short_description: ⑨回遊べる不思議のダンジョン！　紅魔郷～星蓮船までの50キャラ登場。全キャラ＋10の60曲のBGM。東方Project二次創作ゲームです。

name: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

name: Heroes and Test of Succubus
short_description: This is a role-playing game exploring a dungeon with a single storyline.

name: 凶宅 HouseHaunting
short_description: 《HouseHaunting》 is a horizontal puzzle solving game. You need to solve puzzles in a haunted house. There is no fixed sequence for solving puzzles. You can freely explore the room, and finally complete the task "she" gave you, satisfy "their" wishes, and finally find "your" memory and destination.

name: Babel of Ystilia
short_description: Turn-based roguelike with minimalistic, fast-paced combat that focuses on learning enemy patterns and making powerful synergies with your items.

name: Dimwarper
short_description: Dimwarper is an Icy Tower type of platformer, where You play as a mysterious character, who gained an ability to swap between two dimensions. Your task is to climb seven towers, controlled by seven wizards with different powers. This journey will require from You great focus and speed. Good luck!

name: Summa Expeditionis
short_description: Summa Expeditionis is a survival and strategy game set in ancient Roman Empire. Follow the career of a Roman soldier from Legionnaire to Centurion. Build and manage your camp, recruit more soldiers and face the barbarians for the glory of Rome.

name: LONESTAR
short_description: LONESTAR is a strategic Roguelike spaceship deckbuilder. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain rewards and vacations. Find treasures, customize spaceships, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

name: Bloody Hell
short_description: A short but sweet game about an Angel on a Bloody Bullet-hell mission to kill Satan! Dash, Double Dash, Grapple & Blast your way through Hell to fulfill your Holy Mission. Will you be able to kill Satan? Or will you fail to master your abilities and DIE in this BLOODY HELL?

name: Cleaning The World With Pampam
short_description: Help Pampam eliminate the incorrectly disposed garbage to save nature in this cute and super different educative infinite runner game! Evade obstacles, fight bosses and use a variety of powers-ups to clean the world!

name: Mini Arenas
short_description: Mini Arenas is a fast-paced PVP arena shooter in which you and your friends can play and fight together. Play on a variety of stages and choose to play as one of four classes as you fight to be the last player alive!

name: Room of Depression
short_description: "Same encounter, different world." Moon is a young woman who lives an ordinary city life as an office worker. However, because she suffers from depression, she reacts and deals with things in a way that is very different from regular city folk.

name: By the Vine: Chapter One
short_description: By the Vine is a Christian-based Visual Novel. The story follows a young adult named Calum, who has to live on his best friend's farm after burning down his house. What hijinks will ensue as Calum adjust to his new life on the farm?

name: DEAD TRAIN
short_description: A zombie survival game that takes place in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You must manage your food and water carefully because resources are limited. You need to make your way to the end of the railway and back to civilization.

name: What Has Come Before
short_description: What Has Come Before is a perspective-driven puzzle game set in an eerie and stylish black and white Lynchian world. Stuck in limbo with only hearing and vision to guide, players must utilize clever changes in perspective to move forward.

name: Chain Jumpers
short_description: World's Best Platformer Game ???? You run, jump and stuff

name: Classic Memory Game
short_description: Classic Memory Game is a game of memorization skills, designed for the entire family and suitable for people of all ages. It is inspired by the popular game of pairs where the player requires concentration and memory.

name: Forrader Hero
short_description: Forrader Hero – turn-based game with roguelike elements where heroes can’t step back and must fight through the end to save their soul in ‘Forgotten Proto.World’ fighting hordes of monsters, undead creatures, and their overlords.

name: THE HUNTED: SHADOWS OF DESPAIR
short_description: Explore the buildings, forests and grave yards to gather as much information as possible to solve the case(s) with our Paranormal Investigator & Psychic Medium Alex Walker. But be cautious not everything is as it seems.

name: Laser Lightshow
short_description: A board manipulation laser-bouncing puzzle game, featuring a level editor, pack editor, and hundreds of handcrafted levels!

name: City Limits
short_description: Relax and build cities on a desolate tranquil island. Plan ahead to cover the island efficiently by combining buildings and cementing your place on a tile. Each turn an entity spreads, attempting to take over barren or unstable tiles.

name: Rock Life: The Rock Simulator
short_description: Built from the ground up, Rock Life is the next generation of immersion and simulations. Live, do, and experience what it is like to truly become one with nature... as a rock!

name: Junkyard War
short_description: Junkyard War is a unique take on the tower defense genre. Clear trash from the junkyard and recycle it into valuable resources while holding off waves of your competitor's army trying to make the trash disappear by burning it all down!

name: Motioning Monument
short_description: This game that need a little imagination, exploring the abstract landscape and aim of revive mysterious monument. Collect motion fragments and place them in the right place to revive the monument. Enjoy the exploring and letting your imagination run wild!

name: Camp Laughter
short_description: A single player, low-poly horror game about escaping a killer-infested campground

name: KAGITORI -BIRD IN THE CAGE HIDING THE KEY-
short_description: This game is an English translation of a visual novel game released in Japan. In this work, the main character, a boy, and four heroines, who happen to live in a mansion, work together to solve a murder that took place in a certain town in Japan.

name: Shockwave - Land of The Blind
short_description: A first-person immersive bomb disposal sim with stealth mechanics that lets you taste the anxious life of a sapper. Work with specialistic equipment to disarm a wide range of explosives. Gather intel to choose the right path in the multi-layered levels and stay out of sight from armed militants.

name: Pacific Strafe
short_description: Fight through historical locations of World War 2 with 1 of 5 classic WW2 fighters. Sink battleships with the help of your wingmen, recapture islands with the help of your tank crews.

name: Just Jump
short_description: Are you done with big difficult games, with lots of complicated controls to remember? Just Jump is a simple 2D Platformer racing game, where your goal is to set the best time, but with one catch you can't jump!

name: The Lost Key
short_description: You are the last hope, be ready to resist the enemy and eliminate injustice and tyranny.

name: Detective Fantasia DX
short_description: A corpse has been found on the beach! Explore a summery island to gather clues and uncover the truth in this mystery game, Detective Fantasia DX!

name: Mystery of Mortlake Mansion
short_description: Mystery of Mortlake Mansion is a hidden object adventure game with a deep and interesting story. The player is summoned to Mortlake Mansion by an elderly gentleman, who was so obsessed with magic that he dedicated his entire life to tracking down and learning the secrets of his favorite magician.

name: Court of Crowns
short_description: Court of Crowns is a Visual Novel game inspired by Ace Attorney. You play as Princess Adela de Rex and lead the Crown Court that resolves important disputes between the Nobility. But what kind of a person is Princess Adela de Rex? Decide that for yourself, thanks to the game's unique Belief System

name: Hitstream
short_description: Want to make exercise fun? Punch, stretch, squat and step your way to fitness in this 360° game that takes you to stunning locations across the globe. Hit the objects, catch the orbs, dodge the walls and, if you’re feeling really energetic, turn squats on.

name: SnowBrawl
short_description: A multiplayer snowball fighting game! Choose from different hero characters, team up with ur friends and best the opposing team in familiar game modes!

name: Merauders - A Voyage of Discovery
short_description: An immersive and innovative 2D pixel-based narrative adventure “coming of age” story about a teenager, discovering who they are with the help/hindrance of those around them.

name: Animal Wish
short_description: If you have long dreamed of taking a break from the hustle and bustle of the city or becoming a real farmer for one day, enjoying the gifts of nature, then welcome to the animal farm!

name: 尋找自我 MastEr
short_description: 木偶尋找主人的過程，等同於在找尋自我，木偶所蒐集的徵章、糖果，也是小孩尋求媽媽獎勵的象徵，關卡中的場景、角色、以及謎題都緊密的圍繞著”親子互動關係”的核心議題。

name: Language Lab
short_description: Not your standard language learning application. This is the CrossFit of language learning apps. No multiple choice exercises, no grammar written out for you. Just you and the language, the same way you learned your first one.

name: No More Noise
short_description: Survivor of a post-apocalyptic world, the dead have returned to life to make you regret still being among the living. Moreover, their hearing has evolved, and every sound they perceive makes them stronger. A small piece of advice: I think you should stay discreet!

name: Voxrush
short_description: Voxrush is a time survival FPS game with a full destructible voxel environment. Kill monsters, take points, upgrade stats and weapons, use skills and find a better way to survive as long as possible to become the best!

name: Resonance of the Ocean
short_description: Pick up what the waves wash ashore to make instruments. Use those instruments to answer the echoes heard from beyond the ocean.

name: Chonky - From Breakfast to Domination
short_description: Cute characters, endearing enemies and an all together chonky world. Fight your way through adorable monsters, collect all kinds of loot and experiment to find new spells in this top-down action RPG.

name: Cabin Rush
short_description: Explore and gather resources to build traps, towers, and walls to protect your cabin from increasingly difficult waves of monsters.

name: Happy's Clocks
short_description: Run around an enormous mysterious house that once belonged to your dad, while running away from terrifying monsters and solving interesting puzzles. Discover what happened or maybe what was supposed to happen when you left.

name: Oxyjet
short_description: Fly your spaceship by making holes in it! Oxyjet is a ridiculous and action packed couch co-op game, in which you "sumo wrestle" the opposing team for oxygen.

name: Pixel
short_description: Pixel is a minimalist platformer + puzzle game! Control a being that aims to reach somewhere... always jumping, dodging, avoiding and tricking obstacles that seem not to let you proceed. Died? Just try one more time =D

name: Stardust Valkyries
short_description: 1v1 anime fighter X platform fighter hybrid with rollback netcode!

name: NecroNomNomNom: Eldritch Horror Dating
short_description: Plunge into the depths of sanity and Lovecraftian lore in this Eldritch Horror Dating Visual Novel. Will you find love or madness?

name: Ferrule Instincts
short_description: You’re Kayla Ferrule - And your birthday is in a week. However, your friend Miles Hector got in with some bad apples. Can you outsmart everyone and make it to your 20th in one piece? Test your instincts in this brief interactive adventure based on Yellow Optic’s Fool Me Twice.

name: The Wraith of the Galaxy
short_description: The Wraith of the Galaxy is a third-person space combat game. Aliens have taken over outer space in order to conduct experiments on entire planets. Destroy them or they will destroy you.

name: The Ballad of Radolf
short_description: After years of peace an island emerges from the sea with the Demon race, now the Demon race threatens to throw the world into chaos. Can you stop the Demon race and restore peace to the world in this turn based RPG.

name: Earth: Revival
short_description: Earth: Revival is a sci-fi survival shooting game with a third-person over-the-shoulder perspective and a 3D realistic art style. Set in a virtual future world, you'll play as one of the survivors and embark on an adventure on Earth after being hit hard by an alien civilization.

name: Dancing Hime: Rhythm Matching
short_description: “Dance Hime: Rhythm Matching” is a VR game that combines match-3 with music and dance. It focuses on match-3 and girls' hot dance. In addition to the sense of achievement after a successful match-3, players can also enjoy the immersive dance of elven girls.

name: Americas Tower Simulator
short_description: Manage, control and guarantee the safety of all your flights in Torre Las Américas, a simulator based on real air traffic controller procedures, which will put you to the test through the different challenges that the guardians of the sky experience every day. Now with voice recognition feature!

name: 我在地球修仙有系统
short_description: 都市修仙+暗黑+放置摸鱼+妹子养成？这可能是一款和你想象中不太一样的刷子游戏。刷宝，筑基，放置，飞升成仙，系统开挂，这款比小说还精彩的国漫修仙都市游戏里全都有。快来开启爽文般带着妹子打怪兽的后宫养成人生吧！

name: Soul Link
short_description: Soul Link is a challenging puzzle game where you use your intelligence to build bridges with falling pieces of various shapes. Reconnect this broken land with Soul Bridges, and make the world whole again!

name: Pandemic 1993
short_description: Survival horror set in Japan! Fight off various creatures, search for your missing wife and child, and escape from the town safely!

name: Schmaragon
short_description: Schmaragon is an indie MOBA that blends elements of EVE Online, Heroes of the Storm, and Epic’s Paragon. Designed with a focus on a toxicity-free experience, it’s best enjoyed solo or with a group of close friends.

name: Battle of Tanks
short_description: Don't let the army of enemy tanks reach the southern border of the battlefield. You have several guns at your disposal and the ability to call an airstrike. Move around the battlefield in the top view and choose the right guns to attack. You need to hold out for the allotted time.

name: Esoteric Ebb
short_description: ESOTERIC EBB is a single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign.

name: Zold:out
short_description: Zold:out is a semi-turn-based tactical RPG combined with deck building. You will use multiple weapons in one turn to challenge powerful enemies in a non-grid battlefield. Recruit clerks, forge weapons, and save the world with your strategy and creativity!

name: Loop
short_description: Loop is a relaxing & casual contemplative puzzler; where you and your companion travel through a mysterious, ethereal temple. During this Journey, you will traverse many riddles and face the ultimate enigma: can the endless loop be broken?

name: Desstroke
short_description: Desstroke - is a masterpiece of game industry, цруку you can damage everything you see, and have fun. You can blow everything up, or even jump from the balcony, that's on you. Oh, and you can play with your buddies in a battle royale with cars, many guns and unforgettable community.

name: FERD
short_description: As a Viking warrior, you embark on a journey of vengeance through the magnificent Nordic landscapes of the Viking Age. With bow and arrow you defend yourself and your Viking comrades from hordes of attacking enemies.

name: BEAT AIMER!
short_description: BEAT AIMER! is a rhythm shooter where you shoot to the beat. Get your mouse and headset ready, this game will test your aim and sense of rhythm – pull off sick flicks to the beat and track to the bass!

name: Dick Ranger
short_description: Experience an amazing adventure with Dick Ranger, who set off in search of his lost father William, a valued explorer and anthropologist. Travel with the hero through different lands and places.

name: Steam Ocean
short_description: This game uses Oculus equipment and Unity development of a VR3D science fiction gunfight game, players need to pick up the weapon to kill the sea monsters generated in the scene, intense and exciting gunfight game, players each kill a monster scene counter opportunities to increase

name: Rainy Butcher
short_description: On rainy nights, the serial murderer is on a killing spree. This scares everyone but one girl, the journalist who keeps digging for a promotion. Dauntless, she gets involved deep and wide, hoping to discover the real identify of the rainy night butcher.

name: Kokoro's Gensokyo Journey: The Lost Masks
short_description: A 2D exploration danmaku action Touhou fangame (AKA a danmaku Metroidvania). Control Hata no Kokoro in a journey to find her masks. Look for power-up items along the way and challenge powerful bosses to reclaim them!

name: Axima
short_description: Welcome to the world of Axima, a Monster Taming RPG! Befriend and battle alongside over a hundred different Axi, while you explore the fully open world by yourself - or with your friends in multiplayer!

name: Zombie Army VR
short_description: Zombie Hitler may have been defeated, but the zombie hordes are still at large and Europe remains in the throes of war. Return to the field as part of the Deadhunters, an elite squad fighting to end the zombie apocalypse!

name: SmartSoules
short_description: SmartSolues is a 2D platform game with beautiful graphics and challenging levels. Not the easiest gameplay as it might seem. In the game, you need to complete the tasks provided with your robot.🦾 At the beginning you will have easy levels, but they will become more and more difficult.

name: Faraway
short_description: Escaping the planet is your main goal.

name: Stellar Watch
short_description: Stellar Watch is a rotating tower defense roguelike where you can adjust turret defenses in real-time by steering them around enemy paths.

name: The Game of Fourtune
short_description: How far will you go to get your deepest wish granted? In The Game of Fourtune, help guide Clyde & Devon through this cruel game of life and death. Only one participant will get their wish granted. Four rounds and four deaths each round, are you ready to see if fortune is on your side?

name: Capytales: A Folk Adventure
short_description: Accompany Capytu on her journey against the hideous Dry Body. Challenge powerful members of Brazilian Folklore to protect the mother nature using the power of Capybara spirits, solving puzzles and platform challenges. And catch all the collectibles hidden along the way.

name: Worm Runner
short_description: Endless runner game where are 6 different maps with obstacles

name: Fortitude invasion
short_description: The alien invasion has already begun! They're already here! Who can help the brave warriors to learn the full power of our civilization!?

name: Henry Halfhead
short_description: Meet Henry, merely half a head, yet with the peculiar ability to become any object within their reach! Discover every object’s unique abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.

name: Duck Paradox
short_description: Shoot bouncing bullets in this roguelike precision platformer killing corrupted ducks while searching for Dr. Paraducks’ beloved pet throughout the multiverse! To return to safety you’ll need to tackle difficult-to-master trials, run after run, earning upgrades, while maintaining your sanity!

name: Haunted Places
short_description: Survive in the radioactive zone and fight off all the monsters in your way. With you you have only a pistol and a little cartridge.

name: Sich Tactics
short_description: Sich Tactics is a small turn-based tactics set in Ukrainian mythology world. Take control over a party of Cossacks of different classes in procedurally generated battles, fight with chorts, muscovites and other unholy spirits, complete scenarios or compete with other players in special mode.

name: Welcome to Chornobayivka VR
short_description: At that day the Russians start a miss planned attack against Ukraine, Joe grabs his preferred weapon to stop the Zombie Russian Soldiers that got infected by a sick experiment of Putin. Fight for democracy and freedom in a wave like horror VR shooter experience for free.

name: Spaced Out
short_description: Retro, classic, couch-buddy competition in space! Simple controls make it easy for friends and family to join in the fun!

name: Maze Mart
short_description: You play as Isaac looking for a bottle of milk. Through small labyrinths you will have to choose how the story will end.

name: Potion Slingers
short_description: Potion Slingers is a turn-based battle card game for two to four players. Compete to be the last one standing in a spectator packed marketplace arena!

name: Bay Bell
short_description: A science fiction point and click word puzzle video game. Navigate an off-course spaceship, and find a way toward returning home. The end is near… Can you save the Bay Bell?

name: MocapForStreamer
short_description: Windows application for upper body motion capture using 2 webcams of the same model as stereo cameras. Capture upper body, hand, and facial expression.

name: Globe Go
short_description: The Globe Go Game in 3D is an innovative re-imagining of the classic board game Go, transposed onto a three-dimensional spherical playing field. This brings new depth and complexity to the ancient game of strategy, challenging players to think beyond the traditional flat board.

name: Dark Age Dinos
short_description: A multiplayer tactical roguelike. Travel alone or with friends in a medieval world of sword wielding dinosaurs. Strategize your way through short adventures where teamwork is the key to success!

name: Vermis Orbita
short_description: Vermis Orbita is a fast-paced, wave based, action game where you control a Dragon-God who has the power to utilize orbiting objects as weaponry to fight off swarms of enemies.

name: Space Monkeys
short_description: Space Monkeys is a solo-developed, fast-paced action game where you must unleash your inner ape to face 12 unique levels in space. Use skill and strategy to dodge lasers, evade enemies, and collect bananas in zero-gravity on your journey to escape a retro-styled evil space station.

name: One Week By Car
short_description: Explore a small, story-rich world reflecting the struggles of college life. Play mini-games to complete the everyday tasks that you need to survive. Eventually, try to find a way to break the cycle of monotony and escape your bleak surroundings.

name: Truck Rally Hyper Hardcore
short_description: The challenging races that you only know are just the beginning level of this game. Absolutely realistic behavior of the machine. No arcade controls. Using the laws of the real physical world. Only for hardcore players.

name: Micro Wars
short_description: Micro Wars is a fast-paced RTS that throws you into the action in short, intense online battles featuring up to 8 players. Tailor your strategy with a variety of commanders and units, build your base, and micro your way to victory. Hone your skills with the campaign, and then climb the ladder ranks!

name: Art Reborn: Painting Connoisseur
short_description: Dear curator, you are about to embark on a journey to captivate the audience! You will be in charge of an art gallery.Impress the museum curators around the world with these masterpieces, collect badges, apply for support funds, and learn the value of art!

name: Harry Is A Porter
short_description: One day, you suddenly find yourself a porter who is driving a truck in a village. Your driving skills will be perfected after completing different tasks. When you become proficient in driving your truck, you can challenge more interesting levels.

name: Scared Little Ghost
short_description: You are a ghost! Which is pretty difficult when you're afraid of everything…

name: 星辰蓝调(Starblues)
short_description: Our mysterious protagonist wanders through the vast alien ruins, constantly searching for the core of the ruins with his robot companion who has lost its memory. Fight hordes of out-of-control enemies to reach the core, and witnessing the secrets buried in the deepest recesses of the ruins.

name: Relic Guardian - Tower Defense
short_description: "Relic Guardian" is a fantasy style strategy tower defense game. As the builder on the battlefield, summon a variety of defense towers and spells with reliable hero companions to complete this epic and guarding adventure!

name: Tower of Fantasy
short_description: Embark together on your fantasy adventure! Set hundreds of years in the future on the distant planet of Aida, the shared open-world RPG, anime-infused sci-fi adventure Tower of Fantasy now is officially available on Steam.

name: Rogue Realms
short_description: Rogue Realms is an empire building game in which you place tiles to expand the world and build on those tiles to gather the resources you need. Rogue Realms features full 3D pixel world to explore from any angle. Explore new biomes and buildings to grow an empire to stand the test of time.

name: Speedonauts
short_description: Compete against the galaxy in this fast-paced speedrunning game. Create and share levels. Break records. Be the best.

name: Luminescence
short_description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

name: CityDriver
short_description: Driving realistically in a real city for the first time - driving fun & training with CityDriver! ViewApp's newest simulation offers you the opportunity to explore the streets of Munich with various cars.

name: Streetball The Mecca
short_description: A new take on streetball is here, combining streetball with street fighting. If you wanna score here you're gonna have to beat your defender one on one. Break ankles and take names as you become a streetball legend!

name: Cannon Royale
short_description: Battle against cannons of different colors, using cards that give you extra powers. Play alone or against your friends and win with a strategic use of cards and with luck on your side.

name: Lifespace Traveler
short_description: Lifespace Traveler is an action-packed, easy to learn, hard to master cyberpunk game where reality is split into dimensions called Lifespaces. No hand holding. No mercy. Fight your way and test your reflexes in fast-paced, brutal combat as you reveal the mysteries of an unforgiving dystopian world.

name: Deceit 2
short_description: Deceit 2 is an online social deduction horror game. Inspire fear as the Infected, play detective as the Innocent, or create mayhem as the Cursed. Trapped with friends and strangers: who can you trust to help you escape?

name: Alone Again: The Countryside
short_description: You live in Caçapava, in an isolated neighborhood, in the countryside. Mysterious creatures move around your house, you can’t protect yourself. Reach them or they will reach you...

name: Astro
short_description: Astro is a journey going through impossible geometrical worlds. Evolve in a surrealistic world and run away from what begs you to stay.

name: Chess Survivors
short_description: Chess Survivors is a grid based, quick-turn, roguelike where you outmaneuver and destroy an ever growing horde of chess based enemies. Combine abilities, upgrades, and relics to create game-breaking builds. Think fast, die, learn, repeat!

name: I Was Wrong
short_description: A gorgeous short exploration game, focused in tell the story of brilliant man, who ended up trapped inside his own mind. He needs to escape from his mind, but the only way is follow a strange female voice while he tries to remember important things by reading messages in old monitors.

name: John Brick
short_description: John Brick is a game with a very simple and challenging mechanics, just be quick between shooting and protecting yourself

name: The Empanada Protocol
short_description: In this brutal platformer you play as an Empanada trying to escape a dangerous facility filled with traps and fun gimmicks. Do you have the skill and precision to escape?

name: Alexander the Great: Secrets of Power
short_description: Unlock the secret of power of Alexander the Great, collect all the artifacts and save the world in this amazing hidden object adventure full of mysteries! Discover 30 unique locations, enjoy over 45 mini-games and dive into the fascinating storyline!

name: TCSTRIKERS5
short_description: This is the biggest news title of 2024. A cute bullet-hell shooter is now available. The game features cool and futuristic visuals and active gameplay.

name: Hanaja's Body
short_description: You know what they say: Revenge has a way of changing you. Fight enemies and traverse strange, unique worlds while being slowly transformed by powerful attacks and obstacles which change with you! Turn the tide on those kinky foes by powering up your body with special augments in this fetish RPG.

name: The Stone Cutter and the Mountain Spirit
short_description: When a poor stone cutter gets tired of his simple life, the Mountain Spirit make his wishes come true! A beautiful Interactive Fairy Tale about the Wills that move us and the Transformations we go through in our lives.

name: Project Galaxy
short_description: Project Galaxy is a 2-dimensional version of the Roblox game "Galaxy". You'll play as a miner sent to hostile alien-infested territory to mine asteroids for ores and return home to fulfill your contract.

name: Don't Touch Lava
short_description: A 2D side-scrolling lavarunner platformer. Move through endless levels against backgrounds of castles, caves and cliffs. Collect coins for extra points and collect power-ups to keep you going longer as the further levels get faster! Don't Touch Lava!!

name: Red Tower
short_description: Master new powers as you face hordes of demons in intense battles in a frenetic top-down action shooter with rogue-lite elements. Fight against the darkness consuming the tower and uncover mysteries capable of saving or dooming everything around you.

name: Catto Pew Pew!
short_description: Get ready to blast your friends into the horizon in this chaotic arena shooter! A complete remake is coming soon, releasing out of Early Access. Don't miss out—wishlist now!

name: Canis Major
short_description: When good dogs die, they don't stop being man's best friend. You play as Comet: a recently deceased sheepdog tasked with guarding his family in the spiritual realm of dreams. Set in Wales during the aftermath of World War II, we find out just how important it is to have a best friend in Heaven.

name: BLOODSTAGE Possessed By A Tsundere Demon
short_description: An unknown life form controls the crowds of mutated employees of the space station. Impress the demon girl by destroying thousands of possessed with dozens of weapons.

name: Dream Walk: Stolen Color
short_description: Retrieve the stolen mysterious color as you fight your way through hordes of nightmares and other bizarre denizens of the dream world.

name: Bunni Gunni Classic
short_description: They took your kids... Take their lives! Bunni Gunni Classic is a much needed polishing for the game jam game made in 4 days!

name: Bots City
short_description: Artificial intelligence is out of control. Only a Hero can stop this madness. The Hero's goal is to get to the main computer and disable it, thereby disabling all robots. Our hero has only one weapon, but that won't stop him!

name: Endless Nightmare
short_description: You play as James, a police inspector. James's wife and daughter were murdered in his own house. As he uncovers the truth, the strange occurrences in the mansion gradually turn into an endless nightmare...

name: Acanthoceras
short_description: A short game based on a Horror and Parkour mixup. Find Keys, escape monsters, Make your way in the ruins and fight back

name: Silver Nornir
short_description: Can you change the repeating doomed fate of the world in a fantasy RPG?

name: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
short_description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

name: Rush Rush Rally Reloaded
short_description: The acclaimed 2D Dreamcast racing game

name: Goat's Tale 2
short_description: The Goat is back in his next adventure! The challenge will be difficult, but only with your help he will be able to get to the top.

name: WAR DUST Playtest
short_description: test

name: Pimp My Cruise - Maritime Business Simulator
short_description: So you wanna be a businessman? Get fast money in an easy way? For some crazy reason you want it to be related to the sea? You've come to the right place! You only need to... Pimp my Cruise!

name: As The Light Goes Out
short_description: As The Light Goes Out is a simulation game utilizing Emergency and Rescue services from across the globe as its background. Become the Emergency Services Commander and take charge of the Fire, Police, and Paramedic departments! Instruct your teams and ensure public safety！

name: Packed!?
short_description: Packed!? is an extremely difficult puzzle game which has you guiding two punctual little friends on their journey to escape the depot one box at a time.

name: Fogel And Porki Evil Arcade
short_description: This is a game in the genre of "Match 3" with elements of a visual novel, drawn in the aesthetics of retrofuturism of the 80s. Immerse yourself in the neon atmosphere of the arcade arcade and help the students defeat the Demon that broke into reality from the video game!

name: Guns and Rush
short_description: Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic wasteland in this intense horde combat shooter that combines roguelike and bullet-hell elements. Battle relentless waves of monstrous foes as you strive to survive and conquer challenging levels. In my game no vampire, survive 20 minutes!

name: The Gods Are Fickle
short_description: Your army of souls has been summoned by vain gods - fight for their glory or spit in their face! Embark in roguelite campaigns, discover Souls & Artifacts, deal with the godly politicking they produce. Anticipate moves & checkmate your foes in this no-RNG, procedura turn-based tactical!

name: Defending Lydia Collier
short_description: Lydia Collier has been charged with the murder of her billionaire husband after he mysteriously vanished, and it is your job to prove her innocence. Find evidence, follow leads, make decisions and crack the case, and whilst you do it date and find love in London as a newly single, wealthy lawyer.

name: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis
short_description: As a powerful necromancer you have the ability to raise the dead and command them in battle. With each victory, your army will grow stronger and your city will become more powerful. Undead Horde 2 is an action game with elements from RPG, strategy and hack'n'slash. Rise from the crypt and rebuild!

name: The Legend of Azarias
short_description: In this Metroidvania-inspired first person dungeon crawler, play as Raphael, climbing the 13 unique floors to get to the top. Manage your stamina in combat, fight off demons, do side quests, get stronger and gather more weapons to save Sarah from Asmodeus at the top.

name: Unheeded Influences
short_description: A spiritual journey in the life of an elemental soul in our mythologies and legends. A unique adventure infused with 12 elements: fire, time, shadow, water... Unlock powerful spells and influence the game of other players. Fast travel through spirit realms, and try to survive in physical ones.

name: TROUBLE JUICE
short_description: Trouble Juice is a Side Scrolling Shooter Roguelike set in a TV show tournament that is broadcasted across the universe. Use your character's special abilities, and unlock prizes in the Achievement Bingo. Become the ultimate champion and earn your place in the galaxy's hall of fame!

name: Floor Is Lava
short_description: Floor Is Lava, is a 2d platformer where you have to escape an erupting volcano.

name: Prescience
short_description: Unlike other single player deckbuilder, you are going to fill a bag with black and white stones. Wether you can use your skills depends on the order you pick the stones. Build a unique combo, defeat powerful enemies, and don't forget to use your Prescience!

name: 最强炼丹师
short_description: 没有任务，没有跑图，一款超爽的炼丹修仙游戏。战斗方面和视频一样，所见即所得。

name: Dark Jungle
short_description: Dark Jungle is a 2d fantasy adventure where you play as the great magician Dorian and find yourself in a fairytale forest.

name: The Corpse Crusade
short_description: Dark fantasy pixelart hack-and-slash adventure, set in a world full of bizarre demons and even more fearsome zealots. Lead a troop of Santifrancan crusaders in a fight against heretics & demons while unraveling a sinister conspiracy.

name: Wild Delivery: Old Cooking Style
short_description: The old-style-cooking-simulator-delivery game!

name: FREM Sprite32!
short_description: Play, learn, and experiment with programming in the Sprite32! 8-bit microcomputer sandbox. Use the high-level FREMScript programming language to write programs, create dynamic pixel art, and explore audio generation. Play tutorials and challenges to learn all the aspects of the system.

name: Cops N' Zombies
short_description: A horror social deduction game where you and your friends take on the roles of police officers on a critical mission. But there is a zombie among you that can transform at will. Can you trust your friends?

name: Soulstone Survivors
short_description: Face the Lords of the Void and their endless minions, collect their Soulstones and become a god! In this Action Roguelite, unveil secret spells, craft mighty weapons, unlock multiple characters, discover game-breaking synergies and conquer the power of the void.

name: The Grizzled: Armistice Digital
short_description: Try to survive the trenches as a team during the evolving nightmare of WW1 in this award-winning cooperative card game!

name: Dreams with Furry 🦊
short_description: Dreams with Furry 🦊 - Cleopatra, Mulan, Catherine the Great and Joan of Arc are now furry girls! Relaxing gameplay, cute atmosphere and historical horror.

name: SuuubWaaay
short_description: Progress through the SuuubZone, a gateway between universes and time, to solve the case of the 1991 SuuubWaaay incident. Use your past experience as a detective to find clues and to survive in this sci-fi horror game.

name: Furry Pet Dog Yiff Hentai
short_description: Very Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring furry dog girl in different sex scenes.

name: Embodiment
short_description: In this 2D puzzle platformer, take control of a blob with the ability to take control and embody skeletons. Use their abilities to swim, climb, and fly through the facility.

name: War Dots
short_description: Fast paced tug-of-war auto-battler. Unleash hordes of soldiers and wreak havoc upon your enemies!

name: Eris and the fading kingdom
short_description: Eris And The Fading Kingdom is a 2D Metroidvania where you fight epic bosses, meet strange allies and uncover the secrets of the kingdom, consume enemies and items to gain new ability's and heal any damage you might have taken. All with a 2D hand drawn art style.

name: Bunny Alice in Wonderland
short_description: On this fantastical journey, you will use your extraordinary observation skills and, along with your companions, overcome all obstacles and challenges, bravely moving forward!

name: Bughouse
short_description: Play as Christopher, a kid left home alone with a terrifying STALKER on the loose! Try and survive in this 80's, PS1 inspired, Home Invasion Survival Horror game - OR DIE TRYING!

name: Return to the Skyway
short_description: Traverse through a fantastical island and utilize the local fauna to destroy obstacles. In this 2D platform, the player controls a character that has crash landed on a tropical island. Complete puzzles utilizing the creatures' unique abilities in order to fix their ship and return to the Skyway!

name: Escape: The Endless Dogwatch
short_description: A point and click adventure game with a horror twist! You play as 2nd Officer Walton on the SS Carolina. Explore the ship, use items, find the crew, and try to survive! A fun, challenging and satisfying experience!

name: Dalo
short_description: Dalo, a combination of dot and halo. A fun and simple puzzle game where you should find a path that goes through all lines only passing through the same line once.

name: Guardian
short_description: Guardian is a 2D action-platformer set in the fantastic land of Erstwhile for the annual LARP event. Our heroine, Aria, dons the identity of Arcas and sets out on a quest to rescue the Greek Pantheon! With clever platforming and careful upgrades, help Aria achieve her goal and return home.

name: Yumahorome ~Toki o Tometa Yakata de Asu o Sagasu Maigo-tachi~
short_description: 《真愿朦幻馆～在时间暂停的洋馆里追寻明天的羔羊们～》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）于2022年6月24日发售的最新力作。本作由由人气画师萌木原文武担当原画与人物设计，由知名剧本家中岛大河创作剧本。片头主题歌《静寂之门》由新锐创作型歌手逢濑晶创作并献唱。

name: Grand Gate
short_description: Summon your Towers. Defend yourself. Discover the secrets of Grand Gate in this Tower Defense RPG game.

name: The Paracelsian Project
short_description: You awaken in an unfamiliar location with unfamiliar people and are surrounded by mystery. Will you be able to solve the puzzle and uncover why you are here in this sci-fi/mystery/puzzle visual novel? The future hangs in the balance.

name: 这里有妖
short_description: 数以亿计的妖怪遍布整个世界各地。人类需要一个英雄要去弄明白妖怪的来源。去打败妖怪。为人类生存而努力下去。

name: The Sea of Death
short_description: The Sea of Death is a mystery puzzle adventure in which the story revolves around the people and experiences that the protagonist, who has lost his memory due to an accident, meets in the process of regaining his memory.

name: 灵魂筹码:契约
short_description: 《灵魂筹码:契约》是一款生存恐怖对战游戏。这是一场一旦坐上牌桌便无法回头的赌局，为了取胜所要付出的代价远超想象，你需要通过合作才能逃离这越陷越深的泥潭。不过要小心，你将面对的敌人并不只有恶灵，而你要合作的也不仅仅是人类同伴……

name: ECHO3991
short_description: ECHO3991制作工具，是一款简单高效的互动故事制作工具。只要你会使用聊天软件，就可以通过我们提供的素材和特效，制作出属于自己的互动故事作品。

name: Robot Resistors
short_description: Robot Resistors is an irreverent robot-themed auto-shooter with a 16-bit style. Each of the over 100 enemies you face is distinct, with unique abilities and hand-pixeled animations. A huge roster of playable characters, tons of weapons, and five wildly different procedurally generated stages await!

name: Ritual of Raven
short_description: Ritual of Raven is a story-based farming sim - but you don’t do the farming yourself! Enchant Arcana Constructs to grow a magical herb garden, befriend a cute bunch of weirdos and use your witchy skills to perform powerful rituals to stabilize the portals that are causing trouble for the village.

name: 传颂的种族 The Celebrated Race
short_description: Tom Sawyer, the protagonist who wakes up from a deep sleep, doesn't know where he is. He gradually adapts to the strange village and fights against tyranny with his new partners in the new world. Game has 9 levels.With the progress of the game story, the character level will be higher and higher.

name: Metro Mover
short_description: Drive metro trains to move the people of Blueton in this voxel-style sim-arcade game.

name: ERROR143
short_description: A bickering and bantering rivals-to-lovers visual novel where you fall in love after first hack.

name: Great Filter
short_description: A 2D，top-down，strategy game, with original mechanics. Players would strategically operate two characters to collect diamonds from mines, and sent diamonds into “little universe” to generate bricks to pave a way to keys. Color is an important indicator.

name: Wizard War VR
short_description: Wizard War VR is MOBA magic shooting game

name: Dungeons & Keyboards
short_description: Ready your typing skills and defeat the quirky enemies of the Tower of Verbum. Collect coins, relics, and experience to buy items, assign stats and unlock permanent upgrades. How far will your typing skills take you?

name: Creatures of Energy
short_description: Grow creatures to destroy the enemy. A turn-based strategy game where your moves make your army. Creatures are groups of connected pieces on the board.

name: Deep Space Survivor
short_description: Survive massive amount of enemies in space in this top-down action auto-shooter.

name: ASMR Food Experience
short_description: If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In ASMR Food Experience, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage and listen to your own restaurant!

name: 洛神见月
short_description: 在一次巧合的相遇下，被系统传唤到洛神见月的故事世界，化身为故事主角。 结识了阿姐，与阿姐开启了冒险故事，在冒险里了解各种妖神的故事，顺带解救阿姐。

name: Little Nemo The Clown
short_description: Little Nemo The Clown is a 2D Open World game inspired by good Metroidvania titles. Talk, Run, Fly, Explore. Find secret passages and characters and discover a Fantasy World full of Magic and Color. Little Nemo is a modern Maze Runner Adventure. Can you find the Clown before your Time runs out?

name: ColorCube
short_description: A first-person 3D puzzle game. Objects of the same color cannot collide with each other, and you're no exception. But not only you can change the color of yourself, but also you can change the colors of other objects with a wand. This game has 43 levels. It takes about 1~2 hours to pass.

name: Sagger
short_description: This is a BETA VERSION of the Sagger game - historical simulator that will give you control over all Israel resources to face the Yom Kippur War. With the help of your advisor and knowledge, you will acquire, make the crucial decisions that will lead the state of Israel to Victory or Defeat.

name: Quadrata
short_description: Quadrata is a minimalist logic puzzle where you control two different characters with the same keys on either side and collect diamonds with a limited number of moves to finish.

name: New Tanks
short_description: A new dizzying game about tanks. Dynamic battles that will not let you relax and get bored.

name: Summer For You
short_description: Summer For You is a spicy 2D visual novel with lots of mechanics where you’ll have to win the hearts of stunning girls! Build your harem or find your soulmate, save your soul or go straight to Hell with a demoness!

name: Momo Mother Bird: Final Story
short_description: The doors are locked, no one answers and definitely won't help. Your task is to get out and not let yourself be caught! Solve puzzles, escape from the pursuit of Momo 2 and get out of this nightmare! This time Momo won't let you get bored!

name: Polygeddon
short_description: You are on an island where everyone wants to kill you, ranging from weather conditions to dangerous enemies, your goal is to survive. Survive alone or together. Build, craft, grow, explore, fight!

name: Only Straight and Up!
short_description: This is a fun and hardcore roguelike platformer for 1-5 players in which you have to reach the coveted reward by overcoming various traps! Only a few can make it through...

name: Squirrel with a Gun
short_description: Squirrel, meet gun. As the neighborhood’s most obnoxious rodent, develop a knack (and a love?) for crime and mayhem in pursuit of golden acorns in this nutty sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer. Fight tooth, claw, and gun to escape a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

name: Ragtag Heroes : CO-OP Deckbuilder
short_description: Ragtag Heroes is a co-op roguelike deckbuilder for up to 3 players! Craft your own deck, defeat powerful foes in strategic combat, collect rare cards and relics and save the realm together!

name: Sex Adventures - The Office Slut
short_description: A visual novel about a hot sales agent who faked her sales reports to get a bonus. Once her colleague finds out about it, he starts blackmailing her.

name: Book Quest
short_description: Book Quest is an action adventure RPG presented in retro pixel art style featuring cinematic cutscenes and dialogue. Throughout this medieval fantasy, gameplay alternates between top-down and side-scrolling perspectives.

name: Dr.Pumpkin Chapter 2: The SCP hunt
short_description: Dr. Pumpkin Island is shrouded in mystery and intrigue, with its inhabitants being some of the most unusual creatures you'll ever encounter. From the moment you step onto the island, you'll feel like you've entered a different world, with strange noises and peculiar sights around every corner.

name: Word Factori
short_description: Word Factori is a word-building game where your only resource is the letter "i". Build a chain of factories to bend, rotate, reflect, and merge "i" into more complex letters. Discover secret letter recipes, unlock hidden word art, and optimize your factory chains for high scores.

name: StarGazers
short_description: A shape-shifting, interactive nature experience. Transform into animals and explore the world around you.

name: Foster: Ghost Child | 養小鬼
short_description: Foster: Ghost Child provides an atmospheric horror that incorporates East Asian elements rarely used in games. The game makes use of Chinese traditional elements to convey a distinct and frightful storyline that incorporates Taoism, Buddhism, and Chinese mythology.

name: Frido
short_description: Robot time traveler got into the past. To get out, he needs to get to the time machine, passing more than 10 exciting levels.

name: Heavy Works
short_description: Build and Destroy with satisfying digging and building mechanics in this openworld physics constuction simulator, borrow cash to buy bigger more powerfull machines and Build more! Freely construct your yard and the world around to build a town from nothing.

name: Death, Soul & Robots
short_description: In this captivating Metroidvania game you will take on the role of a cute kitty cat on its mission to find the soul of Planet 42 to rescue the Earth. Fight enemies and bosses, solve puzzles and explore levels in this fascinating game.

name: Final Knight
short_description: Build a D&D-style party and switch between tank, DPS, and healer roles in real time. Combine class, mastery, and gear to unleash massive damage and repel invading giant monsters.

name: Berserker: A Viking Board Game
short_description: A strategic and tactical board game for two players that has a timeless appeal and can be played over and over again in different variations.

name: Priestess Lust
short_description: This story will talk about Mira who need to escape from monsters that invading into the castle. But it doesn't seem to get out easily. She must use her skill for evade and solve the puzzle to escape this place. Or she may becomes their toy instead..

name: Earth's Center of Gravity
short_description: Earth's Center of Gravity is a mystic horror visual novel with multiple endings. The story revolves around Tower Antiques. "No one remembers how long Tower Antiques was there. But it remembers everyone. Even the ones who did not visit it yet." Tower Antiques is waiting for you to write your story.

name: Emma's Armaments
short_description: Emma's Weapons Shop is a management simulation game in which players collect items while conquering dungeons, smelt them, and sell them at higher prices to increase sales.

name: Eye of the Portal
short_description: CHOOSE YOUR CLASS AS YOU ADVENTURE THROUGH THE LAND OF THE EYE IN THIS ACTION - BULLET HELL - ROGUELITE GAME. Pick your playstyle and gain powers and upgrades as you find what secrets lie ahead

name: Play With
short_description: Tired of the old "WASD/ZQSD" key binding ? Want to challenge you with some weird key bindings ?PlayWith is a 2D hardcore platform game where every level have a different key bindingDid you ever jumped with "Y", got to the left with "5" and to the right with "E" ?

name: Another World - Thought Taboo
short_description: "Another World - Thought Taboo" is a different world adventure game, you will explore this mysterious and dangerous world alone, and gradually discover the truth hidden in it.

name: Eldritch Empathy
short_description: Learn the language of an eldritch behemoth in the Lovecraftian rogue-lite Eldritch Empathy. Study cosmic horrors to uncover their mysteries or eliminate them and face the repercussions. Your decisions will shape the fate of humanity.

name: Outland Kingdoms
short_description: Colony building RPG with detailed characters, driven by procedurally generated Stories. Build a hut, a village, a town, a city, a kingdom. 5 different races. Ally with unique factions. Rule an Undead empire. Craft Legendary items. Tame creatures. Enslave enemies. It's all here.

name: Rift of the NecroDancer
short_description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

name: INCARNAGE
short_description: Fight through forces of soldiers, mechs, and horrifying experiments in this arcade-style top-down shooter that increases your speed the more you kill.

name: Endless Melody: The Symphony of Angels
short_description: Fighter and his sister Amicia embark on a journey of self-discovery and face life-changing events as they search for answers to their biggest questions: "Where do we come from?" and "Where do we go from here?" Along the way, they learn about friendship, love, and themselves."

name: FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT
short_description: Change the seasons and explore a strange land. Solve a mystery. Quit your forklift job. Play cards and dismantle the local shipping industry.

name: Ansiolisis
short_description: Ansiolisis (or Anxiolysis) is a short interactive narrative text-based adventure over a dream of someone with anxiety.

name: Froggy's Farm & Friends
short_description: Help a friendly frog named Phroge as they farm, craft, and explore. Plant and grow crops for potion crafting, discover their unique magical qualities, and explore to uncover new friends!

name: Paresis®
short_description: You are paralyzed in a house alone. Lean to find the morphs and use your flame energy to scare them off before they rip you apart. Survive 5 minutes to complete each Phase and burn down the house for good.

name: A2C:Ayry seems to be playtesting a 2D runner shooter from Cci
short_description: A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other(and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)!

name: Kanjozoku Game レーサー Online Street Racing & Drift
short_description: 90s Osaka Kanjo Night Street Racing and Drift Online with True JDM Cars, Online PvP, Engine, Body and Suspension Tuning!

name: To the Stars
short_description: To the Stars is a fast-paced, whimsical and tactical planet-hopping game. Choose your own adventure as you conquer the universe - one constellation at a time.

name: Minimal Bubble Pop
short_description: Aim your bubbles and blast away! Match 3 of the same bubbles with your cannon to reach new top scores!

name: Stereo Boy
short_description: A chill, innovative sci-fi adventure where you explore two isometric worlds at the same time. Teleport between worlds to navigate impossible terrain and solve mind-bending puzzles. Along the way, you'll fend off hostile creatures and uncover the story of a lost civilization.

name: Lord of Demons
short_description: Raid villages as Evil Lord by utilizing dark magic and your army of demons and undeads. Conquer the world, one island after the other, until everyone kneels before you.

name: Broken Tails
short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of an abandoned house as you search for your missing kittens in Broken Tails, a psychological horror exploration game. Use your stealth and wit to evade malevolent beings and unravel the disturbing story of animal neglect and other dark themes in this atmospheric experience

name: Holy Paladin Cynthia
short_description: A classic RPG about one girl's journey to save the world—and become a true Holy Paladin!

name: American Campground Simulator
short_description: With American Campground Simulator, you can build your dream campsite. Set up a cafe at the campsite, buy tents, and focus on growing by serving customers!

name: Ludde
short_description: Explore a charming winter world with Ludde and discover various exciting, challenging, and fun activities for all ages!

name: 武林外传
short_description: 游戏以武林外传的经典故事出发，为玩家打造了一个奇幻有趣的武侠世界。玩家在游戏中可以选择扮演不同的职业角色，与其他玩家一道体验轻松幽默的剧情与玩法，卷入千奇百怪的武林纷争，广结各路英雄好汉，成为一代大侠。

name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
short_description: Arena Breakout: Infinite is an immersive tactical extraction FPS. Join a fight to shoot, loot, and raid your path to fortune. With realistic visuals and true-to-life audio, push through tough battles where the stakes are high and the rewards even higher.

name: Gun Knight All Day
short_description: Gun Knight All Day is a close quarters bullet hell dungeon crawler about a knight who uses guns. Shoot, dodge, and scavenge your way through the procedurally generated dungeons one room at a time. Challenging boss fights test the sharpness of your skills and the lethality of your weapons.

name: The Director's Disorder: Pilot Episode
short_description: The Director, a psycho killer, has chosen you to play the main character in his next film. Will you play your part and survive the night or will you be his latest victim?

name: Tomb of Mask
short_description: 《面具古墓》是由《隐秘的原罪》系列原班人马打造的一款民国风悬疑解谜游戏。核心元素依然是我们最拿手的悬疑解谜加剧情推理。同时，得益于《隐秘的原罪》系列作品积累的经验，这回的《面具古墓》，我们有了更多的进化！

name: memory® – The Original Matching Game from Ravensburger
short_description: The original matching game from Ravensburger.

name: Rush Hour® Deluxe – The ultimate traffic jam game!
short_description: The ingenious logic game

name: HeadHorse Legacy
short_description: HeadHorse is your captor and you have a single mission, escape. He is a very intelligent killer with an unmatchable desire for blood is following every single one of your moves, every step, every glimpse of hope you have of escaping, every instant getting closer to his objective, you!

name: Steel Torrent
short_description: In the game, players can choose either the French camp or the Soviet camp, and destroy the enemy's buildings to win. Players can build different weapons and arms, each faction has different buildings, and a reasonable combination of arms can make it easier for you to win.

name: Deceptus
short_description: Arena PVP Multiplayer with up to 8 Players, pure mayhem, kill and collect famous death coins to unlock and equip up your characters with famous accessories and power-ups on 9 levels and counting.

name: THE FINALS
short_description: Join THE FINALS, the world-famous, free-to-play, combat-centered game show! Fight alongside your teammates in virtual arenas that you can alter, exploit, and even destroy. Build your own playstyle in this first-person shooter to win escalating tournaments and lasting fame.

name: Poggers 2 - A-Maze-Thing
short_description: Bun-Bun Poggers is back and this time must face the dangers of hungry wolves without the luxury of open fields to move & dodge freely! In Poggers 2: A-Maze-Thing, you must help the absolutely adorable Bun-Bun navigate many different hedge mazes where death could be around every corner!

name: The Burst
short_description: The Burst is a smashing high-speed VR shooter. Play as a spec ops operative to bring down the tyrannical warband leader and her goons. Restore order on a prison planet the best way you can - with violence.

name: Magicians And Monsters
short_description: Flying battles, controlling Excalibur attacks, taming monsters, land and air battles, experiencing a different magical journey...

name: A Webbing Journey
short_description: Adorable spider chaos! Swing around the house, weave crazy structures, play with physics-based objects, and pull off chores with nothing but your webs and your wits in this madcap sandbox adventure.

name: Hotel Simulator
short_description: In Hotel Simulator, you become the new owner of an old and neglected hotel. Bring back its splendor by cleaning, renovation, and interior design. Hire the crew, manage your business, and make it known as the fanciest hotel in the city!

name: Missing Cat
short_description: Please find Nuri, the cat that disappeared while I was picking up the feed!The protagonist and the cat (Nuri) who lived in a peaceful countrysideWhile you're on your way to get food, you suddenly go to the mountains to find a cat who left the house

name: Brave Heroes
short_description: Kill thousands of creatures and try to complete four seasons. Brave Heroes is a casual action rogue-lite game about using both environment and magical powers to survive against thousands of creatures that only aim to kill you.

name: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite
short_description: A roguelite RPG you can enjoy in just 10 minutes. "Auto-Battle" x "Gear Swapping" x "Roguelite" A roguelite focused on loot-swapping in hack-and-slash auto battles.

name: One Eleven
short_description: One eleven is a dark detective story about twelve lonely people who, by chance, find themselves in the same house with a mad maniac. Who will be the victim and who will be the killer? Be attentive and courageous, and solve the riddles of One Eleven.

name: Koa: A Gluttonous Wizard
short_description: A wonky wizard, slave of his past, has decided to redeem himself and face one of his worst sins: Gluttony. Fight monsters and creatures created by your own fear, overcome darkness in this tiny and quirky adventure full of fantasy, mystery and a lot of bitter sweet challenges.

name: Third Wild
short_description: Third Wild it is a game that combines survival with fantasy. Survive, fight, build your buildings, and go on an adventure in a medieval open world with monsters and strange areas for you to explore.

name: A SIMPLE REQUEST
short_description: In the town of Morton, Louisiana, a series of mysterious deaths and disappearances occur the police bring in Detective Thompson, an experienced investigator known for solving complex cases. As Thompson delves deeper into the case he uncovers a dark past and sinister forces operating beyond the town.

name: Drive
short_description: Need for spirit: Drive - a crime adventure in which you play as an illegal racer and try to escape from persecution. Your task is to leave the city before dawn. In this game you can expect a lot of driving a car, some achievements by hidden objects that you can find on map.

name: Binary: A Puzzling Platformer
short_description: Binary is a game that requires players to mix the ability to solve puzzles and effectively platform. It is about Bit, a piece of computer data, trying to find his fellow bits who got lost in a data transfer.

name: Tommy Gun Carnage
short_description: A colorful run-and-gun shooter with hordes of enemies, powerups, perks and diverse environments!

name: Sophonce
short_description: Sophonce is a science fiction action horror first-person shooter that relies on philosophical undertones as the primary focus of the plot.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats 2
short_description: Adorable and clumsy kittens will cheer you up!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats 3
short_description: Cute and clumsy cats on guard of your good mood! ""1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats 3"" are ready to help you gain positive emotions!

name: Middle Evil: The Priest
short_description: A young priest is coming in a small village where the local church became full of evil. 2d cartoon arcade game with elements of action, top-down shooter and adventure. Use a cross, a sword, a censer and compose words from the holy book to defeat the creatures of the darkness!

name: Blocks of Nature
short_description: Combine cubes of the same color in a lapland-inspired scene with bright visuals and relaxing music for casual gameplay

name: My Stepsis is a Futanari 2
short_description: You're new girlfriend is spending the weekend at your place while your dad and stepmom are out of town.

name: Femboys & Fries
short_description: The fries are hot and the femboys are sizzling. This will be an experience that you won't soon forget!

name: The Obsessive Shadow
short_description: The Obsessive Shadow is a VR Survival Indie Horror Game about a stalker you can't exactly Identify. With nothing but your eyes and a flashlight at your disposal, it's up to you to survive whatever horrific person or thing is out there watching you...

name: REPLAY BOYS
short_description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

name: Soul Maze
short_description: Soul Maze is a 1-2 player Horror game. Run through the mazes collecting the souls of the monsters within in order to escape before you get caught and trapped forever

name: Moving Shadows
short_description: Moving Shadows is a fun, fast-paced, horror game with a twisted black and white, hand-painted art style. Get thrown into a creepy maze and collect all the flowers before the monsters get you! Fun, addictive and offers scares that will make you jump - and laugh!

name: Master of the Tattooverse
short_description: Master of the Tattooverse is a story-driven tattoo game that allows you to create and share art pieces in a wacky universe. Enjoy the freedom of creating your own tattoos for extraordinary clients. Use templates or just do it freehand, satisfy your customers and expand your own tattoo portfolio.

name: One Night at Barneys 3
short_description: A survival horror game based off of Five Nights at Freddy's featuring many iconic characters from Barney & Friends. Defend, upgrade, and discover secrets throughout the one night you will spend trapped in a prison.

name: Ourlands
short_description: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you craft bespoke little lands for quirky little characters.

name: Sunset Routes
short_description: Sunset Routes is an easy and intriguing roguelite game. You can choose your crew, put them in the cabins, select your destination, and set sail. Through a series of choices, you can earn profits during the emergency period of the New World and even decide its fate—unintentionally or on purpose.

name: MOAR - Appeteaser
short_description: The sandbox version of Mayhem on a Rainbow - VR. It offers endless fun with arena and wave shooters, spiced with mini games and upcoming new features. A glimpse into the wacky apocalypse where zombies fly in slow motion and chickens lay airstrikes! Saddle up your unicorn and fire up the spaceboat!

name: OrbiTank
short_description: Local multiplayer tanks in space!

name: Captain!
short_description: You play as a pirate captain navigating the Caribbean to exploit all of its hidden plunder. As the captain, you can order those you command to do your dirty work for you, but don't be fooled you will have to take matters into your own hands from time to time.

name: SHAFTED
short_description: SHAFTED is a QUICK resource management game. Build your mini mining colony. Optimize your mineral outputs. Strategically position your buildings with turn based tactics. Pay off your contracts or else you'll get SHAFTED.

name: Ocular Deprivation
short_description: Ocular Deprivation is a top-down horror game where you, the player, are blind. The only way for you to find your bearing is through the use of echo-location, and observing how the sound bounces off the walls. Be careful though, for you aren't the only one using sound to their advantage

name: Silent Seeker
short_description: Silent Seeker is a Hide & Seek multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!

name: Mr.Brocco & Co
short_description: Mr. Brocco & Co is a classic 2D platform game set in a fantasy world where junk food is trying to take over! Choose one of two characters (Mr. Broccoli or Super Asparagus) to save the city!

name: Millie's Adventure
short_description: Millie, a shy and reclusive Bovian girl, was living a peaceful and reclusive life until a thief stole her treasured magic staff! She will to do anything to get her staff back. Millie's Adventure is a hardcore hentai 2D action adventure game with adult content not in your average adult game.

name: Pentacore
short_description: Pentacore is a metroidvania with a focus on platforming and exploration. Run, shoot, climb, and blast your way through a massive world. All in order to find five keys and leave your prison of a planet.

name: Ars Notoria
short_description: Explore the fantasy world of Ars Notoria, a survival-action RPG set inside an open-world sandbox that lets you hunt powerful possessed creatures. Strike out on your own or play together with friends to build a sprawling faction, utilizing deep crafting mechanics and strategic recruiting of allies.

name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
short_description: Explore a dream world as the iconic Little Nemo, armed with toys, candy, and stuffed animals in this cute & colorful Metroidvania adventure. Experience NES-era platformer gameplay in a vast, non-linear world that has been hand-animated frame-by-frame, as you unlock new abilities to progress.

name: Loplight
short_description: Loplight is a twin-stick shooter taking inspirations from Hermetic lore and old alchemical concepts. Explore the ruins of this world, find out who's responsible, and defeat the monstrous creatures blocking your path.

name: Bloom: Roots of Renewal
short_description: Bloom: Roots of Renewal is a first person shooter inspired by Hexen and Quake. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures.

name: Microbes and Machines
short_description: Microbes and Machines is a roguelite action game where you control a little bubble robot that fights against the forces of evil.

name: Particle Hearts
short_description: Explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and uncover the role you play in this sinister and beautiful land.

name: All-In-One Summer Sports VR
short_description: 10 Summer Sports are waiting for you! Head to a hot tropical island full of sunshine, fun and unforgettable experiences. Create your own character and join the dizzying games with many players around the world! Hone your skills, play and win!

name: Star Boss
short_description: Make robots and spaceships,explore the space,fight with aliens.

name: 焰色方糖 flamed sugar
short_description: Flamed Sugar is a visual novel with light puzzle solving elements, which tells several independent stories.

name: What's your emergency
short_description: "What's your emergency" is a game where you take the boots of a 911 operator. In it you will be presented with different emergencys, your task is aid the victims. You will be able to do this through dialogs with the victim and using the new computer application called "Emergency_Manager_2.0".

name: Richman 11
short_description: Richman 11 is a casual game in Monopoly genre, it is the 11th episode of the franchise. In the game, players could select maps, characters and group play, creating free play or challenge play. Try to earn money and win the play by investing properties, using cards, etc.

name: 8-Bit Farm
short_description: Farm management simulation game! Create the most awesome farm!

name: Jasper's Island
short_description: Help the lighthouse keeper and his cat to caretake a mysterious island in this pawsome hand-drawn platformer.

name: Foklor
short_description: Build, farm, tame, fight and explore as you and your friends survive in the world of Foklor. Discover treasures, items and magic of great power as you defend against evil creatures. Your legend awaits!

name: A Rum Case in Fogtown
short_description: Puppet detectives Sherblock and Blockson are on the case to resolve a string of mysterious sabotage against Fogtown’s most beloved pubs. You control the story in this madcap comedy joyride!

name: 少女妖精弹珠台 Elf Girl Pinball
short_description: More than just a "very happy" pinball game~!

name: 只爱三国
short_description: 2022年度战争策略手游，史诗级三国历史游戏大作！ 全新攻城战法，无限英雄培养，每日福利不停。 最强三国历史题材国战游戏，每天上演城池版图变迁。 再现经典三国战场，回合制战斗模式加即时国战控制策略游戏，超大实感地图，智能多部队行军，丰富的战斗体验和多样内政玩法，给你带来不一样的体验.

name: Photogenic Minds : Identity
short_description: "デッキ構築型３D探索サイコホラー"。 PM0:00からAM0:00までの12時間を支配し、無限ループを抜けて死者の魂を捕獲して下さい。 使えるのはたった1つのカメラだけ。

name: The First Descendant
short_description: The First Descendant is a third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Become a Descendant. Fight for the survival of humanity. Descendants have unique abilities to tackle both solo and co-op missions. Up to 4 players use varied mechanics to defeat giant bosses. BE THE FIRST DESCENDANT!

name: The First Descendant Final Technical Test
Phantom Alchemy ~Silvia's Dynamic Urban Planning~
short_description: In order to make up for the corruption committed by her father, Silvia had to help the development of the border city as an alchemist. But if she wants to use alchemy, she must convert the spiritual power of residents into energy.

name: Very Easy Match3 Game
short_description: The combination of relaxing match-3 gameplay and intense combat will provide you with a unique sensory experience. In addition, you can enjoy beautiful paintings of unlocked female teammates in the gallery.

name: PewPew Live
short_description: A fast twin-stick shooter where you compete for the top spot in the leaderboards.

name: TOPIA
short_description: TOPIA is a time travel, choice based VR adventure game where the future is literally in your hands!

name: REDSTORY and the Last Glimmer
short_description: REDSTORY and the Last Glimmer tells the story of RED, Little Red Riding Hood, accompanied by Birdy, a little bird, in the fantastic world of the 6 Kingdoms. An adventure full of action and humor with stunning graphics, !!

name: Boom Slingers
short_description: A fresh take on the classic artillery genre! Fight in physics-based battles online against players around the world. Defeat your opponents with UFO-tracked Cows, gravity-defying Anvils, or a good ol' fashioned Baseball Bat. The choice is yours!
