short_description: You are a troubled college student trying to live a normal life surrounded by some... complicated men. Although unaware, you are causing the destruction of reality. Will the Guardians kill you to protect the universe? Can you find your happily ever after... How many times will you die trying?

name: Pete's Peril
short_description: Solving puzzles of all skill levels, dodging boulders, grabbing diamonds, upgrading tools, clothing for different climates and crush enemies along the way is all part of Pete's Peril.

name: The Legend of Gandar II
short_description: The Legend of Gandar II takes place four years after the events of The Legend of Gandar. The Legend of Gandar II is again based on an 2D action-adventure video game.

name: Deer Hunting - The Season
short_description: Hunt Deer that act and react differently depending on the time of the season, weather and rut stage. Bucks very in size and you will be able to hunt monster bucks that have potential to score well over 200 inches. Each successful hunt gains you EXP and you can purchase / upgrade gear and firearms.

name: Ghost of Ice Valley
short_description: Ghost of Ice valley is a Visual Novel where you follow multiple different storylines and make choices according to what you believe the characters may do in that situation. Interact in the Interview system to find out more about the characters and about yourself as you go along.

name: The Most Awesome Game Ever Made
short_description: Do you really want to live your life knowing that you never played 'The Most Awesome Game Ever Made?'... I didn't think so! Download it right now so you don't miss out on the fun!

name: Slap Squad
short_description: Slap Squad is a physics based, online multiplayer brawler where you battle your friends with wobbly toon-like characters. Use weapons and powerups in your arsenal to finish objectives and eliminate other players!

name: Path of Achra
short_description: Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

name: Matrix Hearts - Season 1
short_description: Matrix Hearts is an adult Visual Novel about romance, comedy, and choice. Play in the shoes of a former Olympic rock-climber as he moves to a tropical island where he may be able to climb to the top once again.

name: Dungeon in a Bottle
short_description: Dungeon in a Bottle is a precision platformer about choosing the right kind of jump. The acrobatic thief, Reya, has gotten himself trapped in a magic bottle, and now he must use every jump at his disposal to escape the treacherous dungeon within! Hopefully he'll grab some treasure while he's at it.

name: Ceaseless Night
short_description: Ceaseless Night is a strategic roguelike that captures the essence of dungeon crawling in a bleak world. In a world of stolen sunlight, the flickering flames of a campfire lure unwitting travelers to face the dungeons below. Conquer the dungeons, defeat the Lich King, and end this Ceaseless Night!

name: The Lost Bloodline
short_description: The Lost Bloodline is a game where you will venture into an immersive story developed in medieval times, endowed with a lot of action, exploration and a touch of fantasy, we recommend you to venture into this great epic journey.

name: The Immolate
short_description: You will be subjected to the savagery of the spirit possessed by the devil. Try to get out of the old house you were trapped in! Retro survival horror game in the 90s

name: Death Trials (Director's Cut)
short_description: An action horror game about scientific trials gone wrong! Run and hide or FIGHT your way to escape. Plenty of jump-scares and perfect for streaming!

name: Waking Knightmare
short_description: Become a Dream Walker in this high Adrenaline Knightmare! Push yourself to the limits on Single Player for a high score or challenge your friends in a battle with your Knightmares on your side. The choice is yours...

name: Leviathan: An Interactive Comic Book
short_description: A seaside village – and a monstrous threat. Explore as you choose, by day or by night. Can you unravel the secrets of history and defeat the Leviathan? A choose-your-path comic book by Jason Shiga.

name: Code:29
short_description: This is a post-apocalyptic zombie shooter game. You can switch between first person and third person. Multiple bosses, multiple choices, multiple endings.

name: World of Naples
short_description: Play single player or local co-op. Story mode or Brawler is up to you. Remote play with friends. Simple mechanics. 20 levels, 4 bosses, 6 PVP arenas.

name: Seven Seas: Adventures
short_description: Welcome to the Seven Seas: Adventures! Set sail and chart your course to fame, fortune, and adventure in this unique age of sail sandbox game!

name: Enclosure 3-D
short_description: You are Mike Goodman, joining a mission to investigate mysterious activity at an arctic base. Text-parser mystery adventure game inspired by classics of the genre, using pixel art in 3D.

name: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
short_description: Staffer Case is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders. Each mystery unraveled leads you closer to the truth lying at the heart of each case!

name: Kamaria
short_description: Ahoyy!!, Let’s fight em all. It's time to find a way back to the future from this mysterious island!! But wait? what kind of stones on the island is this, there is some kind of power in it. May that be the way back home? Let's find out!! Action, Adventure and RPG game (Single Player)

name: Signal & Echo: Iris is Missing (demo)
short_description: A point-and-click adventure with innovative detective mechanics. Help Ollie, a fledgling reporter on his first day at the Signal & Echo newspaper, to solve the mystery behind a schoolgirl's disappearance. Developed by an ex-journalist.

name: Stagdraft
short_description: STAGDRAFT is a Chaotic 2D multiplayer hack and slasher. Designed for intense PvP action and supports up to 24 players. Pick your role, strategize with your allies and dominate the battleground to capture all the zones and secure the final objectives in a domination warfare!

name: Mycorrhiza
short_description: A love letter to horror manga in the form of a visual novel. Welcome to a world of distorted minds.

name: 海峡の故郷
short_description: 一通の手紙をきっかけに故郷の地、函館へと戻る主人公。 少年時代を一緒に過ごした幼馴染の女性と故郷を巡り、かつての記憶を少しずつ取り戻していく主人公。 そして旅の終着点で主人公を待っていたものとは…… ストリートビューで函館の街を巡る、新しい形のトラベルコミュニケーションゲームです。

name: Demiurges
short_description: I mixed a classic turn-based strategy game (Heroes of Might and Magic 3) with deck building game like Slay the Spire. Also added a lot of reptiles :) Immerse yourself in a rich fantasy world. Develop your town and armies. Collect cards to create new crazy strategies.

name: Omnibullet
short_description: A factory is like a clockwork, can you make it tick? Combine simple towers into complex mechanisms, generate enough energy bullets, charge batteries. An open-ended logic game about efficiency, energy management, and tight budgets. Batteries included, but you will have to charge them yourself.

name: Slime Puzzle Story
short_description: Slime Puzzle Story is a slime-rolling puzzle game set in a mysterious village filled with puzzles. Journey through this comedic adventure story!

name: The Blood Amulet
short_description: A Psychedelic adventure and turn based RPG, with randomized loot, tactical game play and loot sorting. Stylized Visual Arts unlike any other game. Epic Boss fights. Home made music/art. Story Mode, text based game. ---Set out to defeat the Goblin Tribes and destroy The Blood Amulet. By any means.

name: To Eternity
short_description: Play as a hero who wants to seek eternity, face unknown monsters, do tense and exciting slashing, gain the ability to purchase attributes of gold, and defeat the final Boss, forward to eternity in your mind!

name: ファントムゾーン　ダイモンズ  Phantom Zone DAIMONS
short_description: Just a few toes into the future. Yomori-shi, a town full of strange happenings. And Ayamu Jinnai is just an ordinary girl. Except that she is a powerful medium and has the ability to see spirits. She and her occult-enthusiast sister, Makoto, are determined to fight the bizarre.

name: Super Block Crush
short_description: Super block crash is a new Breakout game, with a sprinkle of RPG.

name: Chilljong
short_description: Chilljong is an endless adventure for lovers of puzzles and unhurried gameplay without limits! An unusual hybrid of genres in the style of mahjong connect will delight fans of the genre.

name: Orb Fort
short_description: A unique super-tight platformer with varied, highly challenging platforming and enemies. Run, dash, jump, and shoot to make your way through the secret fort and recover the stolen power orb. Featuring (currently) more than 150 difficult screens. Fast deaths and lightning-fast respawns.

name: Your Waifu JUICE
short_description: Fight with the dungeon dwellers and enjoy sex scenes with lovely girls! You have to consistently conquer 5 dungeons of varying difficulty. Defeat opponents, fight terrible bosses, get more and more sophisticated weapons.

name: Heartless
short_description: A casual 2d Cave Escape game

name: SGS Okinawa
short_description: A standalone epic rendering of the 1945 bloody fighting on Okinawa, the last great battle of the Pacific War. The game is part of the Pacific D-Day collection. Both sides are playable, each with their own challenge.

name: Dinosaurs Dominion
short_description: Reclaim your Dominion! Dinosaurs Dominion is a Compact, Single Player, Action Rougelite, where players must reclaim their dominion from a tyrannical apex.

name: Defect detector
short_description: Defect detector - A dynamic game for fans of the breakout genre! Find the weak point among hundreds of colored blocks and destroy defect after defect in this exciting game! Collect bonuses, hit the ball accurately and get to the end!

name: Hunting grounds
short_description: Hunting grounds - Take on a fleet of space pirates as you pilot your starship in this arcade shoot'em up! Blow up enemies and collect bonuses in the vastness of the vast space and break new score records. How far can you go on this adventure?

name: ClasSimVR
short_description: ClasSimVR is a serious game and an exploratory platform targeted at helping pre-service teacher learn about challenging student behaviour.

name: Rebellion
short_description: A puzzle-RPG with a humorous take on the government's overreach in 2020. Collect pens and paper to write letters Collect keys to access houses Click on people to view their activities Visit a writing desk to write letter Deliver letters to people to build support Sleep to lower suspicion

name: Crescent Cauldron Cafe
short_description: Crescent Cauldron Café is a casual co-op management game where you play as two sisters running their family's café. Both sisters are witches of a different variety and use their abilities for different roles. Manage a storefront, fly on a broom to deliver orders!

name: THE 4 SINS
short_description: THE 4 SINS is a multiplayer puzzle game in horror atmosphere. It is adapted from a local offline escape room which has gained public recognition for its story. There are 4 players in the game to find cooperative solution by exploring the ghost town. Try to escape the strange place!!

name: Gold Of Lotusland
short_description: In our story rich game Gold Of Lotusland you play as Lead Engineer Daniel Quinn as he uncovers the dark truth about the robots he designed as well as the world he lives within. Could the machines be capable of murder? What is Lotusland? You as the player must make the choices to discover the truth.

name: Murders at Tealwoods Manor
short_description: You've been invited to a strange party at Lady Tealwoods' new mansion. It's not long until a sudden murder is revealed, and you must piece together who is lying, and who is the murderer as you uncover the secrets of the different strange guests of Tealwoods Manor.

name: Last Christmas
short_description: Last Christmas" is a short, dark point-and-click adventure. Join Frankie at a remote mountain cabin as he prepares the perfect Christmas for his girlfriend, Betty. But beware, things are not as they seem, and the festive cheer hides something far more sinister...

name: Boulette Hell
short_description: Defeat bosses in this bullet hell with unique characters and silly stories. Will you be able to escape the clutches of a contract you signed for the purchase of a yogurt maker?

name: REX
short_description: Are you up for the challenge of breaking this crazy game with crazy builds? Can you take control of Rex the cat and defeat the evil Draconians? Can you earn a spot on the leaderboard? If you're ready for all of that, buy REX today and enjoy this exciting roguelike game with a steampunk theme

name: Hot Blood
short_description: Take down zombies as a deadly cutie in 3D low-poly style! Hot Blood is physics-based brawling fun inspired by action movies of the 80s & 90s.

name: Unprompted
short_description: A.I. IS HERE. Type to guess the words used to create A.I. artworks, while slowly uncovering A.I.'s reflections on its own work. Come investigate more than 1,500 artworks made by A.I. across 7 carefully curated galleries.

name: My House Is Haunted
short_description: A Vampire Survivor like game but first person shooter. You level up by shooting the enemy and get new skills. Upgrade your skills!

name: Horror Tale 1: Kidnapper
short_description: Uncover the mystery behind a terrifying kidnapper in this story-driven horror adventure. Solve puzzles, explore eerie locations, and help Tom and his friends survive in 1990s America. Horror Tale is a creepy escape game full of twists and suspense.

name: Blue Wednesday
short_description: Blue Wednesday is a relaxing and lovely adventure game focused on story, music, and characters. Explore the city, meet various characters, and have conversations. Listen to their stories, play mini-games, collect music albums, and play music.

name: Silen House
short_description: 《silen house》 is a scary adventure puzzle game. There is always a strange cry in the deserted old house in the deep mountains. I don't know where I came from. When I approached the old house, a grim burst came.

name: Zoo Simulator
short_description: In Zoo Simulator, your main task is to run and manage your own zoo. Renew it and take care of all the animals' needs, ensuring them a peaceful life! Will you attract crowds of visitors? Create your own zoo!

name: Trap of MUSK:Europe Night
short_description: An exotic love story set in the land of hot sand. The target, who has never truly loved a woman. And the client, who loves women in a twisted way. How will you manage between these two? Who is it that destroys the sacrifice of thirsty love--?

name: Scary School Simulator
short_description: Join Akane and Sakura to escape the horror school in the most scariest anime school simulator game that you'll ever playing!

name: WASD Quartet
short_description: A narrative game where you'll play music with robots. Explore places, and play in rhythm to discover all the secrets of this world.

name: CATAIRE - Gambling with cats
short_description: Cat + Solitaire = CATAIRE (legal gambling with cats). Purrfection graphic, You can playing CATAIRE with mouse, meow sounds and purrfect music. Cats would buy CATAIRE (if they could play). Buy Me(ow)!

name: Salt Game
short_description: Serez-vous à la hauteur de ce parcours ?

name: Memory Lost: Chapter One
short_description: First chapter of Memory Lost. It is a story-driven action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one magazine in the weapon - change the bodies to survive!

name: REANIMAL
short_description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

name: Peregrine
short_description: After escaping from an inevitable death you have been chosen to wield the Desolation Blade. While wielding it you can bring justice to those who brought death and destruction to earth and enslaved mankind [...]

name: Fairy Tag : A Game Of Divinities
short_description: Beware the Cat Sith ! In this party game for four, Fairy folk must run away from the Cat Sith chasing them. Those mischievous creatures can’t stop themselves from playing with it.

name: Operation Jaeger
short_description: Operation Jaeger is a tactical team-based first-person shooter where skill counts but teamwork wins. You will be waiting for a lot of both PvP and PvE modes.

name: The Bird
short_description: Spread the wings and fly around in a large tropical Island landscape in this bird simulator.

name: Village and The Witch
short_description: Jump into a farmtastic bewitched adventure and help your king to defend village from witch.The king will take the opportunity to explain basic task and give you feel of your first fright of Witch Attack. The king introduces you to the possibilities of interaction with the environment & villagers.

name: Hardrock Sex 3D
short_description: Hardrock Sex 3D is a dynamic rhythm game with elements of visual novel. Meet our characters, discover their story and explore all the hot scenes they have to offer.

name: R.I.P. Tour
short_description: A death game visual novel where murder victims are decided by group consensus. Make friends and enemies, solve the mysteries of an abandoned amusement park, and suss out the traitor in your group.

name: GUILTY
short_description: Guilty is a first-person psychological horror game. Play as Peter and discover what your past hides. Access your unconscious to remember your traumas and the scariest memories that are hidden. A traumatic past that gives you a feeling of guilt.

name: ZombieSquad Ghouls Guns N Guts
short_description: Fight The Voxelized Zombie Hoards in this FPS online Co-op Survival shooter. Survive, unlock more areas and powerups as you progress through a vast maze of post apocalyptic ruin. Purchase a gun from the wall or the "random mystery gun chest". Online Co-op 1-4 Players.

name: The Impossible Knight Runner
short_description: The Impossible Knight Runner is an intense hack-and-slash platformer full of creatures trying to put an end to your adventure. Enter the dungeon with courage and decisiveness as the slightest mistake will be your downfall.

name: Rectangle Guy
short_description: Introducing Rectangle Guy, a brand new game by The Bare Minimum Studios. Rectangle Guy (game) features Rectangle Guy (character) in this platforming adventure! With many challenging levels and exciting boss fights, there's no shortage of things to do and see in this wacky game.

name: Reignbreaker
short_description: Reignbreaker is a high-octane action rogue-like set in a dystopian medievalpunk world. Step into the boots of Clef, a fearless rebel ready to rid the world of the Kingdom’s oppression, take down the Elite and lay siege to the Queen’s grand Bastion. Grab your javelin and become The Reignbreaker!

name: Elin
short_description: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?

name: Shape Of The Toilet Rim
short_description: A single player arcade-like game where you crush Toilet Cars driven by small suns. See how high of a score you can get!

name: Stinky and Loof in Wonderland
short_description: Stinky and Loof in Wonderland is a compelling action puzzle game! Guide quirky characters through more than 350 individually designed levels, discovering new worlds and challenges as you go. Some levels feature challenging puzzles, some pulse-pounding action, and some both - but all are fun!

name: England in London
short_description: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

name: Castle Warriors
short_description: Castle Warriors is a rogue like auto battler with a strategy twist. Build your army one card at a time!

name: Fallen Evolution
short_description: Choose up to 4 different classes, customize your character and chat with friends in-game, create your own guild/clan, battle monsters, learn techniques and spells, raise your own pet and use it in battle, obtain the best armors and weapons, become rich and famous!

name: Operation Satoshi [Early Version Alpha]
short_description: This is a game in development. It has been published just to get feedback from community. We are aware there will be defects and will do weekly updates. Feedback can be sent to contact@metaxseed.io. A shooting RPG game to rescue a kidnapped scientist, Nakamoto Satoshi.

name: The Slaughterday
short_description: You are a celestial soldier guarding the North Heavenly Gate, but one day you were transformed by mortal technology into a semi-demon semi-mechanical cyborg warrior, trapped in a time-space loop called "slaughter day", caught in infinite resurrection and battle.

name: Sora no Ao to Shiro to
short_description: 《天空的蓝与白/如梭夏日》是由日本美少女游戏品牌Barista Lab于2022年夏天推出的一款恋爱小品作。由知名原画师SesenaYau担当人物设计与原画，由咏野万知子编写剧本，并由知名音乐制作人大川茂伸制作音乐。

name: カルマの回収屋(Karma Collector)
short_description: This is an action combat game that is played with with the D and A keys or a controller. You earn experience points by defeating enemies. When you have earned enough your rank will increase, which raises your attributes such as your attack power. A tutorial is available.

name: The Backworld: Prologue
short_description: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

name: Arcane Survivors
short_description: Arcane Passage is a rogue light action game that takes you into dungeons to explore magic. Choose a class, combine spells and runes, and master the art of magic.

name: Moksha
short_description: A story depicting emancipation from suffering caused by various emotions and cruelty environments. Focused on brutal action, it draws players into the world with not only fists but also lots of weapons. Will she be able to learn what should become in order to truly overcome from her suffering ?

name: Again and Again
short_description: Again and Again is a first-person psychological horror game. How much can a game affect your real life? Enjoy the terrifying moments of being in a realistic home environment and a suspenseful story.

name: The Chalk
short_description: Descend into abandoned gold mine filled with danger. Compete with others for gold, but beware of the lurking monster and water flooding the floors. Use chalk marks to navigate, and customize your character to suit your style. Survive and escape with your riches intact.

name: Best Friend
short_description: Best Friend is a visual novel exclusively for adults! This game will immerse you in the story of a girl who moved in with her friend in New York. She lives side by side with her until she finds out that she is a lesbian. The game is filled with sex scenes, humor and romance.

name: Hot Mom
short_description: Hot Mom is a visual novel exclusively for adults! This game will immerse you headlong into the story of a guy who goes to college and needs a new apartment. He moves in with his mom's girlfriend, who turns out to be very, very sexy.

name: Take The Wheels!
short_description: Take The Wheels! is a fresh, brand new take on the arcade racing genre! Using asymmetric thrust to pilot your hovercar (think rowing a boat, but with rockets!) race across a variety of worlds, from luscious forests to searing deserts. Play online or with your friends in this exciting take on racing!

name: Die Daddy Die
short_description: Die Daddy Die is a 3d adventure and platform game in which you control a slime thrown by a Cosmic God, capable of deforming his body at will, solving traps and situations that arise in order to continue advancing.

name: Ticy Adventure Club
short_description: 本作是2d剧情向角色扮演恐怖游戏。在本作设定中，玩家将扮演灵异探险社的社员，分工调查被委托的事件，探索场景，寻找线索，并最终解决委托中灵异作祟的问题。

name: Atham Battle Simulator
short_description: Fight your way to glory by conquering humans, demons & corrupted veggies in "Atham Battle Simulator". Don't let the bananas scare you from not playing this!

name: Moto Trophy
short_description: Take part in the motorcycle trophy. Upgrade your bike, win a lot of different races, and go! To the prizes, and much more!

name: 拾光物语 Border Town Playtest
Shin Galaxy - Alpha War
short_description: A space shooter game with RPG mechanics. Players will be able to improve their ships to tackle the challenges ahead, as well as buy better ships and customize them.

name: Wishlist
short_description: Wishlist is a 2D side-scrolling pixel art game that tells the story of a protagonist who is disappointed with life in the real world. By coincidence, they travel back to their childhood and relive their past life, making up for past regrets.

name: Mark of the Void
short_description: Turn based RPG game with heavy reliance on strategy and item management. Inspiration from older rpg games with more punishing mechanics but more rewarding for patient and strategic players. Any type of player can play and enjoy, but the more dedicated and curious players will find more reward!

name: Connected through fate
short_description: Romatic and dramatic Otome Game

name: Tinytown
short_description: Tinytown is a cozy zen-like building strategy and puzzle game where you create a small city by placing new buildings. Manage resources, upgrade buildings and use all the small space to build your dream city!

name: Contraption Simulator
short_description: A vehicle builder where the only limit is your imagination and your CPU.

name: WarpVector
short_description: WarpVector is an immersive sci-fi roguelike built around space exploration, combat, and navigation. Explore the remnants of an ancient civilization, fend off marauding space pirates, and find a way to save your home planet.

name: Planet Barren Objective
short_description: Fight, upgrade, explore, and build your way out of a dangerous planet in this 2D pixel art side scroller. Stream of foes will keep you on your toes while beating them will reward you with much needed resources.

name: Tivick'ing! Chronicles
short_description: Tivick'ing! Chronicles is a turn-based fantasy RPG set on the continent of Arcadia. Play as the Prince of Kent as he tries to unravel the mystery of the strange pages appearing across the continent, and their possible connection to his missing sister.

name: Dreamables
short_description: A First-person survival horror with platform elements! Survive the map of Dreamables and get out. Find your way to collect figures and paintings, defeat the creatures with the help of your abilities: Levitate, Teleport and Slow spell combined with the lantern.

name: Rhythm Storm
short_description: Rhythm Storm is a roguelike bullet heaven with stunning vector graphics, rhythmic action, and overwhelming swarms of enemies. Your vehicle aims and fires freely while everything else dances and moves to the beat in this spectacular audio-visual experience.

name: Magnus Positive Phototaxis
short_description: Magnus Positive Phototaxis is an atmospheric journey through a mysterious world of characters, traces and symbols. The task of the player is to solve the puzzles, using proper combinations of objects, finding them in the environment around him.

name: The Icon Battles
short_description: A Windows application that turns your desktop icons to life, and they endlessly fight each other.

name: Ringlorn Saga
short_description: Ringlorn Saga is an adventure RPG inspired by the Japanese PC classics. Prince Gerhard the Brave embarks on a journey to the neighboring land to investigate the appearance of a magic barrier and his father's disappearance.

name: Super Arter
short_description: Solve the most challenging puzzles, jump, throw objects, use switches, dodge traps, defeat enemies, collect gifts, and discover the best way for Arter to take the key to the door in this puzzle/platform game.

name: 500 Second Challenge
short_description: As the ladder gets faster and narrower, can you increase your living space through the upgrade system? Last for 500 seconds, and your gameplay will be different from everyone else's depending on how your skills level up.

name: Vox Populi: Brazil 2022
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customized political figure, and campaign for many alternative Brazilian elections! In "Vox Populi: Brazil 2022", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: Soul Searching
short_description: In this puzzle stealth game, your soul has been captured by an evil necromancer determined to take over the lands! Can you escape his perilous dungeon home to warn the kingdom before the undead rise and take over the throne?

name: To The Top
short_description: Accompany Maya and her little companion on an adventure where the only thing that matters is reaching the top.

name: The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen
short_description: A demon is trying to kill you and your friends, and it's all that you can do to survive. How can you stop it permanently? How many of your friends have to die before it's all over? Try and make the best choices you can in this pulse-pounding horror visual novel!

name: 无尽星海(Endless Stars)
short_description: The story takes place in the distant future. You will play a captain of a star ship and go into deep space. You need to manage your resources carefully. In the game, you can investigate the outliers of various planets, discover the wonders of the universe or learn the stories of lost civilizations.

name: Ami's Room
short_description: An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories. Make a choice as the reality and dreamed world begins to blur...

name: Andromeda Survivors
short_description: Defeat thousands of enemies that are invading Andromeda! Andromeda Survivors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where you collect skills and upgrades for your ship to create amazing builds!

name: PhD
short_description: Will you navigate the intricacies of the scientific world to get your PhD?

name: Infected Friend
short_description: Infected Friend is a 3rd person online pvp shooter. One of the players becomes infected at the beginning of the round. His goal is to infect all other players. Other players will have to hold out for 60 seconds to win the round.

name: Elven Rivers: The Forgotten Lands Collector's Edition
short_description: Celene and her brave teammates have already earn a reputation for themselves: this is why they were chosen to be the first group to explore the neighbouring continent of beastmen.

name: Emergency Crew 2 Global Warming
short_description: Hurricanes are raging in Sunland! Once again, Stephen Shepard leads an Emergency Crew to help people in their hour of need and get to the bottom of what's going on.

name: KAKURIYO
short_description: KAKURIYO is a online co-op horror game for 1-4 players. A vindictive ghost seeks a new victim. You and your team members need investigating the distorted world and purifying the curse.

name: HVS: Hitler VS Stalin - Battle Of Moscow
short_description: Play as Hitler on his mission to assassinate Stalin. Try an alternative history where Hitler actually succed with the Third Reich. Race, shoot and explore the Kremlin in Moscow.

name: Run Or Boom
short_description: This game is inspired by an old game. Eliminate other players and be the last one standing. Online / LAN 2 - 4 players PVP.

name: Cycle of The Moon

name: Ultimate Destruction Simulator

name: Hidden Office Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Hitmen Havoc

Imagine a wild mix of Worms and Unreal Tournament—customize battles with unique characters in modes perfect for quick sessions or lively parties with friends, foes, strangers, or viewers. Can you finish on top?

name: ANKIF - 将棋定跡暗記アプリ

name: Sawdust

short_description: Light In Blood is a competitive asymmetric action-horror with tactical elements. In intense 1v4 matches, choose to play as a nightmare or a survivor with unique abilities. name: Reimus Awesome Holiday

name: Huge Jaws

name: Grapple Gal
short_description: A linear 3D platform where you race through a destroyed future. Play as Bullet, an augmented human with incredible abilities and speed. Navigate environments using your grappling arm, using the momentum you've built to fly through stages at amazing distances.

name: Korean BBQ Simulator

name: Veridian Expanse

name: RKR - Rush Kill Repeat
short_description: With your head, name and purpose taken from you, the only thing that keeps you going is your unquenchable rage... and quickly draining blood. Reclaim what is yours before your blood runs dry.

short_description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

short_description: Inspired by the likes of LSD: Dream Emulator and Yume Nikki, explore a liminal, inhuman, and colossal world in this relaxing puzzle platformer. Explore a multitude of locations, battle a variety of enemies and solve small puzzles to retrieve collectibles for your trophy room. Unlock new areas by upgrading your weapons and abilities.

name: Bomber 3
short_description: Put yourself in the captain’s seat of a B-17 bomber, select your plane, select your crew and plot your path over war-torn Europe. Watch your elevation, watch your formation, and watch very carefully when you are over the target. This classic was a bestseller in the early 1990s.
