short_description: In this open world adventure, you’ll be exploring and solving as you uncover the story of Ria, the magical capybara looking to stop the Dark soul from taking over. With your inner power along the way, and experience a journey driven by your choices to save the world.

name: The Search For Paradisus
short_description: A game with a Dark Fantasy story and 3D platform style gameplay. The game has 3 scenarios which are: "Purgatorium", "Gehenna" and "Paradisus". Your guide to "Paradisus" will be a not very friendly being, called "Mr. Nobody", which is represented by the "Burning Bushes".

name: Brutal TD
short_description: Brutal TD is a minimalist retro-styled game that combines elements of tower defense games and classic space shooters. Brutal TD puts you in complete control of a single tower. You can choose what enemies to fire at, which enemies you prioritize, and how to spend your resources.

name: Lillysia
short_description: LILLYSIA is a tactical leaping and landing 2D platform. Player take on the role of a girl who must save her pet from illness by searching a herb.

name: The Extraterrestrials Museum of Earth Exploration
short_description: The alien lifeforms welcome you to The Extraterrestrial Museum of Earth Exploration! Get lost in the exhibits, meet new friends and take up a job at the museum to help these aliens learn about Earth from a real-life Earthling!

name: Paradise Cleaning!- sex-loving family -
short_description: Paradise Cleaning!- sex-loving family - is super-casual action game. All you have to do is just cleaning out all dirty icons by dragging over them within the time limit. There are 5+1 dirty icons and each of them can be cleaned by the corresponding Cleaning tools.

name: Transliminal: Beyond The Backrooms
short_description: An unsettling rogue-lite horror adventure. Each exploration of the many iconic, and chilling, horror settings will be unique as they generate around you. Collect strange items, and level up your stats. To survive, escape, or claim more uncertain fates. Fall in. Get lost. Go beyond The Backrooms.

name: Cursed Angel: Time Paradox
short_description: In Cursed Angel: Time Paradox, players engage in a captivating blend of time travel, real-time strategy, and action RPG elements. Take control of a heroic character capable of harnessing the speed of light, manipulating time, and seamlessly transitioning between different timelines.

name: Tower! Simulator 3
short_description: Immerse yourself in an ultra-realistic environment that brings the challenges of air traffic control right to your fingertips. With brand-new lighting system, intuitive 2D graphical user interface (GUI), improved voice recognition, 9 airports included, Tower! Sim 3 sets a new gold standard.

name: 云城异闻录
short_description: 这是一款参考豫章书院真实事件改编的恐怖游戏，采用了全新的虚幻5引擎打造，这是一款独立游戏，由于我们没有开发经验所以可能一些地方、功能做的不够完美、完善，目前游戏依旧处于持续更新中，后需将推出更完善、更精彩的游戏内容、更大的地图、更丰富的场景，敬请期待

name: Souls of Tartarus
short_description: Souls of Tartarus is a "Rogue-lite", "Souls-like" inspiered Top-Down Dungeon Crawler. A gamble with the ruler of the Underworld "Tartarus" gives you a last chance to be reborn. Can you defeat his Generals that became lazy and set in there ways? No Checkpoints. No Saves. One Run, One Chance.

name: Crossword World Puzzle
short_description: English crossword games with words puzzle! Improve vocabulary by word search!

name: Escape First Alchemist: Prologue
short_description: First-person escape adventure game. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?

name: Now you are the persecuted
short_description: You spawn in a dungeon that hasn't loaded yet and for some reason the other enemies (apart from you) want to attack you and you have to escape before they reach you (there could be many bugs)

name: Voxel Pirates
short_description: Compete for control of the seven seas with yer mateys in wild cooperative battles!

name: Pedra Crystal Caves
short_description: Pedra Crystal Caves is a 'just one more go' puzzle game where you have to find all the key tiles which open the exit door to each cave. Play solo or local co-op. 48 caves to choose from.

name: The Happies - Doomsday Stories
short_description: Build ships, assemble crews, evacuate the planet from disaster. Conquer space, explore a universe full of dangers: aggressive ufos, ravenous space piranhas or deadly radiation. Find your way, fight battles and if you can survive, find a new home. Indie casual strategy card game.

name: Miss Kawaii 2
short_description: Surrounded by many beautiful girls, a mind-blowing, sexy journey has started. Relax, clear your mind and enjoy.

name: Axiom
short_description: In a cyberpunk world where giant corporations take advantage of their power, only those with the ability to enter the human mind can stop corruption at its source. You are a mind assassin called Miles and this mind-bending first-person action-adventure is your story of revenge.

name: Magical Drop VI
short_description: Follow the story, battle a cast of whimsical characters, set new records, solve puzzles, engage your friends and family in local multiplayer, or compete against players from around the world through online play.

name: Haramase!semen transport project
short_description: Dedicated to those who like fertilization depictions and pregnant belly

name: Baby Storm
short_description: Watch over unpredictable kids as they unleash chaos in your kindergarten! Make your way through clever and original levels, earn loads of points, unlock new stages and features, and encounter special babies with mysterious powers...

name: Testament: The Order of High Human
short_description: Testament is a first-person single-player action-adventure game with bits of RPG and metroidvania elements set in a post-apocalyptic fantasy world. It offers a mixed combat with different possibilities and combination by sword, spells and bow while it is rich with platforming and puzzles.

name: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 3
short_description: Two young girls must solve puzzles, avoid traps and overcome hellish enemies to find The Six Medallions and put an end to The Entity's reign, once and for all.

name: The Lies We Tell Ourselves
short_description: The Lies We Tell Ourselves is an episodic first person psychological action-adventure game with introspective/horror elements and a focus on subtle storytelling and atmosphere. Explore, solve puzzles, survive and uncover truths buried deep within a castle of lies.

name: Star Shift Freelancers
short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

name: Rickstones
short_description: Rickstones is a multiplayer (1 vs 2-8) horror game where one player becomes The Caretaker, while the other players are his student victims trying to escape the grounds or survive the night, in Rickstones School.

name: Jrago The Demon Hunter
short_description: Jrago The Demon Hunter is an indie METROIDVANIA style 2D Platforming Action-Adventure Role Playing Game. The world is overcome in darkness, and you are a hunter named Jrago on a quest to slay the demons and bring back the light!

name: Daemonum
short_description: Detective Andrews is called to a residence after a message is placed to dispatch regarding a disturbance. Not everything is as it seems, leaving you to question your own sanity whilst figuring out how to escape with your life.

name: Dreamland
short_description: Welcome to Dreamland! A town which hosts the wildest college spring break activities filled with hot girls, parties and sex. However, if you look close enough, you'll discover that Dreamland also hides a dark and horrifying mystery which haunts you and your friends...

name: My Holiness the Gobliness
short_description: After being transported to another world, the goblin shaman Anu takes you in as her servant. Tend to the lazy gobliness' every need... and strive to win her affection!

name: FlipScapes
short_description: Flip, bounce and roll through a Pinball Pachinko universe filled with playful characters. Pick your favorite hero and immerse yourself in arcade fun!

name: Gloomy Tales: Horrific Show Collector's Edition
short_description: A magical circus adventure with true disappearance! Watch the performance of a traveling circus and don't let your sister be hurt by the forces of evil!

name: Blobek
short_description: Speed ACTION! Excellent soundtrack! Fast JUMP! Disaster! RAMPAGE! ENERGY!

name: M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero
short_description: Grab a telestarion shotgun and meet Sir Culligan in fury mode! M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero is a classics-styilized shooter with a dark atmosphere, an engaging storyline and hordes of enemies to defeat.

name: Escape From Ithara
short_description: A one player first person escape room-like exploration game. Discover the Ithara temple and the secrets it hides! The temple is divided into 4 rooms with unique puzzles and thematic. Will you be able to escape?

name: Maid for Loving You
short_description: Average guy Yuuma suddenly finds his boring life becoming way more exciting when he encounters a mysterious woman named Eve. Join him as he discovers the joys of having a live-in maid in this heartwarming visual novel.

name: Ragnarok Begins
short_description: Introducing Ragnarok Begins! Reminiscent of the original Ragnarok Online Become the hero of an epic adventure set in a swift side-scroll MMORPG Here lies a fantasy world of mysterious monsters and epic characters. Explore legendary kingdoms and mythical dungeons in this open-world role-playing game!

name: Furry Arena [18+]
short_description: Furry Arena [18+] is a first-person multiplayer shooter, set in a future filled with sexy furries. In the game's primary competitive mode, players are arranged into two teams and compete on a variety of maps and game types.

name: Suffer The Night
short_description: SUFFER THE NIGHT is a first-person survival horror experience. Alone in a secluded cabin during a violent storm, horror illustrator Stacey Linden discovers the true meaning of fear. Explore a constantly changing world and solve puzzles; but above all: survive!

name: Road To Devadatta
short_description: Road to Devadatta is a first-person adventure game focused on story and puzzle solving to advance. Explore ancient ruins Use your wits to escape from them, solve their ingenious puzzles and avoid being killed by the creatures that inhabit them.

name: Tales of Fablecraft
short_description: Tales of Fablecraft is a virtual tabletop RPG. It’s easy for GMs and players to learn, whether you've slain many dragons or are completely new to the genre. Fablecraft features its own system, gorgeous human-made art, pre-built campaigns that eliminate prep, and a growing list of homebrew tools.

name: Flempire
short_description: Flempire is a mix of 1. person action shooting and RTS in a fantasy world. Switch between having the full overview of the entire battlefield, constructing buildings, controlling groups of units, or choose to be in the middle of it, become a rank-an-file unit or a hero with special abilities.

name: Trinity Trigger
short_description: Caught in the middle of a divine clash of epic proportions that has left gigantic weapons towering over the landscape, Cyan and newfound allies Elise and Zantis set out on a quest to save the world…and defy the gods. Claim your fate in this fantastical adventure inspired by classic JRPGs.

name: Walk While My Grandmother Plays The Piano
short_description: This is a simple game. All you do is walk, and my grandmother will play the piano. There's nothing else to it.

name: Reclaimers
short_description: In this single-player roguelike, control an army of RECLAIMERS through a dangerous procedurally generated world. Recruit troops, collect resources, and craft upgrades to advance your army to fight orcs, trolls, and more monsters. Defeat enemies in battle & fight the Orc King!

name: Kanji RPG
short_description: An RPG-lite game where you learn how to read Japanese by battling cute monsters! Track your progress by collecting stamps and unlock new areas as you go.

name: Daddy
short_description: Sabotage a cult and their schemes in this Mystery, Horror, FPS. Explore a mansion while massacring the creepy followers and their foul abominations. Find various weapons to slay your enemies with and uncover the cruel secrets of the organization.

name: Temple of Kasthet
short_description: Brian Teaser must escape from a mysterious Temple by solving mindblowing puzzles before they, well, blow his mind.

name: Main Event: Wrestling Manager
short_description: Main Event: Wrestling Manager is a wrestling booking simulator where you will hire and develop talent and staff, book matches, handle logistics and the media and much more in order to build your promotion into the best wrestling empire that has ever existed.

name: The Lost Village
short_description: It's a horror, first-person play game, and investigate the town and uncover the secret behind the town's abandonment. Also, you have to solve and overcome the puzzles created by the devil and the puzzles that require instantaneous agility with your crisis response skills.

name: SCP - The Sentient Box
short_description: Investigate the life of John Doe as he resides in his lost memories in this story-driven Alternate Reality Game (ARG) that merges Your Real Life with science fiction as it explores the Dark Limits of Alternate History and The SCP Foundation.

name: - Mischief Dungeon Life - 異世界転生した俺のイタズラダンジョンライフ　ClaraEdition
short_description: After an accident, Renji was reborn in another world as a "shapeshifter," a demon that can transform at will. He was reborn in a dungeon inhabited by demons… Using new demon powers, a thrilling and exciting life in the mischief dungeon begins…!

name: All of Us Are Dead...
short_description: All of us are not dead. Our school has been infested with zombies, and we are still alive. Every day, our hopes of escaping this school become less and less likely. Follow us as we try to survive and escape our zombie-filled school. A visual novel based on the popular webcomic.

name: Mission In Space
short_description: 2d space shooter game where need avoid and destroy enemies and big boss

name: Mantra
short_description: Mantra is a multiplayer (1-4 player) and single-player psychological-horror game with high tension. Do whatever it takes to save your soul that has been possessed by an demonic spirit. If you don't, demon will imprison you in hell for eternity.

name: TYKEN
short_description: This is an indie game made by a solo developer set in the very distant future. You are a condemned prisoner forced to destroy the monsters at a clandestine genetic research facility located on planet TYKEN. Use futuristic energy weapons in 10 unique environments.

name: Video Game Trivia
short_description: How well do you know your video game trivia? Challenge yourself or have a video game trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode. It comes with the most popular video game categories including Arcade, Atari, Nintendo, Personal Computer, PlayStation, SEGA, and Xbox!

name: Retro Racers
short_description: A Retro Style Classic Arcade Racing Game! Put the pedal to the metal while speeding by your opponents cars to unlock 12 exciting tracks. Collect the 4 classic power-ups along the way with Acceleration, Top Speed, Nitro Boosts and Traction. Return to your childhood in Retro Racers!

name: The Music Trivia Challenge
short_description: How well do you know your Music Trivia? Choose from the most popular music genres including the 1950’s, 1980’s, 1990’s, 2000’s, 2010’s, General, Foreign, Classical and Pop. Challenge your friends and family in Party Mode (Up to 4 Players).

name: UFO No!
short_description: What would you do in a UFO invasion? How about spacejack a UFO and use their technology against them! Use Space Age power-ups on these uninvited guests to show them who's boss. So go ahead and suck them into a black hole, or just nuke 'em to send them back to the Stone Age!

name: Vectoroids
short_description: Blast your way through waves of asteroids and UFOs in Classic Mode. Or play as a team with up to 4 Players in Co-Op Mode. Battle your Friends in Deathmatch and Last Man Standing on 5 different Battle Maps!

name: Martian Invaders
short_description: A New Retro Classic Space Shooter Arcade Game. Defend Earth from waves of martian invaders and flying saucers in this modern version of a space shooter. Go Back to the 1980’s and Blast these Martians Back into Outer Space!

name: The Sports Trivia Challenge
short_description: How well do you know your Sports Trivia? Choose from the most popular Sports including Baseball, Basketball, Football, Hockey, General, Olympics, Sports Records, Tennis, and the World Cup! Challenge your friends and family in Party Mode (Up to 4 Players).

name: Autumn with the Shiba Inu
short_description: Play as Quei-li the Labrador Retriever, a hacker dog! Uncover the secrets of the Shiba Inu government as an undercover hacker, in this mystery story full of twists and turns.

name: 山谷主
short_description: 《山谷主》is a casual 3D pinball shooting game. Player can be shuttled around the map. It incorporates RPG elements into traditional Zuma gameplay. You can use your wisdom in action. Refueling launch your charm...

name: Trigonometric Mash
short_description: Slide and jump over the procedurally generated maps. Avoid the red blocks, or hitting the edge of a white block. Fast and furious. Are your reactions quick enough?

name: Tokyo Necro
short_description: The Earth has plunged into an ice age, and the cities that survive have a new threat – Necromancers; those who reanimate corpses using inexplicable biotech. Now So'un and Ethica, two badass Living Dead Stalkers, must save Tokyo in this thrilling sci-fi visual novel!

name: Princess Dating Sim
short_description: Princess Dating Sim is an non-linear visual novel where you court multiple princesses at the same time. You'll need to woo them, and see what their tastes are before you can pick a partner to marry!

name: Corruption Ranch
short_description: Corruption Ranch is a little game about a woman who can't stop fucking her monsters. Monster Breeding, Pregnancy, Corruption, Ranch Upgrades, Bad Endings; Become a champion monster rancher without succumbing to the new environment you find yourself in.

name: Diffraction
short_description: A quiet coming-of-age story about how photography changed the lives of three people in a rainy small town and the paths in life they took with it.

name: Paper Needs Inspiration!
short_description: Stay alive! Don't die in this lavish, unearthly Garden! Let life Inspire you!

name: Dead Trip: Hope
short_description: Take part in the adventures of Lars and Jessica in a world of death and chaos. Surviving among the crowds of zombies in search of supplies and fuel in order to pursue the last hope of saving humanity and defeating the virus.

name: The Slothgate Experiment
short_description: The Creature Zone Returns In An Unexpected Way… The Slothgate Experiment is a physics-heavy vr game that takes place in Los Angeles, California, where Oliver Franklin has recently moved into an apartment. He is captured and taken to slothgate two weeks after he gets a job at a warehouse.

name: OSAWARI HOCKEY えんこちゃん
short_description: Hit the ball and make the girl feel goodIt's a game where you play a ball like air hockey and hit a girl to enjoy her reaction.Hit the part where the girl feels and fill the sensitivity gauge to move to the next scene.

name: CHAQS
short_description: CHAQS is an instructive CTF (Capture The Flag) game that performs the basic functions of an operating system. While it meets your expectations from an operating system to a certain extent with the applications it contains, CHAQS progresses in the direction of more challenges in terms of gameplay.

name: Fairy Card Rogue
short_description: A single-player deck-building roguelite. Lily White picks her favorite cards... and charges in to raid the card market?! No two runs will ever be the same. Keep trying over and over again, until you finally reach the card master!

name: UNDERTUNNEL
short_description: Leaving a dystopian metropolis behind, a strange & dangerous journey lies ahead. You must venture into the depths of the sprawling NEO-INDUSTRIAL tunnels below. Weirdos, Gangs, Mutants, Machines, Traps, Humour & More await, as you make your way through... UNDERTUNNEL

name: Talent Club ~ Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: Defeat the head of the club with a match-3 game!

name: SUKUR
short_description: ŞÜKÜR, It is a horror-thriller game with a first-person story. From the moment you enter the game, you will feel that you are alone in the forest and you will try every way to escape.

name: For Your Tranquility
short_description: It's a mystery game that reveals the truth through an autopsy. Be a forensic doctor and find out why the dead died.

name: Keystone Library
short_description: Enter a living library where each book is a new adventure. Solve puzzles, complete RPG quests, battle foes, and upgrade your library. Use a unique keyword interface to interact with characters and stories. Frequent updates bring new books, genres, and challenges to explore.

name: ROOT
short_description: The is a beautiful and huge RPG game that tells the story of a human being on a mission to return to the past and prevent war in order to save a world ravaged by war. However, other races try to interfere with the journey, and in the process, humans face numerous dangers and surprising truths

name: Survival Shot
short_description: SURVIVAL SHOT designed for VR, Zombie apocalypse set for lone survivors. Uncover a sinister plan that takes survivors through Bridge/Town survival & Zombie Run. Be ready to cast undead into hell. Armed weapons with real-life movements to explore a post apocalyptic world in VR.

name: DobbyxEscape: Halloween Adventure
short_description: A fun Halloween inspired Room Escape game!

name: Onmyoji：the card game
short_description: Onmyoji: The Card Game is an exquisite Japanese-style duel card game. as a youkai, choose 4 from more than 120 different Shikigami and build your own deck, power-up your Shikigami during the combat, and enjoy a fair and thrilling duel with brand-new original rules.

name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
short_description: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

name: Supercrab extravaganza
short_description: You play as Crabby the crab, Wielding your claws and magical pearls travel towards the depths of the ocean and save the world in this Metroidvania platformer. Game still early in development!

name: Zabawa Karaoke
short_description: Zabawa KARAOKE​ śpiewaj i baw się śpiewając znane przeboje! Darmowa wersja zawiera trzy piosenki. Paczki z innymi piosenkami dostępne są jako dodatki (DLC) do aplikacji. Karaoke to rewelacyjna zabawa muzyczna dla każdego! Świetna na imprezę i spotkanie z przyjaciółmi.​

name: The Keeper's Book
short_description: Join a young hero in his journey through a magical world filled with wonders and perils, and help him reveal the mystery that lies between the pages of the Keeper’s Book. Explore, craft and fight in this brand new indie adventure.

name: OUTSTAND
short_description: OUTSTAND is a game that reflects the real face of dark and intense fear to the person from a first-person camera angle. Your treasure-seeking friend is trapped! Can you save him? Solve puzzles, watch out for the items around you and most importantly survive!

name: Urban Night Battle Girl
short_description: As night falls, Yinzhi encounters a major setback in her mission to protect the peace of the city. It was at this time that Yinzhi met you, but to her, would you be the angel of salvation or the messenger of hell?

name: Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes (GOLD Edition)
short_description: - World first to achieve a successful serverless online gaming feature by utilizing Locus Chain Blockchain technology - RPG game mode with multi-play capability - Unique RTS/RPG Hybrid

name: Stormbane
short_description: A third person medieval multiplayer RPG where you create your own legend, the story is unwritten, your destination is unknown, 50 gold in your pocket, a sword, and the wild lands in front.

name: Bar Simulator
short_description: Create a real oasis in the Arizona desert and be forever marked with golden letters in the history of fried chicken! Develop your own recipes that will make your coatings stand out from the competition, as well as provide efficient guest service, by which you will ensure their constant flow!

name: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline
short_description: Mega Man X DiVE reimagined the world of the Mega Man X series, and now it's getting an offline version! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of "what-if" worlds in Mega Man X!

name: Osminog Adventures - The Lost Island
short_description: Dive into the fantastical world of Karawark and accompany the Pirate Crew of The Osminog on an adventure they were not prepared for.

name: Hotel Galactic
short_description: Hotel Galactic combines cozy management with a heartfelt tale. Build and decorate your dream tourist getaway, aid Gustav in his search for redemption, and explore a nostalgic world where bonds with creatures and serene gardens sustain a thriving colony.

name: Sushi Bar Express
short_description: Experience the dizzying life of a top sushi chef as you prepare sushi dishes in this exciting time-management cooking adventure.

name: Tasty Slot Machine
short_description: Tasty Slot Machine is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

name: Celebrity Slot Machine
short_description: Celebrity Slot Machine is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

name: Lucky Slots
short_description: Lucky Slot is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

name: The Gravehouse
short_description: Take on the role of a defenseless man in this survival-horror game and experience frightening evil firsthand: A trap leads you straight into a gloomy mansion where gruesome things are going on. A creepy life and death adventure begins that will take you to dark cellars, jails and even worse places..

name: Orestorm Factory
short_description: Orestorm Factory is a BulletHell Roguelike where you build a factory of drills and processors to loot a cave, while dodging your way past enemies and your own deadly machinery along the way.

name: PigShip and the Giant Wolf
short_description: Pig Ship and the Giant Wolf is a classic Shoot'em Up with a 8btis monochrome aesthetic. Cross the 6 worlds full of enemies and defeat the Giant Wolf to save your brothers.

name: KICK MASTER
short_description: In this game the player will have to use 5 keys, 4 of which must be pressed one at a time, as soon as the blue ball is in the place corresponding to the key and then press the enter key, done that the sphere should disappear and then the character will kick the object in front of you.

name: ARCADE VS PLAYER
short_description: For a long time the arcade machines were won and forgotten in the corners of bars, but the time for the arcade machines revenge has arrived. prepare your coins.

name: Bad-Draw
short_description: This game is in the type of 2D platformer. It's about the revenge of a character made of drawings.

name: Actua Golf
short_description: In this classic golf simulation game from 1996, test your golfing skills on two challenging 18-hole courses, across a variety of game modes such as foursome, four ball challenge, and skins. Customize your golfer and lead them up through amateur and pro ranks.

name: ノロワレサイクル
short_description: Mayuhara City, Tokyo. The wounds of the mass suicide event of Mayuhara Academy from eight years ago have finally begun to heal. The rumors of the “Mayuhara Curse” are still whispered amongst the students.

name: SU!
short_description: Use realistic swinging mechanics and climbing to scale an endless tower while drone things try to stop you. Either race to set a new high point with Time Trial or climb peacefully in Endless.

name: The Witch's House
short_description: There is an old house on the edge of a small town. All the locals have always avoided it, as strange and mysterious events constantly happen there. This time, what happened in this house made the whole city shudder with fear.

name: DIMENSIONLESS
short_description: Dive into this platformer taking up the classics of the genre, bringing its unique touch where you will have to change color between black and white and vice versa to move forward!

name: Leak
short_description: Leak is a psychological horror game. Except when you return home your family are missing, and there is a corpse of an unknown man hanging from a ceiling in your study. Explore the house and the area, solve riddles and hide from monsters, for saving your family. Be careful - you are being watched.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
short_description: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

name: Trap Yuri Garden
short_description: Traps in motion at long last! Trap series creators Aogiri Penta and Nishida Hajime bring us another exciting title, a cross-dressing yuri love story that will shatter its readers sense of values into a thousand pieces!

name: Cat Herders: Couch Coop Cat Corralling!
short_description: Herd a bunch of adorable cats in this chaotic 1-4 player, split-screen coop game. Herd the cats on each unique level into the goal as quickly as possible using a variety of zany items! Team up with your friends, compete for the best times, and shout at them for their silly strats!

name: Perfect Inventory - Organization Puzzle
short_description: Perfect Inventory is an organization puzzle game that brings you to a medieval age in the role of a methodical squire trying to make his best to fit all the items perfectly into the inventory.

name: Singularity - 奇异岛
short_description: You are lost in the sea while driving a fishing boat, encountering severe thunderstorms and stranded on a remote island filled with strange things and monsters. You need to survive on the island and fight against unknown monsters to uncover the unknown side of the island.

name: Christmas Wonderland 7
short_description: Santa’s Awesome Adventure in Wonderland Christmas Wonderland is crammed full of fabulous Presents and Hidden Surprises with lots of Gorgeous Graphics and Puzzles for ALL the Family to enjoy. Find Golden Trees, get Game Rewards and Achievements along the way.

name: Star Leaping Story
short_description: Players will help a white-robed girl and her friends uncover the truth of the planet using unique dash gameplay. The storyline is fully voiced by renowned actors, with meticulously designed levels and energetic music for you to enjoy!

name: LIFTED
short_description: Get LIFTED! Play as slacker Ari, unwillingly starring in his professor’s deeply personal, HILARIOUS era-hopping tiara heist. Swing, climb, puzzle through time & outsmart a rival tomb-raider – an ’80s blockbuster adventure!

name: Noslrac
short_description: A casual dungeon crawler ARPG with 4 unique classes with differing playstyles. Choose your conqueror, level up, slay monsters, complete campaigns, conqueror the darkest dungeons, obtain powerful items, and craft the ultimate items to cleanse Banglesway of corruption.

name: Hljod
