short_description: Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony!

name: Lured
short_description: Lured is a 3-player co-op puzzle adventure set in the depths of a forgotten temple's ruins. Communicate, navigate treacherous traps, and unravel intricate puzzles to reveal the hidden truths that lie beneath...

name: Alpha Terminus
short_description: Your clan plays an important role in the new galactic war. The fate of your mutant clan rests in the hands of you and your fellow fighter pilots...

name: Echo of the Last Light
short_description: The worlds of light and dark are in danger. Will the creatures of the light be the key to saving your homeland in the dark? Journey with your new companion to discover how you can save the world while fending off those who would harm you and your companion.

name: STARWEAVE
short_description: Who the stars dictate we’ll be. Set out on your destined quest in this narrative RPG with turn-based tactics. Issue commands, light Beacons, exercise compassion. Take heed, for your roles shall constrict, and your tale was always meant to be bittersweet.

name: YAMC - Yet Another Minesweeper Client
short_description: Yet Another Minesweeper Client is here to evoke pure apathy from onlookers! Come play the newest reimagining of that game that comes with most operating systems.

name: Enchanted in the Moonlight - Miyabi, Kyoga & Samon -
short_description: You’re an average 25-year-old girl, working at the library to make ends meet and support your family’s shrine. However, that all changes when handsome men save you from malevolent spirits! It turns out, though, your saviors are more than they appear… They’re Ayakashi Spirits, too.

name: [Chilla's Art] The Karaoke | ヒトカラ🎤
short_description: The Karaoke | ヒトカラ is a Japanese horror game about a high school girl at a Karaoke.

name: VR Pekin Royal Palace
short_description: Based on 3D and VR technology, simulation restores the Royal Palace, allowing you to experience the beauty of ancient oriental architecture.

name: CursedSword
short_description: Slide into mystery in this Sokoban-style puzzle game! Your attack grows with each move as you bash into monsters, traps, and obstacles to solve snappy puzzles. Face bosses in turn-based battles, find treasures, and unlock power-ups in your quest to break the curse and avenge your hometown.

name: VR Pterosaur
short_description: This is an exciting VR shooting leisure game. You can drive a dragon, avoid the attack of the Raptors while using the attack weapon wave to fight back. Protecting your egg is your ultimate goal. Come on to win the game!

name: VR Dinosaur Invasion
short_description: This is a VR shooting game. When a behemoth appears in your town, it is wanting to destroy your homeland as a brave guard, how can you let it no matter?

name: Millie and Molly
short_description: Millie and Molly is a retro-inspired puzzle platformer that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Can you guide our fearless heroines through 100 themed levels to defeat the malicious monsters that stand in their way?

name: Velocity Rift
short_description: Velocity Rift is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you shoot orbs to defeat enemies and save the world. The number of orbs is limited and shooting enemies at their weak spots return the orbs faster. Also, the faster you move, the slower the world becomes, so always be on the move!

name: Ghost Member
short_description: 【Ghost Member】is a single-player ghost investigation horror adventure game. You investigate ghosts in a house where a member of the occult research club who went missing was investigating. The story progresses by using multiple items to find traces left by the ghost and identify the type of ghost.

name: Project: Nightlight
short_description: Project: Nightlight is a VR survival horror game with a focus on immersive atmospheres. To survive the night you will need to solve puzzles and face the unseen horrors in the dark by using your wits and what little resources you can find. Will you bring back order or succumb to the chaos?

name: To the Grave
short_description: TO THE GRAVE is a horror comedy puzzle game that you have never experienced before! A girl accidentally breaks into a mysterious village. You will face all kinds of funny monster and nonsensical ways of death, making you laugh out loud, but also making you shudder.

name: Trap of MUSK:Asia Night
short_description: The target of the mission, who is in pursuit of the poignant love with the heroine of Legend of the White Snake. And the client, who is a real flirt. One is calm and never doubts others, while the other is kind and nice to everyone. Who is it that indulges in the game of pampering--?

name: Trap of MUSK:Arabia Night
short_description: He, a serious-minded young king. And he, who grew up with you and followed behind you.When memories begin to come back and the real begins to unfold. The person in front of you is not the person in front of you. Who is it that indulges in the masquerade of complicity--?

name: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin'
short_description: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin' is a fast-paced FPS inspired by both retro and modern FPS games. Fingerbang combines elements from each in order to create a mix of its own, with a scoring system added on top to gauge your performance through the different levels.

name: My Little Miniatures
short_description: My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds!

name: Aohri's Uprising
short_description: Embark on an adventure, driven by vengeance, to hunt down your former god and put an end to his reign to restore balance to the world!

name: Tales from Candleforth
short_description: Tales from Candleforth is a folk horror 2D point and click game with puzzles and escape room mechanics, that narrates the fairy tales from the village. The text contained in this ancient and evil book is now bleeding out, mixing the world of nightmares with the real one through handmade 2D graphics.

name: 13 Candles
short_description: 13 Candles is an atmospheric horror game where you play as Sara, 13 year old girl who wakes up in an abandoned hospital. Find your way to the light switch and wake up from your nightmare.

name: 奇雞快打
short_description: A typing game for children designed to improve typing speed and accuracy in Chinese and English. It includes an idiom dictionary and learning mode to help kids learn idioms easily. Players earn coins during practice, which can be used to unlock and play fun mini-games, enhancing learning motivation.

name: Ok I Pull Up
short_description: Ok I Pull Up is a rage platformer, in which you, a capybara, ascend a tree tower only by jumping. This punishing, yet fair game requires extreme patience to complete.

name: ChessBase 17 Steam Edition
short_description: ChessBase is a personal, stand-alone chess database that has become the standard throughout the world. Everyone uses ChessBase, from the World Champion to the amateur next door. It is the program of choice for anyone who loves the game and wants to know more about it.

name: パズルバトラー！みらい Playtest
N₂O
short_description: Pilot your customized craft across 30 psychedelic tubular levels of adrenaline-pumping action, fighting a constant stream of terrifying insectoid aliens trying to stop you in your tracks, all set to a soundtrack by The Crystal Method. Features a 2-player local coop mode.

name: Pocky & Rocky Reshrined
short_description: The original cute and hardcore shrine maiden shooter is now available on Steam! Completely new game, a sequel to the home original "Pocky&Rocky" (Super Nintendo Entertainment System)! The adventures of Pocky&Rocky begin once again.

name: Cowboys & Zombies VR
short_description: Designed for Pico 4, Oculus Meta Quest 2, Valve, Pimax, HTC and Quest Pro PC-VR, Hands Tracking Mode. Cowboys and Zombies... What can go wrong? Prove that you are the fastest gunslinger in the old west by literally shooting with your bare hands. You have to be quick or the zombies will eat you...

name: Fall Dice
short_description: One dice, one rule: Move the dice to match the number at the bottom of the dice with the Blue Tiles' digits.

name: Shopping Center Tycoon
short_description: Shopping Center Tycoon Is : Market Simulation & Tycoon and Improve your market. Grow, Design and Manage your Shopping Center with the right Strategy.

name: Forge of Destiny
short_description: «Forge of Destiny» is the first Spanish RPG to combat disinformation through a steampunk dystopia. Create your character, travel through the Node-capital and venture into the ruins of the forgotten world. Live a unique experience of classic style in which discerning the truth will be a challenge.

name: TuHou Remilia - Begin Of Scarlet Family
short_description: Play as a powerful vampire and make your family stronger by doing the work of your men!

name: The Bogtavern
short_description: Escape the shady brackwater swamp together with the Professor and the Captn in a small Cutter, in a short, text-heavy, linear Horror-Adventure (without Jumpscares).

name: Anime Hunter
short_description: Anime girls versus crazy hunter! Hit girls with dildos to steal their underwear. Crazy, insane, incredible game!

name: My Dream Setup
short_description: My Dream Setup is a simulation game about building the room you've always dreamed of. A huge selection of furniture, computers and their accessories, posters, pictures, plants, and other interior details await you. Try all of them and create your dream setup.

name: Rootless: Memories Of Green - Chapter 1
short_description: The story follows a robot girl named Zoe in a futuristic world. She wakes up in a laboratory, alone with no memory. Zoe goes on a journey to discover her past and protect the last hope for the planet. The adventure explores philosophical themes of self-discovery, and a tree.

name: Thematic Solitaire: Noir
short_description: Thematic Solitaire is a series of classic solitaire games (Klondike) with different settings depending on the style. In the Noir edition, sit back and relax while playing Solitaire with a noir atmosphere, listening to great jazz on a rainy night.

name: ZAHAK
short_description: ZAHAK is a roguelike action RPG survivors game set in the captivating world of Persian mythology. Battle relentless waves of enemies and navigate the magical landscapes of Mount Damavand. Unleash the ancient power within your cursed bloodline to challenge the dark legacy of the Serpent King.

name: The Ranger: A Skyhopper Tale
short_description: Hunt down and kill twisted woodland creatures in this roguelite focused purely on the tactical side of combat. No gear, no min-maxing, just you and a ton of enemies. Each boss you defeat earns you an ability sapped from them.

name: Pigeon
short_description: Pigeon is an action adventure in the original universe. Immerse yourself in a deep and interesting story. Playing as Richard, set out to save the village from the hordes of creatures that have been trapped for centuries in the bowels of the earth.

name: Bebok Invasion
short_description: Fight back against a chaotic alien invasion in this fast-paced retro shooter! Blast through 54 levels, master wall-jumps and dash moves, and take down the mischievous beboks before they overrun the planet.

name: Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant
short_description: Third-person 3D Action RPG with Dungeon Crawler sections. Revive your enemies once again and make them fight alongside you! With a new battle and companion system, travel the continent, restore the sacred city of Euda to its former glory and defeat the ominous threat that looms over the world.

name: Trigger Fever
short_description: Engage in chaotic multiplayer battles in Trigger Fever, a top-down shooter party game. Crush foes solo or with friends, wielding 50+ unique weapons. Show off skills, tactically dominate, and embrace the crazy onslaught!

name: Dodge Barrage
short_description: Dodge Barrage is a chaotic dodgeball party game. Use quick reflexes and aggressive plays to throw, dodge, and parry your way to victory. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

name: The Plane Game
short_description: You are the pilot of a fighter jet in a battle in the middle of the ocean. At the beginning of each game, you and your friends will split up into teams of 1-6 people. You will work with the others on your team to win the game. This is a digital simultaneous turn-based board game.

name: Camelot 2: The Holy Grail
short_description: A terrible disease has struck Queen Guinevere! The only thing that can save her is the Holy Grail. But the ancient artefact has long been lost somewhere in the expanses of Avalon. Can you manage to overcome all obstacles, find the Grail, and save the queen?

name: IN CELL
short_description: IN CELL is a kinetic visual novel (linear, no choices) about the epidemic of sexless, nationless, and friendless men. Gender dynamics are currently not functional, sustainable, or beneficial to either men or women. IN CELL is uncensored conversation between the sexes.

name: Phylakterion
short_description: Phylakterion is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game in which you’ll enter different locations in search of a possessed vessel. Search, Identify, and Destroy the vessel and the entity inhabiting it – before the entity finds YOU!

name: Sotidrokhima
short_description: Sotidrokhima is a story-driven top-down hack-and-slash game with first-person elements. Set in mid-13th century Finland, the eponymous folk hero must rise against oppressors from across the sea to save his people, while dealing with a personal vendetta as well as his own mysterious heritage.

name: Distributor Simulator
short_description: Distributor simulator is open world, third person game. Here you have to buy goods al lowest possible price and sell and deliver it to shops for higher price. Price is changing so buy and sell carefully, otherwise you will bankrupt.

name: Eve of Calamity
short_description: Prevent a world-ending Calamity your way! A player-driven old-school RPG inspired by both the Japanese and western classics of the 80s and 90s.

name: Freddy Frog 2
short_description: Freddy Frog is on a mission to be the highest frog in the world. This frog just wants to keep jumping and you need to guide his hopping legs onto the next available platform. Be careful. These platforms are not what they seem and a fall from a great height is not good for Freddy Frog.

name: Christmas Wonderland 13
short_description: Santa’s Magical Christmas Wonderland Adventure for All the Family to Enjoy! Enjoy magnificent Holiday Festivities in Springfield. Help Santa at the North Pole.

name: Factoryopolis
short_description: Build and run a car factory to design, produce and sell high-quality cars, while expanding your business. Manage resources, research new technologies, and meet market demand. As the factory grows, you can hire more employees and unlock new features.

name: Futanari Sex - Locker Room Affair
short_description: An erotic visual novel about two gorgeous cheerleaders after a day of practice. Everything takes a turn when the secretly futanari starts taking pictures of her naked teammate.

name: Cursor Engine
short_description: Tired of the traditional boring cursor? Use Cursor Engine to customize your cursor with any PNG images or stunning interactive animated VFX and share them on the Steam Workshop!

name: Belial Red
short_description: When her hometown is invaded, Sheryl is apprehended and taken in. She resorts to proving her proficiency with a sword and her worth as a leader, allowing her to join the enemy army. Will she remain loyal or find a way to fight back and regain her freedom?

name: Sex Adventures - The Naughty Maid
short_description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of a very naughty maid who shamelessly interrupts the romantic evening of a vacationing couple. She refuses to sell her uniform, but makes an offer to join in their fun.

name: Fiend Heart
short_description: A difficult short game about monster girls.

name: Date Everything!
short_description: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

name: Crossroads: Escaping the Dark Collector's Edition
short_description: A visit to Crossroads becomes a digital nightmare for a gamer struggling with a host of trauma-induced phobias!

name: Palladise Island：Legendary Space
short_description: Palladise Island: Legendary Space It tells the story of the game master in the real world, who is transmitted to another world called Palladise because of his superb game technology, and then starts the journey to save the Palladise.

name: Lust Colony
short_description: Follow Sophie’s adventures when she gets mistaken for another person and lands a job as colony manager in a paradisiac planet. Will she be able to live up to expectations or find someone special on this planet?

name: laf the game
short_description: Survive, explore, live the life of your favorite furry animal.

name: Remnant Protocol
short_description: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

name: No Name Village
short_description: No Name Village is a top-down adventure rpg game, set in a peaceful village on the brink of being swallowed by the Black Sea. Play as a young boy, explore the world, battle monsters, and uncover the secrets behind the looming disaster.

name: Guilt
short_description: A beautiful first-person narrative short story set after your death. Immerse yourself in a mind-blowing world as you face a traumatic event from your past.

name: Alone in the Outback
short_description: Alone in the Outback is a story-driven survival experience. Traverse through the Australian outback, survive deadly heat of the day and cold of the night. Stay hydrated and choose your strategy to survive the dangerous Australian wildlife. Explore the territory to find out why you are here alone...

name: Freak Show: Party Game!
short_description: Challenge your friends in this bloody party game for up to 6 players! Pick your freak and add your own punishments which the game will hand out based on performance after each mini game. Simple to play and a perfect game for any party!

name: Tokyo Pinball
short_description: A game designed to introduce the fun of pinball. Whether you have never played pinball before or not, I hope you will enjoy playing it!

name: The Cursewood
short_description: A fantastical action-adventure game. Explore the forest, craft dozens of unique potions, and survive the dangers of the night!

name: The Unforeseen Resurrection - Otome Isekai RPG
short_description: A 3D open-world farming RPG with life-sim elements and otome isekai themes. It is set in a fantastical modern world, where computer games bleed into reality and digitized beasts lurk, you wield a unique power: time travel with a hefty price tag.

name: Star-Crosst
short_description: Earth has just survived a decade of war against an invading alien species, and the younger generation has been given an opportunity to restart their lives. Explore a deep, immersive character study set in a futuristic world about relationships, our purpose in life and the paths we make for ourselves

name: Steel Revenant
short_description: Restart and complete the training simulation for CotS-Model 75 in timeless environments against challenging preternatural beings in this melee action adventure.

name: Canterz Paranormies 2
short_description: Canterz Paranormies 2 is a 2D Top Down survival horror game based on the story of the most renowned paranormal investigation team of the US, Canterz Paranormies, who have received a request to investigate the Kentucky house located in the vicinity of the cemetery.

name: Cloud House - Virtual Arts Space
short_description: Cloud House is a revival of a physical location of a performing arts space, Centre 42 within the digital realm, featuring a single-player experience titled 'Love Letters to 42'.

name: Keepers of the Forest
short_description: Keepers of the Forest is a 2 player deck building game that can be played alone against the computer or by two local players. Starting with the same 10 cards, buy from one deck to build your own deck & try to deal enough damage to defeat your opponent. 1st to bring their opponent to 0 health wins!

name: 與魔共舞
short_description: Dance with Devils is a romance visual novel. To be a human or a devil? A young girl's ordinary life is gradually distorted by the sweet temptations and lies of the devil. Make a different choice from the animation and follow different endings with the devils.

name: Yōkaimaki
short_description: The blood moon has risen once again, meaning the yōkai (cryptids) have emerged from the murky depths of the sea. As the heir to the family restaurant, use your fishing and cooking skills to serve up some delicious yōkai sushi!

name: 下山的试炼之江湖遗失录 A test before Jianghu
short_description: It's a story about the mountains before we came to Jianghu You can play a boy or a girl, figure out your identity, collect G's, and win the test

name: Myasoid
short_description: Myasoid - This is an arena shooter about a huge worm that protects this planet from the invasion of dangerous alien ships.

name: My Soul Forever
short_description: My Soul Forever is a 2D puzzle game about a knight who could control his ghost spirit.

name: Nanali in another world
short_description: Nanali in another world is an engaging puzzle-platformer where players must explore two dimensions and solve complex challenges using the unique abilities of the main character.

name: Social Credit Simulator
short_description: In Social Credit Simulator, you make life-altering decisions by assigning social credit scores based on people’s actions and status. Satirizing real-world social rating systems, your choices determine your survival in a dystopian regime.

name: Stolen Dolls
short_description: Stolen Dolls is a 2D platform game in which the girl with the gun must collect her toy dolls.

name: Tiny Onion Knight
short_description: Tiny Onion Knight is an action-platformer about a little onion knight who travels through a mystical forest.

name: Power Driver
short_description: Power Driver is an arcade racing game where you will have to not only try to overtake your opponent, but also literally fight for your life on the race track.

name: My Darkest Witch
short_description: My Darkest Witch is a survival arena where you, as a mage of the Order of Light, fight against hordes of heretical monsters, trying to cleanse the land from the plague.

name: Fallen Stars
short_description: Fallen Stars is the story of a astronaut called Thomas Jackson who travel to I.C.E.S 1 space station to perform several duties along side with his crewmates. They worked together to perform several duties on the space station. During their journey back earth, unexpected things happen to them.

name: No Fly Drone
short_description: Take on the role of commander and protect Earth from the relentless Drone invasion in this exciting tower defense game. Strategize and strengthen your defenses by utilizing a variety of towers, abilities, and elemental upgrades. It's up to you to lead the charge and save humanity from destruction.

name: Fish Bone
short_description: As you land on a planet engulfed by oceans, you must explore this treacherous water world and try to survive. Take on missions from the underworld or loot islands you encounter. How you survive will depend on how you play.

name: Black Dragon Mage
short_description: The Hall of Relics calls out to you, traveler! Unleash elemental magic, slay demon hordes, and absorb their souls to grow in power. Hatch your very own companion dragon from an egg. Fly your dragon into battle. Avenge your death. An action-roguelite survivors shooter.

name: Battle Titan RAINBOW
short_description: Don't dodge the bullets, break through them! A new concept in Shm-up_RPG “Battle Titan RAINBOW”!

name: Pararecords
short_description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

name: LOK Digital
short_description: Learn a cryptic language of world-changing words and master their mind-bending effects. Embark on your charming puzzle-solving journey to help the LOK creatures thrive.

name: Assassinvisible
short_description: A cute bite-sized puzzle and stealth game that takes place in the margins of a bored pupil' notebook. You're an invisible assassin, sneak your way past the guards to reach your target and erase it!

name: Gods Against Machines
short_description: Your world is under attack by a ruthless race of machines, and you are its only hope. Cast epic spells, summon minions or buildings, and destroy the enemy before they conquer your home in this action roguelite strategy game!

name: HELLCARD: Prologue
short_description: HELLCARD: Prologue lets you try the main game's Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own, recruit computer-controlled companions or join other gamers in fast-paced tactical card battles against the armies of darkness and the Archdemon himself!

name: Factory Town Idle
short_description: An entire town builder experience packed into a living spreadsheet. Build housing, assign workers, then craft and sell a huge variety of items to level up your town and expand your civilization across the world!

name: Covenant: Project Zero
short_description: Covenant: Project Zero is a space opera set in a universe where interstellar corporations and big money interests run everything. Embark on an action-packed adventure as Captain John Covenant, accompanied by a band of rag-tag misfits, to confront the dark evil lurking in the universe.

name: MIND CORRIDORS: Paroniria
short_description: A fever-dream-like puzzle horror game. Descend to the depths of a sleeping curse, survive every floor and find your way out of the never ending nightmare.

name: Pages of Time: Prologue
short_description: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.

name: Infected Chronicles: Surviving the Zombie Apocalypse
short_description: The world awakened in hysteria - a severe infection has spread, zombifying people. Panic is everywhere and all you have to do - is to survive and find people who survived too. You have to fight your way through crowds of zombies and find the refugees who managed to escape.

name: TROJAN
short_description: Trojan is a stealth game in which you have to extract a file from a damaged system. Sneak through the levels and avoid enemy attacks to get the file and finish the level.

name: Lost August
short_description: Lost August is a single-player open-world walking simulator game based on the concept of liminal spaces and the backrooms. Experience a dream-like world through the lens of a VHS camera as you explore the contents of a recently discovered video tape.

name: Exorcist 2: Crow Magic
short_description: Are you ready to witness the adventure of the Exorcist, a master of magic and exorcism, and exorcise the most powerful dark being, the crow demon?

name: Strix STG
short_description: "Strix STG" is a "Communication-Synchronized Bullet-Hell Casual Vertical-Scrolling Shooting-Game". Let's aim to capture all 5 stages. The best feature of this game is the ability to play two-player co-op online. A simple chat using two types of fixed phrases is prepared for role sharing.

name: Beat the Heat
short_description: You have 10 years to make your territory sustainable or it won't survive the great heat of the future. Reap your harvest, solve typical problems of the zone and reinvest in the land in a strategic way to create conscience in your people about the necessary changes for their survival.

name: Fellowship of the Oak
short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

name: The Unfound Soul
short_description: Unlock the ultimate power as you combine artifacts to create even more powerful ones in this turn-based roguelike adventure. Collect over 1000 weapons, armor pieces, and artifacts as you vanquish your foes and rise to the top as the ultimate soul.

name: Little Circuit
short_description: Click to place components to create anything from a piano to a computer in a virtual sandbox environment.

name: Super Beast Hunt
short_description: A crazy platformer about a hungry demon girl who wants to eat lots of meat!

name: Bewells
short_description: Bewells is not exactly a classic three in a row game. You don't have to stack three identical stones in a row, but on the contrary, remove obstructing stones so that the stones that fall as a result form a horizontal or vertical row of identical stones.

name: Hard Survivor
short_description: Hard Survivor - An unusual adventure inspired by classic games from the NES console welcomes you! Explore numerous levels and collect all the coins on your way to victory!

name: Relaxjong
short_description: Relaxjong - Especially for fans of pleasant logic games that do not require haste, relaxjong was created!

name: Extreme Tag!
short_description: Extreme Tag! is a casual party game for all! Run from tagged players to stay alive. Last one standing wins!

name: Kovari Legends: Emergence
short_description: Return to the nostalgic golden age of RPGs in Kovari Legends where finding magical Firanite and mastering Sword Techniques is as important as exploring the massive gameworld, solving puzzles, and collecting and combining items.

name: Mihirha's Legacy
short_description: A science fantasy Pixel Novel with arcade puzzles in isometric perspective.

name: The Work of Your Hands
short_description: The Work of Your Hands is a small-scale, deep, and relaxing open-world survival crafting game. You have no crafting screen or list of items. Harvest raw materials, create tools from them, build practical structures, and grow delicious food. You are in control of every step to live off the land.

name: Super Uriel
short_description: Keep one eye open! Super Uriel is back, and he is on a mission to defeat the Greedy Slime Monsters once and for all. Casually play and/or speedrun through 30 action packed levels. This video game is an exciting mix of platform and rpg. Prepare for ultimate game-play glory!

name: Unsure
short_description: UNSURE is an asymmetric horror game where players take on the role of survivor or demon. Survivors, trapped in an asylum, must evade one of many possible killers whilst searching for keys hidden on the map. The keys provide their freedom, but one of the keys is faulty, a trap set by the cultists.

name: Missing Code
short_description: A man wakes up in an unknown office and doesn't know where to go. Discover the mysteries in this 2D Puzzle-Platform Game, with a tense ambiance and dark atmosphere.

name: Kayak League
short_description: Kayak League: Rocket-powered kayaks, stylized courses, and easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay. Climb the time-trials leaderboard, play minigames and compete in 20+ player tournaments with various game modes like first-to-finish, demolition arena and crystal collection.

name: Interior Worlds
short_description: Snap your own homemade liminal space photos using a mysterious SLR camera as you explore a variety of empty, strange, and familiar spaces.

name: House of Ghosts
short_description: House of ghosts is a single-player horror survival game. Stop the demon and find out the name of his victim before he drags you to hell. Run and hide. Just don't get caught.

name: Creator - [deep.sleeper] Saga
short_description: Journey into the world of Creator, where ancient secrets lie beneath neon-lit cities and mechanical titans roam alongside monsters. In Creator - [deep.sleeper] Saga, forge your path as Sonder Moor through three interconnected volumes of discovery and destiny.

name: Ranger Quest: The Adventure Begins
short_description: The adventure begins by navigating your way through the Sanctuary of the Orbs. A mysterious quest, the elemental orbs lying in wait for the ranger to claim and an ancient map to be remade. The Sanctuary of the Orbs is no ordinary building as the corridors twist and turn like a maze.

name: GeoJelly
short_description: GeoJelly is a platformer where you are limited to jumping to escape the laboratory. You'll face the challenge of accurately measuring your jumps to land where you intend to... given you endure the difficulty of the test chambers. To unlock levels you have to collect diamonds.

name: Deep Sea Trip
short_description: Deep Sea Trip is a story of a deep water adventure. The deep sea has many natural dangers, but there are new dangers that threaten all deep sea and ocean life. A hero fish must save the day and figure out their way through the ocean and life.

name: Seaberry Holiday
short_description: It's the day of the holiday festival! Help with preparations, decorate buildings and cookies, and choose the perfect gift for Chippy's mom!

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Best Places
short_description: Best Places for you to visit by playing, Jigsaw Puzzle - Best Places is a minimalist game with 5 difficulty levels (64, 144, 289, 484 and 784 pieces) with over 50 beautiful landscapes.

name: Frog Story : The Power Tongue
short_description: Join a thrilling journey with a tiny frog and its mighty tongue, collecting fireflies and sealing the shadows of the Dark Toad King. Navigate through a charming puzzle-platformer world across 96 carefully crafted levels.

name: BattleZ
short_description: 3 years after the first case of the "Z" virus, the infected would still be roaming the world, whether by land or sea. And here, on Tristan da Cunha, a remote island with around 250 inhabitants is where our game takes place.

name: Cursed
short_description: Cursed is a scary atmospheric walking simulator game where you'll need to watch your back and solve a mystery

name: 人形作战兵器 Automata
short_description: Massive mutant creatures are coming at you, control your automata to beat them!

name: Mislight
short_description: An Adventure Platformer game with RPG elements about a girl who is kidnapped by a shadow monster and taken to a forest where she has to fight her way out by using a magical flashlight as her only weapon.

name: Savvy Courier
short_description: Deliver parcels and conquer challenges on procedurally generated maps. Place building cards from your deck. Customize the motorcycle to enhance your abilities. Trigger powerful chain reactions beyond your imagination.

name: Handless show
short_description: Welcome to TV-show. Play and enjoy before the guillotine cut off your hand. Be prepared to put your skills and reflexes to the test in the many mini-games!

name: Demon's Draw
short_description: Demon's Draw is a push-your-luck card-based game where you summon demons to fight, surprizingly, OTHER DEMONS. Travel through the depth of hell and, upgrade your cards to defeat the increasing foe and absorb their power. May luck be with you...

name: Terrarium Builder
short_description: Build as many terrariums as you like, enjoying lo-fi peaceful and relaxing music. Sculpt the terrain, choose plants and decorations, and finally take pictures to share with everyone.

name: Last Knight
short_description: Last Knight is a top-down roguelight game where you have to survive only with a sword in a castle occupied by a monster. There's only a sword in your hand and your two legs Defeat all monsters and escape this castle

name: Total Chaos
short_description: Fort Oasis is no paradise—it's a decaying terrormare where reality crumbles. From the creator of Turbo Overkill comes a survival-horror stacked with mysteries and monstrosities. Scavenge scraps to craft weapons and follow a cryptic voice on your walkie-talkie through the island's depths.

name: Hentai Doctor 2049
short_description: Take control over the medical center of the future! Will you stay calm in time of diagnostic procedure or let your assistant carry out the deep examination?

name: Rabbit Maze
short_description: This is a maze game. You can choose to go through the level mode, or you can choose to build a 100000 block maze in the endless mode to let your computer explode Or, you can watch the rabbit walk out of the maze in Zen mode

name: Beat Back VR
short_description: This game is a rhythm game in which you move your body and destroy flying magic balls. Blow away your stress with a powerful blow, and collect various cards

name: A frog in a well
short_description: This is a hellishly difficult 2D pixel platformer/avoidance game, one of the toughest you've ever seen. You play as a space miner trapped in a mental world by alien monsters, repeatedly escaping the depths of a well and striving to reach your own blue sky, just like a frog at the bottom of the well.

name: Alchemia Story
short_description: Create the character you really want, and explore the alchemy world with the help of "YOME"!

name: Dark Hours
short_description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and wish for daylight.

name: Limits of Sky
short_description: Limits of Sky is a comedy/drama adult video game in which a young girl - in the face of her own mortality - tries to live out her life to the fullest.

name: LustyVerse: ShackBang
short_description: A trip to a cabin in the woods takes one guy and four hot girls trough an unexpected week filled with all kinds of twists and turns, where fun doesn't always promise a happy ending.

name: Señorita Chupacabra
short_description: Third-person shooter with planning, steampunk and magic on Wild West, lay the traps, use magic to support your action, sneak behind the enemy's back, and take control of the enemy to use his strength.

name: Bebop
short_description: Bebop is a private investigator that gets himself mixed with... THE MOB. And he regrets his actions, then comes back home a hero, after having tried to kill an innocent man and having tried to end him in a hospital.

name: Raiders of Ruin
short_description: Raiders of Ruin takes the thrill of battling a mighty MMO raid boss and distils it down into a single-player experience. Study your enemies, assemble your party, and execute your strategy as you face off against dozens of challenging foes in this turn-based fantasy RPG.

name: Psycho Fear
short_description: Psycho Fear is a heart-pounding escape room puzzle where players must escape to survive. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome deadly obstacles in an intense atmosphere, nerve-wracking and dark environment will keep players on edge.

name: Jurassic Park: Survival
short_description: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.

name: Grabitoons!
short_description: Compete with your friends and smack 'em over the head in this physics-based galactic party game for up to four players!

name: Amazing Space
short_description: Welcome to the world of space stations! Create your own space base with workplaces and production facilities. Ensure sustainability and safety, explore space, defend your base, and build diplomatic relationships. Be vigilant and successful!

name: Wrestling Manager 2023
short_description: Wrestling Manager 2023 is an easy-to-use game where you take control of a wrestling company. It offers all the features you need to manage a wrestling company and grow in this business!

name: World of Unlit
short_description: World of Unlit is a fast paced, first person movement shooter where your goal is to utilize your grapple hook, melee weapons, guns and bows to destabilize a culture.

name: Anna: Exciting Affection
short_description: Anna: Exciting Affection is a game about a regular girl, who moves to Sun City with her boyfriend Andrew. A start of a new chapter. Anna will be thrown into the city life and will have to learn to traverse the world of intrigue, adventure, passion and lust.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
short_description: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is an action-adventure game in which you are a Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a dynamic open world set in England’s Dark Ages. Raid your enemies and grow your settlement to earn your place among the gods in Valhalla.

name: Space Time
short_description: Space Time is a classic arcade style shooter with a modern touch. The goal is to destroy space rocks and achieve a high enough score before time runs out. There are 9 unlockable ships, 4 game modes and 3 difficulties.

name: Geometric Hell
short_description: Geometric Hell is an arcade bullet-hell shooter with minimalistic graphics. Survive waves of aggressive geometric shapes and upgrade to keep up with the progressive increase in difficulty. Many deaths are expected before you get a chance to fight the final boss.

name: See Ya Later!
short_description: Your ship crash landed on a randomly generated map, survive long enough to escape by crafting, mining, fishing, and farming!

name: Gravity
short_description: Test your problem solving skills and creativity in over 80 physics-based puzzles. Hours of fun for the completionist with challenges for every level and over 30 unlockables!

name: Simulators2023
short_description: Do you like playing various simulation games? You can experience various simulation contents here, such as curiosity, funny, nostalgia, joy and madness

name: Gemstones
short_description: Casual Arcade-Puzzle game, where you move gems around to pair them together! Relax and get the highest score possible, earning cosmetics along the way.

name: Polaris Outpost
short_description: Polaris Outpost is a Sci-Fi survival game with powerful intelligent adversaries. In addition to using stealth and tactics, you will need to expand your base, craft supplies, and manage your resources to cope with the variety of threats in this hostile environment. Explore, capture, survive, escape!

name: Scavenia Survivors
short_description: Fight off ferocious mutants and vicious monsters, and try to escape alive! In Scavenia Survivor, you're not playing as a hero; instead, you'll feel helplessly trapped in a dark and dangerous world full of dangers waiting to destroy you.

name: Ascent of Ashes
short_description: A colony sim set in a post-apocalyptic dystopia. Build and defend your base. Manage your survivors. Engage raiders, aliens, Remnant soldiers and other factions in real-time-with-pause combat. Or use stealth to outwit them. Explore the massive world. Survive at all costs

name: Above Snakes: Prologue
short_description: In the prologue of Above Snakes, you awake in a destroyed settlement and help the survivors rebuild it. After that, expand the world with world pieces, craft, farm, hunt, build a base, and fight to find out more about what happened.

name: Angira Online
short_description: Angira Online is a survival and building game set in a fantasy Norse world. Set out into an unknown world and make your mark on the unexplored wilderness. Build towns, lay roads, bring civilization to the forests of Angira.

name: The Princess of the Tower Wants a Hero
short_description: A sweet winter themed Otome Visual Novel about a princess of a tower who just wants a hero. … Except she ends up with a tone-deaf bard for a roommate, a sassy demon for a butler and no hero. Still stuck in a tower though.

name: Iron Guard
short_description: A bite-sized pixel art tower defense game.

name: Oniami
short_description: A journey across vast lands.

name: Moorhuhn Piraten - Crazy Chicken Pirates
short_description: 90 seconds to hunt as many chickens and collect as many points as possible. Beat your personal record and compete with players around the world.

name: 1 Rule Sudoku
short_description: Dive into the world of 1 Rule Sudoku, where the classic number puzzle is reimagined with a fresh twist. Featuring endless, procedurally-generated puzzles, this minimalist yet deeply engaging game offers a perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.

name: 7DAYS HEROES
short_description: A pixel-art 2D action game in which four characters fight zombies. Manipulate the formation of four people, change the leading character, separate them, and conquer the stage. Collect weapons and items with everyone and aim for the goal. Enjoy the adventure of about 30 stages in all 7 areas!

name: Hentai Island
short_description: Travel to a magical island, become more powerful than you could imagine, save the world and let love and lust overtake you along the way.

name: Have You Herd?
short_description: Wild animals have overrun the country, but Cowboy Maloy and his herding dogs are here to help! Play alone or play co-op with up to 4 players across various levels and encounter sneaky traps and fun antics. Help Maloy and his pups get their much needed vacation and end the Herd-pocalypse!

name: Reclamation of Xanthros
short_description: Reclamation of Xanthros is a unique Tower-Defense Roguelike. Xeno have taken over the planet Xanthros and you must save it by defeating their Matriarch. Battle across a wide range of biomes with a changing assortment of Towers, Upgrades, and Artifacts. Features a unique turret building mechanic.

name: Lost in Memory
short_description: You play as a girl who has shut herself in her home and refuses to leave. she must explore and find her memories if she ever wants to escape her past. This game is inspired by Yume nikki and various classic RPG Maker horror games.

name: Chess Morph: The Queen's Wormholes
short_description: An original puzzle game inspired by chess. Control a lonely Queen with shapeshifting abilities and defeat the enemy army. Move wisely, explore the wormholes on the board, take the enemy shape and kill them all.

name: Doggy Up!
short_description: A platformer game where you play as a German Shepherd named Ollie, trapped in his own dreams. Can you pass the main challenge and free Ollie from captivity?

name: I Feel The Need
short_description: "You're not going to be happy unless you're going Mach 2 with your hair on fire." Break your limits by taking on the most difficult aerial missions known to man. Ride straight into the danger zone, risk high G-forces to pull off insane maneuvers, and engage in thrilling dogfights.

name: sim4D ATC
short_description: You will act as the apron/tower controller and command the inbound/outbound operations by issuing voice commands in the virtual radio channel. The AI captain will interact with synthetic voice. Current version needs to have basic ATC knowledge, and the tutorial will be released in a later version.

name: Interplayer
short_description: Pick up the tokens, write the source code, and repair the data that your doctor has deleted! Write source code that achieves the input and expected output pairs set for each stage. The code is written in tolerance, a dedicated language.

name: Bullet Destroyer
short_description: Someone challenges himself and climbs a mountain, and someone climbs a beanstalk.

name: Tozerath In Ruins
short_description: Project Ruins is a Top-Down RPG with turn-based combat. Welcome to the land of Tozerath in the realm of Luminoria. Even after launch, there will be updates.

name: Fire of Life: New Day Playtest
NoEL - Nothing on Elysion Line
short_description: 노엘은 싱글 플레이어 로그 라이트 게임입니다. 전투를 거치고 덱을 만들어 일대기의 마지막 장까지 도달해 보세요. 모든 것의 끝에서 기다리고 있는 것은 과연 누구일까요?

name: Digital Frida
short_description: Digital Frida is a roguelike arena game in stylized 2D graphics.Welcome to the online virtual reality server "Digital Frida", where you can become whoever you want, do whatever you want and be wherever you want!

name: Delivoo Delivery Sim
short_description: Deliver orders through the large city of Peytor Town and save enough money to open a restaurant. Make sure you're ready, as there's a lot of challenges waiting for you!

name: Aviator: Air Combat
short_description: Plunge into the world of sky battles. Pursue an enemy bomber while dodging oncoming missiles. Get your adrenaline pumping and be rewarded with a bonus level.

name: SCAN
short_description: Outsmart and outgun your opponents in this unique multiplayer shooter.

name: Awaken
short_description: In Awaken, a punk world that combines 2D and 3D, the protagonist wakes up unexpectedly. On the way to escape, he shuttles among various forces in the world to complete various tasks. This is an action adventure game with RPG elements, full of surprises, waiting for you to explore and discover.

name: University Love Affair
short_description: University life is always interesting. It is full of romance, dreams and plans for the future. Derek Winters is a university student. Difficulties appeared on his way, having passed which he will be able to find harmony, love and everything he wants. His fate is in your hands. YOU can help him or...

name: Beach Invasion 1944
short_description: Defend the fortified beach during D-day against invading forces in this WW2 FPS game as the enemy attacks you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic WWII weapons such as MG42, Flak88 and Panzers, prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

name: Skybox
short_description: What could be easier than jumping on a skateboard and driving in a straight line to the finish line? It is so? :)

name: Crux: The Great Outdoors
short_description: Solve grid-based climbing challenges in this unique time-based puzzler. Figure out the right sequence to move your hands and feet and execute it flawlessly - or you will fall!

name: 仙道孤旅
short_description: 修仙生存类游戏，在游戏中你将打造法器，喂养灵兽，种植灵草，在不断的修炼中提升境界提升寿命，达到化神境界飞升灵界。

name: POG X
short_description: Cute, minimal physical puzzle.

name: PIP L
short_description: PIP L — cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

name: Guardians of Elderon
short_description: Guardians of Elderon is a free-to-play combat-focused base builder game. Here you get to create your very own fantasy base, summon powerful guardians, go on unique quests and attack the base of other players to become the greatest summoner in Elderon!

name: Hentai Leaked!? Only for Fans
short_description: Naked photos of girls prepared for their fans have been stolen, fight against opponents, upgrade your character, give photos back to girls and get your reward...

name: Nightmare Inside
short_description: Join Finn on his adventure through the most beautiful periods of his adolescence! Finn, a 16 year old boy, lives in a cute town with his mother and friends. So, what will happen in his life? Put on your coats to find out, because Norway is cold! This game is not suitable for all audiences.

name: House Hopper
short_description: JUMP, FALL, CRACK, REPEAT! This stress inducing golf-like 3D platformer will push your resolve to the limit. Climb through super-hard levels, solve puzzles, unlock hidden playable objects! Beat your highscores! Is the game too hard? GET BETTER!

name: Adventures of Red
short_description: The Adventures of Red is a simple platformer game with soft background music and fun gameplay. Help Red find his way through the beautiful but Cursed Forest and back to his home.

name: Mushroom Collector Simulator
short_description: Mushroom Collector Simulator is a mushroom picking simulator that involves you in the hunt for many different mushrooms that grow in the wild. Collect mushrooms, enjoy walks through the forest, complete missions, upgrade your hut and equipment.

name: WiZmans World Re;Try
short_description: WiZmans World Re;Try is HD remaster of legendary JRPG WiZmans World from Jaleco with enhanced 2D pixelated graphic and sound. Experience the vast world of Wizarest with 3 fairly like homunculis.

name: Rolando Deluxe
short_description: Control a team of unique rolling characters in this delightful puzzle-platformer. Use each Rolando's special abilities and powerful gadgets such as bomb cannons, catapults, elevators, and magical bridges to solve puzzles, shepherd sleeping royalty and traverse action-packed environments.

name: The Shadow Over Route 80
short_description: Alone at night, working at a petrol station deep in the American wheat belt. Something feels off... are you sure you're alone? A short 10-15 minute horror game with multiple endings.

name: Look for connecting stars
short_description: It's a starry sky story where you control your character to fly freely through the universe, collect cosmic gems, and use the abilities of a black hole to devour enemies. At the same time, we add obstacles and disappearing modes to make your challenges more interesting.

name: Southern Legends - The Temple Defenders
short_description: Master the arcane arts of magic and mow down hundreds of dark spawns. Defend the ancient temple and its treasures till dawn! Temple Defenders is a casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can mean either you will survive or perish the night. Gather gold and upgrade your skills/stats.

name: Europa
short_description: On the moon Europa, a lush terraformed paradise in Jupiter’s shadow, an android named Zee sets out in search of answers. Run, glide and fly across the landscape, solve mysteries in the ruins of a fallen utopia, and discover the story of the last human alive.

name: Commander: Modern War
short_description: Experience the thrill of a modern conflict between two factions, as you outsmart your opponents in an epic game of strategy and cunning. Take command of your ground, air, and naval units and lead them to victory in the most immersive turn-based battle simulation. The battlefield awaits.

name: Arcane - Tower Defense
short_description: Build your own towers by choosing and combining randomized upgrades. Would you like an anti-air tower that leaves its targets with a burning effect? Lightning attacks that deal Splash damage and bounce from enemy to enemy? There are over 25 million possible combinations!

name: A Slime In Time
short_description: Dive into a world where a simple slime must help a 100 year old sentient blender, Sir Blendsworth, retrieve chocolate covered ice cream for his 100th birthday! Jump from platform to platform, moving through time to find a clear path, but beware. The higher you climb, the farther you fall.

name: cat and rat
short_description: 一款双人欢乐追逐游戏

name: Get To The Gate
short_description: GetToTheGate is a RPG about a girl that needs to reach the Gate to the world of the living while being extremely scared of monsters. When her fear builds up, she loses her mana and runs to safety. Find a shortcut to bypass the enemies and explore the dungeon from a new location ^_^

name: Maze Monsters
short_description: Maze Monsters is a procedurally generated, roguelike dungeon platformer where vicious threats and dangerous foes make for an original and action-packed adventure every time.

name: Conquer Humanity
short_description: Become the super villain in this brutal, top down, fast paced hack and slash where you face ever strengthening forces trying to stop you. Master your abilities in combat, dismember civilians, cause mass destruction, defeat armed enemies and bosses. Conquer Humanity!

name: Twin Mind: Nobody's Here Collector's Edition
short_description: Science has never been more dangerous! Death is in the air... Sounds pretty ominous, doesn't it? Help the twin detectives solve a new case!

name: 妖之梦
short_description: 在Roguelike世界中收集妖兽，构建自己的妖兽小队，获取妖兽的各种技能给予其提升，在6V6单打回合制下战胜各种有趣的挑战，最终获得胜利。

name: Virago: Herstory
short_description: Virago herstory is about a little girl called Willow who after running away from her home becomes a victim of stalking

name: NanoWar: Cells VS Virus
short_description: Fight against the viruses and cure the entire body! A fast-paced real-time strategy game of cell conquest. Lot of players already got the bug... ready to defend your cells?

name: Jewel Match Winter Wonderland 2 Collector's Edition
short_description: ’Tis the season for chestnuts, mistletoe, and Match-3. Travel snow-clad lands across more than 200 huge levels and rebuild a cozy village. Then start decorating the houses for the festive season. Grab a hot chocolate while you play bonus games with jigsaw puzzles, clutter, or spot the difference.

name: Scott Pilgrim vs. The World™: The Game – Complete Edition
short_description: Rediscover the beloved 2D arcade-style beat 'em up inspired by the iconic comic and movie Scott Pilgrim vs. The World!

name: Army Troop
short_description: Army Troop is an old-school PvP World War 2 online first-person shooter. Reminding you of the good old days World War games.

name: SpikerMan X
short_description: The evil alien lizard Kromatone has returned to try and take over the galaxy! And he’s brought several of his former partners in crime to help him succeed! It’s up to SpikerMan to defeat all the crime bosses and defeat Kromatone himself before he takes over everything!

name: 我在终点线等你
short_description: 一个讲述少年少女勇敢踏出追梦第一步的青春日常系故事。

name: Cheers!
short_description: Cheers is a cooperative puzzle party-game for two players who will have to coordinate and work together to combine pairs of elements and create new ones!

name: Speluncaphobia
short_description: A retro-inspired short horror game about caving.

name: Shishi : Timeless Prelude
short_description: In this single-player turn-based dungeon crawler RPG, become Elia, a young mage, who must explore the depths of a sacred sanctuary and complete her training to become an Oracle.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
short_description: Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat.

name: Anime City
short_description: Anime City is a Japanese high school simulator, focused on anime culture and aesthetics. Study, join school clubs, and make friends.

name: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT
short_description: A storm is coming. Venture into the complete Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC; forge your own path through this open-world action adventure and uncover its hidden wonders. Brought to you by Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software and PlayStation Studios.

name: Efpiyes
short_description: Efpiyes is a multiplayer first-person shooter with a built-in map editor that anyone can use.

name: Frogurai
short_description: Welcome to feudal Japan, a world of samurais and danger. In this world, you play as a frog samurai tasked with taking down the snake clan and bringing an end to the war.

name: Colossal Cave
short_description: Acclaimed game designer Roberta Williams revives Colossal Cave as a retro, point-&-click, cave exploration puzzler. Based on the original 1970’s design by Will Crowther & Don Woods this 3D update maintains its vintage charm, while revitalizing it for modern gamers.

name: Retail Wars
short_description: Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining 4 player couch competitive party game. Pickup and throw anything in the store to serve customers and knock out your friends in the fight to become the coveted employee of the month!

name: 30-50 Feral Hogs
short_description: Legit question for rural Americans - How do I kill the 30-50 feral hogs that run into my yard within 3-5 mins while my small kids play?

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Succubus
short_description: When Sumire is summoned to another world by a powerful succubus, she must learn to master her new powers to return to her world.

name: Subject F-011
short_description: Trapped in Area 51 on planet Earth, you must solve calculated puzzles to escape this strange planet. Puzzles consist of using enemies' mechanics to your advantage, moving objects to block enemies, and using items that alter parts of the rooms. A spiritual successor to Adventures of Lolo.

name: Click Real Fast
short_description: Prepare yourself to Click... Real... Fast. Push your mouse, keyboard, or controller to its breaking point—if it has buttons, it probably works. Click Real Fast and see who survives: you, or your hardware.

name: Trinity Of The Fabled
short_description: DARK FANTASY ACTION RPG. Join Trinity Of The Fabled, a league of Warriors, Gods, and Demons who traverse the Abyss in seek of wealth and power. A new dark fantasy experience with brutal combat, dragon riding, and an evolving world with each season.

name: Brave the Dungeon
short_description: Brave the Dungeon is a thrilling and immersive multiplayer open-world game that takes you on an epic journey to fight against the daemonic invasion threatening the archipelago.

name: 抵御者 Defender
short_description: This is a simple fighting game. You only need to press 3 buttons to experience easy battles. The original intention of this game is to bring the most simple and refreshing feeling of combat.

name: Gräuel
short_description: GRÄUEL is a cooperative horror game (1 to 5 players) where you are plunged into an endless nightmare. Run from a relentless monster, kill corrupted creatures, find runes, combine them to increase their rarity, and sell them to upgrade yourself.

name: Late photographer 6
short_description: A short love story

name: MetaBall - Multiplayer Basketball
short_description: Experience the thrill of Hoverboard Basketball! Team up or challenge players worldwide in fast-paced crossplay PvP matches. Master the ball, dribble, and outwit your opponents to score impressive goals— with no aim assist. Only skill and creativity matter. Grab your Hoverboard and dominate now!

name: Finger Trees
short_description: Travel to different worlds to save every version of your family from the sickness created by Finger Trees.

name: ARTificial
short_description: Dig into the truth hidden in the artist's strange paintings through the puzzle.

name: Winter
short_description: Winter — is an adveture third person game in medieval setting with intense gameplay and exciting combat system. Along the way, you will meet creatures that will challenge you to fight and try to get your power.Fight the demons, overcome obstacles, complete the story.

name: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE
short_description: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden.

name: Another Bar Game
short_description: A casual action game where you serve craft beer to thirsty bar guests. Become the most popular bartender in town! Wash glasses, clean tables and keep everybody happy!

name: ZaBaTa!
short_description: ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game where you must find human players hidden among AI NPCs. Blend in, complete missions, and most importantly - don't get caught! Play ZaBaTa! with friends for even more fun.

name: 枪神出击
short_description: Hurry to encircle the growing monsters in the nest! Upgrade weapons, choose your exclusive occupation, strategy combination, a 15 minute meat pigeon experience, and directly shoot, explode, brush, explode!! You can also select the 20 minute mode!

name: Magicube
short_description: A magical puzzle platformer made with PICO-8. Be thinky to get the legendary treasure.

name: 沉默的蟋蟀
